title: [Movie] Nova Zembla (2011)
body:
When I started the film, my only goal was to pass the afternoon, but it ended up sparking my interest in historical events I never studied in school.

There's so much history we simply don't know, that finding it through a film is a bonus that makes watching it worthwhile.

Nova Zembla tells the story of Willem Barentsz's third expedition, searching for an alternative route to India and China through the north, to avoid paying the Spanish and Portuguese, who held the monopoly on the known trade routes.

What began as a journey full of hope and the promise of riches soon turned into a nightmare, as the north proved exactly why no one had ventured through it successfully before.

>! [SPOILER] When the expedition became trapped in the Arctic ice, the mission shifted to something far more primal: surviving the winter.

The film narrates the historical events that were recorded in the diary of one of the crew members, Gerrit de Veer, published a year after the expedition's miraculous return.

An interesting fact worth noting: that account is considered the first best-seller in history, having been published in several languages and spread across the world.

This is the kind of film that pushes you to research more about history, and learn a bit from it, because it isn't always boring — and as they say, sometimes truth is stranger than fiction, as is the case here.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRPyxKNjuyr44z8bSVb93xUY9FTfm8RprBjHRYKUcL2n/1000109255.jpg)


| Campo / Field | Información / Information |
|---|---|
| **Título original / Original title** | Nova Zembla |
| **País / Country** | Países Bajos / Netherlands |
| **Año / Year** | 2011 |
| **Género / Genre** | Drama histórico, aventura / Historical drama, adventure |
| **Director** | Reinout Oerlemans |
| **Guion / Screenplay** | Reinout Oerlemans, Hugo Heinen; basado en el diario de Gerrit de Veer (1598) / Reinout Oerlemans, Hugo Heinen; based on the diary of Gerrit de Veer (1598) |
| **Reparto / Cast** | Robert de Hoog (Gerrit de Veer), Derek de Lint (Willem Barentsz), Victor Reinier (Jacob van Heemskerck), Jan Decleir (Petrus Plancius), Doutzen Kroes (Catharina Plancius), Semmy Schilt (Claes) |
| **Dato notable / Notable fact** | Primera película neerlandesa filmada en 3D / First Dutch feature film shot in 3D |
| **Locaciones de rodaje / Filming locations** | Islandia, Bélgica, Canadá / Iceland, Belgium, Canada |
| **Basada en / Based on** | El tercer viaje de Willem Barentsz y Jacob van Heemskerck (1596–1597) en busca del Paso del Noreste hacia las Indias / The third voyage of Willem Barentsz and Jacob van Heemskerck (1596–1597) in search of the Northeast Passage to the Indies |
| **Licencias artísticas / Artistic license** | La relación romántica entre Gerrit de Veer y Catharina Plancius es ficticia / The romantic relationship between Gerrit de Veer and Catharina Plancius is fictional |




Cuando empecé la película no tenía más objetivo que pasar la tarde, pero ésta logró despertar mi interés por hechos históricos que nunca estudié en la escuela.

Es decir, hay tanta historia que no conocemos, que encontrarla en una película es un plus que hace que verla valga la pena.

Nova Zembla narra la tercera expedición de Willem Barentsz buscando una ruta alternativa a India y China por el norte, para evitar el pago a españoles y portugueses que tenían el monopolio de las vías conocidas.

Lo que empezó como una travesía llena de esperanzas y promesa de riquezas, pronto se convirtió en pesadilla cuando el norte demostró por qué nadie se había aventurado por allí con éxito.

>! [SPOILER] Cuando la expedición quedó atrapada en los hielos árticos, la misión cambió a algo mucho más primario: sobrevivir el invierno.

La película narra los hechos históricos que fueron registrados en el diario de uno de los tripulantes, Gerrit de Veer, que fue publicado un año después del milagroso regreso de la expedición.

Como curiosidad cabe destacar que esas memorias son consideradas el primer best-seller de la historia, al ser publicadas en varios idiomas, y extenderse por el mundo.

Este es el tipo de películas que te mueven a investigar más sobre la historia, y aprender un poco de ella, porque no siempre es aburrida, y como se suele decir, a veces la realidad supera a la ficción, como en este caso.

title: Market Updates, STARBITS Trading, and Opening New Card Packs
body:
Hello everyone! Welcome back to my blog today. I hope you are all having a great day and enjoying your time on Hive. Today, I want to share some of my recent activities, market updates, and game progress with all of you.

မင်္ဂလာပါသူငယ်ချင်းတို့ရေ။ ဒီနေ့ ကျွန်မရဲ့ Hive ဘလော့ဂ်ကနေ ပြန်လည်ကြိုဆိုလိုက်ပါတယ်။ အားလုံးပဲ သာယာသောနေ့လေးဖြစ်ပြီး Hive မှာ ပျော်ရွှင်စရာအချိန်တွေကို ဖြတ်သန်းနေကြလိမ့်မယ်လို့ မျှော်လင့်ပါတယ်။ ဒီနေ့မှာတော့ ကျွန်မရဲ့ မားကတ်အခြေအနေတွေ၊ ဂိမ်းကစားမှုနဲ့ ကတ်ထုပ်ဖွင့်ခဲ့တဲ့ အတွေ့အကြုံလေးတွေကို မျှဝေပေးသွားမှာပါ။


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPLJ2bHRYZh794jPPvkfH1ytevxqiBmiBnW3rDiuSjHnU/1788138805367.jpg)


First, let us take a look at the current market situation for Hive on Binance. Looking at the chart, the price of HIVE/USDT is currently around $0.0426. We can see that the price dropped to a low of $0.0373 recently, but it has started to recover slightly. Even though the market is quiet, keeping an eye on these price movements is very important for all of us on the platform.


ပထမဆုံးအနေနဲ့ Binance မှာရှိတဲ့ Hive ရဲ့ လက်ရှိဈေးကွက်အခြေအနေကို ကြည့်လိုက်ရအောင်ပါ။ တတ်လာတဲ့ Chart အရ HIVE/USDT ဈေးနှုန်းဟာ လက်ရှိမှာ $0.0426 ဝန်းကျင်မှာ ရှိနေပါတယ်။ ပြီးခဲ့တဲ့ရက်ပိုင်းက $0.0373 အထိ ကျဆင်းသွားခဲ့ပေမဲ့ အခုတော့ နည်းနည်းလေး ပြန်တက်လာတာကို တွေ့ရပါတယ်။ ဈေးကွက်က အေးနေပေမဲ့လည်း ကျွန်မတို့ Platform ကို သုံးစွဲသူတွေအတွက်တော့ ဒီလို ဈေးနှုန်းအတက်အကျတွေကို စောင့်ကြည့်နေဖို့ လိုအပ်ပါတယ်။


Next, I checked Tribaldex to see the latest price and order book for STARBITS, which is the main token for the Rising Star game. As we can see from the market chart, the price is staying quite stable around 0.00000232 HIVE, with small fluctuations over time. Looking at the buy and sell orders, many players are actively trading their STARBITS, which shows that the game ecosystem is still alive and active.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2acMX6rh6QULyjLA9xUQA9jGe4GY3tW1rsyuWj5ykbo/ai_generated.webp)

ဒုတိယအနေနဲ့ Rising Star ဂိမ်းရဲ့ အဓိက တိုကင်ဖြစ်တဲ့ STARBITS ရဲ့ ဈေးနှုန်းနဲ့ Trading အခြေအနေကို Tribaldex မှာ သွားရောက်ကြည့်ရှုခဲ့ပါတယ်။ Chart အရ ဈေးနှုန်းဟာ 0.00000232 HIVE ဝန်းကျင်မှာ ငြိမ်နေပြီး အပြောင်းအလဲ နည်းနည်းပဲ ရှိပါသေးတယ်။ Buy Orders နဲ့ Sell Orders တွေကို ကြည့်ခြင်းအားဖြင့် ကစားသမားတော်တော်များများဟာ STARBITS တွေကို တက်တက်ကြွကြွ အရောင်းအဝယ် လုပ်နေကြဆဲဖြစ်တာကို တွေ့ရပါတယ်။


After checking the market prices, I decided to open some Rising Star Card Packs to add new cards to my collection. Opening card packs is always one of the most exciting parts of playing Rising Star because you never know what rare cards you might get. Every pack guarantees at least one rare or better card, which makes it even more fun.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAk2cTof4a3hm4yJ5rmPNMp7HEtDkuPoA6sG5tVeujWg/1778387232876.jpg)


ဈေးကွက်အခြေအနေတွေကို စစ်ဆေးပြီးတဲ့နောက်မှာတော့ ကျွန်မရဲ့ ကတ်စုဆောင်းမှုကို ပိုမိုအားကောင်းလာစေဖို့ Rising Star Card Pack တစ်ချို့ကို ဖွင့်ဖို့ ဆုံးဖြတ်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ Card Pack တွေ ဖွင့်ရတာဟာ Rising Star ကစားသူတိုင်းအတွက် အရင်လှဆုံးနဲ့ စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားစရာ အကောင်းဆုံး အစိတ်အပိုင်းတစ်ခုပါ။ ဘာကြောင့်လဲဆိုတော့ ဘယ်လို Rare Card မျိုး ရမလဲဆိုတာ မသိနိုင်လို့ပါ။ Pack တိုင်းမှာ အနည်းဆုံး Rare Card တစ်ကတ် သေချာပေါက် ပါဝင်တာမို့ ပိုပြီး ရင်ခုန်ဖို့ ကောင်းပါတယ်။


From the card pack I opened today, I was lucky enough to draw three interesting cards. The first card was an i340 Soprano Recorder, which adds 1 Luck point to my total stats. The second card was 251 Kat, a common card that gives me 5 Fans and 5 Skill. These small additions are very helpful for balancing stats and keeping progress steady.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmStn6JF9XtgpFgczXkqPDu9pXxMv6EknjT62PsUigsZVi/img_0.061951704236576616.jpg)

ဒီနေ့ ကျွန်မဖွင့်လိုက်တဲ့ ကတ်ထုပ်ထဲကနေ စိတ်ဝင်စားစရာ ကတ်သုံးကတ် ရရှိခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ပထမကတ်ကတော့ Luck 1 ပေးတဲ့ i340 Soprano Recorder ကတ်လေးပါ။ ဒုတိယကတ်ကတော့ 251 Kat ဆိုတဲ့ Common ကတ်လေးဖြစ်ပြီး Fans 5 နဲ့ Skill 5 ကို ပေါင်းစည်းပေးပါတယ်။ ဒီလို ကတ်သေးသေးလေးတွေက အမှတ်တွေကို ညီမျှစေပြီး ဂိမ်းတိုးတက်မှုကို ပုံမှန်ထိန်းထားနိုင်ဖို့ တကယ်ကို အထောက်အကူပြုပါတယ်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRKzMxpdfWXuUQPqu3BLeNAtpVLTWE9BXm8XT2tUos6V/img_0.3710072561825513.jpg)

The best part of this pack was the Rare card I received, which is R676 Mira. This card provides a big boost to my account with 115 Fans, 135 Skill, 2 Luck, and 5 IM. Getting a card with high skill points like Mira is always great because it helps prevent ego from building up too fast when performing missions.


ဒီကတ်ထုပ်ရဲ့ အကောင်းဆုံးအပိုင်းကတော့ R676 Mira ဆိုတဲ့ Rare ကတ်လေး ရရှိခဲ့တာပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ဒီကတ်က ကျွန်မရဲ့ အကောင့်အတွက် Fans 115၊ Skill 135၊ Luck 2 နဲ့ IM 5 အထိ တိုးတက်စေပါတယ်။ Mira လို Skill အမှတ်အများကြီးပေးတဲ့ ကတ်မျိုး ရရှိတာဟာ ဂိမ်းထဲမှာ မစ်ရှင်တွေ လုပ်တဲ့အခါ Ego တက်လာမှုကို ထိန်းချုပ်ပေးနိုင်တာမို့ အင်မတန်မှ ဝမ်းသာစရာ ကောင်းပါတယ်။


Overall, it was a productive day for me on Hive. Monitoring the HIVE price on Binance, checking STARBITS on Tribaldex, and upgrading my Rising Star inventory with new cards made my day complete. Consistent effort and steady collection are the keys to growing on this platform.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVLyThM3Fqa8wJw2mFubfxxh8MkuvrLTa1JfLyyLELRf/1778387201786.png)

ခြုံပြီးပြောရရင် ဒီနေ့ဟာ ကျွန်မအတွက် Hive မှာ အချိန်တွေကို အကျိုးရှိရှိ အသုံးပြုနိုင်ခဲ့တဲ့ နေ့တစ်နေ့ ဖြစ်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ Binance မှာ HIVE ဈေးကို စောင့်ကြည့်တာ၊ Tribaldex မှာ STARBITS အခြေအနေ စစ်ဆေးတာနဲ့ Rising Star မှာ ကတ်အသစ်တွေ တိုးပွားလာတာတွေက ကျွန်မရဲ့နေ့ရက်ကို ပြည့်စုံစေခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဒီ Platform မှာ တိုးတက်ဖို့အတွက် ပုံမှန် ကြိုးစားအားထုတ်မှုနဲ့ စုဆောင်းမှုတွေက အဓိက သော့ချက်ပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။


Thank you so much for taking the time to read my blog post today. I hope you enjoyed this update, and I would love to hear your thoughts in the comments section below. Wish you all success in your daily gaming and Hive journey!

ဒီနေ့ ကျွန်မရဲ့ ပို့စ်ကို အချိန်ပေးပြီး ဖတ်ရှုပေးခဲ့ကြတဲ့အတွက် ကျေးဇူးအများကြီး တင်ပါတယ်။ ဒီ update လေးကို သဘောကျလိမ့်မယ်လို့ မျှော်လင့်ပါတယ်၊ ကွန်မန့်မှာလည်း သူငယ်ချင်းတို့ရဲ့ အမြင်တွေကို မျှဝေပေးခဲ့ကြပါဦးနော်။ အားလုံးပဲ ဂိမ်းကစားရာမှာရော Hive ခရီးစဉ်မှာပါ အဆင်ပြေအောင်မြင်ကြပါစေလို့ ဆုတောင်းပေးပါတယ်။

title: Indiaunited 🇮🇳 Weekly Contest
body: > This topic is complicated to explain because I honestly believe that sometimes our way of dressing can be important, especially in special moments like a job interview or a date with someone we like. On other occasions, I don't think what other people think or say about us influences our behavior too much. Well, that's my opinion, but perhaps it does affect others. I personally try to dress as well as possible, but not all the time, since comfort is essential for me. I really like black shirts, and also, since I live on an island, I almost always wear shorts that allow for better ventilation, as the heat has been extremely intense lately. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXU8LGXGyv8iP6dN7QZu3cvkuFennY6xEmsrYWMcSA6VE/1788138774435.jpg) Perhaps some people criticize our way of dressing and can offer advice to help us improve, but most criticism is meant to belittle us or make us feel bad, which could undoubtedly affect our mental health. Constant teasing from malicious people will always be a part of our lives, and it's up to us whether we allow these comments, whose clear intention is to harm us, to enter our lives. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRPJzrKGF65AFud2vWZWn5nqGv64mNDsFqvQdfps5JyZA/1788138799886.jpg) [source](https://expansion.mx/tecnologia/2013/08/14/anunciantes-dejan-askfm-tras-suicidio) When it comes to children, it's even more complicated because, as we know, they are children and may not understand the power of words. It's fair to say that this can be an attitude these children see in their parents and try to replicate, thinking it's not harmful to anyone. This is a mistake in how they are raised, a mistake that begins at home, and in this case, in childhood. If this isn't corrected, it will be very dangerous for both the child and others who could become potential victims of a word that's on everyone's lips these days: bullying. In my day, it was common, but perhaps our generation was a bit more resilient mentally. Right now, it's complicated because it leads to various problems among students due to constant teasing, whether it's about their clothing or some other distinguishing characteristic. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPPsmALyc5XSZz7Gsmg5WpQ5io1N8x9EqVTVeJrAWrMZT/1788138851245.jpg) [source](https://elpais.com/mamas-papas/expertos/2022-05-02/como-detectar-el-acoso-escolar-y-si-tu-hijo-es-el-acosador.html?outputType=amp) This concludes my small contribution to the weekly #iucontest contest of the @indiaunited community, where we share our thoughts on a specific topic. This one is undoubtedly complex and difficult because not everyone thinks or acts the same way when faced with criticism, especially in countries where EDUCATION isn't the best. However, we can teach that we must respect everyone without distinction of color, race, religion, or something as trivial as clothing.

title: Television Review: Thine Own Self (Star Trek: The Next Generation, S7x16, 1994)
body:
![(source:imdb.com)](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/M/MV5BZDZkODRiNTItMzNmMi00ZjU0LWE5NzUtMjFlZmY2OGYxMzFkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_FMjpg_UX1000_.jpg)

**Thine Own Self (S70E16)**

Airdate: 14 February 1994

Written by: Ronald D. Moore
Directed by: Winrich Kolbe

Running Time: 46 minutes



As *Star Trek: The Next Generation* approached its terminal bow in the seventh season, the creative resources and narrative opportunities available to the production team began to dwindle significantly. There were fewer chances to pay off long-standing narrative debts, to introduce new \

concepts that hadn't been seen before, or to deliver genuine fan service. In a bid to maximise the value of the final episodes, producers often resorted to stuffing as much of this remaining content into a single hour of television, even if it meant juggling multiple, disparate storylines. The result of such experiments was a mixed bag, often leaving episodes feeling rushed, tonally disjointed, or overstuffed. This strategy did not always yield success, not even when the script was written by Star Trek’s celebrated author Ronald D. Moore. The Season 7 episode *Thine Own Self* serves as a prime example of this, embodying the pitfalls of the final-season cramming strategy while still managing to deliver moments of genuine intrigue.\n\nThe narrative arc involving Data begins with a somewhat intriguing cold open set on Barkonia IV, a planet inhabited by humanoid beings who are at  pre-industrial level of civilisation. Data has been dispatched to safely retrieve radioactive material from a crashed probe. However, an incident involving a power surge has affected Data’s positronic brain, inducing a sudden bout of amnesia. Stumbling into a local village, he is spotted by the magistrate Garvin (Michael Rothhaar) and his young daughter Gia (Kimberly Cullum). Data initially struggles with communication, but he gradually establishes a rapport with Garvin and forms a genuine friendship with Gia. They take him to their healer, Talur (Ronnie Claire Edwards), who happens to be the village's most educated person and an amateur scientist. Observing Data's pale skin and translucent appearance, she believes he is a humanoid from distant snowy mountains and dubs him the nickname \
Data, oblivious to what the word \

actually means, begins giving away the objects he retrieved to the villagers. Consequently, they begin to succumb to radioactive poisoning—not only Garvin and Gia, but the general populace. This leads to a mob mentality where the \

is blamed for the sickness. Talur, however, recognises Data's intellect and assists him when he begins using the scientific method to quickly deduce that the objects are the cause of the disease and even find the cure. He administers the cure by dropping it into the village well, the easiest method of spreading it among the villagers. Data nevertheless gets attacked by a mob, impaled, and apparently killed. Days later, Riker and Dr. Crusher, while looking for Data, appear in the village surgically changed to look like Barkonians. They meet Gia, who shows them \
grave. His body is beamed up, and Data is later repaired in sickbay. When he wakes up, he has no memory of his adventures as \

\n\nThe second storyline deals with Counselor Troi, who, after learning that Dr. Crusher obtained the rank of Commander despite not requiring it for her position as Chief Medical Officer of the Enterprise, decides she must obtain it too. Partially inspired by her own brief experience of command of the Enterprise during a catastrophic encounter with quantum filaments a few years earlier, she applies for the test and goes through a series of simulations, each time failing. She gets further frustrated when Riker, who began calling her \

and offering her casual affection, fails to provide her with the help or critical feedback she needs. It is only when, during a simulation, she orders LaForge to sacrifice his life, that Riker arrives and tells her that she passed. His reasoning is cynical but accurate: ordering friends and subordinates to death is a fundamental part of command, and Troi demonstrated she was capable of making that sacrifice.

Ideally, each of the two storylines could have worked significantly better if they had been utilised in separate episodes. This way, both narratives suffer from a lack of focus and development, as the hour struggles to balance the high concept sci-fi elements of Data's adventure with the character drama of Troi's career progression. The first storyline, based on the pitch of Data as Frankenstein's monster in the [classic 1931 film](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-frankenstein-1931), is more interesting and better made, mainly because of the use of somewhat exotic props, costumes, and studio sets. The script also mixes black humour with suspense, especially when it becomes likely that Data might cause a catastrophe very much like the real-life Goiania incident where radioactive material caused widespread sickness and death. The episode suffers from a lack of originality in some of the images—Data's entrance into the village feels derivative—and the predictable outcome, but it is mostly saved by the presence of Ronnie Claire Edwards, a veteran television actress who wonderfully plays a woman who is both ahead of her time yet hopelessly wrong in her scientific conclusions.

In contrast, the second storyline is probably more satisfying to fans who would love to see some of the major characters advance after years of being in professional or personal stasis—apart from the promotion, Troi gets minor hints about rekindling her romance with Riker—but it nevertheless feels rushed, uninspired, and not exactly memorable. 

Ultimately, high production values and confident direction of Winrich Kolbe make this episode solid, but it is nevertheless a disappointment and a clear sign that near the end TNG producers began to have their creativity exhausted. 


RATING: 5/10 (++)

body.title: 走霉运
body.body:
![vxtt1-6bf4fa7a95be.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/alpha-omega/lkt-mtfcscd5-a1vu0qjm/vxtt1-6bf4fa7a95be.webp)

昨天孩子打了狂犬疫苗，没想到今天我被马蜂蛰了。今天上午11点多家里飞进来一只马蜂，个头挺大的，一直落在窗户上。我尝试了好几次马蜂都没飞出去，于是我拿了几张餐巾纸叠起来，准备抓住马蜂扔出去。刚抓住马蜂就感到右手中指的指头肚感到一阵刺疼，把我疼的马上丢到马蜂，孩子妈见状拿起扫把把马蜂赶到窗户外面。接下来一分钟我持续感到指头疼痛，并且逐渐肿胀起来。

就像灼烧一样，并且越来越疼。需要马上就医，我赶紧来到小区门口的社区诊所，社区的医生说没有针对马蜂的特效药，让我去大医院看看。于是我又打了一辆车来到孩子昨天打狂犬疫苗的医院，准备挂急诊科，护士说不确定能不能看马蜂蛰伤，让我直接找医生问问。于是我直接进入医生办公室，医生看过后说没有针对马蜂的药或者针，回家用碘伏消毒静养就可以了。我问需不需要打狂犬疫苗，医生说马蜂是昆虫，和猫狗之类动物是不同的，主要靠人体自身代谢消肿。

听了医生的话我逐渐放下心来，又打了辆车回家，手指头依然有些疼，回到家我用碘伏擦拭几下。这几天尽量少用右手中指，这让我敲键盘有些麻烦。自从养了猫家里就比较折腾，钱花了一大堆，麻烦事也是一桩接着一桩。

The beauty of flowers in the natural environment is one of the beauties and people love and like flowers to enjoy the beauty of flowers. Flowers are the worshipers of beauty and flowers come to the world to give beauty. There is no person in the world who does not love flowers. Because flowers contain the same natural beauty that people have learned to feel with their hearts and in real life, they have learned to make the beauty of flowers cheerful and joyful in their lives. Today I am sharing a very beautiful crop flower in the natural environment and I saw this flower with my own eyes which I liked very much. The name of this beautiful yellow shaped flower is Sesbania javanica Plant flower. I found this flower very beautiful and attractive to look at and because I liked it, I took a few pictures with my mobile and now I am sharing those pictures.




I saw this beautiful flower blooming beautifully in a crop field on the east side of my workplace school, and I really enjoyed seeing the flowers like this. It is a weed-like flower that grows in crop fields. In fact, a tree has different branches and each branch has a few flower petals, which makes the flower look very beautiful and wonderful even from a distance. I first observed this flower from a distance and saw that there were many flowers together and the flowers had a combination of yellow color, which made the flower look beautiful and attractive. Anyway, I was able to enjoy the beauty of such flowers after a long time, so I enjoyed a lot in my mind. Thank you to all my friends.

body.body:
It's the end of the month and we are off to wonderland! Kidding😉
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EpCAvpytvAsnoJd4GtxYjHMsSbHWu5dHsQ4cW7p4tMtS1CAwLRcqHYfGJzPWPjo4c4u.jpg
We drove out of DD early (6 am), and we are still on the road for an impromptu trip to the capital for some much-needed stuff, and to sort of escape the scares of mudslides. I couldn't calm my nerves in the wee hours last night (2 am) 'coz of the downpour, along with roaring thunder that sounded like an eroding mountainside *(my trauma still lingers).* Thankfully, the back of the farm house remained intact and only a small portion of the slope along the greenhouse gave way. So after flushing it with water, we headed out. Meanwhile along the national highway, some electrical, cable network, and internet posts are seen lying down, including fallen trees (some had to be chainsawed for vehicles to pass through), rocks, boulders and such.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EptbTnZqu4M4unGBZ72ppT3txiamZG1c8Y9gaA9Mwm53GcQucAtKKcCrcDMh8HguBp4.jpg
Runoffs are also overflowing with gushing water, bringing loose gravel from the mountainside, some spreading across the roads.
||| |-|-| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EorzP1sp6XJauKqp8voNVsQY4fb9tNzHjjak894yAA4XBjh6a1y7HGogR3szDQNzGcJ.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EqBd8cb9aafVDvAnmcdenKMV5y1GJE9HfyaguAgNgtd51Gtndih31o26FFKybYpLtAw.jpg|
While such is a common sight year on year on every prolonged wet season like we're currently experiencing, it still makes me exclaim \

and makes me shudder. Nature seems to be really angry this month, the hubby said, as he maneuvered the truck through the dangerous highway. Despite all the risks, the maintenance men and women still show up, working tirelessly to keep the access roads open, allowing supplies and such reach where they arw needed. People still move, even with the risks. Life goes on no matter what. --- ---

body.title: The Power Of Self-respect
body.body:
Sometimes we wonder why security agents, or bouncers, or officers don't smile. It's not because they're angry. It's because their job is to project strength before they ever have to use it.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQnRqKCKsmrEeQWqAAhxRevARVQaxeVVHHB6ZMGrrLiV/1787878703159.jpg)
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/positive-discipline-8305980/)

As a  man, learn from that. Look strong, look confident, look focused, look composed, be ready. Carry yourself like you're prepared for anything. Your presence should make the room think twice before testing you.

How you carry yourself, communicate something strong you don't realise before you even speak. People must not see you and have that willingness to disrespect you.

People must always think twice before they think about testing your disrespect to you because that is how you build your self-respect.

Once people don't see other people that personally they can respect, then you have the problem of getting value from people around you. That is how people get successful easily and people fail very easily.

body.title: [TV] The Blue Skin: You Have Everything and Nothing [Eng / Esp]
body.body:
>

The Blue Skin: You Have Everything and Nothing. For some time now, I’ve been enjoying short series and miniseries; there are also certain shows that deserve a bit of credit, since, in my opinion, they leave a good impression. I must confess that I don’t watch Spanish shows very often; however, I had the chance to watch The Blue Skin and really liked it. While it’s true that it’s a miniseries consisting of two episodes, it’s also true that many streaming platforms have listed it as a movie, which is how I was able to watch it. On the other hand, the plot of the first part of The Blue Skin is similar to Open Water 2, also known as Panic on the High Seas; however, the way the story unfolds and its ending are completely different. I particularly liked this version of The Blue Skin. A miniseries where drama, thriller, and psychological horror are evident no matter how you look at it. It was directed by Gonzalo López Gallego, who simply knows what he’s doing and showed us that terror and panic can also be felt in open spaces. I truly think the direction is excellent—especially during the underwater scenes and close-ups—moments that generate immense anxiety for us as viewers and remind us that at any moment, any character could succumb to exhaustion. Of course, none of this would be possible without a cast that rose to the occasion, and although I don’t know all of them, they really shone here; So, my friends, put on your swimsuits and enjoy *La Piel Azul*; in my view, it feels like a kind of documentary.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZqeioChC5kK4XqiZj28o6DWmH11P96jamz2MrCRqQzG/1000530819.png) Cover Edited In [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
[Cover Image Source](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/83425-la-piel-azul/images/posters?image_language=en)
Each character in this show has unique traits and adds that essential touch to the plot; for example, Miguel Ángel Muñoz plays Germán, an arrogant womanizer who always wants to be the leader in everything; here we see him go from that strength to despair. Leticia Fabián plays Amaya, a girl with many faces who struggles to survive in her world. Manuela Vellés plays Sophie, who wasn’t part of the group but found herself drawn into it; she’s very composed, quiet, yet strong. Alejandro Albarracín plays Luis, a traumatized, frustrated man with a unique ability to stir up conflict among the characters; he has a long-standing feud with German. Rafael Amaya—known as The Lord of the Heavens plays Fernando here, and Marta Milans plays Carlota; they’re an optimistic couple whose optimism fades in the face of the reality they’re living. All the performances are believable, and you can feel the emotion, joy, and despair when they’re called for. This miniseries is very intriguing and shows us how the atmosphere of a paradise can turn into an inescapable trap. Now, before we get into it, the main characters are at a glamorous party at Germán’s house; there, they agree to spend a few days on vacation on his dad’s sailboat. Everything goes well—they make plans, and little by little, each of them arrives at the meeting spot. The voyage out to sea begins, and it’s all sunshine, sea, partying, drinks, and celebration. However, Fernando’s wife isn’t feeling quite right and stays in her cabin, dozing off a bit. Then, they’ve had enough of partying on the sailboat—it’s time to hit the water; everyone jumps in, and amid the commotion, Germán is the last to fall into the water. However, there’s one important detail: they’re out at sea, and no one bothered to set up the ladder. What madness—despair sets in and everyone blames each other; but in a moment of calm, they remember that Carlota is asleep in the cabin and start shouting to wake her. The girl is dazed and has trouble hearing; however, she manages to reach the surface of the boat and tries to set up the ladder. But it’s not all smooth sailing, and no one is safe, since she can’t handle the weight because of her condition, and it all goes to hell; Carlota falls into the water with the whole thing—ladder and all. Things get even worse, and now no one knows what to do; it’s impossible to reach the boat—salvation is just a few meters away—but every attempt fails, and a sense of doom takes hold of everyone.
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPhaN24FBRSYzDnEb8CT2Q4UWWKzcHAmAKFxBzXu5LsXm/1000530865.jpg) ](https://m.filmaffinity.com/uy/movieposters.php?movie_id=429281)
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwoYQBHznqpjiqqpQyf3NGvmTwrVnX5wTeD8KgLbf5cM/1000530835.webp) ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/83425-la-piel-azul/season/1/episode/1?language=es-ES)
Up to that point, there’s nothing to be done; despair grows, and Sophie decides to swim aimlessly, but I think that effort will be in vain. We might think the plot is the same as *Open Water 2*; up to this point, they do resemble each other, but after some time, they notice a small boat approaching and believe they’re saved. The crew is led by a Black man named Abdou (Emilio Buale); from that moment on, the story changes, and each character’s life is completely transformed. I’ve already told you a lot; it’s interesting, and you should enjoy it, because just like them, you, too, could become a survivor—or maybe not? The setting and cinematography are brilliant; the Mediterranean Sea is portrayed not as a symbol of freedom, but as enclosed spaces or invisible walls that suffocate each character. In this sense, paradise becomes an open cage from which no one can escape. Indeed, the sea, the sun, and the sense of despair create an extremely unsettling atmosphere—you may have it all, but here, it’s worth nothing. On the other hand, the message and reflection we’re left with are heart-wrenching and entirely true, because you can be the most arrogant and the wealthiest person, but it’s shown that a desperate situation brings out a person’s deepest, most hidden feelings—and this raises a powerful question: Who might we become when we lose our comfort zone? Best regards, and see you soon.
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTnK2KJfqsE5Hku7SoXw5wjoPtxbPkNmYnncEpZeh67BW/1000530861.webp) ](https://sincroguia-tv.expansion.com/series/la-piel-azul--2wnt-SPA)
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSE4rkaMQLaw2wCnTGKP8BZKtor2jiP9s5h2AHQVUBe7/1000530845.webp) ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/83425-la-piel-azul/season/1/episode/2?language=es-ES)
![20201127 20.12.01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/D5RDDkFA-2020-11-272020.12.01.png)
![0001-4391657861_20210715_235440_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/23z7HmihYB4AQKyPXVrmVMxJpHzbuanm7CXB8ofeQAUbJZBF7z4VGtGgqmr9Fuek1dnr7.png) ![7258xSVeJbKmTr9Z4jhbPj9GHY1wjtmcKenAWGSobm5p1x6c7j1wHbLywh1xgdZAeogKuuJu8tCPpKFzBHcYoSTNYkVodTZa4H8YBeoVg14WoHLRV4CestBBSwxet6FwdTTMXZ3ez7rQm.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/jWafbh6W-7258xSVeJbKmTr9Z4jhbPj9GHY1wjtmcKenAWGSobm5p1x6c7j1wHbLywh1xgdZAeogKuuJu8tCPpKFzBHcYoSTNYkVodTZa4H8YBeoVg14WoHLRV4CestBBSwxet6FwdTTMXZ3ez7rQm.gif) The sources are included in the images; to view them, click on the image **Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

***[....Versión En Español....]()***

>

La Piel Azul: Tienes Todo y Nada. Desde hace algún tiempo, me he dedicado a disfrutar de series cortas y miniseries; también hay ciertos programas a los que le podemos dar un poco de beneficio, ya que desde mi punto de vista dejan buen sabor de boca. Debo confesar que no soy muy asiduo a los programas españoles; sin embargo, tuve la oportunidad de ver La Piel Azul y me gustó mucho. Si bien es cierto; que es una miniserie que consta de 2 capítulos, también es cierto que en muchas plataformas de streaming la han colocado como una película y así la pude ver. Por otra parte; esta Piel Azul, la trama en su primera parte es parecida a Open Water 2 o también llamada Pánico en Alta Mar; sin embargo, la continuidad de la misma y su descenlace son totalmente diferentes; particularmente me ha gustado esta versión de La Piel Azul. Una miniserie donde se aprecia al drama, el thriller y el terror psicológico por donde quiera que lo veas. Estuvo bajo el lente de Gonzalo López Gallego; quien sencillamente sabe lo que hace y nos demostró, que en espacios abiertos también se puede sentir terror y pánico. De verdad que la dirección me parece excelente; especialmente cuando se dan las escenas sumergibles y los cuadros cerrados; situaciones que a nosotros como espectadores, no generan inmensa ansiedad y nos dicen que en cualquier momento, cualquier personaje puede caer antes el cansancio; claro está, que todo esto no sería posible sin un elenco que diera la talla y aunque no los conozco a todos, aquí se lucieron; entonces mis amigos, a ponerse los trajes de baño y a disfrutar de La Piel Azul; que a mí modo de ver las cosas, parece una especie de documental.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZqeioChC5kK4XqiZj28o6DWmH11P96jamz2MrCRqQzG/1000530819.png) Portada Editada En [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
[Fuente de la Imagen de Portada](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/83425-la-piel-azul/images/posters?image_language=en)
Cada personaje de este programa tienen características particulares y le da ese toque necesario a la trama; por ejemplo, Miguel Ángel Muñoz encarna a Germán, un tipo Arrogante, mujeriego y que siempre desea ser el lider en todo; aquí lo vemos trascender desde esa fuerza, hacia la desesperación. Leticia Fabián representando a Amaya, una chica de muchas máscaras quien confronta su mundo con la supervivencia. Manuela Vellés es Sophie no era del grupo, pero le toco estar; muy centrada, silenciosa, pero fuerte. Alejandro Albarracín es Luis, un tipo traumado, frustrado y con una capacidad única para despertar el conflicto entre los personajes; tiene una vieja disputa con Germán. Rafael Amaya, lo conocen como el señor de los cielos; aquí es Fernando y Marta Milans como Carlota; una pareja optimista, situación que se pierde ante la realidad que viven. Todas las actuaciones son creíbles y se nota la emoción, alegrías y desespero cuando hay que tenerlas. Esta miniserie es muy intrigante y nos da a conocer, como puede cambiar el ambiente de un paraíso, en una absoluta trampa sin escape. Ahora; antes de saltar a ello, los protagonistas están en una fiesta glamorosa en casa de Germán; allí se ponen de acuerdo para pasar unos días de vacaciones en el velero de su papá, todo va bien, se organizan y poco a poco cada uno de ellos va llegando al lugar del encuentro. La navegación a alta mar inicia y todo es sol, mar, fiesta, licor, celebración. Sin embargo, la esposa de Fernando se siente un poco mal y se queda en su camarote un poco adormecida. Entonces, ya es suficiente de celebrar en el velero, porque hay que ir al agua; cada uno se lanza y por estar con el desorden, Germán es el último en caer al agua. Sin embargo, existe un detalle importante; están en el mar y nadie se preocupó por colocar la escalera. Que locura, comienza la desesperación y todos se echan la culpa; pero en un momento de calma, recuerdan que Carlota está dormida en el camarote y empiezan a gritar para llamarla. La chica está aturdida y escucha con dificultad; sin embargo, logra llegar a la superficie del bote y trata de colocar la escalera. Pero no todo es color de rosas y nadie está a salvo, ya que ella no puede con tanto peso debido a su estado y esto se jodió; Carlota cae al agua con todo y escalera. Las cosas se pusieron peores y ahora ya nadie sabe que hacer; es imposible llegar al bote, la salvación está a pocos metros, pero cada intento es fallido y la fatalidad se apodera de todos.
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPhaN24FBRSYzDnEb8CT2Q4UWWKzcHAmAKFxBzXu5LsXm/1000530865.jpg) ](https://m.filmaffinity.com/uy/movieposters.php?movie_id=429281)
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwoYQBHznqpjiqqpQyf3NGvmTwrVnX5wTeD8KgLbf5cM/1000530835.webp) ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/83425-la-piel-azul/season/1/episode/1?language=es-ES)
Hasta ese momento no hay nada que hacer; la desesperación se acrecienta y Sophie decide nadar sin dirección, pero creo yo que ese esfuerzo será inútil. Pudiéramos pensar que la trama es igual a Aguas Abiertas 2; hasta aquí sí se parecen, pero pasado algún tiempo, observar que se acerca un pequeño bote y creen que están salvados. La tripulación está liderada por un hombre de color llamado Abdou (Emilio Buale); a partir de ese instante, la historia cambia y la vida de cada personaje se transforma por completo. Ya te he contado mucho; es interesante y debes disfrutarla, porque así como ellos, tú también te podrías convertir en un superviviente ¿O tal vez no?. La ambientación y la fotografía son geniales; el mar Mediterráneo se enfoca no como un elemento de libertad; sino como espacios cerrados o muros que no se ven, pero que ahogan a cada personaje. En tal sentido, un paraíso se convierte en una jaula abierta de la que nadie puede escapar. Ciertamente; el mar, el sol y el sentimiento de desesperación genera un ambiente sumamente perturbador, puedes tener todo; pero aquí no vale de nada. Por otra parte; el mensaje y reflexión que recibimos es desgarrador y totalmente cierto, porque puedes ser el más arrogante y el más adinerado; pero se demuestra que una situación desesperante, saca los sentimientos más ocultos que puede tener una persona y con ello se genera una poderosa pregunta, ¿En quienes nos podemos convertir, cuando se pierde la zona de confort?; saludos y nos vemos pronto.
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTnK2KJfqsE5Hku7SoXw5wjoPtxbPkNmYnncEpZeh67BW/1000530861.webp) ](https://sincroguia-tv.expansion.com/series/la-piel-azul--2wnt-SPA)
[ ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSE4rkaMQLaw2wCnTGKP8BZKtor2jiP9s5h2AHQVUBe7/1000530845.webp) ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/83425-la-piel-azul/season/1/episode/2?language=es-ES)
![20201127 20.12.01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/D5RDDkFA-2020-11-272020.12.01.png)
![0001-4391657861_20210715_235440_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/23z7HmihYB4AQKyPXVrmVMxJpHzbuanm7CXB8ofeQAUbJZBF7z4VGtGgqmr9Fuek1dnr7.png) ![7258xSVeJbKmTr9Z4jhbPj9GHY1wjtmcKenAWGSobm5p1x6c7j1wHbLywh1xgdZAeogKuuJu8tCPpKFzBHcYoSTNYkVodTZa4H8YBeoVg14WoHLRV4CestBBSwxet6FwdTTMXZ3ez7rQm.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/jWafbh6W-7258xSVeJbKmTr9Z4jhbPj9GHY1wjtmcKenAWGSobm5p1x6c7j1wHbLywh1xgdZAeogKuuJu8tCPpKFzBHcYoSTNYkVodTZa4H8YBeoVg14WoHLRV4CestBBSwxet6FwdTTMXZ3ez7rQm.gif) Las fuentes están incluidas en las imágenes; para acceder a ellas presiona la imagen **Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

body.title: ENHYPEN Tops Billboard 200
body.body:
엔하이픈의 여덟 번째 미니앨범 ‘The Sin: Bliss’가 미국 빌보드 200에서 그룹 최초로 1위에 올랐다. 8월 21일 발매된 이 앨범은 9만8000 앨범 유닛을 기록했으며, 이 가운데 9만2000 유닛이 앨범 판매량에서 나왔다. 엔하이픈은 2022년 이후 일곱 장의 앨범을 연속으로 톱10에 올렸고, 이번 작품은 누적 판매량 202만 장을 넘겼다. 총 10곡이 수록됐으며 대표곡은 ‘Bloody Paradise’다.

ENHYPEN earned its first Billboard 200 No. 1 with its eighth EP, The Sin: Bliss. Released on August 21, the record logged 98,000 equivalent album units, including 92,000 from album sales. It is the group’s seventh top ten album since 2022 and has surpassed 2.02 million copies in cumulative sales. The ten track EP is led by Bloody Paradise.

---

**Source:** [ENHYPEN claims 1st No. 1 on Billboard 200 with 'The Sin: Bliss'](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainment/k-pop/20260831/enhypen-claims-1st-no-1-on-billboard-200-with-the-sin-bliss) · 2026-08-31

body.title: A delicious breakfast: an omelette with smoked chorizo and cheese
body.body:
**Welcome to my blog**
> Bienvenidos a mi blog


![Picsart_26-08-30_19-54-04-431.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23wCLPPxsqoshGd6dJ6JtySdQdLaS4GGjcRiQzNgwSV87rq2XkJ1uDpVwCP4YNS5xMsCC.jpg)

# A delicious breakfast: an omelette with smoked chorizo and cheese 

Enjoying a good omelette for breakfast is a great source of protein to help you regain your strength after a good workout. Today my husband went for an early workout and I wanted to make a protein-packed breakfast – and what better than eggs, combined with smoked chorizo, which adds a really delicious flavour. For this recipe, I used 1 smoked chorizo, 3 eggs, mild white Llanero cheese, salt to taste and oil for frying.

> Disfrutar de una buena tortilla en desayuno es una fuente de proteína para recuperar fuerzas después de un buen entrenamiento. Hoy mi esposo fue temprano a entrenar y quise realizar un desayuno con proteína y que más que realizar huevos, combinados con chorizo ahumado que me da un toque de sabor muy rico. Para esta preparación utilice 1 chorizo ahumado, 3 huevos, queso blanco llanero suave, sal al gusto y aceite para freír.


![IMG_20260830_082339.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23zSByexZtoXqYHu9Ygn4KyGazKpG3R3mzxyFCUZCCHVHHgAcwW9zdJEsYnbgcEdE7gjq.jpg)

This is a quick and easy recipe; I started by cutting the smoked chorizo in half and then into small pieces. I fried them in a little oil until they were golden brown.

> Está es una preparación rápida y sencilla; comencé cortando el chorizo ahumado por la mitad y corte en pequeños trozos. Lleve a freír con un poco de aceite hasta ver estuviesen dorados.


![IMG_20260830_082844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23uR5ZR1dMBeW5iypwPGV92QGFPUd2dT4T5dia1Jmscx18ydVNphdDdRVJp5W64zhE2S3.jpg)


![IMG_20260830_083608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23vsUjxgnnxUKahGLc9sYftppv4XYwZMJLtH5mbEDfRzGnzSz9XBj2Ex1m8HSs1DAViTS.jpg)

Meanwhile, beat the three eggs and stir them into the chorizo.
> Por otro lado bati los tres huevos e incorpore a los chorizos.


![IMG_20260830_083618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/243M7cRJV6fvXsg1UxREyACTYBwA5zQjjkJ6TPwGK3QVAcdYTPQH3h87v4Nh4xAQ295wh.jpg)



![IMG_20260830_083734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23x1FTVPxqWPRZxsVbQ8ekN8TdSKHYuBML2bRn3fpTpR3Z2mbrn7w2NUe6J1z9GNbz2hS.jpg)


Sprinkle the grated white cheese on top. Wait until it’s cooked on one side before turning it over. 
> Encima agregue el queso blanco rallado. Espere que estuviera por un lado para proceder a voltear. 


![IMG_20260830_083846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23w2wvvuJo3uPsxHg6h2M9APPM6rS2YsqzUZQ6MMZ7CN5ttx3qvV8iL31sen3CGwFYxpU.jpg)


![IMG_20260830_095518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23wCLJxySVHsdrGNWPJhjVWBe9BZns2gkYwNPgJPXZwAyyo9NqmyWYwVRrDCjwffBLmdr.jpg)

To round off this breakfast, I had a maize arepa and some buttermilk, which was delicious – I love that tangy flavour it has.
> Para completar este desayuno utilice una arepa de maíz y un suero de leche que estaba delicioso, me gusta ese toque ácido que tiene.



![IMG_20260830_095543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lisbethseijas/23w2uaYcZw7yPTZd5uzJQepajkj4queBH8iAh5vukU24LcctwRyWZbFfMWgefERgN9kCw.jpg)

**I’ll sign off now and hope to see you next time 
The photographs are my own

Thank you for reading**

body.body:
> Hi, friends! Happy and official weekend. I hope you’re all doing great. As you read in the title of this post, I want to share a photo shoot with you that was primarily planned and done for Marisol since it was for her birthday and she took the opportunity to get some photos taken with her best friends, who were there with her for the shoot. That day was total chaos; I mean, after their session, I had another one scheduled. They arrived really late and not all at once. We worked against the clock, but we managed to get these results, which they were happy with—and that’s what matters most. Here they are for you to see, friends. >Hola amigos feliz y oficial din de semana, espero estén todos genial, así como lo leyeron en el titulo de este post quiero compartirles una sesión fotográfica principalmente planificada y hecha para Marisol porque eran para el día de su cumpleaños y aprovecho de hacerse unas fotografías para hacerse con sus mejores amigas que estuvieron acompañándola en esta sesión fotográfica, ese día todo fue un caos, me refiero a que luego de la sesión de ellas tenia otra, llegaron super tarde y no juntas, trabajamos contra reloj pero logramos obtener este resultado con el cual quedaron conformes y eso es lo que mas importa, acá se las dejo para que ustedes lo vean amigos.

body.title: Guide to “The Exclusive Store” in Splinterlands and How VOUCHERS Work in 2026 [ES-EN]
body.body:
> A few days ago, I realized that the “Exclusive Store” in the game has some incredible cards just waiting for players to buy them. I honestly hadn’t noticed that the cards are updated so frequently—just a few weeks ago I’d seen different ones, and now there are new ones already. But more than that, I can see that the cards are really powerful. However, this is just my first impression, so as I continue writing this post, we’ll see if this is true or not. I’ll also explain how VOUCHERS work, since new users probably have no idea how they function. This information is very important because, for those who don’t know how to get or earn the VOUCHER, in this post I’ll explain everything. I’ll cover a lot of general topics, but we’ll focus entirely on the game’s “Exclusive Store,” since I’ve been surprised by just how amazing the cards they offer are. However, I won’t discuss them directly until I post another article sharing their strengths and whether they’re truly worth it in the game—which I’m sure they are. Stay tuned for new posts next week: **So, since we already know what's in store for this Sunday, read this post all the way through so you can learn about this store and how the VOUCHERS work.** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# What are VOUCHERS, and how do you get them?
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Before we dive into the game’s “Exclusive Store,” it’s essential that we learn about VOUCHERS and how to get them, because many new players probably don’t have the slightest idea how it works—not to mention that I imagine they think these cards are out of reach, but that’s not the case; anyone can earn them and access them, but it’s just a matter of knowing how it works and exactly where to find them. **But before all that, I'll answer a question you're probably asking yourselves, which is this:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
What are VOUCHERS?
---
![remove-photos-background-removed.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/Eo8LeQYonr8RALW9fRgf2qzXXc34D3aXEdyg55p7BRwq8fZRM33u6CpoEM9LYakeDmv.png)
--- Well, it’s not very hard to figure out what they are, since it’s simply a token created for a specific purpose: its sole function is to serve as a currency used to purchase exclusive “Cards” in the Splinterlands rewards store or at any type of special event where it may be required to access an offer, bonus, or benefit the team is offering at that time. Beyond that, there’s nothing else behind what the VOUCHER token actually is. Now that we've clarified this and know what they are and what they're used for, all that's left is to find out the current ways to obtain them. And to put everyone's mind at ease, it's not very complicated, since there are three ways to do so, which are: >* **SPS Staking:** This is the first way to earn VOUCHERS directly, and I’d say it’s the easiest of all, since all you have to do is stake your SPS to start receiving VOUCHERS completely passively. To do this, a fixed pool of 20,000 VOUCHERS is distributed daily among all SPS holders, so the more SPS you have staked, the more VOUCHERS you’ll receive. > >* **SPS Validator Nodes:** Another way to earn daily VOUCHERS is to have an “SPS Validator Node.” To do this, you need to hold the LICENSE token and complete a few other steps that I won’t go into in this post, but which involve some cost; However, validator nodes can generate SPS earnings by securing the network, and you also earn VOUCHERS, since there is a fixed pool of 20,000 VOUCHERS per day distributed among all active node holders on the network. > >* **The Secondary Market:** The VOUCHER isn’t just a token used for special events or exclusive cards—it’s a token with market value that fluctuates based on supply and demand, so you can purchase it on “Hive Engine” and “Tribaldex.” Additionally, within the game itself, you can exchange them for DECS depending on the market price, since you can’t withdraw them from the platform as such—you used to be able to, but not anymore. However, what you can do is buy them and transfer them directly to Splinterlands.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# How the “Exclusive Store” Works in Splinterlands https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> --- It’s actually quite simple, but many people may not realize this and are only focusing on what they can see—the traditional card market, rentals, battles, and other things— However, buying these cards goes beyond the cost of purchasing very powerful or exclusive cards; it also involves what’s called speculation, since these are cards that the market (players) perceive as being of great value because of the way they’re obtained. I should also add that they have a limited availability, which gives them that sense of uniqueness. **But let's explain how it works, and then I'll share my thoughts on it, because I'll analyze the cards in another post.** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
How the Store Works
|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/48HeFVswgxaTBRfzjMETogGhXsoh5jDwQuvfJK9QN6MLaHWAJZwQFegbcJivAjRjaK.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23uQM1z7BQpxvf5BtP4JMTFH3n7PTme3kXoDUQzX3PkN7onVN3hfRg188EVDekjc2NqQ9.png| |-|-| --- Basically, the store works just like any other; however, instead of using DEC or Credits to make purchases, you use VOUCHERS, where each card has a different cost based on its rarity—Common, Rare, and Epic—in most cases, although there have been promotions featuring “Legendary” cards, which are well worth it. but it’s basically the rarity that determines a card’s market value, in addition to, of course, the impact the card can have on the game itself. To figure this out, all you have to do is look at the card's abilities and stats, but there are several factors that influence this. The main ones, however, are what I mentioned: stats, abilities, and how easy it is to use. What are the current cards? * **Krowl Brightbane** * **Vethos Spineclaw** * **Taark Nightbloom** In the images, you can get a general idea of the cards and what each one offers—I'm referring to their abilities—although they also have skins that you can buy with VOUCHERS. But don't worry; as I said, I'll explain each one in detail, so if you want to know how to use them and what impact they have on the battlefield, comment on this post and follow me.
![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Final Thoughts https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> VOUCHERS and the Rewards Store are an important part of the ecosystem, since we always have new events and cards that are incredible—I know this because I’ve seen them in advance. That’s why the current META evolves so quickly, and it’s impossible to catch your breath, since you have to stay active to keep up with everything new in the game. If you're new here and don't know about the VOUCHERS and the exclusive store, now is the time to find out.

Esta información es muy importante porque para los que no saben como se obtiene o se gana el VOUCHER, pues en este post lo explicare todo, hablare de muchas cosas en general pero nos enfocaremos enteramente en “La Tienda Exclusiva” del juego, ya que me ha sorprendido lo increíble que están las cartas que ofrecen, aunque no hablare directamente de ellas, sino hasta que haga otra publicación compartiendo sus fortalezas y si de verdad valen la pena en el juego que de seguro que sí, estén atentos a las nuevas publicaciones de la semana siguiente: **Entonces, como ya sabemos cual es el contenido para este domingo, lean hasta el final esta publicación para que puedan aprender sobre lo que es esta tienda y de como funcionan los VOUCHERS** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# ¿Qué son los VOUCHERS y como se consiguen?
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Antes de que nos adentremos en la “Tienda Exclusiva” del juego, es fundamental que aprendamos sobre los VOUCHERS, ademas de explicar de que forma se consiguen, porque quizás muchos de los nuevos jugadores en el juego no tienen ni la menor idea de como funciona, sin mencionar que imagino que piensan que estas cartas son inalcanzables, pero no es así, cualquiera puede ganarlo y acceder a él, pero, es cuestión de saber como funciona y donde precisamente pueden encontrarlo. **Pero antes de todo esto responderé una pregunta que seguramente se estarán haciendo y es la siguiente:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
¿Qué son los VOUCHERS?
---
![remove-photos-background-removed.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/Eo8LeQYonr8RALW9fRgf2qzXXc34D3aXEdyg55p7BRwq8fZRM33u6CpoEM9LYakeDmv.png)
--- Pues no es muy complicado de discernir que son, ya que sencillamente es un token que se creó con la finalidad de tener una utilidad única y es que su única función es usarlo como una moneda que sirve para adquirir “Cartas” exclusivas en la tienda exclusiva de recompensas en Splinterlands o en cualquier tipo de eventos especial en donde pueda actuar como requisito para acceder a la oferta, bonificación o beneficio que el equipo este implementando en ese momento. Con esto no hay más nada detrás de lo que es realmente el token VOUCHER. Con esto ya aclarado y sabiendo que es y para qué sirven, lo que nos queda saber es cuales son las formas actuales de conseguirlos y para tranquilidad de todos, no es muy complicado, ya que existen 3 formas de hacerlo que son: >* **El Staking de SPS:** Esta es la primera forma de ganar directamente los VOUCHERS, y diría que es las más fácil de todas, ya que tan solo debemos colocar en Staking nuestro SPS para comenzar a recibir los VOUCHERS de forma totalmente pasiva, para esto se reparte un Pool fijo de 20000 VOUCHERS diarios entre todos los tenedores de SPS, por lo que, mientras más alta sea la cantidad de SPS que tengas en Staking, mayor será la cantidad de VOUCHERS que recibas. > >* **Nodos Validadores de SPS:** Otra de las formas de conseguir VOUCHER diarios es tener un “Nodo Validador de SPS”, para esto necesitas tener el token LICENSE y hacer algunos otros pasos que no comentare en este post, pero que llevan algún costo, sin embargo, los nodos validadores tienen la posibilidad de generar ganancias en SPS por asegurar la red y adicionalmente ganas VOUCHERS, ya que existen también un Pool fijo de 20000 VOUCHERS diarios entre todos los poseedores de Nodos activos en la red. > >* **El Mercado Secundario:** El VOUCHER no solo es un token que funciona para eventos especiales o cartas exclusivas, es un token con un valor en el mercado el cual se mueve por la oferta y la demanda, por lo que podrás conseguirlo en “Hive Engine y Tribaldex”. Ademas, dentro del mismo juego puedes intercambiarlos por DECS dependiendo del precio de mercado, ya que no puedes sacarlos de la plataforma como tal, antes si se podía, pero ahora no, y ademas lo que si puedes hacer es comprarlos y transferirlos directamente a Splinterlands.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# Funcionamiento de la “Tienda Exclusiva” en Splinterlands https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> --- Es bastante sencillo realmente, pero muchos quizás no lo saben y solo se están enfocando en lo que pueden ver, que es el mercado de cartas tradicional, los alquileres, las batallas entre otras cosas, sin embargo, el comprar estas cartas va más allá de costo comprar cartas muy fuertes o exclusivas, sino que entra lo que llamó especulación, ya que son cartas que el mercado (Jugadores) perciben que son de gran valor por la forma en la que se obtienen, puedo que debo agregar que tienen un tiempo límite, lo que da esa sensación de único. **Pero, vamos a explicar como funciona y luego doy mis impresiones sobre esto, porque las cartas las analizare en otro post.** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Funcionamiento de la Tienda
|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/48HeFVswgxaTBRfzjMETogGhXsoh5jDwQuvfJK9QN6MLaHWAJZwQFegbcJivAjRjaK.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23uQM1z7BQpxvf5BtP4JMTFH3n7PTme3kXoDUQzX3PkN7onVN3hfRg188EVDekjc2NqQ9.png| |-|-| --- Basicamente la tienda funciona como cualquier otra, sin embargo, a diferencia de usar el DEC para comprar o los Créditos, usas el VOUCHER donde cada carta tiene diferente costo, esto es debido a su rareza, puesto que existe (Común, Rara y Épica) en la mayoría de los casos, aunque ha habido promociones en donde tenemos cartas “Legendarias”, las cuales valen mucho la pena, pero, es básicamente la rareza lo que dictamina su valor en el mercado, ademas de por supuesto que tato impacto puede causar la carta en el juego como tal. Para saber esto basta con observar las habilidades y estadísticas de la carta, pero son varios factores que influyen en esto, pero lo principal es lo que comente, estadísticas, habilidades y que tan fácil puede ser usarlo. ¿Cuáles son las cartas actuales? * **Krowl Brightbane** * **Vethos Spineclaw** * **Taark Nightbloom** En las imágenes puedes observar más o menos las cartas y lo que trae cada una, refiriéndome a sus habilidades, aunque tienen sus skins que puedes comprar también con VOUCHER, pero no se preocupen, como dije, explicaré en detalle cada una de ellas, por lo que, si quieres saber cómo se usan, cuál es su impacto en el campo, comenta este post y sígueme.
![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Consideraciones Finales https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Los VOUCHERS y la Tienda de Recompensas forman parte importante del ecosistema, ya que siempre tenemos eventos y cartas nuevas que son increíbles, ya de antemano que las he visto lo sé, es por eso que el META actual evoluciona muy rápido y es imposible mantener un respiro, puesto que tienes que mantenerte activo para conocer todo lo nuevo del juego. body.title: Clarence
body.body:
Clarence was a stray who began to hang around in the winter of '14-'15. We eventually caught him, took him to the vet to be neutered, and then he decided to just live at our place. The vet estimated him to be about two years old at the time, which would make him about 13 years old now. 

<center></center>
![20260713_095619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/scribblingramma/23tmMvw2VfaFkRJhexk3aMoeZCLKDf2CKQgy8GprFjqfK1vBb5o5GKMejDgbnB3efWoBY.jpg)

He's definitely not as ambitious as he once was. He spends a great deal of time just lounging around. He likes to be outside if the weather is nice, and he likes it best if one of us is outside, too, so he can supervise whatever we are doing. This photo seems to have caught him arranging himself underneath a blueberry bush in the garden.

<center>
![20260725_082245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/scribblingramma/23tvkRCbj3yRk3QPrW3pnRCV7BP6zu8ovh6niTebo5qsrdvWhCVq9ovyfg6GbwDdD9qqS.jpg)
</center>

In the above photo, he was in one of his mischievous moods, hunkered down low and swatting at little nothings in the weeds.

<center>
![20260828_113405 edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/scribblingramma/23w2qS1oYU9r6hDHEJCcGaLJrrkmKwdaQsH2seVdnW3j3XkAuWZuT12Q2hcAdjVv3pBn8.jpg)
</center>

This is how Clarence likes to spend much of the day, after a long night. I like to leave my bed open to air for a while before I make it, but then a certain cat takes over, and I can't make the bed unless I disturb him.

For many years we put our cats into a shed at night to keep them safe from wildlife. They had food, water, places to sleep, and a litter box, so were quite comfortable. A few years ago, when we had three cats, Clarence was always getting bullied by the other two. So we started letting him stay in the house at night. 

We eventually gave away the worst bully to another family who wanted a garage cat to catch mice. But Clarence didn't want to go into the shed any more. Over a year ago we had to put down the other cat, due to age and health issues. Now Clarence can have the shed all to himself, but he still doesn't want to go out there. 

Unfortunately, he makes a pest of himself if he stays in the house, yowling in the hallway when he decides it's time to go back outside. We try to catch him to put him in the shed, but he has become very wary of us if we approach him in the evening. He hides underneath a bed, or behind the sofa so we can't catch him. So he ends up staying outside half the night, due to his lack of cooperation. It worries me, but I think he actually spends most of the time on the deck or on the stairs surveying his domain. 

We are getting up in years, and have decided when Clarence dies we won't get another cat. They are one more thing to take care of, and one more thing to trip over. But every time somebody shows me a picture of a cute kitten, I want another one. We'll see.

<center>*All photos taken on my Android phone.*</center>

body.title: [ESP/ENG ] CUSTOMIZAR NUESTRAS VIEJAS  PRENDAS DE VESTIR.CUSTOMIZING OUR OLD CLOTHES.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTLXg8peYKXxBQqtgJJJ1j2CLQWecrix4CMbQHsuGkSB/1788052894801.jpg)


|**Esp**|**Eng** | 
| ------------ | ------------ |
|‎Hola amigos es un placer saludarles el día de hoy traigo para ustedes está genial idea de  **CUSTOMIZAR NUESTRAS VIEJAS  PRENDAS DE VESTIR**, y así darles una nueva oportunidad de uso. En está  ocasión una vieja blusa que no sólo estaba vieja y desgastada, sino que también rota. Por lo que decidí reciclarla  y reutilizarla dándole un toqué más atractivo y jovial, usando retazos de tela de jeans y perlas, y así darle una nueva vida. Me dió un poco de trabajo porque mi máquina de cocer se dañó y tuve que coser a mano, pero me divertí creando y colocándole un estilo elegante y moderno, quedé muy satisfecha con el resultado. A continuación les comparto  el proceso  y la lista de materiales, espero les guste el post y Customicen todas sus prendas y les den una nueva oportunidad de lucirlas.|Hi, friends! It’s a pleasure to say hello to you today. I’ve brought you this great idea for **CUSTOMIZING OUR OLD CLOTHES**, giving them a new lease on life. This time, I took an old blouse that wasn’t just old and worn out—it was also torn. So I decided to upcycle it and give it a more attractive and playful look using scraps of denim and pearls, breathing new life into it. It took a bit of work because my sewing machine broke and I had to sew by hand, but I had fun creating a stylish and modern look—I was very pleased with the result. Below, I’m sharing the process and the list of materials. I hope you like the post and that you’ll customize all your clothes and give them a new chance to shine.|





|**Materiales:**|**Materials:**|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Una blusa que deseemos customizar, tela de jeans, tijeras, aguja, hilo, perlas grandes y pequeñas, regla o cinta métrica.|A blouse you want to customize, denim fabric, scissors, a needle, thread, large and small beads, a ruler or measuring tape.|


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNrkrM8jZFDvSUbTRyo3R7Corc1AioaMw5adRgvBj1Pr/1788054332124.jpg)

|**Instrucciones:**|**Instructions:**|
| ------------ | ------------ |

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7mdJPFcf1S8hMHsuF3YKDxmxF6UP6dkbSQufBxdVaty/1723506304106.png)

| Paso 1| Step 1|
| ------------ | ------------ | 
|La blusa con la que voy a trabajar sufrió un accidente se quemó mientras la plancha a, por lo que debía colocar una costura o parche para cubrir el daño.|The blouse I'm going to wear to work had an accident—it got burned while I was ironing it—so I had to sew a seam or patch to cover the damage.|

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcHhUyAesn6roWgQxQbXFzsLq1CLLF3hH2xMpv6U52K5g/1788053868279.jpg)

|Paso 2| Step 2|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Decidí cortar 2  listones en tela de jean, colocare 3 listones de cada lado de la camisa, por lo tanto son 6 listones. Los dos  primeros listones  son de 3 cm de ancho y de largo 30 cm, una vez cortado deshilache por los dos lados.|I decided to cut 2 strips of denim; I'll place 3 strips on each side of the shirt, for a total of 6 strips. The first two strips are 3 cm wide and 30 cm long; once cut, I'll fray the edges on both sides.|



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJUrAV1WYk8jenTt9BWU1GYb2txpp5Td2rkwQY8D5Qcw/1788054828174.jpg)



|Paso 3| Step 3|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Con una tijera descosi la costura por los lados de la blusa a la altura donde están los huecos de la blusa, con la intención de cubrir el daño, por lo que hay que medir bien ayudándonos con un metro para que quede a la misma altura.|Using a pair of scissors, I unpicked the seam along the sides of the blouse at the same height as the holes in the blouse, with the intention of covering up the damage, so you have to measure carefully using a tape measure to make sure it’s at the same height.|


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWCb9XXvGcAoeKmg3Xhg5fEuLJA32KSo8UcJSGxoMwbCC/1788055287855.jpg)





|Paso 4| Step 4|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Enhebre el hilo en la aguja y sujetando el listón con alfileres procedì  a coser el listón por  ese lado.|I threaded the needle and, pinning the ribbon in place, proceeded to sew the ribbon along that side.|



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcJ1Usw3yL5NK6JcSuQGQX9ndpC2Gv7dKPXf9EvWFv61y/1788055490404.jpg)



| Paso 5| Step 5|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Cosí con puntadas corridas por toda la orilla del listón, descosi el otro lado de la camisa y cosí por el otro lado. Cosí tanto en la parte superior como inferior.|I sewed with running stitches along the entire edge of the ribbon, unpicked the other side of the shirt, and sewed along the other side. I sewed along both the top and bottom edges.|



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTqDSwZTHgRkSqpPcHeXM3YYRqrJjLTx6CfQXXCVJXo8S/1788093128251.jpg)



|Paso 6| Step 6|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Cosí la segunda pieza de 2  centímetros de ancho y cosí a la blusa.|I sewed the second piece, which was 2 centimeters wide, and attached it to the blouse.|



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmepUbf3SgeFrXkC8RTMrsV5iBKvhTnXvKe71uA2ztjisX/1788093402454.jpg)




| Paso 7| Step 7|
| ------------ | ------------ |
|Corté la tercera pieza de 1,5 cm de ancho y la cosí a la altura del pecho superior.|I cut the third piece, 1.5 cm wide, and sewed it at the upper chest.|




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZRbw1K3EVoht1rThdytYAmgm3krdisynpBvYXdJT7BU/1788093641391.jpg)




| Paso 8| Step 8|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Repetí el mismo procedimiento del otro lado cosiendo cada pieza del otro lado.|I repeated the same procedure on the other side, sewing each piece on that side.|




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb6g5saapzDoBBrc11T6AobY8RbsDXFuf3z47yT3LcAoS/1788093807438.jpg)




| Paso 9| Step 9|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Con un lápiz en la parte superior marque 8 puntos para coser las perlas grandes y las sujeté con una mostacilla blanca.|Using a pencil, I marked 8 spots on the top where to sew the large beads, and I secured them with a white seed bead.|



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbMkBTs1AaVGE9gBz8URr9i1uQXfrwN8Azx41fQTLapWg/1788094108151.jpg)




| Paso 10| Step 10|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Marqué las perlas pequeñas y las cosí.|I marked the small beads and sewed them on.|


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvdZ5ra7oYtcA1eWWQsX5og5aVrjJnt3EoTkwA2DzsHK/1788094414446.jpg)



| Paso 11| Step 11|
|------------ | ------------ |
|Repetí el proceso del otro lado de la camisa.|I repeated the process on the other side of the shirt.|



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUZbV1VqFNZSe4QjAWidCJf6HFtuprYActryKhe73GjGc/1788094663845.jpg)






|Despedida| Farewell |

body.title: A short trip to Moss Coffee
body.body: One of the places that I wanted to visit while I was in Bintulu was the aquarium shop here. I wanted to get some fish and mini shrimp. The aquarium shop has a coffee shop inside that serves coffee known as Moss Coffee. So, in order to find this aquarium shop, I just type in on google maps. Good Morning to all my friends. How is your Monday? Today is a special day here in Malaysia. Malaysia's Independence Day So, I went to this underground area to find parking, and my wife went to the tofu store to get some soy bean drink.

/> Such a cute name for a shop. This whole place has a very unique concept: the car park is next to all these shops. This tofu shop is a factory in itself. They supply around the city of Bintulu. This is the car park.
/> There is also an underground barber shop here. Not far away, there is also a car modification shop.
/> This is the shop that I was here for. The aquatic shop. AROWANA ======= This is one of the most highly prized fish here in Malaysia. One of this can cost up to a laptop and maybe a secondhand car.
/> It has the metallic blue toned scaled base and golden rim. The Golden Arowana This arowana shines with lots of gold-coloured scales. A lot of aquarium keepers love keeping this.
/> Short Body Koi ============== This is definitely one of my favourite types of fish. I have one platinum short body koi at home. They tend to eat a lot and grow big quite fast.
/> They also have these cute little hamsters. I have a couple of hamsters at home too. Quite the naughty little ones. They are escape artist so whenever I also check for all escape points.
/> The magnetic water bottle. This is quite useful for those enclosures that do not have any areas to hang the bottle.
/> Thank you very much for reading this post. Have a wonderful day ahead. @luueetang YouTube: www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

body.title: 🔥 Guild Brawl Battle: Eternan Brune in a 42-Mana Wild Format
body.body:
Greetings, fellow Summoners! 👋

It’s another day of Guild Brawl, and this time I want to share one of my battles from the Wild Format. This battle was quite interesting because of the combination of Eternan Brune, a 42-mana cap, and the Junior Varsity ruleset, which allowed an additional Gladiator to enter the battlefield.

For me, this was the kind of battle where choosing the right Archon and taking advantage of the ruleset can make a huge difference.

⚔️ Battle Conditions
Here are the important details of the battle:

Format: Wild
Battle Type: Guild Brawl
Mana Cap: 42
Archon: Eternan Brune
Special Modifier: Junior Varsity
Other Modifier: Holy Protection
Third Modifier: Lost Magic

The 42-mana cap gave us plenty of room to build a strong lineup, so I decided not to rely on cheap units. Instead, I wanted to maximize the value of Eternan Brune and the Gladiator mechanic.


![1000118732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pitou-chan/23wCDhmjFi1Uenn6oV5R6LLxtNuvnmtn1PoWvzpA4dwNHtDwbtBWzUp8B2gDND2cDYM4q.jpg)

🛡️ Why Eternan Brune?

The star of this battle was Eternan Brune.
Eternan Brune has the Conscript ability, which allows the use of one additional Gladiator card in battle.
This becomes especially interesting when combined with the Junior Varsity ruleset.
Junior Varsity allows me one additional Gladiator with low mana cost to be used in battle. When combined with an Archon carrying Conscript, this gives me access to multiple Gladiators on the battlefield.
That’s a huge advantage in a Guild Brawl!

![1000118733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pitou-chan/23w2ciXN8HrswgBH4thKkQ9BAjUD6hNhWB1o2RrxUNkAqebaoWNDCUmMzYiu5Sd6aRUJY.jpg)

🏛️ Junior Varsity

This ruleset is practically made for Gladiator-heavy strategies.
Its effect is simple:
One additional Gladiator may be used in battle.
Gladiators are particularly dangerous because of their Bloodlust ability. Every time a Gladiator gets a kill, its stats increase, allowing it to snowball if it starts getting eliminations.
So when I saw Junior Varsity together with Eternan Brune, I immediately thought:
\

😂
✨ Holy Protection
The second important ruleset was Holy Protection.
Under this modifier, every unit receives Divine Shield, meaning the first damage they receive is completely ignored.
This changes the opening rounds quite a bit.
Instead of immediately dealing damage to health, the first successful attack generally removes the Divine Shield. This makes:
Multiple attacks
Fast units
Sneak/Opportunity attacks
Blast
High attack frequency
particularly valuable.
It also means that simply having a very powerful single attack isn't always enough. You want to break those shields efficiently and then follow up with real damage.

🔥 My Strategy
With 42 mana available, I wanted to build a lineup that could survive the initial exchange while giving my Gladiators enough opportunity to activate Bloodlust.
The basic idea was:
1️⃣ Establish a strong frontline
The first position needed to absorb the opponent's attacks while my other units prepared to deal damage.
2️⃣ Let the Gladiators do the dirty work 😈
This was the most important part of the strategy.
Because of Junior Varsity + Conscript, I had access to multiple Gladiators.
The goal wasn't simply to have more cards.
The goal was to give Bloodlust more opportunities to activate.
One Gladiator gets a kill → stats increase.
Another Gladiator gets a kill → stats increase again.
If the opponent fails to stop them early, the battle can quickly become a snowball.
3️⃣ Take advantage of Holy Protection
Since every unit has Divine Shield, the opening attacks are extremely important.
Removing the opponent's shields quickly creates opportunities for the next attacks to actually eliminate units.

![1000118734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pitou-chan/23tbiC6KUDYj61UHvtECavSoPYrGxHZG2asyEeQWnkDUNPvM4MZmtmvPbJDZvApcJSJbw.jpg)

⚔️ The Battle

Looking at the battlefield, both sides brought a fairly balanced lineup.
My opponent had several strong units capable of dealing consistent damage, while my lineup was built around creating opportunities for the Gladiators to gain Bloodlust stacks.
The first few attacks were mainly about removing Divine Shields.
Once those shields started disappearing, the battle became much more dangerous.
This is where the value of having additional Gladiators became apparent.
Instead of depending on a single Bloodlust unit, I had multiple potential threats.
Every successful kill could potentially make the next round even more difficult for my opponent.

🧠 What I Learned From This Battle
This battle reminded me that rulesets should influence your entire lineup, not just one or two card choices.
The combination of:
42 Mana + Holy Protection + Junior Varsity + Eternan Brune
creates a very interesting environment.
Eternan Brune isn't simply an Archon that you pick because of its stats.
Its Conscript ability becomes significantly more valuable when the battle already encourages Gladiator usage.
And in a Guild Brawl, where Gladiator cards are naturally part of the game mode, that synergy becomes even more interesting.

🏆 Final Thoughts
