body.title: Soyez prêt pour l'édition de septembre du Hive Power Up Month !
body.body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/M9RD8KS.png)

Comme vous le savez sans doute, le Power Up Month a désormais lieu tous les mois et la prochaine édition débutera demain.

<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/en_16.png) This post is translated in English - **[here](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pum-202609)**</sub>
<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/es_16.png) Este post está traducido al español - **[aquí](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz-es/pum-202609)**</sub>

Ne manquez pas l'opportunité d'obtenir votre badge PUM. Mais ne le prenez pas pour acquis car de nombreux participants des éditions précédentes ont admis à quel point ce défi est difficile.

L'objectif du Power Up Month est de récompenser ceux qui font des power-ups réguliers plutôt qu'un seul power-up comme le font par exemple de nombreux utilisateurs pour le [Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz/pud-202609).

## C'est parti pour un autre mois !

**Le 1er septembre** n'est pas seulement le [Hive Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz-fr/pud-202609) mais aussi le début d'un **nouveau mois de Hive Power Up !**

### Comment obtenir le badge Power Up Month ?

Ce nouveau défi PUM débutera le premier jour du mois et durera tout le mois. Voici les règles :

Pour **chaque jour du mois**, vous avez 2 options :

**Option 1:**

1. Vous **postez une publication** et **choisisser le mode de paiement 100 % HIVE**.
2. Votre message doit générer un paiement pour être éligible (c'est-à-dire obtenir quelques upvotes)
3. Vous ne pouvez pas définir quelqu'un d'autre comme bénéficiaire de votre publication. Il s'agit de faire un power up de **votre propre compte**.
4. Vous ne pouvez pas vous upvoter vous-même

L'utilisation de cette option est également un bon moyen d'obtenir également le badge d'auteur mensuel. ;)

**Option 2:**
1. **faite un Power Up d'au moins 1 HIVE**.
2. Vous ne pouvez pas faire de Power Down pendant le mois.

Cette option est utile si un jour vous n'avez pas d'inspiration pour écrire ou si vous n'êtes tout simplement pas un blogueur.

> Vous pouvez utiliser l'une ou l'autre option, ou les deux, et passer de l'une à l'autre au fil des jours.

### Suivez vos progrès

Rendez-vous sur votre [tableau HiveBuzz](https://hivebuzz.me) et cliquez sur le badge du Power Up Month en cours. Vous verrez apparaître un calendrier en plus de la description avec toutes les actions que vous avez entreprises et qui ont influencé votre participation au Power Up Month.

<center> ![](https://i.imgur.com/2yuZgth.png)
<sub>_Exemple tiré d'un participant d'une édition précédente._</sub>
</center>

Pour le jour en cours (cerclé de bleu) et tous les jours précédents, les symboles suivants peuvent apparaître :

|Symboles|Description|
|-|-|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/gFO2aue.png)|Vous avez publié un article avec le mode 100% Hive Power|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/NFhC8R0.png)|Vous avez fait un Power Up d'au moins 1 HP|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/2Kg9gma.png)|Un Power Down est survenu. Cela vous disqualifie pour ce PUM|

Cela vous permettra de suivre avec précision leurs progrès tout au long du mois.

**<div class=\

>IMPORTANT :** HiveBuzz utilise les **date et heure UTC** pour valider les publications et de Power Up. Par conséquent, vérifiez votre fuseau horaire et **convertissez votre heure locale en UTC** avant de le faire !
![](https://i.imgur.com/OOhjUQh.png)
Suivez strictement les règles ci-dessus et ce badge sera à vous ! Les badges seront distribués après la fin du Power Up Month. #
Amusez-vous et n'oubliez pas vos Power Up!
---
_HiveBuzz est un projet créé par @arcange_

body.title: ¡Prepárate para el Power Up Month de septiembre!
body.body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/M9RD8KS.png)

Como sabrán, Power Up Month ahora se lleva a cabo todos los meses y la próxima edición comenzará mañana.

<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/en_16.png) This post is translated in English - **[here](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pum-202609)**</sub>
<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/fr_16.png) Une version en français de ce post est disponible - **[ici](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz-fr/pum-202609)**</sub>

No pierdas la oportunidad de obtener tu insignia de PUM. Pero no lo des por sentado ya que muchos de los participantes de las ediciones anteriores han reconocido lo difícil que es este desafío.

El objetivo del Power Up Month es recompensar a aquellos que hacen power-ups regulares en lugar de un solo power-up como hacen muchos usuarios para el [Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz/pud-202609).

## ¡Vamos por un mes más!

**El 1 de septiembre** no es solo el [Hive Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz/pud-202609) sino también el comienzo de un **nuevo Hive Power Up Month!**

### ¿Cómo obtener la insignia Power Up Month?

Este nuevo desafío PUM comenzará el primer día del mes y durará todo el mes. Estas son las reglas:

Para **cada día del mes**, tiene 2 opciones:

**Opción 1:**
1. **realiza una publicación** y **establece el modo de recompensas** en **\

**.
2. Tu publicación debe generar un pago para ser elegible.
3. No puede establecer a otra persona como el beneficiario de su publicación. Se trata de potenciar **tu cuenta**.
4. No puede votarse a sí mismo

Usar esta opción una buena oportunidad para obtener las insignias de autor diarias semanal y mensual también ;)

**Opcion 2:**
Si no planeas publicar o no tienes idea de qué escribir algún día o simplemente no eres un bloguero, alternativamente puedes:
1. **Hacer power up a al menos 1 HIVE**.
2. No se puede hacer power down durante el mes

> Puede cambiar entre opciones de un día a otro. El objetivo principal es power-up algo de HIVE todos los días del mes.

### Sigue tu progreso

Vaya a su [tablero HiveBuzz](https://hivebuzz.me) y haga clic en la insignia del actual Power Up Month. Verá aparecer un calendario además de la descripción con todas las acciones que ha realizado que influyeron en su participación en el Power Up Month.

<center>![](https://i.imgur.com/2yuZgth.png)
<sub>_Ejemplo tomado de una edición anterior._</sub>
</center>

Para el día actual (encerrado en un círculo azul) y todos los días anteriores, pueden aparecer los siguientes símbolos:

|Símbolo|Descripción|
|-|-|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/gFO2aue.png)|Publicaste una publicación con el modo 100% Hive Power|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/NFhC8R0.png)|Hiciste un Power Up de al menos 1 HP|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/2Kg9gma.png)|Se produjo un Power Down. Esto lo descalifica para este PUM|

Esto le permitirá realizar un seguimiento preciso de su progreso a lo largo del mes.

**<div class=\

>IMPORTANTE:** HiveBuzz usara **Fecha y hora UTC** para validar publicaciones y fechas de Power Ups. Por lo tanto, verifique su zona horaria y **converte tu hora local a UTC** antes de hacerlo.
![](https://i.imgur.com/OOhjUQh.png)
¡Siga estrictamente las reglas anteriores y esta insignia será suya! Las insignias se distribuirán después de que finalice el Power Up Month. #
Diviertete y Haz Power Up!
---

> *\

*

--- You should rather call it a massive propaganda operation. Because there are many more people involved in producing propaganda videos than in actual rescue operations.

> *\

*

--- Yes, Emperor Xi is very involved and very concerned. So much so that he travelled to Kyrgyzstan: [Putin, Xi set for Central Asia summit as Russia and China seek to counter Western influence](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20260830-putin-xi-set-for-central-asia-summit-as-russia-china-seek-to-counter-western-influence)

*

> *\

*

[Worse Than Tibet-Nepal Mudslide: China’s Fake Rescue, From Premier To Rescue Team,Everyone Is Acting](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y5HJvPAHhdw): Not a fan of China Observer because they are a bit too biased, but in this video they actually show quite well how China is faking its rescue operations.

body.title: Tipping Continues to Decline as @Savvyplayer Maintains Lead
body.body:
![Weekly tip summary](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNZQwHwnLHNsP6gUGLXXiEPpu3ZCciLK3wcxHyh4ZtBgW/tipchart-2026-08-31.png)

This time around, the platform saw a total of 1,620 tips—down from the previous 1,780. There's a noticeable decrease in activity, with 35 unique tippers and 181 unique recipients, both slightly fewer than last period's 36 tippers and 194 recipients.

The top tippers list sees @savvyplayer holding onto the top spot, contributing 373 tips over the week and pushing their streak to 44 days straight. Others following in the rankings include @pepetoken with 232 tips, joining the ranks impressively, along with @tydynrain contributing 215 tips. @savvytester and @cagolistic round out the top five with 213 and 137 tips, respectively.

On the receiving end, @tydynrain takes the lead with 297 tips received, outpacing others appreciably. Familiar names like @savvyplayer and @cagolistic received 193 and 133 tips, while @savvytester and @barski received 107 and 73 tips, respectively.

Bots remain key conduits for tip dispatching—most notably @indeedly, responsible for 436 tips, leading the way this round. Close behind are @mmbbot at 341 tips and @hopelizer with 266. Given the decreased overall numbers, these remain substantial contributions.

We also noted @savvytester hit a milestone by receiving 1,000 tips overall, while @savvyplayer sent out their 1,000th tip, marking a significant achievement. Meanwhile, newcomers joined the ranks, adding fresh activity to the mix.

In the monthly MMB leaderboard for August, @savvyplayer leads with 2,660 tips, eyeing the 10 MMB prize. Not far behind, @barski and @savvytester compete for the 5 and 2.5 MMB prizes. As the month wraps up, there's still a chance for others to take a shot at moving up.

Lastly, congratulations to raffle winners like @lazzvi and @elizabethbit, among others, who walked away with various small tier prizes. Keep an eye on these names—raffle wins can signal a shift in the tipping landscape later on.

body.title: Emotions are fleeting, and...
body.body:
>

>The feelings are lasting. The problems, the couple conflicts! They are a thorny issue for a few. If someone loves us, they will be willing to forgive and go through all the crises with us. He will wait for the anger to pass after an argument, he will recognize his contribution to the conflict, live \

, perhaps to repair mistakes, and better understand our relationships. There are couples who sleep in the same bed, share the same roof, know the routine by heart... they stopped really meeting a long time ago. And that which united them at the beginning (the complicity, the desire, the desire) was running out of space within the bond. Then our bond as a couple falls into numbness, which kills love. In fact, it often happens that if the last deep conversation we had with our partner we don't even remember it anymore, and if everything we talk about is only functional, that is, on autopilot, there we have the answer. The good news is that this meeting is recovering. Because not necessarily love is over, but we stop feeding it, which is very different. Watch out for that... And many times the most common mistake is to think that if it was time to work on the relationship, it's because the love is no longer there. Well, no, no, it's just that sometimes we just stop feeding him, which is very different. You can share a bed, a roof and a routine, and still not really meet for months. There is a kind of distance that is not noticeable because there are no fights, only functional silence. We can even coordinate who's looking for the kids, what's for dinner, who paid for such a thing. One can work like this for years, coordinating everything perfectly with the couple, without really meeting again. Love can be one of the most liberating and rewarding experiences there is. But also one of the greatest sources of suffering. Maybe not because loving is the problem. But because many times we come to love without having first learned to be complete for us mismos.No there is nothing that causes more suffering than love.And nothing more liberating either. Be careful with that, change that and change everything. I think relationships in healthy couples don't blame themselves for how they feel. They take their part. They are heard... And they accompany each other without exigency, because love is chosen with intimacy, agreements and desires. Because being together doesn't necessarily mean feeling close. Sometimes the routine works, responsibilities are fulfilled and the relationship continues, but desires cease to be named, intimacy cools down and agreements are maintained out of habit, even if they no longer represent what both need. Expressing what we feel, without insulting, without offending, would not have to break a genuine, loyal, and honest bond. Janitze 🌹

# <center>GLD Delegation Returns</center>

The GLD project currently delegates Hive Power through ten dedicated accounts. The table below compares the annualized return produced by each community over the past week, month, three months, and the payment history found in each account's latest approximately 200 operations.

| GLD account | Community paying rewards | Current delegation | 1-week APR | 1-month APR | 3-month APR | Since first payment found |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| @dustsweeper.gld | Dustsweeper | 102.573 HP | 20.38% | 11.55% | 9.56% | 8.15% |
| @ecency.gld | Ecency | 102.573 HP | 8.79% | 8.31% | 8.11% | 8.09% |

| @ocdb.gld | OCDB | 102.953 HP | 7.19% | 7.22% | 6.54% | 6.42% |
| @splinter.gld | Ladies of Hive | 102.761 HP | 4.21% | 4.07% | 4.07% | 4.05% |
| @qurator.gld | Qurator | 102.761 HP | 6.39% | 6.24% | 6.21% | 6.20% |
| @hivepakistan.gld | Hive Pakistan | 102.567 HP | 6.61% | 6.93% | 6.79% | 6.69% |

## How the figures are calculated

Each percentage is an annualized APR calculated from matching HIVE payments received from the listed reward account. The one-week, one-month, and three-month columns use payments received during the trailing 7, 30, and 90 days.

The final column uses all matching payments found in the account's latest approximately 200 operations, beginning with the oldest matching payment returned. It is therefore not necessarily a lifetime return.

The current delegation is converted from VESTS to HP using Hive's current vesting ratio. Because the longer-period return is compared with the current delegation rather than every historical delegation change, it should be treated as a useful comparison rather than a perfect audited investment return.

Returns can vary considerably over short periods. A one-week result may contain an unusually large or small payment, while the longer periods generally provide a steadier comparison.

body.title: 胡思乱想（杂记）
body.body:
![1-3ba0b7e0f510.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mtggy6cx-8kyny5hb/1-3ba0b7e0f510.webp)

![6-c12c40b3f305.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mtggy6cx-8kyny5hb/6-c12c40b3f305.webp)

![2-3b6e9e964ffa.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mtggy6cx-8kyny5hb/2-3b6e9e964ffa.webp)

![3-ff1666208634.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mtggy6cx-8kyny5hb/3-ff1666208634.webp)

![4-ebdd20674457.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mtggy6cx-8kyny5hb/4-ebdd20674457.webp)

![5-6d3345395620.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mtggy6cx-8kyny5hb/5-6d3345395620.webp)

早上下着小雨，一会又转成中雨，但是还是按捺不住想运动的心情。做了几组仰卧起坐，俯卧撑，接着又撑着伞出门散步了。

最近有越来越多感悟，身体健康才是最重要的，像什么名啊，利啊，其实都是浮云，只有自己身体好了，其他一切才好。所以最近一有空就锻炼，下雨了就在室内练，感觉自己棒棒的。

不止我一个人在雨中散步锻炼。走过一条两边种满高大树木的路段，迎面走一对六七十岁的阿姨，她们不一点也没受雨水的影响，健步如飞。我想，散步已经成为她们的一种生活习惯，我在心里为她们点赞。

早上的雨时大时小，我的脚步也时缓时急。像这种没有限制，没有压力的散步是最轻松的，加上下雨的空气特别清新。感觉自己暂时从各种纷纷扰扰中脱离开来，沉浸在自己的世界里。

打开手机，铺天盖地的明星八卦。前天刚发生自然灾害，让人感觉五味杂陈。娱乐圈我本来不想了解的，但是到处都是这些。群里有人说，吃完这个瓜，我实在想不到有钱的坏处。我想，有钱固然好，但它并不是唯一。

当然，人应该趁着年轻多赚点钱。它和健康一样，是很多东西的基础。想到这里，我又加快了脚步，赶着回去开门迎客。又是努力奋斗充满正能量的一天，继续为灾区人民默默祈祷，惟愿一切平安。
body.author: huigezi

body.body: No tener el servicio es terrible, y tal como dices, a veces se puede prever, pero en otras oportunidades o en algunos emprendimientos es vital tenerla, así que planificar no siempre da resultado, pero si aprovechar mientras tengan el servicio.\nMe hiciste recordar cuando trabajaba en la universidad y se iba la luz, casi todos salían de las oficinas a esperar que volviera, mientras yo me dedicaba a archivar, organizar mi escritorio, hacer agenda, corregir trabajos, y siempre buscaba algo para aprovechar el tiempo a pesar de no tener el servicio.

body.title: Cada cabeza es un mundo, desde cualquier tipo de mundo.
body.body:
>Muy buenos días amigos de Hive, les saluda Angélica García, esperando que estén muy bien y sobre todo felices, es un placer para mi traerles esta nueva publicación artística, es una locura creativa, un invento ilustrado de cada cabeza es un mundo de pensamientos, que espero sea de su agrado.
DISFRÚTENLA.
Ficha de identificación de la obra.
>Título: Cada cabeza es un mundo, desde cualquier tipo de mundo.\n
>Técnica: Lápiz de grafito, acuarela, acrílico y lápiz de colores, sobre cartulina.\n

>Nota: la secuencia de fotografías e imágenes de esta ilustración fueron tomadas con la cámara digital Canon, PowerShot A480, algunos detalles que eran necesarios, para lograr lo que deseaba presentar, fueron realizados con el programa Adobe Photoshop, además las diapositivas fueron pasadas a formato jpg con el programa Power point.

*Cada cabeza es un mundo, desde cualquier tipo de mundo.*

![Diapositiva4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcDTh4dYBYSP2pxDD4N5rPrw27QsHwYQjXg1JDuBrYff/Diapositiva4.JPG)

>Amigos de Hive, creadores de la ilusión y la locura, de personajes fuera de lo común, de los pensamiento de cada persona del universo, o seres de una realidad paralela a la nuestra, o simple pesadilla nocturna, que comienza al caerse por un hueco oscuro antes de dormirse, una locura ilustrada, la cual se realizó de la siguiente manera:\n\n+ Primeramente realice un dibujo sencillo de este rostro algo narizón, al que se agregó la base de un sombrero, mientras trabajaba en esta parte inicial fui remarcando cada línea, hasta el punto de que la creatividad, ponía imágenes en mis pensamientos, y empezaron a aparecer las diferentes cabezas o rostros de diferentes mundos, buenos o de miedo, porque como dice el título de la obra, \

...
![Diapositiva1.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWioyqo16B31UAHqmbUUDrEZotWQmFjHpYu2y34ZUYUaS/Diapositiva1.JPG)
+ La locura continúan y los personajes están apareciendo, con estilos y aura propios al caminar, sobre una escalera flotante, como pequeños pedazos de troncos, que flotan encima de la pureza blanquecina del extraño ambiente, o universo paralelo de la nada, con una bruma azulada, como terreno forestal de un planeta en particular...
![Diapositiva2.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdLaCKk7r2v1uR7yKD4ZRWFpnhZNVx1FFhQi1GHzfENQq/Diapositiva2.JPG)
+ Del firmamento universal salen ramificaciones de arbustos, que van completando una nueva realidad ancestral de la naturaleza de otro planeta, y del mi personaje principal tres luces blancas emanan hasta el universo como señal de comunicación.
![Diapositiva3.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNqRVtWUHoX32ottzqHktVecG3uFtWwKFS2gHhCdb95sC/Diapositiva3.JPG)
+ Las texturas y los brillos anexados, generan una profundidad y seguridad a lo plasmado, que alegra aún más la locura ilustrada, la cual se tituló:

*Cada cabeza es un mundo, desde cualquier tipo de mundo.*

![Diapositiva4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcDTh4dYBYSP2pxDD4N5rPrw27QsHwYQjXg1JDuBrYff/Diapositiva4.JPG)
>Desde que tengo uso de razón he escuchado la expresión de que \

, y hasta cierto punto de vista considero que el refrán afirma, que cada ser humano tiene la capacidad de pensar y sentir a su manera, porque cada quien goza de su nivel de pensamiento, por lo tanto considero que la creencia de un lugar habitado y con vida fuera del planeta tierra, es una realidad que deberíamos aceptar, y que cada mundo debe estar habitado, con humanoides con conciencia y vida parecida a la de nosotros...\n\n

>Cada cabeza es un mundo de pensamientos, por lo tanto cada artista es creativo a su estilo, por lo tanto es aceptado la creatividad loca de cada artista, como el mundo que se ha ilustrado, que espero haya sido de su agrado.
Muchas gracias por su amable atención.
Atentamente:

*Angélica García.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhLuyt81ScLNqyt949pHfdVokVWn16NHMRErM2iGeQGE/diapositiva1.jpg)
_________________________________________________________ >
HELLO!, HELLO! And HELLO!
>

>Good morning, Hive friends! This is Angélica García. I hope you're all doing well and, above all, happy. It's a pleasure to bring you this new artwork. It's a creative whirlwind, an illustrated invention: every head is a world of thoughts. I hope you enjoy it. >
ENJOY!
>
Artwork Identification Sheet.
>
>Title: Every Head Is a World, From Any Kind of World.\n>
>Technique: Graphite pencil, watercolor, acrylic, and colored pencils on cardboard.\n>

>Note: The sequence of photographs and images for this illustration were taken with a Canon PowerShot digital camera. A480, some details that were necessary to achieve what I wanted to present were done with Adobe Photoshop, and the slides were converted to JPG format with PowerPoint. >

*Every mind is a world, from any kind of world.*

![Slide4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcDTh4dYBYSP2pxDD4N5rPrw27QsHwYQjXg1JDuBrYff/Slide4.JPG)
>

>Friends of Hive, creators of illusion and madness, of extraordinary characters, of the thoughts of every person in the universe, or beings from a parallel reality to our own, or simply a nightmarish nightmare that begins when falling down a dark hole before falling asleep, an illustrated madness, which was created as follows:\n\n>+ First, I made a simple drawing of this somewhat big-nosed face, to which I added the base of a hat. While working on this initial part, I refined each line, to the point that creativity conjured images in my mind, and different heads or faces from different worlds, both good and scary, began to appear, because as the title of the work says, \

...
![Slide1.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWioyqo16B31UAHqmbUUDrEZotWQmFjHpYu2y34ZUYUaS/Slide1.JPG)
>+ The madness continues, and the characters are appearing, each with their own style and aura, as they walk on a floating staircase, like small pieces of tree trunks, floating above the whitish purity of the strange environment, or parallel universe of nothingness, with a bluish mist, like the forest terrain of a planet in Particular...
![Slide2.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdLaCKk7r2v1uR7yKD4ZRWFpnhZNVx1FFhQi1GHzfENQq/Slide2.JPG)
>+ From the universal firmament emerge branches of shrubs, completing a new ancestral reality of nature from another planet, and from my main character, three white lights emanate into the universe as a signal of communication.
![Slide3.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNqRVtWUHoX32ottzqHktVecG3uFtWwKFS2gHhCdb95sC/Slide3.JPG)
>+ The added textures and highlights create depth and a sense of security in the image, further enhancing the illustrated madness, which is titled: >

*Every head is a world, from any kind of world.*

![Slide4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcDTh4dYBYSP2pxDD4N5rPrw27QsHwYQjXg1JDuBrYff/Slide4.JPG)
>
>Since I can remember, I've heard the expression that \

and to a certain extent, I believe the saying affirms that each human being has the capacity to think and feel in their own way, because everyone has their own level of thought. Therefore, I believe that the idea of ​​an inhabited place with life outside planet Earth is a reality we should accept, and that every world must be inhabited by humanoids with consciousness and a life similar to our own...\n\n>

>Every head is a world of thoughts, therefore every artist is creative in their own style, and therefore the wild creativity of each artist is accepted, as is the world that has been illustrated, which I hope you enjoyed. >
Thank you very much for your kind attention.
>
Sincerely:
>

*Angélica García.*

body.body:
Greetings, friend! It’s been a while since I read your posts, but I’m glad I didn’t miss this reflection. I was really struck by what you mentioned near the end—that many places ban screens and even have guards to enforce those rules. In this part of the world, or at least in my country, things are very different. People here don't have much money, yet they still celebrate in a big way; as for those who have more, I think they squander it—or rather, they go overboard. I did have a bit too much beer one night last month 😅, but it was a very special evening with loved ones, and we really needed it after sharing stories about our experiences following the earthquake. Yes, we young people should keep finding ways to unwind and have a good time, though I’ve personally chosen to keep a wholesome group of friends and go hiking up the mountain. I suppose it sounds boring, hahaha, but sometimes it helps me relax and recharge just as much as going out to party does. Sending you a big hug from afar and wishing you a great start to the week!...

body.title: STREAK DAY 5🥱🥲STEEMHOP
body.body:
***
![IMG_7328.png](https://rpc.blurt.blog/m/0e59902ba5cbacedc5059b725f056a7a)
***

Day 5 of the steemhop grind and I’m fully in leaderboard mode now. Opened http://steemhop.org this morning and my only goal was to beat my day 4 high score of 21 and finally crack TOP 52. First 20 minutes were pure pain. Died at 0, died at -1, died at 1. I kept running straight into red cars and one time a train just smoked me on the tracks because I didn’t wait. The map is still that same orange desert with the little white bunny with the red bow hopping around. Cars were flying in both lanes, purple and orange ones, and the coins were everywhere tempting me. I kept telling myself coins don’t matter, survival does. But it’s hard when you see 3 coins in a row and your brain says go get them. “TOP 52” was sitting at the top left the whole time judging me.
Then I finally found some rhythm and the runs started clicking. Got to 5, then 12, then 19 before I got greedy and tried to grab a coin on the train tracks and got clipped. That was annoying but I could feel myself improving. The timing was getting better, I wasn’t panicking as much when cars came fast. My best run of the day was when I hit 32. I remember it clearly because I was holding my breath the whole time. Dodged 2 purple cars back to back, waited for the gap on the train tracks, cleared it clean, then got through 3 more lanes of traffic. 15, 20, 25, 30, 32. I died right after but when I saw that number pop up I was hyped. That’s 11 more than day 4. Coin total also went up to 59 during that session because I was actually picking some up safely instead of chasing them.
The rest of the session was just trying to repeat that 32 and not fall back into bad habits. Had runs where I died at 2 because I rushed, and one terrible run where I went -2 because I spawned and immediately hopped into a car. But I also had solid runs of 14, 19, and another 21 to tie my old PB. The hardest part about steemhop is staying patient. You can play perfect for 10 seconds and then one bad hop sends you back to the STEEM HOP logo screen. I must’ve seen that big orange logo like 30 times today. The trains and cars get faster the higher you go too, so at 30+ it’s actually stressful. My hands were sweating on the last run to 32 but I didn’t choke.
Ending day 5 with a new personal best of 32 and 59 coins total. Still not on TOP 52 but I’m so much closer now. Day 1 I was dying at 7, day 4 I hit 21, now day 5 I’m at 32. The progress is real if I keep grinding. For day 6 the goal is 40+ and actually getting my name on that leaderboard. I need to stop going for coins unless they’re safe and just focus on clean hops. The streak is still alive and I’m not dropping it. Day 5 done, new PB, and I’m coming back tomorrow to take that TOP 52 spot 💪

***
![IMG_7329.png](https://rpc.blurt.blog/m/e109926866fb3745d693afc67ce2959a)

![IMG_7330.png](https://rpc.blurt.blog/m/7cd8cd22704f3ec058a24e096ad63987)
***
THANKS FOR VISITING 
***

body.title: A Church Day for Sunday
body.body:
Today, I am going to share to you about the happenings that happened yesterday. Well, there was no any fancy things that happened but I just went to the church and pray as early as eight in the morning.


![1000009739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23xVKE9cuGMV7aNaYpTXnDdw3gT3pEZFVDSjJ6gzmDzC14cg3k7NqbvVg4UbnZPfSTe1Y.jpg)


There were several time stamp that the church offer for the people on what time do they like to go to church, there were three options. They were six o'clock, eight o'clock, and the english mass was half past four.

I chose the eight o'clock mass because that's more convenient for me. The six o'clock mass is too early for me to wake up since I slept a little late while in the half past four was not recommended since my work starts at five in the afternoon.

I went here alone in our church because there were no other people that I knew in my family that wants to join to the church. 

Actually, at the time that I went here, I was late because I wake up a little late, too. I also need to prepare myself and such to go to the church. 


![1000009741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/2432HpwVAideJSEZy6t1rqCc4czntFghccHVV443MzsJtwptYb5S9XTQ9GbN1TXT3EULx.jpg)


Even if I was late but I was able to pray at that time but I did'nt listen to the gospel of the priest and was disappointed to myself because I was late on going to the church.

Still, it's better than late than never so, I just went there even if I was late because I want to pray. A pray that comes from the heart. 

There were several people that went to the church, too. When I went there, there were lots of people that were standing and I was one of the that was standing at the end aisle of the church because the seats were already full. 


![1000009740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23wqkijw5joDjsDEPe1vJCoWbZBXhNwVjYVNUHniERK5mqQdpP7EcBJxiWY67dWkdXr26.jpg)


I was standing the whole time listening to the remaining steps of the church but I was glad to attend since I prayed a lot at that time. Prayed to something not to myself but to other people, too. 

Church happens once in a week, so I went here to pray. Even if I am alone if I am persevere enough to go to church, maybe or my prayer will come someday.

body.title: DAY 5 STEEMHOP GRIND🥱🥲
body.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![DAY 5 STEEMHOP GRIND🥱🥲](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/8e3e0de0-51ba-4347-91b0-fa9c15231474.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/3JpWXdVwix1LTpQRUdtJAe) 
 
 
***
![IMG_7328.png](https://rpc.blurt.blog/m/0e59902ba5cbacedc5059b725f056a7a)
***

Day 5 of the steemhop grind and I’m fully in leaderboard mode now. Opened http://steemhop.org this morning and my only goal was to beat my day 4 high score of 21 and finally crack TOP 52. First 20 minutes were pure pain. Died at 0, died at -1, died at 1. I kept running straight into red cars and one time a train just smoked me on the tracks because I didn’t wait. The map is still that same orange desert with the little white bunny with the red bow hopping around. Cars were flying in both lanes, purple and orange ones, and the coins were everywhere tempting me. I kept telling myself coins don’t matter, survival does. But it’s hard when you see 3 coins in a row and your brain says go get them. “TOP 52” was sitting at the top left the whole time judging me.
Then I finally found some rhythm and the runs started clicking. Got to 5, then 12, then 19 before I got greedy and tried to grab a coin on the train tracks and got clipped. That was annoying but I could feel myself improving. The timing was getting better, I wasn’t panicking as much when cars came fast. My best run of the day was when I hit 32. I remember it clearly because I was holding my breath the whole time. Dodged 2 purple cars back to back, waited for the gap on the train tracks, cleared it clean, then got through 3 more lanes of traffic. 15, 20, 25, 30, 32. I died right after but when I saw that number pop up I was hyped. That’s 11 more than day 4. Coin total also went up to 59 during that session because I was actually picking some up safely instead of chasing them.
The rest of the session was just trying to repeat that 32 and not fall back into bad habits. Had runs where I died at 2 because I rushed, and one terrible run where I went -2 because I spawned and immediately hopped into a car. But I also had solid runs of 14, 19, and another 21 to tie my old PB. The hardest part about steemhop is staying patient. You can play perfect for 10 seconds and then one bad hop sends you back to the STEEM HOP logo screen. I must’ve seen that big orange logo like 30 times today. The trains and cars get faster the higher you go too, so at 30+ it’s actually stressful. My hands were sweating on the last run to 32 but I didn’t choke.
Ending day 5 with a new personal best of 32 and 59 coins total. Still not on TOP 52 but I’m so much closer now. Day 1 I was dying at 7, day 4 I hit 21, now day 5 I’m at 32. The progress is real if I keep grinding. For day 6 the goal is 40+ and actually getting my name on that leaderboard. I need to stop going for coins unless they’re safe and just focus on clean hops. The streak is still alive and I’m not dropping it. Day 5 done, new PB, and I’m coming back tomorrow to take that TOP 52 spot 💪

***

![IMG_7330.png](https://rpc.blurt.blog/m/7cd8cd22704f3ec058a24e096ad63987)

body.title: Leker, A Traditional Crepe-Similar Snack
body.body:
>


At first glance, I think it looks like crepes. The only difference is that this snack is folded once. What do you think?

![IMG_8878.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK56DZjjRFhDoup52ZDu63THJcd4TqV79CzKvGLBtTLNd98Y4WoNPpCvE67eKf7.jpeg)
![IMG_8876.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJhZvpJ68QjehTqucCv4T9BKufm2VgKEDuyxynJPcViy3BerNWdp9Qx8x98fGwy.jpeg)
This is a traditional snack from Solo, called Leker. Yes, according to various sources I've read, this traditional snack comes from the Dutch word \

which means delicious.


![IMG_8872.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKLt7CYHacZhqhnXN7HDts39wgTM5EtKseT1YLYguxuqoEzsVASBVAk7FEXfexT.jpeg)
It does have a connection to the Netherlands because there used to be a lot of Dutch people in Solo. Yes, that's part of a dark history. But from that dark history, many cultural influences naturally came into play.

The Dutch love crepes, but by adapting them to traditional ingredients and equipment, Leker was created. Similar to crepes, but different. With its own unique characteristics.

It's named leker because the Dutch used to say this food was delicious. Lekker, Lekker, so the word was adopted by the locals as \

---

![IMG_8873.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJmrhu4QFhe1gdvHKZQH2F6xTUVyNS1Ut8yLdakwFn15hWNRS2F1m2KwWLqv3a9.jpeg)

I enjoyed this Lekker at a food stall in a mall. There's a minimum order of 3 pieces, but you can order with different toppings. I ordered Leker with banana, chocolate peanut, and cheese toppings.

![IMG_8875.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKRBk5tdUncRMCtGsWYKyytp2XDSMdB6KsiPUyTDttxA74JHxQ7H8HdtoJHbgWt.jpeg)

The outer crust of the Leker was very crispy! Be careful because it's very easy to get crumbs, hehe. So don't let your mouth get full of crumbs, hehe. But it was good, right?! Very crispy.


![IMG_8877.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK9PpyKZLpRXtboSRaUzxvkUQnZoFYqERypfFDQ3XH7JbkjsE9S8bhXpw4xY3E2.jpeg)
Meanwhile, the inside, filled with toppings, looked moist with the toppings.

My favorite was the original version of Leker with banana filling. It tasted very local to my taste, hehe. I love bananas!

---

![IMG_8881.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKJ1ykaZi4zDpsy1Fm6nAuaXModmLFwYiAqcQiNGCCPgTCUkHHmsHDaGTTUibqz.jpeg)

But wait. The cheese topping was also my favorite. The cheese topping is of course adapted to today's young people's favorite cheese toppings. This traditional snack is definitely not one you want to miss 😊

---

![IMG_8879.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJoKCTxsUXtZffJrUSniAXbikfJFzBKeVKYrxmBJEyrRB5RJNmkQ3E1bX1TVmxK.jpeg)
Lastly, I enjoyed Leker with chocolate peanut topping. Oh, the perfect combo! All the variants were delicious.

This was my first time trying this traditional snack, and it was definitely worth a try!

Well, I didn't finish it all myself. I asked my husband to help me finish half of each topping. Hehe. That's a man's job, right? 🤣

So, have you ever tried this similar snack? What's your favorite topping? Have a great day!

![IMG_8874.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJmsdjbbzZygJmhqQKcsdnop8tnSRboP11eeDxds2MqN94z4ZGs2tX3VUf6J8DC.jpeg)


---
---
---


>Best Regards,
Anggrek Lestari


---

She has a goal to share life, poem, and food content that makes others happy and can get inspiration. --- Contact Person: authoranggreklestari@gmail.com Discord: anggreklestari#3009 ---

body.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1502 - A Sunny Sunday of Asset Management and Working with Hermes - GaiaYoga Gardens, Lower Puna, Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Saturday, August 29, 2026
body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260827_165048128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u67Pi54ETkxWGxYwTG2VQhD99tPPoApBbWQi3gJGbJBSh4UmdSRnXfyDe6sjnqovNTa.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 26.23% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0429 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.953 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.00974162 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.14779579 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00086129 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.187374 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001279 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 78,679.50 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 251.57 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 49.385 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,453.89 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 66.46 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #121 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#95 (among active witnesses only)/881.9k HP in votes/46 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 Very thankfully it's a lovely sunny Sunday, and I've got a good bit of asset management to do today, both on my own account, and on assorted 'We Are Alive Tribe' accounts. Today's also the Sunday when I'm supposed give my Hermes agent a walk-through of my community asset management for the We Are Alive Tribe, though whether that will actually happen still remains to be seen. There just might not be enough time, and we still have a few loose ends to tie up first. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260827_164928459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQrpaAu9WXiWq9CHT85HeZSVeMGN9EpcZeb3GtFBZbFmc19h2ZwbyutFGiR795tZAUa.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260827_171241050_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsGJQp9B64r57fCrd2sJ49vexGTJZXAaVnEZkxCpCCaTMeUqCkbu4MH4Rd2rL1Yix9G.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I haven't done a thorough round of asset management, especially pool management, on @aliveandthriving, @heartbeatonhive, or @heartbeatvault01 for several weeks now, and it's been about a week since I've done so on my own account, mostly due to insufficient SWAP.HIVE. Now I've got a bit more with which to work. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_151040991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvXrprCoSzYqa9TLsot2gFBvcepmtvkD1nYsb3HzuiemRr5yuqa3fAFZokUcLnWKVnL.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_151414424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMQ8e6n5Y3ATnFzFAtdPgbVNg2kPgC4dELgcpUGQ4J3QoxgTibSvPxHnVheGSG9EBU5.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Although I do very much enjoy asset management, between losing the important asset-management frontend, BeeSwap, losing most daily and weekly SWAP.HIVE income, and a paucity of time, I don't do it anywhere near as often and regularly as I used to do even a few months ago. This is where integrating Hermes into assisting me with my daily and weekly asset-management tasks would really help a lot. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_151555240_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWnMNSMaTpzuCdAWVjC6Wr2DrajWeyetwXshkWGizd4NPvaXgvJRt4231HFXoBxEKBn.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_151919492_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2wztNxpm2HrvSF8Jw1VfcLG9q2vQAiZpCWDR2zfgLPceJzhfXvmErtM6qfpfnP7dtc.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) There's still a little bit of set up and testing to do before Hermes will be able to autonomously carry out asset-management tasks for me, but we're finally at a stage where we can begin testing it out, which is absolute awesome sauce. Currently Hermes can view and interact with my browser via the CUA driver, and it can browse with me as I use my browser, though some aspects of it still need to be tweaked and tested. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_152139624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQiGx7ftwJq2SHf3dJvQSKGgLyjGFTpSTfNKoBQcgZoHR3BJvReKuoaX29ZMgnnaHwE.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_152225352_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhudghuRTscg1A1UbNBgNpECoCQe5zYAGQnLaVjw89x1R5f7M787mrLLeeopv5EuWJK.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) At some point I'd like to set up Hermes to focus on ongoing hardcore asset leveraging via pools and the market, both on my account, and on a few 'We Are Alive Tribe' accounts, though that's a bit more complex, so it will take a little time. It seems like every day that what I'm able to do with agentic AI is increasing by leaps and bounds, and the potentials that are currently unfolding are pretty wild indeed, and they're getting wilder week after week. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_152241643_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2jHoJgpiEeRdvLw3mbznxVsSW2iDP5avB2HHLGusFGq3A7SND39NBbc4UbNX1NtYjF.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260828_152332999_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmBhYEQ3cNWEXSDAWbmNa1gQhvTBdaqQEXBH8JwFsy4wvUWTYXvUCNxXd4x3DudQG8j.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Saturday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by a little before 3PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts, and then to helping Ano to unload his truck after his Friday coconut-collecting run, and to load it again for the Sunday market. With that completed, and after a short break up at the Flow House, I did a small amount of bodywork on Ano (*at his request*) in the Kazbah, before we both went to continue with the clearing work that I had begun yesterday in the new orchard behind Kana's place. Once we wrapped that up for the day, I trekked back across the property, with two small harvested Melochia poles on my shoulder, to take a shower, make myself some food and collect my leftover superfood fire coffee from the fridge in Wabisabi, and with those in hands, I headed back to the Flow House to work with Hermes some more, and to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got everything done by around 9PM, and after another round of working with Hermes, I went to bed a bit to late, by just about 12AM. I woke up just before 8AM, having thankfully slept well, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to write this post. It's now just before 1:45PM, so it's an excellent time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my numerous other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on some jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! body.title: [Movie] Film Review: Obsession | Be careful what you wish for 👀🩸 [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
![1000148209.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vrtbj3LiLrCjoAYCLdCEhksqjqL4uny66raN2DoYW5PtThukJEFcWUxTttHsWVzohEb.png)


<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/eoTnA4j6Cs7A1U8iE)</sub></center>

Hello, movie and TV lovers! I hope you're all doing well. There are stories that leave you blown away by the great performances and how realistic everything feels. Plus, just when you think you're watching a specific type of plot, everything makes complete sense right at the end. That's what happened to me with **Obsession**—a movie that has been really popular lately. Although I think it came out a while ago, I hadn't had the chance to watch it yet. But it definitely deserves a watch because it's super interesting and offers a fresh take on the thriller and drama genres.

![1000148261.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23t72p7hBfqVu9Yq9M3b7eQouoPotsn6xzkBCXsVxXvcub92KYyBfwrAQobJnNHEC76nC.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/N4z5woJY3TFdYnN27)</sub></center>

Who hasn't wished for a magic wand or someone who could grant a wish that seems almost impossible to come true? Imagine walking into an occult shop to make a wish or do a ritual, and your life changes forever—literally. This happens to our protagonist, who everyone calls Bear (**Michael Johnston**), an extremely shy young man with very little confidence when connecting with others, especially women. He starts falling in love with Nikki (**Inde Navarrette**), a girl he's known since childhood, but he lacks the courage to just approach her and tell her he likes her.

![1000148230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbiBfxbkiH1pqmFKstapg7JnCXs6vBctRde9B7cArK2kPiTWQtXjg5XRi3ZFmBYQBmz.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/x8QFF2oYiUFVZ9j1l)</sub></center>

Somehow, he manages to get his wish granted, asking for Nikki to fall in love with him without having to put in much effort or face a potential rejection. Everything starts going just as he hoped—Nikki starts wanting to hang out with him, but it all happens so fast. Although this seems normal to him, they start a relationship that none of their friends can understand. Bear truly feels like his dream has come true, but you have to be careful what you wish for. Once you get what you wanted, it might not be what you expected, or it might be too much for you to handle—just like it was for Bear.

![1000148257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tRxiimBhZWzZGt6LzCkgoQvCu5CofxdxnqCpm3am2cBtC3Sp5qwABcoXvDJYw8HdULW.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/gfUALt3w22KsX6hRQ)</sub></center>

Directed and written by **Curry Barker**, this film shows the true face of obsession. That simple wish causes Nikki to fall in love in an extreme way, to the point where she doesn't even seem like herself anymore. She starts doing things that seem weird to Bear, but he quickly dismisses them with the thought that \

which is more than enough for him and what he feels for her. He got what he wanted effortlessly, but then he has to deal with the jealousy, the mood swings, Nikki's crazy ideas, and her extreme behavior—to the point where he no longer wants to be around her.

![1000148198.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wzxGcj6zd4TAAE8C6uzF2zVdnTrAmxUpdQ4ywWTGKcEuzfB7zVaJnCZ4zDRKLnMYumd.jpg)


<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/v33AwPtzOYGjDK9Sn)</sub></center>

The performances were incredible. I found Michael Johnston very endearing, even though at times he had a bit of an attitude like someone who doesn't know what he wants and just expects things to work out through luck or a wish. I had never seen him in other movies before, but I'd love to see him in different stories because I feel he has potential, especially for romance, sci-fi, or drama.
Inde Navarrette's performance as Nikki was on another level. What a performance showing intense emotions and living up to such a strange character! She could go from being totally fine to turning into a demon if she wanted to. Her way of expressing herself in the role was truly impressive, even though I don't think everyone liked her character.

![1000148265.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoEiGfYmaCTaMf3NJhDEN7s4FEBQSYp8stJrTpNk6ZDqLiYb1HmkehmHNoFFBPwPw8d.gif)

<center><sub>[source](https://www.tumblr.com/movie-gifs/824141264553476096?source=share)</sub></center>

Since it's a thriller and drama film, there are plenty of moments that are genuinely scary—like Nikki's mood swings, the things she did \

for Bear, her jealous moments, and one specific scene that left me totally shocked. It was expected, but I didn't realize it would be so intense to watch. The tension throughout the story was very believable. Although I feel both were to blame for the situation, Bear is probably more at fault for making the wish than Nikki, who had no idea she was practically possessed by it. Maybe things could have been different, but that's not how it went.

![1000148264.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoGw4L9am34K2T4xXXqF14dxBhodcRtp7gsfd5USyBnTgggRCdASifdHhdMc4U78mMN.gif)

![1000148263.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/Eo8LXCC7JtkJFehFfWqxQrVtYmZKWxRHMxiPrGz1DcNeGCxgih1vqUpkHgxLwPqC52d.gif)

<center><sub>[source](https://www.tumblr.com/movie-gifs/824141264553476096?source=share)</sub></center>

There is a lot of blood and suspenseful moments where Nikki pops up out of nowhere, building quite a bit of tension. I feel it's one of the best recent movies from the past few years, with the added bonus of how it plays with a person's mind, the way it presents a wish, and the theme of obsession. By the end, I didn't know what to expect, and it was quite shocking. I imagined a different ending, but the one they gave it was very well done, even if it felt a bit sad for one of the characters. You definitely have to watch it—it's super entertaining, and there isn't a single boring moment. 👀🩸


---

>! [Spanish Version]
>
>¡Hola, amigos amantes del cine y la televisión! Espero que se encuentren muy bien. Hay historias que te dejan impresionado, de las buenas actuaciones y de lo realista que parece todo, además, de que piensas que estás viendo algo en específico y resulta que todo cobra sentido al terminar la película. Eso me pasó con **Obsession**, una película que está muy famosa últimamente y aunque creo que ya tiene algo de tiempo de haber salido, no había tenido la oportunidad de verla. Pero sin duda merece que las personas la vean, porque está súper interesante y es algo diferente a ese estilo de películas de thriller y drama. 
>
>Cuanto no hemos querido poder tener una varita mágica o a alguien que nos pudiera conceder algún deseo que parece casi imposible de hacerse realidad. Imagina que llegas a una tienda de objetos para pedir deseos o hacer rituales y te cambia la vida para siempre, literalmente. Esto le pasó a nuestro protagonista a quien todos llaman Bear (Michael Johnston), un joven sumamente tímido con muy poca seguridad para conectar con otras personas pero sobre todo con mujeres. El se empieza a enamorar de Nikki (Inde Navarrette), una joven que conoce desde niños y que no tiene la valentía para acercarse y decirle simplemente que le gusta. 
>
>De alguna manera el consigue realizar su deseo, en el pide que Nikki se enamore de él, así sin tener que hacer mucho esfuerzo o enfrentarse a una posible negación por parte de ella. Y todo empieza a salir como el esperaba, Nikki empieza a tener intenciones de salir con él, pero todo pasa como muy rápido. Aunque esto para el le parece normal, ellos comienzan una relación que ninguno de sus amigos logra entender. Sin embargo, Bear realmente siente que su sueño se hizo realidad, pero hay que ser cautelosos con lo que se desea, puede que luego de tener lo que querías ya no sea lo que esperabas o sea demasiado para ti, como le pasó a Bear. 
>
>Dirigida y escrita por Curry Barker, este film muestra la verdadera cara de la obsesión. Ese simple deseo hace que Nikki se enamore de una forma extrema al punto en el que ya no parece ni ella misma. Llega a hacer cosas que para Bear parecen raras pero que lo cambia inmediatamente con el pensamiento de que \

y eso es más que suficiente para él y para lo que siente por ella. Sin ningún tipo de esfuerzo logro tener lo que quería, pero luego tiene que enfrentar los celos, los cambios de humor, las ideas locas de Nikki y su comportamiento extremo al punto de que ya no siente que quiera estar cerca de ella. 
>
>Las actuaciones fueron increíbles, Michael Johnston me pareció muy simpático aunque por momentos tenía cierta actitud de persona que no sabe lo que quiere y que además solo espera que las cosas salgan bien con un poco de suerte o con un deseo como él lo hizo. Además que nunca lo había visto en otras películas, me gustaría verlo en otro tipo de historias porque siento que tiene potencial sobre todo para las de romance o de ciencia ficción y drama. La actuación de Nikki Inde Navarrette si estuvo en otro nivel, que mujer para demostrar emociones fuertes y para estar a la altura de un personaje tan extraño como Nikki, ella podía pasar de estar sumamente bien a convertirse en un demonio si así lo quería, fue realmente impresionante su forma de expresarse en el papel, aunque creo que no a todo el mundo le gustó su personaje. 
>
>Como es una película de thriller y drama, hay muchos momentos en los que si da miedo lo que se está viendo. Como los cambios de humor de Nikki, las cosas que hacía \

hacia Bear, los momentos en los que tenía celos y hay una escena en específico que me dejó super impresionada y fue algo que se esperaba pero no sabía que podía ser tan fuerte de ver. Estuvo muy creíble toda la tensión que había en la historia, aunque para mí ambos fueron culpables de la situación, tal vez más Bear por pedir el deseo que Nikki quien no sabía que estaba casi que poseída por el deseo y que de alguna manera tal vez las cosas hubieran sido diferentes pero no fue así. > >Hay mucha sangre, momentos de suspenso donde aparece Nikki en cualquier lugar y genera bastante tensión. Siento que es una película muy buena de las últimas que han salido en estos años, también el plus de cómo se juega con la mente de una persona, la forma en la que presentan un deseo y también la obsesión de una persona por otra. Al final no sabía que esperar y fue un tanto impactante, me imaginaba otro final pero el que le dieron estuvo muy bien aunque me pareció un poco triste para uno de los personajes. Tienen que verla está muy entretenida y no hay momento en el que te sientas aburrido. 👀🩸 ![1000075868.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpGWXuthekT2vNu4T8cshESQpwWUYzNfL3omAr86aa9gdLhXgoHopmGsBijTWXXNhtD.png)
>Espero que les gustara este post, también me gustaría que me dejen sus comentarios; con gusto los leeré y responderé. Un abrazo grande. 🤗\n\n

>I hope you liked this post, and I would also like you to leave me your comments; I will gladly read them and will respond to them. Big hugs. 🤗 ![1000075868.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpGWXuthekT2vNu4T8cshESQpwWUYzNfL3omAr86aa9gdLhXgoHopmGsBijTWXXNhtD.png) Todo el texto de esta publicación es de mi autoría - All the text in this publication is my own. **ADIÓS AGOSTO, GRACIAS**

El mes de Agosto me dejó con una Cicatriz en la rodilla producto de una caida, con el diagnóstico de una gastritis en fin un mes que se cierra con muchas vivencias e incertidumbres, en cuanto a los entrenamientos se sumaron distintos, training bike, series de velocidad y trabajo de fuerza en escaleras. 

**EL ENTRENAMIENTO DE HOY**

Ya lista para salir de casa y solo se escuchaba la lluvia caer, desistí de salir sin embargo al transcurrir 20 minutos cesó la lluvia, tome una chaqueta y sali al asfalto, ya habia cambiado el itinerario ya que no llegaria al entrenamiento grupal que ibamos a hacer en la ruta de una carrera. 

La reprogramacion me llevo a correr sola, el asfalto brillaba con la poca  lluvia que habia caido, y la humedad se hacia presente, afortunadamente el sol aun estaba tapado con las nubes. 

El primer kilómetro sirvió de calentamiento después trate de mantenerme en un ritmo comodo que pudiera mantener por los 15 Kilometros,registrando  un promedio de 6:24 minutos por kilómetros. 

Durante mi recorrido en el kilometro 8, empalme con la carrera y allí ya no estaba sola habia mucha gente a mi alrededor cosa que me gusta porque uno se contagia de la adrenalina de los demas corredores. 


A diferencia del primer kilómetro el ultiml kilometro trate de apretar el ritmo para practicar un sprint en carrera y tenia las ganas enormes de culminar.

body.title: 欢欢捡回一只受伤的猫猫
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmat4YAgdnDDkFgNYbqBdyXLucQVmWS12V24Bto5hyyuMp/1788132773625.jpg)

晚上欢欢又跑出去玩，又去河田打蓝球了，躺上沙发上，我差点睡着了，结果他说：“妈妈，我发现在一只流浪猫，我可以带回去养吗”，朦胧的睡意中，我说可以，然后他又说第一天同学帮忙奍，第二天带到我们家。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcHjkWnDPK9AdZf2jD3kF4jtFWbYhnZMT4MAbEB4mCdJW/1788132792051.jpg)

我还以娃开玩笑，哪知第二天，真的接回来一只猫，我的神，这个猫的脚还受伤了，走路一拐一拐的，可能是哪里不小心弄伤，他和同学都说是流浪猫，打完球，他们踩mobike回来，既然把猫猫带回家。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQQAC1SXMoxb41BseYB4S3Sm1tnHDWCczzsLS37cVdbr/1788132792081.jpg)

刚开始我以为是开玩笑的，随口应了下，昨天晚上他接回来了，哇，真的是一只漂亮的猫，只是脚受伤了，我们马上从网上买了猫砂，还有猫食，我的神一下用了我五十，刚开始，我真的想让欢欢奍 。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQKvjf5G6ApULTWWPHYrPBXKaMNXvnjcFQm9Zf1TWU7M/1788132813505.jpg)

第一天猫猫来很老实，坐在一动不动，到了第二早上，我的神，垃圾倒了，还睡在沙发上，还用脚去抓沙发，有几个地方弄坏了，这下我可不高兴了，还好拉尿，没有乱去地方，放了猫砂的地方，好在那里拉，我一大早当铲屎官，真的好难闻。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmavQ3mHkS5Z9oXfgfkg3wZYZ7ZYZgHZSkDbVjjruwDWmw/1788132694949.jpg)

后来我我跟欢欢说，这猫肯定是别人家奍的，等他的伤口好了点，你记得把送回去，要不然他的家人很急的。 你看他边上厕所都知道去哪，肯定是有主人的，欢欢说，他在球场一直跟着我们，我们走到哪，她就走到哪，我说猫猫亲人，肯定是看到你们了，你们又那么好，所以跟着你们了。 

好点还是送到那地方去，她会找到家的，欢欢答应了，猫猫很可爱，但是不会奍猫的我，这几天在家要受苦了，今天手的风湿又开始了，弄玩猫猫又去医院，这人，在世真的不容易。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWWw5gWmjaJNxPCNYjkmwkGjAFsS7H5e28L296EYGScXp/1788132813535.jpg)

body.title: Free E.M.T Skin On Blood Strike (Battle Royale Highlights)🔫
body.body:
by @samye2 on Simpson Plays 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/simpsonplays1 [![Free E.M.T Skin On Blood Strike (Battle Royale Highlights)🔫](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/6a5e75fd-2957-4233-a6f6-5a6d30697ec6.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/g39xBkbXQjo86MZHvUvhwK) 
 
 *****
https://youtu.be/nsIZVhGCqpQ?si=mkzPIWUV5JnVgssC
*****
Another day, another opportunity to share one of my gaming experiences with you all. Today, I decided to flex my new free E.M.T character skin, which was given to every player who logs into the game. Yes, you read that correctly free.😏 This is one of those rewards you definitely don't want to miss, especially because the skin looks absolutely beautiful and gives E.M.T a fresh and premium appearance. If you haven't logged into the game yet, you still have some time to jump in and claim this amazing skin. 😉
I've been an E.M.T fan for a very long time, mainly because of how unique and useful its abilities are. E.M.T isn't just a character that looks good, but its abilities can make a huge difference when you're caught in a difficult fight.
The primary ability of E.M.T is the Force Field, which allows you to deploy a protective barrier around yourself. One of the things I love about this ability is that the force field provides protection from almost every direction. An enemy can't simply shoot through the barrier from the sides or directly in front of you. However, there is one major weakness you need to keep in mind the force field can be attacked from above. So, if you're fighting someone and they manage to get a higher position than you, I'm afraid the E.M.T force field won't be able to save you. 😂 This means you still have to pay attention to your surroundings and, most importantly, watch out for enemies who might try to take the high ground.
Then we have the secondary ability which is Medic. 🩹
This is probably my favorite part of E.M.T because the Medic ability can completely change the outcome of a fight. E.M.T can deploy a medic that helps you regenerate your health while you're engaged in combat.
Imagine getting shot by an enemy, taking damage, but at the same time having your health constantly regenerating. You're basically giving yourself more time to survive and fight back. As long as you don't get knocked, that extra regeneration can give you a massive advantage during a gunfight. And if you watch the gameplay in this post carefully, you'll actually see a moment where the Medic ability helped me win a fight, even though I was a little late returning fire. That was one of those moments where I could clearly see why I enjoy using E.M.T so much. Instead of immediately losing the fight after taking those shots, the regeneration gave me enough time to recover and continue fighting.
The Medic ability also reminds me a lot of Call of Duty Mobile, because the Medic class has always been one of my favorite classes/skills in CODM. So when I discovered that Blood Strike had an ability that allowed me to use a similar playstyle, I immediately became even more interested in E.M.T.
I love being able to carry some of my Call of Duty Mobile playstyle into Blood Strike. Personally, whenever I spot an enemy and know that a fight is about to happen, one of the first things I like to do is deploy my Medic before fully committing to the gunfight.
That way, if the enemy starts shooting first and I take some damage, I can still regenerate while returning fire. It gives me more time to make mistakes, reposition, aim properly, and hopefully win the fight. It may sound like a small strategy, but in a close range battle where both players are dealing damage, that extra regeneration can make a huge difference. And honestly, that's one of the reasons I enjoy E.M.T so much. It's not just about having an ability that looks cool the abilities actually complement the way I like to play. Now, let's talk about the skin itself. 👀🔥
I believe this free E.M.T skin may only be available for this season, which means it could disappear once the season comes to an end. So, once again, if you haven't claimed yours yet, make sure you log into Blood Strike and check the Gift Center to see if the reward is still available.
Don't wait until the last minute and then realize you've missed it. 😂
Another interesting part of creating this gameplay was actually getting the footage.
The first video I tried to record was honestly a complete mess. 😭 My phone was struggling badly while I was screen recording the entire match. I kept experiencing frame drops throughout the game, and that made it almost impossible to get smooth and enjoyable gameplay.
I really wanted to create a good video for you all, but the constant frame drops were making the footage look terrible. Instead of giving up completely, I remembered one of Blood Strike's really useful features ranked matches are stored for a limited period of time, giving you the opportunity to go back and watch your previous games.
That feature ended up saving me
Instead of trying to record the entire match while playing and putting unnecessary pressure on my phone, I was able to go back to the recorded match, watch the gameplay again, and record the important moments without dealing with the same frame drop problem.
Honestly, features like this are extremely useful for content creators, especially those of us who don't have extremely powerful devices that can comfortably play the game while recording at the same time.
So, after all the struggles with the first recording, I finally managed to put this gameplay together and show you guys why I enjoy using E.M.T so much. ❤️‍🔥
From the Force Field providing protection, to the Medic helping me regenerate during fights, E.M.T has remained one of my favorite characters in Blood Strike. And now that I have this beautiful free skin to go along with it, you already know I'm going to be using E.M.T even more. 😂🔥
Thank you so much for stopping by and checking out my post. I really appreciate everyone who takes the time to watch my gameplay, read my experiences, and interact with my posts. Don't forget to drop your thoughts in the comments before you leave! Let me know if you've already claimed the free E.M.T skin, whether E.M.T is one of your favorite characters, and which ability you prefer Force Field or Medic? 👀 Goodnight everyone, and I'll see you in the next gaming experience! 🎮🔥❤️

body.title: La importancia de actualizar las estrategias / The Importance of Updating Strategies
body.body:
El vecino de una de mis tías, un señor que apenas sacó la primaria, tenía un negocio simple, pero que le generaba altos dividendos: comprar objetos de uso cotidiano para revender en mercados foráneos.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXnQSkdMrdsxshrg99FCfYvKyaipWrvCAibEwcjjHVu3x/ritae_junk_1680921_1280.jpg</center>

[RitaE - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/basura-antiguo-viejo-1680921/)

César (nombre ficticio para proteger la identidad real) un día agarró su camioneta vieja, y se dispuso a llevar artículos de aseo e higiene, además de lentes de aumento genéricos para las poblaciones alejadas de la ciudad. Viviendo en la zona urbana del llano, encontrar caseríos en los que algunos servicios llegan poco o no llegan, no resultaba complicado.

Para su sorpresa, lo recibieron como quien ve a Dios llegar, y en menos de dos horas no solo había vendido todo, sino que volvió con encargos para el siguiente fin de semana.

Era la época de escasez de repuestos en Venezuela, y siendo su oficio el de mecánico, resultaba complicado llevar el sustento a casa, por lo que siguiendo el consejo de uno de sus clientes habituales en el taller, agarró parte de sus ahorros e hizo esa primera inversión con resultados satisfactorios.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmZSgiH75iVYN47jMPQAJzkL6zQC554Ppz6CLtxsbjLNr5/deranho_fruit_vendor_7042999_1280.jpg</center>

[Deranho - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/vendedor-de-frutas-vendedor-ambulante-7042999/)

Pasados los meses, empezó a agregar mobiliario (escaparates, camas, cunas, mesas) además de ropa casual. Era como un centro comercial sobre ruedas, además de poder involucrar a su hijo, quien tenía también una camioneta.

Implementó la modalidad del pago semanal para aquellos objetos de mayor valor, y solo con algunos clientes asiduos. Al cabo de unos años, luego de un altercado con la guardia nacional, quienes le decomisaron su mercancía, decidió abandonar el negocio y volver a la mecánica.

# ¿Dónde estuvo el error acá?

César, conociendo ya la realidad de esas carreteras aisladas, pudo haber previsto que observaban sus rutinas, fueran agentes policiales, o rateros de los que suelen ver oportunidades para delinquir. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmaEAX9iLszKP9sYvVEq6zQ6t2X6oFPG2xLFNBgb8gbC9h/sammy_sander_man_4191143_1280.jpg</center>

[ Sammy-Sander - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-viejo-anciano-retrato-4191143/)

Así que podía haber invertido en un camión cerrado, para que nadie pudiera ver su mercancía, o alquilar un espacio para hacerse de un local que pudiera abastecer durante la semana y solo abrir los fines de semana.

Quizás quedarse solo con la venta de mercancía pequeña, que no fuera vistosa para otros, o hacer esas entregas una vez por mes y fuera de horarios de oficina, en los cuales pudiera encontrarse con funcionarios que pusieran trabas (aunque obviamente esto no debería suceder)

Sin embargo, la lección aún no había sido aprendida para él, quien siguió haciendo las entregas con la camioneta del hijo, cayendo en la desgracia de haber sido robados en la vía, perdiendo tanto la mercancía como el vehículo, cerrando el ciclo de ventas al detal en los pueblos del interior.

La enseñanza llegó tarde para César, quien aprendió de mala manera que ante las mismas acciones, obtiene mismos resultados. En su caso, primero con guardias corruptos, luego con delincuentes, que terminaron con su emprendimiento, teniendo que volver a trabajar de empleado como mecánico automotriz en un taller, luego de haber logrado ser su propio jefe.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQU8tzfuhBgLVpPoqSvwci2KtMoVmHNbUzPnrj28jtpN9/image.png</center>

One of my aunts’ neighbors, a man who had barely finished elementary school, ran a simple business that generated high profits: buying everyday items to resell in foreign markets.

César (a fictitious name to protect his real identity) one day hopped into his old pickup truck and set out to deliver toiletries and hygiene products, as well as generic reading glasses, to communities far from the city. Living in the urban plains region, it wasn’t hard to find villages where certain services were scarce or nonexistent.

To his surprise, they welcomed him as if he were a godsend, and in less than two hours, not only had he sold everything, but he also returned with orders for the following weekend.

It was a time of spare-parts shortages in Venezuela, and since he worked as a mechanic, it was difficult to bring home a living wage. So, following the advice of one of his regular customers at the repair shop, he took some of his savings and made that first investment, which yielded satisfactory results.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmZSgiH75iVYN47jMPQAJzkL6zQC554Ppz6CLtxsbjLNr5/deranho_fruit_vendor_7042999_1280.jpg</center>

[Deranho - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/vendedor-de-frutas-vendedor-ambulante-7042999/)

As the months went by, he began adding furniture (display cases, beds, cribs, tables) as well as casual clothing. It was like a shopping center on wheels, and he was also able to involve his son, who had a pickup truck of his own.

He implemented a weekly payment plan for higher-value items, but only for a few regular customers. A few years later, after a run-in with the National Guard—who confiscated his merchandise—he decided to quit the business and go back to auto repair.

# Where did he go wrong here?

César, already familiar with the reality of those isolated highways, could have anticipated that his routines were being watched—whether by police officers or thieves who often see opportunities to commit crimes. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmaEAX9iLszKP9sYvVEq6zQ6t2X6oFPG2xLFNBgb8gbC9h/sammy_sander_man_4191143_1280.jpg</center>

[ Sammy-Sander - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-viejo-anciano-retrato-4191143/)

So he could have invested in a closed-body truck so that no one could see his merchandise, or rented a space to set up a store that he could stock during the week and open only on weekends.

Perhaps he should have limited himself to selling small items that wouldn’t attract attention, or made those deliveries once a month and outside of business hours, when he might run into officials who would put up obstacles (although obviously this shouldn’t happen)

However, the lesson still hadn’t sunk in for him, and he continued making deliveries in his son’s pickup truck, only to suffer the misfortune of being robbed on the road—losing both the merchandise and the vehicle—which brought his retail sales in the inland towns to an end.

The lesson came too late for César, who learned the hard way that the same actions lead to the same results. In his case, it started with corrupt guards, then moved on to criminals, who ultimately put an end to his business, forcing him to go back to working as an employee—an auto mechanic at a repair shop—after he had finally managed to become his own boss.

body.title: [ESP-ENG] Delicioso caldo de huesos de res con maíz tierno 🥣🌽/Delicious beef bone broth with sweet corn 🥣🌽
body.body:
> Buenas noches amigos de Hive, en la comunidad de gems, un gusto de saludarles y compartir con todos ustedes , para hoy les quiero mostrar como hice este delicioso caldo de fin de semana con huesos de res y maíz tierno, ideal para compartir en casa. > Good evening, Hive friends, in the gems community! It's a pleasure to greet you all and share with you today how I made this delicious weekend broth with beef bones and sweet corn, perfect for sharing at home. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVPkVaxvPqdRaLW2pd8Ky77Nu2HAAVnb5UYjFNTQPc8s/1788131652962.jpg) # Delicioso caldo de huesos de res con maíz tierno # Ingredientes 1 kg de huesos rojos de huesos de res 1 maíz tierno 1 cebolla 1 rama de cilantro 1 rama de cebollín 8 dientes de ajo 300 gr de auyama 300 gr de o uno chino 300 gr de yuca 150 gr de batata 1 cucharadita de orégano seco Sal y color a gusto > # Delicious Beef Bone Broth with Sweet Corn # Ingredients 1 kg beef bones 1 ear of sweet corn 1 onion 1 sprig of cilantro 1 sprig of scallion 8 cloves of garlic 300 g pumpkin 300 g squash 300 g yucca 150 g sweet potato 1 teaspoon dried oregano Salt and annatto to taste #
Paso a paso
#
Paso 1
Cómo primer paso vamos a lavar muy bien los huesos, colocamos en una olla con orégano, cebolla, sal, agua y cocinar a fuego medio. > #
Step by step
#
Step 1
As a first step, we will wash the bones very well, place them in a pot with oregano, onion, salt, water, and cook over medium heat. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXJFUy2VWAxDoKGM568vfC2PDpj3dY4QY1UPz43ZjdkS/1788131544628.jpg) #
Paso 2
Luego vamos a lavar, pelar y cortar la verdura, auyama, yuca, chino, batata y también el maíz, reservar. > #
Step 2
Next, we will wash, peel, and chop the vegetables: pumpkin, yucca, squash, sweet potato, and corn. Set aside. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSTJMoAUkfTsgQw5s6JbfHWbH1xCW4B9Z5F1G92knJqJL/1788131307463.jpg) > #
Paso 3
Una vez la carne que tiene los huesos esté blanda, agregamos la verdura, junto con el cebollín, ajo y cilantro, agregar agua suficiente que cubra la verdura. > #
Step 3
Once the meat on the bones is tender, add the vegetables, along with the scallions, garlic, and cilantro. Add enough water to cover the vegetables. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQTAiTQs1uG1hxkbK26rRH24T5ebatLx4thoFoXSBbMyT/1788131362485.jpg) > #
Paso 4
Por último corregimos de sal, agregamos el color, una vez la verdura blanda, apagamos y retiramos del fuego, dejar reposar y listo para servir y degustar. > #
Step 4
Finally, adjust the salt, add the coloring, and once the vegetables are tender, turn off the heat and remove from the stove. Let it rest, and it's ready to serve and enjoy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVW3NFra5BfYY6fY9phHmoC1fCHqyzb3qScwf1MPLFbnB/1788131259975.jpg) # Delicioso almuerzo! > # Delicious lunch! ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTfA8FJsM15evWbRWAoLG1NBsnEt1GqtWtdBMfDwg8d6G/1788131164504.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyRiFwPmrewMUkqDw1rbjyrJmX8rKPt88kTEYdtnJxgS/1788131165141.jpg) Hasta aquí mi publicacion de este día, espero les haya gustado, muchas gracias a todos por el apoyo brindado. Saludos > That's it for my publication today, I hope you liked it, thank you all very much for the support provided.
