body.title: Free E.M.T Skin On Blood Strike (Battle Royale Highlights)🔫
body.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=samye2/co339pdd


![file_0000000090bc81f9941fcbf71eb3ee3d.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ7BZe1zna7dALWGEcopVk6RqXR8w4xE1fAZN9e2zsaX7/file_0000000090bc81f9941fcbf71eb3ee3d.png)
*****
https://youtu.be/nsIZVhGCqpQ?si=mkzPIWUV5JnVgssC
*****
Another day, another opportunity to share one of my gaming experiences with you all. Today, I decided to flex my new free E.M.T character skin, which was given to every player who logs into the game. Yes, you read that correctly free.😏 This is one of those rewards you definitely don't want to miss, especially because the skin looks absolutely beautiful and gives E.M.T a fresh and premium appearance. If you haven't logged into the game yet, you still have some time to jump in and claim this amazing skin. 😉
I've been an E.M.T fan for a very long time, mainly because of how unique and useful its abilities are. E.M.T isn't just a character that looks good, but its abilities can make a huge difference when you're caught in a difficult fight.
The primary ability of E.M.T is the Force Field, which allows you to deploy a protective barrier around yourself. One of the things I love about this ability is that the force field provides protection from almost every direction. An enemy can't simply shoot through the barrier from the sides or directly in front of you. However, there is one major weakness you need to keep in mind the force field can be attacked from above. So, if you're fighting someone and they manage to get a higher position than you, I'm afraid the E.M.T force field won't be able to save you. 😂 This means you still have to pay attention to your surroundings and, most importantly, watch out for enemies who might try to take the high ground.
Then we have the secondary ability which is Medic. 🩹
This is probably my favorite part of E.M.T because the Medic ability can completely change the outcome of a fight. E.M.T can deploy a medic that helps you regenerate your health while you're engaged in combat.
Imagine getting shot by an enemy, taking damage, but at the same time having your health constantly regenerating. You're basically giving yourself more time to survive and fight back. As long as you don't get knocked, that extra regeneration can give you a massive advantage during a gunfight. And if you watch the gameplay in this post carefully, you'll actually see a moment where the Medic ability helped me win a fight, even though I was a little late returning fire. That was one of those moments where I could clearly see why I enjoy using E.M.T so much. Instead of immediately losing the fight after taking those shots, the regeneration gave me enough time to recover and continue fighting.
The Medic ability also reminds me a lot of Call of Duty Mobile, because the Medic class has always been one of my favorite classes/skills in CODM. So when I discovered that Blood Strike had an ability that allowed me to use a similar playstyle, I immediately became even more interested in E.M.T.
I love being able to carry some of my Call of Duty Mobile playstyle into Blood Strike. Personally, whenever I spot an enemy and know that a fight is about to happen, one of the first things I like to do is deploy my Medic before fully committing to the gunfight.
That way, if the enemy starts shooting first and I take some damage, I can still regenerate while returning fire. It gives me more time to make mistakes, reposition, aim properly, and hopefully win the fight. It may sound like a small strategy, but in a close range battle where both players are dealing damage, that extra regeneration can make a huge difference. And honestly, that's one of the reasons I enjoy E.M.T so much. It's not just about having an ability that looks cool the abilities actually complement the way I like to play. Now, let's talk about the skin itself. 👀🔥
I believe this free E.M.T skin may only be available for this season, which means it could disappear once the season comes to an end. So, once again, if you haven't claimed yours yet, make sure you log into Blood Strike and check the Gift Center to see if the reward is still available.
Don't wait until the last minute and then realize you've missed it. 😂
Another interesting part of creating this gameplay was actually getting the footage.
The first video I tried to record was honestly a complete mess. 😭 My phone was struggling badly while I was screen recording the entire match. I kept experiencing frame drops throughout the game, and that made it almost impossible to get smooth and enjoyable gameplay.
I really wanted to create a good video for you all, but the constant frame drops were making the footage look terrible. Instead of giving up completely, I remembered one of Blood Strike's really useful features ranked matches are stored for a limited period of time, giving you the opportunity to go back and watch your previous games.
That feature ended up saving me
Instead of trying to record the entire match while playing and putting unnecessary pressure on my phone, I was able to go back to the recorded match, watch the gameplay again, and record the important moments without dealing with the same frame drop problem.
Honestly, features like this are extremely useful for content creators, especially those of us who don't have extremely powerful devices that can comfortably play the game while recording at the same time.
So, after all the struggles with the first recording, I finally managed to put this gameplay together and show you guys why I enjoy using E.M.T so much. ❤️‍🔥
From the Force Field providing protection, to the Medic helping me regenerate during fights, E.M.T has remained one of my favorite characters in Blood Strike. And now that I have this beautiful free skin to go along with it, you already know I'm going to be using E.M.T even more. 😂🔥
Thank you so much for stopping by and checking out my post. I really appreciate everyone who takes the time to watch my gameplay, read my experiences, and interact with my posts. Don't forget to drop your thoughts in the comments before you leave! Let me know if you've already claimed the free E.M.T skin, whether E.M.T is one of your favorite characters, and which ability you prefer Force Field or Medic? 👀 Goodnight everyone, and I'll see you in the next gaming experience! 🎮🔥❤️
*****
My gameplay
*****

Feliz domingo!

Apareciendo por aquí y resumiendo un poco lo que fue mi fondo del domingo pasado y el del día de hoy.

El domingo pasado me tocó hacer mis primeros 17K suaves luego de todo este proceso de ir retomando. Salieron y se sintieron muy bien, terminé muy feliz y agradecida por ir retomando estás distancias luego de mi lesión. Al final se me pasó publicar por acá, luego tuve par de días libres en los que solo me quise desconectar, además de que estaba en mood cumpleañero porque cayó el martes y con ese par de días libre que me tomé, cayó perfecto. 

Para hoy me tocaba nuevamente 15K a ritmo, para lo cual debia moverme entre 6:20 a maximo 7:20 min/km. Esta vez quise salir un poco más conservada y buscar mejorar el ritmo luego del km 8, sin embargo, hoy me costó bastante, la humedad y el sol me liquidaron, sobre todo en los últimos 5K. Al final hasta me paré un momento en el km 12.5 porque sentía que necesitaba tomar aire, y luego todo se resumió en darle mucho más suave pero llegar y completar la distancia, al final el entrenamiento salió y todos los parciales dieron dentro del rango, pero cómo me costó.

Aquí sigo entendiendo y reconfigurando todo, vamos a ver que tal me va en esos próximos 15K a ritmo que tendre dentro de 2 semanas. 

Ya por aquí tenemos par de objetivos que iré trabajando, pero que mas allá de buscar un tiempo, mi objetivo es ver cómo me voy sintiendo y cómo responde mi cuerpo, y este par de carreras en las cuales ya estoy inscrita son:

- 10K Caracas Rock 🎸 
- 21K 4 Elementos 🔥

Mi objetivo inicial era hacer la media de Plazas por primera vez, pero en vista de que la suspendieron y 4 Elementos la movieron para esa misma fecha, terminé decidiendo inscribirme en esta. 

El foco esta principalmente en esta media maratón. 

Ya veremos que tal sale!!✨

title.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Conclave Arcana Rewards - End of the Weekly Fortune Draw
title.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP44qYj4LrHdXo2EMg2XzaUGfVY1BidpLgwg65LTPDbLZ/Portada%20-%20End%20of%20the%20weekly%20fortune%20draw.png</center>

<center>Sharp-eyed players will have already noticed an important upcoming date that could heavily impact **Splinterlands** a crucial transition within its rewards structure. With the official countdown active, the community is closely watching the final stretch of the **Weekly Fortune Draw** corresponding to the **Conclave Arcana** reward set. Currently, only **8** weekly draws remain roughly two calendar months before this cycle definitively comes to an end. Furthermore, data from the **Ranked Draw Prizes** panel shows that **3,510** out of the **4,132** total available cards in the main pool have already been claimed, leaving a minimal remaining amount in circulation. This situation not only marks the end of an era for **Conclave Arcana** distribution, but also opens up several strategic questions about the game's economy, the future utility of accumulated **Entries**, and the fate of the **Jackpot** on the platform.</center>

><center>Para los jugadores más perspicaces, ya habrán notado cómo se acerca una fecha importante que puede afectar mucho a **Splinterlands**: una transición crucial dentro de su estructura de recompensas. Con la cuenta regresiva oficial activada, la comunidad observa con atención la recta final de los **Weekly Fortune Draw** correspondientes al conjunto de tarjetas de recompensa de **Conclave Arcana**. Actualmente, solo restan **8** sorteos semanales, lo que equivale a aproximadamente dos meses de calendario para que este ciclo concluya definitivamente. Sumado a esto, los datos del panel de **Ranked Draw Prizes** reflejan que ya se han reclamado **3.510** de las **4.132** tarjetas totales disponibles en el pozo principal, dejando un remanente mínimo en circulación. Esta situación no solo marca el fin de una etapa para la distribución de **Conclave Arcana**, sino que abre un abanico de interrogantes estratégicas sobre la economía del juego, la utilidad futura de las **Entries** acumuladas y el destino del **Jackpot** en la plataforma.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWo17sQQMiZzjqRNVpxokfuEApcTggp3U8Cs5UM4e7cya/WEEKLY%20FORTUNE%20DRAW%20V2.png</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXqL9dikWXsXPin3kpiaV5rYw3qutV7A8yeo6Ytse5EbH/RANKED%20DRAW%20PRIZES%20V2.png</center>

## <center>The Imminent Impact | El Impacto Inminente</center>

<center>The presence of **Conclave Arcana** reward cards has been a fundamental pillar in sustaining motivation within ranked battles. For months, players have carefully managed their energy consumption, **Loot Chests** openings, and **Glints** spending to accumulate as many tickets as possible for each draw. Knowing that only **8** **Weekly Fortune Draws** remain, several expected effects can be anticipated:</center>

><center>La presencia de las tarjetas de recompensa de **Conclave Arcana** ha sido un pilar fundamental para sostener la motivación dentro de las batallas clasificatorias. Durante meses, los jugadores han planificado su consumo de energía, su apertura de **Loot Chests** y gasto de **Glints** para acumular la mayor cantidad de boletos posible en cada sorteo. Sabiendo que solo restan **8** **Weekly Fortune Draws**, se pueden ver unos efectos esperados:</center>

- **Increased Competitiveness:** Over the next eight weeks, the rush to secure the last available copies of the rarest **Conclave Arcana** cards could intensify battle volume and participation demand across active formats like **Modern** and **Wild**.

- **Depletion of the Ranked Prizes Pool:** With over **85%** of the cards already distributed (**3,510** / **4,132**), the probability of pulling high-tier special **Foil** units decreases rapidly as the remaining pool dries up completely.

>- **Aumento de la Competitividad:** En las próximas ocho semanas, la prisa por asegurar las últimas copias disponibles de las cartas más escasas de **Conclave Arcana** puede intensificar el volumen de partidas y la demanda de participación en los formatos activos (**Modern** y **Wild**).

>- **Agotamiento del Pozo de Ranked Prizes:** Con más del **85%** de las tarjetas ya distribuidas (**3.510** / **4.132**), la probabilidad de obtener unidades **Foil** especiales de alto nivel se reduce rápidamente a medida que el pozo disponible se agota por completo.


## <center>Key Unknowns | Las Grandes Incógnitas</center>

<center>The imminent conclusion of the **Conclave Arcana** cycle generates speculation within **Splinterlands** regarding the roadmap the development team will follow. In the absence of an official announcement about a new main reward set, three key scenarios emerge to address community questions:</center>

><center>El inminente cierre del ciclo de **Conclave Arcana** genera una serie de especulaciones dentro de **Splinterlands** sobre la hoja de ruta que tomará el equipo de desarrollo. Ante la ausencia de un anuncio oficial sobre un nuevo conjunto principal de cartas, se perfilan tres escenarios clave para responder a las dudas de la comunidad:</center>

### <center>What Will Happen to Accumulated Entries? | ¿Qué pasará con las Entries acumuladas?</center>

<center>One of the biggest concerns for players who have saved or accumulated **Entries** (draw tickets) through daily gameplay or purchases in the **Glints** Shop is their future validity. If the **Conclave Arcana** cycle ends without a direct replacement in the **Fortune Draw**, the utility of these **Entries** must be redefined. Logical options include automatic conversion of leftover **Entries** into **Glints**, carrying tickets over to the next draw format, or enabling them for limited-time events.</center>

><center>Una de las mayores preocupaciones de los jugadores que han guardado o acumulado **Entries** (boletos de entrada) a través del juego diario o mediante compras en la tienda de **Glints** es su validez a futuro. Si el ciclo de **Conclave Arcana** termina sin un reemplazo directo en el **Fortune Draw**, la utilidad de estas **Entries** debe ser redefinida. Las opciones lógicas incluyen la conversión automática de **Entries** sobrantes a **Glints**, la conservación de los boletos para el siguiente formato de sorteos, o su habilitación para eventos de tiempo limitado.</center>

### <center>Restructuring the Jackpot and Reward Shop | La Reestructuración del Jackpot y la Tienda de Recompensas</center>

<center>The value of the **Jackpot** has been the main draw of the weekly raffles. As the **4,132** reward cards of the current set run out, the system will be forced to make a decision regarding the top prize. Will the **Jackpot** be replaced with a bridge set of exclusive cards, previous expansion packs, or special items? Or will the **Jackpot** temporarily pause until the arrival of the next reward set?</center>

><center>El valor del **Jackpot** ha sido el gran atractivo de los sorteos semanales. Al agotarse las **4.132** tarjetas de recompensa del conjunto actual, el sistema se verá obligado a tomar una decisión sobre el premio mayor. ¿Se sustituirá el **Jackpot** por un conjunto puente de cartas exclusivas, paquetes de expansiones previas o ítems especiales? ¿O el **Jackpot** pausará temporalmente su actividad hasta la llegada del próximo set de recompensas?</center>

## <center>The Continuity of Reward Chests | La Continuidad de los Cofres de Recompensas</center>

<center>The hypothesis that **Entries** will be completely removed from daily or end-of-season chests until a new main set arrives is unlikely, as it would leave a massive void in player motivation. However, launching an entirely new reward set requires months of development, balancing, and art creation. Therefore, it is plausible that the team may implement a transition period featuring rotations of existing items, **Glints** bonuses, or the introduction of special prototype cards for the next edition prior to a formal release.</center>

><center>La hipótesis de que las **Entries** se eliminen por completo de los cofres diarios o de final de temporada hasta que llegue un nuevo conjunto principal es poco probable, ya que dejaría un vacío enorme en la motivación de los jugadores. Sin embargo, lanzar un conjunto de recompensas completamente nuevo requiere meses de desarrollo, equilibrado y arte. Por lo tanto, es plausible que el equipo implemente un periodo de transición con rotación de artículos existentes, bonificaciones de **Glints** o la introducción de tarjetas especiales como prototipos de la siguiente edición antes de un lanzamiento formal.</center>

## <center>Conclusion</center>

<center>The final **8** **Weekly Fortune Draws** of **Conclave Arcana** represent a major turning point for **Splinterlands**. Although the **Splinterlands** development team maintains active communication, as a Web3 game, shifts in progression roadmaps are always possible. While the community awaits official announcements regarding the future of **Entries**, the **Jackpot** restructuring, and the next step in seasonal rewards, the smartest strategy is to maximize returns over these final two months and stay tuned to platform updates.</center>

><center>Los últimos **8** **Weekly Fortune Draws** de **Conclave Arcana** representan un momento de inflexión para **Splinterlands**. Aunque el equipo de desarrollo de **Splinterlands** siempre se mantiene comunicado, al ser un juego Web 3.0 es muy probable que haya cambios en los mapas de progresión. Mientras la comunidad aguarda anuncios oficiales sobre el futuro de las **Entries**, la reestructuración del **Jackpot** y el siguiente paso en las recompensas de temporada, la estrategia más inteligente es maximizar el rendimiento de estos dos meses finales y mantenerse atentos a las actualizaciones de la plataforma.</center>

title.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![EPL EVENT MATCH🥱🥲](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/90928415-d280-4660-822a-dbe279b8cfa7.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/aZvnYZ5pV84ZHDq5uikY78) 
 
 
***

***
MY MATCH SQUAD🌚🥲
***
![IMG_7309.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY2Znchh36asCnoWHekUuGdQ61Bvt9EpcXBMxjY7Ybcai/IMG_7309.png)
***

English football event match and this was easily the most dominant performance I’ve had so far in the Tour Event. I loaded in as Chelsea vs Swansea and from kickoff you could just tell Swansea weren’t ready for what Drogba was about to do to them. First goal came in the 5th minute and it was my 99 rated Drogba who opened it up. I worked it into the box, played a quick pass and Drogba turned his defender and finished it with his left. The game instantly popped up “21 Didier Drogba, Today’s Goals: 1” and then he ran straight to the corner flag to do that celebration holding the flag. The stadium was packed and the crowd was loud. 1-0 up and you could see Swansea’s defense already panicking every time the ball came near Drogba.
After that first goal the whole game changed. I was playing through midfield with Rooney, Bergkamp and Saka and just feeding Drogba every chance I got. Swansea tried to sit deep but it didn’t matter because Drogba was winning every header and holding up the ball like a wall. Around the 10th minute I almost got a second but the keeper made a save. The replay showed how I was breaking them down, passing around their midfield and finding space behind their fullbacks. Swansea barely had the ball and when they did my press forced them into mistakes. You could see in the gameplay that their back line was scared of Drogba’s strength. 1-0 at halftime but it felt like it should have been more because I was creating chances every 2 minutes.
Second half I came out and told myself Drogba needs the match ball today. Goal number 2 came from a quick counter. I won the ball with Rooney in the middle, played a through ball and Drogba just outmuscled their center back and smashed it past the keeper. 2-0. The crowd went wild and I could see Swansea’s heads drop. Then the hattrick came from a corner. Bergkamp whipped it in, Drogba rose above everyone and headed it in. 3-0. The game showed his 99 card again and I was just laughing because he was unplayable. Swansea tried to change formation and bring on subs but nothing worked. My defense with the back line was solid too, didn’t give them a single shot on target the whole game.
The fourth goal was the pick of the bunch. I played a one-two with Bergkamp on the edge of the box, slipped Drogba in behind and he took one touch before curling it into the top corner. Keeper didn’t even move. 4-0. That made it 4 goals for Drogba in one match. At that point I just started playing keep ball because the game was done. Every attack was going through Drogba and he was scoring for fun. Swansea tried to get one back but my midfield wasn’t letting them play. From minute 1 to minute 90 it was complete control. The green and yellow kit looked clean too and Drogba was running the show like it was 2012 all over again.
Ended the match 4-0 and that’s a perfect win in the English football event. All 4 goals scored by Didier Drogba. That’s 3 points and a massive goal difference boost. The video shows the first goal and that celebration but the whole 90 minutes was a Drogba masterclass. From the hold up play to the finishes to the headers, he did everything. Clean sheet as well which helps in the event standings. If I keep playing like this with Drogba leading the line I think I can clear the whole event without dropping points. 4-0 win, 4 goals for Drogba, and I’m buzzing going into the next match 💪

title.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVu73Wb2zZtPXe4aPCmx7L9rinTAcj3g1MrGBDvxeREgv/pit_eagle.png)</center>   
      
<center><sub>Imagen elaborada en Canva / Image created in Canva </sub></center>
    
 ----   
      
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)   
</center>   

<div class=\

> Hello, good morning or afternoon, my dear Praetorian comrades. A post to share my battle against the most powerful fighter of the Pit Challenge, Eagle Libre. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pit Challenge: Eagle Libre

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Since Luz's Favor Roulette came out, I've faced the Pit Challenge fighters a total of four times, counting the one in this post. Being defeated in the first battle against The Big Leronski, for which I was not prepared and did not have the knowledge about the fighters, after that battle I took things easy. My next battles against AI the Mountain and rematch against The Big Leronski resulted in a victory. It's been many days since roulette allowed me to face another fighter, but I can finally share with you my battle against Eagle Libre.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tRzVxdR8bWY7wipKhC6Mo5yKHfNkT63mautX2psDXyJWrfWpyxku7DeuA321qyNxXh8.png)
---- As everyone already knows, the matches against these fighters vary, they present different skills and statistics. Free Eagle had the following stats and skills shown in the picture.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfMGdbn5DpAS31r825WcVDasH1xxFKiLqbDweDaVSScj1/image.png)
|Phase|Shield|Void Armor| |------------|------------|------------| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZSDzgmzSuxgAPZt4xLavCRpgzXSSog5TWwHE35ZHKpSo/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWS6XPVTZxJ2uttMwrBmK9FDrTmaEQHp9A6ybXtbmDd92/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmczjqMVSAVq7ECm96vWicyive3b5dU6XV8MCt6fZU8Vhb/image.png)| | Magic attacks have the same chance of failing as physical attacks. | 50% less damage (rounded up) from physical attacks or 0 damage from physical attacks of 1 power. | Magic damage hits armor before health. | ---- My formation for this battle is as follows: |Name|Image| |------------|------------| |Aurendrak|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKRN2gkhxzrass8frbpnkGTj4sQ4SZBu2UpAcU682ybM/image.png) | |Spellmonger| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUAu8xWazHEbjxfTcNdUFFgJYytdUTqSoLs9Jyb6FYDQk/image.png) | |Gorm the Vengeful| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQxeFJBHbMWPAJX2W8qZTXz3gTc1Rz5YnJYkyCZEjBfy6/image.png) | | Buns the Unseen |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYmEZm8Xtsmok4hGFqQCYZA2QCbC3b1pyiQ4fSrentRem/image.png) | | Vaelok| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWduijNbYz8rERMspiiK1s3LKXHdnvXgnr8bofhhVfXTK/image.png) | |Necrulencian Thief|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRYqbxARxYDsdEAEqs7vXeMC6U6D85N8JUn1GpZUML6dc/image.png) | |Little Sister| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVBqxyWx3VdPd1s15njGxu3XhrX6e2GxMvmbMjp8bC9Ld/image.png) | I thought about using Spellmonger to wear down some Eagle attacks, while taking the attacks from my other units. But the main basis of my strategy was in the last three units: Vaelok and Little Sister with their magic attack would damage him in each round and at the same time gain vitality with each attack; Necrulencian Thief had the objective of poisoning him. Having two units with good vitality or armor in first positions to withstand Eagle attacks. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTyyT6fdHb7BpS6NsC81TKQWFTBrk6bAYDSMt8bhfjjev/image.png)
[Link](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_ol_freed99_2l1W9OPmDN?ref=freed99) ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBTnRB3qUzAwrtvbizx3CjaepSnfvKpwCGGTymChpo1t/pit_eagle_1.gif)
Round 1. Spellmonger fulfilled his first task, to withstand an attack and reduce his armor a little with the thorns. Vaelok slightly reduced his melee attack power. The first attacks of my units would only reduce the armor. Only Necrulencian Thief managed to leave Eagle Free poisoned; this would allow to reduce his vitality little by little in each round. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbwxfvHYDGMzAnwexUwmnnLvBfkRKX7yaQboao1aqYzzx/pit_eagle_2y3.gif)
Round 2 and 3. Spellmonger was defeated at the start of the second round, but that extra damage was enough to destroy Eagle's armor in this round. Gorm the Vengeful, although he lost his armor, was the first to deal direct damage to Eagle in the third round; the attacks of the other units followed. Vaelok and Little Sister started to gain vitality by dealing direct damage in this round. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT7hgSyP5w83Lzjm8m8ois5w2PYrDv4fKAN4oMMWY4h3r/pit_eagle_4y5.gif)
Round 4 and 5. Gorm the Vengeful survived another attack in the fourth round, but the wave of attacks of the third round was repeated, weakening Eagle a little more. The fifth round was the defeat of Gorm the Vengeful, but before his fall he attacked Eagle first. The other units attacked and only Vaelok's attack failed. ----
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8FAcgUt6kGhc6bnfAnkR6VxBo4N7dDLhWAotDxtBk2T/pit_eagle_6y7.gif)
Round 6 and 7. Buns the Unseen took the lead in the first position; having a strong armor, he could withstand several attacks before being defeated. In these two rounds, Buns the Unseen only lost the armor and neither failed their attack against Eagle. So far, Eagle's vitality has already been reduced by fifty points. ----
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKkGSia1qDJyxx23GokGN1QRBWkxZttxn5mLkRMyFQNs/pit_eagle_8y9.gif)
Round 8 and 9. Buns the Unseen dealt another attack and was defeated in the eighth round. Vaelok replaced him in the first position; although another attack failed, he had the ability to fly and a great vitality to withstand some attacks. At the end of the ninth round, Eagle had only fourteen life points left and was still facing three powerful units. ----
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcHnMfAyHLEFQ4BtbvT9ZN7Pf3EmdNjo171MoBq729Th5/pit_eagle_10y11.gif)
Round 10 and 11. The effect of the poison kept reducing Eagle's vitality at the beginning of the round, to then receive the attacks of Little Sister, Necrulencian Thief and Vaelok until his defeat.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeBPmmVcJLFukZ6Hhn5tHubuBvy4qSDuF9U75Aan2j3c/image.png)
--- I had some doubts with the training at the beginning, such as spending a position using Spellmonger; there may have been better options, but I don't regret it. My strategy was right; the poison effect from the first round opened the way to defeat Eagle and two flying magic units that gained vitality with each attack; for me they were an excellent choice for the battle formation. With good support from Gorm the Vengeful and Buns the Unseen, who survived three rounds each, this helped the last units a lot. -----

> Thank you very much to those who read my posts, and thank you very much for your votes and comments. In the following link, you can join the game and get to know this fantastic world: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99 ). I hope to see you soon in a Challenge, telling your battles and experiences. Note: This post is not investment advice; do your own research. --- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)

> Hola, buen día o tarde, mis queridos compañeros pretorianos. Una publicación para compartirles mi batalla contra el peleador más poderoso del Pit Challenge, Eagle Libre. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pit Challenge: Eagle Libre

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Desde que salió Ruleta Luz’s Favor, me he enfrentado a los peleadores del Pit Challenge en total cuatro veces, contando la de esta publicación. Siendo derrotado en la primera batalla contra The Big Leronski, para la cual no estaba preparado y no tenía el conocimiento sobre los peleadores, después de esa batalla me tomé las cosas con calma. Mis siguientes batallas contra AI the Mountain y revancha contra The Big Leronski tuvieron como resultado una victoria. Pasaron muchos días desde que la ruleta me permitió enfrentar a otro peleador, pero por fin puedo compartirles mi batalla contra Eagle Libre.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tRzVxdR8bWY7wipKhC6Mo5yKHfNkT63mautX2psDXyJWrfWpyxku7DeuA321qyNxXh8.png)
---- Como todos ya saben, los enfrentamientos contra estos peleadores varían, presentan diferentes habilidades y estadísticas. Eagle Libre contaba con las siguientes estadísticas y habilidades que se muestran en la imagen.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfMGdbn5DpAS31r825WcVDasH1xxFKiLqbDweDaVSScj1/image.png)

Pero la base principal de mi estrategia estaba en las tres últimas unidades: Vaelok y Little Sister con su ataque mágico lo dañarían en cada round y a la vez ganarían vitalidad con cada ataque; Necrulencian Thief tenía el objetivo de envenenarlo. Round 2 y 3. Spellmonger fue derrotado al inicio del segundo round, pero ese extra de daño fue suficiente para destruir la armadura de Eagle en este round. Gorm the Vengeful, aunque perdió su armadura, fue el primero en causarle un daño directo a Eagle en el tercer round; le siguieron los ataques de las demás unidades. Vaelok y Little Sister empezaron a ganar vitalidad al causar daño directo en este round. ---

Round 4 y 5. Gorm the Vengeful sobrevivió a otro ataque en el cuarto round, pero se repitió la oleada de ataques del tercer round, debilitando un poco más a Eagle. El quinto round fue la derrota de Gorm the Vengeful, pero antes de su caída atacó primero a Eagle. Las demás unidades atacaron y solo falló el ataque de Vaelok. ----
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8FAcgUt6kGhc6bnfAnkR6VxBo4N7dDLhWAotDxtBk2T/pit_eagle_6y7.gif)
Round 6 y 7. Buns the Unseen tomó el liderazgo en la primera posición; contando con una fuerte armadura, podría soportar varios ataques antes de ser derrotado. En estos dos rounds, Buns the Unseen solo perdió la armadura y ninguno falló su ataque contra Eagle. Hasta ahora ya se ha reducido la vitalidad de Eagle en cincuenta puntos. ----
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKkGSia1qDJyxx23GokGN1QRBWkxZttxn5mLkRMyFQNs/pit_eagle_8y9.gif)
Round 8 y 9. Buns the Unseen asestó otro ataque y fue derrotado en el octavo round. Vaelok lo reemplazó en primera posición; aunque falló otro ataque, contaba con la habilidad de volar y una gran vitalidad para soportar algunos ataques. Al terminar el noveno round, a Eagle solo le quedaban catorce puntos de vida y aún se enfrentaba a tres poderosas unidades. ----
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcHnMfAyHLEFQ4BtbvT9ZN7Pf3EmdNjo171MoBq729Th5/pit_eagle_10y11.gif)
Round 10 y 11. El efecto del veneno seguía reduciendo la vitalidad de Eagle al inicio del round, para después recibir los ataques de Little Sister, Necrulencian Thiefy Vaelok hasta su derrota.

--- Tuve algunas dudas con la formación al inicio, como el gastar una posición usando a Spellmonger; puede que existieran mejores opciones, pero no me arrepiento de ello. Mi estrategia fue acertada; el efecto del veneno desde el primer round abrió el camino para derrotar a Eagle y dos unidades mágicas voladoras que ganaban vitalidad con cada ataque; para mí fueron una excelente elección para la formación de batalla. Con un buen soporte de Gorm the Vengeful y Buns the Unseen, quienes sobrevivieron a tres rounds cada uno, esto ayudó mucho a las últimas unidades. -----

title.title: Bitcoin Near 9K: The Institutional Bid Is Back, But Altcoins Are Not All Invited
title.body:
![header](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmY6KwataG8sK7Eb4oruAonaaCuTDiDW3SktaWbwKAZsQq)

# Bitcoin Near $79K: The Institutional Bid Is Back, But Altcoins Are Not All Invited

Bitcoin is ending the weekend with a familiar market message: when institutional demand reappears, the rest of crypto has to reorganize around it. BTC traded at **$78,447**, up **0.28%** over 24 hours, with market cap near **$1.58 trillion** and daily volume around **$16.9 billion**. That is not an explosive candle, but the headline matters more than the percentage move: Michael Saylor is again hinting at fresh Bitcoin buying after a two-month pause, just as BTC sits within striking distance of **$79,000**.

That combination — high price, renewed treasury-buyer signaling, and a sentiment gauge sitting in **Greed at 69/100** — defines today’s crypto market. This is not a broad risk-on stampede. It is a selective, Bitcoin-led market where capital is rewarding liquidity, institutional narratives, and balance-sheet confidence first.

## BTC Sets the Tone While ETH Grinds Higher

Bitcoin dominance is now **59.59%**, according to CoinGecko’s global market snapshot. That is the number to watch. Total crypto market cap stands near **$2.63 trillion**, with 24-hour volume around **$52.0 billion**, but the market’s center of gravity remains unmistakably BTC.

Saylor-related headlines still have unusual power because they represent more than one buyer. They reinforce a playbook: public companies can treat Bitcoin as a treasury asset, raise or allocate capital around that thesis, and normalize holding BTC through volatility. Whether or not a new purchase is confirmed immediately, the signal itself arrives at an important moment. Bitcoin is not struggling to recover from a crash; it is consolidating near highs with institutions still willing to be associated with accumulation.

Ethereum is participating, but not leading. ETH traded at **$2,470.57**, up **0.73%** over 24 hours, with market cap around **$298.2 billion** and volume near **$9.13 billion**. ETH dominance is **11.28%**, which shows that Ethereum remains essential infrastructure but has not yet taken narrative control from Bitcoin. The market appears comfortable bidding ETH as a core asset, but the day’s story is not DeFi euphoria or a new smart-contract cycle. It is institutional Bitcoin gravity.

## Altcoins Show the Market’s Selectivity

The altcoin board is more cautious. Solana fell **1.62%** to **$103.81**, Dogecoin dropped **1.70%** to **$0.08**, Cardano slipped **1.37%** to **$0.20**, and XRP eased **0.51%** to **$1.39**. BNB was nearly flat at **$693.83**, up **0.11%**.

That mixed action matters. In a classic retail-driven mania, Bitcoin strength quickly spills into everything with a ticker. Today’s market is different. Traders are paying attention to quality, depth, and headline risk. Polygon’s disclosure of security flaws fixed in recent hard forks is a reminder that technology risk has not disappeared. A reported **$1.1 million** crypto card hack that crashed a neobank token by **49%** is another reminder that weak token structures can still be punished hard, even during a strong BTC tape.

So the message from altcoins is not bearish, but it is disciplined. Capital is not blindly rotating. It is asking which assets have liquidity, utility, catalysts, and survivable risk.

## Sentiment Is Greedy, Not Euphoric

The Fear & Greed Index rose from **68** to **69**, still firmly in Greed. That supports the rally but also warns against complacency. Greed near 70 means buyers are confident, not necessarily exhausted. The key difference is whether leverage expands faster than spot demand.

Today’s volume profile does not scream panic buying. BTC volume around **$16.9 billion** and ETH volume around **$9.1 billion** are healthy, but the broader market is not acting like every token is guaranteed to follow. That makes the current setup more mature than a pure meme-led pump. It also means any disappointment from institutional buyers, macro conditions, or security headlines could create sharp rotations rather than a uniform market selloff.

## What Comes Next

The next test is simple: can Bitcoin break and hold above **$79,000** while altcoins stabilize? If BTC pushes higher and dominance remains elevated, the market may continue rewarding the “digital reserve asset” narrative. If ETH starts outperforming with rising volume, that would hint at a broader risk-on phase. If SOL, ADA, DOGE, and XRP keep drifting while Bitcoin climbs, the market is sending a narrower message: own the leader, be selective everywhere else.

For now, the defining story is that the institutional Bitcoin bid is back in the conversation at exactly the moment sentiment is already greedy. That is powerful, but it raises the bar. Near $79K, Bitcoin does not just need belief — it needs follow-through.

Sources: CoinGecko market data, CoinGecko global crypto market snapshot, Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index, CoinDesk and Cointelegraph headline feeds.

title.title: ESP/ENG | The War Between Fans: When Passion Forgets It’s Just a Game / La guerra entre fanáticos: cuando la pasión olvida que es un juego
title.body:
### ENGLISH

A warm, fraternal, and cheerful greeting to this wonderful community! A big hello to you, who are taking a moment of your day to share these lines. What a joy to meet again in this corner of reflection and mutual growth!

Sports have an almost magical ability to move masses. A deep pass in the fourth quarter of an NFL game, a sensational catch in Major League Baseball, a last-minute try in rugby, a 90th-minute goal in soccer, or an epic boxing match can cause thousands of strangers to embrace as if they had known each other their entire lives. However, that same emotional force has a dark side: when the team jersey ceases to represent passion and becomes a battle flag.

What should be a spectacle of skill, discipline, and entertainment is often contaminated by a blind tribalism that transforms sports rivalry into open hostility.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWwZFGpf4DLvcUbhtTUbHP5dkLHC9FZ3S9w4Qih34zqwU/1788130400020.jpg)

*Public domain image sourced from Pixabay*
</center>

### The Divide Between Disciplines, National Pride, and Identity

Fan behavior varies drastically depending on the discipline and surrounding culture, exposing how fragile the line between passion and violence truly is:

* **Major League Baseball (MLB) and the Weight of Tradition:** Major League Baseball carries over a century of history, mystique, and belonging. Legendary rivalries like the New York Yankees vs. Boston Red Sox, or the Los Angeles Dodgers vs. San Francisco Giants, pit entire cities and worldviews against each other. Although baseball traditionally maintains a family atmosphere in its ballparks, media pressure and radical fandom have triggered violent altercations in parking lots and stands, proving that even the so-called \

is not immune to intolerance.
* **Boxing and National Pride:** Few disciplines awaken such a visceral fervor as professional boxing. When a fighter steps into the ring, they carry the flag, history, and identity of an entire nation on their shoulders. National pride condenses into twelve rounds where spectators feel every punch as their own. However, this national representation often crosses into chauvinism, turning bouts into geopolitical or ethnic disputes where respect for the opponent dissolves amid boos and overflowing emotions.
* **Soccer and the *Hooligan* Phenomenon:** World soccer has historically been the most affected by ultras and *hooligans* — organized groups that transformed stadiums and surrounding streets into battlefields, where match results became secondary to territorial control and rival aggression.
* **Rugby and the Paradox of Respect:** A famous adage often sums up rugby: \
Despite being an extreme contact sport filled with fierce collisions, rugby culture maintains a standard of respect where the referee's authority is absolute and the \

gathers both teams to share food and drinks after the final whistle. Stands host opposing fans without physical barriers, demonstrating that field intensity does not have to bleed into the audience.
* **American Football (NFL):** In the NFL or college football, rivalry is fierce and drives millions. While fan conflict usually concentrates on pre-game tailgating and verbal banter, it is not exempt from massive brawls when alcohol consumption and passion overflow the bleachers.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvayFuLbzTXQZ3ZAmAt3mcFArmGs4C7G41kuucQkeUdQ/1788130663740.jpg)

*Public domain image sourced from Pixabay*
</center>

### The Business of Hatred and Institutional Controversies

Unbridled fanaticism does not exist in a vacuum; it is often fueled and commercialized by the very governing bodies of sports. Organizations like FIFA have spent decades at the center of controversies over corruption, extreme commercialization, and awarding tournaments to controversial host nations where human rights and fan safety took a back seat.

When governing bodies prioritize financial gain over the integrity of the game, they send a distorted message to the stands. Fan passion becomes instrumentalized: blind loyalty and constant consumption are demanded, while structural issues of violence and racism in stadiums and arenas are swept under the rug.

### The True Triumph: Brotherhood, Sportsmanship, and Values to Replicate

Amid the noise of disagreement and fanaticism, the true greatness of sports shines brightest when we choose to focus on its best side. The real heroes of sports are not those who incite division, but the athletes and fans who remind us of the unifying power of physical activity.

* **Brotherhood Above the Jersey:** Sports history is filled with luminous moments that deserve to be emulated: athletes who stop mid-race to help a fallen rival, lifelong competitors sharing a sincere embrace after a fight or a final series, and entire crowds standing to applaud a brilliant play by the opposing team.
* **Teamwork as a Life Lesson:** No great sporting achievement happens in isolation. Success in baseball, soccer, rugby, or the NFL demands alignment, mutual sacrifice, communication, and deep trust in one’s teammates. That ability to place a shared goal above individual ego is an invaluable lesson we can and should apply to daily life.
* **Actions to Admire and Copy:** A culture of respect in the stands, the camaraderie of the \

recognizing the efforts of others, and celebrating one's own victory with humility are gestures that transform society.

Sports, in their purest essence, are a bridge, not a trench. Celebrating our team's colors is beautiful, but admiring excellence, sportsmanship, and empathy on any playing field is what elevates us as human beings. These are the attitudes worth repeating, sharing, and turning into our own way of life.

---

**Questions for the community:**
1. What act of sportsmanship or brotherhood in sports has impacted you the most, and why?
2. How do you cultivate teamwork and respect for those who think differently from you in your daily life?

---

*Disclaimers:*
* **Images:** Suggested images for this publication belong to the public domain and are sourced from Pixabay.
* **AI Usage:** Artificial Intelligence tools were utilized strictly for spell checking, syntax refinement, English translation, and Markdown layout structure.

---

<center>

### ESPAÑOL

</center>

¡Hola a toda esta maravillosa comunidad! Un abrazo fraterno y jovial para ti que dedicas un instante de tu día a compartir estas líneas. Qué alegría reencontrarnos en este rincón de reflexión y crecimiento mutuo.

El deporte tiene una capacidad casi mágica para mover a las masas. Un pase profundo en el último cuarto de la NFL, una atrapada sensacional en el béisbol de Grandes Ligas, un *try* sobre la hora en el rugby, un gol en el minuto 90 o un combate épico de boxeo pueden hacer que miles de desconocidos se abracen como si se conocieran de toda la vida. Sin embargo, esa misma fuerza emocional tiene una cara oscura: cuando la camiseta deja de representar una pasión para convertirse en una bandera de guerra.

Lo que debería ser un espectáculo de destreza, disciplina y entretenimiento, a menudo se contamina por un tribalismo ciego que transforma la rivalidad deportiva en hostilidad abierta.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWwZFGpf4DLvcUbhtTUbHP5dkLHC9FZ3S9w4Qih34zqwU/1788130710907.jpg)

*Imagen de dominio público tomada de Pixabay*
</center>

### La brecha entre disciplinas, el orgullo patrio y la identidad

El comportamiento de la fanaticada varía drásticamente según la disciplina y la cultura que la rodea, dejando al descubierto lo frágil que es el límite entre la pasión y la violencia:

* **Las Grandes Ligas de Béisbol (MLB) y el peso de la tradición:** El béisbol de Grandes Ligas lleva consigo más de un siglo de historia, mística y pertenencia. Rivalidades legendarias como la de los Yanquis de Nueva York y los Medias Rojas de Boston, o la de los Dodgers de Los Ángeles y los Gigantes de San Francisco, no solo enfrentan a dos equipos, sino a ciudades completas y visiones de vida. Aunque el béisbol mantiene tradicionalmente un ambiente familiar en sus parques, la presión mediática y el fanatismo radical han provocado enfrentamientos violentos en los estacionamientos y graderías, demostrando que ni siquiera el llamado «pasatiempo nacional» está a salvo de la intolerancia.
* **El boxeo y el orgullo nacional:** Pocas disciplinas despiertan un fervor tan visceral como el boxeo profesional. Cuando un peleador sube al cuadrilátero, lleva sobre sus hombros la bandera, la historia y la identidad de todo un país. El orgullo patrio se condensa en doce asaltos donde el espectador siente cada golpe como propio. Sin embargo, esta representación nacional a menudo cruza la línea hacia el chauvinismo, convirtiendo los combates en disputas geopolíticas o étnicas donde el respeto al adversario se disuelve entre abucheos y pasiones desbordadas.
* **Fútbol y el fenómeno *hooligan*:** El fútbol mundial ha sido históricamente el escenario más afectado por las barras bravas y los *hooligans*. Grupos organizados que convirtieron los estadios y sus alrededores en campos de batalla, donde el resultado del partido pasa a segundo plano frente al control del territorio y la agresión al rival.
* **Rugby y la paradoja del respeto:** En el rugby suele citarse una vieja máxima: «es un juego de villanos jugado por caballeros». A pesar de ser un deporte de contacto extremo y colisiones feroces, la cultura del rugby mantiene un estándar de respeto donde la autoridad del árbitro es inquebrantable y el \

reúne a ambos equipos a compartir tras el pitazo final. Las tribunas suelen convivir sin separación física, demostrando que la intensidad del campo no tiene por qué trasladarse al público.
* **Fútbol Americano (NFL):** En la NFL o el fútbol colegial, la rivalidad es feroz y mueve millones. Aunque tiende a concentrarse en la fiesta previa (*tailgating*) y la provocación verbal, no está exenta de altercados multitudinarios cuando el consumo de alcohol y el apasionamiento desbordan las tribunas.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvayFuLbzTXQZ3ZAmAt3mcFArmGs4C7G41kuucQkeUdQ/1788130752917.jpg)

*Imagen de dominio público tomada de Pixabay*
</center>

### El negocio del odio y las controversias institucionales

El fanatismo desmedido no nace en el vacío; a menudo es alimentado y rentabilizado por los mismos organismos que rigen el deporte. Organizaciones como la FIFA han estado en el ojo del huracán por décadas, enfrentando controversias por corrupción, la comercialización extrema del juego y la adjudicación de torneos a sedes polémicas donde los derechos humanos y la seguridad del aficionado quedaron en segundo plano.

Cuando los grandes entes rectores priorizan el beneficio económico por encima de la integridad del juego, envían un mensaje distorsionado a la tribuna. La pasión del aficionado es instrumentalizada: se le exige lealtad ciega y consumo constante, mientras se invisibilizan los problemas estructurales de violencia y racismo que ocurren en los estadios y arenas.

### El verdadero triunfo: hermandad, deportividad y valores a replicar

Frente al ruido de las discrepancias y el fanatismo, la auténtica grandeza del deporte se manifiesta cuando elegimos mirar lo mejor de él. Los verdaderos héroes del deporte no son los que incitan a la división, sino aquellos atletas y fanáticos que nos recuerdan el poder unificador de la actividad física.

* **La hermandad por encima de la camiseta:** En la historia del deporte abundan momentos luminosos que merecen ser imitados: atletas que se detienen a mitad de una carrera para levantar a un rival caído, rivales de toda la vida que comparten un abrazo sincero al terminar un combate o una serie final, y aficiones enteras que aplauden de pie la jugada genial del equipo contrario.
* **El trabajo en equipo como lección de vida:** Ningún gran logro deportivo ocurre en solitario. El éxito en el béisbol, el fútbol, el rugby o la NFL exige sincronía, sacrificio mutuo, comunicación y una profunda confianza en el compañero. Esa capacidad de poner el objetivo común por encima del ego individual es una lección invaluable que podemos y debemos llevar a nuestro día a día.
* **Acciones para admirar y copiar:** La cultura del respeto en las tribunas, la camaradería del \

, el reconocimiento al esfuerzo ajeno y la capacidad de celebrar el triunfo propio con humildad son gestos que transforman a la sociedad.

El deporte, en su esencia más pura, es un puente, no una trinchera. Celebrar los colores de nuestro equipo es hermoso, pero admirar la excelencia, la caballerosidad y la empatía en cualquier terreno de juego es lo que nos eleva como seres humanos. Esas son las actitudes que valen la pena repetir, difundir y convertir en nuestro propio estilo de vida.

---

title.title: [EN/PT] On Avenida Paulista, Reuniting with an Old Friend
title.body: > # [EN] Last week, I was in São Paulo, and one of the first things I did was visit Avenida Paulista with my friend Diego, who has been living in the city for approximately 15 years. Even though we live far apart, we still keep in touch, and sometimes, when he comes to my city to visit his parents, we take the opportunity to meet. This time, he made a point of meeting me and taking me to visit some of São Paulo’s main tourist attractions. After leaving the Consolação Cemetery, we went straight to Avenida Paulista. Near the beginning of the avenue, we climbed the stairs of a building that offers a great view of a large part of Paulista Avenue. Since our visit was on a Sunday, we had the opportunity to enjoy the avenue without vehicle traffic. On Sundays and public holidays, Avenida Paulista is closed to cars, allowing pedestrians, cyclists, and various attractions to take over the avenue. As soon as we arrived, I took a photo with Monica, the famous character from Monica’s Gang, who was there. After that, we went up the building, where I also took a photo with my friend @diego.andrade. We spent most of the morning walking along Avenida Paulista, exploring different places and attractions. The avenue was very lively, with street performers, presentations, and people enjoying various activities. It was a great way to start my visit to São Paulo and, most importantly, to enjoy the city in the company of an old friend. ---- # [PT] Na semana passada, estive em São Paulo e uma das primeiras coisas que fiz foi conhecer a Avenida Paulista com meu amigo Diego, que mora na cidade há aproximadamente 15 anos. Mesmo com a distância, continuamos mantendo contato e, às vezes, quando ele vem à minha cidade para visitar os pais, aproveitamos para nos encontrar. Dessa vez, ele fez questão de me encontrar e me levar para conhecer alguns dos principais pontos turísticos de São Paulo. Depois de sairmos do Cemitério da Consolação, fomos direto para a Avenida Paulista. Logo no início da avenida, subimos as escadas de um prédio que possui uma vista privilegiada de boa parte da Paulista. Como nosso passeio aconteceu em um domingo, tivemos a oportunidade de aproveitar a avenida sem o trânsito de veículos. Aos domingos e feriados, a Avenida Paulista é fechada para os carros, ficando aberta para pedestres, ciclistas e diversas atrações. Assim que chegamos, aproveitei para tirar uma foto com a Mônica, personagem da Turma da Mônica, que estava por lá. Depois, subimos no prédio e tirei uma foto com meu amigo @diego.andrade. Passamos grande parte da manhã caminhando pela Avenida Paulista, conhecendo diferentes lugares e atrações. A avenida estava bastante movimentada, com artistas, apresentações e pessoas realizando diversas atividades. Foi uma ótima maneira de começar minha visita a São Paulo e, principalmente, de aproveitar a cidade na companhia de um velho amigo.

title.title: Boss DR-550 Wave File Sample Set
title.body:
![Boss DR-550 Wave File Sample Set](https://files.catbox.moe/4zepwf.jpg)

[View on Gumroad](https://horrorweapon.gumroad.com/l/BossDR-550)

Over 40 studio quality samples.

The Boss DR-550 Dr. Rhythm stands as a landmark in the evolution of home recording, bridging the gap between toy-like rhythm boxes and professional studio gear when it debuted in 1989. For a generation of musicians, it was the first piece of hardware that provided clean, 16-bit digital drum samples at a price that didn’t require a bank loan. Its compact, plastic chassis housed a surprisingly sophisticated sound engine, offering a palette of 48 internal sounds that ranged from crisp acoustic kits to the synthesized thuds that defined early electronic and hip-hop productions.
The machine’s layout is deceptively simple, featuring twelve small rubber pads and a liquid crystal display that required a bit of menu-diving but rewarded the patient programmer with deep customizability. Unlike many of its contemporaries, the DR-550 allowed users to tweak the decay, pan, and \

of individual samples, enabling a level of sound design that made the unit punches well above its weight class. Its sequencer was equally capable, allowing for the chaining of patterns into full songs, complete with the ability to program subtle velocity changes despite the pads themselves not being touch-sensitive.\nIn 1992, Boss refined the formula with the DR-550 MKII. This updated version nearly doubled the internal library to 91 sounds, famously incorporating samples from the legendary Roland TR-808 and TR-909. While the MKII gained a more diverse sonic range, it made a curious trade-off by removing the MIDI Out port found on the original model, focusing instead on being a dedicated sound module triggered by external sequencers or played via its own internal logic.\nToday, the DR-550 series enjoys a loyal following in the vintage gear market. Producers prize it for its \

charm—a specific digital grit that modern software often fails to replicate perfectly. Whether it is being used to provide the backbone for an indie-rock demo or being fed through distortion pedals for industrial techno, the Dr. Rhythm remains a testament to the era when high-quality digital percussion first became accessible to the masses. Its portability, powered by a handful of AA batteries, ensures it remains a favorite for \
and mobile setups decades after its release.\r\n

title.title: Crypto can be as daunting as facing an anime villain and in Venezuela it's almost a necessity
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeoynPdCxWHrLXKFnSNyhdXbBj7W7dek9NVoPvmKngjHL/1788130409463.jpg)
Getting into crypto and especially trading crypto for a newbie is extremely daunting to put it in simpler terms. Chad or Renji from Bleach would have a better chance of beating Yhwach than someone who's completely green to trading, or even crypto in general, has of understanding how the mechanics actually work.

Some people have the capital to use when they're funding their crypto wallets. Others, like me, who live in Venezuela — it's the only stable way to actually hold any funds that isn't killed by the ever-fluctuating bolívar. Whether you're trading your stablecoins for the only decent exchange you're going to get, or it's the only way you might, and even hopefully can, start saving a little something up for your kids in the future.

Essentially, unless you have the means and can afford to lose money, don't chase trends, and know when it's time to sell. If you're burning through your stakes, just cut your losses and leave with whatever you have left before you lose too much.

So study, learn, because the more you know the less likely you are to fall into the same pitfalls other people already have. Nothing worthwhile is ever easy or comes easy. Just like in Bleach, or any shonen anime/manga, sometimes it's better to sit back and study before you go and tackle the monster in front of you.

***

English football event match and this was easily the most dominant performance I’ve had so far in the Tour Event. I loaded in as Chelsea vs Swansea and from kickoff you could just tell Swansea weren’t ready for what Drogba was about to do to them. First goal came in the 5th minute and it was my 99 rated Drogba who opened it up. I worked it into the box, played a quick pass and Drogba turned his defender and finished it with his left. The game instantly popped up “21 Didier Drogba, Today’s Goals: 1” and then he ran straight to the corner flag to do that celebration holding the flag. The stadium was packed and the crowd was loud. 1-0 up and you could see Swansea’s defense already panicking every time the ball came near Drogba.
After that first goal the whole game changed. I was playing through midfield with Rooney, Bergkamp and Saka and just feeding Drogba every chance I got. Swansea tried to sit deep but it didn’t matter because Drogba was winning every header and holding up the ball like a wall. Around the 10th minute I almost got a second but the keeper made a save. The replay showed how I was breaking them down, passing around their midfield and finding space behind their fullbacks. Swansea barely had the ball and when they did my press forced them into mistakes. You could see in the gameplay that their back line was scared of Drogba’s strength. 1-0 at halftime but it felt like it should have been more because I was creating chances every 2 minutes.
Second half I came out and told myself Drogba needs the match ball today. Goal number 2 came from a quick counter. I won the ball with Rooney in the middle, played a through ball and Drogba just outmuscled their center back and smashed it past the keeper. 2-0. The crowd went wild and I could see Swansea’s heads drop. Then the hattrick came from a corner. Bergkamp whipped it in, Drogba rose above everyone and headed it in. 3-0. The game showed his 99 card again and I was just laughing because he was unplayable. Swansea tried to change formation and bring on subs but nothing worked. My defense with the back line was solid too, didn’t give them a single shot on target the whole game.
The fourth goal was the pick of the bunch. I played a one-two with Bergkamp on the edge of the box, slipped Drogba in behind and he took one touch before curling it into the top corner. Keeper didn’t even move. 4-0. That made it 4 goals for Drogba in one match. At that point I just started playing keep ball because the game was done. Every attack was going through Drogba and he was scoring for fun. Swansea tried to get one back but my midfield wasn’t letting them play. From minute 1 to minute 90 it was complete control. The green and yellow kit looked clean too and Drogba was running the show like it was 2012 all over again.
Ended the match 4-0 and that’s a perfect win in the English football event. All 4 goals scored by Didier Drogba. That’s 3 points and a massive goal difference boost. The video shows the first goal and that celebration but the whole 90 minutes was a Drogba masterclass. From the hold up play to the finishes to the headers, he did everything. Clean sheet as well which helps in the event standings. If I keep playing like this with Drogba leading the line I think I can clear the whole event without dropping points. 4-0 win, 4 goals for Drogba, and I’m buzzing going into the next match 💪

title.title: The happiness of a coffee with my favorite sweet treat. 🤤 (ENG-ESP)
title.body:
***Greetings, beautiful community; I hope you are all doing very well. 🤗***

+ ***Saludos hermosa comunidad, espero y se encuentren muy bien 🤗***


![1000332626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpXMSdhMpdwGHuGsVeuP18qQbTHLJBqVBmdsTvhy8M1fXKGMTAxHxMbuBsEUA8jF9UB.jpg)

---
Lately, sadness has washed over both my heart and my dear husband's; we are still struggling to process everything we’ve been through this year. Sometimes we try to live as if nothing happened, but reality slaps us in the face time and again—though we also realize it is our responsibility not to let these hardships destroy us.

Despite everything, life keeps offering us new opportunities. I believe happiness is found in moments—moments that arrive unexpectedly, but also moments we should actively seek out.

Today, we treated ourselves to an outing, setting aside our complaints and sadness to make room for moments that bring pleasure and joy. There’s a bakery near where I live now that makes delicious coffee, and their pastries are usually fresh and tasty. The coffee and treats aren't cheap, but happiness is priceless, and we certainly know how to enjoy moments like these.

Coffee and a pastry might sound simple to some, but that is precisely the key: enjoying the things that seem simple. I love going to a good bakery, sitting at an outdoor table, waiting for friendly service, and—once the coffee arrives—enjoying it with a strawberry tart like the one I had today. Everything was perfect! My husband, on the other hand, prefers to pair his coffee with a very generous slice of guava bread 🤭.

Honestly, we had a great couple of hours; we forgot about our many problems for a moment and just savored our coffees—they were delicious! We bought two small cappuccinos—having already had two large ones earlier (yes, a total coffee binge, but please understand: right now, we struggle to enjoy coffee at all during the week).

We had our moment of happiness; we’re back home now, and the problems are still there, but there’s nothing that can’t be fixed by a tasty cup of coffee paired with a favorite sweet treat 😌


+ Estos últimos días la tristeza inundó mi corazón y el de mí querido esposo, es que aún nos cuesta asimilar todo lo que nos ha tocado vivir este año, a veces tratamos de vivir como si nada hubiese pasado, pero la realidad nos abofetea una y otra vez, aunque también estamos conscientes de que tenemos la responsabilidad en no dejar que las vicisitudes nos destruyan.

+ A pesar de todo, la vida nos sigue ofreciendo nuevas oportunidades y creo que la felicidad solo son momentos, momentos que vienen sin buscarlo, pero también momentos que deberíamos buscar.

+ Hoy nos dimos el gusto de salir, dejar la queja y la tristeza a un lado para darle cabida a esos momentos que dan placer y alegría, aquí en donde vivo ahora, queda una panadería que hace un café muy rico y los dulces normalmente están frescos y deliciosos, el costo del café y los dulces no son baratos Pero la felicidad no tiene precio y nosotros si que sabemos disfrutar momentos así.

+ Un café y un dulce para algunos puede sonar simple, pero precisamente allí está la clave en disfrutar de esas cosas que a veces nos parecen simples, amo ir a una buena panadería, sentarme en una mesa al aire libre, esperar que me atienda alguien amable y cuando me sirven el café, disfrutarlo con una tartaleta de fresa como la que me comí hoy, todo fue perfecto! Mi esposo prefiere acompañar su café con una porción bien generosa de pan de Guayaba 🤭

+ Sinceramente pasamos un par de horas geniales, nos olvidamos por un instante de tantos problemas y nos dedicamos a saborear nuestros cafecitos que estaban bien ricos! Compramos dos capuchinos pequeños, porque antes habíamos tomado dos capuchinos grandes, si, toda una locura de café, pero entiendan por favor, en este momento tenemos dificultades para disfrutar del café en toda la semana.

+ Tuvimos nuestro instante de felicidad, estamos de vuelta en casa, los problemas siguen allí, pero no hay nada que no pueda arreglar una rica taza de café acompañado de ese dulce preferido 😌

title.body:
BEHIND THE SUBJECT...

CAPEVERDE - 2 PHOTOS


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXiRoyZUcTAkfyMHbCzmFDReXkXd5opAKpLzkM8rdJ8mS/dsc_0705_dxo.jpg)
https://images.ecency.com/p/qjrE4yyfw5pJD9LKQ1BG3NbSyKTowh8wnMyt99dK65jb9EyRiDqdkR63HQ91ZqnuFHTiEML7JsCGppcMeUsSg6BbKH3QeuVfMQwWygfDgJTnhE1wD53KXCSa.webp?format=webp&mode=fit
Fr
En
🇫🇷 La photographie met en avant le sujet. Il est au centre, on ne voit que lui, il correspond au thème annoncé de la photo, tout va bien pour l'oeil, pas besoin de regarder ailleurs...! Pour autant l'important sur cette première photo n'est pas la Flabelline fluorescente qui occupe l'essentiel de la coloration de cette photo. C'est derrière que cela se passe. L'espèce de ruban rose clair à moitié caché par le nudibranche est en fait le sujet principal de la photographie. Si le nudibranche Flabelline est ici, ce n'est pas par hasard. C'est pour fabriquer ce ruban. Il a bien choisi cet endroit et crée ce ruban. Le bon mot est pondre ce ruban. Car en fait ce ruban contient des milliers d'œufs. La Flabelline les a pondu et tout le sujet de la scène est là.
🇬🇧 Photography highlights the subject. He’s in the center, you can only see him, he matches the announced theme of the photo, everything is fine for the eye, no need to look elsewhere...! However, the important thing in this first photo is not the fluorescent flabelline that occupies most of the coloring of this photo. It’s behind that this happens. The kind of light pink ribbon half hidden by the nudibranch is actually the main subject of the photograph. If the Flabelline nudibranch is here, it’s not by chance. It’s to make this ribbon. He chose this place carefully and created this ribbon. The correct word is to lay this ribbon. In fact, this ribbon contains thousands of eggs. La Flabelline laid them and the entire subject of the scene is there.
https://images.ecency.com/p/qjrE4yyfw5pJD9LKQ1BG3NbSyKTowh8wnMyt99dK65jb9EyRiDqdkR63HQ91ZqnuFHTiEML7JsCGppcMeUsSg6BbKH3QeuVfMQwWygfDgJTnhE1wD53KXCSa.webp?format=webp&mode=fit
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTvcMXcQd1AeVvF6PCnFuJ5kYgAu3zig3ecipjsLAmJKJ/dsc_0742_2_dxo.jpg)
https://images.ecency.com/p/qjrE4yyfw5pJD9LKQ1BG3NbSyKTowh8wnMyt99dK65jb9EyRiDqdkR63HQ91ZqnuFHTiEML7JsCGppcMeUsSg6BbKH3QeuVfMQwWygfDgJTnhE1wD53KXCSa.webp?format=webp&mode=fit
Fr
En
🇫🇷 Quant à la seconde photographie, là encore, cette étoile de mer bien centrée sur cette photo n'est pas le sujet premier de la scène. L'étoile de mer n'est pas ici par hasard. Elle a programmée de venir exactement à cet endroit pour une raison bien concrète. Ce tapis de point rouge sur lequel l'étoile de mer est venue se poser, est en fait un tapis d'œufs de poisson demoiselle. Il y a ici des centaines d'œufs dont vous pouvez devinez les 2 yeux en zoomant un peu. L'étoile de mer les a détectés et est ici pour s'en nourrir ! Ce n'est donc pas un passage hasardeux, c'est une chasse ! La photographie prend un sens différent une fois que l'on sait cela!
🇬🇧 As for the second photograph, again, this starfish, well centered in this photo, is not the primary subject of the scene. The starfish is not here by chance. It has planned to come exactly to this place for a very concrete reason. This red dot carpet on which the starfish came to land is actually a carpet of fish eggs, damsel. There are hundreds of eggs here, and you can guess both eyes by zooming in a bit. The starfish has detected them and is here to feed on them! So it’s not a random trip, it’s a hunt! Photography takes on a different meaning once we know that!

body.title: [Movie] ZOOM 2006 [MOVIE REVIEW]
body.body:
If you read my movie reviews, you will know I am someone who loves fantasy, scifi and super hero movies. Yesterday I talked about sky high, a movie I watched as a child and one of the first super hero movies I watched growing up. But after that post I went to confirm which was the super hero movie I really watched first as a child. I went through my old CD plates and finally remembered I watched Zoom in 2006 after which I watched Sky High. This was in a time when decoders were becoming prominent in Nigeria and my dad decided to get one for us where I was able to watch my first super hero movie on a channel called MAX (if I remember correctly). However I decided to rewatch the movie again, and it was every bit as I remembered it to be when I watched it first as a child. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRL1MGAKVqGtXu2x8aP6CTKSVeXzYQhoYnCWEkgNmfHAh/MV5BMjE3ODUwMTY3NF5BMl5BanBnXkFtZTcwMDY1MDE0MQ@@._V1_.jpg) ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQuYAoJcHvqCSd85fzHZwB6urerToS7KtnpZqnSbjjqch/MV5BODY1NzkwMjMzMl5BMl5BanBnXkFtZTcwMjcxNjMzMQ@@._V1_.jpg) ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfMSQWncWrt6xomrffEDESDYjqnFiuPoohCLF36crZYac/MV5BNzhlZmM0YzMtZWQwNy00Y2VhLTlhNmEtNDgwZTQ5YTFhYjJkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg) Before the Avengers, and Before DC came up with The Flash, there was a man called Zoom. He was faster than fast, truer than true and to the end of his speed there was no limit. If you watch it, you will see what I mean. But the movie did not start with the all powerful Jack Shepard otherwise known as Zoom, rather, it started with the ordinary Jack who was called to train the new generation of the zenith team which he was a part of. body.title: Fungi Friday - Is it Edible?
body.body:
I found a potentially edible milkcap of some kind for this #fungifriday
![1000006860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23wWwEG4zaxTEyDH7x1KVuaud9AV18dupEvLLUgXvzkUagT4a2XXTgkUM5mozMD1ivcLX.jpg)
These things are huge and orange and were in pristine condition.

![1000006859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Eq5ESed7w2PAvXDXMKZE5Zs87heWwnT4cFiocihuTT9ips2WLoUGtzZJpTfyAbvmdR9.jpg)
My daughter instantly grabbed one along with a questionable LBM. Eventually she threw the LBMs down and focused on the larger orange milk cap. 

![1000006858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Eou8fzbiBL4FvwesWFKCPjF5kmFQkeqByaqxQH7Mo6BEVRvAJboA4xg12VL6iwqoLym.jpg)
In my mind I was thinking finally I have found the perfect edible Saffron Milk Cap aka Lactarius deliciosus.

![1000006856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23w2si8QtsUBrGTX2vyAE1bpoGHYyk5PakZXSjtQuXjatjcphEcmHekUxxBbmDRiVgFSV.jpg)
But on closer examination the gills seem a bit too light. Saffron milk caps have the same orange in the gills and these ones are nearly white.

![1000006857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23wgYf3zDRaxzz4JL1Ydww8shXjmConStSDHdnKsQK58ZKWMTGXw2bxDrLsMBXHZN2xEL.jpg)
At least I know it is a milk cap, when you slice the gills they immediately bleed a milk like substance. 

![1000006852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EowGfFsiydqFWd3QMUDA4NNmtXoGJfQGGTzSAk2ZzmE15XZHemdQjzQswV4Pf2jdCGG.jpg)
Now I am thinking these might be Tawny Milk Caps due to its more symmetrical solid orange cap color. Saffrons tend to have a few rings and are a bit less symmetrical.

![1000006855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23wqiZPvGWzFNpxDk2Z75xkLTVKjN8MznmQGYU6iuwgfHUcvqDwZ41RowncpsqoP799e5.jpg)
I've read that Tawny Milkcaps stink like fish and some guides say they are not edible and will cause stomach upset in some people. But these ones smelled great.

![1000006854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23u67PfM2Wr7n6wEW5s2pjQsJiMSUYph7FMSfZfsnDP7vQxXoV6F6hCJcbJw2fWNxy7N8.jpg)
I took a taste test and they weren't spicy either which also points to potential edibility. Many milk cap species are edible but are super spicy, so much so that you wouldn't want to eat it. 

![1000006853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Eou8gy7wa9yLZUsMrPB1bw9vXpXAECVtPFTSeev6iEyz9mMe7rZ5dVcfHDYxvHzdWUP.jpg)
For now I'm going with these as maybe fresh Tawny Milk Caps aka Lactifluus volemus before they start to stink like fish. They can found in Asian markets sometimes but I didn't want to take a chance on them just yet even though they were in perfect harvesting condition. 

That's all for now, more mushroom soon El Nino is really bringing them out this year.

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYu6CP35LtU9PYCj3viTAm55HY88gvsXcqyBJPdA8d6cU/1788129868173.jpg)
Happy  #aliveandthriving Sunday afternoon/evening to you, and thank you for your visit!

I had a little time this afternoon so I went over to the Park - and to see if there are more cameras in the neighborhood. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecQ2qZSQ5xW25oQGBpgA9V7WrVimTDRqiu5jTdURHpAV/1788130013538.jpg)

I talked with a neighbor and he told me there are \

.... No buddy I did not and I don't think anyone else did either, he got quiet...

Well back to the trip, and no I did not find the other cameras - yet!

So at the Park I saw that we have a bunch of Seagrass coming in - there must be a Storm in the Gulf somewhere. This is a look to the North,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaYGrS44EhJGZjsuL47Vak4aQRG91eFqpFJULSk2ezLB2/1788130032687.jpg)

And to the South,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4ir8T6rp2yyxY2EARsWh4drjnyZ5ECw9V5jq5hWv61t/1788130040362.jpg)

Since the tides are very low I took the opportunity to walk back to the Breeding Pond - it was beach (normally underwater) all the way.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbgXgsxMwM5grR7uMBD5FANuESNhmxRhAHmUuSRF2FwA/1788130051275.jpg)

And sideways with the beach (?) that would normally be underwater,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTTNW1mKaBKtTXgmFQJPR68vykCSPHF2rtLwpaKvspARV/1788130060094.jpg)

Along the shore I saw some indicators of how dry it is. This is the mud cracking,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsxsAthLDWivfamBwG5aJe3n6QuDthq1E8umjbzh1VTk/1788130072447.jpg)

And Crab holes, which there are hundreds!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMrtiXuDeYSjUBPsZBDjEuNz4Qosdur2XEi4eNzAvVoq/1788130079201.jpg)

And I found this Skull, probably from some fish that the birds dropped off here,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbTxzESdu2oFwgruESc6nDvu1Ra7TqZSi3dsyqa1ZsBi/1788130088375.jpg)

Walking out a little further I got to the Sandbar where the Seagulls are,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfCCcrMfyQ3Kr4RWtN2pRm59muFk2SY1fPKhqzNWg57Je/1788130105803.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWws23YuPgi1GP8tdH2rtmEhweWnRZ4Qu3PJzXRB9GAj2/1788130105941.jpg)

Here I walked up to them and they started taking off!

And another look at the Sandbars and the Causeway,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVKHKm3APaFv2P7kv65k2sBsBKkxSefXj9h8bNmL4KpAx/1788130124055.jpg)

On the way back I found this one \

flowering and took a photo,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP6GheAoeX8MdN9TNi8gM7hekkEXgNx6XaBkbGQZ7S86s/1788130130816.jpg)

And then headed back home!
And...
I want to thank you again for your visit and I am Wishing you a Very Blessed, Happy, and Safe New-Week!
