body.title: [Movie] Immortals (2011)- Review
body.body: >Immortals was one of my favorite movies back then. I like it because it gives me some insight into how gods and men put faith in each other in order to get certain purposes achieved. Immortals is an action, fantasy movie directed by Tarsem Singh. Starring Henry Cavill, Mickey Rourke, Freida Pinto, Luke Evans, John Hurt, Stephen Dorff, Isabel Lucas, and Kellan Lutz. It is a movie inspired by Greek mythology stories. Theseus, a despised peasant, was living happily with his poor mother and his old teacher in a little village when Hyperion, in his quest to conquer the gods and rule the universe, attacked and raided the settlement living many dead, including Theseus’s mother. Theseus found himself captive among others, where he met Phaedra, a seer, and Stavros, who became his allies. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUBEBjjoeBXWDe4MsXqibRZCJ94RW64RrB8P2MDzcKjLp/1001034505.jpg) They eventually found a way to escape and returned back to Theseus’s village, where they found the Epirus bow, a powerful weapon that can destroy anything, including a god, but the story only began there, as Hyperion, the villain, has been on the search for the weapon ever since his thirst for power began. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQQ52ZWZvwomg8BBssiu81avboN41RFGpWFEYuHWmajRw/1001034501.jpg) Immortals is a movie I don't get tired of watching because of the adventures. The portrayal of the behavior of gods and their display of power is something I can not have enough of. The movie was quite good; the background of the environment was nice; the distinction made between the earth realm and the realm of the gods was wise. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUwmFdoaUckFmo6xcD7qHzZzjv7vKxoRd1cV8z4pzGkTD/1001034500.jpg) I can not forget to mention that one of the outstanding scenes in the movie for me was when Poseidon, one of the gods intervened to save Theseus and his friends by causing a sudden mighty storm to clear the enemy. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrBwKk6W2Xsyai9bdphMQ7RvMD8rwLAMNExessLpVa9u/1001034507.jpg) That scene shows the superiority of gods over men; it entails that when the gods choose to stand by a man, they can make the impossible happen. Henry Cavill did a nice job in the movie; the bravery and effort he puts in ensuring that he conquered the enemy was well played. I love how the movie moved from a revenge story to saving the world. Instead of Theseus fighting to avenge his mother, he became a hero who no longer fights for personal interests but for the salvation of both humanity and the gods. The action in the movie was top-notch, especially any time the gods were involved. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUeYLEMswnGWsQg6KRU2oUpn6m4eYR6Ef4Yz3woeg82LE/1001034503.jpg) Immortals is such a movie, but the storyline doesn't seem detailed; it's as if the movie was rushed. For instance, nothing was shown about how the old man, who was Zeus himself in disguise, met Theseus's mother and how they became close. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWnUiRsmJdQAdV6CpRyPVhGnMLrtmMHdcNBphPpexmfcj/1001034504.jpg) Nothing was also said about Theseus's Dad thought out the movie. Theseus doesn't know anything about his father and there was never a time he asked. Meanwhile, I commend the effort of the actors and everyone who made the movie; it's not easy to come up with something like that. The end was a good one, Theseus managed to terminate Hyperion, but he also died, however, he was blessed with a son who obviously was going to continue from where his father stopped as he was already seeing visions of his father fighting evil forces in the heavenly realm. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRdKF9VJwsVuxe93xQVJ2C1Hi5yc2XaPUry1XMrvyxwdX/1001034509.jpg) I recommend the movie to anyone fascinated in action, fantasy, and adventure movies. It's just a perfect one. I will rate this movie 7/10 Image Credit _Rating: **70/100**_ --- _Originally posted through [scrobble.life/movies](https://scrobble.life/review/emreal/immortals-2011-review-mtgedmwj)._

Here is their about me page on their website. I highly recommend them. **_Who we are_** Monarch Precious Metals is a privately held, family owned and operated company. The company was founded in 2008 in response to the increasing demand for gold and silver bullion. We employ a small crew of dedicated and skilled workers to produce unique bullion pieces as well as industry standard investor grade bullion. **_The journey so far!_** The founding of Monarch started with a small local coin shop, Oregon Coin and Jewelry. The shop was having trouble sourcing silver bullion to sell to its customers. From there the idea of making silver bullion was born. The next phase was hand pouring silver bars using a small induction melter typically used in jewelry making. Those bars were then hand stamped with basic individual letter stamps. Eventually, Monarch Precious Metals was formed and moved to a larger warehouse in Phoenix, Oregon for production where we first made some of the original struck 1/10th ounce silver rounds and started machining our own molds for hand pouring small sheets and small bars. In 2011, we moved to our current location in Medford, Oregon. We have continually improved our production processes and introduced a large array of new products over the years. Be sure to check out our blog for updates as well as our posts on social media. **_Our values_** We strive to provide the most unique and highest quality bullion products on the market today. Our raw gold and silver is sourced from the best refineries in the world. Every bullion product that ships out of our warehouse has been quality checked for purity and weight. **_Now for the piece…._**

body.title: [Movie] Movie Review: Mercy
body.body:
> Set in the near future, a detective accused of murdering his wife has 90 minutes to prove his innocence to an advanced AI judge

The movie is directed by screenlife innovator Timur Bekmambetov and it's centered on the ethical landmines of artificial intelligence and automated justice. The movie is set in 2029 in Los Angeles, where the city's justice system has been replaced by the Mercy Court, an artificial intelligence program designed to judge capital crimes. If you've ever wondered whether artificial intelligence has all the answers, then this movie is for you.

The artificial intelligence program was designed to collect data from every data point: cameras, satellites, and home gadgets. Believed to have all the answers, it was tasked with judging crimes, with defendants strapped to a chair and given 90 minutes to prove their innocence by parsing through a massive digital data network to reduce their guilt probability below a 92% threshold. Failure resulted in immediate execution.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbfMEyc4TJUxMnthEyE2NG98vPaYBXbpqZtkX1eVykdmP/1788125676626.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUrznAKjduzTXuxD4ay6ufbjDtnewL1tGytKLjdm32SgH/1788125676694.jpg)

The movie began with Chris Raven, who woke up strapped to a chair, face to face with the same system he had used to judge and execute countless people. The opening was great and hooked me from the very start. The unyielding judge Maddox did a fantastic job playing her role. Even while portraying an emotionless, calculated algorithm, she stole the show. Artificial intelligence is supposed to have no emotions, and that's exactly what she delivered.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeH7snFGLfZM4nA5QPLeQ9GabEkMSMQsMaAaZP97sMhuP/1788125676663.jpg)

Most scenes happen in the Mercy Courtroom (as expected if artificial intelligence handles judicial matters). Every minute brings a longing to see what Raven must prove about his innocence before a machine believed to have all the data and evidence. It turned out that Raven was set up, but tied to a chair, he needed the help of certain people to prove his innocence before the timer reached zero.

This is what I learned from the movie: \

This was the truth revealed in the movie. Just like humans, machines have their downsides and can be manipulated for certain benefits. The movie has little action but high suspense. It doesn't give you room to predict the next action, and that's what made the movie interesting. Running under two hours, the movie rarely stopped to let one catch their breath.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKMNmu9i2fwEzvfmPdfBNVzPJRMWEnmGz46bEte5SazR/1788125676720.jpg)

The film shifts gears in the final 30 minutes into action, with police and a helicopter in pursuit. However, the film hovers around a superficial theme and confused politics, endorsing AI while simultaneously setting up a fascinating, terrifying premise about AI taking over civil liberties.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWoernRPuM6xzSHDy7GYFnvFbXy4h92SnK8gypx4QJB9Y/1788125676748.jpg)

If you enjoy fast-paced thriller movies, then this movie is for you. However, its shallow script prevents it from saying anything memorable about technology or humanity.

_Rating: **70/100**_

---

body.title: Hola Buenas TARDES! || Pensando en voz alta
body.body:
> Muy buenass, han pasado muchas cosas desde Abril ¿no? > What happened since April?
![aksdjaksdja.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23tbRLZ1YSVrgxQ6M9bSrURUiLdk9hscougApv6crPirFGKUyTXEi4dt3cTJ3Q6FkHWtJ.jpg)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23tvcRP4i4gBkeiQbXYqS2TDkWvv6BbzqnQeUnJCpTdpZzM14CSSizKTsc2msjdcCWM6f.png)
🇪🇸 🇺🇸

🇪🇸 Muchas cosas han pasado desde la última vez que publiqué y quise darme un poco a la tarea de revisar que ha pasado estos últimos meses, como un poco de introspección.
https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPWVjZjA1ZTQ3ZHFzMWh1cXowNzdiNzN6ZTJhYW9waWx5cHl3Mm4xN3k5cTk3a2ZrayZlcD12MV9naWZzX3JlbGF0ZWQmY3Q9Zw/muzaYMXAENjiw/giphy.gif
fuente: [Giphy](giphy.com)

En marzo empecé a trabajar en un trabajo de limpieza, por segunda vez. Este trabajo me resulta muy agotador pero aun así, durante unos meses, intente mantener la rutina de continuar mis streams de arte a pesar de llegar exhausta por el trabajo, en especial durante abril y mayo. Volvi al ejercicio dentro de los espacios que podía acomodar, porque empecé a sentir que la chamba de la limpieza me estaba destruyendo mi cuerpo, reduje los ejercicios de fuerza y empecé a enfocarme más en elongaciones y estiramientos. Siento como mis muñecas y mis hombros me duelen mucho.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 18.41.54.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/EpxrDKzvChYKGFNdDp2cngysA47m1HSXtp26coy2F7AW3feQ4ZxveWo8rzrJgQXPRbn.jpeg)
Este es el uniforme de limpieza, almenos me dieron uniforme esta vez.

Llegó el invierno, el frío calmó un poco los ánimos, pero en la chamba de la limpieza no me iba super bien. Realizaba mi trabajo con eficiencia y con la mejor actitud que podía, pero la señora que lleva el negocio es una persona grosera, maleducada e ingrata. En uno de los días de trabajo, llamó “*aumento*” a una esponja mallada atada a otra esponja de alambre y me dijo un “no limpias lo suficientemente bien los baños”. A lo mejor para ella habrá sido la mejor broma de su vida, pero para mi fue un insulto y una humillación que me va a costar perdonar (por no decir que no lo voy a hacer).
![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 18.41.54 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23xyfXTK5NJCjkidyDDYX6yKYHCBQuDHBGkidvYazWdvGFrfiz1ocvagfv3CX8b3WNvt8.jpeg)
el *aumento* equisde

Me volvieron a subir el alquiler, me volví a mudar (a otra habitación más barata), y por ahora, mis días los intento tomar con tranquilidad, sobreviviendo cada semana, sin hacer muchos planes a mediano - largo plazo. Intento cuidarme mi salud y no mucho más por ahora. Realmente en el trabajo me pagan poco, pero en las otras entrevistas de trabajo que he tenido me dejan en un “ya le llamaremos” que eso suele significar, “no quedaste, sigue intentando” como el mensaje que venía en la tapa de un sorteo de una botella de coca-cola.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23tmm5sZF34TeUsN7QRpumULD9EdQLsDgaTC1ewLShP7nyJqKaHx45Qv9eBsXsjezEoGc.png)
correo real de mi última entrevista, esta vez me avisaron. 😅
![90eb316573b81a6b2dc18e8b819def50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23tbwCY6CneQRWYMgaYwGpKrKvwHDGXDjFSZpFpK6bHhihJcxDrmQb6oyTEFurv5GjBYA.jpg)
fuente: [Pinterest-Henry Maxxwell](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/470274386097465708/)

Ahora mismo, estoy estudiando Aseguramiento de control de calidad (QA), yo ya tengo experiencia en eso pero en el ámbito de diseño gráfico y preprensa, ahora estoy intentando enfocarlo a software para ver si así consigo ese trabajo que me saque del laburo de la limpieza y en mis tiempo libre estudio dibujo (anatomía, composición, prácticas de color, y los fundamentos) y modelado 3D, que es un tema que me está gustando bastante.
![placticaa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23tc9xNaz1RqUYzE8NXG9ps9tRbspXvpMVnmq8Ruzaz4TKDBEn99ZcHbtu1KKwF8TEUqn.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23t7DYuFQqr1mHB8X5cveGTgPABrGG5oMwXpBaisGLLGqY8B9NdiGGkE1cAFLkuHttyjj.png)

Respecto a los streams, tengo planes de volver, porque si quiero seguir dibujando algunas de mis obras en vivo, pero mientras tenga trabajos bajo NDA y la chamba de la limpieza me deje exhausta, como que no se va a poder.
https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPWVjZjA1ZTQ3enlzZ3U3bDAxYXV5ZG1lNHAzeXc5M2FhZG8xajAxbTZ4cjcwbGVhNyZlcD12MV9naWZzX3NlYXJjaCZjdD1n/k5wm90xBWhBDGPxBC7/giphy.gif
fuente: [Giphy](giphy.com)

En mis últimas publicaciones, solía pasar mis textos por una IA para que corrigiese inconsistencias, tiempos gramaticales y ortografía, pero en estos tiempo de IA’s, creo que esta vez dejaré un espacio para la torpeza y textos crudos directamente desde mi voz interna (almenos la version en español, sorry, I'm too lazy to translate the whole thing in English!!). Y sin nada más que agregar, muchas gracias por haber leido hasta acá si hasta este punto y te tomaste un rato de leer mis pensamientos en voz alta; nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad 💖✨🌻.

🇺🇸 --ENG Ver.-- Good afternoon, everyone. I hope you’re having a peaceful day. A lot has happened since the last time I posted, and I wanted to take some time to look back at what has happened over the past few months, as a bit of introspection.
In March, I started working a cleaning job, for the second time. This job is very exhausting for me, but even so, for a few months I tried to keep up with my routine of continuing my art streams despite coming home exhausted from work, especially during April and May. I went back to exercising whenever I could fit it into my schedule, because I started feeling like the cleaning job was destroying my body. I reduced my strength training and started focusing more on mobility and stretching. I can really feel it in my wrists and shoulders; they hurt a lot.
Winter came, and the cold helped calm things down a little, but things weren’t going particularly well at the cleaning job. I did my work efficiently and with the best attitude I could, but the woman who runs the business is a rude, ill-mannered, and ungrateful person. One day at work, she called a mesh sponge tied to another wire sponge an “raise,” followed by a “you don’t clean the bathrooms well enough.” Maybe that was the funniest joke of her life, but to me it was an insult and a humiliation that I’m going to have a hard time forgiving (if I’m being honest, I probably won’t). My rent went up again, so I moved again, this time to another, cheaper room. For now, I’m trying to take my days calmly, surviving one week at a time without making too many medium- or long-term plans. I’m trying to take care of my health, and not much else for the time being.
The truth is, I’m paid very little at this job, but at the other job interviews I’ve had, I keep getting left with a “we’ll call you,” which usually means “you didn’t get the job, keep trying”—like the little message inside a bottle cap from a Coca-Cola sweepstakes. Right now, I’m studying Quality Assurance (QA). I already have experience in QA, but in the graphic design and prepress field. Now I’m trying to move that experience into software QA, hoping that I can land a job that gets me out of this cleaning gig. In my free time, I’m also studying drawing—anatomy, composition, color practice, and fundamentals—as well as 3D modeling, which is something I’m really enjoying.
As for the streams, I do plan to come back. I still want to draw some of my pieces live, but as long as I’m working on projects under NDA and the cleaning job leaves me completely exhausted, it doesn’t look like it’s going to be possible for now. And that’s about it. Thank you so much for reading this far. If you made it all the way here and took some time to read through all of this, thank you, and I’ll see you next time. 💖
![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/faffy/23tvcRP4i4gBkeiQbXYqS2TDkWvv6BbzqnQeUnJCpTdpZzM14CSSizKTsc2msjdcCWM6f.png)

body.title: EngineAI's multipurpose humanoid robot
body.body:
> The humanoid robot industry is beginning to diverge into distinct paths, and few companies illustrate this as clearly as China’s EngineAI; within just a few days, the company unveiled two completely different applications for its T800 humanoid robot. In one, it is shown working inside a factory, while in the other, it is seen battling other robots in a ring in the United States.


The first demonstration took place at a Luxshare-ICT factory in Suzhou, China. EngineAI released a video showing several T800 robots performing various industrial tasks within the facility. According to the video, the robots can receive work orders directly from an MIS (Management Information System) used to manage production processes; vision systems then identify the type and quantity of materials requiring handling. The robots use their arms to grasp and position these objects; the demonstration also shows the T800 transporting a load with a single arm, dynamically navigating around obstacles, and executing full-body movements to position containers stably.


The choice of Luxshare for this demonstration is significant. The company is a major Chinese electronics manufacturer and an Apple supplier. The presence of the T800 within one of its facilities highlights the manufacturer's intent to transition the robot from demonstrations to industrial applications, though the video also raises some questions. The presentation is highly produced and edited; while EngineAI maintains on-screen indicators stating that the scenes were filmed on-site, this follows earlier demonstrations by the company that sparked doubts regarding the potential use of computer-generated imagery.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XtggY9LRISw
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> On that occasion, EngineAI even released behind-the-scenes footage to demonstrate that the T800's movements were genuine; however, the editing of the new demonstration makes it difficult to determine the extent to which the robot can autonomously perform these tasks when facing unplanned situations—a contrast that becomes even more striking when considering events from just a few days earlier. On August 15, the T800 made its physical debut in the United States at the RCT, a humanoid robot combat event held in San Francisco; in that instance, the T800 units were operated by human pilots and pitted against one another in matches broadcast online.


The tournament concluded with a victory for Japanese pilot Hiroyuki Oxonic; these two applications are part of a strategy EngineAI is developing for the robot. According to the company, the physical demands of combat serve to test characteristics such as structural durability, dynamic balance, and joint torque. The T800 has an announced starting price of approximately $25,000, and the company states it is working toward a production capacity in the range of tens of thousands of units.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence

links.title: [Movie] ENDER'S GAME
links.body:
Honestly... this movie made me think a lot more than I expected..

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVFAkfmczs9EbzdbGQVNL7sVQgD8EspZgSdPuZFcUtg1M/img_20260830_202003.jpg)

At first, I thought I was just getting another sci-fi movie about kids in space fighting aliens... You know, spaceships, lasers, military uniforms, big explosions... the usual stuff but the more I watched, the more I realized that the actual story is much darker than it looks....

The movie follows a young boy named Ender Wiggin, played by Asa Butterfield, who is recruited by the military because he's incredibly intelligent and has a natural ability to understand strategy and leadership...

Humanity is preparing for another possible attack from an alien species called the Formics, after a previous invasion almost destroyed Earth...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdmbitAFR8wwqadFriiq2wXCZNgiVwjA7yjJNhBEt1ALN/img_20260830_202102.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsi2zk9tqK8uWEJzyjxTLZWCGt6sbppuwj7WJgx3bcgY/img_20260830_202140.jpg)

So instead of waiting for the next attack, the military starts training children to become soldiers and commanders and Ender turns out to be exactly what they're looking for...

Ender isn't the biggest kid neither is He the strongest but he's actually pretty quiet and doesn't really seem like someone who belongs in a military academy and he's extremely intelligent... 

He studies people, He understands their weaknesses, He learns quickly and most importantly, he can think about a situation from somebody else's point of view...

The problem is that the military doesn't just want him to learn how to win battles.... They want to turn him into someone who can destroy an enemy without hesitation and honestly, that part made me uncomfortable because Ender is still a child...


He's being pushed through simulations, competitions and increasingly difficult situations, while the adults around him keep telling themselves that everything they're doing is necessary to protect humanity...

The movie does a good job of making you question whether Ender is actually becoming a great leader or whether they're slowly taking away the part of him that makes him human and Asa Butterfield actually does a pretty good job with that...

His performance is quiet, but you can see Ender changing as the story progresses...

At the beginning, he's just a smart kid trying to survive, Later, he's becoming someone capable of making incredibly difficult decisions but he doesn't completely lose his compassion...

That's probably what makes him such an interesting character..

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZckmzfhpEaTbBtYfUPM7QgKjH3UhdeqWJACttp5vQaDd/img_20260830_202123.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW8Ey12MPvUnunHwyTbhfvp4RWmTHnhkKZh9Z7Qn5C1rC/img_20260830_202256.jpg)

Then there's Colonel Graff, played by Harrison Ford... He is basically the man responsible for turning Ender into the weapon they need and I had a love-hate relationship with him...

You can understand why he does what he does, but some of his methods are honestly disturbing...

He constantly pushes Ender beyond what any normal child should have to experience and then there's Mazer Rackham, played by Ben Kingsley, who becomes another important figure in Ender's training..

The movie also has some really cool visuals..

The battle school sequences are probably my favorite..

Watching these kids float around in zero gravity while fighting each other in these massive training rooms was genuinely fun to watch..

The tactical games are also interesting because Ender isn't just shooting at things.
He's thinking.
He's adapting.
He's figuring out how to win when the rules aren't necessarily fair and I think that's what makes the movie stand out...

It's not really about having the biggest weapon, it's about understanding the person you're fighting but that's also where the movie gets really dark because Ender eventually learns something about the war that completely changes how you look at everything that happened before....

I won't spoil it if you've never seen it, but when the truth finally comes out, I honestly felt bad for him...

The kid thought he was playing a game but the adults knew exactly what was happening and that difference is basically the heart of the movie..

The movie does have some problems though.. I think it moves too quickly sometimes..There are a lot of ideas here that could have been explored much more deeply, especially Ender's relationship with his siblings, the morality of using children in war and the actual motivations of the Formics...

Some of the supporting characters also don't get enough development and while the action is good, I sometimes felt like the movie was rushing toward the next big event instead of allowing certain emotional moments to breathe but despite that, I enjoyed it...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ7AE4GkKki6vXMALXiKt4mhFyNHMjyq85NBHDonoVEnn/img_20260830_202045.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVozVgAAKmPA55fk4rg3HuC54YRamRpSHFQupTbvDGQj6/img_20260830_202231.jpg)

What really stayed with me wasn't the aliens or the spaceships... It was the question behind everything.. 
If you teach a child to win a war at any cost, what happens when they finally realize what winning actually means?

That's a pretty heavy question for what initially looks like a simple sci-fi adventure and honestly, I think that's why Ender's Game has stuck with me...
It's not really a movie about fighting aliens.

<sub>[image Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1731141/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_3_nm_5_in_0_q_ender)<sub>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVPJpkfrMGrWVz94MGvnt6TBC2Fpems2Y8LHiURkmGTyq/img20260421_wa0000.jpg)

_Rating: **80/100**_

links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUfMbuBiFnMFxEcHZwvcHfGjh9orUa15Czb6ZKTeBVzsM/1788127761492.jpg)
[Picture Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/fountain-pen-LxphooAHzvc)

Clara had an ugly incident while going to bank on a busy Monday morning. While she was at the bus stop she flagged down a csb and wanted to board it only for one man to appear from nowhere and took her place. She was rushing to cash a cheque at the bank and return to the office.

But the man had to thwart that plan by elongating her stay at the bus stop. When she finally got another cab after over forty-five minutes, she prayed for a decongested road leading to the bank. That too turned out to be the opposite. She was held up in the traffic for close to an hour. Her time was being spent the way she never planned.

When she finally got to thr bank she went straight to the cashier and placed her cheque for clearance. The cashier gracefully took it and ran a quick check on it. 

\

. 

Clara was surprised that she didn't remember to date the cheque. She searched endlessly for a pen on her handbag but could not find any. When she turned round in the banking hall to see if she'll use another person's pen to sign. She saw the man who had bypassed her to the cab at the bus stop. The man was also looking at her and realized that Clara was looking for a pen.

body.title: ⚖️ Maybe I Can See Her Now
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW1PvVTnWgXzWtEDwBTmRgKwRk3mvscRDtgyeJRZ3M5VY/IMG_2071.jpg 

Looking at this photo, I had a funny thought… I actually look a little like the lawyer I want to become someday. 😅

Okay, maybe the leather jacket isn't exactly courtroom attire, but there's something about this picture that makes me feel confident.

For a long time, becoming a lawyer has felt like this huge dream somewhere far in the distance. I know I still have a lot to overcome before I can afford university, and sometimes thinking about all of it at once is overwhelming.

So I'm trying to focus on smaller things.

Keep creating. Keep learning. Keep believing that what I'm doing today can eventually help me pay for the education I want.

I don't know exactly how I'll get there yet, but I know where I want to go.

body.title: The price of silence.
body.body:
![IMG-20260830-WA9135.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZNfNWQL3QgCu2j96ML1XAYTBiX1czPwJieffNe2Je6yu/IMG-20260830-WA9135.jpg)

The envelope sat on the small wooden dining table like a ticking bomb. It was brown, thick, and had the official stamp of the city hospital  written on the front. John did not need to open it to know what was inside. It was the final bill for his mother’s surgery, and the total amount would be more than everything he had saved in his entire life.

  John sat down heavily on a plastic chair. He covered his face with his hands. He was only thirty-four years old, but his shoulders felt like they were carrying the weight of his whole village. His mother, Magdalene, was sleeping in the tiny bedroom down the hall. The sound of her soft,  wheezing and stridor was the only noise in the quiet house. She was getting better, yes, but the cost of keeping her alive was about to destroy them.

 \

John whispered to the empty room. 

 His phone rang on the table. The screen lit up with a text message from his boss, Mr. Joe.

 *“john, come to the office tomorrow at 7:00 AM. Before the other workers arrive. We need to talk about the missing money from the vault.*

 ”john’s heart dropped into his stomach. His hands started to shake. He did not steal any money. He was just the night shift supervisor at the big grocery warehouse. But he knew exactly who took it. It was Sam, Mr. Joe’s own son. Sam was a wild young man who owed money to some very bad people in the city. Two nights ago, john had walked into the back office and seen Sam stuffing bundles of cash into his jacket.

 Sam had just frozen seeing joe, looking like a caught rat. Then, he had walked over to joe, placed a heavy hand on his shoulder, and spoken in a low, dangerous voice.

 \

Joe had stayed silent. He needed the job to pay for his mother’s medicine. But now, it looked like Samuel was setting him up anyway. If Mr. Collins blamed him tomorrow, David would not just lose his job; he would go to prison for sure. And if he went to prison, his mother would have no one to take care of her and her medical bills.

 He did not sleep that night. He watched the clock turn from 2:00 AM to 5:00 AM thinking.

 At 6:30 AM, David walked out of his house. The morning air was biting cold, and the sky was a somehow, dark grey. He walked the three miles to the warehouse because he could not even afford the bus fare that morning. Every step felt like he was walking toward his own execution.

 When he arrived, the massive warehouse was dark and empty, except for the lights shining in Mr. Joe’s main office upstairs. John walked up the metal stairs, his boots making a loud echoing sound.

 He knocked on the glass door.\

Mr. Joe called out. His voice sounded incredibly tired.

 John walked in and stood by the desk. Mr. Joe looked up. He had deep black circles under his eyes, and a ledger book was open in front of him on the take.

 \
the older man said, pointing to a chair.David sat. He squeezed his hands into tight fists inside his pockets to hide the shaking.\n\n* \
Mr. Joe said directly, leaning forward. \

The truth was right there, sitting on the tip of john's mouth. All he had to do was say Sam's name. But then he remembered Samuel’s warning. He pictured the police arriving at his house, his mother crying as they put handcuffs on him.\n\n I don't know, sir,  John lied, his voice cracking. \

Did the thief confess yet?

 Mr. Joe rubbed his cheek. Not yet, Sam. 

 John says he was at the loading docks.

 Of course he would say that,\
Can you check the logbook for the main entrance from Thursday night?\n\n \
Dad, don't listen to him. He's just trying to confuse you.\
Go to the car right now!\
I am so sorry, David. I almost did a horrible thing to you.\

body.title: [Movie] The Last Sunrise. 2026.
body.body: > The Last Sunrise Is One of those movies where pretty visuals could have just carried it alone with nothing underneath of them, but also it had a story that went great with the visuals, which is why I had the experience that I wanted from it and not just a pretty-looking film with nothing underneath. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQySxqKQNhNTttz1YYyoHhtpiCzCD6UxnKekXvpvwjAN3/1788127303578.jpg) The story follows the journey of a Ry, a college student who suffers from a chronic illness, but travels to Mallorca with her mother, Isolde, who's a little too clingy for her own good, the kind of mother who's afraid of losing her daughter, while they are there, Ry finds herself falling for this local guy Julián who somehow manages to get her outside of her shell and make her realize what it feels like to live in the moment and forget to race for the worst, and all the romance of course, is undercut by a whole host of family secrets that are being revealed along the way, and things start to fall into place, just at the moment they begin to feel good for once. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSFN6v3cZEP4rhMv7y46tHD63NHXDdAze6mPBbExSjHz1/1788127280764.jpg) I have to say the thing that got me the most and that's what I said at the beginning, the display and the colour in this movie, Mallorca as a setting , was beautiful enough to be on its own but there were so many sunset scenes in particular, and there were a lot in this film, that felt deliberate, like they were going somewhere and they were commenting on what Ry was feeling at that moment in the story. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYed7eTNUpDmAwJNW9QAmrqcP99iFofUgJKQidEsTseSf/1788127313684.jpg) The love-interest thing that takes a long time to build up to an emotional climax, the family secret, the health issues, the predictable story beats, a lot of people who have seen this movie are looking at that and saying , “Yeah, it's a predictable story, .” In this movie, color is not a fad, it's a character, it's a prologue, it is an entire character speaking to you before you even hear its voice. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZwTT2aTLvAA571VJEocd8Z4Yjp3U98oXomgfBhZZBTfa/1788127272616.jpg) The story itself still worked for me too though, not just the visuals, When Ry decides to live her life because she may have only this one shot at it, that was the theme I felt on film, no matter how many versions there were before, when you just see someone struggle between protecting their child and letting them really live their life, that's always a genuine fear, whether the movie is more action-packed, more dramatic, or not. Julián's chemistry with Ry was enough to make the romance feel like something believable as well, albeit sometimes the romance movie tropes they used were familiar; but the bottom line is that the chemistry and emotions that underpinned the romance was solid enough to hold me, even if it was using some kind of scenes that I had seen before. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUf8CXmwNdactcxdH9DAWxCKrSTUfNr5DHXSELXNTzB2F/1788127264416.jpg) Overall, yes, I liked this one, the visuals were great, really made it feel like it was a place worth falling in love in, and the story, despite being a predictable one – still did something to my heart where it needed to be. ***[IMDB](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt37654096/mediaviewer/rm3755130882/)*** *** --- ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png) _Rating: **95/100**_ --- _Originally posted through [scrobble.life/movies](https://scrobble.life/review/treasuree/the-last-sunrise-2026-mtgczd5e)._

body.title: [Movie] Seven Doors - A Trap On The Throne
body.body:
![1000952853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23wMaBsGdUysSmTPVzdSZoG5dWoPqCbcneTtk5HzkERzcfiuvov99WgSQfJm5yxRNhw2J.jpg)

Seven doors is a movie that keeps your toes standing in reflecting on how far you could possibly suffer for what you've not done or even know how it came about to be done. Like you're even unaware of the time the offense was committed and you're actually meant to pay for those sins just because you came from the bloodline.

Seven doors is a story about a man who happily lives in Lagos with his wife and kids until he was called by the family to be crowned as the appointed king by the oracle (oracle is an ancestral way of seeking answers to questions traditionally). If only he had knew, he would have refused bluntly, not taking up the position to be crowned as king as implored by his darling wife. An opinion the wife also eventually regret insisting for her husband to take.

![1000952852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23tvYGorgMWWXjMFc22AaHu2Y3G4KLw3JYRpWooKvFwKsVKzZbA6baWbKwETJR8tM6i9f.jpg)

Not long after his coronation, his family was the first target to be eliminated, from the first child dieing, and the king instructed to take on 6 other wives if his life will actually be at peace and save his home. A family that was supposed to be a nuclear family ended up been a polygamous family and not even that it became a polygamous home alone but because the problems the kings family still keeps showing up as his second child and the heir to the throne was at the edge of losing his life as well and must be saved before crossing the last line to death.

What could actually be the solution to the problem on ground kept the king going until he had the knowledge that the oracle actually lured him to the throne so that he could atone for the sins of his great grandfather. Wow!
Dieing could simply means the end of the road so he would rather walk of the palace naked in the sight of all palace workers, chiefs, dignitaries and citizens until the wife came in to intervene. How depressing it was!

![1000952851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AKHzMqHRZDEcWhBWvZLNLtW7r3X1BDa5V5nou8eyU1bBS8gV59YonV97hpDPq5n.jpg)

If he's going to make it out alive depends on courageous he is, and on his fate. Will he actually fight the war successfully as he's not battling with just a mere man like him but against ancestral deities? And is that really the final solution to his problems? Is it a crime to decide to serve your fatherland and why must an offspring suffer for the sins of their forefathers? Those are the questions that answers can only be gotten from the movie.

It's a production well recognized and got several awards by the casts and crews which showed that they really did a lot in the movie. The graphics were dope, scenes were so real that it gets you so emotional to tears if you're not so strong in holding back. The plot of the movie was not lost at any point and all cast and crew did a very well amazing job.

It's a movie worth watching if you're yet to and I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the movie review

Thanks for reading through 🤗 

All images are from the Movie

_Rating: **91/100**_

---

body.title: PEACEFUL RECREATION // Exploring the Natural Beauty of a Peaceful Recreational Place in Bireuen City
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️ ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMryof8jVwRo7NT1E8abYLBbUTuMVkf7e65du7sXP4ir/1788092179276.jpg) A very extraordinary experience happened when several of my friends and I visited a natural recreational place located in Bireuen City, namely “Paya Kareung.” This is not a popular tourist destination, but I believe almost 70% of the people in Bireuen must know about this place. Besides being a recreational place, around this area there are also many facilities and sports fields such as a football field, volleyball court, and even a running track. This place is also rich in natural beauty. Here, we do not need a roof for shelter because there are so many large trees that have become natural shelters. The beautiful scenery can even be seen directly as soon as we arrive at this place. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQvSXanVTFuuoGWoiVsg5e3PVxX3syca1wY4o7dJSzgR/1788092179344.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpvdEWuc8RUW8jtT1fMoaLKMeUWMWqxoG7wYtq65GAHk/1788092179480.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSSZUdLeJ6Qe8eSYoFxukC6bQkaCAq2jcmSGEArnGAvrh/1788092179638.jpg) The main color in this place is green, which indicates how natural this place is. Along the roadside, we can already find so many rain trees growing on both sides of the road. These trees not only provide a shaded area and natural shelter, but also make the scenery an incredibly beautiful natural landscape. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV6G98QKT5M8DfrqsuEuiShZ8VPPsk6SwXoqphQU6qbho/1788092179796.jpg) Along the roadside, we can also find several food stalls that provide various local specialties, so we do not need to worry about coming to this place if we forget to bring equipment or supplies. This is only the scenery in the main area, and now, let’s explore this place even further. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX4gg4DM8ABxqMwVpkXmTqq7pFdDpfgGPVrRSMLH7CeXy/1788092189546.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP1Cx4jz4kSzSEo1JGRc7o8y4WoYhh1CmoJi9hdaobLLU/1788092189694.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme51S1tVHb4st5Ddn2qmBrfomTRaR2Fc3k8FAF3cc42N7/1788092189859.jpg) And finally, I arrived at the main point, which is the recreational area located in front of a large swamp, or more commonly known as Paya Kareung. In this place, we can find so many huts neatly lined up along the edge of the swamp, facing towards the swamp, so we can sit and relax while enjoying the incredibly beautiful natural scenery. From several pictures that I have shared, we can already conclude that this place is very peaceful and incredibly quiet, with a cool atmosphere combined with the refreshing breeze that continuously blows against our bodies. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJWrwdmyTzULjUNyGwdAE5eDZ1zGMrPxEW5LbVEzRS2S/1788092190004.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyE2Pb5zvWrSC6StB3y1DtCTr4SCVPnzbBD6g3EruRci/1788092204631.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVqraWvSv3cuGy9YtVWXH8J97JQcspnkMmu4LXu1PcVaj/1788092190134.jpg) Just like most other tourist attractions or recreational places in Aceh, this place will also be crowded with visitors in the afternoon, and that is a very normal thing. While I was sitting and relaxing, I suddenly realized that from this place, I could see the beautiful view of the tall buildings in Bireuen City. The natural scenery is incredibly beautiful, and green is its main color. However, it is very unfortunate that the swamp has already been filled with water hyacinth plants. The good news is that these plants can become nests and shelters for fish and other aquatic creatures, but their uncontrolled population has made them a bad thing, such as causing water blockages and reducing the oxygen levels in the water. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYHrCPZsUyhDSovvfjBeSSGAhQxtDXak5EeNjGs2WKBV8/1788092204345.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSerJyBLbfhvdDuNUz7nCvEPYvknEB7g7seoK7f6idwEs/1788092204496.jpg) In my personal opinion, this is one of the most amazing recreational places in Bireuen City because it has such beautiful scenery and a natural atmosphere that is incredibly calming, and it is highly recommended to visit. And the good news is that this place also provides various sports facilities, so there are so many fun things that we can do here. Thank you very much. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

body.body: ![Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Cop (8).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yonilkar/23tGVUnqfk5gGiJnTPAVKeRHTsVegr2qdfdtCXq4Akc6Q7c6Xkd2EHxVPQmqEKXzEyLuD.gif) Hello to the entire gaming community! This time, we’re featuring a special card that’s surprisingly useful, as it’s a dual-element battle card. This makes it quite effective in certain battle situations, thanks to its impressive combination of abilities, which gives us a definite advantage. And since it’s a promotional card, it’s even more special—something to keep in mind when deciding whether to include it in battle. I think this is a pretty powerful card, considering that not only can it be used with two elements, but those two elements are Water and Death, giving us a certain advantage in battle. Asking for 10 Sisters is, I believe, more than justified, since the card itself has a surprising combination of abilities that make it more than powerful enough to consider—it’s practically a kind of legendary legacy without quite reaching that level. This makes this card not only worth considering but also of the utmost importance to our team. https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/promo/Warborn%20Shaman_lv8.png I really like that the combination of these abilities works in a surprising way: at first, we have a shield that protects against magical attacks, giving us a certain advantage thanks to its 4-point shield. If we could boost that shield a little more with the occasional card, it would provide our group with a rather surprising variable. It’s worth noting that when this isn’t the case—and we don’t have that advantage—we also have to take into account that this is a magical attack, which gives us a certain advantage. What surprises me most about this card is that it can initiate an attack before the round begins, giving us a certain advantage. As a result, we have a chance to poison the enemy—the way the poison can be applied each round allows us to weaken them as we advance. Finally, we have a healing ability, which is quite rare or unusual for this type of card, since these cards are primarily focused on strategic attack, , giving us a certain advantage—which makes it seem unusual for it to have these kinds of healing abilities, but quite useful for our team. You could say this card has dual functionality, since, as a medium-speed card, it can be used or not depending on the circumstances, meaning it’s not limited to a single purpose but helps in different ways so our team can advance in a manner that’s most beneficial to us. ###### |Pictures / Imagenes | [Canva ](https://www.canva.com/design/DAG9dyg2fcs/c6cRrS8tMremp9Qn9dcc_Q/edit)| ) |https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/social_telegram.svg[Telegram](https://t.me/splinterlandsES)|https://steemitimages.com/300x300/https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yonilkar/AK6X3dCx5ibs1GjniiWMffosYAYWnmZ6taCK1dLwBR3NmMMtsXtvYXH5ETFwqjX.jpg|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/social_discord.svg[Discord](https://discord.gg/sCHsBvfb)| |-|-|-| [Welcome to Splinterlands, where fast-paced card battles meet deep strategy, rich lore, and true ownership. body.title: Learn Zig Series (#154) - Mini Project: Regex Engine - NFA
body.body:
without a magic sentinel value, and how error unions carry parse failures back to the caller;
- How to preallocate the NFA in a single arena slice because Thompson's construction has a _known_ upper bound on state count;
- How to test a machine you cannot yet run, using an epsilon-closure walk to prove structural claims;
- Why this NFA _cannot_ suffer the catastrophic backtracking that takes down naive regex engines, and how C, Rust and Go each build the same thing.

### Requirements
- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- An installed Zig 0.14+ distribution (download from ziglang.org) -- the code here is written and tested against Zig 0.16;
- Tagged unions from episode 6, allocators (the arena) from episode 7, and the recursive-descent parsing we did back in episodes 131 and 132 -- we lean on all three today;
- The regex theory from episodes 141 to 143 is helpful background, but this mini project is self-contained and builds everything from scratch;
- The ambition to learn Zig programming.

### Difficulty
- Advanced

# Learn Zig Series (#154) - Mini Project: Regex Engine - NFA

We closed the Lisp project last episode with a promise: turn away from parsing and evaluating for a while, and point ourselves back at the machine -- the kind of from-scratch engine work where you build one data structure that does one focused thing, and does it fast. A regular expression engine is exactly that. Almost every program you use runs regexes constantly -- your editor's find box, `grep`, the input validation on a signup form, the lexer of every compiler -- and yet most working programmers treat the regex engine as a magic black box. Over the next two episodes we are going to open the box and build one, and by the end you will understand not only how it works but _why_ the good ones cannot be tricked into hanging for thirty seconds on a fourty-character pattern. That last part is not a footnote; it is the whole reason to do it the way we are about to.

Here is the single idea that organises everything. A regex engine is _two_ machines stacked. The first is a **parser** that reads the pattern -- a flat string of characters like `a(b|c)*d` where some characters are literals and some are operators -- and produces a tree that captures the structure the flat string only implied. The second is a **compiler** that walks that tree and builds a **state machine**, a little graph of states and transitions that, when you feed it text, either accepts or rejects. Today we build both of those halves and stop just short of running the machine; next episode we feed it input and watch it match. Splitting the work this way is not busywork -- it is the same parse-then-compile shape we used for the calculator (episodes 146 to 149) and the Lisp (150 to 153), and seeing it a third time in a completely different domain is exactly how the pattern sinks in. Here we go!

## The shape of the problem: string in, machine out

Let us be precise about the little language we are going to support, because a regex dialect is itself a small language with a grammar. We support: **literal characters** (`a` matches an `a`), the **wildcard** `.` (matches any single character), **grouping** with parentheses, **alternation** `a|b` (match `a` _or_ `b`), and the three **repetition** operators -- `*` (zero or more), `+` (one or more) and `?` (zero or one). That is a genuinely useful subset; it is enough to write `(ab)*` or `a.c` or `gr(a|e)y`. What it deliberately leaves out -- character classes like `[a-z]`, anchors, backreferences -- we can layer on later, but this core is where all the interesting machinery lives.

The reason we need a tree and not just the string is **precedence**. In `ab|c`, does the `|` split `b` and `c`, or `ab` and `c`? Regex convention (and ours) says repetition binds tightest, then concatenation, then alternation binds loosest -- so `ab|c` means `(ab)|(c)`, not `a(b|c)`... wait, no, it means \

. The flat string cannot express that grouping; a tree can. So our first job is to turn the string into an **abstract syntax tree**, and in Zig the natural home for an AST node is a tagged union:

```zig
const std = @import(\

is a first-class value (`null`), not some sentinel byte we have to remember never appears in a real pattern. That `orelse break` idiom shows up all over the parser: try to read a character, and if there is none, stop. `parseAlt` reads one concatenation, then keeps swallowing `| concat` as long as it sees a pipe, folding each into a left-leaning `alt` node. Concatenation is the next level down, and it is subtle in one nice way -- there is no operator character for \

), and some are **epsilon transitions**, labelled with nothing at all -- you may follow them for free, consuming no input. Those free edges are the entire reason the construction is so clean, and they are worth understanding before we build anything.\n\nThe problem with wiring an NFA directly is that when you glue two pieces together -- say the machine for `a` followed by the machine for `b` -- you need the \
of the first to become the \

-- a regex like `(a+)+b` that takes _exponential_ time on an input of a's followed by no b, hanging a server on a forty-character string. That disaster is a property of **backtracking** engines (the kind in Perl, Python's `re`, JavaScript, PCRE), which try one path, and when it fails, back up and try another, and on a pathological pattern the number of paths explodes. Our NFA has a completely different performance character. When we simulate it next episode, we will track the _set_ of states the machine could be in, all at once, advancing every state by one input character in lockstep. There are at most `2n` states for a pattern of length `n`, so the state set can never be bigger than that, and each input character does at most `O(n)` work. Total: `O(n * m)` for a pattern of length `n` and text of length `m` -- linear in the text, always, with no pathological input. Thompson's 1968 construction plus set-based simulation is _immune_ to the backtracking blow-up by design. The preallocated `[]State`, the `u32` indices instead of chased pointers, the cache-friendly flat array -- those are the constant-factor speedups; the guaranteed linear time is the algorithmic one, and it is the difference between an engine you can safely run on untrusted input and one you cannot.

## The same machine in C, Rust and Go

Building this makes you see other engines' choices clearly. **C** is where Thompson's construction was born, and the canonical modern writeup is Russ Cox's regex series, whose C implementation uses exactly this shape -- `State` structs with an `out` and `out1` pointer, epsilon edges as states with a special `Split` opcode. The difference from ours is memory management: Cox's C code hands you raw `malloc`'d states and a manual free, and the \

patching is done with pointer-to-pointer lists because C has no arena to lean on. Our arena erases that whole category of bookkeeping. **Go**'s standard `regexp` package is the production heir to that lineage -- Russ Cox wrote it too -- and it guarantees the same linear-time worst case precisely because it refuses to backtrack; when you use Go's regexp you are running an industrial-strength version of what we just built, which is why Go is a safe choice for regexes over user input. **Rust**'s `regex` crate is arguably the fastest of all, and it is the same core idea taken further: it compiles to an NFA, then often to a DFA (the subject of episode 142), and adds SIMD-accelerated literal prefiltering -- but it, too, stakes its reputation on _never_ exhibiting catastrophic backtracking, and its author (Andrew Gallant) has written at length defending that guarantee. Zig sits comfortably in this company: our tagged-union AST, our `?Symbol` optionals and our arena give us the same clarity as the C original with far less manual memory choreography, and nothing about the design gives up the linear-time promise.

## Where we go next

Step back and look at what we have. A recursive-descent parser turns `a(b|c)*d` into a tree; Thompson's construction walks that tree and wires up an NFA of states and epsilon edges, allocated in a single arena slice whose size we could _prove_ in advance; and an epsilon-closure walk already lets us test structural truths about the machine before it can run a single match. Every operator -- concat, alternation, and the three repetitions -- turned out to be a handful of free edges and at most two new states, which is why the construction is short enough to hold in your head. That is a real, non-trivial engine, and we built it from nothing.

What is missing is the fun part: actually running it. Next time we take an input string and this NFA and simulate the machine -- tracking that set of simultaneously-active states, advancing them character by character using the very `epsAdd` closure we wrote for testing today, and reporting a match when an accept state is live. That is where the linear-time guarantee stops being a promise and starts being code you can benchmark against a pathological input that would hang a backtracking engine for a minute. Bring the epsilon-closure idea with you -- it is the whole game. That is the machine built; next time we make it run. Thanks for reading, and I will see you in the next one! ;-)

body.title: My pick: A Gift, A New Card and Another Victory in Splinterlands
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWuJDiZPRwvqKs3HVHcWrgMAvZFjNENuCyxEVEFaBsRjk/1788126237070.png)

Hello everyone, how is your Splinterlands matches been going? Here to share my **Frontier Ranked** battle with everyone. This time something interesting happened before my battle. I received a gift from **@iblast**, and the gift was **Jolius Blast**. Their name matches a lot, I didn't know why I received this gift but I'm grateful for it because I've always wanted a card with higher HP and finally I have got it. Thank you very much for this precious gift.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQwL9QU7QXEB1SZ5spQ9EYZFcSe3f3vCtX52ovCmPR5j/1788126636140.jpg)

I was really happy to receive this card because I don't know how to use Jolius Blast in battles because it's my first time having it. So after getting the gift, I thought I will play with it whenever I will get the chance to see how good it can perform.

After losing battle I got into another match where it's **28 Mana** and I have to use my **Fire** team. Before I didn't know I could use my new card in fire time so I was happy because fire element is my favourite element. I was excited to see if this new card could help me get  victory.

## Match details

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcdhTR51r1C2NMXoYq95XoCTi8tq8AXQArrudgYxwQjFb/1788126362095.jpg)

Mana: 28
Elements: Fire (only)
Ruleset: Maneuvers, Weak Magic

**Maneuvers:** All units have Reach (can use melee attacks from the second position).

**Weak Magic:** All units gain Void Armor (Magic damage hits armor before reducing health).

## My Team

With **28 Mana** available, I decided to make a team where I could finally use my new **Jolius Blast**.

For the summoner, I chose **Barthalamas**. I have been using Barthalamas quite often because I really like the extra speed he gives to my team. I thought the speed boost could be useful again in this match.

Here was my lineup:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3cqwD22wCgh3TAEYm3aDG2t6m3YU7ENKnEayFESgS3s/1788126466069.jpg)

**Summoner**
Barthalamas

1st Position – Jolius Blast (lv.1)

2nd Position – Vengeful Monk (lv.1)

## My Team

I placed Jolius Blast in the first position because I wanted him to lead the battle and take advantage of his strength from the start.

Behind him, I placed Vengeful Monk. The Maneuvers ruleset made this a good choice because melee units could still attack from the second position, so Vengeful Monk could keep helping while staying behind my frontline.

## How the Battle Went

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV2JRpXponS3zGSbpKyaLiazArXXd2yrseTiQQkT4kmAp/1788126483713.jpg)

My enemy was SHEEPKING, and they were also using the Fire element with Barthalamas as their summoner.

Honestly, it looked like an interesting battle because both of us were using the same summoner. The speed boost was helping both teams, so I knew the attacks were going to come quickly.

The battle started, and Jolius Blast was the card I kept watching the most.

The Maneuvers ruleset was helping because Vengeful Monk because it  could attack from the second position instead of waiting for the frontline to fall. So, my decision was good to choose him for the second spot.

The Weak Magic ruleset made things a little different too. Since every unit had Void Armor, magic damage had to break the armor first before reaching health.

The rounds were intense to me as both teams kept attacking each other. My enemy had a decent team, but my team was on the side of getting the better advantages.

Jolius Blast stayed in the fight while Vengeful Monk kept supporting from behind and slowly the enemy team started getting weaker.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXnSF1aW8pVd6hr4i6gijAsHqQSvqCNViFjHuhmbaxp9Q/1788126593335.jpg)

I'm  glad my team was able to end the battle with a VICTORY. Because of the new card the excitement was double.

I think when someone wins a game it always feels good. But if you never have played games then you won't understand this feeling of winning with a gifted card.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSn6mZNotE84FcV1sxz6zC8gswepoZYSdadwRpy6rMEsg/1788126830171.jpg)

The victory, helped me to gain +20 rating, which I had lost in previous match and my ratings got 1400 again before the season ends in Silver II. I still had some energy left but I didn't have energy in real life to play a few more my matches.

## Looking Ahead

This was another enjoyable Frontier Ranked battle for me. Getting a gift from iblast and then using Jolius Blast in my very next match made this battle feel a little more special.

With only Jolius Blast and Vengeful Monk in my lineup, I was able to make good use of the Maneuvers ruleset, and the battle ended with a nice victory.

Now I'm going to keep trying my luck in more ranked battles and hopefully push my rating even higher this season. I'm also looking forward to using Jolius Blast in more matches because this was a really fun first battle with him.

Thank you all for taking the time to read my battle report.

Have you ever received a card as a gift and used it immediately in your next battle? And what do you think about Jolius Blast in the Maneuvers ruleset? Let me know in the comments below.

---

Splinterlands game can be played on both mobile and PC. If you want to play, join through my referral link click [here](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rayhanhiveman).

body.title: It's all about distractions./ Monomad Challenge [Eng/Esp]
body.body: > There are many distractions that steal my attention, and I struggle to take the photos I have in mind when I leave home; some—or, I think, most—are beyond my control, so all I can do is accept reality and, within that framework, impose my photographic vision and interpretation of reality.

> Son muchas las distracciones que roban la atención y me cuesta hacer las fotos que traigo en mente al salir de mi casa; algunas, o creo la mayoría, no dependen de mi poder cambiarlas, así que solo resta asumir la realidad y sobre eso imponer mi visión fotográfica e interpretación de la realidad. ![1000550840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000550840.jpg)

• • •
![1000550839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000550839.jpg)

> I prepare in advance: water for the heat, a hat for the strong sun—or rather, a disguise, because I cover up so much that sometimes I’m unrecognizable. And as I go, I keep shooting; here, you have to do it this way—otherwise, it would be very difficult.

> Yo me preparo de antemano: el agua para el calor, sombrero para el sol fuerte, o más bien un disfraz porque me tapo tanto que a veces soy irreconocible. Y en el proceso voy disparando; aquí hay que hacerlo así, de otra forma sería muy difícil. ![1000550838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000550838.jpg)

• • •
![1000550837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000550837.jpg)

> I was telling my friend @rg2-foto that I already have a sort of spiritual connection with my camera; the idea pops into my head, and the connection with the equipment is immediately established, as if we were connected via Bluetooth.

> Le decía a mi amigo @rg2-foto que ya tengo una especie de conexión espiritual con mi cámara; la idea viene a mi cabeza y ya la conexión se establece con el equipo, como si estuviéramos conectados por Bluetooth. ![1000550836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000550836.jpg)
> Sometimes, halfway through, I suddenly lose the desire to take photos, and that’s okay—but curiously, it’s precisely in that moment that my best images come out; it’s a mystery.

> Igual que de pronto a medio camino se me quitan las ganas de hacer fotos, y no pasa nada, lo que curiosamente es en ese instante donde me salen las mejores imágenes, un misterio. ![1000550842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000550842.jpg)
> What I can assure you is that everything is done with passion, goodwill, and the desire to share my work with the community. To all of you, thank you so much 😊.

> Lo que sí les puedo asegurar es que todo es hecho con pasión, buena voluntad y el deseo de compartir mi trabajo con la comunidad. A ustedes, mil gracias 😊.
Official entry for the #monomad challenge hosted by @monochromes and @brumest
◈ ◈ ◈

CONNECT WITH ME

> TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
Camera: Nikon D200 | Lenses: AF-S NIKKOR 18-70mm & ED 70-300mm
Post-processing: Adobe Lightroom & DxO PureRAW 3

POST DETAILS
English Translation: Assisted by DeepL (English is not my native language).
Author: @muhammadhalim
Content & Photography: All text, photographs, and creative content featured in this post were created by me.

body.title: Cerro Porteño vs Libertad: Resultado EN VIVO de la Copa de Primera — mi opinión
body.body:
![fútbol paraguayo](https://images.pexels.com/photos/30933275/pexels-photo-30933275.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&dpr=2&h=650&w=940)

Les cuento lo que encontré hoy en las noticias de fútbol paraguayo. Hay cosas que me sorprendieron y otras que confirmaron lo que ya venía pensando.

Algo que me llamó la atención: \

. Según la nota, Cerro Porteño vs. Libertad (30 de Ago., 2026) Resultados en Vivo ESPN Deportes. Cada vez se ve más compromiso y menos improvisación. Los equipos y peleadores están invirtiendo en preparación de verdad. Los centros de traineo, los nutricionistas, los analistas de video. Todo eso se nota en la cancha.\n\nEncontré esto: \

. Cerro Porteño vs Libertad: Resultado EN VIVO de la Copa de Primera 365Scores. Esto demuestra que el deporte en nuestra región tiene futuro. Hay talento de sobra, solo faltaba la estructura y la inversión. Ahora que eso está llegando, los resultados hablan por sí solos.\n\n\

— Fixture Copa Libertadores 2026: los resultados y calendario de partidos TyC Sports. Lo que más me gusta es que ya no hay resultados fáciles. Antes podías predecir quien ganaba mirando los rankings, ahora cualquier cosa puede pasar. Eso es lo que hace emocionante al deporte, la incertidumbre de no saber qué va a pasar.

No es fanatismo, es que realmente el nivel está alto y hay que reconocerlo cuando se ve. Yo no soy de los que critican todo, cuando algo está bueno hay que decirlo.

Lo que me llama la atención es la consistencia. Ya no es solo un momento de gloria, es un nivel sostenido que demuestra trabajo detrás de escena. Los que llegaron arriba se quedan porque se siguen preparando, no se conforman con un solo éxito.

También me enteré de que Cerro Porteño - Libertad en directo - Copa de Primera Tigo-Ueno: Resultados y resúmenes de Fútbol - 30/08/2026 Eurosport. Me da gusto ver que el esfuerzo está dando frutos. Los que trainearon duro están cosechando resultados. No hay atajos en el deporte de alto nivel.

También me enteré de que Libertad 2-3 Cerro Porteño (21 de Mar., 2026) Resultado Final ESPN Deportes. Lo que más me gusta es que ya no hay resultados fáciles. Antes podías predecir quien ganaba mirando los rankings, ahora cualquier cosa puede pasar. Eso es lo que hace emocionante al deporte, la incertidumbre de no saber qué va a pasar.

La inversión en infraestructura y formación está dando frutos. Se ve en los resultados, en la calidad de los eventos, en la cantidad de seguidores que está ganando el deporte.

Llevo años siguiendo esto y este momento es de los mejores que recuerdo. Hay una combinación de talento y garra que se siente especial. No es solo que ganen, es cómo ganan, con qué actitud, con qué nivel.

### Lo que viene

Yo estoy mirando especialmente a los jóvenes que están llegando. Tienen una garra que los veteranos ya no tienen, y eso va a cambiar las cosas.

Cada vez se ve más compromiso y menos improvisación. Los equipos y peleadores están invirtiendo en preparación de verdad. Los centros de traineo, los nutricionistas, los analistas de video. Todo eso se nota en la cancha.

¿Qué opinan? A mí me parece que esto va a seguir creciendo. Compartan si les pareció interesante.


*Foto: Chris wade NTEZICIMPA / Pexels (CC0)*

body.title: ✨ Sometimes I Just Feel Like Dressing Up
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZPW52A2TEokyiLqDCK5CkThQpMJijMhpQaKCy9qfkC1z/IMG_8841.jpg 

I had one of those days when I actually felt like taking my time with my hair and makeup. 😅 Most days I’m much more casual, but every now and then it feels good to look in the mirror and think, “Okay… I really like this today.”

I’m learning that there are so many different versions of me. Some days I’m thinking seriously about my future, chemistry, university and everything I still want to accomplish. 🧪 Other days I just want to enjoy being young, try a different look, take too many pictures and have fun with it.

I don't think one side has to cancel out the other.

I can be the girl who dreams about becoming a chemist and also the girl who spends way too long getting her eyeliner right. 😂

Today, I'm definitely enjoying this version of myself. 🖤

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@alanacontreras/-sometimes-i-just-feel-like-dressing-up-euy)
