body.title: Diary of my time in Frontier: Tournament Rewards, Vanguard Arena Awards, Lux's Favor results and opening of Foundations Packs [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> Greetings Splinterlands and Hivers community! Welcome to my weekly report on the Frontiers format. We'll be reviewing various aspects of this format, which even includes the Vanguard Arena. This arena is associated with a set of entirely new Foundations cards that are certainly a great advantage, extending their usefulness to the Modern format. The card that catches my eye is the Foundation Dragon Archon, which truly has very useful tactical modifiers not only in Frontiers but also in Modern. So far, I haven't managed to get one, although I haven't given up hope of getting it, either through the prize wheel or in one of the challenges that various streamers have set up. But I want to start by recording our tournament activity and the number of rewards we've earned. Let's begin! > Saludos comunidad de Splinterlands y Hivers! Bienvenido a mi reporte de la semana en el formato Frontiers, vamos a revisar varios aspectos relacionados con este formato que incluso incluye el Arena Vanguard que esta asociado a un conjunto de cartas Foundations completamente nuevas que ciertamente son una gran ventaja, extendiendo su utilidad al formato moderno. La carta que me llama la atención es el arconte dragón Foundation, que la verdad tiene modificadores tácticos de gran utilidad no solo en Frontiers, sino en Moderno también. Hasta ahora no he logrado conseguir uno, aunque no pierdo la esperanza de conseguirlo sea en la ruleta de premios o en algún desafío que se han propuesto por varios streamers. Pero quiero empezar por dejar el registro de nuestra actividad en los torneos y la cantidad de recompensas que hemos conseguido. Comencemos!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFzXcrKRhv56p3CKNdcy1w4CnQHV6TaBGnm4nYuARrJV/image.png)

> This week we participated in 5 different tournaments with mixed results. I'm performing better in the Modern format events that include Foundations, Rebellion, and Arcane Conclave cards. I'm not doing as well in the Wild format because, strictly speaking, the only set I have almost complete is Chaos Legion, while I have practically no alpha/beta or untamed/dice cards. But as of this Sunday morning, we have generated a total of 496 SPS in liquid. > Esta semana participamos en 5 diferentes torneos con resultados mixtos, tengo un mejor desempeño en aquellos eventos del formato moderno que incluyen las cartas foundations, rebellion y conclave arcana. No me va tan bien en el formato wild ya que siendo estrictos, el único set que tengo casi completo es el de Chaos Legion, mientras que prácticamente no tengo cartas alfa/beta o untamed/dice. Pero hasta hoy domingo en la mañana, hemos generado un total de 496 SPS en líquido.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvBcjZJUgWJtPGKyyop81M6HvWSQAiJPnTCpbquwsCc6/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdrZsUrgjobLHfqALrHnEL6mTKU7WzNw6ZD7vRLRN46wG/image.png) --|-- --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvt29wz1H4FQoYQGeC4kr1mJmHXj73AHnxbkNMt1ySkA/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeatR5PeHbn5W9nXssTYMpDC7c8DmQsDvp4v12ecXWFT3/image.png) --|-- --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdEEe4MAr6ZrEho9cAofv43WMitR3EfoC9CHt1KqSxDht/image.png)

> With two weeks since we started participating in tournaments, we've already generated the equivalent of 1573 SPS in cash. That's a good performance compared to Brawls; I have to wait four days to get between 140 and 150 SPS when I participate in Guild tournaments, and those tokens are locked. In tournaments, SPS is available directly, and of course, as I buy the Legendary Archons we're missing, we'll perform better in these tournaments. Next week I'll probably add 2 more legendary archons to our deck, we'll see if it improves our position in tournaments. > Con ya 2 semanas desde que empezamos nuestra participación en los torneos, ya tenemos generados en líquidos el equivalente a 1573 SPS. Es un buen rendimiento si lo comparo con las brawls, tengo que esperar 4 días para obtener entre 140 a 150 SPS cuando participo en los torneos de gremios que además son tokens que están bloqueados. En los torneos la disponibilidad de los SPS es directa, y por supuesto, a medida que compre los arcontes legendarios que nos faltan tendremos un mejor rendimiento en estos torneos. Esta próxima semana es probable que incorpore 2 arcontes legendarios más a nuestro mazo, ya veremos si mejora nuestra posición en los torneos.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmToeemgrDhHEs8omcPDiQ7SixoHKsueA3NQ6k288FpUp4/ca_sponsor_3_removebg_preview.png)
# Arena Vanguard Prizes/Premios de Arena Vanguard

> We're continuing with the Arena Vanguard event. It's been six weeks now, and this exciting event adds six extra Foundations cards to Frontiers and the Modern format in general, including a new Dragon Archon, which will add more strategic options to Frontiers. It's possible to get these cards in the Sparks store, but honestly, I wouldn't want to spend all the Sparks I've been accumulating on a simple BCX of these cards. Although some people have already been actively buying these cards, like the neutral Buns the Unseen, which is already sold out. > Continuamos con el evento de arena vanguard, ya van 6 semanas de este interesante evento que viene a sumar 6 cartas Foundations extra a Frontiers y en general al formato Moderno, incluyendo 1 novedoso arconte dragón, que vienen a sumar más estrategias de juego en Frontier. Es posible conseguir estas cartas en la tienda de Sparks pero sinceramente, no me gustaría gastar todos los días que he estado acumulando Sparks, en un simple bcx de estas cartas. Aunque ya hay personas que han comprado activamente estas cartas, como la neutra Buns the Unseen que ya se agotaron.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8qPqhG2L8rMe1E2Ax6c9pWgaZEJkD3GWTGztFHwpjJo/image.png)

> So, the way I've managed to get these Foundations cards is through challenges proposed by community members. These range from battle challenges with one of these cards to others that invite us to create a story, expanding the game's lore. I've been lucky enough to win several of these challenges proposed by @takeru255, @iblast, and @king-arminius, and I've really enjoyed participating in them. Thank you so much! > Entonces, la manera que he conseguido para obtener estas cartas Foundations, es a través de los desafíos propuestos por miembros de la comunidad, que van desde desafíos de batalla con alguna de estas cartas y otros que nos invitan a crear una historia expandiendo el lore del juego. He tenido suerte en varios de estos desafíos propuestos por @takeru255, @iblast y @king-arminius, que he disfrutado bastante participando en ellos. Muchas gracias!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVF6dtm1tiUv1u1x8Ar1J9w77YtvTVESHBxFV5hvv7zn/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbt1YiJfNoCUTrtbwp4zGNh9SmYFHELD9MssgkwZcG67W/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdDnpxsRE43Zz2ZqiKF8vzovzf3FkX8jUfeK3DbtchKmR/image.png) ---|---|---

> So far, Jolius Blast and King Ermitaz Twinclaves have been a huge help. I haven't yet developed a good strategy for Khan Feywest, but that's because I haven't bought the legendary Earth-class Archon yet to unlock his full potential. As soon as I get it, I'll do a proper review. > Hasta ahora me han ayudado en gran medida, Jolius Blast y King Ermitaz Twinclaves, Khan Feywest aún no he diseñado una buena estrategia con él, pero es porque aún no he comprado el arconte legendario de la clase tierra para aprovechar su potencial. En cuanto lo tenga le dedicaremos una reseña particular.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTgo9GpaQVaVYMGh8Acs5gPV8DYBmFX4dHqkVFvYCH3PG/cl_sponsor_5.png)
# Lux's Favor Results/Resultados del Favor de Lux

> Now let's look at our performance in the Lux's Favor rewards wheel. First, it's worth noting that we've participated in this activity for 104 consecutive days, so we're keeping our Master Streak title! And these were our rewards for the past week: > Veamos ahora nuestro balance en la rueda de premios del Favor de Lux. Lo primero es destacar que llevamos 104 días continuos participando de esta actividad, así que mantenemos nuestro título de Master Streak! Y estas fueron nuestras recompensas la semana que terminó: ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUim8sN8MhVnkcaZxiVvxA4mcsWtZ8XsmQCNKp95PRfwX/dia_103.gif) --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmanxgFDEN8HYXXuQHihMeiAXXBVr8wj5vrB8NRxtxzPpK/dia_104.gif)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUzyHEEDA9hwPCCxPeZ1NKNfZPAXjCYXqyKCE4WXFYS7d/dia_102.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdmHEjQhvx8r1HDhe49yjqrfSfzKdYVCZzoGsDcLwMSqX/dia_101.gif)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW7KefCz1n3t2nrtXZar1UxK59DQdJ3xH8z1QbTqZkXai/d_a_97.gif) --|--

> The first few days of the week we got a good amount of Sparks from the roulette wheel, but these last few days we've received Frontier Battle Energy, which isn't bad because it gives me extra energy to start Monday by collecting raffle tokens, which just so happens to coincide with the end of the season. > Los primeros días de la semana conseguimos cantidades sustanciosas de sparks con la ruleta pero estos últimos días hemos recibido energía para las batallas de frontier, que no esta mal porque así tengo una cantidad de energía extra para empezar el lunes acumulando las fichas de sorteo que casualmente coincide con el fin de temporada.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXXjdRPhBZ4Snkvw77C12Jhs1CR1yeBwKbwpY3mqCV6bt/image.png) --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbV8EkX6LAdrgemsGjH7HmqfvFuVzJQCXAAedSjFKU2om/image.png)

> So far, I have 65.4K Sparks. One of the new features announced last week was the renewal of card skins. Eight new skins have been included this time. Unfortunately, I don't think there's any way to get the previous skins, and these new skins don't appeal to me enough to spend my Sparks on them. I'll wait for the Halloween and Christmas events to see if more interesting designs appear, especially for Halloween, which is my favorite event. > Hasta ahora van 65,4K en Sparks, una de las novedades anunciadas la semana pasada fue la renovación de las skins para cartas. 8 nuevas skins se han incluido en esta ocasión, lamentablemente las skins anteriores no creo que haya posibilidad de conseguirlas de ninguna forma, y estas nuevas skins no me llaman tanto la atención como para gastar mis sparks. Esperaré a los eventos de halloween y navidad para ver si aparecen diseños más interesantes, sobre todo en el halloween que es mi evento favorito.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU8F5Eg4w6bCXxPt12H4AYyCPpF2akzGFsL6WY4vSZsAT/spl_sponsor_3.png)
# Foundations Packs

> To wrap things up, I'll share our pack openings from this week. The first day was definitely the best—four legendary cards! I don't think I've ever had such a great drop. The rest were common/rare cards, with the exception that we only got two archons: Fire and Death. I was hoping to get enough copies of Archon Aurelia to level her up to 3, but we'll have to try again next week. > Para cerrar les comparto nuestra apertura de sobres a lo largo de esta semana. El primer día, fue sin duda el mejor de todos, 4 cartas legendarias! Creo que nunca había tenido un drop así de bueno, el resto fueron cartas comunes/raras, con el detalle de que solo obtuvimos 2 arcontes: el de fuego y muerte. Esperaba conseguir las copias del arconte Aurelia necesarias para llevarla a nivel 3, pero tendremos que reintentarlo la próxima semana.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmetTW5wNGqceyJ6UfNyJG6QQxvYLSjXqm2hWqNwCrhxG2/image.png) --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcLV9iZULqNwWCos2iHTjjMGYztXfW81VhCctp6ANzw3K/open_foundations_packs_23_8_26_i.gif)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZfFYxDRJB2hB9E2hTa5dNoNy9c9iq1vMtJCTLHFumnye/open_foundations_packs_22_8_26_i.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSrGBsgpRVtn7qpdsDc5jgVgooYmtPYBdeVH8wAVqA2Cr/open_foundations_packs_19_8_26.gif)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRSeRJTka1NYYZjrCejG7YnJdGng2GaNSFXbYZhJY1PS/open_foundation_packs_24_8_26.gif) --|--

> So, we have four archons we can upgrade to level 3, and we're only missing Aurelia. The life and fire archons are just three copies away from level 4, giving us two archons of the same element at the same level. We'll see if we can get more archons in the reward packs next season. > Entonces, tenemos 4 arcontes que podemos upgradear a nivel 3 y solo nos faltaría Aurelia. Los arcontes de vida y fuego ya están a solo 3 copias del nivel 4 y así tener 2 arcontes del mismo elemento al mismo nivel. Ya veremos si en la temporada siguiente podemos sumar más arcontes en los packs de recompensas.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUsQYkHmiVfNGbtHkR13pWBjAEAPx5x8b5hkyrndP7t9r/spl_sponsor_1.png)

We'll be starting a new season on Monday, so we'll get down to business completing all the daily missions to collect as many raffle tokens as possible and try our luck in the special card draw. body.title: [TV] The Boys - Celebrity Superhero
body.body:
I don't think I've ever watched a superhero series that made me feel this uncomfortable, entertained and confused at the same time because let's be honest...
What if superheroes were actually terrible people....
That's basically the question The Boys asks...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYEJKgjyKFy6N1La9nZhqQVbQ4ig71gFLmTwd8QsAm84/img_20260830_224901.jpg)

The story takes place in a world where superheroes are real, but instead of simply protecting people, most of them work for a massive corporation called Vought...

They're celebrities, celebrities with superpowers, endorsement deals, movies, merchandise and millions of fans.... Basically, superheroes have become a business and that's where things get interesting...

The main character, Hughie Campbell, is just an ordinary guy whose life completely falls apart after a superhero accidentally kills his girlfriend and the worst part.. Nobody really cares.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW14KBBpSAnDbFyJnNoqdD87ohmaoX9QR7LtbiKVHKMLH/img_20260830_224651.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU1XLki1GoSX4yrKHQpSYRKEEi8Bj8ANsuqHUXor1TKBt/img_20260830_224752.jpg)

Vought covers everything up, lawyers get involved and Hughie is basically expected to accept some money and move on.
But he doesn't... That's how he eventually gets involved with Billy Butcher, played by Karl Urban and a group of people who have made it their mission to expose and take down corrupt superheroes and honestly, Billy Butcher is one of the craziest characters I've watched in a long time....

This man hates superheroes with every part of his soul and I mean HATES them....

Karl Urban plays him perfectly. He's aggressive, sarcastic, unpredictable and constantly one bad decision away from making everything worse but what makes Butcher interesting is that underneath all that anger, there's a lot of pain...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWyR6U8vqX51uWFivZVkubfmmoXGhWWcmo7BqE4K2QsE4/img_20260830_224847.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZu1Efb2x6emXoPugpP3Cr1eLUTv9V5EmD8B9q5zov68T/img_20260830_224833.jpg)

He's not just fighting superheroes because he thinks they're bad, He's carrying his own personal reasons for wanting them destroyed...

Then we have Homelander...
Oh my God..
I don't even know where to start with this guy...

Homelander is basically what happens if you take Superman's powers, remove the morality and add an enormous amount of insecurity and narcissism...

He's incredibly powerful, but emotionally he's basically a child who desperately wants everyone to love him and Antony Starr is absolutely terrifying in this role.
There are moments where Homelander doesn't even need to do anything... He just looks at somebody qnd you're already thinking..
\

..

What makes The Boys so good is that it doesn't treat superheroes like perfect heroes, it looks at what would happen if people with unbelievable power were still just human beings with greed, jealousy, insecurity and terrible personalities and honestly, that's what makes some of the show's moments hit harder..

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmap2oRbZ1jewAXajyaVBX8vXes6Rqd43GKeVCkSR1V3nV/img_20260830_224705.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmREpfVXWhgj7wpaRS4jNYZmNQX4xJrZC7tjAaXpWZxuc6/img_20260830_224821.jpg)

The series is extremely violent too and when I say violent, I mean EXTREMELY violent...
People explode.
People get crushed.
People get burned.
People get thrown through walls.
Sometimes the violence is so ridiculous that you can't help but laugh but there's always something uncomfortable underneath the jokes...

The show uses the violence, sex and dark humor to criticize things like corporate greed, celebrity culture, political manipulation, social media and the way people blindly worship public figures.
Vought is probably one of the most interesting parts of the whole series because they're not just selling superheroes, They're selling an image, They control the narrative, control the public perception and constantly manipulate people into believing whatever benefits them and honestly, that part feels surprisingly realistic... Not the superheroes though but the idea that powerful organizations can create celebrities, control information and influence what people believe?
That part isn't difficult to imagine...

Hughie is basically the normal guy thrown into this completely insane world...

Annie January, or Starlight, is probably the character I connected with most because she starts the series believing superheroes are genuine heroes, Then she slowly discovers what actually happens behind the scenes and watching her struggle between who she thought these people were and who they really are is one of the better character arcs in the show...

Then there's Frenchie and Kimiko.
Those two...
Honestly, I love them.

Their relationship brings some much-needed warmth into an otherwise incredibly messed-up world and Mother's Milk is basically the guy constantly trying to keep everyone from completely losing their minds...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7VJsyj4tr7cN1PDARyL8THwoXhi6wa9RsRqeFruSJUR/img_20260830_224808.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTMDPA1H6vgybZh4LPmhKndmoUaXGo5Ho73LDcDWswfTk/img_20260830_224721.jpg)

The Boys knows how to keep you watching... Every season seems to end with me thinking:
\

. And then they somehow do, but underneath all the blood, jokes and ridiculous superhero fights, I think the real reason this show works is because it keeps asking one simple question... 
What would people actually do if nobody could stop them?...

Give someone enough power and remove the consequences, and eventually you find out who they really are and that's the scary part...

<sub>[Image credit](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1190634/?ref_=mv_close)<sub>


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2JRnF2gFYszKxh2Tx7gnWVSE9WQhTELNYfWdHJotREs/1751582800744.png)

body.title: Tortitas de pollo especiado con papa y zanahoria/spiced chicken patties with potatoes and carrots 🥕🥔🍗
body.body:
> Hello gente, qué tal todo? Por aquí amanecimos con ganas y tiempo para cocinar algo diferente, y es que a veces caemos en la rutina de preparar lo mismo, porque vamos a estar claros, es lo más rápido y vamos a lo seguro, pero la verdad es que cocinar se vuelve mucho más divertido cuando nos atrevemos a experimentar, a mezclar texturas y a probar combinaciones nuevas con lo que tenemos a la mano en la nevera. Hoy quise salirme por completo de la zona de confort y preparé unas **tortitas de pollo especiadas con papa y zanahoria**. Un plato con muchísima personalidad, perfecto si andan buscando una idea diferente para el almuerzo que sea bien saciadora y que deje de lado lo tradicional.
Hey everyone, how’s it going? Over here, we woke up this morning feeling motivated and with plenty of time to cook something different. Sometimes we fall into the rut of making the same old things—because, let’s be honest, it’s the quickest and safest option—but the truth is that cooking becomes so much more fun when we dare to experiment, mix textures, and try new combinations with whatever we have on hand in the fridge. Today I wanted to step completely out of my comfort zone and made some **spiced chicken patties with potatoes and carrots**. It’s a dish with tons of personality—perfect if you’re looking for a different lunch idea that’s really filling and breaks away from the traditional.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYhVfChNpVzdEpvqvh9ntJSN7PcfDZUaNCY1718z4Mn7/1788126530591.png) *** La idea original era hacer unos nugets tradicionales con pollo molido, pero como mi despensa de especias ha crecido bastante quise hacer uso de ellas y de algunas verduras como papa y zanahoria, así que a último minuto decidí cambiar el rumbo. Les confieso que fue la mejor decisión; la combinación de la papa con la zanahoria no solo hace que las tortitas queden súper jugosas y suaves por dentro, sino que le aportan un volumen genial que hace que rinda muchísimo más. Por otro lado, como a mí me encanta la comida especiada y con un toque de picante, aproveché para usar algunas de mis especias, así que combiné curry, comino, paprika ahumada, jengibre y pimienta cayena, logrando un aroma que inundó toda la casa, y para acompañar estas tortitas, preparé un arroz blanco aromático y una salsa de curry dulce que le dio el equilibrio perfecto al picante del pollo. Y ahora sí, sin más, scompáñenme a ver el paso a paso!
The original idea was to make traditional nuggets with ground chicken, but since my spice collection has grown quite a bit, I wanted to put those spices to use along with some vegetables like potatoes and carrots, so at the last minute I decided to change course. I have to admit it was the best decision; the combination of potatoes and carrots not only makes the patties super juicy and tender on the inside, but it also adds great volume, making the recipe go a lot further. On top of that, since I love spicy food with a hint of heat, I took the opportunity to use some of my spices, so I combined curry powder, cumin, smoked paprika, ginger, and cayenne pepper, creating an aroma that filled the whole house. To go with these patties, I made aromatic white rice and a sweet curry sauce that provided the perfect balance to the chicken’s spiciness. And now, without further ado, join me for the step-by-step guide!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcWSci9tF8vi9k6AG3CCMjjDk4jVvd5iGTxyMoCjoydv8/1788124542043.jpg) *** ## Ingredientes 1 pechuga de pollo 1 papa grande cocida y hecha puré 1 zanahoria rallada 1 huevo grande 5 cucharadas de harina 4 cucharadas de cilantro fresco picado 1 cdta de paprika ahumada 1 cdta de curry 1/2 cdta de comino 1/2 cdta de jengibre 1/4 de cdta de pimienta cayena Sal y pimienta negra al gusto ### Para el arroz 2 tazas de arroz blanco 1 diente de ajo picado 1 cucharadita de orégano seco ### Para la salsa 1/2 taza de mayonesa 1/2 cucharadita de curry en polvo 1 cucharadita de azúcar Unas gotas de jugo de limón ## Ingredients 1 chicken breast 1 large potato, cooked and mashed 1 grated carrot 1 large egg 5 tablespoons flour 4 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro 1 teaspoon smoked paprika 1 teaspoon curry powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1/2 teaspoon ginger 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper Salt and black pepper to taste ### For the rice 2 cups white rice 1 clove garlic, minced 1 teaspoon dried oregano ### For the sauce 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/2 teaspoon curry powder 1 teaspoon sugar A few drops of lemon juice ## Procedimiento / Procedure Para comenzar con nuestras **tortitas de pollo especiadas con papa y zanahoria**, lo primero que haremos será cocinar nuestra papa en agua con un toque de sal, y una vez que esté suave, la retiramos del agua y la trituramos hasta obtener un puré liso y sin grumos. Mientras la papa se cocina, en un bol grande incorporamos el pollo cortado en cubos junto con todas las especias, sal y el huevo. Incorporamos todo muy bien y llevamos a la procesadora para obtener nuestro pollo molido.
To start making our **spiced chicken patties with potato and zsbahoria**, the first thing we’ll do is cook the potato in water with a pinch of salt, and once it’s tender, we’ll remove it from the water and mash it until we have a smooth, lump-free puree. While the potato is cooking, in a large bowl, combine the diced chicken with all the spices, salt, and the egg. Mix everything together thoroughly, then transfer the mixture to a food processor to grind the chicken.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexb8zVkWtWuqY4K8kf6v75NnZ5we64Eg1R7L5tTCNsL2/1788124542450.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdym9ineqcf22tTVvps6smneSDArYKJmLH7sHhEW8yP2N/1788124542685.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRmJXwk3AqaCN4csz2GvTZm9S5sGXccL5tP3vR4ZhiYTj/1788124542949.jpg) *** Listo el puré continuamos con nuestra preparación, y para ello agregamos al pollo especiado el puré de papa, la zanahoria rallada, el cilantro y la harina de trigo que nos va a ayudar a darle consistencia a la masa. Incorporamos muy bien y dejamos en el refrigerador por 15 minutos.
Once the mashed potatoes are ready, we continue with our preparation. To do this, we add the mashed potatoes, the grated carrots, and the wheat flour—which will help give the mixture consistency—to the seasoned chicken. We mix everything together thoroughly and let it sit in the refrigerator for 15 minutes o cuando estemos listos para cocinar nuestras tortitas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVp2A4yDm26KBNa5XkfPuYEnJU6Yy8gMisjYKJuncXGmZ/1788124543189.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc35NzJ7oBg7bHSxQnheQhkDbWgUgA3WWQ1tZGtVdjtVi/1788124758747.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTR6fmJQyXynsLeXDqsmsMY6U9Hgjz7B5XfSQnDhAkkrN/1788124758953.jpg) *** Trancurridos los 15 minutos retiramos nuestra mezcla del refrigerador y con ayuda de una cuchara para helado (para que las tortitas sean del mismo tamaño), procedemos a armarlas. En este paso es importante untar nuestras manos con aceite para que la mezcla no se pegue de nuestros dedos, y lo siguiente es pasarlos por una mezcla de polvo para empanizar y harina de trigo. Formamos las bolitas con nuestras manos y luego presionamos para formar las tortitas.
After 15 minutes, remove the mixture from the refrigerator and, using an ice cream scoop to ensure the patties are all the same size, shape them. At this step, it’s important to coat your hands with oil so the mixture doesn’t stick to your fingers, and then roll them in a mixture of breadcrumbs and all-purpose flour. Shape the mixture into small balls with your hands, then press them flat to form the pancakes.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc6VtBeDUADiBVpsnzoEazPvDkST1syQytquTg1JV6sPw/1788124759366.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTR6fmJQyXynsLeXDqsmsMY6U9Hgjz7B5XfSQnDhAkkrN/1788124834286.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdReKeRyFgTBhntp3JA82tbdKcdkYtd1pWrYg3By4ncrX/1788124759172.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFFHDwDztMhV86L58m2EzDZKGvNemDSXfCHznwy1Ye6k/1788124834082.jpg) *** Para la cocción, calentamos una sartén con aceite a fuego medio. Colocamos nuestras tortitas y las cocinamos durante unos 6 a 7 minutos por cada lado.
To cook them, heat a skillet with oil over medium heat. Place the pancakes in the skillet and cook them for about 6 to 7 minutes on each side.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT2hWdMNQvCtxrA3z4uQ2896VirCS2BPBnn7z48AB1aU3/1788124834499.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeFvMtmiYk3ZVPAcrEvortv481Ai7nUXMmp9sxJSs5Kho/1788124834744.jpg) *** Mientras las tortitas estaban en la sartén, aproveché el tiempo para hacer los acompañantes. Para el arroz, primero sofreí un diente de ajo picado en aceite de oliva y lo incorporé al agua del arroz junto una cucharadita de orégano seco y les cuento que el aroma de este arroz es absolutamente delicioso.
While the pancakes were cooking in the pan, I used the time to prepare the side dishes. For the rice, I first sautéed a clove of minced garlic in olive oil and added it to the rice water along with a teaspoon of dried oregano—and let me tell you, the aroma of this rice is absolutely delicious.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZGVFHjWPqsPGTf87tnzPKcvxrc2bGxuuVQKRR7aYjGth/1788124835007.jpg) *** Por otro lado, para la salsa de curry dulce simplemente mezclé la mayonesa con el curry en polvo, el azúcar, las gotitas de limón y una cucharada de cilantro picado, batiendo con fuerza hasta que el azúcar se disolvió por completo.
As for the sweet curry sauce, I simply mixed the mayonnaise with the curry powder, sugar, a few drops of lemon juice, and a tablespoon of chopped cilantro, whisking vigorously until the sugar dissolved completely.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX6AZoYUXXtDbqeuioEVy5bSBmtyyNYqdpBTi8aUt3nrZ/1788125183221.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZoGanbCH4NSivRv33rRUzEy6DYUd2eLh552G8rv5nino/1788125183438.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTcbJshisz3mHS3LearHXaCKZq1fm1JfB5fkuk7bYbBgV/1788125184052.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQjBBRgEM3Tj7Wxxsah1aQTN5DviVn7DJetF8zjJ5yAX3/1788125183660.jpg) El resultado? Un almuerzo espectacular, lleno de muchísimo sabor y texturas diferentes. Las tortitas quedaron extremadamente crujientes por fuera y súper suaves por dentro gracias a la combinación de la papa y la zanahoria. El toque picante de la cayena quedó perfecto con el toque dulce de la salsa de curry, haciendo que cada bocado fuera una delicia absoluta. Así que si eres de los que gustan de los sabores intensos y especiados, no dudes en preparar esta receta en casita porque les aseguro que les va a encantar.
The result? A spectacular lunch, full of incredible flavor and a variety of textures. The pancakes turned out extremely crispy on the outside and super soft on the inside thanks to the combination of potato and carrot. The spicy kick of the cayenne pepper paired perfectly with the sweetness of the curry sauce, making every bite an absolute delight. So if you’re someone who loves intense, spicy flavors, don’t hesitate to try this recipe at home—I promise you’ll love it.

body.title: AMRAP?! Do CrossFitters Even Speak English?
body.body:
![hd (15).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS3kr2wc2b2zic5eioENVWsGpPLYZjeSkpag6x2SjhnZ9/hd%20(15).png)

### Decoding CrossFit #2 — Apparently WOD was only the beginning

So...In the first episode of **Decoding CrossFit**, I confessed something slightly embarrassing...When I first started, I had absolutely no idea what **WOD** meant. I just nodded and pretended I did lol

Eventually I discovered it simply meant **Workout Of the Day**, and I thought..\

Oh, sweet innocent me!

Because then I walked into the box and saw things like:

**AMRAP 15' / E3MOM 15' / AFAP**

Excuse me? Did I join a gym or accidentally enrol in a military communications course?

Apparently knowing what WOD means only gets you through level one of CrossFit language lol

And since I teased this particular board at the end of my last post...

Let's start there:


![20260827_091610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elianaicgomes/EowG2TgH7BwnNLQBvYabnxc2TPAvr7Ex7DCXnqUQcU7vLqRHsZdHA5581prXAApu6SN.jpg)


## AMRAP — As Many Rounds (or Reps) As Possible

This one sounds much more complicated than it actually is.

On this particular day, the board said:

**AMRAP 15'**

Which means I had **15 minutes** to complete as many rounds as possible of the exercises written underneath.

In this case:

**10 alternating DB Snatches
60 Rope Jumps (or 15 D.U.)
6 Cal or 100mts or 10 Burpees**

Finish one round? Lovely..Start again!

Finish another? Congrats! Do it again!! lol

And you keep going until those 15 minutes are over! If the clock stops while you're halfway through another round, those extra reps still count towards your score.

So instead of simply saying \

, an AMRAP score might look something like:

5 rounds + 17 reps

Five complete rounds, plus another 17 reps before the clock rescued you.
And yes, I deliberately said rescued hehe

---

# Wait...what's DB?

See? This is the problem with CrossFit...You explain one acronym and accidentally uncover another one!

For now:

**DB = Dumbbell** - So DB Snatch simply means Dumbbell Snatch.

And if you're looking at D.U. on the board:

**D.U. = Double Unders** - That's when the skipping rope passes underneath your feet **twice in one jump**.

(If you're currently learning them like me, the rope may also repeatedly attack your legs..Apparently that's part of the experience lol)

We'll save the full CrossFit alphabet soup for another episode!

For now, back to workout formats.

Because AMRAP isn't the only way our coaches like to torture us...

---

# E3MOM — Every 3 Minutes On the Minute

Here's another one from one of my actual workouts:


![20260825_102353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elianaicgomes/23xAVxxf4bByHSXtMKbkPS6THJbJuGWy4NocmZf1nUo1ZFhJxggicNyb5w6LssnWiqrTk.jpg)


You've probably heard of:

**EMOM — Every Minute On the Minute**

You start the programmed work at the beginning of every minute.

But **E3MOM** means:

**Every 3 Minutes On the Minute**

So a new round starts every **three minutes** - You complete the programmed work, and whatever time is left before the next three-minute interval begins is your recovery.

For example, if you finish the work in 2 minutes and 10 seconds...You get 50 seconds to breathe, reconsider your life choices and prepare to do it all over again...How generous!
Then the next three-minute interval starts and off you go.

The annoying part? As you get tired, the work tends to take longer and somehow that lovely little recovery window starts mysteriously disappearing. Funny how that happens!

---

# And then there's AFAP...

You already saw this one in my last WOD:

![20260828_091826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elianaicgomes/23x17QUFVryTbcCVcHoKUCghqpJrTHvhHESSshjwSPzFXb5JaTHNsMdKTHrYi5RjSrgnB.jpg)

**AFAP — As Fast As Possible**

This one requires considerably less translation..You have the work, you have the goal.

Now...GO! (ugh.. lol)

In my case, I had:

**10 rounds**

5 Barbell Snatches
5 Push-ups
5 Down & Ups

with a **16-minute time cap**.

So the goal was to complete those 10 rounds as fast as possible, without going beyond the 16-minute limit...Simple! Not easy...Simple! There is a difference lol

---

# So... what's the difference?

This was probably the part that took me a little while to understand when I started...They can contain similar exercises, but the way you approach the workout changes.

**AMRAP** - How much work can I get done before the time runs out?

**E3MOM** - Can I complete this work and earn myself some rest before the next interval?

**AFAP** - How quickly can I get this whole thing done?

And suddenly:

**AMRAP 15'**

doesn't look like a secret code anymore...Which is kind of funny because now I walk into the box, look at the board and understand most of this stuff without even thinking about it!

Then I post the picture online...and completely forget that someone else might be looking at it exactly like I did when I started.

**What. The hell. Does that mean?**

That's exactly why I'm enjoying making these posts! I'm not trying to teach anyone how to do CrossFit..There are coaches for that, and mine know considerably more than I do!

I'm just translating some of the language I've picked up while learning!

Because not that long ago...I didn't speak CrossFit either hehe

---

## Next time on Decoding CrossFit...

We've already accidentally met:

**DB / D.U.**

And there's plenty more where those came from.

**BB.
WB.
Cal.
T2B.
HSPU...**

Apparently CrossFitters have something against complete words!

So I think it's time for:

\
\n\nWish me luck...We're going to need it ;)

body.body: > Hello friends of Las Colmenas! It's a pleasure to greet you. Today we want to brighten your day with this delicious treat we prepared with so much love 💖✨. Enjoy this irresistible dish that combines juicy, perfectly fried fish fillets, crispy and golden plantains made with love, and a fresh and delicious coleslaw for the perfect balance. It's the ideal menu to pamper your palate! Come visit us and treat yourself to a feast of Caribbean flavor in Las Cumbres 🤤🌴🏡. \n

> Hola amigos de Las colmenas es un placer saludarles Hoy queremos alegrarles el día con esta delicia que preparamos con tanto cariño 💖✨.Disfruten de este irresistible plato que combina Jugosos filetes de pescado frito a la perfección.Patacones crocantes y doraditos, hechos con amor. Y una ensalada de repollo fresca y deliciosa para el equilibrio perfecto.Es el menú ideal para consentir su paladar! Vengan a visitarnos y regálense un festín de sabor caribeño en Las Cumbres 🤤🌴🏡. ![IMG_3444.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23xpB61n6x39Tya3QesGmJYXYxqevPRbV5FN2CeWn5Lo5pv7aL86tAxHZP3TGGR3pRQSD.jpeg)

> Fresh fish fillets or steaks are seasoned with salt and pepper and thoroughly cleaned. A dry batter (pre-cooked flour) is prepared, seasoned with spices like paprika for flavor and color. The fish pieces are coated in the batter, ensuring even coverage. They are fried in plenty of hot oil until the outer layer is golden brown and crispy. For the green plantain tostones: Green plantains are peeled and cut into thick slices (cylinders). They are fried over medium heat until tender but not too brown. They are removed from the oil and flattened with a plantain press or board. They are then fried again in hot oil until they reach a deep golden color and a super crispy texture around the edges. \n

> Las ruedas o filetes de pescado fresco se salpimentan y se limpian bien.Se prepara una mezcla seca (harina precocida)condimentada con especias como paprika para darle sabor y color. Se pasan las piezas de pescado asegurando una cobertura uniforme.Se fríen en abundante aceite caliente hasta que la capa exterior quede bien dorada y crujiente. Tostones de Plátano Verde Se pelan los plátanos verdes y se cortan en trozos gruesos (cilindros).Se fríen a fuego medio hasta que estén tiernos por dentro pero sin dorar demasiadoSe retiran del aceite, se aplastan con ayuda de una pataconera o tabla para darles forma plana.Se vuelven a freír en aceite caliente hasta que adquieran un tono dorado intenso y esa textura súper crocante por los bordes. ![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AK6XiKQP4SZG8rYJWUjq2NTE2M6ibkyZSs7eWKo4iyJCHGe4tv972uDo99QEtsy.jpeg)

body.title: Observa, Analiza y Describe: ¡Una Imagen para Todos! -Esta es la Actividad Interactiva de Septiembre- En Domingo de Séptimo Día (ES/EN)
body.body:
<center>![español alexas_fotos-eye-2053408_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23y9Az3tSZ5M7q6ufms4X2QricaXLdjaca6XxHFUdMRrPyRjJ37i1VngyUcKCnzzREbj5.jpg)</center>
> *<center>[Pixabay-Alexas_Fotos; editada en Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ojo-reloj-papel-ver-iris-vista-2053408/)</center>*

###### <center>*En el ser humano, las imágenes aparecen cuando no sabemos explicar con palabras lo que sentimos o los conceptos que tenemos sobre algún fenómeno en la vida. Es que, desde siempre, la mente del hombre se ha comunicado a través de imágenes en sueños, cuando escuchamos una frase, cuando olemos algo que nos recuerda algún momento determinado y, muchas veces, es la imagen la que abre la conciencia y, en nuestras interacciones, es el punto de partida para analizar, incluso, el entorno.*</center>

###### <center>*Este es un ejercicio que siempre me ha gustado realizar en **Séptimo Día** en la **plataforma de #Hive**; y como estamos pendientes de **La Iniciativa 26**, la cual se está gestando, vamos a compartir, mientras tanto, esta práctica interactiva con una imagen para todos; que podamos compartir los significantes que por ella emergen y ofrecer diversos puntos de vista. **Porque cuando aprendemos a ver las cosas de otra manera, hasta nuestros actos cambian…***</center>


<center>![exhibition-1659453_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23x135oSwmRLWQ7Qzz2cwg8GmGjAvSBdYy9L3VeZ34XDTBoUJQo7T9xPZy7j5Yc68bJSB.jpg)</center>
> *<center>[Pixabay-Peggy_Marco](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/exposici%C3%B3n-ver-visitantes-galer%C3%ADa-1659453/)</center>*

<div class=\

> ###
¿Qué pasa con la conducta?
*Las imágenes surgen de distintas partes del cerebro; y estas transmiten ideas o conceptos que no pueden ser expresados a través de las palabras.* De hecho, el subconsciente utiliza las imágenes en los sueños para comunicarse sin necesidad del lenguaje, y estas siempre van unidas a emociones que te mueven, te alertan, te tranquilizan o que le dan sabor a algún significado en tu vida. Sabemos que la interpretación de las imágenes que nacen de tus sueños muchas veces es difícil y depende de la historia personal de aquel que sueña. Pues, igual pasa con los significados que le das a una imagen que puedes explorar, con lo que explicas que ella produce en ti, lo que te permite entender. *Así, en esta interacción entre tú y el objeto, todo es importante, desde los significados y las emociones, hasta la forma, ya sea positiva o negativa, con la que te acercas a esa imagen para analizarla; sí, todo es importante.* Con una ***[imagen analizada](https://konocet.cl/el-poder-de-la-imaginacion-en-terapia-como-utilizar-imagenes-proyectivas-para-desbloquear-emociones/)***, expresada desde las creencias, vivencias y emociones, es posible conocer más de una persona que cuando ésta habla o manifiesta sus propios conceptos.
![geralt-woman-10287919_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23xexe6egcmKDNhNAtT6RtRCuPC9poZbs4mRDCZMXadkpKAGETWXzbC5EReXUbxiYDRjY.jpg)
> *
[**Esta es la imagen de la Actividad Interactiva de Séptimo Día**; de Pixabay-Geralt](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/mujer-ventana-mayor-luz-solar-casa-10287919/)
* ###
Actividad Interactiva de Séptimo Día
***[Panxo Barrera](https://entropiacreatividad.com/panxo-barrera/)**, quien es Especialista Clínico Conductual, Académico de Honor de la Academia Internacional de la Ciencia, Tecnología y Humanidades y especializado en transformación cultural, liderazgo y pensamiento innovador, entre otros logros, nos ofrece en el **[Blog de Entropía el artículo: Fotografía Terapéutica: El lenguaje visual: un atajo sorprendente](https://entropiacreatividad.com/fotografia-terapeutica-el-lenguaje-visual-un-atajo-sorprendente/)**, que me gustaría que leyeras.* En contextos clínicos se han venido utilizando las imágenes fotográficas como relatos visuales abiertos, donde las personas construyen desde dentro, por sus experiencias, los significados a partir de lo que observan. Es que todo está lleno de la persona que se expresa desde la ambigüedad o la libre asociación de ideas, y parece ser que las imágenes nos permiten, al trabajador de la salud, acceder a capas profundas del acto cognitivo del otro ser humano.
***¿Qué es lo que veo?***
***¿Qué es lo que siento ante esta imagen?***
***¿De qué me acuerdo?***
***¿Qué es lo que creo saber sobre esta imagen?***
Esta es una herramienta, no solo para dialogar, sino para darnos a conocer a quien nos lee o escucha. *Desde el momento en el que me coloco frente a la imagen en determinada actitud, sea abierta o cerrada, esta comienza a hablarme y abre un espacio seguro en esta comunidad para que podamos compartir, con confianza, temas profundos y sin confrontaciones directas, porque el objeto receptor del análisis es simplemente la imagen, no el ser humano que observa y detalla.*
![peggy_marco-visitors-1649815_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/241td47KAjGGTu9a9CVitVjt4aE2H1LThDKquu9Nj3FmFrHMzZaaYzD75xCrm7qtHxYsB.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Peggy_Marco](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/visitantes-exposici%C3%B3n-ver-museo-1649815/)
* ###
El color, la forma, el ambiente pictórico… Todo
*En esta **Actividad Interactiva** te pedimos que te centres en la imagen señalada como la imagen de la actividad interactiva, la de la mujer en la ventana...* Que te tomes tu tiempo para escribir lo que ésta produce en ti. Lo que te que te hace recordar, sentir o razonar. *Trata de escribir pensando que va dirigido a ti mismo y simplemente expresando lo que crees saber y sentir ante esa imagen.* Los diferentes puntos de vista que podamos obtener van a permitir a quienes nos leen, hacerse de otras perspectivas sobre algún tema, situación o emoción, sabiendo que muchas visiones van a dar lugar a cambios del pensamiento y de la conducta. *Porque, como dijimos, otro punto de vista nos puede llevar a otra decisión y a otra forma de actuar.* Espero que mientras esperamos la **Iniciativa 26 de Séptimo Día**, podamos conocernos mejor mediante esta actividad, resaltar temáticas que no creíamos que pudieran estar pendientes o que fueran necesarias, y desarrollar, entre todos, significantes dirigidos a darle sentido y orientación a nuestras vivencias.
*Porque somos una comunidad de creadores, tanto de contenido como de perspectivas de vida.*
***Y, porque además, entre todos, sumamos hacia el bienestar y hacia el crecimiento colectivo.***
![línea azul Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/246a5qLEPyuzfoPXf9x464sPUzemkfM1SU44tvENYZ8R2u9n9XcpS2W7p8ZMECyXESpxh.png)
![english Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23t733UzCMe44rezNMCVaxBE4jErTUH5VgqTuYM5HWixUMTS93PfzNP17TDPU1tNPAeL9.png)
#
Observe, Analyze, and Describe: An Image for Everyone! —This Is September’s Interactive Activity— In Sunday of Seventh Day
![alexas_fotos-eye-2053408_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23y9Az3tSZ9KqKruuKKniDsHgFLE218X5RR5zeFNmefagHBfqKYW9gwbeooxM3NyipBf9.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Alexas_Fotos; edited in Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ojo-reloj-papel-ver-iris-vista-2053408/)
* ######
*In human beings, images arise when we cannot explain in words what we feel or the concepts we have about a particular phenomenon in life. The fact is, the human mind has always communicated through images—in dreams, when we hear a phrase, when we smell something that reminds us of a specific moment—and, very often, it is the image that opens our consciousness and, in our interactions, serves as the starting point for analyzing even our surroundings.*
######
*This is an exercise I’ve always enjoyed doing on **Seventh Day** on the **#Hive platform**; and since we’re keeping an eye on **Initiative 26**, which is currently in the works, we’re going to share, in the meantime, this interactive practice with an image for everyone—so we can share the meanings that emerge from it and offer diverse points of view. **Because when we learn to see things differently, even our actions change…***
![exhibition-1659453_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23x135oSwmRLWQ7Qzz2cwg8GmGjAvSBdYy9L3VeZ34XDTBoUJQo7T9xPZy7j5Yc68bJSB.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Peggy_Marco](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/exposici%C3%B3n-ver-visitantes-galer%C3%ADa-1659453/)
*

> ###
What about behavior?
*Images arise from different parts of the brain; they convey ideas or concepts that cannot be expressed through words.* In fact, the subconscious uses images in dreams to communicate without the need for language, and these images are always linked to emotions that move you, alert you, reassure you, or add depth to some aspect of your life. We know that interpreting the images that arise from your dreams is often difficult and depends on the dreamer’s personal history. Well, the same is true of the meanings you assign to an image you can explore—by explaining what it evokes in you, which in turn allows you to understand it. *Thus, in this interaction between you and the object, everything is important—from the meanings and emotions to the way, whether positive or negative, in which you approach that image to analyze it; yes, everything is important.* ***[By analyzing an image](https://konocet.cl/el-poder-de-la-imaginacion-en-terapia-como-utilizar-imagenes-proyectivas-para-desbloquear-emociones/)*** —expressed through beliefs, experiences, and emotions— it’s possible to learn more about a person than when they speak or express their own ideas.
![geralt-woman-10287919_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23xexe6egcmKDNhNAtT6RtRCuPC9poZbs4mRDCZMXadkpKAGETWXzbC5EReXUbxiYDRjY.jpg)
> *
[**This is the image for the Seventh-Day Interactive Activity**; from Pixabay-Geralt](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/mujer-ventana-mayor-luz-solar-casa-10287919/)
* ###
Seventh Day Interactive Activity
***[Panxo Barrera](https://entropiacreatividad.com/panxo-barrera/)***, a Clinical Behavioral Specialist, Honorary Fellow of the International Academy of Science, Technology, and Humanities, and an expert in cultural transformation, leadership, and innovative thinking—among other achievements—has contributed an ***[article to the Entropy Blog titled: Therapeutic Photography: Visual Language—A Surprising Shortcut,](https://entropiacreatividad.com/fotografia-terapeutica-el-lenguaje-visual-un-atajo-sorprendente/)*** which I’d like you to read. In clinical settings, photographic images have been used as open-ended visual narratives, where people construct meanings from within—based on their own experiences—from what they observe. The fact is that everything is imbued with the person expressing themselves through ambiguity or the free association of ideas, and it seems that images allow us, as healthcare professionals, to access deep layers of another human being’s cognitive processes.
***What do I see?***
***What do I feel when I look at this image?***
***What does it remind me of?***
***What do I think I know about this image?***
This is a tool, not only for dialogue, but also for revealing ourselves to those who read or listen to us. *From the moment I stand before the image in a certain posture—whether open or closed—it begins to speak to me and creates a safe space within this community where we can confidently share profound topics without direct confrontation, because the object of analysis is simply the image, not the human being who observes and examines it.*
![peggy_marco-visitors-1649815_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/241td47KAjGGTu9a9CVitVjt4aE2H1LThDKquu9Nj3FmFrHMzZaaYzD75xCrm7qtHxYsB.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Peggy_Marco](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/visitantes-exposici%C3%B3n-ver-museo-1649815/)
* ###
The color, the shape, the pictorial atmosphere… Everything
*In this **Interactive Activity**, we ask you to focus on the image marked as the image for the interactive activity—the one of the woman at the window…* Take your time to write down what this image evokes in you. What it makes you remember, feel, or think. *Try writing as if you were addressing yourself, simply expressing what you think you know and feel when you look at that image.* The different points of view we gather will allow our readers to gain new perspectives on a topic, situation, or emotion, knowing that diverse viewpoints can lead to changes in thought and behavior. *Because, as we said, another point of view can lead us to a different decision and a different way of acting.* I hope that while we await **the 26th Seventh Day Initiative,** we can get to know each other better through this activity, highlight issues we didn’t realize were pending or necessary, and collectively develop meaningful insights aimed at giving meaning and direction to our experiences.
*Because we are a community of creators—both of content and of perspectives on life.*
***And because, together, we contribute to our collective well-being and growth.***

body.title: What I Learned About Drinking Lemon Water
body.body:
# What I Learned About Drinking Lemon Water 🍋💦♻️

Lately, I have been looking for simple ways to connect self-care with sustainability. Lemon water caught my attention because it is easy to make. It does not require an expensive product or a long morning routine.

It is just water and lemon. But what can it really do for our body and skin?

I decided to look past the social media promises and learn more.

## It May Help You Drink More Water

The greatest benefit may come from the water itself.

Our bodies need water to work properly. Water supports digestion, controls body temperature, and carries nutrients throughout the body.

Plain water can feel boring. Adding lemon gives it a fresh taste without adding much sugar. If that flavor helps you drink more water, it can be a helpful habit.

I like that this feels realistic. It is not a difficult wellness challenge. It is one small way to make water more enjoyable.

## It Adds Some Helpful Nutrients

Lemon juice contains vitamin C. It also provides small amounts of potassium, vitamin B6, folate, and thiamin.

Vitamin C helps protect our cells. It also helps our bodies absorb iron from plant foods. This is important because low iron can leave some people feeling tired.

However, a little lemon juice cannot provide every nutrient we need. It works best as one part of a balanced diet filled with fruits and vegetables.

## It May Support Healthy-Looking Skin

Vitamin C helps the body make collagen. Collagen is a protein that supports our skin.

The vitamin C and water in lemon water may support healthy-looking skin, but lemon water is not a beauty cure. It will not erase wrinkles or clear every skin problem.

Skin also needs balanced meals, sleep, sunscreen, and a regular skin-care routine.

I would rather share the honest version. Lemon water can support a healthy routine, but it cannot do all the work.

## It May Help With Digestion and Bloating

Drinking enough water helps keep food and waste moving through the digestive system. This can support regular bowel movements and may reduce some bloating.

Lemon also contains a small amount of potassium. Potassium helps the body manage sodium, which may be helpful when bloating is linked to eating too much salt.

Still, bloating can have many causes. Lemon water will not solve every stomach problem.

## It May Help With Cravings

Sometimes we think we are hungry when we may actually be thirsty. Drinking water before reaching for another snack gives us a moment to check what our body needs.

The article says lemon contains pectin, a type of fiber that may help with hunger. However, lemon juice has much less fiber than the whole fruit.

I would not depend on lemon water to stop every craving. I see it as a chance to pause, hydrate, and make a thoughtful choice.

## It Can Support Healthy Weight Goals

Lemon water does not burn fat. It is not a quick weight-loss drink.

However, choosing unsweetened lemon water instead of soda or another sugary drink may lower the amount of sugar and calories you drink. Staying hydrated may also help you notice your body’s hunger and thirst signals.

The helpful change comes from the overall habit—not from lemon performing a miracle.

## It May Help Prevent Certain Kidney Stones

Lemons contain citrate. Citrate may help stop certain kidney stones from forming.

Drinking enough water is also important for lowering the risk of kidney stones. Adding lemon may make it easier for some people to reach their daily water goal.

Kidney stones are not all the same. Anyone with kidney problems or a history of stones should speak with a healthcare professional.

## It May Temporarily Help a Dry Mouth

The sour taste of lemon can help the mouth make more saliva. This may provide temporary relief for someone experiencing a dry or sticky mouth.

However, dry mouth that continues may be caused by medicine or a health condition. It should not be ignored or treated only with lemon water.

## Lemon Water Is Not for Everyone

Lemon is acidic. It may cause problems for people with heartburn, acid reflux, stomach ulcers, mouth sores, sensitive teeth, or weak enamel.

Frequent contact with acid can slowly wear down tooth enamel. Do not swish lemon water around your mouth or hold it against your teeth. You can drink it through a straw and rinse your mouth with plain water afterward.

It is also better to wait before brushing your teeth after drinking something acidic.

Pay attention to your body. A habit is not self-care if it leaves you feeling worse.

## How I Would Keep It Simple

Squeeze about half a lemon into eight ounces of water. Add more water if the taste is too strong.

You can drink it warm or cold. You can also add cucumber, berries, mint, or ginger for a different flavor.

There is no need to add a lot of sugar. The goal is to create a refreshing drink that helps you enjoy more water.

## Turn Self-Care Into Sustainable Care

After drinking the water, the lemon does not always have to go into the trash.

If you compost at home or use a local compost program, cut the used lemon into smaller pieces and add it to your compost. It can break down with other food scraps and help create useful soil.

Use a reusable glass or bottle, too.

That small action connects wellness with \

. We care for our bodies by drinking water. Then we give the lemon another purpose instead of sending it straight to the trash.

## My Final Thought

I do not see lemon water as a detox, cure, or fast way to change my body. I see it as a simple self-care choice.

It can make water more enjoyable. It adds some vitamin C. It may support digestion, skin health, and other body functions as part of a healthy lifestyle.

The used lemon can even become compost instead of waste.

That is the kind of wellness I want to explore through the Beauty In You Community; realistic choices that care for our bodies and the beauty of our world.

**Hydrate your body. Compost your lemon. Care for the Beauty In You and the beauty around you.**

Watch my short video below:

https://youtube.com/shorts/TG0JtrfX47c?si=AmVItxWtQDTFTSOA

Do you drink lemon water? What do you do with your used lemons?

Sources: [Prevention: Benefits of Drinking Lemon Water](https://www.prevention.com/food-nutrition/a71523474/benefits-of-drinking-lemon-water/), [CDC: Water and Healthier Drinks](https://www.cdc.gov/healthy-weight-growth/water-healthy-drinks/index.html), [NIH: Vitamin C](https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/VitaminC-Consumer/), and [American Dental Association: Dental Erosion](https://www.ada.org/resources/ada-library/oral-health-topics/dental-erosion).

body.body: >\nGreetings everyone, as for many weeks have past allow me to share some updates of my vegetables here in my simple Garden and how I take care of it using recycled materials found in the trash. Pots and othe things use for gardening are very expensive that is why I only used recycled one so I can save lots of money and aside of that I can helps the place clean by re-using it again. I am glad and happy to see my vegetables grow healthy using organic fertilizer and aside of that even if the planted in a simple pot it also grows better and healthy as well.\n</div class=\

>

I planted lots of tomatoe and luckily the seeds I've planted last month are already grows. I've planted some of it here in this empty big sack so I can easily carried and transferred it from one place to another. Each sack contains two tomato plants filled with loam soil and small amount of organic fertilizer. I also make a small holes at the bottom of the empty sacks so water will come out everytime when I watered it.

![IMG_20260830_130729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoprtFjE9RiTRUVcf5Eye3fWTAtCXWFkX6PcYZzryCJaE2fCNEMwoWuMYwC4HVx4B5i.jpg)
</center>
I only have few big empty sacks here and lots of tomato plants are still need to plant, that is why some of it are planted here in this recycled empty bottled water. This is not yet ready to replant at the exposing areas where sun can sees it and its better to place it somewhere at the garden where it cannot be seen by the sun so the leaves wont burned and dry. Same as the big sack, I also create holes on it so the water will come out. 

![IMG_20260830_130746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EpEFLhpCEqBfWoo7h77LeL5J8hXV6XCKsD6VYXwPtUVTLjCrnARC97PUSsgS3nEjKrL.jpg)
</center>
My small young papaya plants are continuously grows in stabled conditions and I placed it at the middle of the rotten coconut tree particularly at the roots. Our plan for this is to replant at the farm, by next day this will be very perfect to replant and I don't have any seedling trays or polythelene pots so I planted it in a recycled big empty plastic bottle of water.

![IMG_20260830_130609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoyN4ggBtjBPCwvsz38inkS5w43xaATsk2T86UypHwEyRfSNR5TC6zEKEWLgHbuBuVk.jpg)
</center>
The chilli seeds I brought from Department of Agriculture has already grows and it reach hundreds of it. Here in this small recycled Big Plastic bottle water, the chilli sprouts are started to grow squeezing one another. I sliced the thing in horizon so I can plant lots of it, it will be my simple seedling tray. This young chilli peppers still not ready to replant in the garden, it needs to wait few weeks before completely and ready to transferred. But the best thing to do while this plant still needs to grow better and in order to keep away those leaves to be burned is to keep away exposing from the sun. 
![IMG_20260830_130658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoErWoS7qdarM27tiPphkkdp3TPRGQaBUWwXfvfbJ9nwEJvDze5nD3w55KZXyMECS8Q.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260830_130713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoK6H6roLnc8wnZ5DuYM2V2tQziBQFgzpdXZtQBWETwE6ayWporhECryrLhhLviJFrA.jpg)
</center>
Last month, I shared my string beans plant here but that time there was still no flowers and string beans vegetables hanging on it. But now, finally few flowers and beans are started to come out and I felt very happy on it. The bamboo frames I created really helps for it so the beans will only hang and easily to cut when it is ready to harvest. Cultivating and loosen the soil near at the string beans plants needs to do very gently so the roots wont be damage. This kind of plant is very sensitive in fact other farmers don't need to loosen the soil and they let it lived.

![IMG_20260830_130642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoiWE8Zhv8dYzHS6TMKdcgJgJXKgEfy8LYDQf7ghx25S5BiDkhyBMQgHCGp4z4Mvu9T.jpg)
</center>
This bamboo frame I also make last month are filled with small bitter gourd vegetables. It started to crawl at the bamboo and expected to produced vegetables by next week. This kind of plants really needs to make bamboo frame just like string beans because the vegetables comes from it are long and easily damage when it place in the ground. 

![IMG_20260830_130536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/Eokc9oh472cr7QRrHZJrNZGL7z5sfR667shddcBnCbMnbvctoM1hsyE7ugVrqrynrjf.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260830_130552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoK5KX8WujdKrJrJ7RjvkBW9YnzCVBZinx2N1vmAWbedPWqi4fnegoQ6r4BtE5wjw84.jpg)
</center>
Some of the vegetables I have here are well planted at the plastic pots but it is not really new pots. It was already used and brought small parts of the pots and I reused it again. The reason why it is nice to plant it in pots because it can be transferred and aside of that it can also have lots of space in the garden. As I checked my tomato plants, still no indications and signs  I saw that my tomato will produce vegetables but I still keep hope that it will produced on a perfect time. 

Until next post, have a nice day to all of us.

👾 Caos absoluto en el pantano 👾

---

> ###
Español
¡Hola, comunidad gamer de Hive! Monster Hunter Portable 3rd es uno de esos juegos capaces de transformar una simple misión en una anécdota que se recuerda durante años. No importa cuántas veces se haya cazado a un monstruo, ni cuánto equipo tenga cada jugador: cuando cuatro cazadores se reúnen con la intención de cumplir una misión difícil, el resultado puede convertirse en una auténtica batalla campal. Eso fue exactamente lo que ocurrió durante nuestra cacería en el pantano, donde nos enfrentamos a nada menos que dos Duramboros. Desde el comienzo, la misión prometía ser intensa. El pantano era un escenario perfecto para la confrontación: un lugar húmedo, oscuro y salvaje, con árboles enormes, charcos de agua y una atmósfera que hacía sentir que los monstruos podían aparecer desde cualquier rincón. En medio de ese paisaje, los cuatro cazadores nos organizamos con una decisión tan sencilla como peligrosa: todos iríamos con gran espada, o espadón, como prefiera llamarse. No había arcos para atacar a distancia, ni martillos para aturdir, ni espadas y escudos para jugar a lo seguro. Solo cuatro armas gigantes, cuatro cazadores y la voluntad de cortar todo lo que se interpusiera delante. La llegada del primer Duramboros fue suficiente para entender que no sería una misión tranquila. Su enorme cuerpo, su cola pesada y sus característicos giros eran una amenaza constante. Cada vez que comenzaba a rotar sobre sí mismo, todos teníamos que correr, esquivar y buscar una posición segura antes de volver al ataque. Sin embargo, la verdadera locura comenzó cuando el segundo Duramboros apareció en la zona. Tener a dos de esas bestias al mismo tiempo convirtió el pantano en un caos absoluto. Había golpes por todas partes. A veces alguno cargaba el espadón con toda la confianza del mundo, solo para que un Duramboros se moviera en el último segundo y el ataque terminara golpeando el aire. O peor todavía: golpeando accidentalmente a un compañero que estaba demasiado cerca. Pero esa era parte de la diversión. Entre rugidos, pisotones, colas gigantes y espadazos cargados, la coordinación del grupo fue apareciendo poco a poco. Uno atraía la atención de un monstruo, mientras los demás buscaban atacar por los costados o aprovechar alguna caída para descargar golpes poderosos sobre sus patas y su enorme joroba. La pelea fue frenética, agotadora y espectacular. Cada Duramboros parecía resistirse hasta el último momento, como si el pantano fuera su territorio sagrado y nosotros fuéramos intrusos que debían ser expulsados. Pero cuatro cazadores armados con espadones no se rinden fácilmente. Tras una batalla llena de carreras, curaciones rápidas, golpes fallidos y ataques brutales, finalmente los dos monstruos cayeron. La victoria se sintió incluso mejor porque no fue una cacería perfecta: fue una batalla desordenada, intensa y divertida, de esas que solo se disfrutan jugando con compañeros. Después de terminar la misión, nos tomamos una foto frente al enorme cuerpo de uno de los Duramboros derrotados. La imagen refleja muy bien el momento: los cuatro cazadores reunidos, con las armas todavía en mano, rodeados por el pantano y la luz atravesando los árboles, como si el escenario mismo reconociera nuestra victoria. Fue una simple misión de matanza en Monster Hunter Portable 3rd, pero también fue una demostración de compañerismo, valentía y pura adrenalina. Cuatro cazadores, cuatro gran espadas y dos Duramboros: una combinación que convirtió una tarde de juego en una cacería memorable.

> ###
English
Hello, Hive gaming community! Monster Hunter Portable 3rd is one of those games capable of transforming a simple quest into an anecdote that will be remembered for years. It doesn't matter how many times a monster has been hunted, or how much gear each player has: when four hunters come together with the intention of completing a difficult mission, the result can turn into a full-blown battle. That's exactly what happened during our hunt in the swamp, where we faced no less than two Duramboros. From the start, the mission promised to be intense. The swamp was the perfect setting for the confrontation: a damp, dark, and wild place, with enormous trees, pools of water, and an atmosphere that made it feel like monsters could appear from any corner. In the middle of that landscape, the four hunters organized themselves with a decision as simple as it was dangerous: we would all go with a greatsword, or a greatsword, as you prefer to call it. There were no bows for ranged attacks, no hammers for stunning, and no swords and shields for playing it safe. Just four giant weapons, four hunters, and the will to cut down anything that stood in their way. The arrival of the first Duramboros was enough to understand that this wouldn't be a quiet mission. Its enormous body, heavy tail, and characteristic spins were a constant threat. Every time it started to rotate, we all had to run, dodge, and find a safe position before rejoining the attack. However, the real madness began when the second Duramboros appeared in the area. Having two of those beasts at the same time turned the swamp into absolute chaos. There were blows everywhere. Sometimes someone would charge their greatsword with all the confidence in the world, only for a Duramboros to move at the last second, sending the attack flying. Or worse: accidentally hitting a teammate who was too close. But that was part of the fun. Between roars, stomps, giant tails, and charged sword strikes, the group's coordination slowly began to emerge. One of us drew the attention of a monster, while the others looked to attack from the sides or take advantage of any fall to unleash powerful blows on its legs and enormous hump. The fight was frenetic, exhausting, and spectacular. Each Duramboros seemed to resist until the very last moment, as if the swamp were its sacred territory and we were intruders who had to be expelled. But four hunters armed with greatswords don't give up easily. After a battle full of running, quick healings, missed blows, and brutal attacks, the two monsters finally fell. The victory felt even sweeter because it wasn't a perfect hunt: it was a chaotic, intense, and fun battle, the kind you only enjoy playing with friends. After finishing the mission, we took a picture in front of the enormous body of one of the defeated Duramboros. The image perfectly captures the moment: the four hunters together, weapons still in hand, surrounded by the swamp and the light filtering through the trees, as if the landscape itself acknowledged our victory. It was a simple killing mission in Monster Hunter Portable 3rd, but it was also a demonstration of camaraderie, courage, and pure adrenaline. Four hunters, four greatswords, and two Duramboros: a combination that turned an afternoon of gaming into a memorable hunt.

body.title: Sunday Strength & Good Energy 💪🌿 / Domingo de Fuerza y Buena Energía 💪🌿
body.body:
![img_1726-93c4f63bb744.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/avilaluze/lkt-mtgbx9yf-70wz4m3w/img_1726-93c4f63bb744.webp)

Ending the week with a little time for myself at the gym. 💪✨ Some days I come here feeling super motivated, and other days I have to convince myself to get moving, but I almost always leave feeling better than when I arrived.

Something I've learned is that progress isn't only about what we see in the mirror. It's also noticing that an exercise feels easier, lifting a little more than before, having more energy, or simply realizing that you've managed to stay consistent. Those little victories count too. 🥰

As a nutritionist, I know how easy it is to focus only on numbers: weight, calories, measurements... but our health is so much more than that. Eating well and exercising should help us feel stronger and healthier, not become another source of pressure in our lives. 🌿

I'm still working on my own goals, learning along the way and reminding myself that I don't need to rush. There will always be something to improve, so I prefer to enjoy the process instead of waiting for some \

result to finally feel proud.

Workout done, mirror selfie taken 🤭📸 and now it's time to enjoy the rest of my Sunday. 💚✨

>Terminando la semana con un ratito para mí en el gym. 💪✨ Hay días en los que llego súper motivada y otros en los que tengo que convencerme a mí misma de ponerme en movimiento, pero casi siempre termino saliendo sintiéndome mejor que cuando llegué.

>Algo que he aprendido es que el progreso no solamente se trata de lo que vemos frente al espejo. También está en notar que un ejercicio ya cuesta menos, poder cargar un poquito más que antes, tener más energía o simplemente darte cuenta de que has logrado mantenerte constante. >Como nutrióloga sé lo fácil que puede ser concentrarnos únicamente en los números: peso, calorías, medidas... pero nuestra salud es muchísimo más que eso.
