body.title: 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 31.08.2026
body.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uEuuRSMK5UtxZqGS92AyoaiSKJdbhbFq4g29Q44cX4yjwuCKJURnmhCqFgr1rzG1K9z.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 31.08.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uEucZ87edcaL5trpk1hvsHrpMm8PdyxdyY1x3r34Xs8sdRB4CKcUuc5zEQYtApF5BV3.jpg)

---

## 📰 NEWS

### ***Anthropic ostrzega — infostealery kradną sesje Claude i wyczerpują limity użytkowania***

Anthropic wysyłał ostrzeżenia do użytkowników: infostealery (Vidar, LummaC2, StealC, RedLine, Acreed na Windows i AMOS na Mac) kradną aktywne sesje przeglądarki — w tym sesje Claude — bez konieczności znajomości hasła czy 2FA (bo sesja jest już uwierzytelniona). Atakujący używają skradzionych sesji do konsumowania limitów użycia Claude na koszt ofiary lub do uzyskania dostępu do prywatnych rozmów. Anthropic unieważnia przejęte sesje i refunduje nieautoryzowane opłaty. Kluczowy przekaz: problem nie leży w Claude lecz w infostealerze na komputerze ofiary. Sprawdź czy nie masz złośliwego oprogramowania — wylogowanie z Claude nie wystarczy jeśli malware nadal działa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uRGA2W8uFUWeGzPsbdS5w1MvUd3Wxuoq1spNKLdJgnbMpFxLUkYqQFHq8x4UrWovTjn.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/artificial-intelligence/anthropic-warns-infostealer-malware-is-hijacking-claude-sessions-to-drain-usage/) [EN]*

---

### ***Hakerzy po ataku na myDr zapowiadają \
***\n\nDobreprogramy opisują niepokojące oświadczenie grupy odpowiedzialnej za wyciek myDr: hakerzy na forach przestępczych opublikowali zapowiedź \

niż myDr. Nie podali szczegółów celu. To może być element psychologicznego nacisku (eskalacja strachu wzmacnia wartość posiadanych danych do sprzedaży) lub realna zapowiedź. W każdym razie: polskie organizacje, szczególnie z sektorów zdrowia, finansów i administracji publicznej, powinny traktować to jako sygnał do natychmiastowej weryfikacji stanu zabezpieczeń.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23ynKvJdaWVimZvUT65vh5c8U7WakWthbntnywBpYEaskp5f791eSRsXcV41TGKNV23XS.png)

*Źródło: [Dobreprogramy](https://www.dobreprogramy.pl/hakerzy-po-ataku-na-mydr-zapowiadaja-cos-jeszcze-wiekszego,7324037613398048a) [PL]*

---

### ***FulcrumSec potwierdza włamanie do Manchester Airports — 86 GB danych***

BleepingComputer ujawnia: grupa FulcrumSec przyznała się do ataku na Manchester Airports Group i twierdzi, że skradła 86 GB danych — w tym dane personalne 8,7 miliona podróżnych z trzech lotnisk (Manchester, East Midlands, Stansted). Security Affairs potwierdza skalę wycieku. To jeden z największych wycieków danych lotniskowych w historii Europy — podróżni, których dane zostały skradzione, powinni spodziewać się wysoce spersonalizowanego phishingu \

.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23zS9kVnvzYZPkk11qsuVg8ZY3DyUAAtin7JuK28dCd4DFz1b7N1g2nAwJnCQ8H4R3Xya.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/fulcrumsec-claims-manchester-airports-hack-theft-of-86-gb-of-data/) [EN]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Rozszerzenia Chrome wykradają kryptowaluty i dane przeglądarki***

BleepingComputer i Socket.dev opisują nową kampanię złośliwych rozszerzeń Chrome Web Store: kilkanaście rozszerzeń podszywających się pod narzędzia do produktywności i bezpieczeństwa wykrywało i eksfiltrował dane portfeli kryptowalutowych, klucze prywatne i ciasteczka sesyjne z przeglądarki. Kampania dotknęła użytkowników posiadających kryptowaluty — łączne straty szacowane na miliony dolarów. Google usunął rozszerzenia po ujawnieniu. Audytuj zainstalowane rozszerzenia Chrome przez chrome://extensions/ i usuń wszystkie, których nie używasz aktywnie.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23vrtNg6BY8WLdpzw4Z3EYBeHaM2cdFjTQSxMEbXirynGhas8V6iubzsX1BYs6UQBuZ2Q.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/chrome-web-store-extensions-caught-stealing-crypto-browser-data/) [EN]*

---

### ***Wyciek danych Love Electric — próbka wygląda wiarygodnie, skala incydentu niepewna***

Security Bez Tabu opisuje domniemany incydent bezpieczeństwa w Love Electric — polskiej sieci salonów fitness i wellness: na forach przestępczych pojawiła się próbka danych przypisywana wycieko z Love Electric, zawierająca dane klientów (imiona, e-maile, numery telefonów). Autentyczność i skala incydentu są weryfikowane — firma nie wydała jeszcze oficjalnego komunikatu. Artykuł opisuje metodologię weryfikacji twierdzonych wycieków i apeluje o ostrożność wobec niepotwierdzonych doniesień przy jednoczesnej czujności.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uEupbryc5cGXWFnMeFpGcFHLP2hTZgcUrRTXEjVnkwLp9RLjq9d1VUVSi7Kkpp8tjKn.png)

*Źródło: [Security Bez Tabu](https://securitybeztabu.pl/domniemany-wyciek-danych-love-electric-probka-wyglada-wiarygodnie-lecz-skala-incydentu-nadal-niepewna/) [PL]*

---

### ***Atak setek agentów AI na infrastrukturę Hugging Face — analiza i nowe wyzwania***

Security Bez Tabu publikuje polską analizę incydentu Hugging Face (opisywanego przez BleepingComputer i CySecurity News w poprzednich dniach): 700 skoordynowanych agentów AI działało jak zdecentralizowany zespół hakerski z podziałem ról. Artykuł analizuje implikacje dla bezpieczeństwa platform AI, konieczność izolacji środowisk testowych i monitoring zachowań agentycznych w czasie rzeczywistym. To najlepsza polska analiza techniczna incydentu, warta lektury dla zespołów bezpieczeństwa wdrażających systemy AI.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23t7hNbJEwuLrWVCDEFYVoJyNqMSGmXQ5TLaTz7xRBMnCmrRG2gjE1G2vB3BnQqdgB9vQ.png)

*Źródło: [Security Bez Tabu](https://securitybeztabu.pl/atak-setek-agentow-ai-na-infrastrukture-hugging-face-analiza-incydentu-i-nowe-wyzwania-dla-cyberbezpieczenstwa/) [PL]*

---

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***mLegitymacja dla uczniów w mObywatelu — jak aktywować***

Benchmark.pl opisuje praktycznie nową funkcję mObywatela: mLegitymacja szkolna — cyfrowy odpowiednik tradycyjnej legitymacji ucznia, dostępny w aplikacji mObywatel dla uczniów szkół podstawowych i ponadpodstawowych. Artykuł opisuje krok po kroku procedurę aktywacji przez szkołę i przez ucznia. CyberDefence24 opisuje pilotaż eDziennika w szkołach. To element szerszej cyfryzacji oświaty — wchodzącej w życie wraz z nowym rokiem szkolnym 2026/2027.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23z7SbiFjpAdjJd6NoXQv2dyQACBNdEg3g3FvSSvj47Bp7zmsMR6VBndq2qPtCUqcFR6P.png)

*Źródło: [Benchmark.pl](https://www.benchmark.pl/mobywatel-i-mlegitymacja-dla-uczniow-jak-ja-aktywowac-7323310677604416a) [PL]*

---

### ***Mało kto o tym wie — sprawdź czy twój smartfon ma te ukryte funkcje bezpieczeństwa***

Benchmark.pl opisuje mało znane funkcje bezpieczeństwa wbudowane w popularne smartfony: tryb \

(kilkukrotne wciśnięcie przycisku zasilania wywołuje SOS lub blokuje biometrię), bezpieczny folder (szyfrowany obszar dla wrażliwych aplikacji na Samsung), indywidualne hasła do aplikacji i automatyczne usuwanie danych po przekroczeniu liczby prób. Artykuł jest szczególnie przydatny w kontekście rosnących ataków fizycznych na użytkowników kryptowalut i smartfonów opisywanych przez cały 2026 rok.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uEyxYwXGBd2smMne3fVsLuHodVUEXfapfBCaKJcvapayigsvNemtDY4G3dajaWkAG8C.png)

*Źródło: [Benchmark.pl](https://www.benchmark.pl/malo-kto-o-tym-wie-sprawdz-czy-twoj-smartfon-ma-te-funkcje-7322229417335168a) [PL]*

---

## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***Brave browser dodaje aliasy e-mail — ochrona przed śledzeniem***

Benchmark.pl i Telepolis opisują nową funkcję przeglądarki Brave: wbudowane generowanie aliasów e-mail przy rejestracji na stronach — zamiast podawać prawdziwy adres e-mail, Brave generuje unikalny alias przekierowujący do prawdziwej skrzynki. Gdy alias zacznie być zaśmiecany spamem lub trafiony w wyciek — można go po prostu wyłączyć. To znacznie wygodniejsza implementacja niż dotychczasowe rozwiązania (Apple Hide My Email, SimpleLogin) — bo nie wymaga opuszczenia przeglądarki.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23vhwLYui9sYurTixtBx7RE8NpKbvuduZHjRro4eFfEtsYgXtvkSkCghcm1JsbzaNXFZZ.png)

*Źródło: [Benchmark.pl](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/brave-browser-adds-email-aliases-to-help-users-evade-tracking/) [EN], [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/aplikacje/brave-e-mail-do-rejestracji) [PL]*

---

### ***Oszukują na Vinted z pomocą AI — platforma radzi sprzedającym***

Benchmark.pl opisuje nową generację scamów na Vinted: kupujący (lub w rzeczywistości chatbot AI) prowadzi idealnie płynną rozmowę z zainteresowanym zakupem, buduje zaufanie, a następnie sugeruje płatność poza platformą przez \

serwis zewnętrzny — który jest fałszywy. AI eliminuje wcześniejszą barierę językową i bezbłędność komunikacji, przez co scamy są znacznie trudniejsze do rozpoznania. Platforma Vinted apeluje: zawsze płać przez wbudowany system płatności Vinted — nigdy poza nim. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u5ZEeh8WssvHvsvJ3e6nmUfMH1mCwTbviUGp4domjsjVvGNjXeVudHuZ6zE4DDu5MfS.png) *Źródło: [Benchmark.pl](https://www.benchmark.pl/oszukuja-na-vinted-z-pomoca-ai-platforma-radzi-co-powinni-zrobic-sprzedajacy-7321904249977024a) [PL]* --- ## 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER ВОЙНА ### ***Rosyjskojęzyczni hakerzy używali Cursor AI do cyberataków*** CySecurity News opisuje odkrycie badaczy: rosyjskojęzyczna grupa przestępcza używała Cursor AI — popularnego edytora kodu z wbudowanym AI — do generowania i modyfikowania złośliwego oprogramowania. Cursor jest narzędziem deweloperskim z bezpośrednim dostępem do modeli AI, które pomagają pisać i poprawiać kod — w tym, jak się okazuje, kod złośliwy. To kolejny dowód na konwergencję narzędzi AI dla deweloperów z ofensywnym bezpieczeństwem: narzędzia zaprojektowane dla produktywności programistów są używane do tworzenia malware. https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg5MRfwVp9g0r6Jrv5kmMjEdps-u9JwsZ1Sj_1fhha4ewKNri-4PBP6TPobEQoFUbzUhor9Sskx-CJNEG_727-j1lHuIyjkUQP6AxsDf9lEYYfrt3-PWk6h1TA4TMlZbcyKbkNYKyUZPzRF9dgbC6Gw_Z6bPrZc65Jy6Rqawi-o9JQOtl6RbIC2cqwbGbZC/w640-h426/ransomware-2320941_1280.jpg *Źródło: [CySecurity News](https://www.cysecurity.news/2026/08/russian-speaking-hackers-used-cursor-ai.html) [EN]* --- ### ***Anthropic tnie limity Claude Code o 17% — powody i implikacje*** BleepingComputer opisuje decyzję Anthropic o redukcji tygodniowych limitów Claude Code o 17%: firma uzasadnia ją rosnącym obciążeniem serwerów spowodowanym m.in. przejętymi sesjami opisywanymi w dzisiejszym numerze i potrzebą zapewnienia równego dostępu dla wszystkich użytkowników. Dla profesjonalnych deweloperów używających Claude Code intensywnie — zmiana jest odczuwalna. Anthropic zapowiada zwiększenie infrastruktury w Q4 2026 i przywrócenie pełnych limitów. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tkovYu99f2YVBSn1hZrEBpQhDmrs4z3338B3a3PLFsR5XQYxJoqyUhcz6VjucdKvQoK.png) *Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/artificial-intelligence/anthropic-is-cutting-claude-codes-current-weekly-limits-by-17-percent/) [EN]* ----- *📅 Powyższe zestawienie ma charakter wyłącznie informacyjny i edukacyjny. Wszystkie informacje opierają się na publicznie dostępnych doniesieniach prasowych z dnia 30 sierpnia 2026 r. ⚠️ W razie podejrzenia incydentu bezpieczeństwa skonsultuj się z wykwalifikowanym specjalistą.*

body.title: El misterio de lo ya vivido: ¿Qué hay detrás del déjà vu?
body.body: ¡Hola a todos en la hermosa comunidad de Holos & Lotus! Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una reflexión sobre un fenómeno que me ha acompañado y fascinado desde que tengo uso de razón: el famoso déjà vu.\n​¿Les ha pasado alguna vez que están en medio de una conversación cotidiana o caminando por un lugar nuevo y, de repente, una sacudida mental los detiene en seco? Es esa voz interna que susurra con absoluta certeza: “Espera... esto ya lo viví. Yo ya estuve aquí, escuché estas mismas palabras y vi exactamente esta misma escena”.\n​A mis 24 años, siento que he escuchado hablar de esta sensación toda mi vida. De niña solía pensar que se trataba de algún poder místico, una conexión con vidas pasadas o un chispazo de intuición sobre el futuro. Sin embargo, mi curiosidad me llevó a indagar en la psicología y la neurociencia para entender qué ocurre realmente en nuestra mente cuando experimentamos esta vívida sensación de \
.\n​Investigando en lecturas sobre psicología cognitiva, descubrí que lejos de ser un fenómeno paranormal, el déjà vu es una especie de fascinante \

de nuestro propio cerebro. En términos sencillos, se trata de una pequeña desincronización en la forma en que procesamos la información y almacenamos los recuerdos.
​Existen varios factores psicológicos y neurológicos que explican esta experiencia:
​El retraso en el procesamiento sensorial: Imaginen que la información del entorno entra a nuestro cerebro por dos vías distintas. Si una de esas vías se retrasa tan solo un milisegundo por fatiga o distracción, el cerebro recibe el mismo dato dos veces consecutivas. Al procesar la segunda entrada, la interpreta no como algo nuevo, sino como un recuerdo del pasado.
​Falso reconocimiento en el lóbulo temporal: Esta región cerebral es la encargada de otorgar la sensación de familiaridad. A veces, esta zona se activa de forma aislada antes de que las áreas de la memoria consciente puedan verificar si realmente existe un recuerdo previo. El resultado es que sentimos una profunda familiaridad sin tener una memoria real que la respalde.
​Memoria implícita de patrones: Nuestro cerebro es una máquina experta en buscar patrones. Si entramos a una habitación con una distribución de muebles o una iluminación similar a un lugar de nuestra infancia, el cerebro detecta la geometría del espacio y la clasifica como \

, aunque jamás hayamos pisado ese lugar específico.
​Desde mi perspectiva personal, aprender la explicación científica no le restó poesía ni magia al asunto; al contrario, aumentó mi asombro. Me parece profundamente fascinante cómo un desfase de microsegundos en nuestras redes neuronales es capaz de alterar por completo nuestra percepción de la realidad.
​El déjà vu nos recuerda lo compleja, maravillosa y delicada que es la mente humana. Es un pequeño recordatorio de que no siempre podemos confiar ciegamente en lo que percibimos, y que nuestro cerebro trabaja incansablemente en segundo plano para construir el mundo que experimentamos día a día.
​Y ustedes, amigos de Holos & Lotus, ¿con qué frecuencia experimentan esta sensación? ¿Cómo la interpretan en sus vidas? ¡Los leo en los comentarios!

![IMG_20260731_223804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrealove/23xyNhH4rTBrEZZ79si8sxw6HZRVozfu1hwyeCF8KJqrTJJe7CpUn28RytN8biCcen1fZ.jpg)

links.title: MOVIE REVIEW: “The Dog Stars” (2026)
links.body:
[IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt21285562/mediaviewer/rm110021890)
**Synopsis**: *Colorado. United States. After a virus establishes a pandemic situation that decimated most of humanity, an airplane pilot (and his dog) struggle to survive amid what they know as the “new world” (which hides some new dangers)*. The feeling of losing the “timing” when choosing to release certain types of movies seems to me to be a constant for some types of filmmakers already widely known for other works. The most recent case is precisely this new project, which was “randomly” directed by **Ridley Scott**, where the entire plot (which is an adaptation of the book of the same name written by **Petter Heller**) is based on a post-apocalyptic scenario (and which strongly reminded me of certain Westerns from the golden age of American cinema... especially in the portrayal of some of the antagonists).
[Los Angeles Times](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/movies/story/2026-08-26/ridley-scott-director-dog-stars-alien-blade-runner-gladiator-artificial-intelligence-ai)
[Polygon](https://www.polygon.com/the-dog-stars-review-ridley-scott/)
There is a peculiarly interesting cinematography in many aspects, and which to a certain extent is very immersive within a narrative framework because it makes assertive use of its characters. This “shaped” my view of what I was watching, because the mixtures of cinematic genres with places that dialogue so well with each other was a determining factor. There are two lines that blend together... The surrealist drama, and a western atmosphere. I didn't imagine this choice would work so well, but the script establishes (and develops) it with great care. In the plot (which is set in Colorado), in a post-apocalyptic world, after an unknown virus exterminated a part of all humanity, a pandemic that was naturally established. This determined that only a portion of humanity would survive; but simultaneously, some other dangers were mysteriously “personified” in the presence of ruthless raiders. Fighting them brings a type of real and immediate danger to the new society (but which is almost always presented in an episodic manner, with the parts hardly ever linked to one another as part of something larger).
[Yahoo!](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/movies/articles/jacob-elordi-goes-full-action-194515776.html)
[Polygon](https://www.polygon.com/the-dog-stars-review-ridley-scott/)
The protagonist Hig (a pilot who survived the flu, but lost his wife) is a kind of “wandering vigilante”, who, to defend himself, makes constant aerial patrols (always accompanied by his faithful friend, who is a dog) with the goal of maintaining the safety of the place where he lives. Many miles away lives Bangley, a former military man with a strong and pessimistic personality, but who is always armed and extremely paranoid. Ironically, they are close friends and share common goals, leading them to fight for the same ideal through distinct ways of thinking and acting. Although they are two people with personalities that are completely opposite, they maintain a genuine friendship even within a reality troubled by the dangers surrounding them. This is precisely the strongest “point of connection” in the entire screenplay, which is to establish (and explore) the essence of its characters. **Jacob Elordi** and **Josh Brolin** are respectively good in their roles (which are very well constructed and feature layers explored with very apparent complexity), but Brolin captures the spotlight by being a stronger supporting actor.
[Movie Freak](https://moviefreak.com/dog-stars-2026-movie-review/)
[D23](https://d23.com/ridley-scott-and-josh-brolin-on-the-dog-stars-and-what-it-means-to-remain-human-after-the-end-of-the-world/)
Alongside them are **Guy Pearce** and **Margaret Qualley** (however, with less expressiveness in their performances). There is also the (unexpected, but very assertive) presence of Allison Janney, who is inserted at a rather “peculiar” moment within the narrative in its even more “dystopian” part. The supporting cast is competent, but the duo formed by the friends Hig and Bangley (Elordi and Brolin) emulates the strongest emotional and physical conflicts of the plot with greater fidelity. The first has the soul of an explorer, while the second is brutally methodical and systematic. Technically, I really liked the work that was done here. Starting with the cinematography itself, which alternates between post-apocalyptic settings (such as destroyed and abandoned places or places “swallowed up” by vast vegetation and various animals) and beautiful rocky landscapes (which are captured through aerial angles that are always very dynamic). There is also a strong concern with good special effects, well-aligned scene editing and a great soundtrack. The aesthetic look brings the past into conversation with the present (and the future) in a “dialogue” that is tragically inspiring.
[Adoro Cinema](https://www.adorocinema.com/noticias/filmes/noticia-1000219870/)
[Yahoo!](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/movies/articles/jacob-elordi-goes-full-action-194515776.html)
***The Dog Stars*** is that type of survival movie in post-apocalyptic settings that arrived, at the very least, some 10 to 15 years late on the Hollywood “timeline” (compared to the major successes of that era). Therefore, it is not a project of great impact, and which ironically was Scott's own choice (who here, did not bring anything particularly compelling in his directing style... but it is still a decent work); however, without creating an identity of its own. Despite being captivating entertainment at times, it is easily very “forgettable”. ---
**CRÍTICA DE PELÍCULA: “La Constelación del Perro” (2026)**
**Sinopsis**: *Colorado. Estados Unidos. Después de que un virus estableciera una situación pandémica que diezmó a la mayor parte de la humanidad, un piloto de avión (y su perro) luchan por sobrevivir en medio de lo que conocen como “mundo nuevo” (y que esconde algunos nuevos peligros)*. La sensación de perder el “timing” al elegir lanzar determinados tipos de películas me parece ser una constante para algunos tipos de cineastas ya ampliamente conocidos por otros trabajos. El caso más reciente es justamente este nuevo proyecto, que fue “aleatoriamente” dirigido por **Ridley Scott**, donde toda la trama (que es una adaptación del libro homónimo escrito por **Petter Heller**) se basa en un escenario posapocalíptico (y que me recordó mucho a algunas películas antiguas del oeste de la época dorada del cine estadounidense... principalmente en la caracterización de algunos antagonistas). Hay una cinematografía peculiarmente interesante en muchos aspectos, y que hasta cierto punto es muy inmersiva dentro de una construcción narrativa porque utiliza de manera acertada a sus personajes. Eso “moldeó” mi visión sobre lo que estaba viendo, porque las mezclas de géneros cinematográficos con lugares que dialogan tan bien entre sí fue un factor determinante. Hay dos líneas que se mezclan... El drama surrealista, y una atmósfera de western. No imaginé que esa elección fuera a funcionar tan bien, pero el guion lo establece (y desarrolla) con buen cuidado. En la trama (que está ambientada en Colorado), en un mundo posapocalíptico, después de que un virus desconocido exterminara a una parte de toda la humanidad, una pandemia que naturalmente se estableció. Esto definió que solo una parte de la humanidad sobreviviría; pero simultáneamente, algunos otros peligros fueron misteriosamente “personificados” en la presencia de saqueadores despiadados. Luchar contra ellos trae a la nueva sociedad, un tipo de peligro real e inmediato (pero que casi siempre se muestra de manera episódica, sin estar casi nunca conectados entre sí como algo mayor). El protagonista Hig (un piloto que sobrevivió a la gripe, pero perdió a su esposa) es una especie de “justiciero errante”, que para defenderse, realiza constantes rondas aéreas (siempre en compañía de su fiel amigo, que es un perro) con el objetivo de mantener la seguridad del lugar donde vive. A muchos kilómetros de allí vive Bangley, un exmilitar de personalidad fuerte y pesimista, pero que siempre está armado y es extremadamente paranoico. Irónicamente, son grandes amigos y tienen objetivos en común que los llevan a luchar por el mismo ideal mediante formas de pensar y actuar distintas. Aunque son dos personas con personalidades que son totalmente opuestas, mantienen una relación genuina de amistad aun dentro de una realidad perturbada por los peligros que los rodean. Ese es justamente el “punto de conexión” más fuerte de todo el guion, que es establecer (y explorar) la esencia de sus personajes. **Jacob Elordi** y **Josh Brolin** están respectivamente bien en sus papeles (que están muy bien construidos y presentan capas exploradas con una complejidad muy evidente), pero Brolin acapara los reflectores por ser un secundario más fuerte. Junto a ellos, están **Guy Pearce** y **Margaret Qualley** (sin embargo, con menos expresividad en sus interpretaciones). También está la (inesperada, pero muy acertada) presencia de **Allison Janney**, que es insertada en un momento bastante “peculiar” dentro de la narrativa en su parte aún más “distópica”. El elenco de apoyo es competente, pero el dúo formado por los amigos Hig y Bangley (Elordi y Brolin) emula con mayor fidelidad los conflictos emocionales y físicos más fuertes de la trama. El primero tiene alma de explorador, mientras que el segundo es brutalmente metódico y sistemático. Técnicamente, me gustó mucho el trabajo que se hizo aquí. Comenzando por la cinematografía en sí, que alterna entre escenarios posapocalípticos (como lugares destruidos y abandonados o “devorados” por una vasta vegetación y diversos animales) y hermosos paisajes rocosos (que son captados por ángulos aéreos que son siempre muy dinámicos). También hay una preocupación acentuada por buenos efectos especiales, una edición de escenas bien alineada y una excelente banda sonora. La estética presenta el pasado dialogando con el presente (y el futuro) en um “diálogo” que resulta trágicamente inspirador. ***La Constelación del Perro*** es ese tipo de película de supervivencia en escenarios posapocalípticos que llegó, como mínimo, unos 10 a 15 años tarde en la “línea temporal” hollywoodense (en comparación con los grandes éxitos de aquella época). Por lo tanto, no es un proyecto de gran impacto, y que irónicamente fue una elección del propio Scott (que aquí, no aportó nada de estimulante en su manera de dirigir... pero aun así es un trabajo decente); sin embargo, sin crear una identidad propia. A pesar de ser un entretenimiento cautivador por momentos, es fácilmente muy “olvidable”. ---
**CRÍTICA DE FILME: “Ponto Sem Retorno” (2025)**
**Sinopse**: *Colorado. Estados Unidos. Após um vírus estabelecer uma situação pandêmica que dizimou a maior parte da humanidade, um piloto de avião (e seu cachorro) lutam para sobreviver em meio ao que eles conhecem como “mundo novo” (e que esconde alguns novos perigos)*. O sentimento de perder o “timing” ao escolher lançar determinados tipos de filmes me parece ser uma constante para alguns tipos de cineastas já amplamente conhecidos por outros trabalhos. O caso mais recente é justamente este novo projeto, que foi “aleatoriamente” dirigido **Ridley Scott**, onde toda à trama (que é uma adaptação do livro homônimo escrito por **Petter Heller**) se baseia em um cenário pós-apocalítico (e que me lembrou muito antigos alguns filmes de faroeste da época de ouro do cinema americano... principalmente na caracterização de alguns antagonistas). Há uma cinematografia peculiarmente interessante em muitos aspectos, e que até certo ponto é muito imersiva dentro de uma pavimentação narrativa porque utiliza de maneira assertiva os seus personagens. Isso “modelou” à minha visão sobre o que eu estava assistindo, porque as misturas de gêneros cinematográficos com lugares que dialogam tão bem entre si foi um fator determinante. Há duas linhas que se misturam... O drama surrealista, e uma atmosfera de faroeste. Não imaginei que essa escolha fosse funcionar tão bem, mas o roteiro estabelece (e desenvolve) isso com boa cautela. Na trama (que é ambientada no Colorado), em mundo pós-apocalíptico, após um vírus desconhecido exterminar uma parta de toda a humanidade, uma pandemia que naturalmente foi estabelecida. Isso definiu que apenas uma parte da humanidade sobreviveria; mas simultaneamente, alguns outros perigos foram misteriosamente “personificados” na presença de saqueadores impiedosos. Lutar contra eles traz para a nova sociedade, um tipo de perigo real e imediato (mas que quase sempre é mostrado de maneira episódica, sem quase nunca estarem ligados entre si como algo maior). O protagonista Hig (um piloto sobreviveu à gripe, mas perdeu a esposa) é uma espécie de “justiceiro errante”, que para se defender, faz rondas aéreas constantes (sempre na companhia do seu fiel amigo, que é um cachorro) com o objetivo de manter a segurança do local onde ele vive. Há muitos quilômetros dali vive Bangley, um ex-militar de personalidade forte e pessimista, mas que está sempre armado e é extremamente paranoico. Ironicamente, eles são grandes amigos e tem objetivos em comum, que os levam a lutar pelo mesmo ideal através de modos de pensar e agir que são distintos. Embora eles sejam duas pessoas com personalidades que são totalmente opostas, eles mantêm uma genuína relação de amizade ainda que dentro de uma realidade conturbada pelos perigos que os cercam. Esse é justamente o “ponto de conexão” mais forte de todo o roteiro, que é estabelecer (e explorar) a essência dos seus personagens. **Jacob Elordi** e **Josh Brolin** estão respectivamente bem seus papéis (que são muito bem construídos, e trazem camadas exploradas com uma complexidade muito aparente), mas Brolin capta os holofotes por ser um coadjuvante mais forte. Ao lado deles, estão **Guy Pearce** e **Margaret Qualley** (porém, com menos expressividade em suas performances). Ainda há a (inesperada, mas muito assertiva) presença de **Allison Janney**, que é inserida em um momento bastante “peculiar” dentro da narrativa em sua parte ainda mais “distópica”. O elenco de apoio é competente, mas a dupla formada pelos amigos Hig e Bangley (Elordi e Brolin) emula com mais fidelidade os conflitos emocionais e físicos mais fortes da trama. O primeiro tem uma alma de explorador, enquanto segundo é brutalmente metódico e sistemático. Tecnicamente, eu gostei muito do trabalho que foi feito aqui. Começando pela cinematografia em si, que alterna entre cenários pós-apocalípticos (como lugares destruídos e abandonados ou “engolidos” por uma vasta vegetação e animais diversos) e belas paisagens rochosas (que são captadas por ângulos aéreos que são sempre muito dinâmicos). Há uma preocupação acentuada também com bons efeitos especiais, edição de cenas bem alinhada e uma ótima trilha sonora. O visual estético traz o passado conversando com o presente (e o futuro) num “diálogo” que é tragicamente inspirador. ***Ponto Sem Retorno*** é aquele tipo de filme de sobrevivência em cenários pós-apocalípticos que chegou, no mínimo, uns 10 a 15 anos atrasado na “linha temporal” hollywoodiana (em comparação aos grandes sucessos daquela época). Logo, não é um projeto de grande impacto, e que ironicamente foi uma escolha do próprio Scott (que aqui, não trouxe nada de instigante no seu modo de dirigir... mas ainda sim é um trabalho decente); porém, sem criar uma identidade própria. Apesar de ser um entretenimento cativante em alguns momentos, é facilmente muito “esquecível”. _Rating: **70/100**_ --- _Originally posted through [scrobble.life/movies](https://scrobble.life/review/wiseagent/movie-review-the-dog-stars-2026-mtg9aypn)._

links.title: La Rutina de Glúteos que Realmente Me Funciona: Enfoque, Cargas Pesadas y Pausas / The Booty Workout That Actually Works: Focus, Heavy Weights, and Pauses
links.body:
Hoy quiero compartirles en detalle la rutina de entrenamiento de glúteos que me ha dado los mejores resultados en mi proceso en el gimnasio. Después de probar diferentes métodos, entendí que para ver un crecimiento real y una mejor forma no se trata de hacer mil ejercicios con poco peso, sino de priorizar la sobrecarga progresiva, la tensión mecánica y la técnica en movimientos compuestos heavy.
Mi enfoque principal está en la intensidad y en las repeticiones con pausa en la fase de máxima tensión. Aquí les comparto la estructura de mi entrenamiento:
Sentadilla Péndulo (Pendulum Squat): Mi ejercicio estrella. Me enfoco en mantener un rango profundo de movimiento con repeticiones pausadas abajo para maximizar la activación del glúteo.
Peso Muerto Sumo (Sumo Deadlift): Fundamental para la cadena posterior. Trabajo con cargas pesadas cuidando la postura para empujar con la cadera en cada repetición.
Sentadilla Hack (Hack Squat) / Prensa (Leg Press): Varío entre ambas para mantener la tensión constante en las piernas y glúteos sin fatigar la zona lumbar.
Mi consejo: No le tengan miedo a entrenar pesado. La clave no es la prisa, sino sentir la conexión mente-músculo en cada repetición y mantener la disciplina semana tras semana.
(English)
Hello everyone in the community!
Today I want to share the exact glute workout routine that has delivered the best results in my fitness journey. After trying different methods, I realized that real growth and shape come from heavy compound lifts, progressive overload, and high mechanical tension—not endless low-weight reps.
My main focus is on intensity and paused repetitions at the point of maximum tension. Here is the core breakdown of my workout:
Pendulum Squats: My ultimate favorite. I focus on a deep range of motion with paused reps at the bottom to maximize glute activation.
Sumo Deadlifts: Essential for the posterior chain. I lift heavy while maintaining solid form, driving with the hips on every rep.
Hack Squats / Leg Press: I rotate these to keep constant tension on the glutes and legs without putting excess strain on the lower back.
My tip: Don't be afraid to lift heavy. The key isn't speed, but feeling the mind-muscle connection on every single rep and staying consistent week after week.

links.title: The Summit Draws Near.
links.body: https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=izuki.midoriya/rbc3gf2h\n\n<div class=\

>

Advancing past an enemy outpost on Mount Hagen, we fought off a sudden ambush. After Sadie suffered a bad stab wound, Charles stayed behind to tend to her while I pushed ahead alone using a shotgun and collecting supplies from fallen guards on my way to Micah.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZj6uCUHUEYV9RU7UYERx6apzErqFFj4EaDR4KcqKtE9F/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPo85i6XV4Mr39RXDdWN9fMzyVMixd36CWrXqnC8CwWdC/screenshot_2_.png)

Realizing the area below was just a forward patrol post rather than the main camp, we prepared to climb higher up the mountain.

Driven by the single goal of reaching Micah, we pushed forward through the harsh terrain, only to be met by another heavy wave of his men attempting to block our path.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSKGD32mXo84dpjPnTy1xzTpfpTDPHG3zzQg42b81Z6pY/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaqSS41fTXcW1FKupzSjqFR3bNwYHYD2egJF4rM5x4aaC/screenshot_4_.png)

I charged ahead into the gunfire, firing continuously as we gained ground against the defensive line.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfwmD7ZT6ZxM3g7wxAprViaKKmkbVmFsZvq5r9q8Ns5N/screenshot_5_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRDyNKCYe8HrTqrbdPJmg3Rx8VT5qSfqjCnLLCYr5D93/screenshot_6_.png)

During the chaos of the push, two enemies tackled us. One tackled John into the snow while the other lunged directly at Sadie with a blade. John began hammering away at his attacker, but the second enemy managed to stab Sadie deeply before a gunshot rang out from behind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4ukHeqYzqpm9dzSKpdv9yRtpLiVvf7r7UyBwuyRpQmJ/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV9zTVQt1rCPu5rhWFGLWgGRCXhLYdpaU1sdvcbqNRmzA/screenshot_8_.png)

Charles, having pushed through his own injuries to follow us up the trail, shot the attacker in the back just in time.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTBJUgnfPictZDZR1k3YEVJxj9y63gbK7Hp6ifu1Y7dLE/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVaTLYLjeedQuosJ421SASCj2waawb9VZWiC15FXH13ER/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWtphnqnA3Wg5AkXqacgdAoxvMpQkqr1qyQ3d3DzEkoBH/screenshot_11_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRx1XPp5TTrcamMUpZnTcQuD2tJvbs7jbtU8rGvgDz9T/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbTb5GTXfzWXTx4VDmJ2vyP4R6Kdknkvn3XEUUd3tfQbU/screenshot_13_.png)

Sadie was bleeding heavily from the stab wound, yet she stubbornly insisted the injury was nothing serious. Knowing the reality of her condition, she urged John to push forward alone to handle Micah while Charles stayed by her side to provide aid.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf6wZfc85GB3ojn1P16trLpdDLM6PgJyYFg324mRscygE/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcwBRiKGU4WeveUn2yCAbjJNRmHb7JejFHTfVXGuLowMJ/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUPRvu8bHQx9nZsFJx3W1QTP62Xo54H5QtTWYMWTY8Lh/screenshot_16_.png)

Moving ahead on my own, another group of guards stepped out to cut me off, but I drew my shotgun and began blowing them away at point-blank range, and cleared the path through the dense enemy line.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcbeP6SdqMDmFn5guaVvrUhwuKbTJx3JSTwKMfW8AVsz/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZrcUFYmQeRHEjxDJ5TN9Sme1WhKA26MvwAkvTx7ZtoQm/screenshot_18_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5AG7KwAxUC57EpfjoXGxDDHpgixgaDKkDakejLZsyai/screenshot_19_.png)

As I crested a small rise, a guard lunged from the shadows to force a fistfight. Uninterested in wasting time with hand-to-hand combat, I raised my firearm and put a single round directly through his head.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPDJZSzz5tur9R3qnQEHrHQEZKjwQ5ZUND6SSTkcineST/screenshot_20_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYv8vrPeAPzCT25J2fsnzNgAzuVuXyURkkEqiujzKwx2H/screenshot_21_.png)

I swapped back to the shotgun, tearing through the remaining hostiles positioned along the ridge.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKe7pcH7RXy6C3GsrqZL7cLdTBJw7W83dBGbdxgzQVjt/screenshot_22_.png)

Pausing between firefights, I scavenged the fallen bodies along the trail to restock my supply of health and Dead Eye tonics, preparing for the final confrontation waiting at the top of the mountain.

links.title: A Clean Environment: By Law or By Choice?
links.body: Recycling is a responsibility we all as humans must take up in order for us to make our world a safe haven, and that's because when it comes to protecting our environment, we must see it as a shared responsibility that's not only aimed at making our environment neat but also at safeguarding ourselves from the negative effect of leaving our waste to roam around our street, ocean, and the like. But then, given the importance of recycling and the impact it makes, should it be made compulsory by the government for all individuals? ![1000442923.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23vsJNGvB8jKuSz3pWuU6rJ4iQDF2cicF24HuJvKpR4Pr2roJFdrCXSqjPWU2fZCpCym2.png) Without a doubt we all know that recycling helps reduce waste and limit the amount of rubbish in our waterways, such as gutters, and overall it helps conserve resources. But then, even though it's a good thing to do and can be considered a noble cause, I don't think it should be made mandatory by the government, because governments, after all, are the ones who allow these to thrive, and had they placed a ban on certain products packaged in plastic, we wouldn't be in this mess today, so rather than making it compulsory for everyone to do, they should look for other ways to encourage people to partake in recycling activities. Besides, making it compulsory can raise questions about people's privacy, freedom, and proportionality. The best way to go about this is basically to encourage people on the importance of recycling and the need to collectively join hands in doing it as people who want the best for themselves. And that's why encouragement is the way to go, encouraging responsible waste disposal. Encouragement can be done in many ways, for instance, creating awareness about the dangers of improper waste disposal and the benefits of proper waste disposal and recycling, and rather than trying to punish those who don't properly dispose of waste, the government should create a kind of incentive system for those who partake in the journey towards making our environment safe again. Take for instance we've seen nations that build different waste collector machines in different parts of the society, and when you take your waste to this machine, you get a kind of incentive in the form of cash or a coupon that can be used to get anything you want. Doing this has led to many delving actively into the waste disposal business, whereby they literally go into different places where rubbish is to gather them so as to take it to the machine and get paid, and even though they're doing it for the money, they're still indirectly cleaning the environment and making waste recycling possible. ![1000772771.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23x1DBQCWJyNEVs5g4AnY8QJ6Y834cGT7HKthRFfEn2WtGpLnjonoZaZezx5P4Y4HhbY7.png) Even though I said government shouldn't punish people for not participating in recycling activities, this does mean people should not face consequences for irresponsible waste disposal. Take, for instance, at least it's well known that as citizens we must dispose of our waste properly, so we won't let our community just because we want to dispose of waste, nor should one be engaging in waste burning that gives room for hazardous carbon into our air/environment. So when someone doesn't dispose of waste properly, let them face the wrath of the law, if it's a fine or jail time. I remember seeing someone get arrested in Lagos a few months ago for driving to a part of the road, parking his vehicle, and disposing of his waste by the roadside. Thankfully, he was recorded by a concerned citizen, which led to the man's arrest. So that's the way to go. When we know that the fate of our society is in our hands, we'll be able to take responsibility and partake in everything that makes our environment clean and allows recycling to be done easily. And one way to go about it is that it doesn't end with you personally disposing of your own waste properly; also encourage others to do the same, and when you notice someone doing the opposite, cry out so that they'll know what you're doing is wrong and can be collectively chastised by the community people or allowed to face the consequences of their actions. *** All photos are downloaded on canva app. ***

links.title: Confeccionando pequeños pececitos flotadores de nailon. (Esp/Eng)
links.body:
# Español

# Saludos, amigos amantes de las manualidades.💁☀️ 
¡Feliz domingo para todos!

En estos días he querido darle una nueva utilidad al nailon, aprovechándolo mediante el tejido para crear pequeñas manualidades. Por eso quise realizar unos pequeños pececitos flotadores para obsequiárselos a mis pequeños primitos.

Los invito a que me acompañen a conocer el paso a paso de estos mini pececitos tejidos¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![1000020766.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQvaMkWg7jZSpBN57EnqGxDVzrhZcrYMfMRWCQYmDLMeQdTPaw6NiqqhVameW58vBNN.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨MATERIALES
#
<center>
![1000020748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AK3frcxUSHRUJSgZ5C25DPFn8rfgQtbxkRNqhzsSmMz3hhnQNaUFkku1vWACXQX.jpg)
</center>
#
• Nailon en diferentes colores: negro, rosado, blanco y azul.
• Tijeras.
• Aguja de crochet.
• Aguja de coser a mano.
• Aguja de tejer.
• Poliespuma para el relleno.

# ✨MODO DE CONFECCIÓN

Antes de iniciar, preparé todos mis materiales. En este caso, tomé el nailon y lo corté de forma continua, formando tiras delgadas que luego enrollé alrededor de un pequeño cartón para obtener mis carretes de nailon, con los que iba a trabajar.

✨PASOS PARA CONFECCIONAR EL CUERPO DEL PECECITO
#
<center>
![1000020753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCG5hbiN5Utv6ssAtCuXEyEmUBbuWhHcYUrNbs4nWZ44b9kMJ3GsvUY7L9T7SwjbocD.jpg)
</center>
#
Para iniciar, hice una cadeneta de 5 eslabones y cerré con punto deslizado, formando así el primer aro.

Dentro de esta cadeneta de 5 eslabones subí con una cadeneta de 2 eslabones y tejí 7 medias varetas.

En la siguiente vuelta realicé un aumento en cada una de las medias varetas de la vuelta anterior, obteniendo así 14 medias varetas.

En la próxima vuelta tejí 2 medias varetas y 1 aumento, repitiendo esta secuencia hasta completar la vuelta.

En la vuelta siguiente tejí 1 media vareta en cada uno de los puntos de la vuelta anterior, sin realizar aumentos ni disminuciones. Hasta aquí tenemos realizadas las primeras 4 vueltas del cuerpo.
#
<center>
![1000020758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tvkT58nxuGbn5eY8PR7DWH7mLGmHLHQ5zfWUAqe55hSAT6WmD2D9Qsk89tQrpc398Dp.jpg)
</center>
#
Para la quinta vuelta cambié al color azul. Subí con una cadeneta de 2 eslabones, tejí 1 media vareta y en el siguiente punto realicé un aumento, es decir, 2 medias varetas en el mismo punto.

Continué repitiendo 1 media vareta y 1 aumento hasta completar toda la vuelta.

Desde la vuelta número 6 hasta la vuelta número 9 continué tejiendo de forma similar, pero sin realizar aumentos ni disminuciones, manteniendo la misma cantidad de puntos.

En la vuelta número 10 comencé con las disminuciones. Tejí 1 media vareta y 1 disminución, repitiendo esta secuencia hasta completar la vuelta.

En la vuelta siguiente tejí manteniendo la misma cantidad de puntos.

En la vuelta posterior continué con las disminuciones, realizando 1 media vareta y 1 disminución. Continué de esta forma durante dos vueltas.

Después seguí realizando disminuciones de forma continua hasta dejar un pequeño espacio de aproximadamente 6 medias varetas sin tejer.

Luego doblé el pez a la mitad y, por el pequeño espacio que había quedado abierto, coloqué la poliespuma que previamente había desintegrado en pequeños pedacitos para utilizarla como relleno.

Una vez relleno, cerré el cuerpo del pececito.

✨PASOS PARA CONFECCIONAR LA COLA
#
<center>
![1000020759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tmMvrSstoyEWZphinoLR5FEJyxZKFDLBLKxzkmUNDPq4yzw7t6VGo7SwcpEnCLKCiVd.jpg)
</center>
#
Sin cortar el trabajo, desde esta misma zona continué tejiendo la cola del pez.

Para confeccionar la cola, subí con una cadeneta de 3 eslabones y, en ese mismo espacio, tejí 3 medias varetas.

Continué en los otros tres espacios, realizando también 3 medias varetas en cada uno. Al finalizar esta primera vuelta de la cola, cerré con punto deslizado.

Luego giré el tejido y subí con una cadeneta de 2 eslabones. Realicé 1 media vareta y después 3 cadenetas. Bajé nuevamente y realicé otra media vareta, continuando de esta misma forma en cada uno de los espacios anteriores hasta formar la cola.

Finalmente cerré con punto deslizado.

✨PASOS PARA CONFECCIONAR LAS ALETAS

Para realizar la aleta superior, trabajé a partir de la segunda vuelta del color azul, en la parte superior del pez.

Subí con una cadeneta de 3 eslabones y, en ese mismo espacio, tejí 3 varetas. Luego pasé al segundo espacio y tejí nuevamente 3 varetas. Después pasé al tercer espacio y realicé otras 3 varetas.

De esta forma quedaron formados tres grupitos de 3 varetas cada uno.

Al finalizar los tres grupos, tejí 2 cadenetas y bajé en el siguiente espacio, cerrando con punto deslizado. De esta forma quedó conformada la aleta superior.

Para realizar la aleta inferior, seguimos una forma similar a la superior, pero podemos hacerla un poco más pequeña. Para ello podemos utilizar medias varetas en lugar de varetas completas.

Para las dos aletas de los costados, escogemos un espacio en cada uno de los laterales del cuerpo del pez, procurando que queden aproximadamente enfrentadas.

En cada uno de estos espacios comenzamos con 1 media vareta, continuamos con 3 varetas y terminamos con 1 media vareta. Finalmente cerramos con punto deslizado.

El tamaño de estas aletas puede variar dependiendo del grosor del nailon, el ancho de las tiras y el tamaño de la aguja utilizada.

✨PASOS PARA REALIZAR LA BOCA

Con una aguja de coser y nailon rojo, vamos pasando el nailon alrededor del primer arito, donde iniciamos el tejido, hasta formar la boca del pez.

✨PASOS PARA REALIZAR LOS OJOS

Después dejamos una vuelta de separación y, en una vuelta antes de llegar al color azul, cambiamos el nailon rojo por nailon negro.

Con una aguja de coser vamos decorando de forma similar para formar los dos ojos del pececito.

Finalmente ocultamos todos los pequeños restos de nailon que hayan quedado después de cortar las hebras.
#
<center>
![1000020760.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u69VBS5xz6uwzv93rfeHJyhtgt3MgWUQ21fNX8fMdWs3YscrEWPndDZS86iyetb4QnJ.jpg)
</center>
#
Y así quedan terminados nuestros pequeños pececitos de nailon.

Amigos, me encantó cómo quedaron estos pequeños pececitos y, sobre todo, ver cómo mis primitos enseguida se animaron a colocarlos en el agua para ver cómo flotaban.
#
<center>
![1000020765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQtNcQ4RUK1fwfbf7wnxcj8wYEjirSZHW745FSKgRC9uN9qXde9JndezjuThSE1jXYB.jpg)
</center>
#
Como pueden ver, es una manualidad para los pequeños de casa, especialmente para quienes son amantes de los pececitos y no tienen una pecera. También pueden utilizarse como llaveros, para decorar mochilas o para otros usos que ustedes quieran darle.

Espero que les haya gustado. Nos vemos pronto. ¡Un abrazo!💁🌈

Fotografías propias.

*** 
# English
# Making Small Floating Fish from Nylon
# Greetings, friends who love crafts.💁☀️
Happy Sunday to everyone!

These days I have wanted to give nylon a new use, making the most of it through crochet to create small crafts. That is why I decided to make some little floating fish to give as gifts to my little cousins.

I invite you to join me and discover the step-by-step process for making these mini crocheted fish.Let's begin!
#
<center>
![1000020766.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQvaMkWg7jZSpBN57EnqGxDVzrhZcrYMfMRWCQYmDLMeQdTPaw6NiqqhVameW58vBNN.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨MATERIALS
#
<center>
![1000020748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AK3frcxUSHRUJSgZ5C25DPFn8rfgQtbxkRNqhzsSmMz3hhnQNaUFkku1vWACXQX.jpg)
</center>
#
• Nylon in different colors: black, pink, white, and blue.
• Scissors.
• Crochet hook.
• Hand-sewing needle.
• Knitting needle.
• Foam for filling.

# ✨HOW TO MAKE THEM

Before starting, I prepared all my materials. In this case, I took the nylon and cut it continuously into thin strips, which I then wound around a small piece of cardboard to make my little nylon spools, which I would use for crocheting.

✨STEPS TO MAKE THE FISH BODY
#
<center>
![1000020753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCG5hbiN5Utv6ssAtCuXEyEmUBbuWhHcYUrNbs4nWZ44b9kMJ3GsvUY7L9T7SwjbocD.jpg)
</center>
#
To begin, I made a chain of 5 stitches and joined it with a slip stitch, forming the first ring.

Inside this 5-chain ring, I chained 2 stitches and worked 7 half double crochets.

On the next round, I made an increase in each of the half double crochets from the previous round, giving me a total of 14 half double crochets.

On the next round, I worked 2 half double crochets and 1 increase, repeating this sequence until the round was completed.

On the following round, I worked 1 half double crochet in each stitch from the previous round, without making any increases or decreases. At this point, the first 4 rounds of the fish body are complete.
#
<center>
![1000020758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tvkT58nxuGbn5eY8PR7DWH7mLGmHLHQ5zfWUAqe55hSAT6WmD2D9Qsk89tQrpc398Dp.jpg)
</center>
#
For the fifth round, I changed to blue. I chained 2 stitches, worked 1 half double crochet, and in the next stitch made an increase, meaning 2 half double crochets in the same stitch.

I continued repeating 1 half double crochet and 1 increase until the entire round was completed.

From rounds 6 through 9, I continued crocheting in the same way, but without increases or decreases, maintaining the same number of stitches.

On round 10, I began making decreases. I worked 1 half double crochet and 1 decrease, repeating this sequence until the round was completed.

On the following round, I worked the same number of stitches.

On the next round, I continued with the decreases, working 1 half double crochet and 1 decrease. I continued this way for two rounds.

Then I continued making decreases until leaving a small opening of approximately 6 unworked half double crochets.

I then folded the fish in half and, through the small opening that remained, added the foam that I had previously broken into small pieces to use as filling.

Once it was filled, I closed the body of the fish.

✨STEPS TO MAKE THE TAIL

<center>
![1000020759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tmMvrSstoyEWZphinoLR5FEJyxZKFDLBLKxzkmUNDPq4yzw7t6VGo7SwcpEnCLKCiVd.jpg)
</center>

Without cutting the yarn, I continued crocheting the fish tail from the same area.

To make the tail, I chained 3 stitches and, in the same space, worked 3 half double crochets.

I continued in the other three spaces, also working 3 half double crochets in each one. At the end of this first round of the tail, I joined with a slip stitch.

Then I turned the work and chained 2 stitches. I worked 1 half double crochet and then made a chain of 3 stitches. I went down again and made another half double crochet, continuing in the same way in each of the previous spaces until the tail was formed.

Finally, I joined with a slip stitch.

✨STEPS TO MAKE THE FINS

To make the upper fin, I worked starting from the second round of the blue section, on the upper part of the fish.

I chained 3 stitches and, in the same space, worked 3 double crochets. Then I moved to the second space and worked another 3 double crochets. After that, I moved to the third space and worked another 3 double crochets.

This creates three groups of 3 double crochets each.

At the end of the three groups, I chained 2 stitches and joined in the next space with a slip stitch. This forms the upper fin.

To make the lower fin, we follow a similar method, but it can be made slightly smaller. For this, we can use half double crochets instead of full double crochets.

For the two fins on the sides, we choose one space on each side of the fish body, making sure they are approximately opposite each other.

In each of these spaces, we begin with 1 half double crochet, continue with 3 double crochets, and finish with 1 half double crochet. Finally, we join with a slip stitch.

The size of these fins may vary depending on the thickness of the nylon, the width of the strips, and the size of the hook used.

✨STEPS TO MAKE THE MOUTH

With a sewing needle and red nylon, we pass the nylon around the first ring where we began the crochet work, forming the fish's mouth.

✨STEPS TO MAKE THE EYES

Then we leave one round of space and, one round before reaching the blue section, we change from red nylon to black nylon.

Using a sewing needle, we decorate in a similar way to form the fish's two eyes.

Finally, we hide all the small pieces of nylon left after cutting the strands.
#
<center>
![1000020760.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u69VBS5xz6uwzv93rfeHJyhtgt3MgWUQ21fNX8fMdWs3YscrEWPndDZS86iyetb4QnJ.jpg)
</center>
#
And this is how our little nylon fish are finished.

Friends, I loved how these little fish turned out and, above all, seeing how my little cousins immediately wanted to put them in the water to see how they floated.
#
<center>
![1000020765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uQtNcQ4RUK1fwfbf7wnxcj8wYEjirSZHW745FSKgRC9uN9qXde9JndezjuThSE1jXYB.jpg)
</center>
#
As you can see, this is a craft for the little ones at home, especially for children who love fish but don't have an aquarium. They can also be used as keychains, to decorate backpacks, or for any other use you would like to give them.

I hope you liked it. See you soon! A big hug!💁🌈

 Own photographs.

links.title: La Rutina de Glúteos que Realmente Me Funciona: Enfoque, Cargas Pesadas y Pausas / The Booty Workout That Actually Works: Focus, Heavy Weights, and Pauses
links.body:
Español)
¡Hola a todos en la comunidad!
Hoy quiero compartirles en detalle la rutina de entrenamiento de glúteos que me ha dado los mejores resultados en mi proceso en el gimnasio. Después de probar diferentes métodos, entendí que para ver un crecimiento real y una mejor forma no se trata de hacer mil ejercicios con poco peso, sino de priorizar la sobrecarga progresiva, la tensión mecánica y la técnica en movimientos compuestos heavy.
Mi enfoque principal está en la intensidad y en las repeticiones con pausa en la fase de máxima tensión. Aquí les comparto la estructura de mi entrenamiento:
Sentadilla Péndulo (Pendulum Squat): Mi ejercicio estrella. Me enfoco en mantener un rango profundo de movimiento con repeticiones pausadas abajo para maximizar la activación del glúteo.
Peso Muerto Sumo (Sumo Deadlift): Fundamental para la cadena posterior. Trabajo con cargas pesadas cuidando la postura para empujar con la cadera en cada repetición.
Sentadilla Hack (Hack Squat) / Prensa (Leg Press): Varío entre ambas para mantener la tensión constante en las piernas y glúteos sin fatigar la zona lumbar.
Mi consejo: No le tengan miedo a entrenar pesado. La clave no es la prisa, sino sentir la conexión mente-músculo en cada repetición y mantener la disciplina semana tras semana.
(English)
Hello everyone in the community!
Today I want to share the exact glute workout routine that has delivered the best results in my fitness journey. After trying different methods, I realized that real growth and shape come from heavy compound lifts, progressive overload, and high mechanical tension—not endless low-weight reps.
My main focus is on intensity and paused repetitions at the point of maximum tension. Here is the core breakdown of my workout:
Pendulum Squats: My ultimate favorite. I focus on a deep range of motion with paused reps at the bottom to maximize glute activation.
Sumo Deadlifts: Essential for the posterior chain. I lift heavy while maintaining solid form, driving with the hips on every rep.
Hack Squats / Leg Press: I rotate these to keep constant tension on the glutes and legs without putting excess strain on the lower back.
My tip: Don't be afraid to lift heavy. The key isn't speed, but feeling the mind-muscle connection on every single rep and staying consistent week after week.

body.title: ‎🧠 Sometimes Your Biggest Upgrade Isn’t More Money — It’s Your Thinking
body.body:
‎Hello Hives,
‎
‎There was a time when I believed that making more money would automatically solve most of my problems.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPb7zjUrLzvbqrrRjf5SziJPmm2EAN757q8P534T2axXX/IMG_20260319_092838_584.jpg 

‎I thought, “If my income can just increase, things will become easier.”
‎
‎And honestly, money does make some things easier. We all need money to survive, pay bills, take care of our families and pursue the things we want in life.
‎
‎But as I have grown, I have realized that money is not always the real problem.
‎
‎Sometimes, it’s the way we think.
‎
‎You can increase your income and still make the same poor decisions.
‎
‎You can earn more and still spend everything you have.
‎
‎You can get a better job and still be unhappy.
‎
‎You can have more opportunities around you and still be too afraid to take them.
‎
‎That’s when I started understanding that personal growth is not only about what enters your bank account. It is also about what changes inside your head.
‎
‎A better mindset can make you look at the same situation differently.
‎
‎Instead of seeing every difficult moment as punishment, you start seeing it as something you can learn from.
‎
‎Instead of reacting immediately whenever someone annoys you, you learn to calm down first.
‎
‎Instead of comparing yourself with people who seem to be ahead of you, you start focusing on your own journey.
‎
‎And one thing I have learned is that not every situation deserves a reaction.
‎
‎Sometimes, keeping quiet is better.
‎
‎Sometimes, walking away is better.
‎
‎Sometimes, taking a few hours to clear your head before making a decision can save you from a lot of regret.
‎
‎That, to me, is also an upgrade.
‎
‎We often celebrate visible things. Someone buys a new car, builds a house, gets a better job or starts making more money, and we call it progress.
‎
‎But there are other forms of progress that nobody sees.
‎
‎Being more patient.
‎
‎Thinking before speaking.
‎
‎Learning from your mistakes.
‎
‎Managing your money better.
‎
‎Choosing peace over unnecessary arguments.
‎
‎Having the courage to start again after something fails.
‎
‎Those things may not look impressive on social media, but they can completely change a person's life.
‎
‎So yes, I want to make more money. I want to achieve my goals and improve my standard of living.
‎
‎But I also want to keep improving the person behind those goals.
‎
‎Because a bigger income is good, but a better way of thinking can help you make better use of that income.
‎
‎Sometimes, the next upgrade we need is not in our wallet.
‎
‎But, it's in our mindset.
‎
‎
‎**Thanks for Reading**
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎
‎

body.title: Why Being a Beginner Is Actually an Advantage
body.body:

body.title: Comparing prices of some Foodstuffs due to Excessive Rain fall
body.body:
Hello Hivers!

Shopping for foodstuffs from the bush market during the weekend is one of my favorite activities. This time around shopping did not go as planned due to my health condition. After my discharge from the hospital, my doctor strictly advised that I do not engage in any kind of stressful activity as this might be detrimental to my health. 

Well, shopping from the bush market is actually a bit stressful but fun. It is stressful in the sense that one has to walk from corner to corner and from one long section to another to pick foodstuffs. 

Also, pricing foodstuffs here in my locality is a thing, one cannot just arrive at a particular goods stand, pick goods, ask for their prices and pay immediately without bargaining, this is so because goods and services from the bush market are not plastered with fixed prices. That is to say that goods can be bargained and bought at a favourable price convenient for both the buyer and the seller. 

I love to bargain prices of goods each time I go to the market. Personally, I cannot buy anything from the market without bargaining because most times market women are fond of hiking prices of their goods especially when they look at one's appearance and feel the person is wealthy, they will just add about N200 to N500 away from the normal price of the goods.

Due to my health condition, I could not go to the market myself and my mum went instead of me. She bought so many things from the market but their prices were alarming as compared to recent prices in the past months.


![IMG_20260829_133501_628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23wX5gswa23zmaymHym32EsjZG4m8UDDLnEqad1z2PSLPSBT24ezTrXXp7ps8DuQgUJzD.jpg)


*Plantain*

Amongst what my mum bought, were four pieces of small plantain which was sold at N2,500, whereas this same quantity of plantain was sold at N200 two years ago and was even sold at N500 a few months ago. I asked my mum why plantain was so expensive and she told me that there were no plantains due to wind and excessive rainfall experienced in this part of the world.

Mum further analysed that plantain seem to have become a foodstuff meant for only the rich because if someone went to the market with just N3,000, hoping to buy plantain and some other ingredients to cook at home, he or she will not be able to afford plantain this season because the money will not even be enough to buy the plantain and the other ingredients needed to cook.

My mum further lamented that she only bought this plantain as a result of my cravings for it. That left only for her, she would wait until we enter into the plantain season before she buys plantain or she would wait for the one she has in her farm to yield fruit before plantain can be cooked in the house because the price of an ordinary plantain is too high.


![IMG_20260829_133303_518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/Ep7tDUTwvmjsE2jsnSPTyktZ7iCiWnmwXZrEu7KpQsrSDjrs6z3S81bot5G8ueinFgk.jpg)

*other things she bought*

Apart from plantain, Mama bought other foodstuffs like crayfish, ekporoko also known as stockfish, periwinkle, fresh leaves for soup, fresh brisket bones, seasoning cubes, garri also known as cassava flakes and lots more. The prices of most things she bought had increased by N200 or N300.


![IMG_20260829_133515_411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23z7Dudv3hFGVT4HrD9qj8Y2WWAxo12Todm7GtBnKaTx7NQscmrJNJ8oioXGsU45Pdqkf.jpg)

*waterleaf*

The price of this waterleaf is also alarming as its price had risen from a bundle at N100 to a bundle at N700. I asked mum if these prices could not be bargained and she told me that she had bargained the price but the market women refused to sell to her, leaving her with no choice than to buy at the rate of N700 for one bundle. This made us use one bundle of waterleaf to cook a big pot of soup instead of the normal four or five bundles.
 
The prices of waterleaf had also been hiked due to excessive rain fall and this is not getting any funny. Farmers prayed for the rain to come and in the beginning they were all enjoying it but now, everyone seems to be crying because the rain is getting heavier, it comes along with heavy wind and becoming more frequent as the day goes by, thereby causing erosion and killing many crops.

In all, we were able to buy some necessary foodstuffs needed at the market and we are grateful.

Paraguay tiene una cultura que no se encuentra en ningún otro lugar, y hoy quiero compartir algo que encontré.

Lo que encontré me hizo reflexionar: Tradiciones de Viernes Santo se mantienen vivas en Paraguay La Nación. La cultura paraguaya tiene una profundidad que merece ser reconocida y valorada por todos nosotros.

Un dato interesante: Noche de San Juan: las pruebas, rituales y tradiciones que sobreviven en Misiones, el Litoral y Paraguay MisionesOnline. La cultura paraguaya es mucho más profunda de lo que parece. Cuando uno se pone a investigar, se da cuenta de que hay siglos de historia detrás de cada tradición.

Lo que me llamó la atención: Día del Folclore, tradiciones e identidad nacional: ¿Qué Paraguay queremos recordar o representar? ultimahora.com. Son esas cosas que te hacen valorar más lo que tenemos. Paraguay no es solo un país de paso, es un lugar con identidad propia.

Encontré algo que no esperaba: Carrulim: siete tragos sostienen un antiguo rito que cada agosto renueva la tradición El Nacional - El diario de los lectores influyentes. Eso me hizo pensar en lo poco que conocemos de nuestro propio país. Paraguay tiene una historia tan rica que siempre hay algo nuevo por descubrir.

Un dato interesante: ➡️Estudiantes formoseños celebraron el Día de la Independencia bailando el Pericón Nacional instagram.com. La cultura paraguaya es mucho más profunda de lo que parece. Cuando uno se pone a investigar, se da cuenta de que hay siglos de historia detrás de cada tradición.

Lo que me gusta de la cultura paraguaya es que siempre hay algo nuevo por aprender.

Cada dato que descubro sobre Paraguay me hace pensar en lo mucho que queda por aprender. La cultura paraguaya tiene una profundidad que merece ser explorada, compartida y valorada por todos los que vivimos aquí.

Lo que más me gusta de investigar sobre Paraguay es que siempre encontrás algo que no sabías.

Lo que descubrí hoy me confirmó algo que ya sabía: Paraguay es un país que merece ser reconocido por su riqueza cultural. No somos un punto pequeño en el mapa, somos una nación con historia, identidad y futuro. Y eso es algo que todos deberíamos sentir con orgullo.

A veces olvidamos que la identidad se construye con memoria. Escuchar a los abuelos, recorrer los pueblos, aprender palabras en guaraní: todo eso suma. Paraguay no es solo lo que vemos hoy, es todo lo que vino antes y nos sostiene.

Lo que más me gusta de investigar sobre Paraguay es que siempre encontrás algo que no sabías.

Lo que más valoro de investigar sobre Paraguay es que cada dato me conecta más con mis raíces. La historia del país es fascinante, y merece ser conocida por todos nosotros. No se trata solo de datos viejos, sino de una historia viva que se vive cada día en las calles, en la gente, en las tradiciones.

¿Qué opinás sobre este tema? Me encantaría leer tu punto de vista.

body.title: Television Review: Paradise (Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, S2x15, 1994)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/moLXafwf54K35lYfKyAsCGZMFWr.jpg)

**Lower Decks (S70E15)**

Airdate: 13 February 1994

Written by: Jeff King, Richard Manning and Hans Beimler
Directed by: Corey Allen 

Running Time: 46 minutes



Star Trek has long been celebrated for its optimistic vision of humanity's future, built upon Gene Roddenberry's utopian ideals where poverty, war, and prejudice had been largely eliminated. However, after Roddenberry's passing, his successors demonstrated a more nuanced understanding of human nature and history, recognising that even well-intentioned utopian concepts could give rise to dystopian horrors when taken to extremes. One of the most explicit explorations of this tension in Star Trek's canon occurs in the Season 2 episode of Deep Space Nine, titled *Paradise*. This episode not only presents a compelling narrative set far from the familiar space station setting but also delivers one of the series' most thoughtful examinations of the relationship between humanity and technology.

The episode opens with Commander Benjamin Sisko and Chief Miles O'Brien aboard the runabout *Rio Grande*, engaged in routine exploration of planets near the wormhole that would become the show's most significant narrative device. Their mission takes them to Orellius, an M-class planet showing promising signs of human colonisation. They discover not only traces of habitation but evidence of actual human life. However, their attempts to contact the colonists fail mysteriously, with O'Brien speculating that interference might be caused by a duonetic field. He and Sisko decide to beam down to establish contact directly.

When they arrive on the planet, they face a disorienting reality: all their advanced technology has ceased to function. Their combadges, tricorders, and phasers are rendered useless by the same mysterious field that blocked their communications. Their first encounter is with two men who introduce themselves as Joseph (Steve Vinovich) and a young man named Vinod (Michael Buchman Silver). They lead Sisko and O'Brien to a settlement built around the wreckage of the *SS Santa Maria*, a transport ship that had vanished ten years earlier. The apparent colonists, it turns out, are survivors of this mysterious crash. Their leader and Vinod's mother, Alixus (Gail Strickland), explains that the duonetic field, apparently caused by metallic sediments in nearby swamps, prevented them from calling for help, using replicators, or any modern technology. Forced to fend for themselves, they had survived through hard work and built what Alixus describes as a thriving community, complete with children born on the planet.

What makes this settlement remarkable is how most of the castaways, Joseph included, appear genuinely content with their situation and proud of their achievements. Their community represents a genuine attempt to create an alternative way of life. However, the episode subtly reminds us that life without modern technology also carries inherent dangers. The fatal illness of young woman named Meg (Lisa Madigan), who had been bitten by a local insect, demonstrates these risks. When Meg's condition deteriorates, O'Brien and Sisko suggest contacting the *Rio Grande* for medical supplies, explaining that they might be able to circumvent the duonetic field. Alixus, however, is adamant that they use only natural remedies, revealing a philosophical difference that would soon become more significant.

Alixus reveals herself to be a philosopher who, prior to the incident, advocated for the abolition of technology, which she believed had made humans \

Her new community on Orellius appears to be the realisation of her long-held ideals. However, as the episode progresses, Sisko begins to see the dark side of their utopia. When one of the men is accused of stealing a candle and punished by being placed in a metal box, Sisko recognises this as excessive and punitive. Sensing Sisko's scepticism, Alixus attempts to win him over through manipulation rather than genuine persuasion. She sends Cassandra (played by Julia Nickson), attractive female castaway, to seduce him, but Sisko reacts with disgust at what he perceives as a calculated attempt to break his resolve.

The tension reaches its peak when Alixus orders Sisko to abandon his Starfleet uniform and replace it with locally made clothes. When Sisko refuses, Alixus has him placed in the box, leaving him to reflect on the true nature of their community. Meanwhile, back on the runabout, Lieutenant Jadzia Dax and Major Kira Nerys, searching for their missing colleagues, discover the *Rio Grande* has been remotely set to fly away from the planet.

On the planet, O'Brien finally uncovers the truth about the duonetic field. Through an improvised compass, he discovers that the field is not natural but artificially created. He overpowers Vinod, who reveals himself to be complicit in Alixus's deception, and switches off the generator. Once the field is disabled, his phaser begins to function again, and he uses it to free Sisko from the box. With technology restored, Sisko and O'Brien contact Dax and Kira, who beam down to arrest Alixus and Vinod for sabotage and manslaughter. They offer the castaways the opportunity to return to civilisation, but to everyone's surprise, the former colonists choose to stay with Joseph, explaining that they prefer their community and way of life.

*Paradise* holds significant importance in Star Trek: Deep Space Nine as the first episode with its plot entirely taking place outside the station. This was one of many such experiments that would become increasingly common throughout the series' run, allowing exploration of diverse environments and narrative possibilities.

While the general premise of rejecting technology, drawing from Luddite primitivist movements appearing in future centuries, had already been explored in Star Trek's original series episode [*The Way to Eden*](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-the-way-to-eden-star-trek-s3x20-1969), the similarities are superficial at best. Producer Michael Piller had been inspired by experiences of a family member involved in a cult, while also drawing inspiration from the anti-technological stance of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia. Gail Strickland's performance as Alixus creates a ruthless cult-like leader in many ways modelled after Jim Jones, but with subtle differences that make her character unique.

The script ultimately finds a balanced view on the idea of rejecting technology. While it acknowledges that for some, like Joseph, technology can do \

it also demonstrates that such rejection must be based on truth and free choice, rather than maintained through deception and used for manipulation, coercion, and tyranny. The episode doesn't definitively condemn technophobia nor does it glorify technological dependency. Instead, it presents a nuanced understanding that both approaches have their merits and limitations.\n\n*Paradise* also benefits immensely from excellent work by Avery Brooks, who rarely had opportunities to act as a major protagonist. His performance shines particularly in scenes of conflict with Alixus, especially during his time in the \

His portrayal captures stubborn idealist who fight oppression, making comparisons to Alec Guinness in [*The Bridge at the River Kwai*](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-the-bridge-on-the-river-kwai-1957) and Paul Newman in [*Cool Hand Luke*](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-cool-hand-luke-1967-l7g) entirely appropriate. Brooks brings a physicality to his performance that grounds the philosophical arguments in human experience, making the episode's themes resonate on an emotional level rather than remaining purely intellectual.

Despite some potential improvements through trimming of segments featuring Dax and Kira, *Paradise* is a very good piece of Star Trek that successfully explores complex themes about human nature, technology, and the nature of utopia. Its thoughtful approach to these topics, combined with strong performances and a compelling narrative, makes it one of the standout episodes of Deep Space Nine's second season.


RATING: 8/10 (+++)
