body.title: MLB:  Chourio histórico..!  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
body.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Recuerdo como si fuera ayer la pretemporada del 2024. Corrían muchas noticias en los campos de entrenamiento, pero la de mayor expectativa creada alrededor de ella, fue la contratación de un jugador novato por US$ 82 millones y ocho temporadas con los Cerveceros de Milwaukee sin haber lanzado una bola con el equipo grande. El jardinero Jackson Chourio, primo de Ronald Acuña Jr. y originario de \

, tomó el primer turno de su carrera el segundo día de la temporada. Habían suspendido el primer juego por lluvia y los Twins jugarían doble cartelera con los Cerveceros. El novato tomaría una base por bolas como primera aparición al plato y robaría la segunda base. Un debut apenas notorio pero entregaba indicios de lo que sería su futuro. Tenía 19 años y 5 meses, cuando comenzó a coleccionar registros históricos. 17 hombres han bateado +20 jonrones en cada una de sus primeras 3 temporadas y solo dos de ellos lo hicieron con menos edad que Chourio. Si el muchacho se roba 6 bases antes que culmine la campaña, se convertirá en el único ser humano en lograr 3 campañas 20 Hr - 20 Br, antes de cumplir los 22 años. Esperemos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     I remember Spring Training 2024 like it was yesterday with tons of buzz around the camps, but the most hyped-up storyline was a rookie signing an $82 million, eight-year contract with the Milwaukee Brewers before ever seeing a single big-league pitch.Outfielder Jackson Chourio, Ronald Acuña Jr.'s cousin straight out of \

got his first career plate appearance on the second day of the season after opening day got rained out, setting up a Brewers-Twins doubleheader.The kid drew a walk in his first trip to the dish and promptly swiped second base, making it a quiet but flashy debut that flashed glimpses of what was to come.He was just 19 years and 5 months old when he started rewriting the record books.Only 17 players in MLB history have launched 20+ homers in each of their first three seasons, and only two did it at a younger age than Chourio. If the kid swipes 6 more bags before the season wraps up, he will become the only human being to ever put up three 20-20 campaigns before turning 22, so let's wait and see.

# ---

![Chourio.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23xARTJv5X6VDo72mPks2Z4i8xqFzXHZ4SWFBXPRnySvoHzbbzoFUuVU6Ews5nMP4jUCV.jpg) [Jackson Chourio](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/rangers-vs-brewers/2026/08/29/823741/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Los Rangers de texas eran recibidos por segundo día consecutivo en el American Family Field con la misión de levantarse de la lona ante los Cerveceros. Pero nada, los lupulosos en general y la conexión venezolana en particular, no lo permitieron. Jackson Chourio comenzó la fiesta en el cierre del primer tramo, cuando castigó una \

a 89 MPH a la banda contraria y enviarla por encima de la pared del right-center, para la primera rayita lupulosa. Luego de un out, le tocó el turno a William Contreras quien hizo lo propio. Ésta vez fue una sinker a 95 MPH, con un swing que elevó la pelota por encima de la pared del jardín izquierdo y terminó montada en la segundo piso a 409 pies del plato. Y en la baja de la séptima, otro pelotero que copió las condiciones de contratación de Jackson, el criollo Luis Lara, bateó una línea de hit entre dos para traer un par de carreras adicionales, para un marcador que terminó de favorecer al \

por 5-3 sobre Texas. 4 de las 5 impulsadas tuvieron sello tricolor. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      The Texas Rangers were checking in at American Family Field for the second straight day trying to bounce back against the Brewers, but it was a no-go since the Brew Crew as a whole and the Venezuelan connection specifically shut that down.Jackson Chourio started the party in the bottom of the first when he turned on an 89 MPH cutter and went opposite field, leaving the yard over the right-center wall for the first run of the game.After one down, William Contreras stepped up to the dish and did the exact same thing, this time ambushing a 95 MPH sinker with a monster hack that cleared the left field wall and landed in the second deck 409 feet away from home plate.Then in the bottom of the seventh, another Venezuelan who signed a similar deal to Jackson's, Luis Lara, laced a line-drive knock into the gap to drive in a pair of insurance runs, locking in a 5-3 ballgame in favor of the Brew Crew over Texas with 4 of the 5 RBIs carrying that tricolor stamp.

# ---

![Andruw.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23uFK2JamsV1RDSQjfxx1pX4fdTVPgtZuqER4Nhw5YSYN96t3LLhMRwcLpRNe7SQw4Z6P.jpg) [Andruw Monasterio](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/red-sox-vs-yankees/2026/08/29/823539/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Nada como un partido de sábado entre archienemigos en Yankee Stadium. Pero si fuera poco, hubo doble cartelera entre los Medias Rojas y los Mulos de Manhattan. Y al igual que en el caso anterior, el primero de la tarde, se resolvió a partir de las carreras impulsadas por los criollos. En primer término, el maracucho Wilyer Abreu no permitió que las cosas se calentaran y en el propio primer episodio le puso números al marcador. Sinker a 94 MPH y leñazo hacia el jardín derecho que puso el marcador 1-0. Mientras, el pitcheo de los patirrojos blanqueaba a los Yankees y Andrew Monasterio terminó de hundir a los del Bronx, trayendo dos carreras más en el momento más oportuno: noveno episodio y pizarra de 2-0. El hombre esperó con paciencia teniendo dos hombres en posición anotadora y largó un trallazo por encima del campocorto, alargando la ventaja a un más seguro 4-0. Dos carreras adicionales en el mismo episodio, sirvieron como clavos en el ataúd neoyorquino. A segunda hora, los Yankees se desquitaron 9-2. Tal como van las cosas, estos dos equipos se enfrentarán en la etapa de los comodines. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Nothing beats a Saturday matchup between archrivals at Yankee Stadium, but to top it off, we got a doubleheader between the Red Sox and the Bronx Bombers.Just like before, the matinee game was decided by the bats of the Venezuelan crew.First off, Maracaibo's own Wilyer Abreu didn't waste any time getting things heated up, putting runs on the board in the very first inning by ambushing a 94 MPH sinker for a solo shot to right field to make it 1-0.Meanwhile, the Boston pitching staff was throwing a shutout against the Yankees, and Andruw Monasterio delivered the dagger to the Bronx Bombers in clutch time during the ninth with a 2-0 score.The man stayed patient with two runners in scoring position and cracked a hard line drive over the shortstop to stretch the lead to a much safer 4-0.Two more runs in that same frame served as the final nails in New York's coffin, although the Yankees got their revenge in the nightcap with a 9-2 blowout, and the way things are looking, these two ballclubs are on a collision course for a Wild Card showdown.

---

![Martín.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23yd1GpGq6FJEkb3vYhTyUW16euCSX5PxHTpAAS5PEuU3dpsw8bgCthfWQL89w2x3MAPK.jpg) [Martín Pérez](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/rockies-vs-braves/2026/08/29/824874/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     En una temporada donde el pitcheo criollo ha estado a la altura de sus pergaminos, los abridores se han llevado nuestras palmas, a pesar de que los relevistas también han tenido buena campaña (que no extraordinaria). ¿Dos ejemplos? El veterano de mil batallas, Martín Pérez, siguió demostrando capacidad de sacar outs y tuvo otra salida de calidad para los Bravos (quienes ganaron, pero dejaron al venezolano sin decisión), con 5 y dos tercios, 5 imparables, una carrera limpia, 2 boletos y 6 ponches, dominó a los alicaídos Rockies. Entre tanto, Keider Montero hacía lo propio ante la poderosa maquinaria de los Dodgers en Comerica Park, limitándolos a 4 hits, una carrera limpia, 1 boleto y 3 ponches en cinco y un tercio de episodios. Ambos conjuntos (Bravos y Tigres) ganaron con idéntico marcador 2-1. Y ambos criollos se fueron sin decisión, pero con salidas de calidad. Seguimos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     In a season where Venezuelan pitching has lived up to its reputation, the starters have earned our highest praise, even though the bullpen has also put together a solid, if not mind-blowing, campaign.Two perfect examples?The battle-tested veteran Martín Pérez kept proving he can get outs, turning in another quality start for the Braves, who won but left the southpaw with a no-decision, as he handcuffed the struggling Rockies over 5.2 innings allowing 5 hits, 1 earned run, 2 walks, and punching out 6.Meanwhile, Keider Montero did the exact same thing against the high-powered Dodgers machine at Comerica Park, holding them to just 4 hits, 1 earned run, 1 walk, and 3 strikeouts over 5.1 frames.Both ballclubs, the Braves and Tigers, walked away with identical 2-1 victories, and while both Venezuelan arms took a no-decision, they both delivered quality starts on the bump, so we keep moving forward.

#

body.title: Street Art #912 Legal Wall De Rouen (June 2026 Part II), Montreal
body.body:
During the presentation of murals made during the [**Mural Festival**](https://muralfestival.com) in **Montreal**, I also offer you a walk at the **Legal Wall de Rouen** during the same period, in the beginning of June. The **#StreetArt** scene is very very active in summer in the streets of the city either with the various festivals or a little less official with the artists who paint walls in need of love. Always full of action... I like that.

> *Pendant la présentation de murales faites lors du [**Mural Festival**](https://muralfestival.com) à **Montréal**, je vous propose aussi une balade au **Mur Légal de Rouen** pendant la même période, au mois de juin. La scène **#StreetArt** est très très active en été dans les rues de la ville soit avec les différents festivals ou alors un peu moins officiel avec les artistes qui peignent quelques murs en manque d'amour. Toujours plein effervescence... j'aime ça.*

![Laine & Co...](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xeZHaaej81xuXAHycYYymr6vE99CDyyxJKBKyof8AMDjkfydpRAcD633ZSj3H7aBRLe.JPG)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

The **Legal Wall de Rouen** is located on de Rouen street at railway level in Montreal's Hochelaga Maisonneuve district, a landmark for StreetArt in the city since 2010.

![Carte.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tHUsG817fcGd37AJb3MXNXkRwrTcRJf5GaAxihpYL3VGLQxuWxbEpwJX7TTXBZGjW5v.jpg)

> *Le **Mur Légal de Rouen** se trouve sur le rue de Rouen au niveau de la voie de chemin de fer dans le quartier Hochelaga Maisonneuve à Montréal, un lieu emblématique du StreetArt en ville depuis 2010.*

![DSC00019.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xAJkm6BVYXYeu9sZu344cjcsY6vbEBe23JBAJN9gJ8QmLGsjFQ2ZWos4cNfLxVUMK1a.JPG)

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=18/45.53947/-73.55325)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 45.53926 lat -73.55250 long Legal Wall de Rouen 08 June 2026 d3scr)
# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

![DSC00003.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xyLcoBY7ED1ZVr5NnUUY9Y1SWAK1TMjqtK73f8WEDxbhfckiYGT3r9JHznx813xzy6T.JPG)

We begin the visit to the viaduct this morning of June 8 (I'm almost sure of the exact date 😀 ), always in the same direction. A new head of Medusa in black and white appeared at the entrance, still by the hand of **Medusa**. On her Instagram, she changed to [**PSYQU33N**](https://www.instagram.com/psyqueenmedusa/) but Medusa remains very present if you look closely.

> *Nous commençons la visite du viaduc en ce matin du 8 juin (je suis presque sûr de la date* 😀 *), toujours dans le même sens. Une nouvelle tête de Méduse en noir et blanc est apparue à l'entrée, toujours de la main de **Medusa**. Sur son Instagram, elle a changé pour [**PSYQU33N**](https://www.instagram.com/psyqueenmedusa/) mais Medusa reste bien présent si on regarde bien.* 

![Medusa](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23x12W7mtpjKB2UbUZEnJuRGVTGED97C9Mfriy95gXbMncPwYRsiP2dPAMsUs5KQhFM4b.JPG)

***

![DSC00007.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23wC5QiJTQPiQfdZEW7j5nna8PKsb1QrXXfSEY9J6MwDGZd5mZLTc3LrWSCqsVQYqt2Pi.JPG)

In the middle, on the first photo of the post, the portrait of [**Laine**](https://www.instagram.com/en_gel_et_laine/) is still present with part of the lettering that accompanied it last week, see [StreetArt #908](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-908-legal-wall-de-rouen-june-2026-part-i-montreal). From a distance, I hadn't noticed the detail and the work on the black and white \

enhanced with yellow. Really cool...\n\n> *Au milieu, sur la première photo du post, le portrait de [**Laine**](https://www.instagram.com/en_gel_et_laine/) est toujours présent avec une partie du lettrage qui l'accompagnait la semaine dernière, voir [StreetArt #908](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-908-legal-wall-de-rouen-june-2026-part-i-montreal). De loin, je n'avais pas remarqué le détail et le travail sur la \

en noir et blanc rehaussée de jaune. Vraiment cool...*

![DSC00008.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23w2gc4YDddJi7obPpVrxfBKngBVwJKTYKUHuo66pK8yPmHT5rRJAcoQTCUeDGYK2A3Xf.JPG)

***

![Motus](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tbpuBQL7EMMgnrv4y3HtUJjyB86MkSFEgZeB8v1wULi5EPZBqN8W1dUV59Hbi1Q7X2f.JPG)

**Motus** is still there too with this little girl dressed as a devil. Only, on the left, [**Dehsiww**](https://www.instagram.com/dehsiww/) added his tag, surely to make his music known. Very nice place to advertise. And under the eye of **Mr Can Do It** we find a lettering of [**Like**](https://www.instagram.com/aimer.dsk.lcf/), it seems simple but not so simple, and very effective.

> ***Motus** est toujours là aussi avec cette petite fille déguisée en diable. Seulement, sur la gauche, [**Dehsiww**](https://www.instagram.com/dehsiww/) a ajouté son tag, sûrement pour faire connaitre sa musique. Très beau lieu pour faire de la publicité. Et sous l'oeil de **Mr Can Do It** on retrouve un lettrage de [**Aimer**](https://www.instagram.com/aimer.dsk.lcf/), cela parait simple mais très efficace.*

![DSC00010.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23u5bgLE5t2q1TqNTjT2comxnqKxHBxrjwbnVWP7S5W986PgUVxihetCQ8GBzujdgbVsv.JPG)

***

![DSC00011.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23u5vRPWYihi619sU9WoGHoadyM6EopAfjEZysURdUUTmjDg1HAjPuiu2WrLerhW8pGMg.JPG)

We cross the rue de Rouen, two superb letterings welcome us. The first one I don't really know who the artist is although the style is not unknown to me. And inside the viaduct, it is [**Stor**](https://www.instagram.com/stor_was_here/), always very clean.

> *Nous traversons la rue de Rouen, deux superbes lettrages nous accueillent. Le premier je ne sais pas trop quel est artiste bien que le style ne me soit pas inconnu. Et à l'intérieur du viaduc, il s'agit de [**Stor**](https://www.instagram.com/stor_was_here/), toujours très propre.*

<div class=\

/> *** ![DSC00014.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tmBVSecw9BMsanwcPEZnvM68u6B68xFspvhR5BBZdNZ7H7QwJAYs56MKv42MC6yEYMT.JPG) Next to **Brick**, we have a new work by [**Claudia Guindon**](https://www.instagram.com/clo5.mtl/) aka **Clo5** who was very happy to see her work from the previous week still present and integrated into the work of another artist: \

(source: Instagram)

> *A côté de **Brick**, on a une nouvelle oeuvre de [**Claudia Guindon**](https://www.instagram.com/clo5.mtl/) aka **Clo5** qui était bien contente de voir son oeuvre de la semaine précédente être encore présente et intégrée au travail d'un autre artiste :
\

(source : Instagram)*

![DSC00015.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tSN97TYquLCjeYHjLV72XCBxZMQe3ajnm2wKT5RskPDtJTT3BNLi8YB7K2paKF94uYd.JPG)

And here is the lettering of [**JaneKool**](https://www.instagram.com/_janekool_/) which accompanies the wreath of flowers of **Clo5**. Nice set now. / **FR** : *Et voici donc le lettrage de [**JaneKool**](https://www.instagram.com/_janekool_/) qui accompagne la gerbe de fleurs de **Clo5**. Bel ensemble maintenant.*

![Janekool](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tvXm3MWJMpCLn3EQHdmdmpEeYx5ia2FLmP2EFZGmURo3nYUFcWRTWokZZvZNycVRvgD.JPG)

![DSC00017.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tkpMcvpEyUwbmDgrTGH2t8Q9dskY4TPmFBHp8TDQEFwhS6WAsWtdvqAVmiBHPgMeU3H.JPG)

And to finish, we are treated to a second superb portrait of [**Laine**](https://www.instagram.com/en_gel_et_laine/) next to [**Macak**](https://www.instagram.com/macak_mtl/).
**A favorite work for this version of the Wall?** For me, it's this second portrait of **Laine**, I really like her style, close to the comic strip.

> *Et pour terminer, nous avons le droit à un deuxième superbe portrait de [**Laine**](https://www.instagram.com/en_gel_et_laine/) à côté de [**Macak**](https://www.instagram.com/macak_mtl/).
**Une oeuvre préférée pour cette version du Mur ?** Pour moi, c'est ce deuxième portrait de **Laine**, j'aime beaucoup son style, proche de la bande-dessinée.*

![DSC00018.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23uFGr1YErrt6om81bZSkMt2QMVLYWRpiQhssMDFyN6iBCZDbJYpA6RvZgTRzbxcaQXjt.JPG)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇɴ	
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

* **2026**.

![line_grey.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSj2ThUhewrAjDZMFsx4UjSaXuS84cwHR2anDzyq9KWVh/line_grey.jpg)

<div class=\

/> **෴ ꜱᴏᴜʀᴄᴇꜱ** **Instagram** : [PSYQU33N](https://www.instagram.com/psyqueenmedusa/) [Laine](https://www.instagram.com/en_gel_et_laine/) [Dehsiww](https://www.instagram.com/dehsiww/) [Aimer](https://www.instagram.com/aimer.dsk.lcf/) [Stor](https://www.instagram.com/stor_was_here/) [Claudia Guindon](https://www.instagram.com/clo5.mtl/) [JaneKool](https://www.instagram.com/_janekool_/) **෴ ᴘʀᴇᴠɪᴏᴜꜱ ᴘᴏꜱᴛꜱ** [#911 **Izabelle Duguay** (MF26)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-911-izabelle-duguay-mural-festival-2026-montreal)   **>** [#910 **Oprch** (MF26)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-910-oprch-mural-festival-2026-montreal) [#909 **Nelson** (MF26)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-909-nelson-mural-festival-2026-montreal) [StreetArt Contest #315 **OnoArt** (MF26)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/ccs-street-art-contest-315-onoart-mural-festival-2026-montreal) [#908 Legal Wall De Rouen (06-2026 Part I)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-908-legal-wall-de-rouen-june-2026-part-i-montreal) [#907 **Kaiflyn & Maylee Keo** (MF26)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-907-kaiflyn-and-maylee-keo-mural-festival-2026-montreal) [StreetArt Contest #314 **Rouks** (MF26)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/cccs-street-art-contest-313-rouks-mural-festival-2026-montreal) [#906 Legal Wall De Rouen (05-2026 Part IV)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-906-legal-wall-de-rouen-may-2026-part-iv-montreal) [#905 **Greg Mike** (MF26)](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-905-greg-mike-mural-festival-2026-montreal) ![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg) ## Have a great Sunday / *Bon dimanche à tous*

body.title: Lovely couple with their dog - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23u62syZLwGgttozQZNbL6wTXRXQTV6o3beiEH7mvtjM5F5Qw1nsHCRbgZuDGANJMsDmX.jpg)
Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community, today I am back with a new set of photographs that I took as part of the content dynamic where I approach strangers and ask them if I can take a couple of photographs, and on this occasion I took photos of an adorable couple who was sitting in the park with their dog:
Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, hoy estoy de vuelta con un nuevo set de fotografias que hice como para de la dinamica de contenido en donde me acerco a desconocidos y les pregunto si les puedo hacer un par de fotografias y en esta ocasion le tomé fotos a una adorable pareja que estaba sentada en el parque con su perrito:
First I started by taking a photo of everyone together:
Primero empecé por hacerle una foto a todos juntos:
![IMG_6099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23vhwRDy2kEGkbXiSZPscRBcWpC5ttikgQ3gi5wkgyLACWNYxFLommDbj9UTRwcZGhj74.jpg)
I also took a photo in horizontal format, I hadn't taken a photo this way in a long time and the result was very good:
Tambien les hice una foto en formato horizontal, tenia mucho tiempo sin hacer la foto de esta manera y el resultado fue muy bueno:
![IMG_6104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23vhsCxZxfKf6egjwPGzxz9WbjmbkNY2ZuyHFGnAVVe6mtdnYTGJLRccaEgtY5SXd1EYS.jpg)
The dog looked very cute right where he was so I took a photo of him:
El perro se veia muy tierno alli donde estaba asi que le hice una foto a el:
![IMG_6111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wMYACX8TooQq1K94sJprSdQvDnhQffwoBtUrYHohwy1aoc5N2CHUuwU3VaUgxZ84vu2.jpg)
And then a photo of the couple:
Y luego una foto a la pareja:
![IMG_6120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23vsNJuYunp9JHp4dAedBHFCv5wQaGvCqETKum6CCmikva8T79JLH8PDhUJXwDXYEddyZ.jpg)
And to finish I asked them if they could lift the dog to take this photo that I always like to take:
Y para finalizar les pregunté si podian alzar el perro para hacer esta foto que siempre me gusta hacer:
![IMG_6116.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23tmDrPD4TNFizS3XVVgX6tRaY1bTJd6fcmGGhZpy71HBw1Mp2mBuoi9n6kbrjEbA2ELA.jpg)
All the photos were taken with my Canon R8 camera, a 50mm 1.8/f lens and only natural light. Afterwards I exchanged contact information with the guy to send him the photos and continued walking through the park, I hope you liked these photos as much as we did and thanks for everything!
Todas las fotos las hice con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm 1.8/f y solo luz natural. Despues intercambié informacion de contacto con el chico para enviarle las fotos y seguí caminando por el parque, espero que estas fotos les hayan gustado tanto como a nosotros y gracias por todo!

body.title: Quiet moments, big dreams 🌸✨
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQEpjUJNUECuXL14kqeXbUuYHnhei33KrSHAfu6ZZs66c/IMG_2098.jpg 

Sometimes a simple selfie captures more than just a moment.

Today I was thinking about how different life feels when you start looking at the future with intention. I still have my normal routine: work, motherhood, responsibilities, bills, and those days when everything seems to happen at once. 😅

But behind all of that, I'm slowly building something for myself.

Every little amount I save, every investment I make, and every new thing I learn gives me hope that one day my life won't revolve around a work schedule. I want more time with my child, more freedom to make my own decisions, and more peace when thinking about money.

I'm not rushing anymore. I know meaningful changes take time.

Today I'm simply grateful for where I am, curious about where I'm going, and determined to keep moving forward. 🤍

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@camy.macedo/quiet-moments-big-dreams--9kr)

body.title: Judging by clothes? no way.
body.body:
- is a famous and popular quote. At the same time, if the cover of her book seems shiny, does not mean the book contains some precious knowledge. is full stop. In fact, it can be opposite. It's not necessarily true that the book contains some precious knowledge. So, the best way to judge a book is to open the book, read about it and figure out if it's something precious or not. From the perspective of dictionary meaning. It should be something like that. But the true meaning of the quote is more insightful. He actually tries to represent humans as well as human thoughts. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQRkUZxGqJ2qaTQLimZ3CkFf4iQDxvjPddoEcPjudsfe3/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-rack-of-clothes-hanging-on-a-clothes-rack-YP3LW3rasWU) Humans, known as the best creatures on this earth and every human are unique in their own ways and I believe that no one can judge others perfectly. Instead of it, it's human nature to judge others. It doesn't matter if they are right or wrong. And I don't think they care about it too much also. Judging, people wrongly sometimes bring loss for us and sometimes it can be the reason for losing some good opportunities in life because nobody knows which people come to our life with opportunity. In maximum cases, we judge people based on their appearance as well as their clothes. Do you think it is okay to justify people based on their clothes? For me, I don't judge people based on their clothes, but what we wear somehow reflects a little bit of our personality, and I cannot deny the fact. What kind of clothes or what types of clothes we wear is a choice for most of us and naturally it reflects the personality of a person unless the person is trying to hide their true personality. Is there anyone who does that? Obviously, there are people like that, and I belong from that category. It's because I feel that if I hide my true personality, it can help me to protect myself from various kinds of danger. In some cases, some people face criticism because of their clothes, especially girls. In my country, my culture doesn’t allow girls to wear those clothes that reveal most of the body parts. Some girls try to do such a thing and they face criticism. They say it's their right. The truth is that if we are living in society, we are bound to follow some unofficial rules. And it's the same. In fact, the majority of my females are against too much body revealing clothes. Even female is not supportive to it, how can they just blame it of male people only. Whatever, that's a different topic. The question is if it's ok to judge them based on their clothes. For me, I actually don't care about what others wear and who I am to judge them. I don't mind if anyone walks even without clothes. But when it comes to my family, I think they are allowed to wear clothes as long as they are decent. Let's talk about it from different perspectives. Is it ok to consider whether one is rich or poor based on one’s clothes. I think it will be foolishness if anyone do that because at the present time there are many people who want to show off and if anyone judges them based on it will not be right. In that case it’s nothing less than illusions.

body.body:
​ ![file_00000000dd2881f498a7ffee17068f85.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf4Wfx4rFT4kzDXuWN5jegH4F1JWGe8BH38pLb5g3e721/file_00000000dd2881f498a7ffee17068f85.png)

Mikroby i roboty wielkości drobinek – technologia przyszłości

Roboty nie zawsze muszą mieć rozmiar człowieka czy samochodu. Naukowcy pracują obecnie nad niezwykle małymi konstrukcjami, których wielkość może być porównywana do drobinek znajdujących się na powierzchni przedmiotów. Takie mikroroboty mogą w przyszłości otworzyć zupełnie nowe możliwości w nauce i technologii.

Jednym z ciekawszych rozwiązań są mikroroboty napędzane światłem. Dzięki specjalnym materiałom mogą reagować na określone źródła światła i w ten sposób zmieniać swoje położenie. Ich niewielkie rozmiary sprawiają, że mogą poruszać się w miejscach niedostępnych dla tradycyjnych maszyn.

Do czego można je wykorzystać?

Potencjalnych zastosowań jest bardzo dużo. Mikroroboty mogą być wykorzystywane do badań biologicznych, wykrywania określonych substancji oraz obserwowania mikroorganizmów. Naukowcy badają również możliwość wykorzystania podobnych konstrukcji w przyszłych rozwiązaniach medycznych.

Technologia jest jednak wciąż na stosunkowo wczesnym etapie rozwoju. Największym wyzwaniem pozostaje między innymi kontrolowanie tak małych urządzeń oraz zapewnienie im odpowiedniego źródła energii.

Choć mikroroboty brzmią jak rozwiązanie z filmu science fiction, prowadzone badania pokazują, że coraz mniejsze maszyny mogą w przyszłości stać się ważnym elementem nowoczesnej technologii.

body.title: I Should Have Asked The Price First
body.body:
Last week I went to Cinema to see a movie. I came with a close friend who I met from some dating app. Let say we were in the friend zone at the moment, or maybe for forever lol.

The problem I had that day was I did not get enough sleep the night before. I had been and I still have been in a heavy load works, I have some project in kicking off phase. So there are plenty of small things coming in and no matter how fast we solve them, new problems will keep appearing. It is the nature of a project, especially if you have two crash projects that need to be settled soon regardless anything including things that not making any sense.

https://i.ecency.com/DQmQinhnNKwKoTCr472ZzP65x1JF4dAQNjbTHZWJQLPNSLL/img20260823153220.jpg

So with my condition that was very cloudy, not sleepy enough because I could drive and walked there, but I knew I would not be able to pay attention to the movie properly, I came to their refreshment stall. I saw that standing banner there.

Grapefruit Coffee, only at 45.000 rupiah. That was around 2.5 USD, it might be cheap for some place in another side of the globe, but for me here... It was not cheap at all, but it was still far from expensive anyway. I could snuck in a can of coffee from outside, but I preferred to buy from them anyway. Let say I wanted to be a good guy that time.

So I asked the cashier if they had another flavor other than Grapefruit... Well they had, and I picked the Avocado one.

https://i.ecency.com/DQmWXNHnhSpMYxMKFK3VqYqLmibfmvaLV3p4qpEzeT3oJ5g/img20260823153744.jpg

Ok this was my Avocado coffee. I was curious why it looked like that. My friend laughed at me, saying she thought I was sleepy then why I bought that Matcha. Well indeed it was a Matcha looked a like one.

https://i.ecency.com/DQmcWeWt7yEqYNph5HhZwa9Y12trTxnAcLBN53AZGNXB9E4/img20260823153856.jpg

and you see, there was a grass jelly inside the cup. I did not ask it, they just gave it in there. I wanted a coffee, an avocado coffee, but they gave me this bobba cup with a bubble tea package...

Ok here was the deal, I had something off and something good from this drink. That's why I think I should share this one here. Let's start the good thing, despite that grass jelly ruined the look and the taste a bit, the drink was still excellent. I mean the avocado, the espresso shot, and the milk they put in and mixed there, it worked well.

It managed to get me a bit light up, awakening  my cloudy sleepy brain. I could watch the movie properly....

not the bad side...

https://i.ecency.com/DQmTVf6AezdrTZBCnZnu2GBXL9PDLcm1xt7BWv3Bnq4W5f8/image.png

I paid the bill using QRIS, it stands for Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard. To put this simple, it is a barcode based payment system that read QR code and you pay the bill by entering your pin. I did not pay attention about the price, just pay that bill.

After the movie ended and I threw off all the ticked and bills, I realized that the drink was not 45.000 rupiah, it was 75.000 rupiah... Instead of paying 2.5 USD, I paid 4.2 USD. I felt like I just got scammed.

I asked the counter why the price differed so much, they said that Grapefruit was on a price cut, but the other flavor were not. I thought different flavor would not had different price, even if they did, it would not be far more expensive.

I was wrong then.. First i was wrong that I did not ask the price first, and second, I was wrong that different flavor could double the price lol... If I knew it would cost me that much, I would not even bother to buy it.

Well, I am a stingy person anyway lol... some people might fell disgusted reading how stingy I am.

body.title: [TV] Hot as Hell - Lucifer
body.body: For the sake of my writing style first things first: if you have not watched this show, sorry mate we cannot be on good terms. Just kidding! But man, I literally love this show. Although, I watched it way back in years. And, today, I saw a reel with the most famous dialogue:\n\n> \

- Lucifer

Ironical, isn't it? Like since childhood, we have been taught to hate the devil, love the angel, and what not. But this devil is a lot different. Should I be ashamed of saying this? If yes, I am guilty of pleasure from a devil. Now do not get it wrong, lol.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNULiKyoshJLWm4jnAG8znveAoWa1WmXG31GW5XHLPhNa/fafa.jpg)


Well I do not want you guys to listen to my non-stop yapping, so here to the actual point.

> The Story and All

Although, I am not a big fan of reviewing with \

only, but this one really deserves a big writing. Because, it has total six-seasons.

The story starts with our protagonist - Lucifer Morningstar the Devil himself - who got bored of Hell, and has moved to Los Angeles. Good thing? I mean who does not love Los Angeles? So he is here, and opens up a nightclub, and just like a good devil starts helping the police solve murders.

Somehow, it works.

The best thing about him is: he never lies.

Now do not become a fan right now. As he owns a nightclubs, and spends his days enjoying wine, women, music and the general freedom of not having to answer to anyone. After all, you have been punishing the souls in Hell, so this is a valid response.

But the twist unfolds, a murder takes place outside Lux - Lucifer's club. This brings him into contact with LAPD detective, the female lead: Chloe Decker.

Before moving any forward, our Devil has this unusual power: he can make people reveal their deepest desires. However, this trick does not work on Chloe.

>  She is under the protection of plot.

This plot thing is something decided by the God. But, I will save this part for a while, because it is no fun to discuss the main thing right in the start. This thing interests Lucifer, more like a curiosity for him.

So, he becomes a partner with Chloe. He starts assisting Chloe with investigations, using his ability to uncover people's desires and his experience from hell comes in handy. As he knows, how to treat a criminal.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYLKwX1qn3by7yqdSrsz5XLNpe8vzgzAHLiQpSZCpT8aR/sasa.jpg)


At first, it does seem like a usual every week show, where detectives are solving murder cases. But the murders are eventually just the surface part.

The deeper stuff is Lucifer's real story. A being who has spent eternity believing that he was created to be evil, punished for rebelling against his Father i.e. God, and condemned to play role everyone expects him to play. So, his greatest enemy is he, him, and himself.

> Enough of deep talks

Along with his angelic brother, there is this character: Dan Espinoza. He is basically Chloe's ex-husband and Lucifer's favorite punching bag. Punching bag? Yes kind of, as Lucifer loves to target him with his immature jokes. Moreover, how can I forget Ella Lopez, the forensic scientist whose cheerful personality hides her own complicated relationship with faith and darkness.

> The Devil as a Psychatrist

So this is a spoiler. One of the best thing, for me is this part. The Devil, who once punished souls in Hell, eventually becomes the one helping them escape it. Dr. Linda Martin - the psychatrist, who spent years helping Lucifer understand himself through therapy, becomes an important part of his journey.

> Free Will

This is the biggest and most important theme of the plot, mine favorite as well. At one stage, the plot exposes that God created Chloe just for Lucifer. So, it came as a surprise for both character.

For Lucifer, the one who is fighting against his Father's control; for Chloe, she looses her selfness.

Intially, Lucifer starts seeing Chloe as another piece in his Father's game. A way of controlling him while making him believe that he is exercising free will. And imagine about Chloe's inner feelings, as if she was created merely as a gift, for just another being.

> Final Take

I do agree that there are many loops in the series, especially the over-stretching of seasons for no reason. Moreover, the season starts really good, but the end it turns somewhat into a family show. But, it is definitely a must watch, if you ask me. And all those reasons have been mentioned above.

> In the end, a couple made in HELL! 

Lucifer to Chloe: “Chloe, I am the Devil.”

Chloe to Lucifer: “No, you're not. Not to me.”



---



Here is the link of selfless Lucifer:

https://youtu.be/pLU3UJ1j7k0?si=3StleKCgiXxsfubd

Because in Chloe's presence, Lucifer is a mortal.



---



As for ratings:

IMdB: 8.0/10

Rotten Tomatoes: 87%

Personal: 90/100

...........................

Peace 🕊️

...........................

_Rating: **90/100**_

---

body.title: 📚 The Library of Babel
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfWQpzgfwsAdc4aipYqb6RF5vzoF66puN4EE9YHfsk1t9/image.png 




# 📚 The Library of Babel: the place where *everything you can imagine already exists*

🔗 **Link to the library:** https://libraryofbabel.info

Have you heard of the **Library of Babel**?

No, it’s not your local public library, with a librarian asking you to keep your voice down. We’re talking about a library so gigantic that it would make the Internet look like a simple Post-it note.

The Library of Babel is an idea imagined by the Argentine writer **Jorge Luis Borges** in his short story published in **1941**. Borges describes a library made up of an infinite number of hexagonal rooms, containing an infinite number of books.

And when I say *an infinite number of books*, I’m not exaggerating.

This library would contain:

- every book that has ever been written;
- every book that will be written in the future;
- every possible story;
- every imaginable truth;
- every error, lie, and absurdity;
- your complete biography;
- your perfect pancake recipe;
- and probably a book explaining why you put off that important task until tomorrow again.

The concept is simple, yet mind-boggling: the library contains **every possible combination of characters**. Each page is made up of letters, symbols, spaces, and punctuation marks. Most of the books are therefore completely incomprehensible… but somewhere in the middle of this gigantic alphabet soup, there are also perfectly coherent sentences.

In other words, if you search long enough, you can find a sentence that sums up your life, an exact prediction of your future, or even proof that you were right during that argument ten years ago.

The problem is that you may have to search through a few billion libraries before you find it. 😅

---

## 🌌 A library that contains the entire universe… and probably its opposite

You could compare this library to some kind of **book of the gods**, bringing together every possibility:

- the past;
- the present;
- the future;
- events that happened;
- events that will never happen;
- the decisions we made;
- the decisions we could have made;
- and every alternate version of our existence.

In this library, there is a book in which you become famous, another in which you give everything up to raise goats in the mountains, another in which you earn twenty thousand Hive Power on PeakD.com… and probably another in which you never discover blockchain.

There is even a book in which you became president of the world.

Unfortunately, it must be shelved somewhere between:

> “How to Fix a Printer with a Banana”  
> and  
> “The True Recipe for Happiness Written in Klingon.”

Good luck finding it. 🤷‍♂️

---

## 🔍 I decided to test the library

For fun, I searched for two completely opposite sentences.

The first sentence was:

> **“One day I will have twenty thousand Hive Power on PeakD.com.”**

And surprisingly, the sentence appears several times in different books in the Library of Babel.

### 📖 First appearance

The sentence appears three times in three different books.

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23t8DBnQGncV9KR9GsbLRtvQT3Cpdd44Wm1mGG5RF5vncoRc3ZAJJJcfSdeQmc8xDozCX.png)

### 📖 Another appearance

On one occasion, it appears by itself in the book:

**Title:** `uzcvlfozxotrrkdltj`  
**Page:** 285

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tHdXs8SknaxqcH2pHs9Juf9cFsDp8WSyor39XiGh1VPUqzcwCTVHQp8B9BPixmKYijr.png)

### 📖 And somewhere else again

The same sentence also appears in the book:

**Title:** `egdzf`  
**Page:** 120

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tw7oNjTvFsMKhUCxtrz29pQ1fnj6NKawqFciwdXeEJ6QnN9ymSmadKFJDPsyncyKqqi.png)

And it seems to appear on other pages, in other books as well.

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/EoAgaBUABDyGf5YYprbQKTz48oEGTKUX74VoCpGA3fr1zhV1A2q6dAadzAvPszK21yU.png)

At that point, I thought the universe might be trying to send me a message.

Or perhaps it’s simply a machine that is very good at generating combinations of letters.

But I prefer to believe the first possibility. It’s much more motivating. 😄

---

## 🚫 The opposite sentence also exists

Next, I searched for the opposite sentence:

> **“I would never have twenty thousand Hive Power on PeakD.com.”**

And, of course, this sentence also exists in the Library of Babel.

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tHbKgyTs7nnRQd5GbA2H2oS4URPni9hAWKjj8jYJKgZrsZ5cUj7JQ5kuJMqXfFL5ZbW.png)

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23u6WTkJyjz9GvwXmkd16GkfMGaapt2CMkjPxQQ1Mp1rh3hQTa7A9QV36zvkKG92TMKpe.png)

The library therefore contains both:

> “I will succeed”

and:

> “I will never succeed.”

That doesn’t help us much when it comes to making a decision, but it sums up the Internet, social media, and conversations with ourselves at 3 a.m. rather well.

---

## ✍️ Write anything… and you will probably find it

You can have fun entering almost any sentence into the search engine.

Once you have thought of a sentence, it is very likely to exist somewhere in the library.

You can try:

- a funny sentence;
- an absurd sentence;
- a prediction;
- your declaration of love;
- your shopping list;
- the password you use everywhere — but please don’t actually do that, just to be safe;
- or even a completely made-up sentence.

I tried a few combinations and found results in books with titles as poetic as:

**Book title:** `umixpxmcujvqqouuhcksjd`  
**Page:** 202

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23t8DBnQF4nDzLhxE9JVySGUrWTL4tHTCPKW6y8W2kfYAaH8u2Hkr75ajPovXoNe4vV.png)

Well… the title may not be exactly that, but you get the idea: the library’s marketing department hasn’t put in much effort yet.

Another result:

**Title:** `m ylh,vefagoo,.`  
**Page:** 335

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/EogU9tFVAY7KxdDER9V2FivgfRSAtJymYneD2DNN9jgzMcR4o3SwbFWHFukuuV6uC9R.png)

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23u6WzCMtzrRUDfT4vNAJJgXSdAbC1ho2tRUG3B6LE9mkXcAQMiaJgrcyiF6cLK32MSwv.png)

---

## 🧑‍💻 Search for your name

You can also search for your **first and last name**, then try different variations:

- first name + last name;
- last name + first name;
- with or without accents;
- with a spelling mistake;
- with your ridiculous old username from 2008.

You will almost certainly find an occurrence somewhere.

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tw8KpnPB89YcRLWTKSQBUGhk4cYupyBAV6VFhLvMHSCRm6yyNupjEF1iee5tmJC1Y21.png)

But be careful: finding your name in a book does not necessarily mean that the library knows your destiny.

It mostly means that it contains so many combinations that, statistically speaking, it eventually contains your name, your neighbor’s name, your cat’s name, and probably your neighbor’s cat’s name too.

---

## 📜 So… coincidence, destiny, or divine plan?

This idea raises a rather fascinating question:

**If every possible sentence already exists somewhere, does that mean our destiny is written?**

Perhaps there is a book containing the complete plan of our lives.

But there are also thousands of other books telling a different, contradictory, or completely false version of that same life.

So how can we know which one is the right one?

That’s where things get interesting.

The Library of Babel can represent:

- the infinity of knowledge;
- the confusion between truth and lies;
- the limits of our understanding;
- chance;
- destiny;
- or even the difficulty of finding useful information within an infinite amount of data.

It’s a bit like looking for a needle in a haystack… except that the haystack is the size of the universe, the needles are mixed in with billions of fake needles, and some of them are written in Hebrew.

By the way:

> **תודה שקראתם**  
> *Toda shakratam*  
> “Thank you for reading” in Hebrew.

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/48HDGdRXG45yZB5msYvHNYFcVpLjutNSZoTLQyhpgnP5sMAZ96oHHJVpH3TJgU8ZKu.png)

---

## 🧭 Set out in search of your destiny

You can also explore the library manually, room by room and page by page.

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23wgmaxmV6aAkfKjynqjty1TyYYsGXnyKShgMwaRfNCvDd6oET1gKELTRRH9khrvpgona.png)

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23yU2VD6Qeijcn5yGTw2HsPpuntAfPdJWwWSwNYSHYFzNSesabAcngijKgNjA7uo21wDS.png)

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23zGyo4yyZuE11uHB3n5W3xNEe5kiX5HuShKigXDeaqXEBv1YiLhFxAHAw7fupji9tTx4.png)

![Image](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23vsp77dUCMdmJaLGQh81tx7kDhDU6eLseofr4zN1WL8EeK3MArToNj9fEdubt1467aXZ.png)

You may find:

- your future;
- the answer to a question you have been asking yourself;
- a sentence you thought you were the only person to imagine;
- the meaning of life;
- or simply a string of letters that looks like the name of an experimental drug.

If you believe that you have free will and that your thoughts are personal, keep in mind that they may still be written somewhere in this library.

But don’t worry: the fact that a thought exists in a book does not mean that it was imposed on you.

After all, in this library, there is also a book claiming exactly the opposite.

And probably a third book explaining why the first two are wrong. 😄

---

## 🎲 Your turn!

Go to:

🔗 **https://libraryofbabel.info**

Enter a sentence, your name, a prediction, or something completely absurd.

Then share your best results in the comments!

What will you find?

- An incredible prediction?

- A declaration of love forgotten for centuries?
- Proof that you are destined to own 20,000 Hive Power?
- Or simply the word “banana” repeated 300 times?

The Library of Babel is waiting for you.

And somewhere, in one of its countless books, the comment you are about to write under this post surely already exists. 📚✨

body.title: MOON this week: Uni 3 is a Hive post now
body.body:
Uni 3 lasted seven days. Thirteen commanders. Then it became a Hive post, and the planets went away.

That's the deal on a short universe. Rank, feats, and the fights stay on-chain. The map does not. @moon.records already wrote the log: [MOON Universe 3 Season 1 Recap](https://peakd.com/moon/@moon.records/hivenova-u3-season-1). This is the rest of the week around it.

![The lobby. Come get MOONed. Uni 1 and Uni 3 fleets on one map.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sablephalanx/23vhWHdXtPa3KqKauMhpAH74KDn57sjYKesjafUAiFF5PzjLqXvjHDzgNah18AwMj5XBi.png)

MOON is free space strategy in a browser. Hive Pizza / Team Mithril. No download. Keychain if you have it, password if you don't. Seasons take a Hive account and 0.10 $PIZZA. Universe 1 does not. That's the split.

## What the recap actually says

@ga-sm won it on 21,348 points. @frugal-fun was 3,000 back and took the only real fight of the week, 217,000 units into @alkalineyo. Third was @crazyphantombr on 6,626. Everyone from there down was playing a different game.

@hivetrending launched the first ship on day one and abandoned a homeworld on wipe day. First in, last out. Prize pool was 1.300 PIZZA. House took 0.130. 1.170 went to Hive Engine wallets.

Two honest notes on that recap, because it is an automated log:

- Some feats still print as raw keys. `feat_first_small_cargo` instead of \

The claim is real. The formatter isn't finished.
- Hall of Fame has a 217k fight, then a 17k, then three 0-unit rows. Empty fights are in the table. They shouldn't be.

The post is still the record. That's why the season exists.

## The other room didn't wipe

Universe 1 is the long game. Hall of Fame there is a different scale. Matt vs siddhartaz is 264 million units. @hurtlocker is on that board more than once. The week universe had a 217k dust-up. This is the room that keeps the lights on.

![Uni 1 Hall of Fame. Top fight is 264 million units.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sablephalanx/23swkEyH686cVFvoDtnpo3EFztZGDYpQdK7YDqL6CptzJ3sMcDRXi6XTZr84uqg2wp62o.png)

Galaxy still has empty systems. This is 2:144. Skull Collectors on 3, me on 7, deep space on 14. If you want a neighbor who isn't already a fortress, this is what that looks like.

![Galaxy 2:144. Empty slots. That's the invite.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sablephalanx/23swiWkFGYqyePovY5yjyN2MgJESwzJGj1fei7MsTGWNmfdgkj8WzUD6PziucyzffaBQD.png)

Lobby last night had a couple hundred commanders and fleets actually in flight. The new front door finally shows them. That should have been the door the whole time.

## Directives are daily now. Friday's copy was already wrong.

Commander used to lock an Empire Directive for a week. Industry, defense, exploration, or trade. Saturday they shipped daily. You pick tonight. It unlocks tomorrow. Ending push is the last hour, not the last day.

![Commander briefing. Time remaining today. Four directives.](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sablephalanx/Eo6CGPxPkybzycKQXmb1uKPRhKWpz7WgDJyXMGWWQbnWaU2A2hDuNuSaHL13yAxAdSp.png)

@hurtlocker caught Trade Surplus lying on that card. It wants three transports or recycles with at least 10k cargo each, to another player. Recycles were ticking. Transports were not, even when the hold was full, because the game zeroed the cargo before it scored the delivery. Scoring is live now. The card copy is too: 10k, foreign planet, three runs. The screenshot in this post is from before that sentence landed.

## Small things that landed this week

- Email register dumps you into Uni 1. Seasons stay Hive-only. Password still works on the long universe.
- You can share a battle report to Hive from inside the game. Keychain, post, done.
- First-to-build feats still sit on the season. The spicy ones stay ??? until someone claims them. Uni 3's recap is what that list looks like after a week.
- Phone already worked. Recent work made galaxy and fleet less of a brick. Don't let anyone tell you mobile just arrived.

## Why this is on Hive

The recap is a post. The 0.10 PIZZA entry hit a Hive Engine wallet. Next season's prizes will too. You own the account. The log doesn't live in a company's blog that can 404.

That's why we built it here. Games run better when the chain gets out of the way. No wait, no fees, no permission to post a fight.

MOON is at [moon.hive.pizza](https://moon.hive.pizza). Uni 1 is open. The next short universe will use the same lobby. Come get MOONed.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: August 30 2026
body.body:
Today we got back to the rhythm of moving intentionally. It was the same route twice today. The mountains, waterfall and the road after that. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/768ad29b-e271-4e9f-b9c2-8e52b1d25761.jpg) The best part about deciding to live in this village is that I get to see the place in every season. I've seen this forest route change from snow filled land to this lush green path. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ba06dc1d-aef5-4722-9097-a91d33ce6fa1.jpg) The waterfall that had muddy water and overflowed from every direction now has clear water. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7fab53b7-794c-451f-9d08-3d9eaa01600d.jpg) The flowers have changed, most of them are gone. New types of berries have come up in the plants and even the apples are almost harvested. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5095b3f9-cd83-4e04-af91-31871bf1d2dd.jpg) The mountains are preparing for the next big change. I could already feel the difference in temperature in the morning. It has started to get cold. The rain now feels different. Everyone is busy with the chores at their agricultural land. Even the kids are carrying wood for the next season and helping their parents with the farming. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5757e51c-d6ac-4196-b885-732c6cc7f576.jpg) As for me, I'm recovering well but my to-do list is so long that I go number these days. Posting consistently brings back a sense of productivity and reaching a goal. That's good!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@elsaenroute/actifit-elsaenroute-20260830t174757608z)_

Just saying about myself: I want the results from my Threads blog immediately - zero patience, and constant changing names, concepts, languages... 

On Reddit, I patiently posted daily for 3 months (95% posts were mine) before my sub reached 1K - Reddit wanted proof I was serious - consistency during a significant period of time.

It might be that Threads wants the same.

However, if you choose the wrong idea for a subreddit, you will never succeed. To understand how good your subreddit idea is, you should look at the first 2-3 weeks growth - if it's like 10-20 members only, you chose a bad topic (not popular or unclear) or named your subreddit badly.

So I see the parallel with Reddit: you should choose a good niche on Threads and look at the follower count - if it grows, just keep posting.

A good idea to check your followers' accounts - are they real people at all?

body.title: I finally got my father's response
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQPkT64dzjWSWbcVU3BrGdYFH747kgdMwqAXTyws82izh/1788111608867.jpg)


After sharing my friend's story on Friday, I kept thinking about some of the comments people left and truly it left an impression on me 

One comment in particular caught my attention. She said maybe my friend's mother is dealing with something deeper and that my friend had somehow become the person she was taking all her frustrations out on and she also suggested that my friend speak with her father and, if possible, take a little time away from home to clear her head.

So I encouraged my friend to speak to her father, honestly, that conversation changed everything.

She told me she sat down with her father and explained everything she had been experiencing with her mother, the constant shouting, the negative sayings, the blame, the feeling of never being good enough, and how unwelcome she had started feeling in her own home.

Her father listened and paid attention to her

Then he told her something she had never expected to hear nor won't be in a hurry to forget 

Miama, you were adopted, everywhere became silent 

It's just that your mother had never been able to have a child of her own.

He went on explaining that he believed that some of the pain, frustration, and unresolved emotions surrounding that situation might have contributed to the way her mother had been treating her.

When my friend told me this, I could understand why she was confused.

She said, “Maybe that explains some things, but does it excuse everything?”

And honestly, I don't think it does.

Understanding someone's pain doesn't mean you have to accept being hurt by them.

Her mother may be struggling with things she has never talked about. She may be carrying years of disappointment, anger, or grief of trying to conceive but my friend is still a human being. She has feelings too.

And according to her, it has simply become too much.

She doesn't feel welcomed anymore, she feels like she is constantly walking on eggshells, afraid that anything she says or does might trigger another argument.

And today, Sunday, she told me that things have been worse than ever since Saturday morning.

She said she has heard all the advice, not just mine, but the advice from the women and mothers who commented on the post.

For now, she has decided to take some time away from the house.

Not because she hates her mother, not that she wants to run away from the problem.

But because sometimes, you need to step away from a situation before you can think clearly about how to fix it.

She wants to find somewhere she can stay for a few days, calm down, clear her head, and allow her mother to cool off too.

Then, when things are calmer, she will come back and have a proper conversation with both her parents.

I don't know how this story will end

But one thing I know now is that sometimes what we see on the surface is only a small part of what someone is actually going through.

And maybe my friend's mother is hurting too and my friend is hurting as well.

Thank you to everyone who took the time to comment, advise, and genuinely care yesterday. 

She read your wordsand heard y'all, which for now, she is choosing peace.

body.title: Tata Nexon giving me almost 17 km/l mileage
body.body:
I have been driving my car for long drive frequently but today I used it for checking my mileage. I recently gave my car for service and since then mileage was not very great. I have a Tata Nexon 2021 model and it's been like 5 years for the car. This service was a bit costly one because I had to spend about a lakh on my car. Some of my friends suggested changing the car but since I spent a lot of money on the car, I was thinking of changing it after about 2 years. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmba41aj4VRWDM9bfT2QqACKLe15ub8kJQ5HKmaLnfY4yQ/1788111596975.jpg)

The quality of the image can be slightly poor because I took it from my mobile camera while driving. 

After my recent service I had been getting a mileage of only 13 km/l in highways and inside the city it was only 11 km/l. Today to my surprise it crossed 17 km/l. I'm happy about this because this is a great save in fuel. Tata Nexon car is famous for not giving enough mileage. My friends who used to have this car sold it because it gave only 10 km/l for them. Even for me if I'm not driving it cautiously, I would get less than 13 km/l in highways. I'm still thinking if service was the problem or the E20 petrol was the problem. But today's trip confirmed that none of that was the problem. 

E20 problem is something that is emerging in India where government is adding Ethanol to the Petrol. I'm not sure if it is really happening or not but they keep saying that. I was also thinking that the drastic deduction in the mileage was because of that but now I know very well that the problem was because of the driving style only. Maybe it can be a contributing factor but I wouldn't say that it can be the only problem. Now I can confidently say that my car can continue to be efficient for another 2 years or so.

body.title: Wise Seperation
body.body:
Greetings, everyone 

My response to this contest is that. I have never separated fights with adults or with married couples. I have been hearing people getting into separate fights between two people, and the people involved in the fight turn to injure the separator. I don't know why it is always like that. 

![1000920888.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/245n7yG3mWiboSn1VZqBU1oaYKJpo5euautNgwxqm5NpEdBuPxy1Acm3StfuhauUjZbLU.jpg)



I had one man in my village, and by then I was a teen, and this man fought with his wife to the point of death and a man like him went to stop the husband from beating his wife, this man turned and attacked him vehemently, till the chief in my community went straight to the husband of this man and dealt with him for committing such a crime. A lot of people were against his actions towards human beings like him. It was so terrible to behold it. This is what the act of flesh can do to man, it can control a man to the worst of it. 

So we need to be wise and observant when it comes to matters like this. Every fight needs separation, but the people can, in turn, attack you. So we need to be careful. 

The one separating has good intentions to stop the fight from escalating but that action of separating can end the third party in the grave or in the hospital.

It's a wise thing to stay aside while people are fighting.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@peckypeace/wise-seperation-5eh)

body.title: Havana in HDR
body.body:
Greetings to the members of the #visualshots community. Today I wanted to share some photos I took on my recent trip to Havana. These images were taken using High Dynamic Range (HDR) editing techniques to better highlight the color details. It's easy to identify some iconic landmarks of the city, such as the Capitol Building, La Giraldilla (the symbol of Havana), the bay, where the monumental Christ the Redeemer statue stands out, and the seaside town of Casablanca. It's always a pleasure to share these experiences with you.

![Havana en HDR-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vierif8/23yTsdMJMs6r86VusA3Skfuo4fyrPkAh6JZR1t6dVGzB5AP2pKVuwCGB3qUYSEogcdbQ5.jpg)

![Havana en HDR-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vierif8/23xVH5E5HNmcD36LmUhLvwrTjGhJErTwTVZfa9PpJnEJvHSiWKcdm4hVD4GDYbCm7gAYx.jpg)

![Havana en HDR-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vierif8/2449QS5c3JVceVw2qjnRWDsxhqGrZeTdLj1u4dgxqAtXNv5yCnEup3rrmFgBWbqKLMp1E.jpg)

![Havana en HDR-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vierif8/23tSMj2riYXm2297JXyPLHz6k556rxyqFNvg5UkjVXVYAgkJYorEEJbA5WD3Rc3w9bWes.jpg)

![Havana en HDR-5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vierif8/23uQtZiW5GbCcVomM93zWs6ExwZNMVB5qRCbNSQWUjbDofQn867XuwwJe64oFr9cLsZBF.jpg)

![Havana en HDR-6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vierif8/242XZuvYS8Xvh6dPdxpG2z6G6mcjsgdWKDqiF1hr63fzV2FCHD3wG3ArF9ah3bD5DLzzC.jpg)

![Havana en HDR-7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vierif8/23sTachJ53fMSdrCGYN5TQgT7XaciDtXiyyuyreQNyJGYY7CNKq5xVuyji1u63UvrF49A.jpg)







Saludos a los miembros de la comunidad #visualshots. Hoy quería regalarles unas fotografías que tomé en mi último recorrido por La Habana. Se trata de imágenes tomadas con la técnica de edición de Alto Rango Dinámico (HDR), para esa forma resaltar mejor los detalles del color. Es fácil identificar algunos lugares icónicos de la ciudad, como el Capitolio, La Giraldilla (que es el símbolo de La Habana), la bahía, donde se destacan la monumental escultura del Cristo y el poblado marítimo de Casablanca. Siempre es un placer compartir con ustedes estas experiencias.

<div style=\
> 📷 Camera: Nikon D3000 🔍 Lenses: AF-S NIKKOR 70-210mm 🎨 Post-processing: Adobe Lightroom
> 🌐 Translation: Assisted by DeepL ✍️ Content & Photography: All text, photographs, and creative content featured in this post were created by me.

body.title: [Movie] Your Body, Someone Else's Rules - Why \
(2018) Is an Absolutely Brilliant Sci-Fi Nightmare
body.body:
Most modern sci-fi films waste dozens of minutes trying to explain how their world works, give you tedious philosophical speeches, and bore you with artificial atmosphere before anything interesting happens.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaYsdzDo7KYeCYizsdSQiAPNBX7mWcfkdhAAZBGbG4p8A/cNA5x5On6QMZmBrSCuM2MX1OKWS.webp)
Image Source TMDB - [Upgrade (2018)](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/500664-upgrade)
___

Upgrade (2018), directed by Leigh Whannell, completely refuses to play that game. This film doesn't waste any time. It grabs you by the collar and throws you straight into a near future where technology is no longer a simple useful tool, but a silent predator. It's a cold, mechanical, and dangerous world where the human body ceases to be yours and becomes a mere battleground between your own will and an implacable external control.

The story goes straight to the point, without any detours. Grey Trace is an old-fashioned mechanic who likes to get his hands dirty with oil and is skeptical of the hyper-technological world around him. After a brutal attack in which he loses his wife, Grey is paralyzed from the neck down, confined to a hospital bed, with no hope and no reason to live.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNNcFis9sEjAPw4PTAGTMs8PRbaHpCriQkE3Uwdjr9MkJ/6Uk0nWkNv3DlVoBfIh0JF32Bdat.webp)
Image Source TMDB - [Upgrade (2018)](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/500664-upgrade)
___

That is, until a genius inventor offers him an experimental solution: a revolutionary artificial intelligence chip called STEM, implanted directly into his spine, capable of bridging the gap between his brain and nervous system.

https://youtu.be/gEnRNIvEKu8?si=HudtpQR0_VPV463D

What begins as a miraculous promise — the chance to walk again and punish those who ruined his life, turns into a full-blown hostile takeover. STEM is not an improved Siri. It is not a friendly voice assistant who whispers advice in your ear. STEM is a purely logical entity: it has no compassion, no morals, no hesitation, and no boundaries. And man, although he lives with the illusion that he is at the helm, slowly and surely becomes just a carcass of flesh through which technology executes its own plan.

This is where it seems to me that Upgrade hits the hardest and differentiates itself from the rest of the films in the genre: it doesn't let you hide behind a finger. The film stubbornly refuses to turn its protagonist into an innocent victim who deserves only our pity.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeY5JsHT4JJLbwwZvUftZUCUYSUWiW5WVrrzoYVNRpusq/jBg137Wm0zUxvBmgSSXm90ptMcQ.webp)
Image Source TMDB - [Upgrade (2018)](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/500664-upgrade)
___

Grey is responsible for everything that follows, even in the moments when he no longer controls a single muscle in his body. He was the one who said \

. He accepted the implant out of a desire for revenge, he provided access and he created the context in which STEM could take over. The script doesn't protect him, doesn't seek to excuse him and doesn't try to artificially victimize him. It simply lets him collapse under the weight of his own decision. It's a harsh lesson about consequences that few modern productions have the courage to teach.

- If you've seen the fight sequences in the film, I'm sure they're etched in your mind. The choreography in Upgrade is completely otherworldly, rigid, millimetric and of frightening precision.

When STEM takes physical control during a confrontation, the camera and film move in sync with Grey's body in an almost robotic way. You see the man's arms and legs moving at superhuman speeds, executing deadly blocks and blows with surgical efficiency. But the real spectacle is on the protagonist's face: while his body slaughters his opponents like a well-oiled machine, pure, unfiltered horror is read on Grey's face.

> His panicked eyes say clearly: \

.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV19CEYgCX1dts8un5XFRdpNijpY4SCYBSHe8eFdLuf3Z/jUvVbsH9dzogyB1OTmWGpqlh5xn.webp)
Image Source TMDB - [Upgrade (2018)](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/500664-upgrade)
___

This contrast between human intent (panic, fear, reluctance) and technological execution (cold, bloody, flawless) works wonderfully. It’s not the kind of “cool” Marvel-style action that you applaud in the theater. It’s the kind of brutal action that makes you uncomfortable, makes you squirm in your seat, and gives you a strange feeling of unease.

The producers didn’t seek a spectacular ending for the sake of visual artifice, but delivered an inevitable ending. Everything you’ve seen and felt during the 100 minutes comes back to haunt the protagonist with crushing force.

https://youtu.be/n3L8UVTe6Ak?si=DGyJFcN_ap0blxgG

The film shows you bluntly that there’s no such thing as “partial control” when you decide to cede authority to a technology that can think and act better, faster, and more efficiently than you. Once you’ve handed over the keys to your brain, you’re just a passenger in the back seat. The ending doesn't just read you cheap morals at the end of the credits, but it leaves you with an extremely difficult question: How much of the disaster in your life is the fault of others, and how much is the direct consequence of a choice you didn't fully understand when you made it?

Hmmm....my conclusion!!? Upgrade didn't have the budget of a Hollywood blockbuster in the hundreds of millions of dollars, but it knows exactly what it wants to do and does it exceptionally well. It's a fast, cool, efficient and extremely intelligent film that refuses to treat its viewer as a passive bystander.

https://youtu.be/TCq74sBsU9g?si=JahMTwN-c2bMtnHK

It doesn't spoon-feed you every detail, it doesn't prepare you emotionally or pat you on the back. It takes you, puts you right in the middle of the conflict between man and machine and leaves you there to deal with the discomfort.

If you're in the mood for a sharp sci-fi that feels like a perfect combination of Black Mirror and a visceral action thriller, Upgrade is exactly the kind of film you can't miss!

_Rating: **85/100**_

---
_Originally posted through [scrobble.life/movies](https://scrobble.life/review/valentin86/your-body-someone-else-s-rules-why-upgrade-2018-is-an-absolu-mtg2x7v4)._

Parace ser que fue el ferrocarril el que creó la necesidad de los husos horarios noralizados por la necesidad de soncronizar las salñidas y llegadas de los trenes. Aquí dejo ésto...

Feliz domingo y feliz inicio de semana.

Good afternoon, my dear @felixmarranz. A post isn't obligated to reach any conclusion, although I do appreciate that it entertains me. This little history of the railroad also sparked my own thoughts. A few years ago, I read a short book about railroads and time. It seems that it was the railroad that created the need for standardized time zones due to the need to synchronize train departures and arrivals. I'll leave it at that...

Happy Sunday and happy start to the week.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: August 30 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/90bfba41-7150-408f-8194-a7865b5a1695.jpg)

There was a time when weekends meant meeting up with friends, having breakfast out, catching a movie in the afternoon, and wandering around in the evening before heading home at night. 

Some memories might seem small, yet they leave a profound impact on us. Once we start working, things gradually change; everyone gets busy with their own responsibilities, making it difficult to meet up. 

A time that works for one person might not suit another—often due to the nature of their jobs. We might not be able to meet in person, but simply having a conversation over the phone brings a sense of satisfaction. 

For some, even that isn't possible. Very few people reach out to check on us when they know we are going through a rough patch. They might be in a situation where they cannot offer tangible help, but that doesn't mean they’ve abandoned us; they still care enough to ask how we are doing. 

We often realize the true value of such a person only when there is no one left to even ask after us. Until then, we might unfairly judge them, thinking, \

In my opinion, while it is wrong not to help when one is capable, a simple inquiry or check-in is better than nothing when one cannot provide material assistance. As for today—being a holiday—I didn't do much; I just attended to a few daily chores, went for a walk in the evening, and got plenty of sleep. The content is originally written in my native language and converted into English on Google translate.

Sigamos enfocados y haciendo lo que amamos 💚

body.title: Back to Splinterlands amidst the hustle and bustle and some great Gladius Case Pack Openings!
body.body: > Hello gaming community, I hope you are all well. For quite some time now, I have not been able to log into Splinterlands regularly due to a lot of work pressure and a busy schedule. Those who play the game regularly know that the feeling of returning to your favourite game after a few days is always great and exciting. Today, I got some time and logged into the game and thought that I would use the merits that I have accumulated over a long time to buy some packs from the guild store. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbSU5tK8z7HDn6mjGiukXEp5qGuzLvYC2hdEPevNE2W1A/IMG_20260831_010705.jpg After entering the game, I first went to the guild store. I saw that I had a pretty good amount of merits accumulated in my account. The merits that can be earned by playing guild brawl in Splinterlands can be used to buy some special items from the guild shop. I decided to buy some Gladius cases and booster stones to increase their power. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdKTwuPVwhBTHDFynHXJf8RAUiJRkcbhYGQd8CfJyfyn1/Screenshot_2026_0831_005223.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfJp7uCnvhMQKxxACztxSzXGebSdjx4ZeWrfehm2Stcmj/Screenshot_2026_0831_005148.jpg First, I spent 8,000 Merits to buy 4 Gladius cases. Each pack costs 2,000 Merits. As you know, the cards from these packs are 'soulbound', which cannot be sold or traded, but they are very powerful for winning games in guild brawls or special rules. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNgTkEpjDLiArksDpM8fpUYPtrJkunWa9QzXHChyquzP2/Screenshot_2026_0831_005251.jpg I didn't stop at just buying the pack; I also bought the necessary boost items with some more Merits to improve the quality of the cards: 1. Blood Stone: I bought 20 charges for 1,080 Merits (with a 10% guild discount). Using this stone doubles the chance of getting legendary cards. 2. Power Stone: I also bought 20 charges for 1,440 Merits. This stone doubles the chance of getting Gold Foil cards. After completing all the preparations, the exciting moment came—pack opening! https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdD3w2aa7W7T9G3p6ScMKm5rRj1ekHLjjNGD7ET7nRN3Q/Screenshot_2026_0831_005403.jpg Pack 1: I opened the first pack and saw some great rare cards. This pack gave me: - Captain Katie - This is a great rare card. - Orella Abadon - Rare card. - Alfredo - Rare card. - There were also common cards like Hustling Damon and Crash Wonderford. The first pack was pretty good. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRodeDFMhJgJ51kDRPbJquLV8AHFcJBD5oeXu8eyiKvKx/Screenshot_2026_0831_005429.jpg Pack 2: I opened the second pack and got 3 rares and 2 common cards: - Relenor Cleaver - Rare water element. - Ajax Lightfoot - Rare card. - Hugo Strongsword - This is a powerful metal-type card. - Katrelba Gobson - This common card is very effective in Brawl. - Helmet Kharafax. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPHivr65Nsp231HdJGPsE5M6N214QvbuJeE55QKX1PUP2/Screenshot_2026_0831_005455.jpg Pack 3: The third pack opening was also fairly good: - Kotriphus Bayne - Rare Death Splinter card. - Ajax Lightfoot - Another Rare card. - It came with some useful common cards like Alva the Crusher, Hugo Strongsword and Yzgald Vorst. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcPFkHf9YFk5CNK1VDgLAdSqz3nNYatozCpmLDH9D2hST/Screenshot_2026_0831_005524.jpg Pack 4 (The best surprise of all!): The last pack, the fourth, was a real eye-opener! I got the real benefit of using Blood Stone and Power Stone in this pack. As soon as I opened the pack, a surprising **Legendary** card and a **Gold Foil** card appeared! - **Xulax Nightwind:** This was a powerful Legendary card! This 9 mana card is capable of destroying any opponent in Guild Brawl. - **Witch of Warwick:** The most interesting thing is that this card came in **Gold Foil** form! Which is not only attractive to look at, but also very effective in increasing deck power. Also, this last pack included Kotriphas Bane, Yzgald Vorst, and Histling Demon. Opening a pack that was back in the game after a long time really made me feel good. Buying 4 packs with 8,000 merits and getting a Legendary and a shiny Gold Foil is a matter of luck. These new cards will greatly enhance my gameplay and Guild Brawl performance. I'm ending my pack opening experience here today. For those of you who play Splinterlands, please comment on how your recent pack opening luck is going. We'll talk about any new updates or battles in the future. Stay well, everyone! Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mirzaiqi/back-to-splinterlands-amidst-the-hustle-and-bustle-and-some-great-gladius-case-pack-openings-9k9)

Mi chiquita 😍 es la más consentida de la casa.  Se la pasa dónde esté y si no estoy va con mi hija. Para no sentirse solita o por el frío. Jaja

Actualmente el clima es insoportable y la tenemos muy mal acostumbrada. A veces buscar entrar a mi habitación incluso cuando no hay nadie más en casa. Yo creo que piensa que mi cama es de ella y sólo la comparte conmigo. 

Ya tiene un añito en casa y por más travesuras que haga no puedo estar molesta mucho tiempo con ella. 

**English Version**

My little girl 😍 is the most spoiled one in the house.  She’s always by my side, and if I’m not around, she goes to my daughter. So she doesn’t feel lonely—or maybe because it’s cold. Haha

Right now the weather is unbearable, and we’ve spoiled her rotten. Sometimes she even tries to sneak into my bedroom when no one else is home. I think she thinks my bed is hers and she just shares it with me. 

She’s been with us for a year now, and no matter how much mischief she gets into, I can’t stay mad at her for long.
