body.title: [Movie] Action, Chaos And Fast Cars! Hobbs & Shaw (2019)
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWWty9Pqs7WqCDpHXy9QS6Gnra9fQFHXj56PBVoZW4VeQ/1000129969.jpg)
The *Fast & Furious* film series is one of the action franchises I followed consistently and enjoyed especially for its storylines, high-speed car chases and daring stunts. So when the spinoff was released, I didn't waste time streaming it. Though I initially wondered why the need for a spinoff, one look at the ensemble cast convinced me that I was in for an entertaining dose of action, fast cars, thrilling chases and cool drive stunts. **Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw (2019)** is an American action comedy directed by David Leitch based on a script by Chris Morgan and Drew Pearce starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham, Idris Elba, Vanessa Kirby, Eiza González, Helen Mirren, Cliff Curtis and other supporting actors. This spinoff follows Hattie Shaw (Vanessa Kirby), an MI6 agent who gets hold of a supervirus that could wipe out the world from existence and made by a terrorist group. But she is ambushed by Brixton Lore (Idris Elba), an ex-MI6 agent, who works for the terrorist group and wants the virus. Not willing to let it fall into the wrong hands, Hattie injects herself with the virus and goes on the run. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdPyAHXjx9rZsjkBtxmjNJWr3NLpbNa5bPQ1QrvKUPKij/1000129975.jpg) Her brother, Deckard Shaw (Jason Statham), also an ex-MI6 agent recently released from prison is paired with Luke Hobbs (Dwayne Johnson), an ex-DSS agent, to find the missing virus. In search of Hattie, Shaw and Hobbs are attacked by the terrorist group. They find Hattie and Hobbs takes her to the CIA office for protection and they are attacked again. That is when Deckard meets his old colleague, Brixton and realises they are not on the same side. Can he save his sister from dying from the virus? Can they extract the deadly virus from Hattie without endangering her and humanity? https://images.hive.blog/DQmTfmKGxwrfbPKTkSb7bZ4u68wi3JrV1PGKDiWWVzve6bj/1000129968.jpg #### My Review And Rating Despite mixed reviews from viewers, I actually enjoyed this movie. The plot is a familiar one but the storytelling, pacing, acting and action sequences elevates it. The actors bring from the franchise their wild, exciting energy of impossible stunts, powerful enemies, advanced technology and vehicles being pushed far beyond anything most of us would consider sane and reasonable. This movie turned out to be impressive for me because of the chemistry between Jason Statham and Dwayne Johnson. Their constant insults and competitive behaviour give this movie its personality. Neither of them is willing to give the other the satisfaction of being right even when they are clearly trying to achieve the same goal of saving the world, and Hattie. Somehow their differences work in the movies’ favour. Hobbs is loud, direct and driven by loyalty and Dwayne Johnson embodies him in a fascinating way. On the other hand, Shaw is more controlling, calculating and comfortable working alone. Their approaches clash but that clash creates the comedy. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXbuV2zQ3C6SGhtn64ioDyChTrg3jccyX9aRQyBe6fCx3/1000129970.jpg) ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmapsYWJyLdM4F4dM6JXwjAN1dbNifSZdo8uso7FMAFmko/1000129971.jpg) Another thing I enjoyed is the way the movie changes its atmosphere from a polished, global action thriller feel to gradually becoming more personal. By the end, there is a stronger sense of history and connection behind the explosions and fistfights. The action is exciting to watch but the movie gives the characters something more to fight for than simply stopping another villain. Idris Elba as the villain brings an interesting presence to this film. He's confident, intimidating and enhanced by technology that makes him seem impossible to defeat. I wish this movie explored his character more but if there will be a sequel, maybe they might touch on this aspect. I love Vanessa Kirby as Hattie. She's capable, intelligent and not treated as a damsel in distress. And as the three of them move from one dangerous situation to another, their acting becomes seamless. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWbKDowXBf7Wj1Hq1MQzra5wX7xowZf9RK4kEbBuqm252/1000129974.jpg) ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV9jCPMYXShMeTxPHdCahTaoGMHc8ydBJ2k1M9kLEFhgT/1000129973.jpg) Like the franchise, the theme of family is emphasised in this film when Hobbs visits his family on an island seeking help. I also find it interesting that Hobbs and Shaw with all their macho acts constantly turn to the women to save them including Helen Mirren as Shaw's mother and Eiza González as Madame M. The choreography is smooth and the visuals are impressive. As I expected, the filmmakers try to defy physics by making their cars survive situations they shouldn't and actors performing stunts that would put a normal person in the hospital. This movie is not realistic and once you accept this, the action scenes become more captivating. Rating this movie, I'd give it 7.5 out of 10 stars. It's an interesting, fast paced movie that puts two popular characters together to show why audiences enjoy watching them. The action is huge and the partnership gives this film enough personality to stand apart from the main series. I hope there will be a sequel to it. https://youtu.be/HZ7PAyCDwEg?si=eJ7UXd6BUvNf2V7g ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are screenshots from the movie* *[Poster image source](https://pics.filmaffinity.com/Fast_Furious_Hobbs_Shaw-729732578-large.jpg)* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog* 🤗
_Rating: **75/100**_ --- _Originally posted through [scrobble.life/movies](https://scrobble.life/review/esther-emmanuel/action-chaos-and-fast-cars-hobbs-shaw-2019-mtg2a3vo)._

body.title: Xbox may be in the biggest crisis, but its studios are soaring
body.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2gVMkrvTVtyCgBytru444MgPcZiDLytvjiMKAtkHXX5vqnaiCszvdJajfU92Mmgjy8.png)


---

I have to admit that lately it has become harder to understand exactly what Microsoft wants Xbox to be. For years, the company invested huge amounts of money into its gaming division, bought major studios and created Game Pass, but the results have not always matched those ambitions.

The situation is especially interesting because, while Xbox itself is facing a difficult period, some of the studios under Microsoft's umbrella are actually doing very well. Blizzard, for example, has reportedly become the top-performing Xbox studio after finishing Microsoft's fiscal year above expectations.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xL2ixYVMRnG5dwP3NhYBgjc3QF2oM9ARYvQQZXiz34oDHvaioYDUV3Wc9gm92usFeks.png)



---

For me, this is one of the strangest parts of the current Xbox situation. It doesn't feel like Microsoft has a lack of talent or games. The company has an enormous amount of intellectual property, talented developers and some of the biggest franchises in the industry.

The problem seems to be figuring out how to put all of those pieces together.

Xbox has also been dealing with layoffs and major restructuring, which obviously creates uncertainty for players. Recent reports indicate that Microsoft's gaming division has been under pressure, while the company continues changing its strategy around consoles, PC, cloud gaming and Game Pass.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xKrGxUwCeryDhSaVp9khEBUPxMizvVYSKG4ahcw7rhL9gQ2AHdQVHM2ZHX1wD6NrQSu.png)




---

And honestly, I think the biggest problem is that Xbox doesn't feel as clear as it used to.

When I think about Nintendo, I immediately understand what Nintendo is trying to sell me. When I think about PlayStation, I can also understand its identity. With Xbox, however, things have become much more complicated.

Is Xbox a console? Is it Game Pass? Is it PC gaming? Is it cloud gaming? Is it a publisher that wants its games everywhere?

The answer seems to be a little bit of everything.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/242rrongXxdMwKi7UAa1Tq9BZzBMWGMCAY3GndL8aRvmcr886fEWwSfo62Svu5tMiheYQ.png)




---

I understand why Microsoft is doing this. Selling games on other platforms can potentially generate more money, while Game Pass gives players a huge library for a monthly subscription.

But from a fan perspective, I can also understand why some people feel confused. If Xbox games are appearing everywhere, what exactly is the reason to buy an Xbox console?

This is where I think the success of studios like Blizzard becomes interesting.

Blizzard reportedly finished fiscal year 2026 with its third-highest fiscal revenue ever, while Overwatch had its strongest quarter since 2022 and other major franchises also performed strongly.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vhuddzqZXkC8JkGYctSANHXJZvxsoUhnpMZzeULQSdZQpB4MQ5tkadGa13pnSoTTLxJ.png)




---

That tells me something important: Microsoft doesn't necessarily have a content problem.

Maybe the bigger challenge is making the entire Xbox ecosystem feel like one coherent thing.

Personally, I don't think Xbox is dead or finished. That idea seems exaggerated to me.

Microsoft still has an enormous amount of money, some of the biggest franchises in gaming and the ability to invest for years if it wants to. The upcoming strategy around the next generation, including the reported Project Helix plans and broader compatibility between Xbox and PC, could become extremely important.

What I want to see now is a clearer direction.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tmBi1stVk86vaNPfWpXwfq9vyGzMwFSq7JAErZKJ9vhbjQigiueP9EAseoy5nm65Km1.png)


---

I want Xbox to remember why people became fans of it in the first place. Great games, great hardware, a strong community and the feeling that there is a reason to be part of the ecosystem.

Maybe the current crisis is actually the moment Microsoft needs to rethink everything.

And if the company manages to learn from its mistakes, I honestly think Xbox could come out of this period stronger than before.

body.title: [Movie] THE SOUND OF MUSIC
body.body:
Hello everyone it's your girl @chisom13❤️

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmULPBiwBJb6fF7Z9xXbP4ZGcgwaY3B1xdcPnEzYw9qdpX/1000513252.jpg)



The Sound of Music is both a movie and a musical. It's a beautiful film adaptation of what I consider one of the greatest musicals ever written.

Maria is a free-spirited young Austrian woman studying to become a nun at Nonnberg Abbey but she isn't exactly the perfect nun. She loves singing, exploring the mountains and enjoying the beauty of nature, and her free-spirited personality often gets her into trouble at the convent.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWnRehTyPYbrxiCER6Ke7QrSr88F6MpBsne6MCnq6njRU/1000513259.jpg)


Eventually, Mother Abbess sends Maria to the villa of retired naval officer Captain Georg von Trapp a widower, to be the new governess to his seven children: Liesl, Friedrich, Louisa, Kurt, Brigitta, Marta, and Gretl. The Captain has been raising his children using strict military discipline following the death of his wife.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbrzcntkanqeqyhLnHpzzuZwsaYZEtT7MGFEpLVomXs22/1000513250.jpg)



They have scared away several governesses by playing tricks. Although the children misbehave at first, Maria responds with kindness and patience, and soon the children come to trust and respect her.

Instead of controlling the children like their father does, she takes her time to understand them and later gains their trust. She also introduces music to them, takes them outside, makes them enjoy being children and gradually brings happiness to their home.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRchhfrq5VnKnCWxaHL3Ea2f2Z5B2jQLVkXPtbUcf2tW3/1000513251.jpg)



She didn't just teach them how to sing, she taught them how to live joyfully.

One of my favourite parts of the movie is the music. From “Do-Re-Mi” to “My Favorite Things,” “Edelweiss,” “Sixteen Going on Seventeen” and the unforgettable “The Sound of Music. It has a way of smoothing the soul. 

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZdpifnMqn9RuTq1Pm4cCwYyfExjF8pUsQmkpNrc6fwJs/1000513253.jpg)



I also love how gentle Maria is with the children. Her kind heart and cheerful nature slowly brings laughter, singing and  life back to their home.

Then, comes the romance between Maria and Captain von Trapp.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNsUW4fvxVWf3yYFtwTBvejJ6KNFRwn9dMyEqGVCVb44b/1000513254.jpg)



At first, their relationship is so complicated. He is so strict and difficult to deal with. But as time goes on, and he spends more time at home, he begins to notice how loving Maria is. He later finds himself falling in love with her and with time, they begin to understand each other and their relationship gradually develops into something beautiful.

He starts laughing, singing again and reconnects with his children.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUVsghWTo3vraa5XfotvMuiCxfA7Y4UmDc4PYM9yC3MH9/1000513255.jpg)



Maria doesn't accept the relationship, when she realises she has fallen in love with the Captain, she runs away from the house back to the convent. She is scared that her feeling for him are wrong and it's failing in her commitment to her religious life.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX1F8YNuvFqWgF77za4MnTUu4fbGmum9hJaYPQw664qDh/1000513246.jpg)



Mother Superior realises something wrong and talks to Maria about it. Maria eventually opens up to her. She doesn't condemn her for falling in love, instead, she encourages her to explore her feelings and follow her heart.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQme5b1WKazMo9e3QNe3MXSU8DnbFCvc9eyGRhsgxWWz9yq/1000513249.jpg)



But just when everything finally seems perfect, Austria is about to come under Germany's control, and the Captain may soon find himself drafted into the German Navy and forced to fight against his own country.

The most striking thing about the movie is how beautiful it is. The mountains, the abbey, the home, the music, and the people are all right out of a fairy tale.

In the end, you discover that life is a mystery, it always has unpredictable endings. Maria already had her life all planned out, that is, to be a Nun but she unexpectedly finds love and eventually becomes a mother to seven children. Sometimes, life can take us somewhere we never expected.
But I guess, that's the beauty of life❤️.

Thank you stopping by my blog today ❤️, I will really appreciate your love and support.

_Rating: **100/100**_

---

body.title: 🦈 DIEMONSHARK — My new purchase is a powerful Water card
body.body:
When I bought this card, I thought it would be a good addition to my Water Splinter. So after thinking a lot, I finally bought the card. In today's article, I want to share my own experience and some things about the card's various aspects.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf58LrBQWYdfi9ECpJQBYAwvSDsk4udDTxUQqN1EFRDnx/1788109325804.jpg)

When buying a new card in Splinterlands, I don't just look at the current power of the card. I also try to understand how useful the card can be in my battle strategy in the future. Especially, the Mana Cost, Attack, Speed, Armor, Health and Ability of a card are very important to me. In the case of the DIEMONSHARK card, I decided to buy it by considering these factors.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmde1eE6aF4M8uoNyiZqjk57t21XDKFPksh5Z1cfueFiX3/1788109325961.jpg)

🦈 The moment I bought the DIEMONSHARK card

As you can see in the picture, when I was going to buy the DIEMONSHARK card, its price was 141.55 DEC.  The price didn't seem too high to me, especially after looking at the card's stats. So without thinking too much, I decided to buy it.

What I liked most about the card is that it has good Armor and Health from its base level. At Level 1, its Mana Cost is 8. That is, it is not a card for low-Mana Battles, but rather a card to use in Battles with sufficient Mana. But in return, it can provide quite strong Defensive Support.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdBvBacixjJsPuXd1FXu8xQgb1chgV5kboLE7xQHUDuKU/1788109325895.jpg)

At Level 1, DIEMONSHARK has Attack 2, Speed 4, Armor 6 and Health 7. In my opinion, these stats are not bad at all for Level 1. Especially since it has 6 Armor and 7 Health, it can act as a good Tank to prevent attacks from the front.

⚔️ DIEMONSHARK's Role in Battle

The most interesting aspect of DIEMONSHARK for me is its Defensive ability. Many times in Battle, we look for a Tank that will not only attack, but also withstand many hits and give time to the cards behind us.

 I think DIEMONSHARK can be quite useful in this place.

Since it has 6 Armor, it is possible to block a lot of damage through Armor before the enemy's Physical Attack goes directly to Health. Also, since it has 7 Health, it can survive in Battle for some time even after the Armor runs out.

And I also like that its Speed is 4. If it is a very slow Tank, the enemy's card often attacks first. But since DIEMONSHARK has Speed 4, it can get a chance to attack quickly in at least some Battles.

Of course, not every Battle is the same. The outcome of the entire Battle depends a lot on the Opponent's Summoner, Ruleset, Magic Attack, Melee Attack and other Abilities. So it is not possible to win every Battle if only one card is strong. The real thing is to use the right Strategy at the right time.

📈 Level Up the Card It will be even better

I was also quite interested in seeing the Level Stats of the DIEMONSHARK card. 

The best thing is that as you increase the level, additional abilities are added to the card. That is, not only does Attack or Health increase, but the card's usability during Battle also increases.

To me, this is the biggest reason to Level Up a card. A card may seem ordinary at first, but after increasing the level, it can become much more effective due to the new ability it gets.

So if I get the chance in the future, I will try to Level Up DIEMONSHARK further. Of course, it will depend on how many copies I have and what the market price of the card is at that time.

🌊 Use with Water Splinter

Since DIEMONSHARK is a Rare card for Water Splinter, I plan to use it with my Water lineup.

 When fighting with Water Splinter, I usually try to create a team with a strong Tank in the front and the cards in the back to support that Tank.

I think DIEMONSHARK can fit well into that type of strategy.

If you put DIEMONSHARK in the front and use Damage Dealer and Support cards in the back, it may be possible to hold off the opponent's attack for a while. And during that time, the cards in the back can deal damage to the enemy team.

However, I think you have to be a little careful when using it against Magic Attack. Because Armor is mainly more effective in preventing Physical Damage. So it is very important to create a lineup by understanding what kind of team the opponent can use.

💰 My opinion on the purchase decision

When I bought DIEMONSHARK for 141.55 DEC, my main intention was not just to collect a new card. I wanted a card that could be useful in my battle strategy in the future.

 Looking at the stats of this card, I think it's a pretty good card for me, especially defensively.

If you buy a card and don't use it, you won't get the full benefit of buying it. So now my goal is to try using DIEMONSHARK against different rulesets and different types of opponents.

I will understand which type of battle it works best in, which Summoner it combines well with, and which Support Card it is most effective with—all these things as I battle.

🎮 My next plan

Now that DIEMONSHARK has been added to my collection, my interest in it has increased even more. I want to gradually gain experience in using it.

Not every battle can be won with all the cards. Sometimes we can lose a battle despite having good cards. Sometimes an ordinary team can give extraordinary results due to the right strategy. This is what I like most about Splinterlands.

I want to play the same way with DIEMONSHARK. First, I will use the Level 1 card in different battles.  If I think the card is consistently giving good results in my strategy, then I will try to collect more copies and Level Up in the future.

Finally, I would like to say that I am really happy with my collection after buying this new DIEMONSHARK card.And as the level increases, its Stats and Ability have the opportunity to improve further.

I hope that DIEMONSHARK will become an important card for my Water Team in future battles. Now the real test will be on the Battle field. I will gradually understand how well the card actually performs.

Buying a new card means not only expanding my collection for me; but also an opportunity to create a new strategy. And that is why buying this DIEMONSHARK today is also a very happy moment for me. 🦈🌊🎮

body.title: Ісландія на розслідуванні: коли класичний детектив зустрічається з вічним холодом
body.body: Буває, читаєш детектив, і раптом ловиш себе на думці: ну от, знову герой-геній зненацька витягує з рукава доказ, якого ніде не було, або розгадка висить на випадковості, яка трапилася десь на задвірках оповіді. Саме в такі моменти я згадую про Раґнара Йонассона. І не випадково, адже його ім'я міцно пов'язане з магією [класичного детективу](https://bookblogua.com/oglyady-avtoriv/kryha-shcho-ne-tane-detektyvna-heohrafiya-ragnara-yonassona?utm_source=ecency&utm_medium=referral), тією, що її творила Аґата Крісті. Уявіть, людина в сімнадцять років береться за переклади її романів і доводить справу до чотирнадцяти повних томів ісландською мовою. Це ж не просто підліткове захоплення, правда? Це вже справжнє занурення в архітектуру жанру.\n\n

/>І саме та кристі-подібна конструкція — коли коло підозрюваних замкнене, гра з читачем чесна, а розгадка спирається на логіку, а не на щасливий збіг обставин, — стала його фірмовим знаком. Навіть посвята Крісті є на титульній сторінці одного з пізніших романів. Можливо, саме це пояснює, чому Йонассона так часто порівнюють не з його сучасниками в нордичному нуарі, а саме з цією великою майстринею.

Але життя письменника — це не лише книги. Це завжди про досвід, який формує твій погляд на світ і на письмо. Йонассон здобув юридичну освіту, багато років працював адвокатом, а й досі викладає авторське право в університеті. Він також був телевізійним та радіожурналістом, а нині ще й член ради директорів Ісландського симфонічного оркестру. Чи не дивовижно, як ця багатошарова кар'єра – право, медіа, переклад, музичний менеджмент – відбивається в його прозі? Для нього детектив – це ніколи не шлях до швидкого заробітку чи проста розважальна формула. Кожен його роман – це юридично й фактично витримана конструкція, де уява працює пліч-о-пліч з дисципліною людини, яка звикла оперувати доказами.

Його дебютний роман, \
, – вийшов 2010 року ісландською. Так почався цикл \

про молодого поліцейського Арі Тора Арасона. Герой переїжджає зі столичного Рейк'явіка до рибальського містечка Сіглуфйордюр, відрізаного тунелем у горах. Цікаво, що це рідне місто батька й діда самого письменника, куди він і досі їздить щороку. Міжнародне визнання прийшло не одразу, бо англійський переклад з'явився лише у 2015 році. Ісландський порядок книжок був іншим, але для міжнародних ринків послідовність змінили, і так цикл почав завойовувати читачів по обидва боки Атлантики.

Окрім власного письма, Йонассон також доклав руку до створення детективного фестивалю. У 2013 році він разом з іншою письменницею та перекладачем заснував Iceland Noir у Рейк'явіку. Кажуть, ідея виникла за вечерею в індійському ресторані, коли вони здивувалися, чому країна з такою потужною традицією нуару не має свого фестивалю. Перше видання організували за півроку, і почесною гостею стала британська письменниця, яка погодилася приїхати, навіть не звірившись зі своїм графіком. Сьогодні цей фестиваль, який Йонассон досі співголовує, щороку збирає сотні гостей з усього світу, включно з відомими іменами.

Паралельно Йонассон розгорнув ще один цикл — \
. Він розповідає про детективку Хульду Германсдоттір. Перший роман цього циклу, \
, навіть ліг в основу телесеріалу, де сам автор виступив виконавчим продюсером. Досвід роботи над \
підготував ґрунт для наступного етапу — серії-спін-оффу \

про молодого криміналіста Гельґі Рейкдаля, який у першому романі циклу перетинається з Хульдою Германсдоттір саме напередодні її виходу на пенсію.\n\nТут, до речі, важливо прояснити один момент, який часто губиться в оглядах [ісландського нуару](https://naperelomi.com.ua/?utm_source=ecency&utm_medium=referral). Попри спільний авторський почерк, \

(з Гельґі Рейкдалем) — це три _різні_, хоча й перехресно пов'язані цикли з різними головними героями. Це _не_ єдина наскрізна серія, як іноді помилково вважають. Саме на цьому, наймолодшому циклі про Гельґі, а також на одному позасерійному романі, зосереджені три книжки Йонассона, перекладені українською мовою.

. Роман розгортається у двох часових лініях. У 1983 році в колишньому туберкульозному санаторії на півночі Ісландії, що перетворився на звичайну лікарняну палату, вбивають літню медсестру. Детективка Хульда Германсдоттір зі своїм начальником розслідує справу серед шістьох підозрюваних. Через тиждень головний лікар гине, впавши з балкона; смерть визнають самогубством, а справу закривають, вважаючи його вбивцею медсестри. Майже тридцять років потому, у 2012-му, до цієї нерозкритої історії береться молодий криміналіст Гельґі Рейкдаль. Він щойно повернувся з навчання і отримав посаду в поліції Рейк'явіка — ту саму, яку звільняє Хульда, виходячи на пенсію. Гельґі, палкий шанувальник класичного детективу золотої доби, береться знову опитати живих свідків, і швидко натрапляє на стіну мовчання. Цей роман став бестселером, а критики відзначили його бездоганно чесну побудову інтриги в дусі Крісті.\n\n

. Тут молодий криміналіст вже виступає в ролі детектива. Одного зимового вечора безслідно зникає популярна ісландська авторка детективів. Гельґі доручають розкрити справу до того, як про зникнення дізнаються журналісти. Це одразу задає роману подвійність: розслідування реального злочину та паралельне дослідження професійного й особистого життя жінки, чия репутація письменниці виявляється набагато складнішою, ніж публічний образ. Опитуючи людей з її найближчого оточення, Гельґі поступово виявляє, що успішний фасад приховував провали, творчі кризи та особисті конфлікти, кожен з яких міг стати мотивом. Сюжет свідомо будується як данина класичній традиції \

з чіткими правилами гри з читачем, де всі необхідні для розгадки факти чесно викладені по ходу тексту. І, до речі, особиста лінія Гельґі — його непроста історія співжиття з партнеркою — слугує тут емоційним якорем розслідування, за що книжку окремо відзначили рецензенти.\n\n

.](https://naperelomi.com.ua/ua/p2864809609-rejkyavik-nordicheskij-detektiv.html?utm_source=ecency&utm_medium=referral) Це позасерійний роман, написаний у співавторстві з тодішньою прем'єр-міністеркою Ісландії, яка до політичної кар'єри викладала ісландську літературу. Ця книга також відверто присвячена Аґаті Крісті. Дія починається у 1956 році: чотирнадцятирічна дівчина проводить літо як хатня робітниця на невеликому острові неподалік Рейк'явіка і на початку серпня зникає безслідно. Поліцейський веде розслідування, але справа так і лишається нерозкритою десятиліттями. Тридцять років по тому, у 1986-му, коли Рейк'явік готується святкувати двохсотріччя міста, молодий журналіст береться розплутати справу наново. І що ближче він підходить до розгадки, то очевидніше стає, що впливові сили в місті готові зробити все, аби таємниця й далі залишалася прихованою. Роман увійшов до списку найкращих кримінальних романів року за версією The New York Times, а Kirkus Reviews назвав його \

, гідним письменниці, якій він присвячений.\n\nВсі ці три книги, хоч і належать до різних періодів і форматів творчості Йонассона, демонструють одну його наскрізну авторську методологію. Він не жертвує чесністю гри з читачем заради темпу оповіді. Натомість послідовно вибудовує розслідування як інтелектуальну задачу, що є спадщиною золотої доби детективу. І водночас він щоразу заземлює інтригу в конкретному ісландському соціальному контексті — чи то забутий санаторій, чи літературне середовище, чи навіть політична верхівка острівної держави. Саме ця подвійна вірність — класичній конструкції загадки і документальній достовірності місця й часу — і робить його романи такими особливими.

body.title: My Second Day at the🥳🥳🥳 Hotel Front Desk: Learning Patience and Finding a New Vibe
body.body:
Yesterday was just full of pure excitement, but today was my second day at the hotel, and man, it really showed me what real hotel management actually looks like. I woke up pretty early in the morning, spent some good time ironing my uniform so it looked sharp, and then walked over to the hotel with a huge smile on my face. Honestly, I felt like a totally different person compared to those dark, hopeless days when I was just sitting empty-handed inside my small rented room.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWXE51g1CSgF8aSD7amLE1iiSF9H5M6jELq7jzbacYVGX/1788109211022.jpg)


The moment my shift started at the front desk, everything became crazy busy. Yesterday I was just standing there and watching things, but today my senior manager told me to actually handle a real guest check-in by myself. I won't lie, my hands were literally shaking when I first touched the computer keyboard. A family had just arrived all the way from Islamabad; they looked super tired from the long travel, and their little kids were crying. I immediately remembered what I was taught, took a deep breath, and welcomed them with the biggest, warmest smile I could manage.



 It took me a little extra time to process their room keys on the system, but the guests were incredibly nice and patient. When the father looked at me and said, \

all my fear and nervousness just disappeared in a second.By the afternoon, I had to face my very first real problem. A guest came downstairs looking quite angry, complaining that the hot water system in his bathroom wasn't working at all. 





At my old clothing store job, if any customer got mad, the shop owner would just start blaming me for everything. But here, things were different. My senior manager stepped in very calmly.


He listened to the guy calmly. Then he called the repair boys to fix it fast. He turned to me, smiled, and said, \

Man, that hit me hard. I learned a big thing today. Hotel work is not just about clean beds. It is about staying quiet and cool when things go bad. After that, it was tea time. So I went to sit with the kitchen staff.



We drank some really strong, hot milk tea together, and they started asking me more about my old life back in Karachi and how different Lahore feels to me now. For the first time in so many months, I didn't feel lonely or like an outsider in this massive city. It felt like I am finally starting to build a small circle of people who actually care about how my day went.I am writing all this down tonight because I really want to remind everyone on Ecency that tough times don't last forever. 





I know I only made a tiny bit of crypto on my very last post, but honestly, the crazy amount of motivation it gave me to keep writing is worth way more than any dollar amount. I am learning new things every single day, I am finally earning some real respect, and I know Allah Pak is showing me the right way forward step by step.

body.title: [ES-EN]Conociendo La Nieve en Farellones Chile-Experiencing the Snow in Farellones, Chile
body.body:
>Muy buenos días hivers, viajeros, amantes de las aventuras. Vengo a contarles que el viernes pasado tuve un día muy especial, después de casi 7 años en Santiago de Chile y 6 inviernos, finalmente fui a hacer el tradicional paseo de conocer la nieve, aunque en mi país hace muchos años atrás tuve la fortuna de verla en Mérida. Good morning, winter lovers, travelers, and adventure seekers. I’m here to tell you that last Friday was a very special day for me. After nearly 7 years in Santiago, Chile—and 6 winters—I finally went on the traditional trip to see the snow, even though I was lucky enough to see it many years ago in Mérida, back in my home country. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23ywwZduJ8vSgesHJoGheEpuWvNhYS8jmAJGLrC1iXomtpSm2Lc5q8Upm4qc7zSkcGii3.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/242rkwSX86TBNr99CWD3MKD4tpWGa7cQDaSFiAe1Sbg3LzxguNrmNtDKxECqEtgKYsWA5.png)
---

>Realmente no era un paseo que me entusiasmara mucho, pues el frío suele ser duro para mi. Sin embargo hay que vivir bonito y aprovechar las oportunidades que se nos presenten. Ese viernes me paré muy temprano junto a mi amiga y nos fuimos al punto de encuentro con el grupo y la van que nos llevaría al paseo. It wasn't really a trip I was very excited about, since the cold is usually tough on me. However, you have to live life to the fullest and take advantage of the opportunities that come your way. That Friday, I got up very early with my friend, and we headed to the meeting point to join the group and the van that would take us on the trip.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23uQpecgvwy3HrSXsAJPBYEVJcibYKpyiTVEUvxG4aaamJEiDY2btoYfF8pcXhm5KWWgX.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23z7GD7rPfLxtDsFQLZQ5PfkUJsg3qELAcAqXvH4dQkz2a4pjFNiDo9T2DLRtFmbhp7Ue.png)
--- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23w2uWD6TqtYk2DWZ97aTXprVhpkuuS17MxwiPFb9WYZepQw6QrvZKom3aL2noBsMTDGB.png) ---

>A las 6 de la mañana ya estábamos en la ruta, recibiendo las indicaciones y las recomendaciones, junto a mi amiga decidimos no subir al parque pero si quedarnos en el pueblo llamado Farellones. La primera parada fue en el centro de equipamiento y ropa necesaria para estar en la nieve, ese día estaríamos a -2° y -6°. Mi abrigo es gigante y bastante abrigado así que solo renté los lentes para protegerme del reflejo del sol en la nieve y las botas especiales porque las zapatillas deportivas definitivamente no son aptas. At 6 a.m. we were already on the road, getting directions and recommendations. My friend and I decided not to go up to the park but to stay in the town called Farellones. Our first stop was at the rental shop for the gear and clothing needed for the snow; that day, temperatures would range from -2° to -6°. My coat is huge and quite warm, so I just rented goggles to protect my eyes from the sun’s glare off the snow and special boots, since sneakers definitely aren’t suitable. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/242DLEJ7rG17T6LpqyoRzUhwvwk9kWKGH7x3UXUvvjpwZBQQaFVyb5AiqReHcvdowULy1.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/244UhiWjXEzDs92hVAD1qC9c9p999PG6gRrtnuTBGbDCBe1oXTwiqr44xD2a5BiqVHVXi.png)
---

>Había muchas ropas coloridas y bonitas, como también elementos para esquiar y demás deportes especiales para la nieve. Una vez equipado todo el grupo seguimos, emprendimos el camino de 2 hrs casi para Farellones, en una montaña bastante empinada con muchas curvas, pero yo aproveche de dormir. There were lots of colorful and pretty clothes, as well as gear for skiing and other snow sports. Once the whole group was geared up, we set off on the nearly 2-hour hike to Farellones, up a fairly steep mountain with lots of curves, but I took the opportunity to sleep. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23xKzVfxYRZctv2r2ymj1m3ythepm58ReG6ePZZS5hMgTonLL3XsPwQp7HBH1bFUKtwEt.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23xp8Z4pmmewWQHKVNtGyfCUbXPW1bk8oGtyEzxCWMZeU7ocgBiqHrcJ8QpfVCxPoJYi4.png)
---

>Finalmente nos dejaron en la entrada del pueblo, desde que llegamos estuvimos rodeados de nieve, fue increíble la primera vista, pude admirar, reflexionar y agradecer la oportunidad de vivir la experiencia. Subimos en unos 10 min por unas escaleras hasta la primera parte del pueblo que es un como plano lleno de nieve donde puedes observar al horizonte a Santiago y sus alrededores casi totalmente nevado. Finally, they dropped us off at the entrance to the village. From the moment we arrived, we were surrounded by snow. The first view was incredible; I was able to take it all in, reflect, and be grateful for the opportunity to have this experience. We climbed a set of stairs for about 10 minutes to the first part of the village, which is a sort of flat, snow-covered area where you can see Santiago and its surroundings on the horizon, almost entirely covered in snow. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23yJM56MZm4KFdRCcyzV8XUzwAhZMxoQAYfyWHMCYH1vz6kzm63W9tywNEo8iekdD179C.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23tShMbhwoTo7muE8FRJfbuhSYHk3acQJEoFWX86HHDxN21Ui4Z83eX9owwC59GkKLkWD.png)
---

>Subimos lento, apreciando el paisaje pero también cuidándonos de no caer y respirando de forma consciente porque el frío y la altura suelen restar oxígeno. Al llegar nos recibió la inmensidad de la creación nevada, a donde mires estaba lleno de nieve, también de personas turistas y citadinos que van a practicar los deportes y otros como nosotros que van solo a ver, conocer disfrutar de un buen chocolate caliente o una crema de verduras de la temporada. We climbed slowly, taking in the scenery but also being careful not to fall and breathing consciously, since the cold and the altitude tend to reduce oxygen levels. When we arrived, we were greeted by the vastness of the snow-covered landscape; everywhere you looked was covered in snow, as well as tourists and city dwellers who had come to play sports, and others like us who were there just to look around, explore, and enjoy a good hot chocolate or a seasonal vegetable soup. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23uFe9xvbjgM4zpsNFuWe7otV9JRcyDZ8tgZLYwkbUzyLdgwoXNfds3SuWmGrbhhiydqf.png)
---

>Después de caminar bastante, apreciar el paisaje nos sentamos un rato a conversar de la vida, aproveche de hacer una lectura de cartas para mi amiga, aprovechando que la energía estaba fresca y de disfrute. Compartimos los lunches que cada una llevó, entre frutas, pan y te. After walking quite a bit and taking in the scenery, we sat down for a while to talk about life. I took the opportunity to do a card reading for my friend, taking advantage of the fresh, joyful energy in the air. We shared the lunches we’d each brought—fruit, bread, and tea. ---

>Finalmente nos ubicamos en un lugar donde pudimos hacer el ángel de nieve y el muñeco con la canción respectiva de “ y si hacemos un muñeco”. A las 3 de la tarde comenzamos el descenso para encontrarnos con el resto de grupo para volver a Santiago, en ese momento estaba algo nublado, más frío, empezando la nevada leve. Finally, we found a spot where we could make a snow angel and a snowman while singing the song “What If We Make a Snowman?” At 3:00 p.m., we began our descent to meet up with the rest of the group and head back to Santiago. By then, it was somewhat cloudy, colder, and a light snow had begun to fall. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/245canK776wJSJqukSr19YhaQYPG3niZy5Cjy7paJXfhcLqzjV8SQqDCTJV4nDzECJ6Nw.png)
---

>Realmente fue un paseo encantador, relajante que todos si tienen la oportunidad vivanlo, si les gusta los deportes extremos los de la nieve les da un extra esfuerzo para ejercitarse con gusto. Si llegaron hasta acá muchas gracias hivers, nos leemos en una próxima aventura.Las fotos son registro personal con redmi note 13. It really was a lovely, relaxing outing that everyone should experience if they get the chance. If you like extreme sports, snow sports give you that extra push to exercise with enthusiasm. If you’ve made it this far, thank you so much, hivers—see you on our next adventure. The photos are from my personal collection, taken with a Redmi Note 13. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikablr/23y8zFmgLDaapp9zziScQNRHTfRACr8Ejv6ETuxUkPKdbcgMT5DZrDnubkXn3MUrBWiq5.png)

body.title: Why the physical world still runs on paper, and why that is rational
body.body:
# Why the physical world still runs on paper, and why that is rational

![Why the physical world still runs on paper, and why that is rational](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Physical%20examination%20of%20child%2C%20age%2015%20months.jpeg)

Leyendo Why the physical world still runs on paper, and why that is rational me puse a pensar en cómo cambió el panorama.

Tengo una opinión formada sobre esto, y no voy a ser neutral.

**Lo que veo**

Why the physical world still runs on paper, and why that is rational es una noticia que refleja la aceleración constante en el sector tecnológico. Lo que vemos aquí no es solo un evento aislado, sino parte de un patrón más amplio de innovación que viene dando forma a la industria desde hace meses.

La clave está en entender que cada avance tecnológico tiene múltiples capas. Está lo que se anuncia, lo que realmente significa para el mercado, y lo que viene después. Y eso es exactamente lo que vale la pena analizar cuando leemos este tipo de noticias.

**Mi lectura**

La industria tecnológica tiene un problema de narrativa. Cada avance se presenta como la próxima gran revolución, cuando en realidad la mayoría son iteraciones incrementales importantes, pero incrementales al fin. Lo que sí es cierto es que la velocidad de estas iteraciones se acelera, y eso cambia las reglas del juego.

Lo que me preocupa —y no veo que nadie hable mucho de esto— es la brecha entre los que entienden estos cambios y los que los consumen pasivamente. Cada vez hay más herramientas disponibles, pero la alfabetización tecnológica no crece al mismo ritmo.

No se trata de ser pesimista. Se trata de ser realista. La tecnología es una herramienta, y como toda herramienta, su valor depende de quién la use y para qué.



30 de agosto de 2026

body.title: Birthday Thoughts and Rambles...
body.body:
It's my birthday, today.

Somehow, I have managed to complete 66 circuits about the sun which is — in some ways — a bit of a surprise to me. Maybe it shouldn't be, since the men in my family typically live into their 80's and 90's.

![0014-TinyDaisy.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23ydEJ9nJy8dWM1pLTCjz5LxaS38xpvhRgPEzqUXmNdgBwsrjE4nw4GdqWWzJsE6uXut6.jpg)

Some people seem to be born with *\

* while others dwell primarily at the *opposite* end of that scale... and I would be among the latter. I have often felt like I would be *unlikely* to reach any kind of old age, the same way big dogs live shorter lives than small dogs, on average.

Not that 66 is really *old,* anymore. 

*\

* and all that rot.

Ironic that I find myself living in a society *(meaning the USA)* that's obsessed with youth and anti-aging... and *yet* is now one of the *only* industrialized nations with a *declining* life expectancy.

Things that make you go *\

*

![0805-Clouds.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23xyTD1WQd2oGMN2oKCPZP9Xna9Yvy2nE2ExcZQTazPWBUnSpR5bMXWoe8QTejWKTR6or.jpg)

Writing a bit *early* today because Mrs. Denmarkguy and I are heading out on a *(hopefully lovely)* day trip to the historic Crescent Lake Lodge... possibly one of the most beautiful and peaceful places in the western part of the USA. It's part of the National Parks system, and hopefully will *stay* that way... unless the powers that be decide this pristine forest land is better used for timber to build more houses nobody can afford.

*Hhhrrrumpffff....*

Crescent Lake is a gorgeous glacier and snowmelt fed lake that's always a remarkable deep blue color, thanks to the complete absence of the kind of algae that typically turns freshwater bodies a greenish-brownish shade, even if they are quite *clean.*

![0868-LakeCrescent.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/242XtfRb9TkkZFGoHnkR4vt4CJuyCWyXxgATkB97JdpMZvqGi2PbQ6P1CA7LanjfpDbJp.JPG)

I was never big into birthdays... my own, or anybody else's.

*\
*\n\nI was *still* not into birthdays, perhaps because they served mostly to land the reality of being *\

* that people often forgot to invite.

OK, that was a moment of pity party.

I was actually more like *invisible* than *unpopular* and there were many reasons for that, including the fact that we traveled and moved around so much that I was seldom in a single location where I would have a friend group to celebrate and hang out with.

That *did,* however, lay the foundation for not really *caring* once I became an adult, primarily because I had no real basis/attachment to birthdays being *\

*

![1123-Grass.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EoeEWShPLn8SHBVsQKXHk7PL5ZXBvcyCtkwCJageX1GBQdBzoZgnDCguyTQ7HwNaXqK.jpg)

We did celebrate my dad's birthday, but that ended when he died when I was just 18, and my mother typically *avoided* birthdays because her image-obsessed ego actively rejected any references to the idea that she was aging... a life philosophy that pretty much kicked in at the moment she determined that she could no longer pass for someone who'd just walked off the pages of some glamour magazine.

In a way, today's outing represents a sort of *meaningfulness* in the sense that I just can't ever bring myself to care about *\
* as a representation of caring. The only *stuff* I care about is really good food and treats... and what we might call *\
*\n\nMy perfect day is one on which I am liberated of the feeling that I have to serve, fund, work for or otherwise carry a sense of obligation something/someone extremal to me. It's a *\

* where the constantly whirling apparatus inside my brain can simply be shut *off.*

![0936-CrescentLake.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23tvB3iyu6VFhj8aexC5jrKpmr5Wp1uevPWva8sgp49UabLzPJ84HH28NMyaCmRk8CRbP.JPG)
*The actual color of Crescent Lake on a sunny day!*

If there is anything I feel grateful for at this stage of my life, it is mostly the fact that I have managed to make peace with the weird attributes that make me *me,* without significantly imposing that chaos on other people who see those attributes merely as a nuisance that require actual *thinking* and *caring* to fully comprehend.

I embrace that I am *afflicted* by various conditions that present certain challenges, but I have moved well past *suffering* from them... as many people seem to, as they rain down chaos and distress on everyone around them.

And so, *enough about that.*

I need to get ready for today's outing... maybe I'll share some photos later *(or not!)*.

body.title: Dressed for the occasion
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeJ8iNqwwY9pe898bAbt1H4gq25W6i8jT1MwD6AqnUNW/1788108848427.jpg)

**Image is mine**

**Does the Way We Dress Say Something About Us?**

Clothes, beyond covering our nakedness and making us look modest, play a great role in our identity. Through clothing, one can easily tell what occupation a person is involved in. In society, clothing adds to our esteem; it beautifies and decorates us. Now, the real issue is, Does the way one dresses have something to say about that person? I will answer **yes**.

Someone's choice of clothing is greatly influenced by their kind of work, culture, family, faith, and, generally, their personality. Even without speaking to someone, we make assumptions based on their appearance.
Decent clothing, regardless of diversity in culture, faith, etcetera, is recognized when seen. And truly, it is appreciated because it is always beautiful and gives an impression of responsibility. Indecent clothing, however, differs in different places. What might be considered indecent in Africa might be considered decent in Asia. So, the kind of indecent dressing I will be talking about is clothing that reveals sensitive parts of the body, which I believe is generally considered indecent in most parts of the world.

Another thing that can make clothing inappropriate is the setting in which it is worn. A swimming suit or beachwear, when worn randomly on the streets, may not be considered normal, but at the beach, it is perfectly appropriate. The same applies to wearing party clothes to church or to the office. Each setting has its appropriate style of dressing, and sticking to it is a good thing.Dressing decently is not necessarily about covering every part of the body I feel it is also about knowing the appropriate clothes to wear in different settings.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7fJpkunhH7hHPiEvbbEMSRi85hkZTPpwSSA8N7xtBRf/1788108286258.png)

**Image generated using meta AI**


**Is Indecent Dressing All About Mindset?**

Yes. Some people who love dressing in revealing clothes may genuinely have no ulterior motive. Perhaps the family they grew up in made them see such dressing as normal, while others may have an ulterior motive when they dress in revealing clothes. So, when it comes to mindset, I would say it also depends on the viewer. Whether or not the person has an ulterior motive, we, as viewers, don't know their reason for dressing that way. What we see is an individual dressed in what we consider to be indecent clothing.

**What About Rape?**

In cases of rape linked to indecent dressing, to me, indecent dressing is not enough reason to rape someone, though it may influence how a person is perceived or approached. People who dress decently are also victims of rape, including children both boys and girls. So indecent dressing should not justify rape. Rape is most often associated with the rapist's actions, choices, disregard for consent, and lack of respect for another person's boundaries, rather than what the victim is wearing.

So, my take is that modest dressing can add respect to a person and can also influence how people judge that person's appearance, decency is beautiful and not outdated. Even if someone dresses indecently, whether or not they have an ulterior motive, what speaks to the observer is what they are wearing, not necessarily their intention. This is because people generally judge based on what they see. However, how people perceive someone's dressing should never be used as an excuse to justify harmful behaviour toward that person.


**Thank you for engaging with my post! You can follow me @cecilia1 to stay updated on my future posts.”**

This season has been much better for me and I am also much happier. There are almost 21 hours left in this season to end and I am trying to make a little effort and improve my ranking a little bit. body.title: The Sublime Moment of Sunday!
body.body:
> I can't say this Sunday was sublime, much less can it defend the week that just ended. It wasn't good at all, but as I always manage to find the positive side of everything, this very moment as I write these words has been the sublime moment of Sunday, reminding me how important written catharsis is for me... I'm taking this opportunity to share the best photos I took this week with my phone, which actually make me reflect, as they continue to remind me that life is still beautiful, even though there are those moments that overwhelm us and make us see gray days where there aren't any.
![1784841192441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23w2m45i9AVGsCFkNmvchu9yg1L8ff8KH5CSa7LE8XEqeM51YrMcTQjkGA1EMGivpSGGi.jpg)
I had the highest expectations for the last week of August, just like every year. This month has always been my vacation time, ever since I was a child or teenager attending school, and even now as an adult working at a music education institution. I have particularly vivid memories from last year; on this very day, I was with my wife, my mother, and my brother enjoying the beaches of La Guaira. At that moment, I told them we had to come back every year and keep exploring them, since we only know the beaches of Aragua. But you know what happened there; the double earthquake destroyed almost everything, and I think all I have left of that time in La Guaira are the photographs and memories we made. Sadly, everything that has happened since that terrible day has been rather bleak, which is why I'm spending my last week of August feeling bored, a little ruined, and somewhat annoyed.
![1784841192411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/2449r5Y7bpcru1igeB5uetM1MAjvxhW1SHPwc9DoibsDfBSpJKZj7mXGEesxHJmidRPgh.jpg)
Not everything is bad, as you can see in these photographs. The city is beautiful again. Of course, there are still marks from the earthquakes if you look closely, and although there are still sporadic scares, like last Thursday when the east, center, and west of the country were shaken by four significant tremors, there is more peace of mind regarding that issue. Many activities are returning to normal, and in fact, many people are enjoying their vacations. But that's not my case, and perhaps that's why it affects me, because it's not what I had in mind for this time of year. But there's a lot to sort out in my personal life. The only thing that saddens me is continuing to discover that there are still situations and people who manage to disrupt the peace I've been building; I don't know if it's because I'm vulnerable or because I haven't fully learned yet...
![1784841192250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/245cRkLo6DY6kWaNDBo4P6eyhsrtxjFKCaYrrpSWfxW1yhLuP7hAS3mrt2yQQwCdsMDJo.jpg)
Let's just say it's human nature, and it's normal to stumble over the same stone twice before learning, although I know it doesn't happen to everyone. I can't help but love places, people, life itself with great passion; it's part of my nature. But as you well know, everything has to have limits, and that's also part of being a functional adult. Every time I immerse myself in the gray cloud I create, I end up making it bigger and blinding myself to problems that aren't that difficult to solve. I've written this several times on my blog, but: \

and I must let others stumble and learn from their own mistakes. I can only offer good advice or help if needed, but we also have to learn to be quiet when we haven't been asked.
![1784841192227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/2458GMUaTDmpenLzDUZYLmgaSwgHSNtrT6T1sTLAsXsnYTFHnGTLn4VpdqCyszEd2Navd.jpg)
I don't know if this happens to everyone, but sometimes I think it's harder to deal with the people closest to me than with those awful people on the street we don't really know. It's not that I'm stupid; I've figured out my limits with everyone, but sometimes I feel like I need to do more when I see someone I love literally drowning in a glass of water. Sadly, you discover in your attempt to help that the other person also knows it's a glass of water, and yet they still choose to feel bad. Wow, that always surprises me, but there really are people who like living badly, and they get annoyed if you try to disrupt their normality.
![IMG_20260523_145856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/241QNtXTqQqM9mn7PBg1QHgscqYy7TtTmPmanAhEwEFUFQEE7zXx2wu9YKEyTCWLNHYCU.jpg)
Sí, definitivamente escribir todas estas ideas que pasan por mi mente ha sido la mejor decisión de la semana. Quizás ocurrió porque estoy totalmente solo en este momento, pero no puedo olvidar que yo mismo puedo cambiar mi entorno en cualquier momento. Creo que toda esta reflexión nace del hecho de que he aprendido a alejarme de situaciones y personas que no me suman en nada, de hecho estoy casi graduado en eso, pero: ¿Qué pasa cuando te enfrentas a esas personas que pro naturaleza son intocables? Esas personas que son especiales, o que merecen un respeto superior, pero que no dudan ni un momento en irrespetarte a ti... Mejores amigos, parejas, padres, sobre todo cuando las relaciones nunca habían sido tóxicas y de repente cambiaron. Ese es todo un tema, pero tristemente para mí ya sé la respuesta a esa pregunta; no me gusta, pero es parte de crecer...
![IMG_20260523_195055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uEx3nKaJzCwjWW7G4oDXvcfGD6oPsqeFaso6ScUZ9ktXgJyxUb3Zof9e8we8LQkSXDJ.jpg)
#### **
Versión en Español
**
No puedo decir que este Domingo haya sido sublime, y mucho menos puede defender a la semana que acaba de terminar. No fue buena para nada, pero como siempre termino encontrando el lado positivo de todo, este preciso instante en el que estoy redactando estas palabras ha sido el Momento Sublime del Domingo, lo que me hace recordar lo importante que es la catarsis escrita para mí... Aprovecho de compartir las mejores fotografías que capturé esta semana con mi móvil, que de hecho me llaman a la reflexión, ya que me siguen indicando que la vida sigue siendo hermosa, aunque existan esos momentos que nos abruman y nos hacen ver días grises donde no los hay. Tenía las mejores expectativas para la última semana de Agosto, al igual que todos los años. Este mes siempre ha sido mi periodo vacacional, desde que era niño o adolescente asistiendo al colegio y desde que soy un adulto que trabaja en una institución de educación musical, y de hecho recuerdo mucho el año pasado, justo un día como hoy estaba junto a mi esposa, mi mamá y mi hermano disfrutando de las playas de La Guaira. En ese momento les dije que teníamos que venir todos los años y seguir conociéndolas, ya que solo conocemos las playas de Aragua, pero ya saben lo que ha ocurrido allá, el doble terremoto destruyó casi todo, y creo que de esa etapa de La Guaira ya solo me quedan las fotografías y recuerdos que ya vivimos. Tristemente todo lo que ha venido desde ese terrible día ha sido algo triste, lo que me hace pasar mi última semana de Agosto aburrido, un poco arruinado y con algo de molestia. No todo es malo, como pueden ver en estas fotografías, la ciudad está bonita otra vez, claro, siempre hay marcas de los terremotos si ves con detenimiento, y aunque sigue habiendo sustos esporádicos, como el pasado Jueves donde se sacudió el oriente, el centro y el occidente del país, ya que hubo cuatro temblores sobresalientes, pero de igual modo, hay más tranquilidad respecto a ese tema. Muchas actividades vuelven a la normalidad y de hecho hay muchas personas que están disfrutando de sus vacaciones. Pero no es mi caso, y quizás por eso me afecta, porque no es lo que tenía en mi mente para estas fechas, pero hay mucho que arreglar en mi vida personal. Lo único que me entristece es seguir descubriendo que aún hay situaciones y personas que logran sacarme de la paz que he estado construyendo; no sé si por estar vulnerable o porque aún no he aprendido del todo... Digamos que es solo por ser humano, y que es normal volver a tropezar con la misma piedra antes de aprender, aunque sé que no a todos les pasa. No puedo evitar amar con mucha pasión a lugares, a gente, a la vida misma, es parte de mi naturaleza, pero como bien saben, todo tiene que tener límites, y eso también es parte de ser un adulto funcional. Cada vez que me sumerjo en la nube gris que yo mismo creo, termino haciéndola más grande y cegándome en problemas que no son tan difíciles de resolver. He escrito varias veces esto en mi blog, pero: \

, y debo dejar que los demás también tropiecen y aprendan de sus propios errores, no puedo más que dar un buen consejo o ayudar si así lo requieren, pero también hay que prender a callar cuando no nos han llamado. No sé si a todo el mundo le pasa, pero a veces pienso que es más difícil lidiar con la gente más cercana que con esas personas detestables en la calle que realmente no conocemos... No es que yo sea tonto, ya he entendido hasta donde puedo llegar con cada quién, pero, a veces siento que es necesario hacer algo más, cuando ves que alguien que amas literalmente se está ahogando en un vaso de agua. Tristemente descubres en tu intento de ayuda que esa persona también sabe que es un vaso de agua, y aún así decide sentirse mal por elección, wow, eso siempre me sorprende, pero realmente hay gente que le gusta vivir mal, y les molesta si intentas romper su normalidad. Sí, definitivamente escribir todas estas ideas que pasan por mi mente ha sido la mejor decisión de la semana. Quizás ocurrió porque estoy totalmente solo en este momento, pero no puedo olvidar que yo mismo puedo cambiar mi entorno en cualquier momento. Creo que toda esta reflexión nace del hecho de que he aprendido a alejarme de situaciones y personas que no me suman en nada, de hecho estoy casi graduado en eso, pero: ¿Qué pasa cuando te enfrentas a esas personas que pro naturaleza son intocables? Esas personas que son especiales, o que merecen un respeto superior, pero que no dudan ni un momento en irrespetarte a ti... Mejores amigos, parejas, padres, sobre todo cuando las relaciones nunca habían sido tóxicas y de repente cambiaron. Ese es todo un tema, pero tristemente para mí ya sé la respuesta a esa pregunta; no me gusta, pero es parte de crecer...
![IMG_20260523_195004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uQiGXRq99aPQ25PU3JiaMKxLtaMgaLqcU52c6oFnDvYZcGMz1pPVbaWPgnaHGLmzWDY.jpg)

body.title: ESP/ENG | Arquitectos de nuestro cautiverio / Architects of Our Own Captivity
body.body:
### ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a toda esta maravillosa comunidad! Un abrazo fraterno y jovial para ti que dedicas un instante de tu día a compartir estas líneas. Qué alegría reencontrarnos en este rincón de reflexión y crecimiento mutuo.

La libertad suele imaginarse como un horizonte abierto, un espacio sin fronteras donde el alma respira sin ataduras. Sin embargo, en esa capacidad infinita de decidir habita una paradoja silenciosa: somos tan libres que podemos escoger nuestra propia esclavitud.

A diferencia de otros tiempos donde las cadenas venían impuestas por manos ajenas, hoy la servidumbre suele ser una obra de diseño personal, firmada en silencio con nuestro propio consentimiento.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUSJGaVw9tMa1VwMF9XqFCLzFuUxZmqNw6ZVasC6h2G8/1788108193111.jpg)

*Imagen de dominio público tomada de Pixabay*
</center>

### Las sombras que elegimos

Nadie nos obliga a revisar la pantalla con angustia compulsiva, ni a habitar rutinas que apagan la chispa interior, ni a sostener estilos de vida moldeados solo para complacer a un público indiferente. Lo elegimos. Diseñamos compromisos que nos desbordan y adoptamos ambiciones que nunca nos pertenecieron.

Sin darnos cuenta, nos convertimos en artesanos de nuestras propias ataduras al abrazar:

* **La mirada ajena:** Entregamos la paz a cambio de un aplauso efímero, sacrificando la esencia con tal de encajar en moldes ajenos.
* **El culto a la prisa:** Cambiamos el tiempo —nuestro bien más sagrado— por cosas que no necesitamos, convirtiendo la vida en un laberinto de ocupación permanente.
* **Los guiones heredados:** Caminamos por senderos que nunca nos detuvimos a cuestionar, asumiendo roles que otros escribieron para nosotros.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQEP4YeLdMBV6mU5SBp4hNgadArux1DrzfwncrqVRSMvL/1788108376535.jpg)

*Imagen de dominio público tomada de Pixabay*
</center>

### La ilusión de las puertas abiertas

La forma más sutil de cautiverio es aquella donde el prisionero sonríe creyendo que es libre. Cuando elegimos nuestra propia prisión, el reclamo se vuelve imposible, pues no hay un opresor externo al cual responsabilizar; la llave y el cerrojo siempre han estado en nuestras manos.

Sin embargo, reconocer que fuimos los constructores de esas paredes no es motivo de culpa, sino la semilla del despertar. Si tuvimos la libertad de erigir la jaula, conservamos intacta la misma fuerza para derribarla.

Al final, la verdadera libertad no consiste solo en la facultad de elegir, sino en la sabiduría de no escoger aquello que nos roba la luz.

---

**Preguntas para la comunidad:**
1. ¿En qué aspecto de tu vida diaria has sentido alguna vez que elegiste una \

disfrazada de decisión propia?
2. ¿Qué hábito o compromiso has logrado soltar recientemente para recuperar tu paz interior?

---

*Descargos:*
* **Imágenes:** Las imágenes sugeridas para esta publicación son de dominio público y provienen de Pixabay.
* **Uso de IA:** Se ha empleado Inteligencia Artificial de forma exclusiva para la revisión de ortografía, sintaxis, traducción al inglés y estructuración del diseño maquetado.

---

<center>

### ENGLISH

</center>

A warm, fraternal, and cheerful greeting to this wonderful community! A big hello to you, who are taking a moment of your day to share these lines. What a joy to meet again in this corner of reflection and mutual growth!

Freedom is usually imagined as an open horizon, a space without borders where the soul breathes without restraint. However, within that infinite capacity to decide lies a silent paradox: we are so free that we can choose our own slavery.

Unlike in other eras where chains were imposed by foreign hands, today servitude is often a work of personal design, signed in silence with our own consent.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUSJGaVw9tMa1VwMF9XqFCLzFuUxZmqNw6ZVasC6h2G8/1788108407996.jpg)

*Public domain image sourced from Pixabay*
</center>

### The Shadows We Choose

No one forces us to check our phone screens with compulsive anxiety, nor to inhabit routines that extinguish our inner spark, nor to sustain lifestyles shaped only to please an indifferent audience. We choose it. We design commitments that overwhelm us and adopt ambitions that never belonged to us.

Without realizing it, we become artisans of our own bonds when we embrace:

* **The gaze of others:** We surrender peace in exchange for fleeting applause, sacrificing our essence just to fit into someone else's mold.
* **The cult of rush:** We trade time —our most sacred asset— for things we do not need, turning life into a labyrinth of permanent occupation.
* **Inherited scripts:** We walk down paths we never stopped to question, assuming roles that others wrote for us.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQEP4YeLdMBV6mU5SBp4hNgadArux1DrzfwncrqVRSMvL/1788108442319.jpg)

*Public domain image sourced from Pixabay*
</center>

### The Illusion of Open Doors

The most subtle form of captivity is one where the prisoner smiles, believing they are free. When we choose our own prison, complaint becomes impossible, for there is no external oppressor to blame; the key and the lock have always been in our hands.

However, recognizing that we were the builders of those walls is not a reason for guilt, but the seed of awakening. If we had the freedom to erect the cage, we retain intact the very same strength to tear it down.

In the end, true freedom consists not only in the ability to choose, but in the wisdom not to choose that which steals our light.

---

**Questions for the community:**
1. In what area of your daily life have you ever felt that you chose a \

disguised as your own decision?
2. What habit or commitment have you recently managed to let go of in order to reclaim your inner peace?

---

*Disclaimers:*
* **Images:** Suggested images for this publication belong to the public domain and are sourced from Pixabay.
* **AI Usage:** Artificial Intelligence tools were utilized strictly for spell checking, syntax refinement, English translation, and Markdown layout structure.

body.title: Bei den Ostfriesen - Unsere Runde
body.body:
![IMG_20260729_211732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EqHyMmovwdpDZ4c2zNTcvaaLPYNnZZZQa6A1vBpdwt7WcDDUUSgAvb6fHWLDDd35BHS.jpg)

Da die Kiddies ja alt und groß genug sind, alleine auf den Hof zu bleiben, machen Mama und Papa unsere Runden.

![IMG-20260727-WA0021.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/244KJWkx9GU8TaZBRPRJKw7uBxViVkaVYGWoWQSuV9GCLcvcaXqFcKPWeiLx8FaAJc5w5.jpeg)

Mittags werden die 7km gejoggt und abends dann mit unserem Kampf-Chihuahua und ein paar Getränken (die gute Aldi-Hausmarke) nochmal abspaziert.

![IMG_20260726_163959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EoMDExyjXJjeyCdPbVXVGGsZuyhGkn7QwoA1uWUzwXaN3obDj23xZnvJA3VHmp28J2F.jpg)

Urlaub heißt für uns auch die Ruhe genießen. New York oder London zu erleben, wäre nix für uns. Ist ja hektischer und stressiger als zu Arbeiten. Aber hier sagen sich sprichwörtlich Kuh und Schaf gute Nacht.

![IMG_20260727_195305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/245HaiBD4F8QuvcdEnVw9hYom6vN7eAnC2demexqwmZXv6JZng6PF9xTEDYwetYgrcX5S.jpg)

Kein Straßenverkehr - nur selten muss man mal kurz rechts ran und ein Auto vorbei lassen. Nicht zu vergleichen mit meinen Touren aus dem Pott über Düsseldorf nach Köln - schauder.

![IMG_20260727_211038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EqBcB3ySsH6e65tuEUwTVC9hWuKidjRHR2SSU6zGBUBgpZXgP5coJZvvc9PdvTwaoSB.jpg)

Lieben die Ruhe also und die Natur. Wie zu Hause quasi auch hier oben eine Schönes-Leben-Runde. Man muss es genießen und schätzen, solange man es kann.

![IMG_20260729_205818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EppKd71qAMtPwTxDQxaru42YX3iWGqvLu3tVw4J5ryEWobxBYDje4QfmmSEiXbc5FYk.jpg)

Ist nebenbei hier der nordwestlichste Punkt vom Festland. Nur Borkum liegt noch nordwestlicher.

![IMG_20260729_212130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/23wqgbEca4xJWmV9sCmwaDXdRF8XtAd2qp8fqCtAuMWTibkdGj6W5jJ6iNFSiX4Y2pzp3.jpg)

Bei der Pinkelpause ums Eck kann man bequem ein paar Brombeeren schnabulieren. Was für ein Service!

![IMG_20260730_204426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EqNFi2FPSmy3KJa67H7yUdRZZ3Es6jVH6nthNmRausLnZ3zXWmPYEZbofoABhzv1Gve.jpg)

Hunde sollen eigentlich nicht auf den Deich. Aber unser Theo kommt einfach in die Umhängetasche - da vergeht ihm die Lust, ein Schaf zu reißen.

![IMG_20260731_152356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EpT4D9nD1CLZnNvT5xwkfxAs47MLhBeaH5WwiRf27RoEKQNi8WvQfi5qVaG1vy1JqD3.jpg)

Bei dem Foto hier höre ich direkt wieder das endlose Geblöke der Schafe, die uns im Vorbeigehen immer neugierig anglotzen.

![IMG_20260731_201149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/242Y1EfvgLHpLTJNp7C1Tjvu2osEeHQvudVofWYQ9DpTdNMqihkaRpcpyU3XBZpQdi9de.jpg)

Noch so eine Symbolik der herrlichen Ruhe hier: Ganze vier mal am Tag verirrt sich auch ein Bus hier entlang am Deich.

![IMG_20260731_202626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/243WKatRW1Qapm3X3G3nVfY1gg5S1amXmxfxnsjtaYVHQ8928wd2ENFMXoZuGGRVt9Trq.jpg)

Na, da möchte man jedoch nicht unbedingt auf den ÖPVN angewiesen sein. Ohne Auto oder Trecker geht hier nicht viel.

![IMG-20260725-WA0042.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/242DBqr6WEF1Z9HdV2qMDRA9gJMTjvmxFnwXZ6gy4RSQ9oKVF1XaLTCYZRGe5axqgpk6p.jpeg)

Die Kühe sind wie jedes Jahr auch wieder da. Manchmal kommen die angetrabt, weil die hoffen, dass man was für die dabei hat.

So denn, nächstes Jahr ist wieder gebucht. Nun wird es Herbst und die Kiddies müssen Mittwoch wieder in die Schule.

Kommt alle gut in die Woche!

body.title: RURAL - (PHOTOGRAPHY SERIES)
body.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AJkQrgTTJuCuYf1UWvUVCBSr96fSayRoJkbjcapbNtQeuL5c2n6ofWv5sixGG6F.jpg) ---- **F**ifty years ago, when I was just a five-year-old boy, Montalbán was a much more rural place than it is now. I remember waking up and peeking out of a window to see droves of cattle passing through the streets. I also remember how common it was to see people arriving from the mountains on mules or horses, bringing pack trains of donkeys loaded with their harvests to sell or trade for supplies at the small local stores. Much of this has changed today; it's no longer so common to see cows in the streets or people on horses and mules. However, some of those bucolic scenes can still be seen in the streets, and some of my photographic documentation bears witness to this. But what hasn't changed in half a century is the miracle of being able to leave the town of Montalbán and almost immediately find yourself immersed in a charming and captivating rural landscape... These photos, for example, I took just a 20-minute walk from my house, during one of those foggy mornings that seem to accentuate the air of bygone times that I find there... > **C**incuenta años atrás, cuando yo era un niño de apenas 5 años, Montalbán era un lugar mucho más rural que ahora. Recuerdo de mi temprana juventud, despertar y asomar mi cabeza por una ventana para ver arreos de vacas pasar por las calles. También recuero lo común que era ver personas llegar desde la montañas a lomos de mula o caballos, trayendo arreos de asnos cargados con sus cosechas para venderlas o cambiar parte de ellas por insumos en los pequeños abastos locales... Mucho de esto ha cambiado hoy por hoy, ya no es tan común ver vacas en las calles o gente a lomos de caballos y mulas. Sin embargo, se siguen viendo algunas de esas escenas bucólicas en las calles y parte de mi trabajo de registro fotográfico así lo atestigua. Pero, lo que sí no ha cambiado en medio siglo, es el milagro de poder alejarse del casco urbano de Montalbán y prácticamente de inmediato encontrarse inmerso en una ruralidad encantadora y avasallante... Estas fotos, por ejemplo, las hice apenas a unos 20 minutos a pie de mi casa, durante una de esas mañanas con niebla las cuales parecen acentuar todo ese aire de tiempo pasado que allí encuentro... ![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/2423uzjVco9akH5CRTCHoCRn8ihgLYWPvZGuMyL44DbLxr5XxFrZeYyvnkKeHbHEyRKGQ.jpg) ![T02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23u5tWYWjSF7iovrwGDiYiqNkVeCdCiJJeFHjdbPnnXyi1FnTjn9Y1ciXPFHcFfzNNRcm.jpg) ![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tbiDzi537mxipBGD9rkHZnNqYuKNZQ3RaKhmgMHQCCMDPHFZSipkLdDPbbPur6GiUaz.jpg) ![T04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23t7cyGr6DJv5LKT25dcQxeCJyUminSzC8df4DedDYpNbvQaJy6y6p96SUSnyiXa8maDR.jpg) ![T05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tGwQkZcJgTFjBW6NsjhLfNVKeXnnBvx4oF21iF6c9FJJMDsNBfDKCBawEW8mePuCx8V.jpg) ![T06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/242DLbw2qqx49URsYAv7QZPXHK59DyFoBYg29xQ2B1mz2FeQJN1SFd4rWWDrA7RQ8VSVk.jpg) ![T07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xowjKh46nTuZYSfymWERPVPc1SGhy6nVgRqVpTx68fbYPynDGQPoC2TDF7NDbbffmJV.jpg) ![T08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/242Y3YfeESKayqcaGx1gjzQt4227iucMWizq4vV8tWQX3GQMGwyAwdwkT9sqvuQW5faoR.jpg) ![T09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tbipEVDtLjzP8LQvsG6vdPkbc68YKUpEFX14mEd99hNC4gKmStS7rscdBQ1cjQ68JmF.jpg) ![T10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/245nBk5zmnvaHGtkEteRbTHPYGhzScMsDMZgk8VPPGkjAyyGwtDN3zp8bbxBN86ZGWrK4.jpg) ---- ##

Good afternoon, dear friend @avdesing.

These combinations of passions created my hobby, which I enjoy so much at the reserve.

My maternal grandmother, along with my mother, instilled in me a love for nature, and from my paternal grandfather I inherited a love of hiking. Thanks to my father, I became interested in the world of photography and music, since I had one of the first recording devices from a young age.

Photographic hikes have been wonderful for keeping my health in good shape.

Thank you so much, dear friend, for your constant support.

Have a beautiful Sunday afternoon.

Buenas tardes, querida amiga @avdesing.

Estas combinaciones de pasiones crearon mi hobby, que tanto disfruto en la reserva.

Mi abuela materna, junto a mi madre, tuvo que ver con mi amor por la naturaleza, y de mi abuelo paterno heredé el amor por las caminatas, y gracias a mi padre me interesé en el mundo de la fotografía y la música, ya que desde pequeño tuve uno de los primeros aparatos para hacer grabaciones.   

Las caminatas fotográficas han sido geniales para mantener mi estado de salud bien encaminado.


Muchas gracias, querida amiga, por el gran apoyo que siempre me brindas.


Que tengas una preciosa tarde de domingo.
