body.title: A Week Made of Little Things
body.body: Some weeks are memorable because something big happens. And then there are weeks like this one. * * *

>Nothing particularly extraordinary happened. There was no big achievement, no dramatic story, no once-in-a-lifetime moment. But when I look back at the pictures, I realize this week was actually quite full — just in a very quiet, ordinary kind of way.

It was made up of food, random views, little outings, cups of chai, and those tiny moments that you don't plan but somehow end up remembering. One of the first things that caught my attention this week was something as simple as **two birds sitting together on an electric wire**. I don't even know why I took that picture. Maybe it was the way they were sitting so close to each other. Maybe it was the completely clear blue sky behind them. Or maybe I just happened to look up at the right moment. I think that's one of the nicest things about taking pictures. Sometimes you don't really have a reason when you take them. You just see something and think, _\

_ And apparently, this week had quite a few of those moments. There were also the evenings. The moon appearing between the clouds. The dark sky with just enough light to make you stop and look at it. Trees turning into silhouettes at night, with little bits of light showing through them. I have always found something strangely comforting about looking at the sky at night. Everything around you can be busy and noisy, but the sky doesn't seem to care. It just stays there. And sometimes, that's enough. * * *

/> Then came the little escapes. A visit near the water, watching it move through the rocks while the bridge stood quietly in the background. Nothing fancy about it, but it felt different from the usual surroundings. There were even cows casually wandering around as if the entire place belonged to them.

/>

* * *

There was something nice about just standing there and looking around — water flowing, grass moving, rocks scattered everywhere, people somewhere in the distance.

Not every outing needs to be a proper trip.

Sometimes you just need to get out for a little while.

And then, of course, there was **food**.

A lot of food.

This week clearly had its priorities sorted.

There was spicy-looking chaat, golgappe, dosa with chutney and sambar, noodles, creamy pasta, sandwiches, chocolate, and enough drinks to make me wonder if I was documenting a week or secretly running a food blog.

Some meals were probably planned.

Others were probably more like, _\

_

But honestly, those are often the best ones.

There's something about eating outside — sitting across from someone, talking about random things, deciding what to order, stealing a bite from each other's plates, and then taking a picture before eating because apparently we can't just eat anymore without documenting it.

And sometimes the food isn't even the important part.

It's the conversation.

The company.

The place.

The mood you were in that day.

Years later, you might not remember exactly what was in that plate, but you'll remember that you were sitting there, laughing about something completely stupid.

* * *

<div class=\

/> * * * There was chai too. And somehow, chai always makes an ordinary moment feel a little more complete. Two little clay cups sitting on a table. Nothing special, really. But maybe that's the point. Not everything needs to be special. Sometimes a cup of chai, a familiar conversation and a few quiet minutes are enough to make a day feel good. There was also that little tea-shop artwork — the kind of random detail you notice when you're actually paying attention to your surroundings. I think that's what I liked most about this week. I wasn't necessarily looking for things to photograph. I was just noticing things. A painting on a wall. The moon. Birds on a wire. Water flowing under a bridge. A cup of chai. A plate that looked too good not to photograph. A dark evening that somehow looked beautiful. And maybe that's what a week really is. Not just Monday to Sunday. Not just work, responsibilities and everything that needs to be done. It's also these tiny pauses in between. The moments where you look up. The moments where you stop somewhere. The moments where you eat something you really wanted. The moments where you sit with someone without checking the time. The moments you almost don't notice while they're happening. Looking through these pictures now, I don't think I would describe this as an _eventful_ week. I'd describe it as a **lived-in week**. * * *

>A week with ordinary things that felt nice.

A week where there was enough food to make me happy, enough sky to make me look up, enough little outings to break the routine, and enough quiet moments to slow down for a bit. And maybe that's actually a pretty good way to spend a week. Because life isn't always going to give us big, cinematic moments. Most of it will probably look like this. A random picture. A half-finished meal. A cup of chai. A beautiful sky. A walk somewhere you didn't plan to go. A photograph you took without knowing why. And later, when you look back, you'll realize — **this was the life I was living while I was busy waiting for something bigger to happen.** So, yes. That's how this week looked. A little messy. A little delicious. A little peaceful. A little random. But very much mine. ❤️

Introducing cards at a quicker rate brings potential for further dipping card prices. The old mantra of less is more is something I am a big fan of. In a hot market, sure; strike when the iron is hot. But lets wait for the Splinterlands market to get hot again first. I believe that having nothing officially for sale for months is beneficial. It creates FOMO and puts currency in the pockets of those trading on secondary markets. Currency that widely dips back into the Splinterlands ecosystem, next set of packs.

body.title: Different Clothes, Same Respect - Harassment Has No Excuse
body.body: ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/23x1BXUVnJRpbRF4PyTRsfgi7bmFunSF9kw9PR3DFFhV388oxKEy2sC3xzDcr5A3G4Phg.png) As a girl, I have seen and faced many things in life. I always hear people say that the way someone dresses can influence how others behave towards them. Often said that, some clothes people wear is to seduce the other person. I disagree with this kind of mindset. A piece of cloth can never cause people to have bad intentions. I believe it's the mindset to blame not the other person or their clothes. I do believe in dress codes, we should present ourselves differently at different places. You can't go to the school with the dress which you went with to the disco party. It means we should keep differences between personal and professional life. I believe harmful intentions come from a person’s mindset when they think they can get away after harassing because they can simply blame the the victim and that is the most easiest thing. For an example, if I look at someone and have inappropriate thoughts, that is my responsibility. It has no correlation with the other person because I do everything by myself, by my own choices and nothing can influence me unless I want to be influenced or think that I'm being influenced. No one should be blamed for wearing something attractive or different. Everyone has different kind of thoughts for clothes and it exist in our own minds. Clothing does not control our actions; we do. If someone can not control their eyes then it's on them not on the other people. We have freedom to do what we like not only that we have free will, that doesn't mean we should misuse it. Like I can't imagine a teacher teaching at a school in a bikini, that would be hilarious. So, there should be dress codes for places and it should vary. We should be understanding to tackle with the situation and dress according to it. Anyway, it becomes even clearer when we think about children. Or the boy child, what can be attractive about them? Even though they are from a different gender. The abuser is not gay obviously, he just wants to pursue for his lust at any cost, that's why he wouldn't mind if it's a guy or a girl, or a kid. We often justify by saying maybe that person is crazy, out of their mind, pedophile but that's not always the reason. These people know kids won't say anything or can't protest that is why they target children the most, because they can get away easily. A child victim and an adult victim there's no difference other than the age. We would prioritise more if it's a child but not the same for an adult, why? I feel the victim can be anyone the age or gender does not matter. They are all victims of harassment, abuse, and violence. They all deserve the same treatment from us. Anyway, clothing was never a problem, it always has been used as an excuse. The responsibility belongs entirely to the person who chooses to do bad things. Moreover, if someone’s favourite colour is blue and mine is black, I would not attack them because their choice is different than mine, right? Also, If someone loves vegetable rice and I like pizza, that difference does not give me a reason to attack them. So why should clothing be treated differently? We are not clones, we are supposed to be different and have different choices. But no one has the right to abuse just because someone feels bothered by it. We need acknowledge the basic thing that, we should prevent someone else’s bad behaviour, instead of asking someone to not wear something attractive. We should be teaching children's from young age that they should always respect other people and learn to control their actions. ____ This is my entry to a contest by [indiaunited](https://ecency.com/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-fd8fc7f25b4ae), I would love to invite you to participate! ____ The picture is created with [chatgpt](chatgpt.com). ____

body.title: Let’s visit the small mountain village of Sassa together./ Visitemos juntos el pequeño pueblo de montaña de Sassa.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSXHJgCQoAsVps4LUPJB1hkEtBCsnXzEVUdTQjB9Bmruc/1788098730667.jpg)

Good morning, blog friends—how are you? I’m back with you for a trip into the mountains. This time, we crossed the Nievole area to visit the mountain villages overlooking the valley, making our way up into the Pistoia mountains. It was a long journey, but one filled with beautiful hamlets—many of which were new to me, as we had never taken this route leading from Montecatini up into the highlands. After crossing the Nievole Valley, we began our ascent; at first, the landscape was still dotted with houses and settlements—including some charming old stone farmhouses—but as we climbed higher, we began to encounter nature in earnest. The roadside vegetation was wild and somewhat overgrown, with trees, brambles, shrubs, and tall grass. There were a few barren fields here and there and some lovely views, while in the distance, we could already glimpse the mountains that encircle the valley on all sides, stretching toward both Pistoia and Lucca.

> Buenos días, amigos del blog: ¿cómo están? Vuelvo a acompañarlos en una excursión por la montaña. Esta vez atravesamos la zona de Nievole para visitar los pueblos de montaña que dominan el valle, ascendiendo hacia la sierra de Pistoia. Fue un trayecto largo, pero repleto de hermosas aldeas; muchas de ellas eran nuevas para mí, ya que nunca habíamos tomado esta ruta que va desde Montecatini hacia las tierras altas. Tras cruzar el valle de Nievole, iniciamos el ascenso; al principio, el paisaje aún estaba salpicado de casas y asentamientos —incluidas algunas encantadoras y antiguas granjas de piedra—, pero a medida que ganábamos altura, empezamos a adentrarnos de lleno en la naturaleza. La vegetación a los lados de la carretera era silvestre y algo frondosa, con árboles, zarzas, arbustos y hierba alta. Había algunos campos yermos aquí y allá y vistas preciosas, mientras que a lo lejos ya se divisaban las montañas que rodean el valle por todos sus flancos, extendiéndose tanto hacia Pistoia como hacia Lucca.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmawWDDX154gXcXEkFsfCYrAzK6H4zcFnrLqLRvgejRSum/1788098730852.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSHsn9UVdGXDUnTPaWbzuewJ8eNpXUTxeCWqqt8SyxR5Z/1788098731031.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhRGQ8KqprB7rot36ZRGVT1K3RPUaKHQaqCcqbgWauVy/1788098731253.jpg)


As we traveled, the landscape became much denser and—thank goodness—the temperature dropped slightly, surely thanks to the many broad-crowned trees providing shade and improving the air quality. Then we arrived at La Sassa, a tiny, charming hamlet in the middle of nowhere; yet, there was a large restaurant there that I’ve read has excellent reviews—we really ought to try it someday! La Sassa is a very small, quiet place surrounded by fields and woods; there are a few barns and many stacks of cut timber, suggesting it’s an area where many lumberjacks work. The surrounding nature is stunning, with plenty of greenery and wooded areas. The houses are few and far between—simple, lovely homes ranging from brightly colored ones to more traditional mountain-style cottages. Anyone living here certainly doesn't have to worry about neighbors or disturbing noise. It is a truly peaceful spot immersed in nature—a real gem in the mountains and exactly the kind of village I love. I’ll sign off for now, but I’ll be back soon to share the other mountain villages I visited. Have a wonderful Sunday, blog friends!

> A medida que avanzábamos, el paisaje se volvía mucho más frondoso y —menos mal— la temperatura bajaba ligeramente, seguramente gracias a los numerosos árboles de copa ancha que proporcionaban sombra y mejoraban la calidad del aire. Luego llegamos a La Sassa, una aldea diminuta y encantadora en medio de la nada; sin embargo, allí había un restaurante grande que, según he leído, cuenta con excelentes críticas: ¡realmente deberíamos probarlo algún día! La Sassa es un lugar muy pequeño y tranquilo, rodeado de campos y bosques; hay algunos graneros y muchas pilas de madera cortada, lo que sugiere que es una zona donde trabajan muchos leñadores. La naturaleza circundante es impresionante, con abundante vegetación y zonas boscosas. Las casas están muy dispersas: viviendas sencillas y bonitas que van desde las de colores vivos hasta las cabañas más tradicionales de estilo montañés. Quien vive aquí, desde luego, no tiene que preocuparse por los vecinos ni por ruidos molestos. Es un lugar verdaderamente apacible e inmerso en la naturaleza; una auténtica joya en la montaña y exactamente el tipo de pueblo que me encanta. Me despido por ahora, pero volveré pronto para compartir los otros pueblos de montaña que visité. ¡Que tengan un domingo maravilloso, amigos del blog!

body.title: Estoy de Vuelta
body.body: > Después de varios meses he tomado la decisión de volver a Hive. Un lugar donde fui feliz compartiendo momentos de mi vida y donde aprendí muchísimas cosas a través de todos ustedes.

> After several months, I've decided to return to Hive—a place where I was happy sharing moments of my life and where I learned so much from all of you.
![IMG-20260629-WA0174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oabreuf24/23w2qC5WzWwd7aM4jm5N7B2H88S9DAxQ1HamuMKAuJhd41s97hEP5L1QhRi8zHCzGAVCL.jpg)

> Hace algunos años, estando en plena pandemia de la covid-19, una amiga muy querida me enseño esta plataforma, me mostró lo que se podía hacer y todo el universo de cosas que podías aprender. En un principio estaba escéptico, aparte de tener temor de contar sobre mi vida y no tener el respaldo de la comunidad. Decidí empezar a escribir, en ese momento había terminado mis pasantias universitarias y estaba en la espera de mi título, no podía trabajar por la pandemia y me la pasaba en mi casa sin poder hacer nada. Al hacer mis primeras publicaciones sentí el respaldo de la comunidad, muchos comentarios bonitos y emotivos. Todo eso me ayudó a seguir creciendo dentro de hive.

> A few years ago, in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic, a very dear friend introduced me to this platform. She showed me what I could do and the whole world of things I could learn. At first, I was skeptical—not to mention afraid of sharing details about my life and not having the community’s support. I decided to start writing. At the time, I had finished my college internships and was waiting to receive my degree; I couldn’t work because of the pandemic and was stuck at home with nothing to do. When I posted my first entries, I felt the community’s support—I received many kind and heartfelt comments. All of that helped me continue to grow within Hive.
![20260824_200513.heif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oabreuf24/23wWpJCJoSS8sLC1254Hch7gjzSjoweVSh3JWawQpnDxMrHR5C1djt75Yhp3XDHWLCr7X.jpg)

> En poco tiempo pude lograr metas que me había trazado al empezar en este mundo. Fue una ayuda muy grande, tanto emocionalmente como económicamente. Fueron unos meses donde me sentí acompañado por todos ustedes y fui creciendo en este mundo.

> In a short time, I was able to achieve the goals I had set for myself when I first started out in this field. It was a huge help, both emotionally and financially. During those months, I felt supported by all of you, and I continued to grow in this field.

> Poco a poco mi rutina diaria fue cambiando, empecé a ejercer mi profesión y me consumía mucho tiempo. Empecé a hacer otras actividades y hasta empecé a entrenar, todo eso me mantenía ocupado casi todo el día. Poco a poco fui dejando de publicar y me fui alejando, con cierta nostalgia porque hive significo mucho en mi vida. Pero las cosas aveces se vuelven difíciles y el día a día te consume, sin darnos cuenta el tiempo pasa super rápido.

> Little by little, my daily routine began to change; I started working in my profession, and it took up a lot of my time. I started doing other activities and even began working out; all of that kept me busy almost all day. Little by little, I stopped posting and drifted away, feeling a bit nostalgic because Hive had meant so much to me. But things sometimes get tough, and day-to-day life consumes you; before we know it, time flies by.
![20260307_165539.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oabreuf24/241thjVkZuZKCgZwjxMkViEJ7wP1x7prEbfBVghkWc2QEUedR2xGV3zFmRXaamL8YtGZ3)

> Por eso hoy he querido volver, conectarme de nuevo con hive, escribir, leer y aprender de todos ustedes. Espero poco a poco volver a generar contenido y contar siempre con su apoyo y sus interacciones. Tengo mucho que aprender de nuevo, todo a cambiado, incluso hive, ya las dinámicas son diferentes y espero poder adaptarme rápidamente.

> That’s why I wanted to come back today—to reconnect with Hive, write, read, and learn from all of you. I hope to gradually start creating content again and to always count on your support and engagement. I have a lot to learn all over again; everything has changed—even Hive—and the dynamics are different now, so I hope I can adapt quickly.
> Así que estoy feliz de volver a Hive. Estaré agradecido de recibir sus sugerencias y comentarios para mi regreso 🙏🏻
> So I'm happy to be back on Hive. I'd appreciate any suggestions and feedback you have for my return 🙏🏻

# 🌟 August 29th Ecency Daily Leaderboard Quest 🌟

Hello friends! I hope everyone is having a good day today. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNqwMG1Bq4xFt4CAj8oknmn5PGK5bQWVkBX6SxUqy891R/file_000000004b6881fa92cdf0841f99bcd5.png)

body.title: Easy Cooking for a Sick Family.
body.body:
> ![Image](https://ipfs.3speak.tv/ipfs/QmTvQLa9kc9HjUiktebxnXWqCZvfE9CCMJxCu8qpQ2icWs) This morning started a little differently for me. Since waking up, my body has been struggling. My head is also heavy. In fact, when my body is sick, I don't feel like doing anything properly. Daily tasks like cooking seem like a mountain of a burden. When my body doesn't respond, my mental strength also seems to disappear somewhere. ![Image](https://ipfs.3speak.tv/ipfs/QmTyVY4CcoYpHSR1KLRsVo1o3LjV6P69m1JZEXLDgzEMHG) No matter what, there is no other way but to cook. Everyone in the family will want to eat. So I entered the kitchen with my sick body. I couldn't think of what to cook in such a situation that would be done in a very short time and easily. That's when the idea of frying eggs came to my mind. I think frying eggs is one of the easiest and fastest ways to prepare a dish. It can be cooked very beautifully with just a few spices and onions. You don't have to stand at the stove for a long time, which was very important for me at the moment. ![Image](https://ipfs.3speak.tv/ipfs/QmT4mxCjBSFgJdsBLsdQoCb6drucp1jcG5oLRd58fzDD9q) I quickly boiled the eggs and sautéed the onions and spices to make a beautiful fried egg. Fried eggs are not only easy to cook, but also very nutritious and delicious. Eggs are a very good source of protein. Moreover, my children love eating fried eggs. Being able to prepare this favorite dish of theirs gave me a sense of satisfaction in the midst of my illness. Finally, I request you to pray for me. May I overcome this physical discomfort and recover very soon. Being healthy is truly a great blessing. Thank you. ___ |

body.title: A beautiful experience of suddenly meeting a need from the bank's ATM booth.
body.body: > ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZFYkRzyDRzBTSch6wwDocSFEffjgUv5k6niDQCh5zaLC/1788106496983.jpg) Today's day started with a very ordinary morning. Since waking up in the morning, I was busy with various small tasks. As the afternoon was approaching, I suddenly needed some urgent cash. I didn't have much time, so I quickly decided to go to the nearest bank and withdraw money. Even in this modern era, with mobile banking or online transactions, sometimes the need for cash cannot be avoided. It is very comforting to have cash on hand, especially for some urgent expenses. That's what I thought. After quickly finishing my household chores, I left the house for a booth of Dutch-Bangla Bank. Having these ATM booths around us, we can be saved from many major dangers in an emergency. When I reached the bank premises after walking a little in the sun, I found a wonderful cool atmosphere inside the booth from the intense heat outside. The cold air of the AC seemed to instantly relieve all the fatigue of my body. The surroundings inside the booth were quite neat and quiet. Even on holidays or normal times, this clean look of the booths always gives peace of mind. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWv3fEFpi7NMz9q57cpvQ8ieWoU4ZuWtv67hyhNypLjy6/1788106497117.jpg) After entering, I saw several ATM booths arranged side by side. Since the environment of the booths is quite calm and secure, it is possible to complete my work without any hassle or crowd. I went and stood in front of the assigned booth. The familiar logo of Dutch-Bangla Bank was flashing on the screen. Then I punched my card, gave the PIN number and typed in the amount of money I needed. Right after selecting the cash out option, the booth machine started working with a soft sound. The moment of waiting for that familiar sound of money coming out of the machine was quite exciting. A beautiful message appeared on the screen where it was written Collect your money. Without delay, I raised my hand and took the money from the cash tray of the machine. Just as it can be seen in the picture, that moment of getting the money I needed from the booth was quite a relief. My mind felt better in an instant as a sudden emergency was easily met in this way. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZvwuTQQ2X3ZHxdqvDUoHH8TRvXhnj59BBrGEjhV3kYMQ/1788106497297.jpg) After receiving the money, I left the booth and enjoyed the surroundings. A small amount of busyness and tension that had suddenly arisen passed away very nicely. Thanks to modern technology, banking services have now come to our fingertips, which has made life much easier. This small experience of withdrawing money from the bank gave me a lot of joy. On the way back home, I thought I would share this beautiful moment with everyone. Today's small incident reminded me once again how easy and smooth our daily lives have become today due to the touch of technology and the benefit of the modern banking system. body.title: Un pequeño cactus [ES/EN]
body.body:
🇪🇸 En Español

¡Hola, querida comunidad de Visual Shots! 

# Un pequeño cactus

Hace unos días, una paciente me regaló un pequeño cactus.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme6cnD2MMHnPTMbvHhkWBcTJmw3c2yWCXRQjzHzzMX8Y5/1788106374237.jpg)

No era un regalo costoso ni especialmente llamativo. Era una plantita pequeña, de esas que pueden caber fácilmente en una mano, pero cuando me la entregó sentí que llevaba algo más que tierra y espinas dentro de aquella pequeña maceta.

—Para usted —me dijo simplemente.

Lo recibí con una sonrisa y le di las gracias. No hizo falta mucho más. A veces, después de pasar buena parte del día escuchando preocupaciones, dolores y problemas, recibir un gesto así resulta inesperadamente bonito.

Me contó que lo había comprado pensando en mí. No recuerdo exactamente qué conversación habíamos tenido antes ni cómo surgió la idea del regalo. Lo que sí recuerdo es su manera de entregármelo, como quien quiere agradecer algo pero no encuentra demasiadas palabras para hacerlo.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKtzyZ2L6pk4ULsm1kiRMASXVAZ7w1y7xy89fh5WwDvM/1788106427298.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4W3fUu5FWtyMzXdqcsSDnT1YLirTjyWmvK4XU8zXQDi/1788106427361.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXo2dJZzHCGb2wiVG3ptHqU2Qv5Zff1G7V3UiUBLKGz2A/1788106427457.jpg)

Desde entonces, el cactus quedó en un pequeño espacio donde puedo verlo durante la jornada. Es curioso porque no necesita demasiadas atenciones. Un poco de agua de vez en cuando, algo de luz y paciencia. Quizás por eso me gusta tanto.

Cada vez que lo miro recuerdo a aquella paciente.

En el hospital estamos acostumbrados a pensar en términos de tratamientos, medicamentos, resultados, horarios y procedimientos. Todo tiene una función concreta. Pero hay gestos que no aparecen en ninguna historia clínica y que, sin embargo, también forman parte de nuestro trabajo.

Un pequeño cactus no cambia una jornada complicada. Tampoco hace desaparecer el cansancio ni resuelve los problemas que pueden aparecer durante un día de trabajo. Simplemente está allí.

Y a veces eso basta para recordar que, además de atender enfermedades, también compartimos momentos con personas.

Hoy quise fotografiarlo porque me gusta cómo se ve con esa sencillez que tenía desde el principio. Una pequeña planta que llegó a mis manos como un regalo inesperado y que terminó ocupando un lugar especial.

Quizás algunos regalos no necesitan ser grandes para quedarse con nosotros.

Este es uno de ellos.

---

Las imágenes son fotografías tomadas con mi teléfono móvil y la traducción al inglés fue hecha usando DeepL Translate.

---

🇬🇧 English Version

Hello, dear Visual Shots community! 

#  A Small Cactus

A few days ago, a patient gave me a small cactus.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme6cnD2MMHnPTMbvHhkWBcTJmw3c2yWCXRQjzHzzMX8Y5/1788106374237.jpg)

It wasn't an expensive or particularly striking gift. It was a small plant, the kind that can easily fit in one hand, but when she handed it to me, I felt that it carried something more than soil and little thorns inside that tiny pot.

—For you —she simply said.

I accepted it with a smile and thanked her. Nothing more was really necessary. Sometimes, after spending much of the day listening to worries, pain, and problems, receiving a gesture like that feels unexpectedly nice.

She told me she had bought it thinking of me. I don't remember exactly what conversation we had before that or how she came up with the idea of the gift. What I do remember is the way she handed it to me, as if she wanted to say thank you but didn't have many words to express it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKtzyZ2L6pk4ULsm1kiRMASXVAZ7w1y7xy89fh5WwDvM/1788106427298.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4W3fUu5FWtyMzXdqcsSDnT1YLirTjyWmvK4XU8zXQDi/1788106427361.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXo2dJZzHCGb2wiVG3ptHqU2Qv5Zff1G7V3UiUBLKGz2A/1788106427457.jpg)

Since then, the cactus has stayed in a small space where I can see it during the day. It's funny because it doesn't require much attention. A little water from time to time, some light, and patience. Perhaps that's one of the reasons I like it so much.

Every time I look at it, I remember that patient.

At the hospital, we are used to thinking in terms of treatments, medications, results, schedules, and procedures. Everything has a specific purpose. But there are gestures that never appear in a medical record and yet are also part of our work.

A small cactus doesn't change a difficult day. It doesn't make tiredness disappear or solve the problems that may come up during a working day. It simply stays there.

And sometimes that is enough to remind us that, besides treating illnesses, we also share moments with people.

Today I wanted to photograph it because I like the simple way it looks, just as it did when it first came into my hands. A small plant that arrived as an unexpected gift and ended up having a special place.

Perhaps some gifts don't need to be big to stay with us.

This is one of them.

---

The images are photographs taken with my mobile phone, and the English translation was done using DeepL Translate.

body.title: (ESP-ENG) La Champions League a la vuelta de la esquina - [Opinión]
body.body:
Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.

> Hello friends, good vibes to all.


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wC3BwYmwG9iuTm32dcP3DMEcySHZAabCkryvfB6v4iT2grp7jN8FGraKHrsdavwa3qe)


[Fuente. ](https://elcomercio.pe/deporte-total/champions-league/sorteo-champions-league-en-vivo-hoy-clasificados-bombos-fixture-y-donde-ver-ceremonia-online-lbposting-noticia/)

Esta semana que acaba de culminar se realizó el sorteo de lo que será la fase de liga de la Champions League la cual dará inicio el 8 de septiembre y cuya final se jugará en el estadio Metropolitano, casa del Atlético de Madrid. Como ya lo dije en su momento este nuevo formato ha sido uno que poco a poco me ha terminado de convencer, al principio tener una especie de todos contra todos era algo con lo que no estábamos acostumbrados pero al final resultó ser una idea bien pensada porque tenemos partidos de todo tipo y porque de verdad no es tan sencillo avanzar como parece, hay que hacer las cosas realmente bien para quedar dentro de las posiciones que avanzan de manera directa.    

> This past week saw the draw for the Champions League group stage, which kicks off on September 8th and will culminate in the final at the Metropolitano Stadium, home of Atlético de Madrid. As I mentioned before, this new format has gradually won me over. Initially, a round-robin format was something we weren't used to, but it ultimately proved to be a well-thought-out idea because we have all kinds of matches, and because advancing isn't as easy as it seems. You have to perform exceptionally well to secure a direct qualification spot.

Hoy vamos a hablar un poco del camino de algunos de esos clubes que les tocará transitar para buscar la tan ansiada \

. Creo que los emparejamientos que involucran al Barcelona, PSG y Manchester City pueden ser los más llamativos y picantes tanto por la historia que hay como por todos los fichajes recientes que se han dado en este mercado de pases. Rodri vuelve a verse las caras con su ex equipo pero vestido de blaugrana, Ferrán Torres también tendrá reencuentro esta vez pero vestido con la camisa del París y después de haber declarado que el mejor equipo para ganar la Champions es el PSG; es decir, hay razones para considerar estos partidos como grandes enfrentamientos que nos dejará esta primera fase de liga. Si a eso le sumamos todo el morbo que existe entre el Barca y el PSG pues sin dudas estaremos ante un gran ambiente. Increíble como el mercado fue capaz de unir justamente a los tres clubes que se van a ver las caras. 

> Today we're going to talk a bit about the path some of the clubs will have to travel in their quest for the coveted Champions League trophy. I think the matchups involving Barcelona, ​​PSG, and Manchester City could be the most exciting and intriguing, both because of their history and all the recent signings in this transfer window. Rodri will face his former team again, this time wearing the Barcelona colors. Ferran Torres will also have a reunion, this time wearing the Paris Saint-Germain shirt, after having declared that PSG is the best team to win the Champions League. In other words, there are reasons to consider these matches as major clashes that this first phase of the league will bring us. If we add to that all the intrigue surrounding the Barcelona-PSG rivalry, we'll undoubtedly be in for a fantastic atmosphere. It's incredible how the transfer market managed to bring together these three clubs.


![2.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tvib8U8iJYyTip9N4ndBrqqVAUBE37SqT5wy9m2GpGjEm48rTStv8ahLvVsTEZbwUHg.webp)


[Fuente. ](https://news.abplive.com/sports/football/uefa-champions-league-draw-ferran-torres-against-barcelona-rodri-faces-man-city-1864215)

---


![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tbiNDkFHV7wVbNWRe6QheWhF99ZLDBcVh3ZqSos5xj8weoGqkLZsuKq92CxPvtdGj7v.jpg)


[Fuente. ](https://www.justarsenal.com/arsenal-stun-real-madrid-3-0-to-take-control-of-champions-league-tie/390123)

Seguimos con el Real Madrid que le tocará bailar con el Inter y el Arsenal. Creo que para los blancos es una parte del camino un poco engañosa, el Arsenal, actual campeón de la Premier y finalista, se le da bien jugar contra los españoles, sino pregúntenle a Declan Rice y al Inter, actual campeón de Italia, siempre es incomodo de jugarle, es un club áspero. Cualquier cosa puede suceder en esos tres partidos, no lo veo nada claro. Lo que cambia con el Arsenal es que se verá contra el todopoderoso Bayern y el Inter hará lo propio contra el Liverpool. Creo que de los grandes ocho equipos del bombo 1 el que menos confianza me genera es precisamente los del Anfield, no terminaron bien la temporada pasada y en esta tampoco su comienzo ha sido el mejor, 2 pts de 6.   

> We continue with Real Madrid, who will have to contend with Inter and Arsenal. I think this is a somewhat tricky part of the journey for Los Blancos. Arsenal, the current Premier League champions and finalists, are good against Spanish teams—just ask Declan Rice. And Inter, the current Italian champions, are always a difficult team to play against; they're a tough club. Anything can happen in those three matches; I don't see it as a sure thing at all. What's different for Arsenal is that they'll face the all-powerful Bayern Munich, and Inter will do the same against Liverpool. I think that of the top eight teams in Pot 1, the one I have the least confidence in is precisely the team from Anfield. They didn't finish last season well, and their start this season hasn't been the best either, with 2 points out of 6.

El Bayern siempre tiene que ser considerado entre los favoritos, pasan los años y siguen teniendo un gran equipo y siguen siendo una maquina que impone mucho respeto. Sus rivales fuertes son el Arsenal y el Atlético de Madrid. Los del Cholo Simeone también son una interrogante porque te pueden hacer un gran partido pero después hacen 3 muy malos y todo lo que avanzan lo terminan perdiendo. El Arsenal supo callarme la temporada pasada con aquello de ser un equipo frío y no ganador pero los colchoneros no, para este servidor el equipo más pequeño de este bombo 1, no solo por número de títulos sino por actitud. A lo mejor pueden ser capaces de darle un susto a alguien, lo hicieron con el Barcelona, pero de allí no pasan. 

> Bayern Munich always has to be considered among the favorites. Years go by, and they still have a great team and remain a machine that commands a lot of respect. Their strongest rivals are Arsenal and Atlético Madrid. Diego Simeone's team is also a question mark because they can play one great match but then have three very bad ones, and they end up losing every match they advance. Arsenal managed to silence my critics last season with their claims of being a cold, unwinning team, but Atlético Madrid didn't. For me, they're the weakest team in Pot 1, not only in terms of titles but also in terms of attitude. Perhaps they can give someone a scare, as they did with Barcelona, ​​but they won't go any further than that.


![4.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23u62jnox3C3idD7n2StDwMoFGzQW44gx4AZryskr8NChynkQriPNtTEgicWsNfqG9xnK.webp)

---


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23vhuZqp4TzybHWrYzmp7NU2pbyNEwQ5zthEWLfACtEVwtdxj5wrNALP81PnBfwbqi3Hf)


[Fuente. ](https://fcbayern.com/es/matches/profis/champions-league/2015-2016/fcb-atl-tico-de-madrid-03-05-2016/lineup)

Y claro, acá estamos hablando de los 8 más importantes pero en el camino de todos hay otros clubes de cuidado: Manchester United, Roma, Porto, Aston Villa, Napoli, Villarreal, el sorpresivo Bodø/Glimt, PSV, etc. Cualquiera de estos equipos puede aguar la fiesta de un \

por lo que hay que tener cuidado porque para algunos el camino puede estar llenos de espinas. Hablar de favoritos es imposible porque apenas estamos arrancando la temporada en todas las ligas europeas pero si hay que decir que la gran mayoría se reforzó bien en este mercado pero de eso hablaremos esta semana en otra reseña. \n\n> And of course, we're talking about the top eight, but there are other clubs to watch out for along the way: Manchester United, Roma, Porto, Aston Villa, Napoli, Villarreal, the surprising Bodø/Glimt, PSV, and so on. Any of these teams could spoil the party for a \

club, so you have to be careful because for some, the road ahead could be fraught with difficulties. Talking about favorites is impossible because we're just getting started with the season in all the European leagues, but it's worth noting that the vast majority of teams strengthened their squads well in this transfer window. We'll discuss that in more detail this week in another review.

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. 
¡Un abrazo a todos, nos leemos en la próxima!

> Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it.
¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

body.title: [Movie] My Review on 72 Hours.
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



So lately I've been seeing action movies but today I decided to see 72 hours which is a comedy movie, although it goes beyond comedy as there are lots of important things to learn in the movie. Is started with Joe who is struggling to advertise the company business to the young ones, the genz. Since the product needs more people like the Gen z, but Joe who happens to be a 40 year old man is struggling to meet up with this task, he's struggling to learn the Gen z way and what they like to do. On the other hand, his boss ask him to take some time off because he's getting outdated. But then Joe is never ready to quite or be defeated.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT4QSXXRVG5Ya1L1wQiikmcvpSyo2PbpyASqMEMrnSmiM/912896.png)





He was accidentally added to bachelor's party, a party that will be held with the Gen z in the Miami, he then thinks it's the perfect thing he's waiting for , he wants to seize that opportunity to know more about Gen z by mingling with them and also get the company products sold there since it's Gen z party.

body.title: Walking Towards Happiness | A Beautiful Evening at Thal CanalMy Actifit Report Card: August 30 2026
body.body:
Assalamualaikum and hello to my Actifit community. I hope you are all doing good. I am also doing pretty well. In this blog, I will tell you about my todays' walking activity. I hope you will enjoy my today's activity report. Today, I got up a bit late in the morning. I had my breakfast. After having my breakfast, I did some domestic chores. Then, I rested for a while at my residence. After that, I had my lunch with my family. My kids were very happy because they were having a meal after the whole weekend. Sunday is always a fun day for me. Usually, I try to enjoy my weekends. So, in the evening, I decided to go for an evening walk. I chose a beautiful canal track for today's walk. At about 5 p.m., I left my home and reached my favorite place, the canal track, within 15 to 20 minutes. It was a bit humid out there, but a cool breeze was still blowing. I started walking along the canal track. It was a peaceful and lonely walk. There were beautiful trees on the right side of the canal track, while on the left side was the beautiful Thal Canal, with its water flowing peacefully. The view of the sunset was absolutely beautiful. I was enjoying my peaceful walk while admiring the awesome sunset view. I also took a picture of the setting sun. The reflection of the sun could still be seen in the flowing water of the Canal, which made the whole scene even more beautiful. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXyGRxt5Fs6ztL8VvVfw9hnnwkN25Qf7Q9xFoZPLMADCf/1788104680592.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdxSYAE5dyYPLub1SXeipagR5kKAKksg1Jw123UNsYRy5/1788104680305.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWF6xXsbYwqz4jSuRgtqjP6Zm2ZEufhMZsRcngor9EhZg/1788104680514.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmci1v2qtUaGvXDPEPTkqMS4px5Mq8f5RcwCo5CCPFN1WR/1788104680412.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcetVPwiRniNQp3pMjAt5D1zPkP83jUUk3qCNmEuJSM4B/1788104680138.jpg) It was the last month of the summer season, and September was just around the corner. The cool breeze seemed to announce the arrival of the pleasant weather. It was a brisk walk, and I decided to head towards the siphon side of this beautiful track. Within 15 to 20 minutes, I reached the siphon. I stopped there and captured a beautiful picture of it. The siphon was full of water, but it seemed that no cleaning or maintenance work had been carried out there for quite some time. Despite this, the flowing water and peaceful surroundings made the place look beautiful and refreshing. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX6bxpXhqDPtY4QGLuU8DkHcaykc3hVJjv5qJE839o6Ww/1788105119165.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtVySMaHyFttX6QZnb6JYNiJGNDkGhgp8bD3JiTkorek/1788105119080.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRZ31MU3vaK5hTMFeKQhnRJDfWVLJYnFHJRELCBNVZgdf/1788105119270.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6LYt3jtxyvUhR9FH8HouyHoUmcN5xXwEBFd5QX865cN/1788105119415.jpg) Believe me, I felt truly happy after completing my walking activity today. Physical activity is very important for a healthy body and, of course, for a healthy mind as well. I have read that research suggests physical activities such as walking, running, or playing games can stimulate the release of dopamine and other chemicals associated with feelings of happiness and well-being. That’s why I really enjoyed today’s walking activity. It was not only good for my physical health but also refreshing for my mind. After finishing my walk, I felt relaxed, energetic, and genuinely happy.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@javedkhan1989/actifit-javedkhan1989-20260830t161153109z)_

body.body: En medio del aperitivo del domingo, la publicación en preparación cambió de dirección. >In the middle of Sunday's aperitif, the publication in preparation changed direction. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRJfQxZFhj2GqFs7sCKQvm21hQduKMjmnsqicuc3ZRJ5t/image.png) Una reflexión sin conclusión, otro paseo en medio del recorrido que, como buen laberinto, cuando parece que te acercas al centro, te alejas y cuando sospechas una salida, vuelves a estar perdido. >A reflection without conclusion, another walk in the middle of the journey that, like a good labyrinth, when it seems that you are getting closer to the center, you move away and when you suspect an exit, you are lost again. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNwvNjN2D1VdAzLcE9rG6NTfrYEFhLxH65g8zCCB3t4Pt/image.png) Viendo cómo se acercaba el tren, esperé que pasara para captarlo, mientras el conductor o maquinista saluda con la mano, a veces con un cambio de luces, y cuando entre el público hay niños, hace sonar el silbato y la campana. >Watching the train approach, I waited for it to pass so I could capture it, while the driver or engineer waves, sometimes with a change of lights, and when there are children in the audience, he blows the whistle and rings the bell. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJ11sPGhoU8tgMwE1RvsNrsoHJDAcxqtrduxLZkNbCLQ/image.png) Sospecho que a veces responde al tañir de la campana del templo sabiendo que en la tarde llama a acudir a los fieles a la misa de seis. >I suspect that sometimes he responds to the ringing of the temple bell, knowing that in the afternoon it calls the faithful to attend the six o'clock mass. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaqiP7kRvACNFzw3U64kYyorjQTYs5D5CGskq4q3GuDUM/image.png) Un tren moderno que atraviesa la ciudad, pero guarda la tradición. La primera tiene que ver con su origen inglés y por eso debe ser que sigue circulando por la izquierda. Aunque he visto que a veces comparten una sola vía, pero en ese caso los controladores tienen que estar atentos para coordinar sin falta cuando se cruzan los que van con los que vienen. > A modern train runs through the city, yet it retains a sense of tradition. The first reason is its English origin, which is probably why it still runs on the left. Although I've seen them sometimes share a single track, in that case the controllers have to be vigilant to coordinate precisely when the oncoming and off-track trains pass each other. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdXfHqTjzkiuHxFy9o6zCyY9ngwwerxkhdetRvJ6DV9Ln/image.png) Planeando compartir estas imágenes, me enteré de que en el próximo mes de septiembre se cumplen 201 años de la puesta en servicio del primer ferrocarril que conectaba dos poblaciones en Inglaterra. >While planning to share these images, I learned that next September marks 201 years since the first railway connecting two towns in England was put into service. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYunN14dMtWYFYpk2q6WuT3Jc3QvTQa8C9NLXyXGH9mGz/image.png) Claro que el invento de la máquina de vapor es anterior, igual que el uso de vagones y vías, solo que con anterioridad no eran de hierro o acero, sino de madera, empleados principalmente en el interior de las minas. >Of course, the invention of the steam engine is earlier, as is the use of wagons and tracks, only previously they were not made of iron or steel, but of wood, used mainly inside mines. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmboEoH4rH7XZ7Mi8Z7Zccmc9Lk7zfcSZUdBQkECw9Ajm7/image.png) Otro dato interesante es que el ferrocarril fue el protagonista de la primera película de cine, hace ya 130 años, cuando los hermanos franceses Lumière exhibieron por primera vez el siguiente cortometraje. >Another interesting fact is that the railway was the protagonist of the first movie, 130 years ago, when the French Lumière brothers first exhibited the following short film. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A2xrwSQT6Dg Con esto daría por terminada mi publicación, pero mientras espero el almuerzo, busco una película para mirar en la tarde y me encontré con esta interesante propuesta, Ciudad Oscura o Dark City, que aún no descubro en qué plataforma ver. Si alguien la encuentra y quiere, me puede compartir la información. Advierto que, además de la película, también existe una serie del mismo nombre, pero con distinta temática. > That would be the end of my post, but while I wait for lunch, I'm looking for a movie to watch this afternoon and I came across this interesting option, Dark City, which I haven't yet figured out which platform to watch it on. If anyone finds it and wants to share the information, please let me know. I should mention that, in addition to the movie, there's also a series with the same name, but with a different theme. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uxEeIrYggiM Crédito a los creadores de los videos compartidos. Las fotografías son todas mías, tomadas con la cámara del teléfono Motorola y, aunque se parezcan a otras anteriores, totalmente inéditas. El texto escrito en español traducido por Google. Gracias. >Credit to the creators of the shared videos. All the photographs are mine, taken with my Motorola phone camera, and although they may resemble previous ones, they are entirely new. The text written in Spanish was translated by Google. >Thank you. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdrkK2ySGtKi3hjzxTTCqZhmwBTYwesT14cJXJ6WU8ZTa/image.png)

body.title: ESP/ENG - Hay kilómetros que no se miden en mapas, sino en intenciones / There are kilometers that are not measured on maps, but in intentions
body.body:
¡Hola a toda esta maravillosa y activa comunidad, y un saludo muy especial para ti que te tomas el tiempo de leerme hoy! Espero que estés teniendo un día excelente.



Todos nos hemos descubierto alguna vez mirando la pantalla del teléfono, evaluando una invitación, un proyecto o una cita, mientras dejamos escapar un suspiro de cansancio anticipado. «Está muy lejos», «el tráfico va a estar imposible», «no creo que me dé tiempo». La geografía, las agendas y el clima se convierten de pronto en nuestros mejores aliados para disimular una verdad mucho más sencilla: simplemente no tenemos ganas.

Porque cuando el deseo existe, el mapa se encoge. Cuando algo verdaderamente nos mueve, una hora de viaje parece un suspiro, el mal tiempo se convierte en anécdota y el cansancio desaparece. En cambio, cuando el interés falta, hasta cruzar la calle exige un esfuerzo titánico.




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme6N8nFVvQoHFjs4duRke7L7SGLBbaz2rNXEveL6ds24d/1788105282544.jpg)

*Fuente / Source: Pixabay*

#### Las distancias que inventamos

Esta reflexión apela a esa arquitectura de excusas que construimos para proteger nuestra zona de confort o para evitar decir un «no» categórico. Preferimos culpar a la logística antes que asumir nuestra falta de voluntad.

Pero esta máxima no solo aplica a un lugar físico o a una reunión social; funciona exactamente igual para los grandes movimientos de la vida:

* **El cambio profesional:** «No es el momento adecuado», nos decimos, mientras mantenemos en pausa un proyecto que exige esfuerzo.
* **Las conversaciones pendientes:** Aplazamos un diálogo necesario escudándonos en la falta de tiempo, cuando en realidad lo que falta es valentía para enfrentar la respuesta.
* **Las decisiones personales:** La distancia entre donde estamos y donde queremos estar raras veces es un obstáculo técnico; suele ser el miedo a dar el primer paso.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV24E7hHsV5Ad1hnSyvjQdC9s4Mfivc2sWALGJ3R5onsR/1788105559161.jpg)

*Fuente / Source: Pixabay*

#### La geografía de la voluntad

Decir que algo «queda lejos» es, en el fondo, una declaración de prioridades. La distancia es relativa, pero la apatía es absoluta. Reconocer que la traba no es la distancia física sino nuestra propia desgana es un ejercicio necesario de honestidad con nosotros mismos y con los demás.

Aprender a identificar cuándo estamos inventando kilómetros nos ahorra energía y culpa. Si el camino se siente demasiado largo antes de haber empezado a caminar, tal vez no sea cuestión de buscar un transporte más rápido, sino de admitir con calma que, sencillamente, ese no es nuestro destino.

Al final, los lugares, las metas y las personas a las que realmente queremos llegar... nunca quedan demasiado lejos.

---

#### Preguntas para la comunidad

1. ¿Te has descubierto alguna vez inventando «kilómetros de logística» para evitar un compromiso o una decisión?
2. ¿Cuál ha sido ese proyecto o lugar por el que cruzaste cualquier distancia sin lo pensarte dos veces porque la motivación era enorme?

---

*Nota / Descargo: Las imágenes utilizadas en esta publicación provienen del banco de imágenes de libre uso Pixabay. Se ha utilizado asistencia de herramientas de inteligencia artificial únicamente para la revisión ortográfica, ajuste de sintaxis, traducción al inglés y el diseño de la maqueta en Markdown.*

---
---

We have all caught ourselves at some point looking at our phone screens, evaluating an invitation, a project, or an appointment, while letting out a sigh of anticipated fatigue. \

Geography, schedules, and weather suddenly become our best allies to disguise a much simpler truth: we simply don't feel like it.

Because when desire exists, the map shrinks. When something truly moves us, an hour-long trip feels like a breath, bad weather becomes an anecdote, and fatigue disappears. On the other hand, when interest is lacking, even crossing the street requires a titanic effort.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme6N8nFVvQoHFjs4duRke7L7SGLBbaz2rNXEveL6ds24d/1788105610384.jpg)

*Fuente / Source: Pixabay*

#### The distances we invent

This reflection appeals to that architecture of excuses we build to protect our comfort zone or to avoid saying a definitive \

We prefer to blame logistics rather than admit our lack of willpower.

But this rule does not only apply to a physical location or a social gathering; it works exactly the same way for life's major milestones:

* **Professional change:** \

we tell ourselves, while keeping a project that requires effort on hold.
* **Pending conversations:** We postpone a necessary dialogue using lack of time as an excuse, when in reality what is missing is the courage to face the outcome.
* **Personal decisions:** The distance between where we are and where we want to be is rarely a technical obstacle; it is usually the fear of taking the first step.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV24E7hHsV5Ad1hnSyvjQdC9s4Mfivc2sWALGJ3R5onsR/1788105860458.jpg)


#### The geography of willpower

Saying that something is \

is, deep down, a statement of priorities. Distance is relative, but apathy is absolute. Recognizing that the obstacle is not the physical distance but our own reluctance is a necessary exercise in honesty with ourselves and others.

Learning to identify when we are inventing kilometers saves us energy and guilt. If the path feels too long before we even start walking, perhaps it is not a matter of finding faster transportation, but of calmly admitting that, simply, that is not our destination.

In the end, the places, goals, and people we truly want to reach... are never too far away.

---

#### Questions for the community

1. Have you ever caught yourself inventing \

just to avoid a commitment or a tough decision?
2. What has been that project or location for which you traveled any distance without a second thought because the motivation was huge?

---

body.title: The Hive Token is fighting furiously to hold the $0.043 line
body.body:
/> ----------------------
_Image Source_: [https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/hive-blockchain/](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/hive-blockchain/)
------------------- The above graph has been taken from CoinMarketCap. It shows the today USD trade value of the Hive Token ($0.04312). If we look closely at the graph we can see the tokens upward trajectory started on August 19th/20th. The USD trade value of one Hive Token on those dates was $0.037+. Soon after the Hive Token hit near $0.047 USD per token. Those numbers represents a 27% increase in token value. A correction (dip) after such an increase is normal and is to be expected. As I sit and watch these charts over the past days and weeks I can't help but be surprised at how well the Hive Token is holding the value of its most recent pump. Even at today's going rate of $0.043+ that increase in USD value still represents a 16% improvement from recent lows. Folks, that 16% number is nothing to sneeze at. I have to admit, I was gearing up to purchase some $1000 worth of the Hive token near the $0.037 mark but I held out a little too long.
---------------- My procrastinating got the better of me. I am now looking at and contemplating when I should make the move. If I was asked that question and were to answer seriously. The answer I would want to give: now, even at +16% increase the Hive Token is still highly undervalued. However I would never give that direct advice to someone as financial decisions need to be based on ones own specific goals and finances. While I have faith in the Hive ecosystems long term success, short term price movement is unpredictable in just about any cryptocurrency market. As per what my own actions are going to be. I got this little bugger in me. A man who takes enjoyment at rolling that dice. A guy that wants to say _I purchased at the best possible time_. It's the same guy who happily declares they were one of the first to toss his hat (cash) at the leading blockchain game known as Splinterlands. That guy is a major part of that procrastinating. There is also a logical guy in there that makes sure I have hedges to secure another profitable move. So while I am currently in sit back and watch the Hive market mode -> I also have another move in mind for that $1000 USD worth of HBD. That move can be summed up in three little magical letters DEC, a Splinterlands gaming token. ----------------------

/>
---------------------- _Image Source_: [https://tribaldex.com/tokens](https://tribaldex.com/tokens) -----------------
The above link will take you to TribalDex (Powered by Hive-Engine). TribalDex hosts many layer two tokens. Such tokens are more commonly known on the Hive Blockchain as community and gaming tokens or simply called Hive-Engine tokens. One such token is the token known as DEC (Dark Energy Crystals). As we went over in the first paragraph of this post; DEC is a Splinterlands gaming token. What makes this token unique is the Splinterlands team accepts DEC at the ratio of $1 per 1000 DEC for assets like in-print core sets. If we take a close look at the most recent image displayed in this post, the one directly above this paragraph, we will see that DEC is currently trading at $0.00033 per token. This is great news for those looking to purchase a bag of DEC for purchasing Splinterland assets. Why is this great news for such people? It means the DEC token is 66% below its soft peg. Put another way: that is a 3X gain on assets sold by the Splinterlands company for those who spend their newly acquired DEC on Splinterland assets (when weighted against spending USD on those same assets). For those who like to speculate and hold the DEC token. If purchasing DEC at current open market rates. That is a 3X gain if DEC were to reach its soft peg. --------------------
Historically DEC has dipped and regained its soft peg or come close to its soft peg multiple times. The spike in DEC trade value usually happens around the same time a new core set is released. body.title: Learning With Flair And Interest
body.body:
Learning is one thing that comes with continuous process. This means learning never finishes , unless as humans we don’t want to move forward in life. So, as long as we develop interest in something, we will definitely will want to learn and achieve it.

Another thing with learning is that as humans with different capabilities and interest, some of us can process things faster while other can only catch up moving with slow pace. But this does not mean they will not get there, especially in situations where individuals go into learning something new to acquire more experience in life.

For me , learning is all about having flair for that one thing we involved ourselves into. In simple understanding, learning comes with having interest on something, even though its a different line of activities or something that is educating. And sometimes, it could be something that we must learn to go to another level in life. But as long as we have interest or the push to acquire it, we definitely will put the energy no matter how long it takes.

Am a very faster learner, especially when the line or activity involved is what I have flair/interest in. And again, I have cultivated the habit of being patience while learning any new thing as this usually gives me concentration and focus. With this, I can be able to put more effort to learn faster within a short pereira of time. 

Although, we all know that learning comes with different experiences. Some needs gradual process and progress, others needs us to pay attention, be patience , even if the process involves repeated practices. What we should have in mind is that everything that has a beginning, surely will have an end. So as a part of live, learning never comes to an end, unless we stop ourselves from involving in daily activities or lessons of life.

As a 9:00 - 5:00 worker after graduation 👩‍🎓, I have gotten more extra experiences today. One was my Realtor Management Course I went for six months to learn what is involved in properties, lands, measurement, clients handling and coordinating. When I started the course initially, I thought I will never be able to finish because of how tough some areas were, especially the practical areas that involves mathematic and calculation 🧮. But as time went by, it all became more interesting to me because of the flair and interest.

Joining Hive Blockchain, I have also learnt many things here. The way I write ✍️ and blog has improved so much. And as a member of the gastronomy communities I have learned many recipes from dessert 🍨, to baking snacks, bread 🍞🥖, drinks 🍹what vegan 🌱 entails. And not just learning recipes, I have also learned about foods and cultures of other countries here on hive because of the opportunity of being here. 

However, learning and mastering something new depends on how interesting  they are to us. The interest makes it easier for us to quickly adapt to even though naturally, they seemed tough. And no matter how tough, many who has the enabling capacity can still put all effort to learn it. I think we all have individual capacity and grit energy in learning new things, be it easy or tough. 

This is my response to the #hiveleaners featured content for week 232, edition 03.

# Thanks for visiting and reading friends 🥰💕.

# Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

body.title: Eli en IRL: Startups World Cup + Ecuador Web3
body.body:
<center>![1001242178.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xpAUrXnyYnZWjnPNvLbNWLizuZmM7sZHBLanzBjENJZj3aVNouvFio1tt7fgL5Q7z26.png)</center>

---

<div class=text-justify>

El 19 y 20 de Agosto se llevó acabo en la ciudad de Manta, Ecuador, la [Startups World Cup 2026](https://www.instagram.com/startupworldcup_ec?igsi=MTZiczZiOWJvbDFhcA==), un evento que reunió al talento ecuatoriano regional para competir por el pasaporte a San Francisco, donde se reunirán todos los ganadores regionales de diferentes países para competir por el premio mayor de 1 millón de $$ para impulsar su proyecto.

Manta, queda muy cerca de la ciudad donde vivo y algunos de los chicos que forman parte de la Comunidad Ecuador Web3 eran finalistas, así que estarían participando con su proyecto Agri-X y decidimos ir a apoyarles. Fue un grato tiempo, ya que de mi parte, personalmente solo conocía en persona a uno de ellos. Y fue bueno conocernos y conectar con personas que también hablan el idioma Web3.

|![1001217849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wC5cjjym7qc8U2tpvZwrxX1nK6WjFyUEQagjZBGT9phR4HEYLM5uZ9e3uqzT1Ch1yTD.jpg)|![1001217924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23yd1qb5LvV14TcvTMWrE9zvw7NK6DXK1QtjB7HuQbwM75GpxbdH1vPC6DH8QLDxqpanf.jpg)|![1001218052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xKtZ1haKRAtQuqMWsHyNf5NUhf2GuPyZR32otXGkTMuMKzxPM6SeJfsoqvPCJ9U8K6u.jpg)|
|-|-|-|

El evento estuvo cargado de charlas, presentaciones de proyectos y diferentes paneles informativos. La mayoría enfocado solo a tecnología y otros muy pocos tocando el tema de blockchain y criptomonedas como punta de lanza para crecimiento en Ecuador del ecosistema Web3. 

![1001218437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xp4iHRg3Nvsea6Lg7oTgQ6Uq8rMdKV1jX5xa76cSpVcw31cRcmeoLKT5g82xLKdsXG3.jpg)|![1001218554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wqiZvPuLUMkAZUr977ZVUecfN6SeFno1JcTvwtSabvzKP8L5TRpUGoSaQJRs58FiZdP.jpg)
-|-
![1001218656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wC9de3e2BTt8UdGrNcPp2Qh4ChVPXTxTBt96EEDUJR3y7eAFAGcRr9rj3CLPZLGuqax.jpg)|![1001218762.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wqgVWcGYk3NjWNxJ3Xd24b7xvJ1SX4HrKLCAe2fgn9L2eM84MuYaXtaS7CCntdAKBtU.jpg)

Pudimos hacer networking y además me pude reunir con parte de mi programa de embajadores de P2Pme aquí en Ecuador, como quiera soy la \

, como dicen ellos y aunque a Carlos ya lo conocía, a Maikel no y fue un gustazo poder coincidir ya que nos llevamos muy bien. También hubo otro amigo con el que pude hablar y conocer que realmente nos llevamos bien y queríamos hacer posible este encuentro. ![1001229852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xVP1ttF9JoGGm3FwvUb1jCpzzXwAP4oA2c31MutBCmE9RVUJLsdvJme2jt7UfsPbkvw.jpg) |![1001219678.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/EowH3e533B4uWyWA5s9Ax22s3jgzAP6atwrwXuApSBaZghq44qjknRBhxSE8dJfr2gH.jpg)|![1001217573.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tbpysjcXzMDBpuUr6uxCtmZ7WMFqW4NDTijq7HG7F5FdD5bBxtued4AwUTDc2HXiDBw.jpg)| |-|-| Jna anécdota graciosa: al final del día ya habian llegado todos los del Team Ecaudor Web3 y en el carro que yo andaba con uno de los chicos que pasó por mi casa buscándome para viajar juntos, no entrábamos. Así que amablemente y al ser la única mujer decidí irme atras en el maletero con otro de los chicos más pequeños. Pero olvidé un detalle importante que recordé solo cuando cerraron la compuerta. Sufro de fobia a los encierroooos 😆, así que empecé a gritar para que abrieran la puerta y los muchachos corrieron a sacarme de allí por el susto.
![1001220967.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23yJCYaocRfGXNnwrcvq3PEMHTBfpuvStQ2L5AZYSezLsFTtAwjR7pqqN4UQJ5jNzhjqn.jpg)
Eli siendo Eli siempre, en todo momento jajaja. 3 duritos antes: feliz por ir atrás, 3 duritos después gritando porque tiene claustrofobia. Lo bueno fue que hubo, mucho café Juan Valez 😏. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xATjQu43VLb2Dj6rr8D8Da7DfqUoLWuyKMnE9GLJ4CjwKFmLps58W1fFuvr3bEx3QyQ.png)

*Foto: McLean Bible Church Rear / Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/McLean%20Bible%20Church%20Rear.jpg*

Hoy quiero reflexionar con ustedes sobre algo que mucha veces pasamos por alto.

Pensando en todo esto, me doy cuenta de que la vida cristiana se trata de confiar día a día, incluso cuando no vemos el resultado inmediato. La paciencia bíblica no es esperar sentado, es seguir caminando aunque no veas el destino.

Lo que veo en las noticias de hoy me confirma algo: la fe sigue siendo relevante en estos tiempos. La plenitud de la Salvación en Jesucristo Agustinos Recoletos. La Escritura nos recuerda que la fe no es un sentimiento pasivo, es una decisión diaria que tomamos cada mañana.

Esto que encontré es interesante: El arte del perdón: amar hasta el final Catholic.net. Y me hace recordar que Dios siempre está trabajando, incluso cuando no lo vemos. La vida cristiana se trata de confiar día a día, incluso cuando el camino no está claro.

body.title: Martin Luther und die Reformation: Wie ein Mönch die Welt veränderte
body.body:
# Martin Luther und die Reformation: Wie ein Mönch die Welt veränderte

![Martin Luther und die Reformation: Wie ein Mönch die Welt veränderte](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1719384940096-916822568159?crop=entropy&cs=tinysrgb&fit=max&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NDgzODF8MHwxfHJhbmRvbXx8fHx8fHx8fDE3ODgxMDU2MDJ8&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=80&w=1080)

---

Am 31. Oktober 1517 soll Martin Luther seine 95 Thesen an die Schlosskirche zu Wittenberg genagelt haben. Ob diese Geste wirklich stattfand, ist historisch umstritten - sicher ist, dass seine Schriften die westliche Christenheit für immer spalteten.

## Vom Jurastudenten zum Mönch

Ein Gewitter auf dem Weg nach Erfurt veranlasste Luther 1505, ins Augustinerkloster einzutreten. Als Theologieprofessor in Wittenberg rang er mit der Frage: Wie kann ein sündiger Mensch vor Gott bestehen? Seine Antwort - Rettung allein durch den Glauben, nicht durch Werke oder Sakramente - wurde zum Kern der Reformation.

## Der Ablassstreit

Der Dominikanerprediger Johann Tetzel verkaufte Ablassbriefe, die Sündenstrafen erließen - Einnahmen für den Petersdom in Rom. Luther empfand dies als Skandal. Seine 95 Thesen, ursprünglich als akademische Einladung gedacht, verbreiteten sich dank der Drucktechnik binnen Wochen durch ganz Deutschland.

## Bruch mit Rom

1521 wurde Luther exkommuniziert. Auf dem Reichstag zu Worms weigerte er sich, seine Schriften zu widerrufen. Kurfürst Friedrich der Weise rettete ihn auf der Wartburg - wo Luther das Neue Testament in nur elf Wochen ins Deutsche übersetzte und damit die deutsche Sprache nachhaltig prägte.

## Folgen

Die Reformation spaltete die Christenheit dauerhaft. Die religiösen Konflikte mündeten im Dreißigjährigen Krieg und endeten mit dem Westfälischen Frieden 1648. Luthers Betonung des individuellen Gewissens legte geistige Grundlagen für Aufklärung und Demokratie.

**Martin Luther wollte die Kirche reformieren, nicht spalten - und löste dennoch eine Revolution aus, die Europa für Jahrhunderte prägte.**

---

*Dieser Beitrag wurde mit wissenschaftlichen Quellen erstellt.*

links.title: The Letter from the Old Truck
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX4iVrSZsgfjJPPzUwDpvhPAGqtc8i48mqgtVrTR3jhGj/1788105059196.png)

[AI](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_6a94515569b48191a8fd0ecaaf12b5c8)
On the sickbed, he glows with so much radiance: faint smiles, weak breaths, skinny flesh, and a full face. He lies down like a lifeless body. Her parents wipe tears frequently from their faces, offering silent prayers for their first child's recovery.  


Miracles can happen, but it is certain that he wouldn't make it after a few days; these were the doctor's last words earlier that day.  



James, the younger and second son, was eavesdropping when his parents met with the doctor. He simply left the hospital to go sit at the reception.  

As soon as James sat down, he drifted into a heavy sleep. When he awoke, he found himself strolling beside the road, then he crossed to the other side. It seemed like he needed to move faster; while doing so, he saw an old truck just about to take off, and he quickly jumped on it.


The truck drove a very long distance. When the driver finally stopped on a shady road, he went to the back of the truck to check his tire. James hid himself in a corner, covering himself with the sack he found in the truck. All of a sudden, the driver spoke in a calm voice, \

he said after dropping a letter in the truck.

James was anxious when he heard the man's voice; it was soft yet echoed through the air, and no one seemed to see him. However, James uncovered himself and found no one but a purple letter on top of the truck. He picked it up and read what was inside.

The letter read: \

James lost control instantly; the thought of losing his only brother tormented him. He ran as fast as he could back to the hospital. It seemed like he had wings while going back.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLbHWVPoMcgkcdeMDGCBKCCsmS34ETuhw2KPwqszbs29/1788105343752.jpg)
[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/merry-christmas-pen-handwriting-3481061/)
He used only 8 minutes running at high speed, an unimaginable feat. When he got to the hospital, he wasn't allowed in because there was an emergency. His brother was gasping for breath while some nurses and a doctor were trying to stabilize him. 

\
James thought as he forced his way in, despite the restrictions. He wouldn't give up; at that point, he shouted his brother's name, \

Then he opened the purple letter and read the words aloud. He did that three times as instructed, and then his parents came and took him away so he wouldn't disturb the doctors.

BACK TO THE HOSPITAL

James woke up suddenly. He had been dreaming all this while, still sitting at the reception. Then he remembered his dying brother and rushed to the ward to see a miracle. His brother, John, was sitting up, eating, and even interacting with their mom and dad. 

James ran to embrace him. He thought he had lost his brother to the cold hands of death but couldn't comprehend how he had overcome it.
I heard your voice; your echoes resounded in my ears while I was sleeping, John said, still holding James in a tight embrace.

You came in and read a letter to me. The words were real, and the letters flew into my nostrils. I sneezed thrice because you read it thrice, so I am awake now, and I'm totally healed.  


\
I thought I was dreaming, James said in amazement as he moved away from his brother. \

he asked further.  




\

Then I saw those words arranged in a line, flying towards me like butterflies.  
John repeated,  
\
James responded, still confused because it all happened in his dream. Moreover, his brother was discharged the following morning.\n

links.title: Чому PIN-код має саме чотири цифри?
links.body: alt=\

/>

Коли я вперше прочитала цю історію, не повірила. Не тому, що так розрахували криптографи. Не тому, що чотири цифри — якийсь ідеальний стандарт безпеки.

А тому, що дружина винахідника сказала: шість цифр я не запам’ятаю. Чотири — так.

1960-ті, Велика Британія. Банки працюють за розкладом. Не встиг зняти готівку до закриття в суботу — до понеділка живеш із тим, що залишилося в кишені.

Одного разу саме так сталося з Джоном Шепердом-Барроном, працівником компанії De La Rue, яка займалася банкнотами та захищеним друком.  
Він запізнився до банку.

Кажуть, того вечора, лежачи у ванні, він згадав автомат із шоколадками: якщо машина може цілодобово видавати шоколад, чому інша машина не може видавати гроші?

Так народилася ідея банкомата.

Звичних нам пластикових карток тоді ще не було. Перші автомати працювали зі спеціальними паперовими ваучерами на £10, які мали мітку з вуглецем-14. Але залишалося головне питання: як автомат зрозуміє, що гроші забирає саме власник?

Потрібен був секретний код.

Шеперд-Баррон запропонував шість цифр. Він служив в армії й чудово пам’ятав свій шестизначний військовий номер, тому був переконаний, що це легко. І вирішив перевірити на дружині Керолайн:  
— Шість? Ні, не запам’ятаю.  
— А скільки запам’ятаєш?  
— Чотири.  
На чотирьох і зупинилися.

27 червня 1967 року перший такий банкомат встановили у відділенні Barclays в Енфілді, на півночі Лондона. Першим гроші з нього отримав популярний британський актор Редж Варні.  
А далі банкомати почали завойовувати світ.

Мільярди людей десятиліттями підходять до банкоматів, прикривають клавіатуру рукою і вводять чотири цифри.

І майже ніхто не замислюється, чому саме чотири. Не п’ять. Не шість. Не вісім.  
Ми звикли думати, що світ влаштований за складними розрахунками. Що за кожним стандартом стоять дослідження, комісії й десятки сторінок обґрунтувань.

А іноді світ змінює звичайна розмова чоловіка з дружиною:  
— Шість я не запам’ятаю. Давай чотири.  
І чотири цифри залишаються з людством на десятиліття.

* * *

Більше цікавих новин на моєму телеграм каналі - [Ірландія для українців](https://t.me/irelandforukrainian)

links.title: Mi helecho cuerno de alce.
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcKrJPPUq6qCYg3fKuQibYsSciF4rWBwRGpocixBtkNxW/20260827_154155.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWpK8PxuzzigyPj2FFPzVab6qAhGPhBCoubsxBHfYuqA/20260827_154145.jpg)


¡Hola a todos en la comunidad en esta tarde de domingo!
Hoy quiero seguir compartiendo con ustedes amantes o no de la plantas otro de los helechos de mi pequeño jardín. Lo conozco como cueno de alce o cresta de gallo.
 Con sus frondas onduladas, bordes rizados y ese tono verde brillante tan lleno de vida, se ha convertido en una de las plantas más admiradas de mi colección.Además este helecho tiene un significado super esecial para mi ya que me lo regaló mi madre quien ya no está físicamente, es por eso quee lo cuido con tanto amor y cariño,a mi madre le debo el amor que siento por las plantas, a ella  también le gustaba cuidar de ellas.

​Para mantenerlo así de frondoso y sano, he aprendido a darle justo lo que necesita:

​Luz: Se desarrolla perfectamente en un lugar con luz indirecta brillante. La luz solar directa muy fuerte puede quemar sus delicadas hojas, por lo que una sombra bien iluminada es su punto ideal.
 ​
Riego y humedad: Prefiere mantener el sustrato ligeramente húmedo sin llegar a encharcarlo. En los días más calurosos, rocío un poco de agua sobre sus frondas para mantener ese ambiente fresco que tanto le gusta. ​

Ubicación: Esta maceta colgante le da la libertad de desplegar sus hojas libremente, permitiendo que cada nuevo brote crezca sin tropezar.
