body.title: (en.es) Lost Childhoods, a Reality for Many. • Infancias Perdidas, realidad de muchos
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQZXMkDt6GrSJMyMgVUoGRzpKFxXvMFcncxz8nyqcSyz8/artguru_text2image_20250927134538.png)


📸[www.artguru.ai](https://www.artguru.ai/create/)

# *Lost Childhoods, a Reality for Many.*

Today, I want to share some words in this community that touch the deepest fibers of my soul. For the past week, the same thing has been repeated over and over again. It's not a specific situation, but rather a recurring topic of conversation among friends, stemming from different moments we've shared or memories that have resurfaced. Today, no one doubts the importance of experiencing a fulfilling childhood, one where the only worries are playing and learning. That would be in a perfect world, but we know it isn't. Out there, perhaps closer than we think, are hundreds, if not thousands, of children who have lost their childhood and will never get it back.

I belong to a generation where children were raised with an iron fist, where reprimands might or might not come with physical punishment, but today that has changed. Most parents have at least a basic understanding of responsible parenting, of raising children with love and not pain. But I still can't stop thinking about those adults today who stopped being children, who learned under the threat of the belt to obey fearfully, holding back their tears, because yes, crying was forbidden.

I have friends who have brought this up recently after seeing the most chilling news stories online, news that keeps you up at night because even though our parents beat us, they wouldn't be capable of doing something like that, but the doubt lingers in our hearts. Many friends have shared their stories of childhood abuse, laughing nervously and with relief, and I can't help but imagine that those now-tired eyes were once innocent and full of dreams.

How do you move forward when the person who should protect you is the cause of your pain, when the place where you should be safest has become a house of horrors?

“As soon as I turned eighteen, I left home. I was hungry and cold, but I couldn’t stay there any longer, and my mother simply refused to let go of that man who only brought her trouble,” a friend told me amidst these stories. Together, we remembered those two children, possibly siblings, who approached us in the street asking for money. We talked about them for a long time, wondering, between sighs and a few tears, what would become of them, what they would eat when they got home, who would give them a toy for their birthday. We wondered if they would ever be able to escape the horror, if they would ever break the cycle.

I’ve felt extremely strange these past few days, questioning moments in my life and memories I didn’t even know I had. It frightens me to see how, month after month, the situation repeats itself, and it’s always an adult who shatters a childhood, sometimes irrevocably. It frightens me how this society increasingly seeks to justify crime and pain. And while I'm aware there's a systemic failure, institutions that aren't functioning as they should, moments of breakdown and necessary intervention, that doesn't absolve the individual of responsibility, of guilt. If we as a society simply see the broken system and not the human being as the source of the problem, we are allowing and perpetuating the cycle, and above all, creating justifications and precedents for it to repeat itself.

I'm not doing well this week, not after this news, not after the memories of myself and my friends. Please forgive such a dark post in a place meant for sharing about family and friends, but I simply couldn't keep these words stuck like thorns in my chest. May a lost childhood not be a reality for so many, may justice be served.

![](https://images.ecency.com/p/3ossSWoLBnTDQ1TvAjS9Kmow57ZbFshVns79LnDvVUgHmyB6wd16NRx56R33JmgTV6Lbh41zkpSVr5ou4TryEoAMMYQwT66EFbNybWKw9DcxBGgtP8cEYXGoFzvLxt9bJU1exVtC7Bo4ScXWZaPEkSciz4F4Mu44m83fqhLpP5iEpQdimxeKYvy96eb2M4gQrPoPtLNAEgH2vrBtxYJQNPyGJdcvvBib4LPmU8RHM4FAqezegCkeFq9DMqAXPXWchZ4s?format=match&mode=fit)

# *Infancias Perdidas, realidad de muchos.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQZXMkDt6GrSJMyMgVUoGRzpKFxXvMFcncxz8nyqcSyz8/artguru_text2image_20250927134538.png)


📸[www.artguru.ai](https://www.artguru.ai/create/)


Hoy quiero dedicar en esta comunidad unas palabras que me tocan las fibras más sensibles de mi alma. Llevo una semana en la que se ha repetido lo mismo una y otra vez, no es una situación en específico, es más bien un tema de conversación que se ha escurrido entre amigos a través de distintos momentos que hemos vivido o recuerdos que han sido removidos. Al día de hoy nadie duda de la importancia de vivir una infancia plena, una donde no haya más preocupaciones que jugar o aprender, eso sería en un mundo perfecto, pero sabemos que no es así, que ahí fuera, quizás más cerca que lejos, hay cientos si no miles de niños que han perdido su infancia y nunca más la podrán recuperar.

Soy de una generación donde se educaba con mano de hierro, donde los regaños podían o no venir con golpes, pero hoy eso ha cambiado. La mayoría de los padres tienen un mínimo de conocimientos sobre la crianza responsable, sobre educar con amor y no con dolor. Pero aun así no dejo de pensar en esos adultos de hoy que dejaron de ser niños, que aprendieron bajo el miedo del cinturón a obedecer con temor y guardándose las lágrimas, porque sí, llorar estaba prohibido.

Tengo amigos que han sacado este tema en estos días después de ver en internet las noticias más escalofriantes, noticias que te quitan el sueño porque aunque nuestros padres nos pegaron no serían capaces de cometer algo así, pero nos queda la duda en el corazón. Muchos amigos a raíz de esto han hecho sus historias de abusos cuando niño, con risa de nervios y de alivio, y me es imposible no imaginar que esos ojos ahora cansados fueron una vez inocentes y llenos de sueños.

¿Cómo seguir adelante cuando la persona que te debería proteger es la causante de tu dolor, cuando el lugar donde deberías estar más seguro se convirtió en la casa del terror?

-En cuanto cumplí la mayoría de edad me fui de la casa, tuve hambre y tuve frío, pero no podía seguir ahí, y mi madre simplemente no quería dejar ir a ese señor que solo le traía problemas -me dijo una amiga en medio de estas historias, y juntos recordamos aquellos dos niños posiblemente hermanos que se acercaron pidiéndonos dinero en medio de la calle. Hablamos de ellos durante mucho tiempo, y nos preguntamos entre suspiros y alguna otra lágrima qué será de ellos, qué comerán al llegar a la casa, quién les regalará un juguete en su cumpleaños. Nos preguntamos si podrán escapar del horror en algún momento, si lograrán romper el círculo.

Me he sentido extremadamente raro estos días, me he cuestionado momentos de mi vida y recuerdos que no sabía que tenía. Me da miedo ver cómo mes tras mes se repite la situación y siempre es un adulto el que rompe una infancia, a veces sin vuelta atrás. Me da miedo cómo esta sociedad cada vez más quiere justificar el crimen y el dolor. Y si soy consciente de que hay un fallo sistémico, instituciones que no funcionan como deberían, momentos de quiebre y de intervención necesaria, pero eso no quita que la persona sea responsable, sea culpable. Si nosotros como sociedad simplemente vemos el sistema roto y no al humano como fuente del problema, estamos permitiendo y perpetuando el ciclo, y sobre todo creando justificantes y antecedentes para que se repita.

No estoy bien esta semana, no después de esta noticia, no después de los recuerdos míos y de mis amigos. Perdonen por un texto tan oscuro en un lugar que es para compartir sobre familia y amigos, pero simplemente no podía quedarme con las palabras clavadas como espinas en el medio de mi pecho. Que una infancia perdida no sea una realidad de muchos, que se haga justicia.

body.title: [Movie] Movie Review: Introducing The Kujus.
body.body:
If you're looking to watch a very funny, relatable, emotional, heartfelt, cool, and, at the same time, very interesting movie, just give Introducing the Kujus a watch. It is a very, very interesting Nigerian movie. Introducing the Kujus is about five siblings who aren't that close after the loss of their mom.



![1001418825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tRzfZwgw6G9gFJWyVjSHb1vuQJccDfSytUwuKbxibUiZwF5Z1tYaoWyXzDZV6Lp4Z2Y.jpg)




But along the line, one of them who's named Mausi, she felt it's high time everyone becomes a big large family once again. And together with the help of one of their brothers, Maugbe, she was able to make everyone come together once again. Even though it wasn't easy, they made it happen.








The interesting part is that none of them really wanted to come back home, to badagry and they have their reasons, of which it is so that they wouldn't have to face the the same old issues that separated them before. But then, this coming together happened, and when it did and they all came together once again, what they feared began to find its way out again.



![1001418826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23u62suBSVRzQXFS9692z1Y2bVmTY3L75u37cfs75vMCWJvZfZS2LzEFSqBPbvNHt6US5.jpg)


But then, I love how that despite all that happened, they were able to find their way back together and understand that at the end of the day, they're still family. And to be honest with you, I very much envisioned none of that before giving the movie a watch. Even the title didn't make me think towards that direction. But then, it didn't take long before I finally realized what the movie was all about. It consists of different things: a touch of pride, anger, stubbornness, competition, and a lot more. More like typical stuff that could be seen in a family.








I actually have a favorite character in this movie, and that is Mausi. You know, she really wanted to bring the family back together, and I really gave her kudos for that. She tried; she found ways to reach out to each one of the siblings and make sure they all came home and all of that. This is not to add that I'm encouraging lies, but then, she did tell some hilarious lies that we can say were helpful in bringing each person over.





![1001418827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23sweHqqefKMytqHkaXkpxi7r9HByxdr3VaFTxD99T59GxvHHucFf7qYm7p2FZ9KpeapZ.jpg)



It was when everyone finally came together that the film became more deep. Everyone has one wound or the other that they're carrying inside of them; another interesting part is that the story or version of everyone's story is different, and no one was even interested in listening, let alone understanding each other.






The movie really showed what family problems could look like. And talk of the dinner scene towards the end too. I thought it was just going to be a meal and that will be the end, but then, that meal, that dinner turned out to be where each one of them was able to speak out their mind.






And the cast, trust them to do well. Talk of Timini, Bisola, Femi, Ronke, Kunle, Bimbo, and the like. And like always, the movie isn't perfect; it is not a 100/100. But then, it was worth it. They all gave in their best and killed their roles. Yeah, I love how they all showed what a family can look like, who that there will always be issues, misunderstandings and all in a family, but then at the end of the day, we're still family and should always find ways to settle it and come back together.




🌹



**Images are screenshots taken from the movie.**



**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**


❣️❣️❣️

_Rating: **85/100**_

# 寻味之旅：全球美食探秘

旅行不仅是欣赏风景，更是一次舌尖上的冒险。在这篇博客中，我们将带您走遍全球，探索各地独特的美食文化。无论您是美食爱好者，还是计划下一次旅行的食客，这里都有值得一试的美味佳肴。

## 1. 意大利：正宗的意大利面

意大利以其丰富的美食文化而闻名，尤其是意大利面。无论是经典的番茄肉酱面（Spaghetti Bolognese），还是清新的青酱意面（Pesto Pasta），都能让人垂涎欲滴。在意大利旅行时，不妨亲自到当地的小餐馆品尝一碗地道的意大利面，体验那份手工制作的美味。

## 2. 日本：寿司与拉面

日本的美食以其精致和新鲜著称。寿司是日本的代表性美食，生鱼片与醋饭的完美结合让人回味无穷。而拉面则是另一种必尝的美食，各种汤底和配料让每一碗拉面都有独特的风味。在东京的街头，您可以找到无数家拉面馆，品尝到正宗的日本拉面。

## 3. 泰国：香辣的街头小吃

泰国的街头小吃种类繁多，味道独特。无论是泰式炒河粉（Pad Thai），还是冬阴功汤（Tom Yum Goong），都能让您的味蕾感受到热带风情。别忘了在清迈的夜市上尝试各种小吃，体验当地的美食文化。

## 4. 墨西哥：色彩缤纷的美食

墨西哥的美食以其丰富的口味和色彩而著称。玉米饼（Taco）和墨西哥卷（Burrito）是最受欢迎的街头食品，搭配新鲜的鳄梨酱和香菜，令人欲罢不能。在墨西哥城，您可以找到许多地道的餐馆，享受一顿丰盛的墨西哥大餐。

## 5. 法国：优雅的法式料理

法国是美食的天堂，法式料理以其精致和细腻而闻名。无论是松露蘑菇酱（Truffle Sauce）还是香煎鹅肝（Foie Gras），都体现了法式烹饪的艺术。在巴黎，您可以在小酒馆中品尝到正宗的法式大餐，感受那份独特的浪漫气息。

## 6. 中国：多样的地方风味

中国的美食文化博大精深，各地的风味各具特色。从四川的麻辣火锅到广东的点心，再到东北的饺子，每一种美食都有其独特的故事。在中国旅行时，您可以尝试不同地方的美食，感受那种丰富的文化底蕴。

## 结语

美食是文化的缩影，旅行中的每一口美味都是对当地文化的深刻体验。无论您身在何处，记得用心去品尝每一道菜，感受它背后的故事。希望这篇博客能激发您踏上寻味之旅的灵感，探索全球各地的美食魅力！

body.title: [Movie] Movie Review: 23 000 Leben
body.body:
> The simple act of deciding to help someone, without expecting anything in return, is the greatest act of courage there is—especially today, when people don’t value anything and don’t appreciate the simplest things in life. In this movie, we see how a group of young people decides to take a risk and come together to help those who found the courage to leave their country and their homeland in search of a better life.
![post (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFMBg7Szxbs3mvrc7ZhysUxLvcbvKX3VDGJH2B8C3WLpGLcVb1meSwKCJwUj6GKdQom.png)
##
🎬 23 000 Leben 🎬
This film tells the story of a group of young people who set out on a mission to rescue refugees lost in the Mediterranean, but it’s not that easy; they have to face situations they can’t handle, since they aren’t sailors or professional rescuers; all they have are good intentions, a big heart, and the courage to take on such a difficult task as rescuing these people. It all starts with an idea—a dream, so to speak—of a young man named Luckas, who, without a second thought, decided to find a way to help a little more, seeing how these people were dying without receiving help from anyone. It was something he couldn’t understand or stand by and do nothing about, and as I said, he started with this idea: to put together a team, get a boat, and set sail out into the open sea in search of these people who were waiting for a kind soul to come to their rescue.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vrtpMppBdB19WDQ4HsHgeszV7wD7YEr8CJiB4kRvDPyo9CnbcFj4bb9tVtuPGDgyhAU.png)
It’s worth noting that this story is based on real events, which, in a way, shows us that fragility—the expressions on people’s faces when they’re found and receive that help, that support. The simple fact of having made it, of having survived, is an emotion that defies explanation, and just seeing it on their faces is more than enough. It’s an inspiring story; it’s not a masterpiece, but simply an example of what can be achieved if you really set your mind to it, if you have the determination and courage to try. We see not only bravery, but also the solidarity that defines human beings. This reminds me of what happened recently in our country, with the earthquake, when we received help from rescue workers from various countries. They made the decision to come and help without expecting anything in return—simply to save as many lives as possible.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoEo9xpvm7fom2F2mo83RD6SB8Ui6Q13K59vrDo1BZqbAD7epVmXDAtQYx4q4WE4YtX.png)
A moving, simple film that gets its message across: the helplessness of seeing how many people choose to look the other way so they don't have to take action, and that there are still good people in this world. Anyway, if you haven't seen it, I recommend it.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=89dugTvBEWw
---
SPANISH VERSION

El simple hecho de tomar la decisión de ayudar a alguien,sin esperar nada a cambio, es el mejor acto de valentía que puede existir, sobre todo hoy en día, donde las personas no valoran nada, no aprecian lo más sencillo de la vida. En esta película podemos ver cómo un grupo de jóvenes decide arriesgarse, unirse para ayudar a estas personas que tomaron el valor de dejar su país, su tierra, en búsqueda de una mejor vida.

![post (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFMBg7Szxbs3mvrc7ZhysUxLvcbvKX3VDGJH2B8C3WLpGLcVb1meSwKCJwUj6GKdQom.png)
##
🎬 23 000 Leben 🎬
Este film cuenta la historia de un grupo de jóvenes que se embarcan en una misión para rescatar a refugiados que se encuentran perdidos en el Mediterráneo, pero no es tan fácil; tienen que enfrentar situaciones que no pueden manejar, ya que no son marineros ni rescatistas profesionales; solo tienen la buena intención, el corazón, el coraje para atreverse a realizar tan arduo trabajo, como es el de rescatar a estas personas. Todo comienza con una idea, un sueño, por decirlo de alguna manera, por un joven Luckas, el cual, sin pensarlo, decide buscar la manera de ayudar un poco más, viendo cómo estas personas morían, sin recibir ayuda de nadie. Era algo que él no podía entender ni quedarse sin hacer nada, y como dije, empezó con esta idea, de reunir un equipo, de conseguir un barco y embarcarse, en el medio del mar, en búsqueda de estas personas que esperaban un alma que los socorriera.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vrtpMppBdB19WDQ4HsHgeszV7wD7YEr8CJiB4kRvDPyo9CnbcFj4bb9tVtuPGDgyhAU.png)
Cabe mencionar que esta historia está basada en hechos reales, lo que en cierta parte nos muestra esa fragilidad, el rostro de las personas al ser encontradas y recibir esa ayuda, ese apoyo. El simple hecho de haberlo logrado, de sobrevivir, es una emoción que no tiene explicación, y que solo verla en su rostro es más que suficiente. Es una historia inspiradora, no es una obra maestra, es simplemente una muestra de lo que se puede lograr si realmente te lo propones, si tienes las intenciones y el valor para intentarlo. No solo vemos la valentía, sino esa solidaridad que caracteriza al ser humano. Esto me recuerda a lo que sucedió hace poco en nuestro país, con lo del terremoto, donde recibimos ayuda de diferentes rescatistas, de varios países. Tomaron la decisión de venir, de ayudar sin esperar nada, simplemente salvar todas las vidas posibles.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoEo9xpvm7fom2F2mo83RD6SB8Ui6Q13K59vrDo1BZqbAD7epVmXDAtQYx4q4WE4YtX.png)
Una película conmovedora, sencilla, pero que cumple con el mensaje: la impotencia de ver cómo muchos prefieren no mirar para no actuar, y que aún existe gente buena en este mundo. En fin, si no la han visto, se las recomiendo.

body.title: Observe yourself in the landscape\n| Obsérvate en el paisaje (es|en)
body.body: /> Hello, beautiful Hivers: It is a pleasure to greet you this Sunday. Thank you for reading me. I hope you don’t leave; I have something valuable to tell you: It may seem utopian, but I sincerely believe that this world still needs a little bit of utopia. … I would like you to look at the firmament, carefully, observe yourself there, living alongside your flaws and virtues, with your immense joy, overflowing or repressed. It doesn’t matter where you read from: in a favela hut or in a luxury building. Fill your lungs with air, listen to the song of birds; sing with that music that, since childhood, made the body tremble and raised the hairs of the soul with uncontrollable frenzy. Do not stop being your origin, even as you grow; chirp like a bird and dream like a child. There are still many sunrises before completing this human mission. And happiness awaits us right there: we will be a mole different from all the others. ... **Have a beautiful day!** **Thank you for your visit. 😍☀️** **—PoetaFrankoo 🌿** * * *

/> Hola preciosos Hivers: Es un gusto saludarte este domingo. Gracias por estar leyéndome, espero no te vayas, tengo algo valioso que decirte: Puede parecer utópico pero creo sinceramente, que a este mundo le hace falta aún un poco se utopía. Quisiera que miraras el firmamento, detenidamente, te observes allí conviviendo, con tus manchas y virtudes, con tu inmensa alegría desbordada o reprimida. No importa desde donde leas: en una choza de favela o en un edificio de lujo. Llena tus pulmones de aire, escucha el canto de aves; canta con esa música que desde niño estremecía el cuerpo e izaba los vellos del alma con frenesí incontrolable. No dejes de ser tu origen aún crecido; gorjea como una ave y sueña como un párvulo. Todavía quedan muchos amaneceres antes de completar esta misión de humanos. Y la dicha nos espera justo allí: seremos un lunar distinto a los demás. **¡Que tengan un bonito día!** **Gracias por tu visita. 😍☀️** —**PoetaFrankoo** 🌿 #spanish #poetry #poesia #literatura #bbh #waivio #alive #lolz#hbd #curation

body.title: Vocation for Life, A story about Lola.
body.body:
![1788039123928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrewq/23wgRyxhZ1V2JBfuysR1pkcoRn4GHe8NvQc1kqbR8A854KsoH4vdqSky64dDAyHNpRCyh.jpg)


How nice it is to laugh, that is one of the things that makes us all happy. And the best thing about it is that it is easily funny and you can brighten up other people's day just by laughing yourself. But it is even nicer when you live and work for the sake of brightening up others. That has no comparison in this life. That is Lola. She is a very charismatic and talkative girl. If you talk to her you will immediately start laughing. She has it in her blood, it is as if she was born for her current job. She works as a clown, that is her vocation and for which she has worked hard for a long time to achieve it.


![woman-5780949_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/martinte/23vsX3z9bEemMkBmqPPbin5hUEcDdYkcPHRNdxEzmhxjfQdJSCm48BtUBiZvnctYfYMxR.jpg)

But to get to where she is today, many things had to happen, some very good and others, well, not so good. But everything that has happened has served to strengthen her and help her become the best clown, one who truly lives for what she does. The beginning of this adventure was a long time ago, perhaps since she was in her mother's womb. No one knows if she already had the idea of ​​becoming a clown when she grew up. No one knows, but everything seems to indicate that because when she grew up and was already a little girl, she began to develop a great ability to make others laugh and brighten anyone's day. For example, at her friends' parties to which she was invited, she caught everyone's attention, even if the party was not for her.

Sometimes they would make her break the piñata, but instead of doing it directly, she would first invent a comedy routine about how the piñata suffered a nervous breakdown before being destroyed. She would say, Oh, don't break me, don't break me. The children burst out laughing at Lola's pantomime, and even more eagerly asked her to break it. These were very funny moments that only she knew how to create. That's why family friends always invited her to their children's parties, because she really knew how to liven up the atmosphere. It wasn't necessary to hire a clown, since they already had a clown.


![little-girl-3209549_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/martinte/23wqwC6PycszHyUtwnD4gEM125SHfJVVU8jPdmdekwDxGXZbXC5hxBrnezgp3FHrAeaxa.jpg)

From this perspective, it seems that her life will be geared towards being a clown when she grows up, at least some kind of entertainer. And she herself knew it, she knew that this would be her destiny. Now making it a reality would not be as easy as saying, okay, I'm a clown now, no, nothing like that, things were much more complicated. Although her parents enjoyed her a lot when she did these numbers and such, they wanted a more promising future for her, let's say, economically speaking. Her father was an accountant in a bank and her mother was an economist in a good company. Both earned good money in their jobs and wanted Lola to have a good life like they had now.

For this reason, from a young age, they told her what career she should choose. This did not please her at all, because that was not what she wanted for her life. Even so, she had no choice but to put aside that crazy desire to be a clown that she had to study a career at her level. Already as a young woman, with the dedication of her parents and with her good teachers, she managed to be in the highest echelon of the school where she studied. Her teachers constantly reminded her that she had a great future ahead of her because she had a lot of promise. Lola always thanked them. Even so, her talent for making others laugh did not go away just like that. Her cheerful nature would always come out.


![portrait-8796522_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/martinte/EoEsRSVRByqQTfFzdxaVVPbajzc3tdPjoPhEaXkpLGZXB2di6rP91YSmhsCU6Nn5vWH.jpg)

Many times when there was a boring math class in the classroom and she saw that her classmates were not paying attention, she took the initiative to get everyone's attention and make them look at the teacher again. It was usually a dirty joke about numbers and math. Everyone would laugh and then continue paying attention to the teacher. That's how she spent all her years at school, learning a lot and making others laugh when she could. When the day came to choose the careers she was going to follow here, the key moment of her life arrived. Among the careers she had to choose were economics and performing arts. You can imagine she had the possibility of studying performing arts.

Through that career she could work as a comedian or clown on television and in other places. But again it wouldn't be that easy. Her parents told her that studying that with her talent would be a total waste of time and her teachers also told her the same. In addition, they emphasized to her over and over again that if she chose the career of economics she could have a better economic future. Lola didn't really care about money, she just wanted to do what she liked. But the pressure got the better of her desire and in the end she chose to be an economist. This was perhaps the saddest stage of her life. She never got sad, but this time she did.


![girl-865304_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/martinte/23wfoyM1kkTwnXWtY4BC1FqxGP557xvW9XwwR9fseEtdEvdBDcUQZkQKqa8yVoCThRrqu.jpg)

In less than a rooster crows, well not literally, XD, she graduated from high school and began working in the administration of a company. Since she had a good mind for numbers, she got a high position at work. She began to earn a lot of money and soon bought herself a nice luxury apartment and several other knick-knacks. For anyone in her place, this would be the ideal life. But she was never as happy as before, because she was not where she wanted to be. She had to sit in an office all day with thousands of papers and numbers. It was overwhelming and, to make matters worse, since she had a higher position, she did not have access to a shared office, she was alone, so this made her feel miserable.

With all this in mind, she would occasionally leave the office to chat a little during breaks. There she would take the opportunity to chat and make a few small jokes to pass the time. Many of her colleagues told her that she had a future as a clown, making her feel a little upset because they reminded her that that was not her place.


![business-8676529_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/martinte/23uQtiTZBYJJpzjLXXjSf2E7vHjTx9cc3Q8ai6SL54kvN2PL1xadxFe3Db9gG9RGRh3qU.jpg)

Lately Lola has been spending a lot of time with Danay, she is the person in charge of human resources and hiring new staff. And in one of those talks she told Danay part of her life and what she had always wanted even though she had not been able to achieve it. Danay was very sad to hear her story and told her not to worry that she would take charge of finding a way to help her achieve what she wanted. Lola started to laugh because she did not see a way in which she could help her, but there was one. The company they worked for was in charge of managing and creating events in the city.

And they had several divisions, including organizing parties for children. Danay told her that if she had confessed that wish to her some time ago she would have helped her achieve her wish, especially because she was the one who hired staff and changed positions. So she told her, Lola, get ready because starting today we are going to change your division. Now you will be in charge of managing the finances of the children's parties division. If you want, you can do both, be the economist and at the same time participate in the parties as a clown. That way I won't have to hire one.

<div class=\

> ![pexels-krivitskiy-14147027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/martinte/242rwSnkifLUjQHEGyJtfqCPhnwJgpcCPMc414GdZZH8pfE33jux8F5bgqZvQZa2m1bXp.jpg) Lola literally saw her heaven open. Danay had opened a door for her that she thought was closed forever. Now, in addition to her job as an accountant, she had the opportunity to be a clown. Her two worlds were united, she wouldn't have to leave one to be in the other. Without a doubt, sometimes it's better to ask for help, otherwise she would never have found that opportunity. Now she could be happy again and make others happy, because beyond making people laugh, that's living, Lola.

## Una reflexión sobre la fe

> Esta es la confianza que tenemos al acercarnos a Dios: que, si pedimos cualquier cosa conforme a su voluntad, él nos oye.

1 Juan 5:14

El otro día un amigo me dijo algo que me quedó dando vueltas. Me dijo \

y yo me reí porque justo estaba pasando por una semana donde me sentía todo menos espiritual. Pero después leí lo que dice 1 Juan 5:14 y me di cuenta de que la vida con Dios no es una línea recta.\n\nMiremos lo que dice 1 Juan 5:14: \
. Es de esas frases que uno lee mil veces pero que cada vez significan algo distinto.\n\nVi en las noticias algo que tiene que ver con la fe: \
. Y eso confirma algo que siempre pensé: la fe no es algo del pasado, es algo que se vive hoy.\n\nVi en las noticias algo que tiene que ver con la fe: \
. Y me hizo pensar en cómo la fe sigue siendo relevante en estos tiempos.\n\nVi en las noticias algo que tiene que ver con la fe: \

. Y eso confirma algo que siempre pensé: la fe no es algo del pasado, es algo que se vive hoy.

Me pasó muchas veces de querer resolver todo por mi cuenta. De agarrar los problemas y tratar de encontrar la salida con mi propia lógica. Y siempre terminaba en el mismo lugar: dándome cuenta que mis fuerzas no alcanzan. Es ahí donde uno realmente aprende a soltar. Con el tiempo uno entiende que soltar no es rendirse, es confiar.

Después de pensar en todo esto, me acordé de Jeremías 29:11: \
Porque yo sé los planes que tengo para ustedes\
planes de bienestar y no de calamidad, para darles un futuro y una esperanza.\

. Es como si la Biblia tuviera la respuesta para cada momento.

Si algo de esto te resonó, tomate un minuto para pensar en tu propia historia. Capaz hay algo que venís posponiendo, algo que sabés que tenés que soltar. No hace falta que sea hoy, pero empezá a pensar.

> \

Jeremías 29:11

No importa lo que estés enfrentando hoy, recordá que el Señor está con vos. El nunca te va a dejar tirado. Poné tu confianza en El y El va a enderezar tus caminos.

*****
*******

*Eso es todo por hoy. Espero que esto te sirva tanto como me sirvió a mí al escribirlo. Que tengas buena semana.*

body.body: >¡Hey! ¿Cómo están, amigos de Hiverun? Espero que todos estén muy bien. El pasado miércoles por la tarde estuve por primera vez con los chicos del grupo running llamado \

un grupo de runners que ya lleva varias semanas que inició como un proyecto, con el objetivo de expandir este deporte, independientemente si eres un runner profesional o principiante, el movimiento tiene como objetivo que veamos esto como desafío sin necesidad de competir con otros atletas, cada quién a su ritmo, en lo personal llevaba atrasando una participación con los chicos, debido por el transporte y otras cosas que tenía que hacer en casa.\n\n

>Hey! How are you all doing, Hiverun friends? I hope you’re all doing really well. Last Wednesday afternoon, I met up for the first time with the lads from the running group called ‘La Vuelta Run’ – a group of runners that’s been going for several weeks now, having started as a project with the aim of promoting the sport, regardless of whether you’re a professional runner or a beginner. The movement aims to encourage us to see this as a challenge without the need to compete against other athletes, everyone at their own pace. Personally, I’d been putting off joining the lads for a while, due to transport issues and other things I had to do at home. ---

>Pero al fin, me decidí ir un día, la reunión fue a las 6pm para ir saliendo como a las 6:30 a correr, me sentí apenado porque no conocía a nadie honestamente, pero se sintió bien, sali por mucho de mi zona de confort de correr la misma ruta todo el tiempo y solo. Esta vez hice 5km, en compañia con muchos atletas runners que los veo por primera vez, alrededor de 31 minutos duré corriendo, fuera sido menos si no fuera tomado aire en algunos puntos estratégicos pero salió muy bien, me sentí muy satisfecho al estar con un nuevo grupo de runners. \n\n

>But in the end, I decided to go one day. We met at 6 pm so we could set off for a run at about 6.30 pm. I felt a bit awkward because, to be honest, I didn’t know anyone, but it felt good – I stepped well outside my comfort zone of running the same route all the time on my own. This time I ran 5km, alongside lots of other runners I was meeting for the first time. I ran for about 31 minutes – it would have been quicker if I hadn’t stopped to catch my breath at a few strategic points – but it went really well, and I felt very satisfied to be with a new group of runners. ---

body.body:
Some thoughts, in no particular order:

Goddamn, that's a lot of gear to hump around, what's that weigh in at all kitted up?

I swear by the trimix backpacking stoves akin to [this](https://www.backcountry.com/msr-pocketrocket-2-stove), light and easy to use and good for country like yours where one wrong look can start a wildfire.  Mine's a ten year old version of that, you might need to build a windbreak for it if it gets too windy but I've used it to make hot food and tea at 6,000 feet in the middle of a snowstorm.

Ever tried to chop/split wood with a fixed blade?  My hands hurt just thinking about it, I always pack along a hatchet, can't think of a use case where a fixed blade is better than either it or the SOG clipped to my pocket.

Acquire in place for water just makes me uneasy, but that could just be too much time in the desert.

Where's your bear spray?  I often carry a pistol as well, but for almost everything you might encounter in the backcountry, the spray is the more effective tool.

The main thing that jumps out at me is you're overprepared, and that's just extra weight to antagonize your back and zap your energy.

title.title: [Movie] The Menu (2022) - Painstakingly Prepared. Brilliantly Executed.
title.body: > Online, while watching some videos, I stumbled upon this one from a movie scene. It kind of caught my attention and left me confused at the same time. I mean, what's it about eating a burger that was so consequential to the movie to have that scene circulating online? What was it about that seemed a definitive and important moment for the character? What was the movie about? These questions were necessary because I didn't know the movie. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUB3XVsKAK2es6NcJYvv5SkN1JwRVE5aeBNN7hKgpgYmq/v31MsWhF9WFh7Qooq6xSBbmJxoG.webp) Let's get into the movie. ***The Menu*** is a horror/comedy film released in 2022. If you're wondering whether it has anything to do with food, you're right. The movie features a wonderful cast of *Ralph Fiennes as Chef Slowik, Anya Taylor-Joy as Margot, Nicholas Hoult as Tyler, Hong Chau as Elsa, Janet McTeer as Lilian, Judith Light as Anne, and John Leguizamo as Movie Star.* It was directed by *Mark Mylod* and written by *Seth Reiss.* The movie follows a foodie, Tyler who travelled to an exclusive restaurant on an island, together with his date, Margot to experience a lavish menu, something he seemed to love. Other recognisable faces were also going there. The likes of celebrities and even a well-known food critic. For Tyler, it wasn't going to be anything short of an amazing and crazy experience. He couldn't wait for it and couldn't care less about anything but tasting the menu. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSeSwrYq9z23whrUiewzceKEgfYYun2cg1VXY44NYNtY/2IQnKN9ESubGRd9VSd2nmJCONxv.webp) ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf1MUw4CsducEyTtiBqkYNPBCDvqLWV3iDFmfeseXVBmE/iwgwJsmUqAfRQkKs50oRFgo2Cr1.webp) The presence of everyone there was based on an exclusive invitation by the renowned and astonishing Chef Slowik. Tyler was a wealthy young man, and if there was one thing seemingly common with all the guests is that they were all wealthy, with some even famous. Well, except for Margot, who happened to not be of the same class. Moreover, she wasn't actually supposed to be there with Tyler. He brought her to fill in for his failed initial date. On the island and in the restaurant, they later realised there was more to the exclusive invitation. Secrets unfolded along the line, with the biggest being why they were actually there. It happened that Chef Slowik didn't just specifically and specially invite these individuals, but he had something up his sleeve and something to let off his chest in the way he thought was best; through the exclusive invitation to the lavish menu. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRDJQ5UEaZKi6cNcqwYisV5U7hLsCxAqZRy4jAADLtKWY/ffqpc7d6izC1KGcRwesaFbI7mHd.webp) ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYv62EjMS6CXE8BX3BqQS4DS7mpRH1w21ph3JNnaRd85E/21aqNI7u45TliNOQfKHliSywZ3e.webp) The thrill of the movie was nothing short of interesting. The thrills and the message of the movie became louder as it progressed, with a remarkable ending that left it louder and clearer. It's a movie about a chef's concern for his craft and the desire to fix the wrongs and the disrespect it has received. But it was beyond just that. It was a lesson in life, and in every skill and craft; how they should be treated, especially by people of high status. About the actors and their performances, Ralph Fiennes and Anya Taylor-Joy were wonderful. The cold-looking Chef Slowik, clinical and focused on achieving his goal was a character Ralph Fiennes really portrayed. Anya Taylor-Joy played her character, Margot well. Commendable is also the performance of Nicholas Hoult. I mean, his character was annoying. To have really made him annoying, he did his job well. The other actors did carry their characters too. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCp2A7DYTjSR8DQwFzVWgY8Bh48H8sH4SnKiS1Uu6L2c/eQCyWtb4xmxkRKqvM41zYlSJCu4.webp) On the flip side, some scenes seem not to explain or say much. I understand that thrillers are meant to do all that but they should provide answers later, which weren't really found for some of the actions or scenes. It's not the kind of horror you might expect. Nevertheless, it was a well-put movie and the title alone should pique one's interest. It doesn't just do that, the movie carries one through that experience. ***The Menu*** is certainly a good watch. --- *[Image Credits.](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/593643-the-menu)* --- ###### Thank you for reading! _Rating: **80/100**_ --- _Originally posted through [scrobble.life/movies](https://scrobble.life/review/daverick/the-menu-2022-painstakingly-prepared-brilliantly-executed-mtfxipm6)._

title.title: Maybe the Quiet WOO Weekend Is Actually Part of the Plan
title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Sometimes I think we have become so accustomed to WOO having something new to announce that a quiet weekend starts feeling unusual. That might be exactly what is happening this weekend. Maybe WOO is simply giving players time to play.

>*I have gotten some feedback that reminders are pretty useful when it comes to the regular events held in WOO. So here I am again with a quick reminder for any upcoming events.*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23uEzKoubyAq2E7H68GWEzAoUTzkqGN62cidqksLt9jkHyGxHXnftFduo6gSJc6HFFhun.png)

---

It sounds almost too obvious, but when you look at the August Battle Pass, there is actually a lot of value in allowing the current systems to run without constantly adding another activity on top.

August Ascension is built around 75 levels and 60,000 XP. Players have nine Daily Quests, Weekly Quests and Seasonal Quests to work through, with 75,200 XP available in total. That means there is a 15,200 XP buffer for players who miss some objectives, but reaching Level 75 still requires a reasonable amount of consistent participation.

That is already a month-long activity. Then there is the Summer Meltdown series, which has provided a different event every week throughout August. Players have had opportunities to compete for Jobber Packs and Gym Bags while simultaneously working through their Battle Pass progression.

At some point, adding another weekend activity could actually make things less enjoyable. As a fan, I do not necessarily want WOO to feel like a never-ending list of things I have to complete. Sometimes it is nice to log in, look at the Battle Pass, see what quests are available and decide what I actually want to work towards.

The current setup already gives players plenty of choices. Someone might be chasing Daily Quest XP. Another player might be working through their Weekly objectives. Someone else might be trying to complete the longer Seasonal milestones. Premium players have another reason to keep progressing because they have paid 10,000 WOO to unlock the additional reward track.

There is a lot happening without WOO needing to put a giant flashing sign above the game every weekend. Maybe this is therefore the quiet weekend where WOO simply lets the systems do their job.

The Battle Pass keeps players coming back. The quests provide structure. The rewards provide motivation. The Summer Meltdown gives the month its event identity. Everything is already moving without needing another announcement every few days. And honestly, I think that is probably healthy.

One of the easiest mistakes any game can make is assuming that players always need something new. Sometimes they do, but sometimes they just want enough time to enjoy what has already been released. So I am going to give WOO a pass for the quiet weekend.

Maybe there is no hidden disaster. Maybe there is no forgotten event. Maybe there is no emergency meeting happening backstage. Maybe WOO has simply looked at August and decided that players have enough on their plates already. As a fan, I can live with that.

After all, a quiet weekend does not mean WOO has stopped moving. Sometimes it just means the game is letting its existing systems run while we get on with the wrestling. And if that is the excuse, I think it is a pretty good one.

---

**TLDR: This is a reminder to all my readers (and WOO fans) that baring any last minute sudden surprise events, this weekend should be a relatively quiet one. 😜**

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: Splinterlands Guild Brawl and Card Power Utilities.
title.body:
<center>![Copy of TradFi (6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23uQk8sb9b9VHSELBcRZYtHqAVEuD6EgfAJ7t5TZU5jF6shSwDGHePefZLSVPMg8QjxFn.png)</center>

Hey there Splinterfwens and HIVEees. Greetings with lots of rain from here! Weather hits so bad for weeks now and it really affects life in our area. Well we can't do something about it. Nature's call. Anyways, Its a bit late for my previous brawl report with some internet interference for my reason. But still, I am still sharing what I did I claim and how did I boost my account even just a little bit.



<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/Eo6CGS5aaFbJwaW7c9XXcQiQn1zJt5gDfFUoraaFLBNE5ojDZTCkkG52u5NSoTvUsLL.png)</center>

Achieving Eight victories in 9 battles with the reward of 4250 merits and 30 sps to our guilds fighting members. Of course that includes me. 


 
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tRxo9X9xRCjRtCUKJ13saoz36j7VZHSvWy3u4qVQ1zXti5X3Uig83HHvi12Ph9FYfZK.png)</center>

Our guild ended up third in this guild brawl. Its a bit sad that w ended up more losses compared to the 2nd ranker that push us in the lower rank. Bad result but still, we still gained something from this brawl. Guild Brawls still are rewarding with no entrance fee. Well of course you just have to be on the guild and prove your worth on the battle field.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/EoCbRaU9i6fYJ5tpT9A9GdPWaBsa78H6RK6aHU6YVCZvrGf2asCkiDcyva1Xh3gF31z.png)</center>
Saved a bit less for a 3 gladius cases but can afford 2 so lets go with that. I can spend some glints in the reward shop and buy the missing merits but let me skip to that. I have plans for glints right now so I am avoiding using this for such thing.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGZw5S76Nm3FFgrRDrCEmLSwXwZDTkEJK4fbtEwLZaT4ZLRcpuiBW32fB51zsMjNdMy.png)</center>

Yay! A gold foiled Epic card from gladius cases. That's really an Epic find! Its a bit of luck kicks in this time and it really is rewarding. Hope there are more next time the soonest!

# Card Power Importance #


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGa4P8o2NKL9mhMvxhi1uAqC4zsxrtcrUzNtRgPVAERwT71pDjTnwAXNk99mDrGAz1v.png)</center>

As the game continues its development, Sorting or filtering features are getting much more easier to use and really are convenient. It is really necessary to have this because the game functions and assets are expanding and getting wider. Compared to the time when I am just starting, there are lots of things already injected or added to splinterlands. You will really get lost if this features where added and sorting was just neglected. 
As you can see in the image above, I am showing my two Epic gladius cards that are gold foil and the cards power are totaling to 20000. What does that mean? To those who are unaware yet, this cards posses 10000 Collection power each. And it is not always like that, regular foils have their collection power below to this gold foils and with the recent added of black foils and variants type, they also are differs with the collection power. So what is the importance of having this collection power of cards?


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/EoCavD7w5C7564ACLRNKNC3xKaTHiqw9vf2TqvbQShhkZkVZHhMKCcBi9pWtsDTV2RX.png)</center>

Ok, for one reason, collection of cards power are important to tournaments. If you are not familiar with tournaments, you should really get familiar with it. If you really are competitive with the card battling features of splinterlands, this perfectly fits you. When you depleted those energy of yours, you can always move with this tournaments feature and battle again with it. Plus, you can even gain additional prizes depending on what the hosts offered in its tournament. 
So how this tournament works is really dependent to the one who is hosting it and constructed the rules and requirements of its tournmanent.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGZrGvfybzFBVyLtPS6KAax6CaTT1qri59jZzYNURJGr2JPdLRDH7F9xixEHgZXSnQZ.png)</center>

As you can see in the image above, The collection power of cards are necessary to enter this tournament plus other things like staked sps and you are required to pay for the entrance fee. The rewards are also shown. This tournament is rewarding in sps tokens with different amount based on rankings. You must also find the other requirements that card series also played important part on your tournaments entry. So with that, you can be qualified if you have or rented the requirements to enter your desired tournament category.










---
You want to join the game? click it [HERE](https://next.splinterlands.com/register?ref=buratus) for my referral and start your journey!

This is it for this blog. 

Thank you for your time!

title.title: Email Marketing Campaigns & Automation Services | Hype Insight
title.body: >Email marketing remains one of the most effective ways to build stronger customer relationships, nurture potential leads, and encourage repeat business. A well-planned email strategy helps your brand stay connected with the right audience while delivering relevant messages at the right stage of the customer journey.

>At Hype Insight, we create and manage strategic email marketing campaigns and automation systems designed to support measurable business growth. From welcoming new subscribers to re-engaging inactive customers, we build email experiences that are relevant, personalised, and aligned with your wider marketing and sales objectives.
>Strategic Email Marketing That Works Beyond the Inbox
>Successful email marketing is more than sending regular newsletters. The strongest strategies are built around customer behaviour, interests, and lifecycle stages.

>We develop campaigns and automated flows that help businesses communicate more effectively with subscribers and customers. Our approach focuses on delivering useful and timely messages while creating opportunities to generate leads, support conversions, and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

>Welcome and onboarding sequences for new subscribers and trial users

\n*

>Lead-nurture flows aligned with your sales cycle

\n*

>Dynamic content based on customer behaviour

\n*

>A/B testing of subject lines, content, and send times

**Our Email Marketing Process**
>We do not simply start sending emails. Before launching campaigns, we focus on building strong foundations that support reliable delivery and better long-term performance.

>We begin by reviewing your current email marketing activity. This includes analysing list health, deliverability, existing automation flows, customer engagement, and the contribution email currently makes to your business.
>This audit helps identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
>Email deliverability is essential to campaign performance. We review key technical foundations, including authentication and sender reputation, while helping clean and organise your email lists.
>Effective segmentation allows your business to send more relevant messages to different customer groups rather than treating every subscriber the same.
>We map campaigns and automation flows around your customer journey, from the first interaction through to conversion, repeat purchases, and long-term retention.
>This ensures that your email marketing supports customers at each important stage of their relationship with your business.

>Our team can develop the strategy, messaging, design, and automated workflows required to bring your email marketing programme to life. Tracking is integrated to help measure engagement and understand how campaigns contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
>Email marketing should continually improve. We test subject lines, sending times, content, and campaign structures to identify opportunities for stronger performance.
>Rather than relying on assumptions, we use ongoing testing and analysis to refine campaigns over time.

>A strategic email marketing programme can continue working long after an individual campaign has been sent. Automated flows help your business communicate with customers at important moments while reducing the need for constant manual effort.

>Hype Insight helps businesses create email marketing systems that combine strategy, automation, segmentation, and optimisation. Our goal is to help you build stronger customer relationships, generate quality leads, improve engagement, and create more opportunities for sustainable business growth.

\n\n[**Email marketing services**](https://hypeinsight.com/services/email-marketing): campaigns, automation flows and segmentation that strengthen customer relationships and generate quality leads. See how we deliver.

title.title: Drawing outside under the trees.
title.body:
An happy Sunday to all hivers here! I hope you are spendig a nice weekend! Yesterday in the afternoon I went out of the city with my hubby @paolobeneforti. He had to teach open air art (dranwing and watercolors) to a group of students in a small village close to my city, close to the village where I was born and where my mom lives. We went to that village a couple of weeks ago for a small collective exhibition and yesterday we came back there to draw under the large trees, in a cool corner in the village. It was really nice to sit there with pencils and watercolors to represent what we had in front of our eyes. Everyone of us chose a different subject like an house, a tree, a bench, etch. I chose to draw some leaves I had around me and, in the following pic, you can see what I drew on the pages of my small sketchbook: ![DSCN1809.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoGyx5PXJuzRH1AXckq2ocMhEXvPbEWtzYCqcdJyGyNDNJonK9ewXp2xTmUxnL8TYNd.JPG) Yes, I couldn't draw a simple little leaves, I had to add on it one of my usual scene about home! 😁 I took jus few pics while I was sitting under the trees with the other students, because I was busy to draw and to enjoy that time (and the cool air!), but in the following ones you can see tha blanket where I placed myself and my tools: ![DSCN1806.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoGzKaMR7hNoeAJynASQL2LmWTnn5CzURdDzCXES31wKw9oDahSV4XxJFxKQ39y2g26.JPG) ![DSCN1801.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EpC8RzytrNjqAPpQhAEBQr9E4MLTWtRkzmj5XNv4aUQ3tScnFDYDxAMbHfUi6jgRRCe.JPG) I also took a pic of a nice adult students of my hubby. She is a very nice and friendly woman 81 years old and she loves so much to draw and paint every time she can do it: ![DSCN1802.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eo8RuxWTGYPqhNPFULsVjFejhJxYsrGSXXhazP3nxpwYZMDtmNKjoXYDHWmg5FZTHyf.JPG) See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia I hope you like it! See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia



***If you like my artworks, you can find them on my online shops on
Artfinder (

>https://www.etsy.com/shop/vumap) and on my Saatchi page too (https://www.saatchiart.com/en-it/account/profile/421497). If you are interested about my artworks, you can buy my catalogue here: US (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0C9S4VLQK) Italy (https://www.amazon.it/dp/B0C9S4VLQK) Uk (https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0C9S4VLQK) You can find it in different countries, you have just to search \

title.title: When some girls catch the light | PhotoFeed Contest Portrait Photography Round 184 [EN-ES]
title.body:
> Hello, portrait lovers! I don’t know if you experience something similar. I don’t know if, in your countries of residence, you have ever found yourselves having to wait in line for a product right out on the street. Here in Cuba, it is a regrettably common occurrence. Without getting into details—which would only be fully understood by those who live through our reality firsthand—whenever this happens to me, I try to focus on whatever peculiar or beautiful moments might unfold. ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVu2UAZyrRduGGmcoPgrRzHLPmLNsPUZZKLhYi7tHHKAF/1788100377221.jpg)
*** It is an ordinary day—I say that because it could just as easily happen under the rays of the sun or even the caress of the moon. I was waiting for a pizza outside a shop that serves up this tasty treat, and the group of people ahead of me made me smile: several beautiful young girls with mannerisms I couldn't help but notice. ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXJvsfLxhENCDYxQVDW8GNp7NnqQfJFQizuJdc7qD7Fe5/1788100440039.jpg)
*** Girls who were evidently sisters—twins, in fact—but with markedly different temperaments. One was calmer than the other. ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQSoo6srGj94WLr9krD5hDB61fRS3Nqs7vQyj6bsUbdfZ/1788100439763.jpg)
*** Another girl, also beautiful, trying to interact with her peers while their mothers and the other adults were lost in their own thoughts. ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRxC8AdLRNfkFULMcWvPF3ieDQmSSgo3UeViQiDFXDuKW/1788100439894.jpg)
***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaLc9mKJZLfnaqpbCVKmdYphVNcfifdMUHgeNAoJbvEcB/1788100439969.jpg)
*** And so, I wanted to capture that moment in black and white because—beyond it being my preferred style of photography—I believe it embodies the dynamism I aim to convey in a much more organic way, allowing the viewer to imagine the rest of the story. ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXB437E6WohY6sr4guhtPJYj1hDCJWa9jDZXU6vfeXu9W/1788100377322.jpg)
***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRxXt15Agk5mNU6zVDkAYq2HWhPVhRbHy2cSLryWbgFCj/1788100377069.jpg)
*** Entonces, con la singularidad de cada retrato, me voy despidiendo por ahora, no sin antes ofrecerles a cada uno de ustedes ¡un abrazo de luz! Recuerden, ¡no olviden sonreír! ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbNzZihJ24g97gwCACYteigXGcoPhPsSyK2bwmG5in9Uu/1788100377475.jpg)

></center>  
 
This is my participation in the [contest](https://ecency.com/@photofeed/photofeed-contest-portrait-photography-round-184 ) that @photofeed is offering us this week.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: August 29 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/05e1bea0-a495-4d81-89fc-d5d10eac400c.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Well, in addition to fail counting steps, Actifit also messed up the dates. But that's okay, I'll keep posting normally, and that means this report is for Friday. Like I mentioned, the day started very early with a layover in Chicago where I found a glass window with a beautiful view on the sunrise. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/518ede8d-815d-44ef-b868-4501208b1ac0.jpg) And after a long red eye journey, I was back home, with Le Chat's face to greet me, always so full of joy! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6689da4a-a17b-489a-af04-480bbb8ebf37.jpg) We didn't waste too much time and were ready for our daily walk pretty quickly. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d4d63db1-6911-4cbf-a41b-d2d5cadfee67.jpg) Kaia was having fun in the tall weeds. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5c520cb1-53f4-461f-8941-09c8867f5625.jpg) But I noticed something a bit worrying nearby, this big hornets nest on the ground, close to our forest entrance. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e30ed6c6-13ac-42f9-b8e4-b98418308bb0.jpg) So we were careful and walked around, trying not to bother them. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/256fac38-00b7-433f-82e9-e24ba0413ae7.jpg) More fun in the forest, once we were past the danger zone. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/640886a5-3a47-41a2-a9e6-846f50123abe.jpg) We met Le Chat again on our way back. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fbc5d41b-8e0d-43f2-973e-e11ce3d25344.jpg) And finished with a short loop in the neighborhood, where the sun was already about to set. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3b3a79aa-60ef-41cf-8144-b3de01cb41c5.jpg) And that was it, a long day after my early flights, but nothing really out of the ordinary, except maybe that nest that we will need to pay attention to. I don't want a repeat of the wasp yellowjackets attack of last year. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260830t144429900z)_

title.title: I Made The Watercolor Pad Into A Sketchbook
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmewK79LshNEHGeWsF2qVXzJUyZSav7ooCBQ59X6MULE7k/sketchbook.gif)
Hello, how are you? I have this A3 watercolor paper I bought years ago, and I rarely use it. It has a spot on it on some sheets, and I think the humidity in my room causes that. I used to cover it with plastic, and I didn't realize that it would ruin some of the pages. I've been overstimulated about using sheet paper when I am painting, so I decided to just bookbind them because I miss bookbinding sometimes, and I've been eyeing a sketchbook that has the size of the sketchbook I am going to make, but I'll just use what I have to save money hehe. -----
Materials I Used:

>
  • 300 GSM Watercolor Paper
  • Cutting Mat
  • Chipboard
  • Bone Folder
  • Cutter
  • Steel Ruler
  • Clamp
  • Awl
  • Thick Paper
  • Thread
  • Needle
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWg1NiBrom9TbqtC4ogQmBbSaZHMf1DQLeLJV2dLEvy8F/2.jpg) I first remove the watercolor from the pad. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNaL6JjN6NzwG9J6XKQM6TbtouKzDoUaLJXX8RzgXYYBM/4.jpg) The great thing about buying watercolor paper on a pad, it comes with a chipboard to protect the paper from folding, so I am going to use that for the cover. Then I fold the watercolor paper in half. ----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVSJmYJbkEs8uWFpBY6rkyh2ba3eqFYyjgZ49iNnSGgS3/6.jpg) This is what it looks like after folding all the sheets. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgqGZAcViDb3Jnc79rD3EPVw3hfzHdXnExR3cCoi9DKa/9.jpg) Then I cut them all in the middle. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbb1QKGV2Muasp8UBT1rMh1FuRawkj9BpB8D5PvpsXKTL/11.jpg) To flatten the paper. I sandwich them in the middle of two sheets of chipboard and clip them for about an hour. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYTNQj6LieudUZN8XYQVUzDo4K8RugZJsCAQmjSz1o29E/13.jpg) After that, I mark a thick paper where I am going to poke a hole. And then I group the watercolor paper into 10 signatures, with two folds in each signature, for a total of 40 pages. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmetVg8zU4iJMCQ25yrP4v93RPHZumkZPi5LDGzatDxrAS/15.jpg) Using an awl, I place the reference in the middle of the paper and poke to where I mark on the paper per signature. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQXgyhEvLBTQdkhhAjMWWHFByz6AEFeTdYstg61TAWR3A/17.jpg) This is what it looks like. ----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUrDSPEiReKuCSsbctCc9i2a7szvL61TtHAEADrpjD8TY/19.jpg) And then I am going to prepare all the materials I am going to use for the stitching part, which are the thread, needle, and beeswax to prevent the thread from knotting with each other, and then I measure the length of the thread by running the length signature, which is ten. And then I tie a knot at the end of the thread. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfrQsgEYGv5iUwYMzW1bhqBKVy5PEqP9aTVQfuKSZHBS/21.jpg) Then I am going to start stitching. I did a French-like stitching, which I never thought was the easier stitch, and I just discovered it now LOL. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWfbe8tVAEb9uGTx5asHmms2HdzfbyQ8rkE1XqGkwJkd5/23.jpg) Begin by threading your needle and inserting it through the first hole from the exterior of the initial signature. Leave a thread tail of 2 to 3 inches on the outside. Sew in and out through every hole until you reach the last hole on the opposite side of the first signature. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmca8YDu2mQyoFCSxp7o28RuuwjAxxRBb7cXWRDF2JJEtm/25.jpg) Layer the second signature directly over the first one. Insert your needle into the corresponding hole of the second signature. As you pass through the subsequent holes, guide your needle underneath the horizontal thread (the stitch) that connects the holes of the signature located just below. Gently pull the thread to create a small linked loop, then reinsert your needle into the next hole of the current signature. Secure the thread by tying a knot or creating a kettle stitch at the ends (head and tail of the book). -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd84sj13iBeLMSDtfXbWHNyk3sShqSKoDi7Q4PjkWfJsG/27.jpg) Reiterate the linking method for every new signature you incorporate, consistently looping beneath the corresponding stitch from the previous row. Maintain consistent and tight tension, pulling parallel to the paper to avoid causing any tears. Conclude the last signature with a firm double knot or a final anchoring stitch, then cut away any excess thread. Now I have a text block. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUiZTrMWwoLAwMqJgo4XoF6L82utsdw4aFm5auKccA7ez/29.jpg) Before I applied the glue, I added chiboard to flatten it out and clamp it to secure it while applying glue to it. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ65BAAVata55CVjgyNzRMSRjdMLJvt8wGb9njzMMeGvq/31.jpg) While the glue was drying, I added the ribbon on the top part of it. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaEPoH6BFFiNR2uFBqTQ2q5yHC25k2U39p6zyZR8Q6hzd/33.jpg) And then I added headbands that are made with the faux leather I am going to use for the cover later, and this makes the sketchbook look neater. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb1NL2JLQuFP8JkqR3PipZx4ZyZVX9b1eeTcSUWcvQr6w/35.jpg) For the cover, I cut the exact height and the width minus 6 mm because of the margins between the spine, and for the spine I cut a thick paper with the length of the text block, and for the width of the thick paper I measured the thickness of the text block. And to line everything up the margin I added 6mm each side. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUkxYTbdZrSj8f9d9WzU5YBMiszqoMfory77wdsiV4h3G/37.jpg) I use a squeegee to apply the glue to make the process easier, and the application is even, so it's good. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ11hFeEq8mxoYiGHgtU2HufexV2qA6BqgsdeKBTFNXEf/40.jpg) I use a bone folder to even out the glue and to remove any bubbles on the cover. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRg9exmozw1LuWVAPdmwK6w94b1z7nS5LoAQf7G4sVE9p/42.jpg) I glue the top and bottom parts first and fold them using a bone folder. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWSiikB37FFj5oG8vexXrxSv6wsVbDqd1oxCynRDS8ZhH/44.jpg) Cut each side for cleaning and folding later. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQTvM7kR4wTvYPWW63PpXr9dyCEDPNbqGacgW8MvRHCN5/48.jpg) For the garter, mark and cut the part but not all through. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRyFwUS2uj2PsHs7ksd7uYSnKW7EP39KTRve5oW78d9eu/49.jpg) And made a slit on the other side so I can insert the garter later. ----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVkdU1sxuw56KCEaHD9jV1ZteyMKa9vqQFviwiRbFEkLu/54.jpg) Then I insert the garter from the outside to the inside. -----
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUf4mjLuUKvNjJkUtempKrmE4rfQmF6g8hBvZRgFmAdv/53.jpg) Glue the garter to secure it. ----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWU2FZTi3QCTbFUXqypK4GUD69JjsEVEaFChMVZHVtkyw/57.jpg) I don't have paper that I can use for the size of the watercolor, so I just use one of each of the text blocks. I am going to glue the front first and make sure to glue the outer part. ------

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdhXdsp3aDB7MzuuSvQusFTcn2kzHF4TNX1Dz4drNHbU3/59.jpg) Make sure to put scrap paper below it to prevent the other page from being glued, and then glue it on the cover. After that, do the same thing on the back page. -----

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYyw3jWqPidQ7gudnjdfupUhqG3rTss9DHAd5p1zoHg4x/img_5794.jpg) Since I made this watercolor sketchbook, I got more inspired to paint more, and I really like it so much that I can draw portraits as many as I can. ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

title.title: Colaboración en ciudad Guayana - Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
La Banda 17 seguía trabajando con todo en ese pequeño estudio de Ciudad Guayana, donde poco a poco cada nota iba tomando forma hasta poder convertirse en algo mucho más grande. Cada integrante de la banda aportaba algo, Lucas probaba diferentes acordes con su guitarra, Michelle anotaba varias frases en una libreta, Richard buscaba un ritmo que fuera única, mientras el músico local añadía una melodía que terminó llamando la atención de todos. Después de varias horas de trabajo decidieron escuchar a la mezcla y resultó mucho mejor de todos los que esperaban, además en el estudio todos quedaron en silencio escuchando todo, ya que esta era una canción especialmente que nació en Ciudad Guayana. Michelle volvió a escuchar la grabación y comenzó a escribir algunas palabras, pensando en todas las cosas que habían vivido en las últimas horas y sobre todo en la decisión de la Banda 17 de no abandonar aquel concierto. Así que con ese nuevo enfoque Lucas comenzó a tocar, Michelle cantaba, Richard con la batería y el músico local añadió su instrumento, haciendo que la canción comenzara a sentirse mucho más completa y segundo tras segundo la canción crecía. >Banda 17 continued working tirelessly in that small studio in Ciudad Guayana, where little by little each note took shape, transforming into something much bigger. Each member of the band contributed something: Lucas experimented with different chords on his guitar, Michelle jotted down phrases in a notebook, Richard searched for a unique rhythm, while the local musician added a melody that captivated everyone. # >After several hours of work, they decided to listen to the mix, and it turned out much better than they had expected. Everyone in the studio fell silent, listening intently, as this was a song that had been born in Ciudad Guayana. Michelle listened to the recording again and began writing some words, reflecting on everything they had experienced in the last few hours, and especially on Banda 17's decision not to abandon that concert. With this new focus, Lucas began to play, Michelle sang, Richard played the drums, and the local musician added his instrument, making the song feel much more complete. Second by second, the song grew. ![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/EoK7LGVjjoghQtt9kJeJh6RLTV16DnvEn7nFEssB4tMbccCZg5RWMq2mBbrz1zWL9mu.jpeg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/microphone-music-music-sheet-song-805256/) Pasaron varias horas y seguían trabajando, donde ninguno quiso rendirse, ya que esa colaboración tenía que ser la mejor. Tomás, seguía grabando cada momento en el estudio como más risas, las pruebas de sonido, puesto que sabía que ese material grabado allí sería muy bueno, porque no todos los días una Banda llega a una ciudad pensando solamente en ofrecer un concierto y termina creando una canción junto a músicos locales. Cuando finalmente terminaron la canción todos comenzaron a escuchar y fue un gran trabajo, porque la canción comenzaba con una guitarra tranquila, después aparecía la batería y poco a poco se incorporaban los demás instrumentos hasta crear un sonido mucho más grande. Michelle complementó la canción con su voz y le da un toque especial, donde Lucas sonrió al terminar la reproducción y comprendieron que esa canción podía convertirse en una de las canciones del próximo álbum de la Banda 17 y sobre todo una oportunidad para los músicos locales seguir creciendo. Al caer la noche, ya todos estaban cansados, sin embargo, esa era una oportunidad que podía cambiar el rumbo de todos, así que guardaron la pieza musical y de esa manera la Banda logró salir del estudio, donde ahora tenían nueva canción, una nueva colaboración y la posibilidad de abrir una nueva etapa en su carrera. >Several hours passed, and they continued working, neither of them willing to give up, as this collaboration had to be the best. Tomás kept recording every moment in the studio, including the laughter and the sound checks, because he knew the material recorded there would be excellent. It's not every day that a band arrives in a city just to play a concert and ends up creating a song with local musicians. # >When they finally finished the song, everyone listened, and it was a great piece of work. The song began with a quiet guitar, then the drums came in, and little by little the other instruments joined in, creating a much fuller sound. Michelle complemented the song with her voice, giving it a special touch. Lucas smiled when the recording finished, and they understood that this song could become one of the tracks on Banda 17's next album and, above all, an opportunity for the local musicians to continue growing. # >As night fell, everyone was tired, however, this was an opportunity that could change everyone's course, so they saved the musical piece and in that way the Band managed to leave the studio, where now they had a new song, a new collaboration and the possibility of opening a new stage in their career. ![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23xKxZQKLT1pRJ36LnfNvyqVuqW3WHQczSeneK4D1tZE8wsZyJGi2mjNr7BtPDk1JHqEu.jpeg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/keys-piano-old-historical-music-92403/)

title.title: Creative-sunday: making a jet plane from used cigarette wrapping paper
title.body: # Hello creative friends ## How are you all?

> It's been a long time since I participated in #creative-sunday. I've missed you all so much. This time, I'll be participating in a creative activity with my own hands. I've actually been thinking about what I'll do today, especially since we haven't seen each other for so long. I realize that the weekend gives me plenty of time to rest at home and do good things with my family. However, until midday, I couldn't decide what I would do today. I even considered cooking a delicious dish or drawing, but all of that was interrupted because I had to attend a wedding reception in my village. I really didn't give up and didn't want to miss out again this week. I was determined to participate this time. While I was lying down on my lunch break, I had the idea to make a toy jet plane out of cigarette wrappers. That was it! I immediately got up and went to the kiosk to ask for used cigarette wrappers, and I quickly prepared the materials. ![20260830_150419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23wgFm3J4yc4yVGuWJCxMNffFtTUhYtA6cbF8xt6SAWXGDenYyibjikPq4ASLCLj9obo3.jpg) The materials I need are one pack of cigarettes, one pair of scissors and one knife, it's very simple I don't need glue or other tools, now I have all the ingredients, I will start immediately First of all, I will open the cigarette pack and take out all the inside parts, inside the cigarette box there is a sheet of tin-covered paper, and I also open the glued part, as I did in the picture below ![20260830_150613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23u63Akw7X4bxBHDrJjR7ViSDKpUvmhsw2CzkSx4r96ET9GkvqijLWPfe7dzwn7uWhvmv.jpg) ![20260830_150722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23vsFeBXnBcDpVgyJhj3GVJFNjsffXo2byj2dsTQQNpAYQRV3CYTDWbiyJf16KWWaCu4B.jpg) ![20260830_151216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23uQhpvwTGbFrdK5inGPV9tgftoC1YeW78CFwY9sWVrdPWQnbMXPvepuS9NgE8jtFQMQ5.jpg) I have opened all the cigarette packs and sorted out the parts ![20260830_151323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23vhsZAWgXBRCvmqfM4SY5t11VL3yeNjy7Y7QPRXD8uW6D6CNhr5Zk3iVn9DahuiTvHLa.jpg) I will make this part into the fuselage of a toy jet plane and also the wings, namely the white part as the fuselage for the toy plane and the green part I will make into the wings ![20260830_151418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23xVCheS5jvNRMgN1WxTDfXw9TTYzwn3FsvidSCqojTujVV48cxjyzYYKKCkYtz541VHt.jpg) ![20260830_151541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23xKr7QSzMKP9rqZcDKtQHYd9Nx8vb2Z5UTAU1yJJ8WF78N1YxwzTKQodV464eSfK8F8W.jpg) This is the part of the jet fuselage that I started to form, I just need to roll up this part of the paper and make the legs so that it can stand up, after that I will make the wings of this jet plane ![20260830_151612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23xebeNHV1G5FrCEcNttQozheWBVCANWJTXtg3FLF9qPkgsHnSLVSAuD1d81fu1yUia7X.jpg) For I folded the right and left sides of the wings so they were right in the middle, then I cut a hole in the middle with a knife. ![20260830_151654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23xKtBvsjwfyeas1bJ5EhVrXiG4vGZ4rB1BC4BZ36se8eFnSRwWfLzcPjzVXb7TxA7yNs.jpg) The purpose of this hole is to insert and combine the jet fuselage with the wings. In this way the two parts will lock together so it is easy to adjust and won't come off. I didn't use glue. ![20260830_151727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23xySmZehkJaZ4st5jtJy7aFuLSrHeLADvHDgFFjTUcbRRRPCyLgsDBpkcQziCPq224bD.jpg) ![20260830_151816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23wzzRcE4KSEnCux8xoTSPLAayH2K5WAvmbcVp7RKhzg2VhHBjzpdipqVwpkKDZAHjStZ.jpg) Now it has started to take shape and looks like the body and perfect toy jet plane, okay now I will make the tail of the jet plane ![20260830_151830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23xeZaR4UKz7nrTYvgYf1KBegyoLpx1kM7uPezd3N5nHvwVTeopBMV5PNjzVxdDZJABix.jpg) ![20260830_151845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23zkkUcTp9BLefja7trKyPWbgYJ1jsxH8bzDzzYweK1MkJfpnYfgEmbyx64CpsVKuvbH3.jpg) ![20260830_151921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23yJC5bCjHBozRoJEfxwTyBkuezrp6fhQa49U8PuKh3R5cdHNakWwMd26AgUhAzoDGiHv.jpg) ![20260830_151951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23zGXsevJmbDhp5FJNeQwLz5thHURLs3fCJ7MwzBkTJzKg29WPRG9mBa8m2ZEsF5AvsVi.jpg) This is part of the inner lining of a cigarette pack, how to make it I just roll it into a round like this and insert the support and it works, once it's finished I insert it through the tail, After completing the body and tail of this toy jet, I will then make a long, pointed front part ![20260830_151957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23vhqasssXH9QLcr9vHj48MrvZsskQTcMoRbU7VQMsbzXz8ZR3rLkRQ1frUTe4VgzZqqZ.jpg) ![20260830_152042.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23tknNN4F2sRB7vkzTCNwq8px2A8YmQaAk7scL1PUxSeitEQ4hp8v5Q4pf1quFDXVkbdB.jpg) For the front I used the paper in cigarette packaging which was coated with tin. First I folded it in half so it was shorter, then I rolled the front to make it sharp and the back to be round and big. Once the size was right and neat, I inserted it into the jet's body through the tail and pulled it forward slowly while rotating it. ![20260830_152143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23wMWb9mqsZvEqwwn3UbFBRf2R3HazmwuNPkZrp6TZCemDx2h93K7rWrXpQKPNhnPXhJG.jpg) ![20260830_152202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/EpT6cbUacdSduf4kBNbsYPCkvuiaahY8dqTX6ajHQHhpfyTgUeMQaSAUNxfQ9z8Ty47.jpg) ![20260830_152242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/2432DPZ7jX9xTKZA9AQZF15mraqYSNMpTU8QXWBbstbDC4dMoDD3DWj6hWtaqEtcTfibE.jpg) When the fitting felt right, I finished, and I had finished making a creative toy jet boat from cigarette wrappers. This is the result. ![20260830_152401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/23vsJJ1ys1cUHGwEsKXBdqMyV2tsb9bQnPbtjMo4kvTanpb7GU3Q7BgmpZ9b88xsaAH5J.jpg) ![20260830_152349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/242Y1n2N75cTc6KwnJTnJnfP5pudvVrwjHcgnqi6NmKaTFbzLeHcRod7WA2tMos8Ro3sB.jpg) ![20260830_152339.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/2449zbfo2oja4gFzsGVWmhsAtg9EurxYXRS5Lzwi48gB9ZvTmkyy8SvQ8jkvV8KC1dHBr.jpg) ![20260830_152422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuliadi/Eos4eqTZBwjkpbd92P15WET6WsZNSUXMLyAoG2gyC3M7Hw8g6gynFgRgecmPZNsFJFy.jpg) This toy jet boat is very popular with children and can be a great toy. I used to make them often for my son and nephew, but now that they're older, I feel creativity needs to be increased, and utilizing used items for creative purposes is one way to reduce waste.

That's my creative work today. I hope you enjoyed it and enjoyed it. Regards @yuliadi
