title.title: Grain Run, Peas, Harvest, Chairs, Snake, Stormy Bike Ride With Friends, Coldstone - Saturday
title.body:
I was in town again yesterday morning for more grain, a much larger load this time. ![IMG_20260829_055832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242XycH18Yz2fmPnCnG8Z5cnHrgU5RHuqp1D68F2uHFjb5tSfdLpyv7tz6xJrPhi2jN13.jpg) 5 Barrels needed to load into the trailer. ![IMG_20260829_061944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2h81KfejM2rZ77BAgGe2yX512yQcRcok9QGAAvMdMEnZCQZwK246qNtAxfZUSC4o1z.jpg) I got another nice sunrise though. ![IMG_20260829_061948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23z79UG1LMCwa4bdbhCJkV42a9Qi5ZCGM7bxYs488idcz3UR5Yorarc5YN2Wr2Pjfi9dN.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_062247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xATGrN8f23EGSPkohGYxGeFWqcrzNiqxeRxqFqXchJ1qe3BnaHeUEaz8nn4CkpdffJo.jpg) The trailer managed to hold all the grain for the trip back north. ![IMG_20260829_063713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23yTjZL9FikYridYoWwGgA3wNvj69Ji7Es66n46ST8T3oTrMfSf8eTfFmBezEkUbhAL1Y.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_063723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/2423qh8FecfTf8dS81JwmL3743W5qAp4V7Uf83dxNs8FMHQLECovx7wmdftfqJpQSw5TV.jpg) Over a ton of grain shoveled out for the sheep and alpaca. ![IMG_20260829_071946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvkSy9sjkvGSmeKjrmscdo3GgdL1VKBCu4X8otLBwCy1i3A2ksnPfnCcNNSGNqds1wm.jpg) Around 9am I was in the garden pulling hte rest of the pea plants and removed the fence and posts. ![IMG_20260829_091503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2efnzfh8q9J2Rk2ULp1gyrYhsGooELoGSTPmbhdzxQ5KAt5NCuFjEaeUH7n3NuGXQC.jpg) Got the tomatoes and cucumbers harvested for the day. ![IMG_20260829_093449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wgHXjQDSidQ3twsFJ3dK6TpRmBJwHxr1JsnacyWPK2n5jJAZC1ZaxBSp7W5D1s7HAEC.jpg) Mid day @stryeyz and I headed up to Deer Park to pickup the first 2 of the deck chairs. ![IMG_20260829_121146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23x14sQVX5sRxnPFZPQjRZ3q3HHtsa2w4XVekNeXzfQyh8adokRvVjCwa9CuaFq8Ytgwq.jpg) The cat had caught a snake that we rescued and let go under the plastic in the greenhouse. It was a rather chill little snake and not too damaged by the cat. ![IMG_20260829_122431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/243M9f2ZUBqJrBAKUFeCM9JKvo4oKfApav3wx84QH8qyGUicxYKkf3QNNaXpcCBJ2XMJj.jpg) I got the bikes all loaded onto the carrier on the car for our ride. ![IMG_20260829_125429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWrtczc2hLbYdb79Ab9HhxBCVVZf7hbHCdcA6tDq9P1nXTc8jK3uTgbnSxy1oppsC5a.jpg) Made the 13x2 HSW panel and got it printed in hopes it would fit my headlight once it arrived. ![IMG_20260829_133227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tSNJiJvQVzowdNJxJULRfKm62hfB3NqcAKHEkkZ5oRbnSmnNPeFkFwFjVua8xNKi1Ln.jpg) Met up at Farwell elementary with our friends for the bike ride. ![IMG_20260829_141052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWs6ig3hnVuFBricWg74GCtUcBUHVgJn9o19JQpsApyqEugMHiZManuQW1CUNcPcfMD.jpg) R was rolling around and thumped his bike into a curb. A short while later the tire blew before we could even start the ride. ![IMG_20260829_141057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uQpHTFEM7cPxYnkgjrYbM3ZTuJX2w39GnZkRLWEZNFuDxNuQg6Zr8DU5SxdyTqzqY7V.jpg) Thankfully Matt had a patch kit and we got the tire good enough for the ride. ![IMG_5728.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/EpGRhRvN9d7FkteU6kZ1gJCWTLsfMQTXZwdu6pBB1N5Sz5J1Vr2zjpaiBiKhFaSBwM2.JPEG) ![IMG_5729.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/EowH4d59xV44za4oW5N9WQiEVDsx7Mfrv4NLyWgLkWfev3yaPPVKX2MvvPgZikBTfnC.JPEG) We all ended up spread out on the Children Of the Sun trail and there was some serious clouds to the south and west. ![IMG_20260829_144549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244KR3aJ3QAkrxTUpjmnu8qPhqqusUzNvK9ZwNXe9Ae2HcJWvJUTb4riBKGk8GfHo7Jgk.jpg) Holy shit was that some strong wind gusts from the storms heading our way. ![IMG_20260829_144704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23ynN9VRurx84a5RxuaYgwQLNhuPddeSNdHq3WNWFKPDGsbqDA7fLoE15F8EaA8gHhfKN.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_144810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242rrh3cWB4VueC4K7iNWM6xxJoTYRr8xJVh3aeHKC7mQgeZUkdgagctyeRcDiWMCJSvN.jpg) The wind was great for some people flying kites. ![IMG_20260829_145008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23v4ZpUQyKovZdZ2EgHFyEAVT4bvPpgNzvBgesd7ujwfDePWgb7oHGmBdq5qjKz3tnDuA.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_145915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/245cTkbcDUayfcG35ziPzf8wHmZmQ561SKDoJoNpvgu55azWqvPVhtiJaafVGC67Q2Z8A.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_145918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242ro5r8pVXdfKuW9RbrT7yuGKnrHEDXRNAcU7rmZXmVxzBks6YmtxxsoZ6dWNNcdnDf6.jpg) We stopped at the summit of the COTS trail which is where the Fairview fire started. ![IMG_20260829_150221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244oWow7gE4Q4NK1h3rsq8pKphQ8RsbdcgtsNF3rgjbMzRfZFZoNzJ2Hxnonqhbu21CRm.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_150224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23zS1BTNgtwQorUPUxPSVYEwAwaGNb9FM5oR5dhzD8rmpipCGjh9a4HBjyaiN8J2p11Nc.jpg) The storms were HEADIN RIGHT FER US! ![IMG_20260829_150451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242DFrmWfhok8rxRWtsTgbDmM23RYyPsXBGFHGG92bQynok65oj4AdNgfWFMvsTz1daP4.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_150457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/245HiwtV31XU3aki5LtwyQLq2oyvGhaT26rW2Uvh2YkKuMgjpYEr3i8ShEEXEaB4azdeV.jpg) The wall of dust from the storms preceded the rain that came right after. ![IMG_20260829_150708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242hUH9KBopVUws2WLjTBGecuvcpHUCkX4PFBV9kZgm8zmF3aqyN91UG9j1UW6B5E5rQj.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_150711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23zkkBqRHMSipYgMcDmfLq4LGQYgQH1E7UbtUCBgHUMNkXHkNQQJezYoJn3wz571gMc2k.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_150714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242NeoZqsUysaJ9aMzvdSu9mHUu7faTw4Us51AtthyHs6G25sYfqYwdy3qUvc9X8FKuQW.jpg) It started to dump pretty good and I was not too excited about riding with the slick front tire I still have on my bike. J and I got back first and I tossed the bikes on the rack while we waited for the others. OF COURSE it was not a huge group of storms and soon the sky cleared. Eventually everyone made it back and we decided to go for Cold Stone. ![IMG_20260829_152326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/243zdWNUYrNDm2mcz83qEZPD5RudDmGQZ9oEHqwRjwVRCxPfipZ3F928NmJm98iVrvKA8.jpg) ![IMG_20260829_155630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xediZVSjiPGaRFFMwQhxg4HSNe5ev25TB4GbFYi1MW1vtqK159c9ctXz9zcsgjLCL8x.jpg) R's was full on as big as his head! ![IMG_20260829_155919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23ynNRwv77FPL9fR2fTeJsZk59s97BxGNhrJhiacVc5jZRd9zqYkUXrJhK61pc27L2afY.jpg) We all ended up back at our place for dinner and @stryeyz got more painting of the new chairs done. My new bike headlight arrived and I got it charging. ![IMG_20260829_204048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wBg4ijxiYtLF4nezrUVZMCeAKCRGzn4A94KaFTXKBUvqgCVqBBhbMiRNMyAdvCnn1n7.jpg) It will be superb for early morning rides now. And with the sunlight changing duration I will be needing it more and more as we get to Fall. ![IMG_20260829_204105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23x15AEkDf84LNu59i15xVqFhcmjjU86WGrx4sLEvVeNCy612nKTSJsR9xoEjBU2aPAhr.jpg) Bit more rain overnight last night. This morning we are going to friend's across the way for breakfast and so Isaac and I can go over his water feature design and progress. I have more to do in the garden, prep tools for jobs tomorrow, and make sure the sheep waters get filled. ---

title.body:
![artistjoke.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmNcGZztkvXVtTKTSCAjMu1jw9eKLgwqvXdrjggKGFxfc7/artistjoke.jpg)

*This Old Artist Walks Into a Bar and the Bartender Says, “Yup Man, That's the Joke!”* 2026. Oil on paper, 18 x 24\

), which can’t be helped because the larger is unaffordable. The dimensions can grow over time if my financial situation improves. I will meet my painting quota today and tomorrow with gesso-primed loose canvas. Tuesday I take a day off to travel to Cooperstown to pick up disintegrating paintings I was trying to sell in a gallery (none sold, phew). They’re in frames, so I’ll hang them up in the studio to watch them wither away every day in unison with my self’s demise. 
I guess it’s just a minor setback in the entire 20 year scope of the project. I’ll just double down and push out more paintings to catch up. 
In a way, there is something timeless and romantic about a disintegrating archive. *As long as the story gets told*. I am serious about putting the notice on the box covers of the stored paintings. Like my ashes in an urn. I’ll print out thumbnail images and titles of the contents, so their memory will remain. 
God help my lazy idiocy! What a perfect nothing to hang my hat on!

body.title: Cabin Fever Takeover: Pinky and Spiky a Full-On Zoo
body.body:
![PENUP_20260830_215654~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jadung/23uR2x8XXYEjJ9a6DiYv6RvnWTYcuwCb64xnWdFeQoJANfZx22GzDBSj4jgVgHNyfs1bJ.jpg)


When the theme for Allyson’s Pinky and Spiky comics making contest dropped as rainy day cabin fever , my mind immediately went to the chaotic scenario, like what happens when the monsoon rains hits non stop literally everyone decides to crowd into Pinky and Spiky’s small cozy cabin. It turns into a total zoo, leaving the poor duo completely speechless right in the middle of it all. Wah wah wah... Something they did not anticipate 

Working on this silent comic for my entry is pretty interesting and fun, it was all about filling the canvas with shape and color until this crowded, stormy mess came to life. I didn't get tired or bored tbh. I tried to recall the other characters like Cornelius the purple bird , Betsy the yellow butterfly and look how cute Victor the spider as he sleeps. I almost forgot about Dietrich the mouse he could be represented by the brown character with a sandwich. I used to join pinky and Spiky comics making contest back when @organduo is hosting the contest. 

Anyway, I think the positions and proportions of the characters added to the zoo vibe, From snacks scattered around to everyone occupying every square inch of space, I just kept layering the forms and expressions until the story told itself without needing a single speech bubble. Pinky and Spiky standing there looking totally frozen while a whole crowd takes over their living space? That’s peak cabin fever right there. 

It’s such a fun challenge to capture a whole scene this is an actual scene I was observing on my phone when I called my siblings back in the Philippines. I checked on them earlier today had a video call when I heard they have nonstop rain and flooding. I got worried upon hearing and had peace of mind when I saw everyone safe dry and warm. Kids laughing out loud, eating, playing games , singing karaoke etc. made me happy to see them happy I missed those gatherings really. 

I was laughing too while making this comics they didn't know I included some of them on my comics. Cornelius and the big dog are actually patterned after my two nephews hahaha when I send this to them they will surely laugh too. Hope you guys made your entries too.

body.title: Three Legacy: Residences - Nursery
body.body:
# Three Legacy
First time reading about Three Legacy? Three Legacy is a hive-based economic simulator with a sustainable skill-based rewards pool. 
[Come check it out!](https://www.threelegacy.com/universe)

You can signup and start playing for only $1 in HIVE, HBD, SWAP.HIVE, or HSBIDAO.

## Residences
There are six different residence types in Three Legacy, and they all do the same thing... Residences provide worker slots. Worker slots are where aliens 'live' while they are reading blueprints, constructing buildings, or completing quests. Having multiple residence types makes it easier to scale your worker slots with your household. Autonomy keeps your household actively queuing for worker slots to become available.

### Nursery

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/three.legacy/243zrDuRAWPsFcNHjrx3Bpg3oe3GRxcKpjV5UBNmFoBVZKpbkZQiERmrZ4pSihuSiidod.png)

The nursery is linked to the 'Matriarch' and 'Grand Matriarch' blueprint tree. This is unique from the rest of the residences, which are all linked to birth circumstances.

The 'Matriarch' blueprint requires filling out all three birth slots. Even a completely inactive player will eventually rise to the top of the Sage leaderboard and have their birth slots filled in by other players. Like 'You're A Parent', every alien will eventually earn 'Matriarch'.

Of course, a player can earn this blueprint for the first time very quickly by birthing more aliens in their own household, and then it scales similarly to the planning office. At a slight delay, a player can keep their Nursery at the same level as their Planning Office.

The 'Grand Matriarch' blueprint is where this starts to get interesting. When an alien has claimed the 'Matriarch' blueprint *AND* all three of its offspring have claimed the 'Matriarch' blueprint, the player unlocks the 'Grand Matriarch' blueprint. This is a repeatable achievement, with each level unlocked by the alien and its offspring all claiming the previous level. You could think of 'Matriarch' as being tier 0 for the 'Grand Matriarch' repeatable achievement.

The Nursery will count all completed 'Matriarch' *and* 'Grand Matriarch' blueprints toward the level requirements. Since every alien can eventually earn every tier, a player can spend most of the game with their Nursery levels limited by their Planning Office levels, instead of limited by their blueprints. This can make higher tiers of 'Grand Matriarch' unattractive, because the claiming costs scale more quickly than the usefulness of the blueprint. 

There will be a whole family of 'Matriarch' achievements. The variants will depend on your 'Matriarch' meeting certain requirements (all sage births, for example) and then the higher tiers will depend on their offspring all claiming 'Grand Matriarch' (offspring do not have to be the same variant for these claims to count). This will make the higher 'Grand Matriarch' tiers more valuable again (especially since claiming could help unblock 3 or 4 different variants).

## Previous Buildings Posts

[Relationship Between Blueprints and Buildings](https://peakd.com/hive-175317/@three.legacy/three-legacy-buildings)
[Planning Office](https://peakd.com/hive-175317/@three.legacy/three-legacy-buildings-tkdtet)

### Keep Following for More
With thirteen buildings and fifteen achievements to explore, we have a whole series of posts planned out.

### Start playing now

[Come check us out!](https://www.threelegacy.com/universe)

body.title: An Afternoon Shadow on the Stairway. [EN/ES] Entry for the Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest-Round 441.
body.body:
Hello, friends of the #ShadowHunters community, thanks to our friend @melinda010100 for inviting us to this initiative in her Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest – Round 441.

> Hola, amigos de la comunidad #ShadowHunters, gracias a la amiga @melinda010100 por convocarnos a esta iniciativa en su Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest – Round 441.

### An Afternoon Shadow on the Stairway

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPnN6vjn47m9NEMmmC5osBJLmmp8Jmgr1FaMZ9hMqJnSA/1787673287228.jpg)

This is the same staircase I photographed on a previous occasion, when the morning sun projected its shadow onto the ground. This time, near sunset, the light comes from a different angle, causing the shadow to fall directly onto the wall where the permanent metal staircase is attached.

> Esta es la misma escalera que fotografié en una ocasión anterior, cuando el sol de la mañana proyectaba su sombra sobre el suelo. Esta vez, al caer la tarde, la luz llega desde un ángulo diferente y hace que la sombra se proyecte directamente sobre la pared donde está sujeta esta escalera metálica permanente.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNg29ULdeuQ6uwcvQY92hgddTF2pTgm8uDMSw7f6peXbe/1787673324549.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRh42HwFS5p5GGzhRTswnF4annCNj6basmc6ZtES9jiWa/1787673324402.jpg)

The change in light completely transforms the image. Even the shadow seems to become part of the staircase itself, creating an interesting combination of real structure and projected silhouette.

> El cambio de luz transforma completamente la imagen. Incluso parece que la sombra pasa a formar parte de la propia escalera, creando una interesante combinación entre la estructura real y su silueta proyectada.

---

The photos were taken with my mobile phone, and for the English version I used Google Translate.

> Las fotos fueron tomadas con el móvil y para la versión en inglés utilicé el traductor de Google.

---

Thank you for reading.  
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

> Gracias por leer.  
> Un agradecimiento especial a @bradleyarrow por apoyar a la comunidad.

body.title: [Music] Discovering \
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUwydSLL5yD5P1pgTphu6JN7Ym9GN6fvNbHoh6hVNKnkr/Screenshot_2026-08-30-09-47-54-771_com.dywx.larkplayer.jpg)

---
I discovered Red Hot Chili Peppers’ music as an adult, little by little.  

Venice Queen felt like two songs in one, because of the abrupt change you hear halfway through. Only after listening to it a second and third time did I realize it wasn’t two songs, but one. I’m a Spanish speaker, so I can’t fully grasp an English-language song on the first listen.  

From the very first chord, I felt a masterpiece coming my way. As the intro builds rhythm and strength, my instinct wasn’t wrong. It seems like something wild is about to break loose at any moment, but then the intensity of the drums, bass, and guitar drops a bit, and the vocalist begins serenely releasing words.  

Although this small change was surprising, I also found it pleasant and relaxing. The singer’s voice makes me think of a young man performing, yet he’s already got quite a few years behind him, and even in more recent songs he still sounds youthful.  

But let’s continue:  

Once the track shifts to a much faster and catchier rhythm, I confess I felt a little disappointed. I wished that slow pace and melancholic tone had carried through the rest of the song. Nevertheless, I’ve learned to enjoy it as I’ve listened to the song over and over again.  

It’s said that this piece is dedicated to Kiadis’s former teacher, named Gloria, which explains the spelling out of G-L-O-R-I-A during the chorus. The lyrics sum up all the affection he and his classmates felt for that woman, who apparently had a huge impact on them.  

It’s a beautiful song that has been accompanying me lately at least twice a day, and it also makes me recall my childhood moments, when I still had so much uncertainty and fear.  

It’s also worth noting the abundance of effects and strange sounds that accompany the piece, especially in the first section, making it, in my view, much more unique and special.  

My instinct wasn’t wrong with this RHCP gift. It truly is a masterpiece. 

---
**Español**

---
La música de de Red Hot Chili Peppers la he descubierto de adulto y poco a poco. 

Venice Queen me pareció dos canciones en una, por el cambio brusco que podemos escuchar al mitad de la misma. Solo después de escucharla por segunda y tercera vez es que fui capaz de ver qué no eran dos,.sino una. Soy hispanohablante, así que no soy capaz de entender una canción anglosajona a la primera.

Desde el primer acordé sentí que se venía hacia mi un temazo. A medida que la intro va cogiendo ritmo y fuerza, mi instinto no temía a equivocarse. Parece que vamos a romper con algo salvaje en cualquier momento, pero es entonces en qué cae un poco la intensidad de drums bajo y guitarra, y comienza el vocalista de manera muy serena a soltar palabras.

Si bien fue una sorpresa este pequeño cambio, también me pareció muy agradable y relajante. La voz de Kiadis, me hace pensar que es un jovencito el canta. Este man tiene unos cuantos años ya y en temas más actuales se sigue sintiendo joven.

Pero sigamos:

Una vez que el tema pasa a un ritmo mucho más rápido y pegajoso, confieso que me sentí un poco decepcionado. Deseaba que ese ritmo lento y con el tono melancólico hubiese sido parte del resto de la canción. No obstante, he aprendido a disfrutarlo a medida que he escuchado una y otra vez la canción.

Se dice que este tema es dedicado a una antigua maestra del Kiadis, que se llamaba Gloria y de ahí el deletreo de G-L-O-R-I-A durante el estribillo. La letra resumen todo el cariño que él y sus compañeros de clase sentían por aquella señora, que al parecer fue de mucho impacto para ellos.

Es una hermosa canción que me acompaña últimamente al menos 2 veces por día, y que también me pone a recordar mis momentos de niño, cuando todavía tenía tanta incertidumbre y temor. 

También es destacable la gran cantidad de efectos y sonidos raros que van acompañando la pieza sobre todo en el primer tramo, haciéndola, a mi entender mucho más única y especial. 

Mi instinto no se equivocó con este regalo de RHCP. Es un verdadero temazo

---

body.title: # [Estremoz: History, Flavours and the Legacy of Queen Saint Isabel 🏰👑🍽️ [EN/PT]]
body.body:
# [EN]

Hello PeakD and WorldMappPin community! 👋

On one of my recent visits to Estremoz, in the heart of Alentejo, I decided to explore this beautiful historic city with my camera and, above all, with time to observe the details. Estremoz is one of those places where history seems to be present everywhere: in the white marble, the old walls, the castle, the churches, the streets, the gardens and even in the flavours of its traditional cuisine.

Walking through Estremoz was like opening a history book, but one where every page could be photographed. The city has a very particular character, created by the combination of Alentejo architecture, marble and centuries of history. From the lower part of the city to the medieval castle, there were always new details catching my attention. This visit resulted in 41 photographs that I am very happy to share with you.

## 🍽️ A Taste of Alentejo

Before talking about the castle and its history, I want to start with something that is impossible to separate from a visit to Alentejo: its food. Alentejo cuisine is deeply connected with the land and with traditional ingredients such as bread, olive oil, herbs and local products. It is a simple cuisine, but full of character, where recipes passed down through generations continue to be an important part of regional identity.

The food is also another way of discovering a place. The aromas, colours and textures of a traditional Alentejo meal tell a story just as much as an old building does. During my visit, I wanted to include this side of Estremoz in my photographic journey because travelling is not only about seeing monuments. It is also about experiencing the local culture through its flavours and traditions.

## 📸 The First Photographs

I began my photographic walk through Estremoz by observing the city itself. The streets, façades, windows, doors and small architectural details immediately caught my attention. The famous white marble gives the city a distinctive appearance, while the strong Alentejo light creates shadows and contrasts that change throughout the day. Sometimes the smallest details became the most interesting subjects for my camera.

**📷 Photographs — Exploring Estremoz**

![1000059936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23zbKkfjBruyCcjsQYLB2iQN11GyuKDfPahycCKne5SYNEuFn2ofb3Z5oCwQHBJqu33wK.jpg)

![1000059938.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23zGeoDPnLCv1jkE46RzADSdnQGEwb8eUCM8Eo71J6yuv4uympjGRJhiW3f8YsL7kGDm1.jpg)

![1000059944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/242DGc52T1KVvYZkWgrhujtaBtSzeBjg6E2nnhELZ2hmGC7BMufxwDvgC9pjKNTcSkRNQ.jpg)

![1000059943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23tmL4q4Tn1UZWwi5Cn2YUCqnwRjjvVbMJcrTnUJuHevHCEN4d8vJhZ6Z4sJ6rch3DQ8e.jpg)

![1000059946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/242rsA19jnQaj1a1nkyXVF4NG1U7EYv8rgfaQU9w32UKVLE9HeHGUEBceLiYNLV83vTZ6.jpg)

![1000059947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23yJEKK7bBVCLsL9FFG4Ksh4osaSbEeuBLkc9FwtFDssTm25r3GFeYnGYBrp3yP8RgTA8.jpg)

![1000059950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/243zdeUrWPcuEk7GpmBAzBgrS9pAXN7jp6pnF9sdJNUK5JXtMgCL5QazTiu2rVvus3PgP.jpg)

These first photographs are an introduction to the city and to the atmosphere I found during the visit. I wanted to show not only the famous monuments but also the everyday details that give Estremoz its personality. Old façades, stonework, streets and views can easily go unnoticed when we are simply passing through. Photography made me slow down and look at these places from a different perspective.

## 🏰 The Castle of Estremoz

The Castle was naturally one of the main reasons I wanted to explore Estremoz. Rising above the historic centre, the castle dominates the surrounding landscape and provides an extraordinary viewpoint over the Alentejo plain. The monumental complex reminds us of the strategic importance that Estremoz had throughout Portuguese history. As I approached the castle, the walls and towers immediately created a sense of entering another period of time.

**📷 Photographs — The Castle and Medieval Walls**

![1000059953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/244UoTUUxEbkR8nR6PCYGhupArATQcZvWDwcdEbexwuAkAA5KBTMeZ2jrvSFynVvBJcVy.jpg)

![1000059954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/2423qoKac1jb8nNDw28EHo4R9FSZ8ATtxcXxPFKPbsBJsJCsu5tZSbUPFkHafw3vszBrz.jpg)



![1000059957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23uQpaL1RCp1y5txCMgqZi37sqZPBeivbMwqeDASFkm8d7cHnCLg1ied735RD1YCW6n4k.jpg)

![1000059959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23vsUmQn4dXc7GrBeEQy8NMNzR26rFmuZ8GY1yDANk8HXyfZPqdpaua3pq6b3U1r6ERZX.jpg)

![1000059961.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wXA5Tc4AKPucTthchBYkZCC5sCEuyR9FhR48kEaQWAdT5183Wrvo24fSPTR9v9VtEtA.jpg)

One of the most impressive elements is the Keep Tower, built in white Estremoz marble. Its presence is remarkable, especially because the marble connects the monument directly with the identity of the city. From the castle area, the views are also spectacular, with the Alentejo landscape extending far into the distance. Standing there, looking across the rooftops and countryside, gives us a very different perspective of Estremoz.

## 🏨 The Pousada

Within this historic environment we find the Pousada Castelo de Estremoz, installed in the former royal palace. The building combines the atmosphere of a historic monument with the comfort of a pousada, creating a very special setting. Walking through this space allows visitors to experience architecture and history in a more intimate way, surrounded by old walls, decorative details, gardens and views over the city.

**📷 Photographs — The Pousada and Its Historic Details**

![1000060025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23zRyKZkKcvLEcg756D8iYc9M7oLvoJsz2BJ81WnTrrBimguAvxWPa6NT2wf3Rh1YBNDw.jpg)

![1000060028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23ywry3JRwgoTqEDWSviyxNfZN3Bnumve39KLXD3fqA6PPW8H4QLa3JGyNkQyiy4NvfJx.jpg)

![1000060029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23xKtLSirpqQDPagKN1thcewQYMupyRmAWmhNoajLffRF9nTcpbVQ7bhGZPANmbsUCSxJ.jpg)

![1000060030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23yJJTMypNCz2cBTsRuhi8SiYjbhtkaeCUw7Y4pE9ULNhAgNpEYNMEcc7AoFLmVh5Cy2Y.jpg)

![1000060027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wgKuYpBpAC5458jmdEDTQ9Swx6tXY3WmighjMZuwSE4MgjUDDNDL7NYb9JKxAGyorji.jpg)

![1000060026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23zkpQcQfZJKpP6cDQxWnj2ABUUPwQnPT6b8oCT67uEwTfKhS8kepS31C4rhMQW1xQurt.jpg)

What fascinated me most was the way the old architecture remains present everywhere. Instead of being something distant that we only observe from outside, the history becomes part of the environment we walk through. Doors, windows, stone details, decorative elements and views all contribute to the atmosphere. These are the details that I tried to capture with my camera, creating a visual record of the experience.

## 👑 Queen Saint Isabel

Estremoz has a particularly strong connection with Queen Saint Isabel. The medieval palace was commissioned by King Dinis for his wife, Queen Isabel, and the Queen spent important periods of her life in Estremoz. She died here in 1336, leaving a lasting connection between her story and this city. Knowing this history while walking through the castle gave the visit another dimension, making the ancient walls feel even more meaningful.

**📷 Photographs — The Queen and Her History**


![1000059956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23uFMhcS5oAy7Ef9sdJHEcdadoa2TGeNhrb2GZQSdp7vt8aoQN4cN34WCpzGKWuXJBERJ.jpg)


![1000059967.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wgUMLRJV9EyedosUgDyui9ENs78X7brDmTecRcwwkYSYR7EmydYY3qnngzHoqRhxBMk.jpg)

![1000059969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/243q94VxRtvhqoYdEqQmHS9hyeCb2cT6rNPk9DSPPcmpZzBpjreoeW7b31xYE94oUHniM.jpg)

![1000059971.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/243BinQbA8zzn7fmWbCDmnQiLVHHHqu3NoayFKoa6bbXyvPtxxYYhkxN3FgBwJnmawAFu.jpg)

![1000059970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23zkk48ry2kx4SxDEsE351VEBh7B5w9ei4hLAVTHP1oQR4AxtkxdeyzX1rFxftakQRFo1.jpg)

![1000059986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/245cU7gZFUjq2sSZhogGyA1br1G8QdqjwjECVCDjgmEcidk9Gu3iSPrSyqQad2nipLeXW.jpg)





![1000060004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23sJrMDDnWaVe1pDWa7GmcyZwmrtPmAEjYhxMKxHwz6qTJnuuUr6H2X9MMByXdDXtfTxz.jpg)






The story of Queen Saint Isabel is still present in the monuments and religious spaces associated with her memory. One of the places that particularly interested me was the Chapel of Queen Saint Isabel. It is a beautiful example of how religious art, architecture and history come together. Looking at the interior, I found myself paying attention to details that might easily be overlooked during a quick visit.

## ⛪ The Church and Religious Heritage

The religious heritage of Estremoz is another important part of the city's identity. The churches and chapels preserve centuries of artistic and spiritual history, while their interiors contain details that deserve to be observed slowly. During my visit, I was particularly interested in the relationship between the architecture and the decorative elements. The atmosphere inside these spaces was very different from the bright Alentejo streets outside.

**📷 Photographs — Churches, Chapels and Sacred Art**

![1000059984.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23vi4EV99JzxEeLtR4PX4vmvWZMXfazTtRdwoTPVc31ZoGV9EiUW5QgLryGErQhQs2b29.jpg)

![1000059987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23xKtdTyjLJimonYAkadEJWXQFWd2tSaaWYDCccXqoyNSHzHYuhLeLGBMbDeMpPi2Lg1J.jpg)

![1000059995.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23tHCPq9tMMqu9JSpjmhvZXbYYwfKN6TtxML58BxdoTEUYG8HaEt8p3tXbQ1WSvHLpW98.jpg)

![1000059994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23tvgqNWxHd9zg6w2zxaKcQ37hBjMfJd3uVU2EQ68ujF4QCz7rgZfcRK4dFuw9ad4zY1n.jpg)

![1000059998.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23uQrDGNfzn8eLnRY15XEjv5mkQz8NsxqWv8zh3npybLrpGk6fupaucJ3aTmcr7TUdWRX.jpg)

![1000059962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wMY9jJq4ajwXWY5jsDpMPUHjSVdCCwnFcws92sDz2Pif471Ka6ufLVS8acNw74A3aru.jpg)

![1000059966.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wWyFv9mRZzWPFge3gZmTLQcHvd9yrnaYE9e8j6cotYiYV3YV8ZAkx1EDTzHoNB8gu5f.jpg)

![1000059964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wX3G8ppScy6nWcutymRKAQjfFm7ALMJy4E9JD5sgem9Q2XRR8nH1HS1zhzcEhRBX3rq.jpg)


## 🎨 The Beauty of the Azulejos

The azulejos were another detail that immediately caught my attention. Portuguese tiles have an extraordinary ability to transform walls into works of art, and in Estremoz they can be found in historic religious and architectural spaces. The combination of blue and white, decorative patterns and painted scenes creates an incredible visual effect. Looking closely at these panels reveals details that are easy to miss when simply walking through a room.

**📷 Photographs — Azulejos and Decorative Details**

![1000060000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23y8ufE8qF3BNKmw65LLM7vGFqZaiHdjUNTNxT2FjKAvuWa5ojevJhpgw3Sq7X4aXspaC.jpg)

![1000059980.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23ywuYWbW9UVYLiZNZtz2jWwZT6mX6qGSrkZoazrNYnHkyjx87r8Np9Y75Zennsam83Zt.jpg)

![1000059977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23xKxmyWYZC5Zv7S9nbuNR2fNLjUz1cEoYNPWzRfn8iNofAxYzBKo8rVxPdpawNutwtWP.jpg)

![1000059979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23wqpwgSHr4XapZzxZzmEdKdRqfPU3DhV3QWgMjM3rc6sS6ZZUWdTR9LiURmwDUWuQaJn.jpg)

![1000059981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23uFW1Yt7gsFuHDzm8rydbiZx3ZK8rLk7Wtuoa1VUFwYT6xZ7UoSNwTCeYkdBkTiPJRd8.jpg)

I particularly enjoy photographing azulejos because every panel contains so many details. The repetition of patterns, the small differences in colour and the marks left by time create photographs that are almost abstract when viewed closely. At the same time, they remain connected to Portuguese history and artistic traditions. These images are therefore not only photographs of decoration; they are also photographs of a cultural heritage that deserves to be preserved.

## 🌳 The Gardens

After spending time inside the historic buildings, I went outside again and explored the gardens. The green spaces create a wonderful contrast with the white marble and old stone walls. There is something very peaceful about walking through a historic garden while looking across the Alentejo landscape. The atmosphere becomes calmer, and it is possible to stop for a moment and simply appreciate the surroundings.

**📷 Photographs 34–37 — Gardens and Landscape**
![1000060048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23zS573hRfg8Z6Na7A7BPaGFR9gh6FWNNDzHrybtb8fefUGqRpXkqy16B43KUZHf11Vsm.jpg)

![1000060048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23zS573hRfg8Z6Na7A7BPaGFR9gh6FWNNDzHrybtb8fefUGqRpXkqy16B43KUZHf11Vsm.jpg)


The gardens also offered some of my favourite photographic moments because of the combination of vegetation, architecture and light. During the day, the colours and shadows create one atmosphere, while later, as the light begins to disappear, everything changes. This is one of the reasons I like photographing places at different moments: the same location can almost become a completely different place depending on the time of day.

## 🌙 The Lake at Night

One of the details I particularly wanted to include in this post is the lake in the garden. When night arrives and the lights come on, the atmosphere changes completely. The illumination creates reflections on the water, while the surrounding historic environment becomes quieter and more mysterious. It was one of those moments when I stopped for a while simply to observe the scene before taking my photographs.

**📷 Photographs — The Illuminated Lake at Night**

![1000060056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ricestrela/23yHkt9LeqHtxbJTEPmzFam9Uu9DHMJXEVJGToAcz5oUrR4HfZzU14Q2ztBpqakfXoUGZ.jpg)
![1000060052.jpg](image-41-1000060052.jpg)


For me, these final photographs are a fitting way to finish the visual journey through Estremoz. During the day, the castle and its surroundings are full of history, architecture and bright Alentejo light. At night, the same place becomes much more intimate and atmospheric. The reflections in the lake and the lights around the garden create a completely different mood, showing another side of this historic place.

## 📸 Photographs, One Journey

These photographs are my personal record of a visit to Estremoz. They show different sides of the experience: the city, the food, the castle, the Pousada, Queen Saint Isabel, the religious heritage, the azulejos, the gardens and finally the illuminated lake at night. Together, they tell a story that goes beyond simply visiting a monument. They represent the details, moments and impressions that stayed with me after leaving.

All these photographs are mine and were taken during my visit to Estremoz, Portugal. Photography gives us the opportunity to preserve not only what we see, but also something of what we feel at a particular moment. Looking at these images again, I can remember the streets, the architecture, the food, the history and the quiet moments in the gardens. I hope that, through these photographs, you can experience a little of that journey too.

I would love to know which part of this photographic journey caught your attention the most. Was it the food and Alentejo traditions? The castle and its magnificent marble tower? The connection with Queen Saint Isabel? The church and the beautiful azulejos? Or perhaps the gardens and the illuminated lake at night?

Have you ever visited Estremoz? If you have, I would love to know what your favourite place or memory is. And if you have never been there, did these photographs make you want to discover this historic Alentejo city?

Leave your thoughts in the comments. I always enjoy reading your opinions and discovering which details people notice in my photographs. Sometimes a small detail that I considered secondary can become someone else's favourite photograph, and that is one of the things that makes sharing photography so rewarding.

Thank you very much for joining me on another photographic journey here on PeakD and WorldMappPin. I hope this post has shown you a little of the history, culture, flavours and beauty that I found in Estremoz. Portugal has so many places waiting to be discovered, and I am happy to continue exploring them one photograph at a time.

Until the next adventure! Keep exploring, keep photographing and, above all, keep discovering the wonderful places that surround us. ✨📸

# [PT]

Olá, comunidade PeakD e WorldMappPin! 👋

Numa das minhas recentes visitas a Estremoz, no coração do Alentejo, decidi explorar esta bonita cidade histórica com a minha máquina fotográfica e, acima de tudo, com tempo para observar os pormenores. Estremoz é um daqueles lugares onde a história parece estar presente em todo o lado: no mármore branco, nas antigas muralhas, no castelo, nas igrejas, nas ruas, nos jardins e até nos sabores da sua gastronomia tradicional.

Percorrer Estremoz foi como abrir um livro de história, mas um livro em que cada página poderia ser fotografada. A cidade tem um carácter muito próprio, criado pela combinação entre a arquitetura alentejana, o mármore e séculos de história. Desde a parte baixa da cidade até ao castelo medieval, encontrei sempre novos detalhes que despertavam a minha atenção. Esta visita resultou em 41 fotografias que tenho muito gosto em partilhar convosco.

## 🍽️ Um Sabor do Alentejo

Antes de falar do castelo e da sua história, quero começar por algo que é impossível separar de uma visita ao Alentejo: a comida. A gastronomia alentejana está profundamente ligada à terra e a ingredientes tradicionais como o pão, o azeite, as ervas aromáticas e os produtos locais. É uma cozinha simples, mas cheia de carácter, onde receitas transmitidas de geração em geração continuam a fazer parte importante da identidade da região.

A comida é também outra forma de conhecer um lugar. Os aromas, as cores e as texturas de uma refeição tradicional contam uma história tanto como um edifício antigo. Durante a minha visita, quis incluir este lado de Estremoz na minha viagem fotográfica porque viajar não significa apenas visitar monumentos. Significa também conhecer a cultura local através dos seus sabores, das suas tradições e dos pequenos momentos que ficam guardados na memória.

## 📸 As Primeiras Fotografias

Comecei o meu passeio fotográfico por Estremoz observando a própria cidade. As ruas, fachadas, janelas, portas e pequenos detalhes arquitetónicos chamaram imediatamente a minha atenção. O famoso mármore branco dá à cidade uma aparência muito característica, enquanto a forte luz alentejana cria sombras e contrastes que mudam ao longo do dia. Por vezes, foram precisamente os pormenores mais pequenos que se transformaram nos motivos mais interessantes para a minha máquina fotográfica.

**📷 Fotografias — A descobrir Estremoz**



Estas primeiras fotografias são uma introdução à cidade e à atmosfera que encontrei durante a visita. Quis mostrar não apenas os monumentos mais conhecidos, mas também os detalhes do quotidiano que dão personalidade a Estremoz. Fachadas antigas, cantarias, ruas e vistas podem facilmente passar despercebidas quando estamos simplesmente de passagem. A fotografia fez-me abrandar e observar estes lugares de uma perspetiva diferente.

## 🏰 O Castelo de Estremoz

O Castelo foi naturalmente uma das principais razões que me levaram a explorar Estremoz. Erguendo-se sobre o centro histórico, o castelo domina a paisagem envolvente e proporciona um extraordinário ponto de observação sobre a planície alentejana. O conjunto monumental recorda-nos a importância estratégica que Estremoz teve ao longo da história de Portugal. À medida que me aproximava, as muralhas e torres transmitiam imediatamente a sensação de estar a entrar noutra época.

**📷 Fotografias — O Castelo e as Muralhas Medievais**



Um dos elementos mais impressionantes é a Torre de Menagem, construída em mármore branco de Estremoz. A sua presença é extraordinária, sobretudo porque o mármore liga diretamente o monumento à própria identidade da cidade. A partir do castelo, as vistas são também magníficas, com a paisagem alentejana a estender-se ao longe. Estar ali, olhando para os telhados da cidade e para o campo, proporciona uma perspetiva completamente diferente de Estremoz.

## 🏨 A Pousada

Neste ambiente histórico encontramos a Pousada Castelo de Estremoz, instalada no antigo paço real. O edifício combina a atmosfera de um monumento histórico com o conforto de uma pousada, criando um espaço muito especial. Percorrer este local permite ao visitante experimentar a arquitetura e a história de uma forma mais próxima, rodeado por antigas paredes, elementos decorativos, jardins e vistas sobre a cidade.

**📷 Fotografias — A Pousada e os seus detalhes históricos**



O que mais me fascinou foi a forma como a arquitetura antiga permanece presente em todos os lugares. Em vez de ser algo distante que observamos apenas do exterior, a história passa a fazer parte do ambiente que percorremos. Portas, janelas, detalhes em pedra, elementos decorativos e vistas contribuem para a atmosfera. Foram precisamente estes pormenores que tentei captar com a minha máquina, criando um registo visual da experiência.

## 👑 A Rainha Santa Isabel

Estremoz tem uma ligação muito especial à Rainha Santa Isabel. O paço medieval foi mandado construir pelo rei D. Dinis para a sua esposa, a Rainha Isabel, e a rainha passou períodos importantes da sua vida em Estremoz. Foi também aqui que morreu em 1336, deixando uma ligação permanente entre a sua história e esta cidade. Conhecer esta história enquanto percorremos o castelo dá uma dimensão diferente à visita e torna as antigas paredes ainda mais significativas.

**📷 Fotografias — A Rainha e a sua História**



A história da Rainha Santa Isabel continua presente nos monumentos e espaços religiosos associados à sua memória. Um dos locais que mais me interessou foi a Capela da Rainha Santa Isabel. É um belo exemplo de como a arte religiosa, a arquitetura e a história se encontram. Ao observar o seu interior, dei por mim a prestar atenção a pormenores que poderiam facilmente passar despercebidos numa visita mais rápida.

## ⛪ A Igreja e o Património Religioso

O património religioso de Estremoz é outra parte importante da identidade da cidade. As igrejas e capelas preservam séculos de história artística e religiosa, enquanto os seus interiores guardam detalhes que merecem ser observados com calma. Durante a visita, interessei-me particularmente pela relação entre a arquitetura e os elementos decorativos. O ambiente no interior destes espaços era muito diferente da luminosidade das ruas alentejanas que encontrava no exterior.

**📷 Fotografias — Igrejas, Capelas e Arte Sacra**



## 🎨 A Beleza dos Azulejos

Os azulejos foram outro dos elementos que imediatamente me chamaram a atenção. Os azulejos portugueses têm uma capacidade extraordinária de transformar paredes em verdadeiras obras de arte e, em Estremoz, podemos encontrar exemplos muito bonitos em espaços históricos, religiosos e arquitetónicos. A combinação entre o azul e o branco, os padrões decorativos e as cenas pintadas cria um efeito visual impressionante. Observar estes painéis de perto permite descobrir pormenores que facilmente passam despercebidos.

**📷 Fotografias — Azulejos e Detalhes Decorativos**



Gosto particularmente de fotografar azulejos porque cada painel contém uma enorme quantidade de detalhes. A repetição dos padrões, as pequenas diferenças de cor e as marcas deixadas pelo tempo criam fotografias que, quando vistas de perto, podem quase parecer abstratas. Ao mesmo tempo, continuam ligadas à história e às tradições artísticas portuguesas. Estas imagens não são apenas fotografias de decoração; são também registos de um património cultural que merece ser preservado.

## 🌳 Os Jardins

Depois de passar algum tempo dentro dos edifícios históricos, voltei ao exterior e explorei os jardins. Os espaços verdes criam um contraste muito bonito com o mármore branco e as antigas paredes de pedra. Existe algo muito tranquilo em caminhar por um jardim histórico enquanto contemplamos a paisagem alentejana. A atmosfera torna-se mais calma e é possível parar por alguns momentos e simplesmente apreciar tudo o que nos rodeia.

**📷 Fotografias — Jardins e Paisagem**



Os jardins proporcionaram também alguns dos meus momentos fotográficos favoritos, devido à combinação entre vegetação, arquitetura e luz. Durante o dia, as cores e sombras criam uma determinada atmosfera, mas mais tarde, quando a luz começa a desaparecer, tudo se transforma. É precisamente por isso que gosto de fotografar os lugares em diferentes momentos: o mesmo espaço pode quase transformar-se num local completamente diferente dependendo da hora do dia.

## 🌙 O Lago Iluminado à Noite

Um dos detalhes que queria muito incluir nesta publicação é o lago existente no jardim. Quando chega a noite e as luzes se acendem, o ambiente transforma-se completamente. A iluminação cria reflexos na água, enquanto o espaço histórico envolvente se torna mais silencioso e misterioso. Foi um daqueles momentos em que parei durante algum tempo simplesmente para observar a paisagem antes de começar a fotografar. Achei o ambiente verdadeiramente especial.

**📷 Fotografia — O Lago Iluminado à Noite**



Para mim, estas últimas fotografias são uma forma perfeita de terminar esta viagem visual por Estremoz. Durante o dia, o castelo e os seus arredores estão cheios de história, arquitetura e da forte luz alentejana. À noite, o mesmo espaço torna-se muito mais íntimo e envolvente. Os reflexos no lago e as luzes espalhadas pelo jardim criam uma atmosfera completamente diferente, mostrando-nos outro lado deste lugar histórico.

## 📸 Fotografias, Uma Viagem

Estas fotografias são o meu registo pessoal de uma visita a Estremoz. Mostram diferentes lados desta experiência: a cidade, a comida, o castelo, a Pousada, a Rainha Santa Isabel, o património religioso, os azulejos, os jardins e, finalmente, o lago iluminado durante a noite. Juntas, contam uma história que vai muito além de uma simples visita a um monumento. Representam os detalhes, momentos e impressões que ficaram comigo depois de partir.

Todas estas fotografias são minhas e foram tiradas durante a minha visita a Estremoz, Portugal. A fotografia dá-nos a oportunidade de preservar não apenas aquilo que vemos, mas também um pouco daquilo que sentimos num determinado momento. Ao voltar a olhar para estas imagens, consigo recordar as ruas, a arquitetura, a comida, a história e os momentos de tranquilidade nos jardins. Espero que, através destas fotografias, também consigam sentir um pouco desta viagem.

Gostaria muito de saber qual foi a parte desta viagem fotográfica que mais vos chamou a atenção. Foi a comida e as tradições alentejanas? O castelo e a sua magnífica torre de mármore? A ligação à Rainha Santa Isabel? A igreja e os belíssimos azulejos? Ou talvez os jardins e o lago iluminado durante a noite?

Já visitaram Estremoz? Se sim, gostaria muito de saber qual é o vosso lugar ou memória favorita. E se nunca tiveram oportunidade de visitar esta cidade, estas fotografias despertaram em vocês vontade de conhecer este lugar histórico do Alentejo?

Deixem as vossas opiniões nos comentários. Gosto sempre muito de ler o que sentiram ao ver as minhas fotografias e de descobrir quais os detalhes que mais chamaram a atenção de cada pessoa. Por vezes, um pequeno pormenor que considerei secundário pode transformar-se na fotografia favorita de outra pessoa, e é isso que torna tão interessante partilhar fotografia.

Muito obrigado por me acompanharem em mais uma viagem fotográfica aqui no PeakD e WorldMappPin. Espero que esta publicação vos tenha mostrado um pouco da história, cultura, sabores e beleza que encontrei em Estremoz. Portugal tem tantos lugares à espera de serem descobertos e fico feliz por continuar a explorá-los, uma fotografia de cada vez.

Até à próxima aventura! Continuem a explorar, fotografar e, acima de tudo, a descobrir os lugares maravilhosos que nos rodeiam. ✨📸

body.title: When I Choose to Grow My SPS, Not Simply Hold It
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNLfgnemf4xmptdUe8YbFQdBwvHRuWjWtiU7NjWVcgBD7/burn_sps.png)

Hello, Splinterlands warriors!

There was a time when I saw **SPS (Splintershards)** as nothing more than one of the tokens in *Splinterlands*. Now, my perspective has changed a little. By staking SPS, I can earn staking rewards, receive VOUCHERs, get certain bonuses in the game, and have a say in the direction of the ecosystem through governance.

When SPS became popular in 2021, it experienced an extraordinary rise. Its all-time high was around **US$1.07 in July 2021**. But the journey afterward was far from smooth. In June 2026, SPS even reached a low of around **US$0.002680**. Toward the end of August 2026, its price had returned to around **US$0.0035**. That means SPS is still down roughly 99.7% from its peak.

If the chart could talk, perhaps it would say, *“Don't look at my past, sir.”*

### So, how much SPS do I have now?

Now, this is the part that makes me smile a little myself.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZAUJcSAvA1ix97iDCFRCvtX14HdMuvQuszUhRPTGtEpg/my_sps.png)</center>


From my latest screenshot, my total balance is **22,329.4 SPS**, with an estimated value of around **US$77.47**.

Interestingly, I am no longer simply holding SPS in my wallet.

I have already staked **22,125.285 SPS**, earning **7.84% APR**. Meanwhile, the SPS available under *In-Game (LIQUID)* is **204.115 SPS**. I also have small balances on other networks: **1.302 SPS on Binance Smart Chain (BSC)** and **0.01 SPS on Hive Engine**.

I also have an **incoming delegation of 1,000 SPS**.

Roughly speaking, 22,125.285 SPS at an APR of 7.84% could generate around **1,734 SPS in a year**, assuming the APR remains unchanged and the staking conditions stay the same.

For me, that number is actually more interesting than checking the SPS price every five minutes.

Because I have started thinking about it this way: *if the price isn't ready to go up yet, at least the amount of SPS I own shouldn't be sitting around doing nothing.*

### Staking: a simple strategy that turns out not to be so simple

I have indeed left almost all of my SPS working. I don't really need a large amount of liquidity at all times, so rather than letting my SPS sit idle, I would rather stake it and earn a return.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQSbbbUt75LqU68HkWEqGh5RV1jU6LsbDxJCZUZgrjjzr/tools.png)


But I also don't want to become someone who locks up all their money just because they see the words “7.84% APR.”

Because **APR is not a guarantee of profit in rupiah**.

For example, I might receive an additional 1,700 SPS in a year, but if the price of SPS falls by half, the value of my portfolio can still shrink. On the other hand, if the price of SPS rises while the number of tokens continues to increase, the effect could become much more attractive.

That is why I look at SPS investment from two perspectives: **the number of tokens and the price of the token**.

### My biggest lesson

For me, the important question is no longer, *“When will SPS return to US$1?”*

A healthier question is:

**“Is the Splinterlands ecosystem still growing enough that the SPS I accumulate today has a reason to be worth more in the future?”**

That is a more difficult question. At the same time, it is a more honest one.

SPS remains a crypto asset with extreme volatility. Even with 7.84% staking, a decline in the token price can be far greater than the staking returns.

So, if I could give myself one piece of advice: **don't chase a growing SPS balance while forgetting its value.**

Stake when you are genuinely prepared to hold the tokens for the long term. Keep some liquidity available for other needs and opportunities. And most importantly, keep an eye on the development of **Splinterlands**, not just the color of the SPS candlesticks.

Because in the end, I don't want to own 100,000 cheap SPS that have no reason to be used.

I want to have SPS that **grows in quantity, remains useful, and one day—hopefully—is valued by the market once again**.

For now, I'll just let these 22,329 SPS work slowly.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXaBtYPQQcQ4fDb2DMaFETkzmZ5DNhevYHW4pANVaM2/banner.png)</center>

As you can see in the image it was ***my father and my cousins who helped open the box*** and gave each goods anything with their name tags, each contains our names and so with my cousins.

As you can see here there are bags, clothes and also kitchen utensils. **My mother was quiet busy getting all that is ours.**

![Aesthetic Photo Collage Instagram Post_20260826_130424_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/AKe6bMRPsHnFP3a4YXzJJ3YQf5Yyta7rEoXh5qqwGQzMbnF1ddRgSs2UNUGCfpW.png)
***After a while, they we're look at all that we have received. They tried their clothes ~ that was my sister and brother has a new ball as well and so many more..***



![8ae3a989-5b72-4d70-abbc-65887c04899a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/EoK7qf4kBn9tRxsaQ9bfnho6hZ8br6ZEJBQy3SddnRCPT38r5XdpW8LRs14Hv8fUSBv.jpg)
**What amazes me even more is this basic needs** that we have received, it was Sunday and tomorrow is Monday it's my scheduled class day so of course we need viands for the school snacks and so on, since we don't have any extra money for the week especially that my father's work haven't received yet his salary so it was kinda tough week for us but as I have arrived home, **I was in tears and deep in my heart I was so happy and relieved and in my mind I praise and thank God because His provision always hits on time**, I am so happy not just for myself but also for my family now we don't have to worry for our basic needs the entire week. ***I praise God for His goodness, all glory belongs to Him alone!***

![0696a131-f4d3-46ea-a9b7-1dee167806f0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/EoeDR6buWALYsh7YMDpNxXWx2BPXiifX6FbiPNmVLDJawMGFDsKhrJ91RgibEb5iY42.jpg)

![c8e6d238-18dc-4ac4-a9a1-3b9323b4756c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23wgasGmDavBqh1eJmt3vnSP9koLBoD6BtqwoHQne6bzqsi3ttMyigpXPs93hwouRENfW.jpg)
***One of the always request of my mother whenever I go to supermarket is to buy laundry powder and she has a one bag of it, she is very happy now..***

![812f6ead-1ea6-4567-a598-276c012d36df.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/EoeEU2egAFEgqxYJ6spzsvV2ZCoARHn78C8d4P6umvaobKNQemnp8JW42pRiawZSmae.jpg)
And **one of my ultimate joy is to have my own perfume**, here in our house whoever has a perfume it will be one for all and all for one, it has my name tag so basically it's mine and I really the smell of it, so gooood..

We received coffee also, chocolates, maling somewhat like a Spam, shampoo, bread spread, my mother have her bags also, slippers and shoes and so on.

*Looking back now, it was a testament of God's amazing provision it is never too late nor too early just hit on time. I am so happy for myself and my family and I was able to share some chocolate to my circle of friends and I had a good night sleep after all.*

**That would be all guys, I hope may we be reminded of how good God is every single day!**

body.title: Delicious and nutritious pumpkin cream soup🍜🥣
body.body:
<center>![vc.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vi42aAP8cpkfjmxRFLjh1LVxFpqXDKExmmehUyXujWZtfPeQXYDqmAf685BLNxpKgzW.jpg)</center>

Hello, my dear friends at Hive Food. I hope you are doing well and feeling happy. Today, I’m sharing a culinary idea that you’re going to love for its simplicity and incredible flavor. This creamy pumpkin soup recipe is highly nutritious, comforting, and very easy to prepare. It is the ideal choice for a family Sunday—a perfect day to stay home, treat your taste buds, and simply take a break from the daily routine that wears us out so much during the week. Pumpkin is a magical ingredient in the kitchen. Not only does it add a beautiful golden color that brightens up the table, but it is also packed with vitamins, fiber, and antioxidants that nourish our families. To enhance the flavor, I like to cook it with a touch of onion, finely minced garlic, and a vegetable bouillon cube. The secret to achieving an incredibly creamy texture is to blend it thoroughly while it is still warm, adding a splash of milk—or a spoonful of heavy cream if you want an even more gourmet result.

Preparing this dish won't take much time, allowing you to make the most of your time with loved ones while the house fills with a delicious aroma. You can serve it with toasted bread cubes, grated white cheese, or a sprinkle of fresh cilantro on top. I invite you to put on your apron and try this delicious dish for your Sunday lunch. Bon appétit and have a restful Sunday, everyone!

>Hola, mis queridos amigos de Hive Food. Espero que se encuentren muy bien y con el corazón contento. Hoy les traigo una propuesta culinaria que les va a encantar por su sencillez y su increíble sabor. Esta receta de crema de auyama es supernutritiva, reconfortante y muy fácil de preparar. Es la opción ideal para este domingo familiar, un día perfecto para quedarnos en casa, consentir al paladar y simplemente descansar de la rutina diaria que tanto nos agota durante la semana.La auyama, o calabaza, es un ingrediente mágico en la cocina. No solo aporta un color dorado hermoso que alegra la mesa, sino que también está llena de vitaminas, fibra y antioxidantes que cuidan a nuestra familia. Para elevar su sabor, me gusta cocinarla con un toque de cebolla, ajo bien picadito y un cubito de caldo vegetal. El secreto para que quede extremadamente cremosa es licuarla muy bien cuando todavía está tibia, añadiendo un chorrito de leche o una cucharada de crema de leche si quieren un resultado aún más gourmet.

>Preparar este plato no te quitará mucho tiempo, lo que te permitirá disfrutar al máximo de los tuyos mientras la casa se llena de un aroma delicioso. Se puede acompañar con unos cuadritos de pan tostado, queso blanco rallado o un toque de cilantro fresco por encima. Los invito a ponerse el delantal y a probar esta delicia en su almuerzo dominical. ¡Buen provecho y feliz domingo de descanso para todos!


![hyguyg.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23t8Aro8xFxcHR8L3i5h5NZbRyMjDFzVXqmxjH27wF9spNgnuWb6ofJAMb1UunEjBz4wA.png)




![5190262c-5188-42a4-a83b-fe7570d28e7e.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23xAZgZzirjjQx7SP9NzsK5ez1tVNTQ6b2uPbJV6FYNYVMxM7wqJzUZWwucyLXEayRhH7.jpeg)

Preparación:-Preparation:

We cut all the vegetables into julienne strips, place them in a pot with water, and bring the pumpkin to a boil along with the vegetables, the bouillon cube, and half a tablespoon of vegetable oil.

>Cortamos todas las verduras en juliana y las vertemos en una olla con agua y dejamos hervir la auyama con las verduras, el cubito y media cucharada de aceite vegetal.





![e188a740-23e8-439d-a2f9-fa3386bb462d.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23tmNJ52X5sMz1XE1uYeku1V5uQnEUmPomJ5DxWKyDXQ8ZUw37jScdBscnMHBCEHqvYuD.jpeg)


![e72608d1-d832-48bb-b266-e8786c6176be.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wCBXYjhrfVpRiVjty5H7AP7tUncgHVttU7ZacEsctQGrSJYZjRcrnpzbkknSyHr1X7G.jpeg)



![1afb32c8-72d8-443c-af35-79f276d2d1e9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23xVAv4DVXLV3XjN7QHzS4d7AQBC5QLW6q7v7Q6PF8bNYeQu1EihrkXMZEGpvvNVMf8SY.jpeg)

We let the boiled vegetables rest and blend them, then serve the delicious cream soup.

>Dejamos reposar las verduras ya hervidas y las licuamos para luego servir la deliciosa crema.


![e3d4af26-d81e-41cc-a9ea-159978d5ff2a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23yJJpZvK8pHXmZNRTqgKR4WCjjjyULcumSvBGhJiDphXpv56tmWwqdqwg8Yhpjs7c4pD.jpeg)

body.title: POLLO AL HORNO CON VERDURAS, ARROZ Y ENSALADA+++++++Oven-Baked Chicken with Vegetables, Rice, and Salad
body.body:
SI EXISTE UNA COMIDA PARA MI GUSTO, LA

               VERDAD AMIGOS ES ESTA, POLLO PATA Y MUSLO

               AL HORNO, CON TROZOS DE VERDURAS VARIAS

               TAMBIEN ARROZ, ENSALADA Y AGUACATE O PALTA.

               +++++++

               IF THERE IS A FOOD TO MY TASTE, IT

               TRUTH FRIENDS, IT'S THIS ONE, CHICKEN LEG AND THIGH

               BAKED, WITH VARIOUS VEGETABLE PIECES

               Also rice, salad, and avocado or palta.

Para tal comida lo primero, es tener el pollo, como dije pata y
muslo, el cual lo corto en trozos, tambien preparo la verdura
zapallo, cebolla, batata, papa, todo cortado en trozos pequeños.

+++++++

For such a meal, the first thing is to have the chicken, as I said, leg and
thigh, which I cut into pieces, I also prepare the vegetables
squash, onion, sweet potato, potato, all cut into small pieces.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23tmHzUbBJn9bCvDMRNaCWMXvLfF597kVdxK82fgSnX48nasdPKycFC163RSVHGbtvH7c.png)

Como se ve en esta fotografia, luego de tomar una bandeja para
horno, a la que le agregue mantequilla, luego el pollo mencionado
tambien dicha verdura cortada en trozos pequeños, la cual la
lleve al horno, cuando esta bien dorado todo es cuando ya esta
cocinado dicho pollo y la verdura.

+++++++

As seen in this photograph, after taking a baking tray
oven, to which I added butter, then the mentioned chicken
also that vegetable cut into small pieces, which I
I put it in the oven, when everything is nicely browned, 
that's when it's cooked said chicken and vegetables.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eorypw93UvLan4d6wDXmAnSWVB7LzdxU5yidFQmmyvsoPKWBmWoZvZpCVg1YBehoyGW.png)

Asi que mientras se esta cocinando el pollo con la verdura se
hace lo siguiente, la ensalada y agrego una olla en la hornalla
de la cocina con agua, dicha ensalada contiene, zanahoria rallada
pepino, lechuga, tomate, todo condimentado con sal a gusto y
limon.

+++++++

So while the chicken with the vegetables is cooking,
do the following, the salad and I add a pot on the stove
from the kitchen with water, this salad contains grated carrot
cucumber, lettuce, tomato, all seasoned with salt to taste and
lemon.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23wMaoxiZ5AiRLoHx5mTwCALgmNY56iFEwgu72C6Wunc44E9YWUAtWvDweyZotL8LfWBU.png)

Bueno la olla con agua cuando la misma se calienta le agrego el
arroz, lo revuelvo despacio y una ves cocinado le quito el
agua y listo como lo pueden ver.

+++++++

Well, the pot with water, when it heats up, I add the
rice, I stir it slowly and once it's cooked, I remove the
water and done, as you can see.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23vhunnPvfmCVXq9F1XBxkfjZnUzWei11SqewY7DNTCgmAw2stf2Syt7HPBV9PQ5Uk6v7.png)


Asi que estando todo cocinado, lo que resta es preparar con
la palta o aguacate el guacamole, al que le agrego cebolla
locote todo bien picado, para luego agregarlo en una 
licuadora con un poco de sal y limon, despues de darle 
con dicha licuadora que todo listo para el almuerzo.

+++++++

So, with everything cooked, all that's left is to prepare with
the avocado, the guacamole, to which I add onion
bell pepper, all finely chopped, then add it to a
blender with a little salt and lemon, after giving it
with that blender, everything is ready for lunch.

body.title: Un Perrito de Jumbo con mi Mamá | A Hot Dog with my Mom [ESP | ENG]
body.body:
>
 
# English

Happy Sunday to all my friends on Hive!  I hope you're all doing great. So, on Friday, I went with my mom to Jumbo in Barrio Obrero. 

We didn't feel like cooking at home, so at first we thought about getting burgers, but we decided to share one between the two of us so we wouldn't stray too far from our diet. Besides, you can have junk food once a week without losing all your progress. 

So we went to Jumbo, and the most surprising thing was that it was packed. We arrived, ordered, and waited for a table. It took about 10 minutes to get seated. And another 10 minutes for our order to arrive. 

Since we were seated at a large table, we shared it with another family, because otherwise they would’ve had to wait much longer to get a seat or order takeout.

We started chatting with the family, and it turns out that one of the women had been a teacher at the school where I studied—but she taught in the afternoon, so I never saw her. She knew all my teachers, though. 

We ate, and the food was delicious; each hot dog cost 10,000 Colombian pesos, or $2.50. We washed them down with hibiscus tea instead of soda.

We had an amazing time and really enjoyed the day.

We'll read you in the comments! 💛

---

# Español 


¡Feliz Domingo a todos mis amigos de Hive!  Espero que se encuentren de maravilla. Les cuento que el viernes fui con mi mamá a Jumbo en Barrio Obrero. 

No teníamos ganas de hacer comida en casa, así que primero pensamos en comer Hamburguesas, pero íbamos a comer 1 entre las 2, para no salirnos tanto de nuestro régimen alimenticio. Además, que 1 vez a la semana se puede comer una comida chatarra sin perder todo el progreso. 

Así que fuimos a Jumbo, y lo más impresionante es que estaba muy lleno. Así que llegamos ordenamos y esperamos por una mesa. Tardamos en sentarnos como 10 minutos. Y 10 minutos más en que nos trajeran el pedido. 

Cómo estábamos sentadas en un mesa grande,  compartimos mesa con otra familia, porque sino iban a tener que esperar mucho más para poder sentarse o pedir para llevar.

Empezamos a compartir con la familia y resulta que una de las señoras había sido profesora de la escuela donde estudié, pero en la tarde, así que nunca la vi. Pero conoció a todas mis profesoras. 

Comimos y estaban exquisitos, cada perro costó 10.000 pesos colombianos o 2.5$. Los acompañamos con agua de Jamaica, para evitar el refresco.

La pasamos increíble y disfrutamos de este día.

¡Nos leemos en los comentarios! 💛 

---

body.title: What can you see beyond the horizon?
body.body:
[ALMANAC](https://www.almanac.com/what-can-you-see-horizon-and-how-far-it)
I’m sure that all of us (and I believe I can speak plurally) entered this project in search of money, and there is definitely nothing wrong with that. Writing and sharing about diverse concepts, ideas and thoughts on different scales in “exchange” for money really ends up being our first focus. However, after we understand how the gears of this ecosystem work, if we cannot see beyond the horizon, everything that keeps this project standing loses its reason for existing (in the essence of its idea, which was never money itself). Each of us has different needs in the real world, and almost all of them need money to become realities. We can get that money here, but if that is the bar that keeps our commitment here, are we not doomed to failure as users, and doomed to failure as a project? The fluctuations in the price of **HIVE** give me a very clear (and even obvious) view of this, because the interest of many users here is only to make “easy money”, which we all know (or should know) is not as easy as we imagine.
[Axios](https://www.axios.com/2022/09/29/hurricane-preparation-low-income-costs)
Building an idea based only on the financial horizon gradually weakens the idea behind the conception of this ecosystem. When the cycle around money repeats itself (and this has already been historically traditional in the existence of this project), those who think and act this way are actually neutralizing the potential for collectivity that exists here (just as they are also neutralizing the rise of everything that has already been built up to this point). The problem is not thinking about making money; but rather, thinking of it only as a definitive (and immutable) horizon. As long as this kind of small (and restrictive) thinking prevails here, the actions that can raise the quality of the project will potentially be smaller. Fortunately, resistance exists. On the other hand, it would be much more promising if we all worked together to prosper in a truly collective way. Some consider this kind of thinking a sort of “utopia”, but I like to nurture this idea because it is something I strongly believe in. This project needs to be better seen, evaluated and supported by everyone who truly already knows its potential. ---
**¿Qué logras ver más allá del horizonte?**
Estoy seguro de que todos nosotros (y creo que puedo hablar en plural) entramos en este proyecto en busca de dinero, y definitivamente no hay nada de malo en eso. Escribir y compartir sobre diversos conceptos, ideas y pensamientos en distintas escalas a “cambio” de dinero termina siendo realmente nuestro primer enfoque. Sin embargo, después de que entendemos cómo funcionan los engranajes de este ecosistema, si no conseguimos ver más allá del horizonte, todo lo que mantiene este proyecto en pie pierde su razón de existir (en la esencia de su idea, que nunca fue el dinero en sí). Cada uno de nosotros tenemos necesidades diferentes en el mundo real, y casi todas ellas necesitan dinero para convertirse en realidades. Podemos conseguir ese dinero aquí, pero si ese es el listón que mantiene nuestro compromiso aquí, ¿no estamos destinados al fracaso como usuarios, y destinados al fracaso como proyecto? Las oscilaciones sobre el precio de **HIVE** me hacen tener una visión muy clara (y hasta obvia) al respecto, porque el interés de muchos usuarios aquí es solo hacer “dinero fácil”, que todos sabemos (o deberíamos saber) que no es tan fácil como imaginamos. La construcción de la idea que tiene como base únicamente el horizonte financiero, debilita gradualmente la idea detrás de la idealización de este ecosistema. Cuando el ciclo alrededor del dinero se repite (y esto ya es tradicionalmente histórico en la existencia de este proyecto), quien piensa y actúa de esta manera, en realidad está neutralizando el potencial de colectividad que existe aquí (así como también está neutralizando el ascenso de todo lo que ya se ha venido construyendo hasta entonces). El problema no es pensar en ganar dinero; sino, pensar en ello únicamente como un horizonte definitivo (e inmutable). Mientras este tipo de pensamiento pequeño (y restrictivo) prevalezca por aquí, las acciones que pueden elevar la calidad del proyecto serán potencialmente menores. Afortunadamente, la resistencia existe. Por otro lado, sería mucho más prometedor que todos nosotros trabajáramos juntos para prosperar de una manera realmente colectiva. Hay quienes consideran este tipo de pensamiento como una especie de “utopía”, pero me gusta alimentar esta idea porque es algo en lo que creo mucho. Este proyecto necesita ser mejor visto, evaluado y sostenido por todos los que realmente ya conocen su potencial. ---
**O que você consegue ver além do horizonte?**
Eu estou certo de que todos nós (e acredito que posso falar pluralmente) entramos nesse projeto em busca de dinheiro, e definitivamente não há nada de errado nisso. Escrever e compartilhar sobre conceitos diversos, ideias e pensamentos em escalas distintas em “troca” de dinheiro acaba realmente sendo o nosso primeiro foco. No entanto, depois que nós entendemos como as engrenagens desse ecossistema funciona, se não conseguimos enxergar além do horizonte, tudo que mantém esse projeto de pé perde à sua razão de existir (na essência da sua ideia, que nunca foi o dinheiro em si). Cada um de nós temos necessidades diferentes no mundo real, e quase todas elas precisam de dinheiro para se tornar realidades. Nós podemos conseguir esse dinheiro aqui, mas se essa é o sarrafo que mantém o nosso comprometimento aqui, não estamos fadados ao fracasso enquanto usuários, e fadados ao fracasso enquanto projeto? As oscilações sobre o preço da **HIVE** me fazem ter uma visão muito clara (e até óbvia) quanto a isso, porque o interesse de muitos usuários aqui é só fazer “dinheiro fácil”, que todos nós sabemos (ou deveríamos saber) não ser tão fácil quanto nós imaginamos. A construção da ideia que tem como base apenas o horizonte financeiro, gradualmente enfraquece a ideia por trás da idealização desse ecossistema. Quando o ciclo ao redor do dinheiro se repete (e isso já é tradicionalmente histórico na existência desse projeto), quem pensa e age dessa maneira, está na verdade neutralizando o potencial de coletividade que existe aqui (assim como também está neutralizando a ascensão de tudo o que já vem sendo construído até então). O problema não é pensar em ganhar dinheiro; mas sim, pensar nisso apenas como um horizonte definitivo (e imutável). Enquanto esse tipo de pensamento pequeno (e restritivo) prevalecer por aqui, as ações que podem elevar a qualidade do projeto serão potencialmente menores. Felizmente, a resistência existe. Por outro lado, seria muito mais promissor que todos nós trabalhássemos juntos para prosperar de uma maneira realmente coletiva. Há quem considere esse tipo de pensamento como uma espécie de “utopia”, mas eu gosto de alimentar essa ideia porque é algo no qual eu acredito muito. Esse projeto precisa ser melhor visto, avaliado e sustentado por todos que realmente já sabem do seu potencial.
