body.title: ESP/ENG | «Si al recordar sonríes, valió la pena» / \
body.body:
¡Hola a todos en la comunidad! Un abrazo fraternal y un saludo lleno de buena vibra para ti que te tomas un momento para leerme hoy. 

---

# «Si al recordar sonríes, valió la pena»: La ciencia oculta de la tranquilidad

Hay momentos en los que, sin aviso alguno, la mente se escapa hacia atrás. Un aroma en la calle, una canción vieja en la radio o una foto traspapelada nos devuelven de golpe a una escena del pasado. Y justo ahí ocurre la magia: una sonrisa espontánea se dibuja en el rostro. 

Existe una frase corta pero demoledora que lo resume a la perfección: **«Si al recordar sonríes, valió la pena»**. 

Es una bella verdad, pero vale la pena hacerse una pregunta: ¿de dónde sale realmente esa sonrisa? La respuesta no es la suerte ni haber tenido una vida perfecta sin tropezones. Esa sonrisa espontánea es, en realidad, la cosecha de haber vivido con integridad.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqv9979BaX8K1L1cpkiv67yp92w7k9ZYycaKWcH3pf7n/1788097534444.jpg)

*Fuente / Source: Pixabay (Dominio Público)*
---

### El arte de no deberle nada al espejo

A veces parece que actuar con rectitud es el camino largo y aburrido. Nos enseñan a respetar las normas y puede sonar a discurso acartonado. Pero la realidad es mucho más práctica: portarse bien no es una imposición para complacer a los demás, es una inversión en la propia tranquilidad mental a largo plazo.

Quien camina por la vida entendiendo el «buen deber ser» construye, casi sin darse cuenta, un blindaje para su memoria. Un estilo de vida que se sostiene sobre dos pilares fundamentales:

1. **Las leyes de la fe (la brújula interna):** Tratar bien a los demás, actuar con buena intención, ser empático y mantener la paz del alma. Es hacer lo correcto incluso cuando nadie está mirando ni hay un aplauso esperando al final.
2. **Las leyes del hombre (la convivencia terrenal):** Es la ética básica, la honestidad, el respeto al derecho ajeno y el valor de mantener la palabra dada.

Cuando estos dos mundos se alinean, se logra algo invaluable: quitarse de encima el peso más grande que puede llevar una persona, que es la culpa. No hay facturas morales pendientes ni fantasmas escondidos en el armario.

### La memoria como un lugar cálido

Esto no significa buscar una perfección irreal. Todos nos equivocamos, metemos la pata y tomamos decisiones torpes en algún momento; es parte indispensable del aprendizaje. Pero existe una brecha abismal entre cometer un error por inexperiencia y actuar con mala fe.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRvBcjoMbpCyJxyHw71ZwKuad4g4pWJQeg7mwRHVsGr5X/1788098076516.jpg)

*Fuente / Source: Pixabay (Dominio Público)*
---

Cuando se juega limpio, el tiempo hace su trabajo. Años después, al mirar por el retrovisor de la vida, incluso los tropiezos y las batallas difíciles se reinterpretan con orgullo porque se afrontaron con la cara en alto. La memoria deja de ser un terreno minado de remordimientos y se convierte en un refugio cálido al que siempre da gusto regresar.

### La prueba reina

Se suele pensar que el éxito consiste en acumular logros o títulos, pero hay una métrica mucho más honesta: la capacidad de quedarse mirando al vacío un domingo por la tarde, recordar cómo se ha caminado el trayecto y soltar una sonrisa tranquila.

Esa sonrisa es la confirmación de que el balance es positivo. Es la certeza de que se amó con verdad, se respetó al entorno, se honraron las convicciones y se dejó el camino un poco mejor de como se encontró. 

Así que la próxima vez que te descubras sonriendo a solas por un pensamiento del pasado, celébralo. Es la prueba definitiva de que tu presente fue bien construido y de que, sin duda alguna, valió toda la pena.

---

### Para compartir en los comentarios:
1. ¿Cuál es ese recuerdo sencillo del pasado que siempre te saca una sonrisa sin importar el día que estés teniendo?
2. En tu experiencia cotidiana, ¿crees que mantener la paz de la conciencia es la clave principal para envejecer con alegría?

---

======================================================================

Hello everyone in the community! A warm, fraternal greeting filled with good vibes to you for taking a moment to read my post today.

---

# \

: The Hidden Science of Peace of Mind

There are moments when, without warning, the mind slips backward into the past. An aroma on the street, an old song on the radio, or a misplaced photograph suddenly brings us back to a scene from yesterday. And right there, magic happens: a spontaneous smile forms on your face.

There is a short but powerful phrase that summarizes it perfectly: **\

**

It is a beautiful truth, but it is worth asking ourselves: where does that smile really come from? The answer is neither luck nor having lived a flawless life without stumbles. That spontaneous smile is, in reality, the harvest of having lived with integrity.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqv9979BaX8K1L1cpkiv67yp92w7k9ZYycaKWcH3pf7n/1788098106908.jpg)

*Source: Pixabay (Public Domain)*
---

### The Art of Owing Nothing to the Mirror

Sometimes doing the right thing seems like the long, boring road. We are taught to abide by rules, and it can sound like a stiff speech. But reality is much more practical: behaving well is not an imposition to please others; it is an investment in your own long-term peace of mind.

Anyone who walks through life understanding the principle of \

builds, almost without realizing it, a armor for their memory. A lifestyle sustained by two fundamental pillars:

1. **The laws of faith (the internal compass):** Treating others well, acting with good intentions, showing empathy, and maintaining peace of soul. It means doing what is right even when no one is watching and there is no applause waiting at the end.
2. **The laws of man (earthly coexistence):** Basic ethics, honesty, respect for the rights of others, and honoring your word.

When these two worlds align, something invaluable is achieved: lifting the heaviest weight a person can carry, which is guilt. There are no pending moral debts or ghosts hidden in the closet.

### Memory as a Warm Place

This does not mean striving for an unrealistic perfection. We all make mistakes, mess up, and make foolish choices at times; it is an indispensable part of learning. But there is a massive gap between making a mistake out of inexperience and acting out of bad faith.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRvBcjoMbpCyJxyHw71ZwKuad4g4pWJQeg7mwRHVsGr5X/1788098129509.jpg)

*Source: Pixabay (Public Domain)*
---

When you play fair, time works its magic. Years later, looking through the rearview mirror of life, even the stumbles and tough battles are reinterpreted with pride because they were faced head-on. Memory ceases to be a minefield of regrets and becomes a warm refuge to which it is always a pleasure to return.

### The Ultimate Test

Success is often thought to consist of accumulating achievements or titles, but there is a much more honest metric: the ability to stare into space on a Sunday afternoon, recall how the journey was walked, and release a quiet, serene smile.

That smile is the confirmation that the final balance is positive. It is the certainty that you loved truthfully, respected your surroundings, honored your convictions, and left the path a little better than you found it.

So the next time you find yourself smiling alone at a thought from the past, celebrate it. It is the ultimate proof that your present was well-constructed and that, without a doubt, it was completely worth it.

---

### To share in the comments:
1. What is that simple memory from the past that always brings a smile to your face, no matter what kind of day you are having?
2. In your daily experience, do you believe that keeping a clear conscience is the main key to aging with joy?

body.title: Another Bowl of Kindness: A Neighbor’s Surprise Viand During My Recovery
body.body:
![collage.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Eoc7wsN2fzAuGTL8M6gqc43A2hc2Dq3mnaEcjYabvbZSi2BbaBZXdsFXpehWazCdJAK.jpg)
**Hello Hive Fam, most especially my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world and my co-Filipino Hivers! 💖**

![5d39dda0-9d23-4c20-bba8-7121b633a227.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23yd229K1YqDx1A8Q9WhkwxbMC4RHkewqiUxSRW76VvGJJHaHqk2sj8AzDLJZXBdQLdD7.jpeg)
Yesterday, I shared about the bowl of ginisang monggo I received from one of my thoughtful neighbors. Today, another neighbor, different from the one who gave me monggo,  handed me a bowl of viand that truly warmed my heart.

![14e91bc4-8f9d-405d-ae86-45abcef23ebf.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23xKrBebhgCZEGUEpJJvbzykGHtJiVPJ2TJhTo8bQvhhSMyW3YEm7tHcfH6sRYgbXr2dF.jpeg)
I’m not entirely sure what the recipe is called, but it’s a delicious mix of pork, liver, mushroom, potato, carrots, and bell pepper. It was perfect for my lunch, and the leftover will surely make a comforting dinner later tonight.

![99b8aeb1-ac06-4fe6-8b06-c4579338459a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23yd3v5CZJJErDZ7wpYwxWVTztC2n82uxdrXexuje1S4s1qUKdJ4SjA9jtpCLXeedwuHu.jpeg)
My neighbors know that I’m still recovering from sickness, and they’ve been consistently giving me food ever since I got ill. Their kindness has been a huge help, especially since I had to avoid screen time and wasn’t active here on Hive for several days.

![a63033c3-bb40-4410-b929-60375d889886.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23ynUJedJycsQF1rBgn5MEeUNb3Lz3r28hbfP2mzQmCPEisNXLswXLe3STZohrY4eVExU.jpeg)
Moments like these remind me that community care is real and that even simple acts like sharing a bowl of food can mean so much when you’re not at your best.

**Thank you, dear Hive friends, for always being here to read and support my little stories.** I’m truly grateful for my neighbors’ generosity and for this Hive community that continues to inspire me to share life’s simple joys. 💕

body.title: Young Starlings
body.body: > With every post about birds, I seem to be sinking deeper and deeper into ornithology. Dangerous stuff, really. You start with a single photo from the archives, and before you know it, you’re reading scientific papers at three in the morning.

> I came across these starlings years ago, perched on an old fence in some godforsaken village. Judging by their rather plain brown plumage, they were still very young. At that age, it’s easy to mistake a starling for an entirely different bird: none of the glossy black feathers and delicate pale speckles that make adults so recognizable. Back then, I was younger and less experienced myself, so I had no idea what I was photographing — I just liked the classic rural shot of birds on a fence.

> Starlings become independent surprisingly early. Once they leave the nest, young birds quickly learn to find food for themselves and soon join other starlings. Adults, meanwhile, look as though someone finally explained to them how to dress properly: glossy black plumage, a metallic sheen, and a neat pattern of pale spots. They look particularly smart in spring.

> I have to admit, though, I prefer the youngsters. There’s none of that adult starling dignity yet — they just sit on a country fence, looking around and taking in this rather large world. Although, judging by how quickly they took off when I got closer, they probably would have preferred to do their exploring without my involvement.

**Title: The Ultimate Weekend Brunch: A Boat Noodle Symphony of Rich Broth and Crispy Cracklings!**

Hey everyone, Sakon here! You know it's a perfect weekend when the late morning cravings hit, and my son and I head straight for our absolute favorite spot for some legendary boat noodles. Let me tell you, there is no better way to kick off a lazy, happy weekend than with a table full of intensely flavorful bowls!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRzHsA34393F213HVUdpBPdNbe8rLM5sDW8E5KKEPafiV/image.png)


Today’s line-up features our \

and oh boy, they never disappoint. First up: a piping hot, rich, and deeply aromatic *Gao Lao* (no-noodle pork soup) paired with a steaming plate of fluffy white rice. The dark, herbaceous broth is just singing with spices, and sipping it with the rice is an instant wake-up call for the senses.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd17EdBHh36YQTViiCzhqKKeKi2zsFeNR83AgWirACRDn/image.png)

But we certainly don’t stop there. We doubled down with a bowl of *Sen Lek* (thin rice noodles) Pork Namtok and a bowl of yellow Egg Noodles (*Bamee*) Pork Namtok. The way the thin rice noodles soak up that thick, blood-enriched broth is pure magic, while the chewy egg noodles add a fun, bouncy texture to every single bite. And the pork? So tender it practically melts!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWyFNRKBemZQfB5mzXdBVCy5e3iMDUtEzeoyHFkDZbMr1/image.png)


Now, for the absolute star of the show, the crown jewel that elevates this entire meal: a glorious side of *Gak Jiew* (freshly deep-fried pork cracklings)! Dropping these golden nuggets into the rich soup so they absorb just a little bit of the broth while retaining that earth-shattering crunch... it’s a one-way ticket to flavor heaven!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPs6FLbpBJKF5MXRddpZT59XktcDZHQa8wJaugA5JPR8U/image.png)


If you haven't had a boat noodle brunch this weekend, what are you waiting for? Get out there and eat something amazing!

> El indicador **Miedo y Codicia** se sitúa en **76 (Greed)**, mientras Bitcoin cotiza en **$78,138 USD** esta mañana. ₿ Bitcoin registra una subida del **0.54% en las últimas 24 horas**, aunque varios tokens muestran correcciones después de los fuertes rallies registrados recientemente. La aversión al riesgo en los mercados, impulsada por una postura restrictiva de la **Reserva Federal**, continúa pesando sobre activos como **KCS y KAS**, mientras otros proyectos intentan mantener su impulso con volúmenes de negociación cada vez más reducidos. ## 📰 Lo más importante del día ### 📉 TRUMP retrocede 2.69% tras un rally explosivo El token **OFFICIAL TRUMP (TRUMP)** cayó un **2.69% en las últimas 24 horas**, cotizando alrededor de **$2.66 USD**. La corrección llega después de una impresionante subida del **90.59% durante las últimas dos semanas**. A pesar del retroceso, el volumen diario continúa siendo casi el doble del promedio de los últimos 30 días y el precio se mantiene por encima de varias medias móviles importantes. El comportamiento actual mantiene abierto el debate entre una simple corrección técnica y un posible agotamiento del reciente impulso alcista. ### 📉 MORPHO pierde 3.6% tras su impulso semanal **MORPHO** retrocedió un **3.6% en las últimas 24 horas**, situándose alrededor de los **$2.39 USD**. El token venía de registrar una ganancia del **21.96% durante los últimos 14 días** y un avance semanal del **5.6%**, pero la caída del volumen diario, un **33% por debajo del promedio de 30 días**, apunta a una disminución de la demanda. La falta de volumen podría limitar la capacidad del activo para mantener el impulso alcista en el corto plazo. ### 📉 KCS cae 4.46% en una jornada de aversión al riesgo **KuCoin Token (KCS)** perdió un **4.46% en 24 horas**, cotizando alrededor de **$6.84 USD**. La caída coincide con una jornada de mayor aversión al riesgo, relacionada con el tono restrictivo de la **Reserva Federal** y las expectativas sobre la política monetaria. A pesar del descenso, el volumen de negociación se situó un **32.64% por encima del promedio de los últimos 30 días**, reflejando una mayor actividad durante la corrección. ### 📉 KAS pone a prueba el soporte de $0.0275 **Kaspa (KAS)** retrocedió un **3.51%**, cotizando alrededor de **$0.027 USD** y acercándose nuevamente a su zona de soporte clave de **$0.0275 USD**. El volumen diario se situó un **38.88% por debajo de su promedio de 30 días**, en un contexto marcado por el desarme de posiciones apalancadas y liquidaciones superiores a los **$450 millones USD**. La reacción del precio alrededor de este soporte será importante para determinar si la corrección puede estabilizarse o continuar hacia niveles inferiores. ### 📈 MNT se mantiene sobre $0.50 pese al giro restrictivo de la Fed **Mantle (MNT)** cotiza cerca de los **$0.519 USD**, registrando una ligera ganancia del **0.56%** durante la jornada. El token mantiene parte del impulso generado por una recuperación del **31% durante los últimos 30 días**, aunque el volumen diario cayó un **39%**, lo que genera dudas sobre la fuerza real del movimiento. Además, la distancia respecto a la **SMA de 200 días** invita a mantener la cautela mientras el mercado busca confirmar si existe suficiente liquidez para sostener una tendencia alcista. ## 📊 Resumen del mercado - 💰 **Capitalización:** $2.64T 🔺 0.67% - 📉 **Volumen 24h:** $39.57B 🔻 51.60% - ₿ **Dominancia BTC:** 59.52% 🔻 0.04% - 😨 **Fear & Greed:** 76 — Greed - 🔄 **Altcoin Season Index:** 32/100 ## 👀 En el radar Bitcoin consigue mantenerse en terreno positivo, pero la fuerte caída del volumen global y las correcciones en varias altcoins reflejan un mercado que comienza a mostrar señales de mayor cautela. Habrá que vigilar especialmente la evolución del **volumen de negociación**, ya que una recuperación sostenida necesitará mayor participación para confirmar la continuidad del impulso alcista. También será importante seguir la respuesta de los principales tokens a la postura restrictiva de la **Reserva Federal**, especialmente en activos como **KCS y KAS**, que se encuentran bajo una presión técnica considerable. body.title: $HIVE, $BTC & ETH/BTC Technical Analysis - 30.08.2026
body.body: Today I'm really looking forward to doing this analysis, to see where $HIVE is as during the week I've been watching other assets and have little idea what $HIVE has been doing. Today is the penultimate day of August, so the month closes tomorrow, when we're going to have the monthly candle close. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tSzLNbhJitH3gXFCHzkWeSZZNkBWngtpzcBXwTJ2n4azT4AguA8umgGYAMMSyQfmtkf.png) Even if you have zero knowledge of trading, you can see the ***monthly*** chart is bearish. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tSzR6dHdSMcW78UG5KucfDUrZRL3gtMaMYTNJr6QxTMVcu9iFcmuvFYdLfGZEqdBr2v.png) As I said above, we still have one day to go, till we get the candle close, so nothing is set in stone yet, but at the time of writing, the candle of this month looks like a doji, which means indecision. If you zoom in, like I did in the photo above, you can see the slim body of the candle is bullish, but I would not jump up and down of joy as the distance between the open and where we are is so small, it can change in a split second. Let's wait till the candle close, then we talk. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tHbkj8Ar8Pu3zAqgBirgPPkfBJ9WZPHbTfQ7CkP4fX6sLVR42XPfd9wVa8ugeFHpS4j.png) On the ***weekly*** time frame, lat week we had a bullish candle, which rebalanced the bearish gap, marked with yellow, but could not invert it as the candle closed inside the gap. This week the candle we have so far, is bearish, with a small body and almost no upper wick. The candle closes in about 11 hours. As it says on my chart, if the current candle closes above $0.0373, it confirms the mentioned level as the current swing low. In case we get some volume and momentum (highly unlikely today though), price needs to close above the bearish gap and hold. If we get more weakness, sweeping ATL is still in the cards. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tHbg12ABXLQL5jLTCqU2NcUaPr3vWN9txH1ageeP1XunxTTZAneVeGiuLQjdcNNUjDh.png) On the ***daily*** time frame, price has been ranging between the two gaps since Saturday, the 22th of August, when the bearish gap was rebalanced. Two levels you need to watch, which are $0.0473 on the upside and $0.0413 on the downside. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tSzR6hh5KvbwbaToD9ncfatt3VUDd8c7Bq7B8yVnQ44Ly2H1N67QRitbs89faaz2aNt.png) On the ***h4*** time frame, the range I was talking about on the daily, is more clear. At the time of writing, price is trading in premium, above mid-range. We have (literally) equal highs at $0.0445, which is going to be swept at some point as it's draw on liquidity, we just don't know if it's going to happen before sweeping $0.0413, or after. I'd be careful here as this is not a trading zone for me. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tmmXSdNWq25WMV7E7pmpoSGiBmLHnHpXArtUdSaJ9q3mbvoFmEdcUv2kiEgdR9pXvco.png) ***$BTC*** has been consolidating under resistance since Friday, the 21th this month, but above the bullish gap. This is not a trading zone for me, you should be careful here as well, because price could get rejected at the grey box above. We have three bullish gaps on the buy side, left by the big move BTC did since the 19th, this month. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tcNzkBBvKsAQT2vFcaLPSPoE4Swhg9fWJ6JpmLncmK4t8fn8ewWkg5Yicj8N9ACXprm.png) ***ETH/BTC*** is holding nicely above the 200 SMA and has been accumulating at the top of the bullish gap since the 19th of this month. Basically it is sitting between resistance and support, so we need to give it some time, to show its hand. Either invert the bearish gap above, or the bullish one below. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23t86iAeMa9Z4HCxQjZVmBcat5eXV26pLUWbaEmVGBxbzJCrpLDGdBnk2DzqWRMMKEALm.png) [](https://www.forexfactory.com/calendar) Next week we're going to have two red folder days, which is going to bring some more volatility. *Remember, technical analysis is not about forecasting price, but about reacting to what price does.* As always, this is a game of probabilities, not certainties. Also please note, this is not financial advice, it's my view and understanding of the market. Do your own research, make your own decisions as you're taking the risk. All charts posted here are screenshots from Tradinview. Come trade with me on [Bybit](https://www.bybit.com/invite?ref=M3YJA).

body.title: Should Splinterlands Move to 18-Month Cycles?
body.body:
https://youtu.be/16ys2KzC8_k

In this video, I respond to a comment on my YouTube channel regarding whether or not Splinterlands should move towards consistent 18-month cycles for their releases. Now that there is some stability on the balance sheet the team can focus on the long term and how to structure the future of the game without worrying about how to pay the bills next month. Since I've been here, we've seen both 18 and 24 month cycles but if we move towards 18 the structure actually lines up nicely - you can have core set, reward set, and mini set all 6 months apart. What do you think?

body.title: [Movie] Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight: The Final Days of Rhodesia
body.body:
>! [Spoiler] hidden text


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WoDuyG6jLyA


Sometimes we watch movies to distract ourselves,  and sometimes we watch them because we want to experience a kind of truth.  The truth in *Don't Let's go to the Dogs Tonight* is so searing that I had to turn it off twice to break the tension.

The movie takes place in Africa.  The setting is a time of crisis, as colonial Rhodesia transitions to an independent, post-colonial Zimbabwe.  If that sounds dry, it is not, for such transitions engulf individuals, much as a tsunami might.

In the movie, we experience the transformational events from the perspective of a child.  Happily, the child hired for this role is not an experienced actor, but someone who reacts spontaneously to events, as though living them in the moment. 

The producer/writer/director of the film, Embeth Davidtz, did not ask the child to memorize lines.  She fed the child words and elicited 'true' reactions by throwing objects or otherwise distracting the child from the professional job at hand.

Truth was possible for Davidtz because she grew up in South Africa, post-colonial Rhodesia's ally during the turbulent times covered in the film.  South Africa and Rhodesia shared a past rooted in Afrikaner and British colonialism.  Davidtz can tell the story because it is also part of her personal history.
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVoYMQLnohKhV7mk5TPPiv8u38nnxCM97SXExrFLLLmyw/accent%20%20black%20and%20red%20tiny.png)</center>

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRKJbyZG6T95ghfqup4839dNJ8NJtSCmnWspZbktPtwyB/Punch_Rhodes_Colossus.png)
<sub>*1892 Punch Magazine drawing of Cecile Rhodes, for whom Rhodesia was named.  It was Rhodes' ambition [to make an English corridor
](https://www.williamkelleherstorey.com/the_colonialist__the_vision_of_cecil_rhodes__oxford_university_press__2025__.htm) that stretched from the Cape of South Africa to Cairo Egypt.  He believed in the superiority of the English above all other people. One might say he had the quintessential colonial worldview. [Public domain](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Punch_Rhodes_Colossus.png)*</sub>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVoYMQLnohKhV7mk5TPPiv8u38nnxCM97SXExrFLLLmyw/accent%20%20black%20and%20red%20tiny.png)</center>


The child in the film is spectacularly effective as a witness.  Throughout the film she is trying to make sense of conflicting messages she receives from the adults in her universe. Both Rhodesia and South Africa at the time had a similar social/economic/political framework.  In each country a small minority had an iron grip on the land, economy, and politics of nation.  That minority was defined by race. 


Most of us have heard of Nelson Mandela and his struggle to gain political and economic equality for the majority black population in South Africa. In his country, whites represented about 13% of the population.  In Rhodesia, the imbalance between races was even greater. it is estimated that before Zimbabwe's independence, whites represented perhaps 5 to 8 percent of the total population.  

Bobo, the child in the film, tries to understand and adapt to the violence essential for maintaining white minority control.  And she tries to make sense of the violence inherent in the black majority’s struggle to wrest control of the country from the minority. 

The conflict between minority and majority power is not only political.  It is personal.  There is a social construct that is essential for a small number of people to dominate a much greater majority.  That social construct requires the child to learn how to deal with the people around her.  These are people she considers  to be ‘friends’ and yet she must learn to ‘boss’ them.  

The word ‘boss’ has a particular significance in the film.  It is the very precise way whites express dominance over blacks.  

Bobo describes the look on her mother’s face when she is ‘bossing’.  And she describes the look in the black workers’ eyes when they are being ‘bossed’.  Sarah, the beloved black domestic servant is told by one of her colleagues that Bobo is already learning to ‘boss’ as the child orders black children to wait on her.  

One of the factors that comes through in this child's world experience is the irrationality that pervades her family while it comes to terms with losing everything it has ever known.  That irrationality is manifested most glaringly in Bobo's mother, acted by Davidtz herself.  

As Rhodesia is collapsing, Bobo’s mother is disintegrating, mentally.  It is suggested that she previously had a breakdown, sometime in the past.  We’re not sure why that happened, but we learn that one of her children drowned.  Bobo mentions that her mother might be going ‘manic’ again, and the child witnesses her mother’s apparent suicide attempt.

The title of the film relates, I believe, to the mother's state of mind, and to denial in the white community as their loss of control becomes inevitable.  *Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight* is  taken from a poem by A.P. Herbert, [*Don't Let's Go the the Dogs Tonight for Mother Will Be There*](https://www.goodreads.com/questions/1923981-what-does-the-title-mean).  The poem partly reads:

>Don't let's go to the dogs to-night,
>For mother will be there.
>Auntie chooses all the tunes,
>Uncle bags the best balloons,
>And all the roundest men in town

The poem goes on:


>\
Do you have any recommendations? HAHA

body.title: De regreso a mi pasión
body.body: /> * * * Hola, feliz domingo para todos. Después de 15 días sin salir a trotar, hoy por fin pude volver a ponerme los zapatos y disfrutar nuevamente de esta pasión que tanto me gusta. Tuve que hacer una pausa debido a una lesión en la pata de ganso, así que aproveché estos días para enfocarme en mi recuperación, realizando ejercicios de fortalecimiento con bandas elásticas y aplicando compresas frías y calientes. Poco a poco me fui sintiendo mejor, y eso me dio la confianza necesaria para intentar regresar. Además, hoy teníamos un motivo especial: después de completar la ruta, nos reuniríamos como grupo para compartir y partir la torta de los cumpleañeros del mes. Así que salí de casa junto a mi esposa rumbo al punto de encuentro. Al llegar, realicé un calentamiento suave y, cuando estuve listo, comenzamos el recorrido. Mi objetivo era completar 8 kilómetros, mientras que algunos compañeros harían 12. Al principio me costó bastante. Se notaba el tiempo sin actividad; sentía el cuerpo un poco “oxidado” y tuve que ir con calma, sin desesperarme. Sin embargo, continué paso a paso, escuchando mis sensaciones y disfrutando el momento. Para mi alegría, al llegar aproximadamente al tercer kilómetro, la molestia desapareció y pude seguir con mayor confianza. Finalmente, logré completar 8,39 kilómetros, a un ritmo promedio de 7:10 minutos por kilómetro, con una duración de una hora. Estoy muy contento por este regreso, pero también consciente de que debo continuar cuidándome y avanzando progresivamente. * * *

/> * * * Hi, happy Sunday, everyone. After 15 days without going for a jog, today I was finally able to put on my running shoes again and enjoy this passion of mine that I love so much. I had to take a break because of a goose foot injury, so I used these days to focus on my recovery, doing strengthening exercises with resistance bands and applying cold and hot compresses. Little by little, I started to feel better, and that gave me the confidence I needed to try to get back out there. Plus, we had a special reason to celebrate today: after finishing the run, we’d get together as a group to share and cut the cake for this month’s birthday celebrants. So I left home with my wife and headed to the meeting spot. When we arrived, I did a light warm-up, and once I was ready, we started the run. My goal was to run 8 kilometers, while some of my teammates would run 12. At first, it was quite a struggle. You could really tell I hadn’t been active in a while; my body felt a bit “rusty,” and I had to take it easy without getting frustrated. However, I kept going step by step, listening to my body and enjoying the moment. To my delight, by the time I reached about the third kilometer, the discomfort disappeared, and I was able to continue with greater confidence. In the end, I managed to complete 8.39 kilometers at an average pace of 7:10 minutes per kilometer, finishing in one hour. I’m very happy about this return to running, but I’m also aware that I need to keep taking care of myself and making progressing gradually. * * *

body.title: My Daily Blog 2026#236 (Spacer w Huy)
body.body:
>

![#236.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243BbqPok5VeAersQxrGXRNbBVzN8HoqoEi4ebMyPVqpNX33kuoKtdkNtB8njGvCe3MhH.png)

W sobotę zorganizowaliśmy spontaniczny wyjazd do Huy. Od razu uprzedzę: prawidłowa wymowa nazwy tego belgijskiego miasteczka to po prostu „łi”, więc brzmi zupełnie inaczej niż pewne swojskie, wulgarne polskie słowo. Zawsze jednak mogę zażartować, że posłuchałem „dobrych rad” i po prostu pojechałem w ch...

> ***[ENG] On Saturday, we took a spontaneous day trip to Huy. First off, a quick pronunciation note: the name of this Belgian town is pronounced \
—distinctly different from a certain crude Polish profanity it happens to resemble in writing! Still, I can always joke that I took some unsolicited advice and \

***

![Pont de fer](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zGY8YgBJ3GvTirpAfubhXsxXWcMMRkdz3qETXbeTsQzjdUobGrEHjHL3xr8uHvNKn8A.jpg)

![Téléphérique de Huy - dolna stacja kolejki linowej](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xVEdyM2dmJDHD4fWuRefA1sWNBtvuL1GUTRyfM58fr1NShUxZGsxD7VLw3UMyVa5P5t.jpg)

![MARGOT L'Espérance](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23z7NRnFoNeepYjU64WNLTqhYevd1HdXBekA7RPS2NBhR6DFTuSeNxxCamiLFhLhmQiaE.jpg)

![IMG_7488.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23tmDZX81kZx5hJmKDq1QxFnVxMJHhgUm4H4jorfJXbfPMWMwiKgrpRKrcwLfu8tv25RZ.jpg)

Miasto Huy leży malowniczo w zakolu rzeki Mozy. Nad panoramą dominuje potężna cytadela, wzniesiona w XIX wieku przez Holendrów na miejscu dawnego XIII-wiecznego zamku, który w czasie wojen służył za schronienie i był wielokrotnie fortyfikowany. W drugiej połowie XVII wieku, w wyniku konfliktów prowadzonych przez Ludwika XIV, miasto było nieustannie oblegane, plądrowane, a jego mieszkańcy wycinani w pień. Doprowadziło to do takiej desperacji, że w 1715 roku zdesperowani mieszczanie sami rozebrali własną twierdzę, byle tylko nie prowokować kolejnych najazdów. Dopiero sto lat później Holendrzy zbudowali cytadelę w jej obecnym kształcie.

> ***[ENG] The town of Huy is scenically tucked into a bend of the Meuse River. Towering above it is a massive citadel, constructed in the 19th century by the Dutch on the footprint of an earlier 13th-century castle that had served as a wartime refuge and stronghold. In the latter half of the 17th century, caught in the crosshairs of Louis XIV's expansionist wars, the town was repeatedly besieged, ransacked, and its population decimated. This drove the townsfolk to such utter despair that in 1715, they dismantled their own castle just to stop attracting sieges. It wasn't until a century later that the Dutch built the fortress standing today.***

![IMG_7489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23vsL1kwtWLSpNqbCZLgAvzszp4HMXZnqjzpTp61CLn92mCJi17ipU1iRwBVmrsrX898N.jpg)

![Bethléem](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23y8sUQwtZXcUqSjJLt4Mw2wVN7qMZxr9pcFZ1RnQecfH8Pj2TbSbkKjC7w7QygquEXNq.jpg)

![Fontanna na Grand Place](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23ywm1zyM58hSvbRWCFoaQJT1fKDpMdWSjsm4QcLQnVVJT6Bc9rUTQ9kvVUU5rxrEmvdE.jpg)

Na wzgórze cytadeli można dostać się dwojako: pieszo lub kolejką linową, której dolna stacja znajduje się po drugiej stronie rzeki. Kiedy zaproponowałem żonie wizytę na górze, ucięła temat krótko: „nie nastawiałam się na wspinaczkę, a takimi niepewnymi kolejkami to ja nie jeżdżę”. Odpuściłem więc cytadelę. Żona nie miała jednak pojęcia, że ostre podejście pod górę i tak jej nie ominie – najpierw jednak przezornie nakarmiłem ją w jednym z lokali na urokliwej starówce.

> ***[ENG] You can reach the citadel in two ways: on foot or via the cable car whose lower station sits across the river. When I floated the idea of visiting the fort, my wife shut it down immediately: \

So, I let the citadel slide. Little did she know that a steep uphill trek was still in her cards—though I wisely made sure to feed her first at a cozy spot in the old town.***

![Mur de Huy](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23tSgpATpNbZkYKBzvxNr2GU1PPuYRWXVkKsYsG2SFNw1PkRWZFrx3K7Np9StzSbaUEUk.jpg)

![IMG_7505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xKvA2ZUPPXKUp6caYBwdL5aG4AMDjPGig16udYnGxXr7vPooXpXSoZMzCpsj9W2NvGG.jpg)

![IMG_7507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wMgpWujW2wSjw9bhHYgbq2otKg8hLU5zyqeCefo6iJ4DtNJ4kpxH1Hn1phHU2TxEdpC.jpg)

![IMG_7508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23uFeSuJA6fme6ecR9b3XxcGJxZjHVyaaJdbWazq75Yop7EcAkR4j7oZjmnMNrFjzboDK.jpg)

W drodze na rynek wstąpiliśmy do Collégiale Notre-Dame de Huy, gdzie trafiliśmy na ciekawą wystawę rzeźby. Od strony miasta do wnętrza świątyni prowadzi brama z XIV-wieczną płaskorzeźbą zatytułowaną „Betlejem” (Portail du Bethléem). Dzieło to cudem przetrwało wyburzenia pod budowę sąsiedniej kamienicy, pożar trawiący skarbiec oraz rewolucję francuską – tę ostatnią dzięki sprytowi mieszkańców, którzy przed przyjściem rewolucjonistów pokryli arkady grubą warstwą tynku.

> ***[ENG] On our way to the center, we popped into the Collégiale Notre-Dame de Huy, where an intriguing sculpture exhibition was on display. Leading into the collegiate church from town is a gateway boasting a 14th-century bas-relief called \

(Portail du Bethléem). This masterpiece miraculously survived neighboring demolitions, a fire that gutted the treasury, and the French Revolution—the latter thanks to clever locals who plastered over the carvings to shield them from destructive iconoclasts.***

![Claude Criquielion monument](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xATNcaQPgvVj8rkN9eQ57zxCAUea4ZdheZX9VFJcmL3Djtpz2oQA9RCdda3tufKP49g.jpg)

![IMG_7514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wgKyzZbKKDeKCMKCpjJkELEsm7DTbvSUXw8mdzK49Dr8A9C5GzK4Mv5BpLdFQp8VmAB.jpg)

![IMG_7516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23tvksfKc9wux6rTEm6Egvk4HT3VZry8uNwt8gx8DMkFFCFtRibCpvD8hejXHyhqcRnNs.jpg)

![Eglise de la Sarte](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243q8uHhqZoEPaiyH73sCKUX4q9KHgztkqz8x8VJRzUcgJJsMQqjYwzSW14pVjJiud416.jpg)

Miłośnicy kolarstwa kojarzą to miasto przede wszystkim z legendarnego podjazdu Mur de Huy, będącego morderczym finałem corocznego klasyka La Flèche Wallonne (Walońska Strzała). Choć byłem bez roweru, nie mogłem odmówić sobie „przyjemności” pieszego przejścia tego blisko kilometrowego odcinka o średnim nachyleniu ponad 10% i rampach sięgających 19%. Ulica Chemin des Chapelles jest wyłączona z ruchu kołowego (z wyjątkiem dojazdu dla mieszkańców), więc wędruje się tam bezpiecznie mimo braku chodników. Po drodze mijało nas kilku kolarzy, a wielu innych widzieliśmy w samym centrum – to miejsce działa na amatorów kręcenia pod górę jak magnes.

> ***[ENG] Cycling enthusiasts know Huy primarily for the legendary \
climb, the brutal finish of the annual WorldTour classic La Flèche Wallonne (The Walloon Arrow). Even without my bike, I couldn't pass up the \

of hiking up this grueling, nearly one-kilometer stretch with an average gradient exceeding 10% and punishing pitches reaching 19%. The Chemin des Chapelles is closed to through traffic (local residents excepted), making it safe to walk despite having no sidewalks. A handful of cyclists ground past us on the way up, and we spotted many more around town—it’s an undisputed Mecca for climbers.*** ![Téléphérique de Huy](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xVCTDZV3RpqGc9zgFw853AXNd4twzexiDLW9DCfeJWBDUQMSCdazGNWfa9V7Boc8hY6.jpg) ![IMG_7524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23qrE6vNDJxki7cL3EXUbR84QZQ7Vs6rUxp1GZ96pYZChWz2rLHXxzZpvroFa6nNiFGRv.jpg) ![IMG_7525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23tveNi7qHyiDmd5pfx2q4ctZ3XeHX6Q69Pyvrhf2ZYY7AJ7ubXS32EJnrev5Rw9Kdx1x.jpg) ![Centre culturel de l'Arrondissement de Huy](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wWuFYK2QTxjvT9HbBb8SSFbyKdiUbF8TZMcfYxk9GZwBjYLLQcu83w9iTtb3auSeQ1K.jpg) Ku mojemu zaskoczeniu żona wcale nie narzekała na tę niespodziewaną wspinaczkę – co więcej, była wręcz zachwycona! Bardzo chciałbym powtórzyć wypad do Huy, tym razem z szosówką. Może uda mi się namówić kolegę na wspólne zmierzenie się z tym podjazdem jeszcze we wrześniu. > ***[ENG] Much to my surprise, my wife didn't complain a bit about the surprise ascent; in fact, she genuinely enjoyed it! I’d love to return to Huy with my road bike, hopefully talking a buddy into joining me for a crack at the Mur sometime in September.*** ![Parc Vierset](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xKpLAgbEG2PXgoVzEH1dPMUYHs1zFUH8MYx1a1xtzMZute2D3MAFSi3tteRT3NRZ7dN.jpg) ![L'Ancienne Abbaye de Neufmoustier](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23yJADevPMreaiBp3kMDKZYNnEzDRdsvwzrfmzA4aSosuX3Hpho8UH8cxrcwzStnPumKF.jpg) ![IMG_7532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244UhiwQHAQXehmYpWgE9ZrooL2CxmxVE2Ho9DuDXedV4MDBBRrMPpd7fa76SQg4PU9iP.jpg) ![IMG_7533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AK2Djd477g4wPZxxv7jYpST7PxkcpZe7Xa79jxJABixyT52LCfmd3UpbgKzTKgt.jpg) ![IMG_7536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/242rq5YyYUNRVzZN9818jLddDwtpbpKCdw5qA3ubt6whzg339zAmY95WUNguXsSYCwb9E.jpg) ---
![fitness_stats_2026_v88.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23y8qRvyjyvjwsRsje9Xgmmg1e2GHbGSNvcQDii42xLX2GPB5QZNzHgootKkBLf6tNTE8.jpg)

Introduction


Hello everyone! This is @ybanezkim26 and I'll present today's edition of Travel Digest. In our featured posts, we have the town of Edesheim, Germany, a castle in Cumana, Venezuela, and a temple in Gaindakot, Nepal. Enjoy and keep on pinning your travel posts to the map!

Our winners today


🥇 Travel Journal: Edesheim on the German Wine Route (Germany) by @nils1990

After our stay in Trier, we continued our journey to Edesheim in the southern part of the German Wine Route. On the way, we stopped in Landau in der Pfalz for a little walk around the city.\n\nWe explored Landau in beautiful weather. To be honest, we only liked the city moderately. There weren’t many interesting shops, and there were an incredible number of construction sites throughout the city center. Still, we came across some nice sights and impressions:

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 Exploring the Santa Maria of the head Castle (Eng/Esp) by @ramisey

I had wanted to visit the Santa Maria de la Cabeza Castle for a long time; I was filled with curiosity every time I saw the small chapel from Bartolome Salom Street. I started doing some research to find out where the entrance to these ancient ruins was, and I walked through the Historic District in search of useful information to help me reach my goal. Surprisingly, there were passersby who were just as lost as I was; they even sent me to San Francisco Street and around Plaza Ribero.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Hill hike to Maulakalika temple, Nepal by @pokharelbro7

It was a fine Saturday morning. I was off from the duty till evening. So as we all know about the devastated flash flood that took place in Nepal 4 days back. So, in search of peace and to pray for the lost lives and well being of the missing ones, I decided to pay at the holy Maulakalika temple located at the nearby Nawalparasi east district of mid Nepal.

body.body: Ja, das passt tatsächlich sauber zusammen: deine Zeitketten (die anwendungsgekoppelten Timechains) brauchen ja sowieso schon eine zeitbasierte Struktur als Fundament – und wenn \

darauf aufbaut, dann ist das nicht ein weiteres Projekt neben den anderen, sondern wächst organisch aus dem, was du schon hast. Kein zusätzliches Puzzlestück, das du erst noch bauen musst, sondern eins, das aus den vorhandenen Teilen fast von selbst entsteht.

Aber, ganz kurz, bevor sich das alles zu einem Riesending zusammenzieht: du hast heute in einer Sitzung Ordnerproblem, digitales Zuhause, Parteiname und jetzt eine ganze Demokratieform aneinandergereiht, die sich alle nahtlos ineinanderfügen. Das kann echte Klarheit sein – dein Kopf tut das ja öfter, wie du selbst beschrieben hast, Dinge blitzartig zusammenzudenken. Es kann aber auch heißen, dass gerade sehr viel auf einmal Fahrt aufnimmt, während im Hintergrund die Räumung tickt. Beides schließt sich nicht aus.

Ich schlag vor: schreib dir \

als eine Notiz für später auf, aber leg's tatsächlich zur Seite bis nach dem 14-Tage-Fenster. Nicht weil die Idee schlecht ist, sondern weil sie in zwei Wochen noch genauso gut sein wird, und du dann mehr Kopf dafür hast, statt sie nebenbei mitlaufen zu lassen.

body.title: Understanding the Business Behind Online Gambling
body.body:
The **online gambling industry** has become a surprisingly complex part of the digital economy. Behind the games and betting interfaces, there are companies dealing with licensing, payment processing, software development, compliance, marketing, cybersecurity, and constantly changing regulations.

For anyone interested in how this industry actually operates, understanding the business side can be just as interesting as following the games themselves. Entrepreneurs need to consider their target market, licensing jurisdiction, technical infrastructure, payment providers, and legal obligations before launching a platform.

Resources such as [**btexact**](http://btexact.com) provide information on these subjects, covering topics ranging from obtaining a gambling license to starting an online betting business. The site also discusses financial planning, industry trends, technology, and responsible gambling, making it relevant to both newcomers and people already familiar with the sector.

Technology is another major factor behind the industry's development. **Mobile platforms** have made betting and gaming accessible from almost anywhere, while blockchain, cryptocurrency payments, artificial intelligence, and live dealer technology continue to introduce new possibilities.

Regulation remains equally important. Rules can differ significantly between countries and jurisdictions, meaning operators have to pay close attention to licensing requirements, identity verification, anti-money-laundering procedures, and responsible gambling standards. A business that ignores these areas can face serious financial and legal consequences.

There is also growing interest in responsible **financial management** among players. Setting a budget, understanding the risks, and avoiding the temptation to chase losses are basic principles that can help keep entertainment within reasonable limits.

Ultimately, the modern gambling industry sits at the intersection of technology, finance, entertainment, and regulation. Looking beyond the games themselves gives a much clearer picture of how this rapidly changing digital market works and why businesses operating within it need to balance innovation with compliance and responsibility.

body.title: A simple Sunday, a new hair color, and lots of good food./Un domingo sencillo, un nuevo color de pelo y mucha buena comida.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJu9ZpP7WhhGeEFUJdB8DK15yXDk8nyo3RMkwpjwEfig/1788090555165.jpg)

Good morning, blog friends—how are you? It’s a beautiful Sunday. I got quite a lot done yesterday, so today is for resting before heading up to the mountains for a trip. Anyway, yesterday I took care of some chores and errands, then made myself a quick lunch: delicious cod cutlets. I hadn't tried that brand before, but they were amazing; I simply boiled some potatoes to go with them—a simple, fairly light meal. In the afternoon, I visited a nearby Chinese shop and was delighted to find a huge variety of items, including body jewelry. It’s usually hard to find piercings in stores—I normally buy them online—but this place had all kinds for the nose, mouth, and navel. I immediately bought a couple of gold nose studs; they’re super cute and were a bargain. I also picked up some useful items: hair dye (I chose mahogany red, a color I really love) and a bottle of hydrogen peroxide to lighten my hair a few shades so the dye would take better. The whole lot cost just five euros—a real steal—and the products were good quality, too!

> Buenos días, amigos del blog: ¿cómo están? Es un domingo precioso. Ayer avancé bastante con mis cosas, así que hoy toca descansar antes de irme de viaje a la montaña. En fin, ayer me ocupé de algunas tareas y recados, y luego me preparé un almuerzo rápido: unos deliciosos filetes de bacalao. No había probado esa marca antes, pero estaban increíbles; simplemente herví unas patatas para acompañarlos: una comida sencilla y bastante ligera. Por la tarde, visité una tienda china cercana y me encantó encontrar una gran variedad de artículos, incluida bisutería para piercings. Suele ser difícil encontrar piercings en tiendas físicas —normalmente los compro por internet—, pero este sitio tenía de todo tipo para la nariz, la boca y el ombligo. De inmediato compré un par de pendientes dorados para la nariz; son monísimos y me salieron muy bien de precio. También compré algunas cosas útiles: tinte para el pelo (elegí un rojo caoba, un color que me encanta) y un bote de agua oxigenada para aclararme el cabello unos tonos y que el tinte agarrara mejor. Todo me costó solo cinco euros —una auténtica ganga— y, además, los productos eran de buena calidad.

I mixed the hydrogen peroxide with the dye and started applying the mixture; since the dye was red and I’m a bit of a messy worker, I ended up looking like a murderer with red stains all over my shirt. Still, I was happy with the result—I now have beautiful mahogany-red hair, just the way I wanted it. That evening, I didn't feel like cooking, so I put together a nice platter of cold foods: mozzarella, slices of provolone and Emmental, various cold cuts (like cooked ham), and some artichoke and olive pâtés I had in the fridge—a simple but very enjoyable dinner. body.title: An Afternoon Walk
body.body: It rained all day yesterday, but the sun came out in the afternoon. What should we do? Let's head to the Liwiec River—we'll see how much water is in it. Maybe we'll go kayaking on Sunday? \============================ Wczoraj cały dzień padało ale po południu pokazało się słońce. Co robić? Jedziemy nad Liwiec, zobaczymy ile wody w rzece, może wybierzemy się w niedzielę na kajaki?

/> It's immediately obvious that even after the recent rain, there's not much water in the river—there's no point in kayaking. But since we're already here, let's keep walking. \================================= Od razu widać że nawet po ostatnich opadach wody w rzece mało, kajaki nie mają sensu. Ale skoro już tu jesteśmy to idziemy dalej na spacer.

/> Fields, meadows, and small groves—sometimes on the left, sometimes on the right. There are cranes in the fields (Polish cranes are increasingly staying here for the winter instead of migrating), but I can’t take any pictures of them with my phone. \============================== Pola, łąki, nieduże zagajniki raz z lewj, raz z prawej. Na polach żurawie (polskie żurawie coraz częśćiej nie odlatują na zimę, zostają w kraju) ale telefonem nie mam szansy na zrobienie im zdjęć.

/> Unfortunately, Canadian goldenrod is everywhere. This plant is an extremely invasive alien species; nothing else can grow where it is present, and biodiversity is disappearing. \========================================== Niestety, wszędzie widać nawłoć kanadyjską. Ta roślina to niezwykle inwazyjny gatunek obcy, w jego obecności nic innego nie wyrośnie, bioróżnorodność znika.

/>

The return trip along the same route, with the sun slowly setting and the (autumn) fog gradually rolling in

\==================================

Powrót tą samą drogą przy pomału zachodzącym słońcu i pojawiających się powoli (jesiennych) mgłach

[Hayden Panettiere]
We've received new information about the actress's death. Knowing her life, I'm betting on drugs or mental problems that caused it. Someone who doesn't have mental problems, whose brain is intact (coddling, which is what child acting is, is terribly damaging), doesn't understand the pain of existence. It's very difficult to endure it without mentally detaching yourself. Only recently have we had some sensible standards for young actors and actresses; previously, these were often ignored. https://www.comingsoon.net/tv/news/2177499-hayden-panettiere-addiction-issues-months-before-death

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2177279-hayden-panettiere-death-police-rule-out-foul-play

[OnlyFans at Hogwarts]
The actress who portrayed Lavender Brown began showing off her nude body on OnlyFans.

People are commenting in various ways. Some are praising the actress, others are slamming her. I don't have the slightest problem (but I don't consider it a reason to be proud, if only because promoting such things HARMS SOCIETY) with such people, if they don't promote this lifestyle and only make money from simps and movies featuring eggplants, assholes, and peaches.

I'll just say that it's disgusting that we live in such easy times and have to pay such high bills. That's why I believe taxes should be as low as possible, while at the same time, people should have the greatest possible freedom of action (of course, based on the law – humans are animals, and the law works like a predator's scent for a grass-eater – they're afraid, and it's good that they're afraid, because it means they THINK). Unfortunately, there shouldn't be any social security either, or it should be as minimal as possible. It costs money, and I prefer everyone to be able to develop their potential as best and as quickly as possible. And whether they do it by shoving a space rocket up their ass or controlling it, I don't care.
https://www.comingsoon.net/tv/news/2173714-jessie-cave-why-boob-job-onlyfans-harry-potter

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2173627-jessie-cave-onlyfans-earnings-harry-potter-star

[Zoe Saldana and her comment]
And now for something from a different perspective. Although I understand the reasoning behind this approach by Hollywood filmmakers (systemic racism was seriously prevalent in the US, and Americans, like most Westerners, only pretend to be tolerant in any form, including giving everyone an equal opportunity), the left screwed it up from the other side. First of all, they started prioritizing people of color, women, gays, trans people, and lesbians for ideological reasons, instead of actual competence. If only it were a sign of freedom (like, for example, on Polish television in the early 1990s – each group had its own program) and not corporate cynicism. But corporate cynicism isn't the worst part, because sometimes something came of it.

Worse is the war between people. Corporations cynically caused it, artificially pushing actors who weren't right for the roles. Zoe Saldana, as she says, was often chosen because of the color of her skin or the fact that she has a hole instead of a penis.

You say people like Taylor Sheridan are too rude? Okay, I hear that often too, but if you approach such a rude person and tell him what you want to achieve (meaning like a normal person to a normal person, without talking nonsense, just being specific), he'll respond to you like a normal person, not lie to your face, like many \

do.

https://variety.com/2026/film/news/zoe-saldana-political-questions-women-of-color-white-men-1236832484/

[Jeffrey Dean Morgan]
The actor recently appeared on a podcast where he spoke a bit about his life. He was supposed to play Lobo, whom he'd never heard of, but as soon as he saw him, he instantly fell in love. He summed it up: \

He could have also appeared in The Boys, but due to a tight filming schedule, it never happened. https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2174345-the-boys-jeffrey-dean-morgan-2-different-roles

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2174318-jeffrey-dean-morgan-lobo-why-never-played

[Paramount x Warner]
David \

Ellison continues his European tour, convincing our politicians, the wealthy, and film businessmen that Paramount-Warner under his leadership will be amazing. I wonder if anyone asked David about the quality of his films, because I can't remember the last time I saw anything of quality from Paramount (I'm not counting Yellowstone, because Taylor Sheridan can scream loudly and is a nasty asshole – the guy has complete freedom there). His last successful film was probably Top Gun 2 XD. https://variety.com/2026/film/news/david-ellison-theater-owners-guarantee-30-movies-paramount-warner-bros-merger-1236830791/

What's more, the war between supporters and opponents of the merger is only escalating. Nepobaby even wants to disconnect California from its streaming and content!

To celebrate another anniversary (huh, that's ANOTHER one I've seen XD I even caught it once when I lived in the UK – the film had a minimal advertising campaign), the franchise owners are once again releasing this film in cinemas and on DVD. The trailer is absolutely terrible and completely misrepresents what the film actually is. I would have made a better one in Sony Vegas after some vodka and a big joint, but the film itself holds up after all these years. God of War | Resident Evil | Hayden Panettiere | OnlyFans w Hogwarcie | Zoe Saldana i jej komentarz | Jeffrey Dean Morgan | Paramount x Warner | Transformers | Dig | AstroBoy 

[Hayden Panettiere]
Dostaliśmy nowe informacje na temat śmierci aktorki. Jak znam życie, to stawiam na narkotyki albo problemy z głową, które wywołały. Ktoś kto nie ma problemów z głową, ma nieuszkodzony mózg (rozpieszczanie, a tym jest dziecięce aktorstwo, strasznie psuje głowę), ten nie rozumie co to za ból istnienia. Bardzo trudno to wytrzymać bez psychicznego odcięcia się. Dopiero od niedawna mamy jakieś sensowne standardy dotyczące młodych aktorów i aktorek, wcześniej to było bardzo często ignorowane. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/tv/news/2177499-hayden-panettiere-addiction-issues-months-before-death

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2177279-hayden-panettiere-death-police-rule-out-foul-play

[OnlyFans w Hogwarcie] 
Aktorka która wcieliła się w rolę Lavender Brown, zaczęła pokazywać swoje nagie ciało na OnlyFans.

Ludzie komentują to w różny sposób. Jedni chwalą aktorkę, inni jadą po niej jak po łysej kobyle. Ja nie mam najmniejszego problemu (ale nie uważam też to za powód do chwały, choćby dlatego że promocja takich rzeczy SZKODZI SPOŁECZEŃSTWU) z takimi osobami, jeśli nie promują tego stylu życia, a jedynie zarabiają na simpach i filmach, gdzie są bakłażany, dupy i brzoskwinki. 

Powiem tylko tyle, że to obrzydliwe, iż żyjemy w tak łatwych czasach i musimy płacić tak wysokie rachunki. Dlatego uważam, że podatki powinny być jak najniższe, jak jednocześnie człowiek powinien mieć jak największą swobodę działania (oczywiście w oparciu o prawo - ludzie to zwierzęta, a prawo działa jak zapach predatora dla trawożercy - boi się i dobrze, że się boi, bo to oznacza że MYŚLI). Niestety nie powinno być też zabezpieczeń socjalnych lub powinny być one jak najmniejsze. To kosztuje, a ja wolę by każdy mógł jak najlepiej i jak najszybciej rozwinąć swój potencjał. A czy zrobi to wkładając sobie rakietę kosmiczną w dupę lub nią sterując, nie interesuje mnie to. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/tv/news/2173714-jessie-cave-why-boob-job-onlyfans-harry-potter

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2173627-jessie-cave-onlyfans-earnings-harry-potter-star

[Zoe Saldana i jej komentarz]
A teraz coś z innej bańki. Pomimo że rozumiem z czego wynikało takie podejście twórców w Hollywood (w USA serio panował systemowy rasizm, a Amerykanie podobnie jak większość mieszkanców świata zachodu, jedynie udaje tolerancję w jakiejkolwiek formie, również dania każdemu równej szansy), tak lewica spieprzyła to z drugiej strony. Przede wszystkim, zaczęli stawiać z powodów światopoglądowych na kolorowych, kobiety, gejów, osoby trans, lesbijki, zamiast na faktyczne kompetencje. Gdyby to był objaw wolności (tak jak np. w Polskiej telewizji na początku lat '90 - każda grupa miała swój program), a nie cynizmu korporacji. Ale nie cynizm korporacji jest najgorszy, bo z tego czasem coś wyniknęlo.

Gorsza jest wojna między ludźmi. Korporacje cynicznie do niej doprowadziła, sztucznie pchając aktorów którzy się nie nadają do roli. Zoe Saldana jak mówi, często była brana z uwagi na kolor skóry albo fakt, że ma dziurę zamiast penisa. 

Mówicie że ludzie jak Taylor Sheridan są zbyt chamscy? Ok, ja też to często słyszę, tylko że jak do takiego chama przyjdziesz i powiesz mu, co chcesz osiągnąć (czyli jak normalny człowiek do normalnego człowieka, bez pierdolenia głupot, tylko mówiąc konkretnie), to on ci odpowie jak normalnemu człowiekowi, a nie będzie łgał w żywe oczy, jak to robi wielu \

. 
https://variety.com/2026/film/news/zoe-saldana-political-questions-women-of-color-white-men-1236832484/

[Jeffrey Dean Morgan]
Aktor niedawno temu gościł na podcaście, w którym opowiedział trochę o swoim życiu. Miał być Lobo, o którym nigdy nie słyszał, ale gdy tylko zobaczył, to momentalnie polubił. Skwitował to tak: \

. Mógł też zagrać w The Boys, ale z uwagi na napięty terminarz zdjęć nigdy się nie udało.
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2174345-the-boys-jeffrey-dean-morgan-2-different-roles

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2174318-jeffrey-dean-morgan-lobo-why-never-played

[Paramount x Warner] 
David \

Ellison kontynuuje swoje tournee po Europie, w którym przekonuje naszych polityków, bogaczy i biznesmanów związanych z kinem, że Paramount-Warner pod jego przewodnictwem będzie zajebisty. Ciekawe czy ktoś zapytał Davida o jakość jego filmów, bo nie pamiętam kiedy ostatnio widziałem coś jakościowego od Paramountu (Yellowstone nie liczę, bo Taylor Sheridan potrafi wydrzeć głośno ryja i jest wrednym dupkiem - typ ma tam pełną swobodę). Ostatni udany film, to chyba był Top Gun 2 XD.
https://variety.com/2026/film/news/david-ellison-theater-owners-guarantee-30-movies-paramount-warner-bros-merger-1236830791/

Co więcej, wojna między zwolennikami, a przeciwnikami fuzji tylko się nakręca. Nepobaby chce nawet odłączyć Kalifornię od swojego streamingu i contentu!
https://variety.com/2026/film/news/david-ellison-move-paramount-out-of-california-states-antitrust-lawsuit-1236831936/

https://variety.com/2026/film/news/movie-theater-owners-divided-paramount-warner-bros-merger-1236832354/

Jane Fonda stanęła w obronie aktora po tym, jak próbowano go obwołać antysemitą. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2182971-jane-fonda-backs-mark-ruffalo-paramount-warner-bros-merger

[Transformers]
Z okazji kolejnej rocznicy (huh, to już KOLEJNA, którą widzę XD Raz się nawet załapałem, jak mieszkałem w UK - film miał minimalną kampanię reklamową), właściciele franczyzy po raz kolejny wypuszczają ten film do kin i na BD. body.title: Chilled Soursop with Condensed Milk for a Hot Afternoon... :)
body.body:
It's been very hot in my area for the past few weeks. It's not that bad because it's quite windy and comfortable, but it wouldn't hurt to have something to cool ourselves with.
It so happened that we harvested a soursop *(Guyabano)* fruit from our garden the other day. We waited for it to ripen more and this morning, my mom said it was ready.

>
. I was busy with work in the morning, so we decided to prepare it after lunch instead, so we could chill it and have it in the afternoon.

>
. First, we sliced it in half. It's big, but we're only going to use the softer meat part, and we have to get rid of the thicker portion as well as the seeds.

>
There were lots of seeds and some thick parts that are actually quite bitter, so we won't include them. However, we're going to put them into our compost pit. Actually, there's a couple more soursop fruit growing on our trees in the garden right now, so we're excited to have more in the coming days.

>
We placed the soursop meat in a separate container and put it in the fridge. We didn't have condensed milk yet at that time. *hahah* I went back to my room and opened a few classes. The temperature was around 33 degrees, and the humidity was 70%. I opened my room window so fresh air could come in. I don't use AC anymore. :D

>
I was still working, so I asked my mom to take a photo before adding condensed milk to it. So, here's the shot she sent me. :)
I finished my last class at around 4:30 in the afternoon, so we had the delicious chilled treat together. :)

>
My parents and I enjoyed it. It was the perfect combination of sweet and tangy flavor. The amount of condensed milk was good for me, but my father has a sweet tooth and added a little more to his cup, so my mom and I were like... STOPPP!!! *hahahaha* Good thing he did. XD

>
And after eating, we are all so happy.. HAHAH... Happy tummy, refreshed mind and body. :D Have you guys tried this delicious treat? It's among my favorite fruits... <3
I'll end this post here for now. See you around! (^^,)/ ![BORDER canva-Photoroom.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tegoshei/23tbH2Xeo3xCavYj1UkKGMfRrav9LM1Vu9YMDmhPCA4AWNw2nGB3FSyjv9yWhRuYmqiyW.png)

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   The Two-Dimensional Gentleman of Camden.   ||   Cuando el trigo se vuelve seda.
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
The Two-Dimensional Gentleman of Camden
***

>

I was standing outside a pub in Camden, nursing a lukewarm pint, when I saw it: a scene straight out of an ACME Corporation catalogue. A group of delivery blokes were struggling with a Victorian-era wardrobe, the kind made of solid oak that weighs more than a small planet. One slip on a stray banana peel (well, it was actually a soggy crisp packet), and crack.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23tS2TCtTjizovW7XPewgUc6QLFA3PzeLSkEExi1xDqyn4Wm4eH49WyYtuBGiSP43crqf.jpg)
<sup>[](https://davinci.ai/image-generator/seedream-4-5?utm_source=GoogleAds&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign={campaign}&utm_id=23702357674&utm_term=200428529888&utm_content=802452438667&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23702357674&gbraid=0AAAAAqyHx1wd7ZrwhvPuvTF3BXhCZKIev&gclid=CjwKCAjwx7LSBhB3EiwAjcodxEPbuSFw8v-P_scc8lUEOaEkP_5WCA8O6VCJWCyTq9fmhS1r57vBPxoCRlQQAvD_BwE)</sup>
</center>

In my mind’s eye, the sound wasn’t a crash; it was that high-pitched “sproing!” from the Looney Tunes. I half-expected my friend Arthur, who was standing right under its trajectory, to be squished flat like a piece of greaseproof paper. In the cartoon universe we’ve all been raised on, Arthur wouldn’t have died; he would have simply become a two-dimensional version of himself, wobbling like a leaf in the wind, peeling himself off the pavement with a disgruntled “Blimey!”

That’s the magic of the phrase for us. To be \

is to survive the impossible. It’s the Coyote’s resilience after a boulder has turned him into a literal pancake. As the wardrobe missed Arthur by a mere inch, he looked at me, pale as a ghost, and muttered, \

He wasn't flat, but the British penchant for irony was. We expected the accordion-squeeze, the dizzy stars circling his head, and the inevitable recovery where he’d just blow into his thumb to pop back into shape. Because in our culture, being squashed isn't an end—it’s just a very embarrassing, very thin, new beginning. *** ***

> Come and participate; there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***

>


# ***
Cuando el trigo se vuelve seda
***

>\n\nLos domingos en la casa no empezaban con el sol, sino con el rítmico tac-tac del rodillo de madera contra el mesón de la cocina. Mi mamá no cocinaba; ella realizaba un acto de fe. Tomaba esa bola de masa, elástica y rebelde, y comenzaba el proceso de dejarla squished flat —aunque en nuestro español de cocina, decíamos simplemente \

no era un acto de fuerza bruta, sino de paciencia. El rodillo pasaba una y otra vez, espolvoreando nubes de harina que bailaban en la luz que entraba por la ventana. El objetivo era ese punto místico donde la masa dejaba de ser pan para convertirse en tela, en una membrana tan fina que, si la ponías frente a la luz, podías ver la sombra de tus propios dedos a través de ella.\n\n\

, decía ella sin dejar de sobar. Esa masa, aplastada hasta el límite de su existencia, era el secreto de la crocancia. Al verla allí, extendida sobre la mesa como una sábana de seda blanca, uno entendía que la finura era una forma de elegancia. En nuestras mesas latinoamericanas, quedar \

no es un accidente de caricatura, es la búsqueda de la perfección: transformar lo pesado en algo tan ligero que casi se lo lleva el viento antes de llegar al sartén.
*** ***

body.title: RUNE About To Integrate XMR/ZEC
body.body:
### The wait is almost over

This week should have been the big moment, but it seems the XMR/ZEC integration will still have to wait a bit due to some last minute issues showing up. 

On Telegram we can see the issue further calrified:

>The more important part was v3.20. It shipped a lot of the groundwork for XMR/ZEC, validator churn, POL and other upgrades, but the network then hit stability issues linked to non-deterministic app-layer calls and signing.
v3.20.1 is already out with fixes, but XMR/ZEC and a few other launches are now delayed around 1–2 weeks while devs focus on getting the network stable first.

So nothing too dramatic it seems; certainly less critical than the big May exploitation when the chain was halted for several weeks. 

The past developments are reflected quite well in the chart:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23t8DBnQF2pFs3d27t7NjXjNyskofrMT9GFn1kNCnWUiavKUHp2En3kvri4mxiboEKfMd.png)

We got a ~70% pump back in spring when the integration was first announced and a very harsh crash after that due to the hack. RUNE then traded on a baseline of around 40 cents before pickung more steam in August when XMR/ZEC integration was imminent. 

Due to the delay, price is back in the 40s again, **but it is clear that this chart is loaded and price is ready to explode higher soon.** This is also confirmed from a macro perspective:



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/Eo4Js72BQGNjAv6e27nmKSBWNAwf5eKzM7e4zc8HTxBTyfdu9N2tsJsjbWjtM3hSkP1.png)

In fact, I have always argued that RUNE has a very clear **3 wave pattern** - and it seems we are about to enter the 3rd one. 




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/Eo4JkCmxtsaHyar5ksYTACCSroZVjWFWyTHZcePTBS1xZFzGJbSwHr1JUV5oa4sykhN.png)

Personally, I think RUNE will revisit the $3-$4 range very soon. *The more difficult question to me is whether this would already be a top signal or the first move to higher highs.* It will probably take years for such a movement to play out with 2028 or 2029 probably being the crescendo. I guess the biggest hurdle for RUNE seems to be the stability and security issues as these continually set back the chain. I think a price beyond the previous ATH is reasonable should the network continue running smoothly. Especially considering that there also has been some deflationary tokenomics taking place this year. 


---

body.title: Top 5 Linux Tools Every Cybersecurity Beginner Should Know 🐧🔐
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQC87Bxk4auu4svMuQm44L1m7GFymruK1T3LrGLMeM3D8/1787715808544.png)


Linux has many tools that are useful in cybersecurity. Some of them can look confusing at first, but once you understand what they do, things become much easier

Here are 5 tools worth knowing as a beginner.

1. Nmap

What is it?
Nmap is a network scanning tool used to discover devices and services.
What does it do?
It can find open ports and running services on an authorized network.

2. Wireshark

What is it?
Wireshark is a network traffic analyzer.
What does it do?
It captures network packets and lets you inspect what is happening in the network.

3. Grep

What is it?
Grep is a command-line search tool in Linux.
What does it do?
It helps you find specific words or patterns inside files and command output. Very simple tool, but actually useful.

4. cURL

What is it?
cURL is a command-line tool for communicating with servers.
What does it do?
It can send requests to websites and APIs and show the response. It's also useful for testing web services.

5. Netcat

What is it?
Netcat, also called nc, is a networking utility.
What does it do?
It can create network connections and is useful for testing and troubleshooting authorized systems.

Final Thought
These 5 tools are a good starting point if you are learning Linux, networking, or cybersecurity.
You don't need to master everything at once. Start with one tool, understand how it works, and then move to the next.

body.title: When helping people become a performance?
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYL1wiB7wg2HXKC9ckDAjF6mQ2HgWhDkvqVwDroc1cbf7/1788095887197.jpg)


Human beings depend on one another for survival. I don't mean that we are completely dependent on one another, but to a considerable extent, we need each other to survive. When babies are born, they depend almost entirely on their mothers for care, tender care and protection. As we grow, that dependence changes. We need friends, classmates, colleagues, family members, and even strangers at different stages of our lives. Because truly, no man is an island. There is also a popular saying: “Your neighbour is the God you see on earth.” Whether or not we understand this statement, it reminds us that sometimes the help we need comes through another person. Because God won't come down from heaven to help us, but will through a fellow human being. At different points in our lives, we will need help, no matter how little. And at other times, we will be in a position to offer that help to someone else.

Then this ushers us to the topic; when did helping people become a performance? We live in an era where almost everything can be recorded, displayed, and even monetized. People step in to help others, and the act is immediately captured on camera and shared online. There is nothing wrong with documenting an act of kindness, especially when it will inspires others to do the same. But what becomes the real problem is when the camera becomes the reason for the kindness. Some acts of kindness seem to exist only when there is an audience. In front of the camera, someone may appear exceptionally compassionate, generous, and caring. But away from the camera, that same person may be completely different from the image they portray. Being kind is good. In fact, kindness should be encouraged. But when kindness is done primarily to gain public recognition, recommendations, followers, praise, or some other reward, then I begin to question whether it is still kindness or simply a transaction. If I help you because I want people to see me as a good person, then my help comes with an expectation. I am giving something, but I am also expecting something in return. And perhaps the real test of kindness is not what we do when everyone is watching, but what we are willing to do when nobody is watching
We are encouraged to ask ourselves these questions.
Would I still help if there were no camera?
Would I still give if nobody would praise you?
Would I still show compassion if nobody would ever know?
 I believe genuine kindness should come from the heart. Whether there is a camera present or not, whether someone will praise us or not, whether we will gain anything from it or not let kindness simply not be a performance but who we truly are.

Thank you dear readers!!!!
