body.title: Unboxing Time: Cute Blind Box
body.body:
Hello guys....

How are you all? I hope you are all well and always happy. Meet me again, nice to meet you all. I'm back with my story, I'll tell you about the various activities I do.

This time, I’m going to share what I bought: a few mini ornaments that are both beautiful and cute.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbEaJypd4JaXtxUNEoHHm36Edj6bkA9qrj4oduwjYpWg/1788084604885.jpg)

I bought a few mini blind boxes at a 20-baht shop in Thailand; unfortunately, I didn't take a photo of the store because it was too crowded at the time. It was a really interesting shop—the prices were incredibly low, and there was a huge variety of items available. I actually bought a lot of things there, but for now, I’m just going to talk about the blind boxes.

I bought five blind boxes: two Sanrio-themed, two Nailoong, and one cat-themed. These are display-style blind boxes; their small size makes them perfect for placing on a work desk or study desk.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXu9tKS9rnjwqmRZpx45EqodpawwDsAtE6LbMXqbBoGTn/1788089400458.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhQfrG51TDmgHTgmPCu8ZDxRZ4TT6FyFy3m1nXw3iw1c/1788089400502.jpg)

First, let's open the Nailoong ones. I bought two boxes, but unfortunately, I got the same design—the one where Nailoong is lying down. Still, since it's so adorable, it doesn't really matter.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmednDMjveB3tsQFcxyXZzZ5txhSDRSkSrRABcQAYtQLJP/1788091285098.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaXFQawV68RNSiDYSDBSrfQHEv6Ea3Rq9gtqwSWxzxo1Z/1788091285137.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPphtFiXHKinygkfPfoXai7ArhkmhM13RYGMf7xQgEbN/1788091285177.jpg)

Next, I also bought one shaped like a cat. It looks like the beckoning cat you usually see in shops. It's really cute.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUg2nnBfMz6X1nhr5q6NaMxqGV7uVSsYnRS3pnxH2cbi1/1788091425432.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5VzrvFqXxNW39mj1zt4bRPinbjA6Xy7aQUJ5MYWCmfp/1788091425472.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUTyp4QAKXsdNq5T5uKsh36o16CLE3rKQqsHdrKwgwGV5/1788091425507.jpg)

I also bought two Sanrio blind boxes: one was exclusively Hello Kitty, and the other was a Sanrio one shaped like a pot.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbc7CYTeyA9MwtEm2vpWDYavzLNh3ncn5iUQR7LMbXa9F/1788092389394.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRb6rrcpXPRW2iLz1iRQUATfxRq7Q2wThv3mHKKQBfy18/1788092389435.jpg)



The Hello Kitty one is made of excellent material that sets it apart from the others; it features a soft, lovely velour fabric.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdyAKkaoPkLutVkALb4MDA2Nur3kXFpmFd67BfC9PBD4g/1788092407105.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwHPPfTjEVUNabtX2Q7DDVhubVd4X5HJvcXJ7jqjsjkL/1788092407144.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWTJ7KLUcVsz6F83ApCjQmAGynUGQJPtg8PByzQWz5Brp/1788092564769.jpg)


And for the other one, I got Pochacco—it's really cute. Even though I don't follow Pochacco all that closely, I still like it. To be honest, though, I was hoping to get Kuromi.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYeHGrgB6RbLtZhU1AJ7jSeVxW2d8naAjNAeDCdzMihx6/1788092554659.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVihPcjzBj1e3kXxbLgo3xuUQg7aGGwQQL8DnKFktEUAy/1788092554699.jpg)

Everything is so cute and lovely; despite the low price, the quality is excellent—sturdy material and great image details. It makes me want to buy even more.

Okay, that's my activity this time. Thank you for reading my story, see you in my next story~

body.title: [Movie] KABHI KHUSHI KABHIE GHAM – THE STORY OF A FAMILY THAT LOVES EACH OTHER, DRIFTS APART, AND EVENTUALLY REUNITES(TRAILER REVIEW KABHI KHUSHI KABHIE GHAM)
body.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/Z5GczjXM/MV5BMj-Mw-NDY2NDY1OV5BMl5Ban-Bn-Xk-Ft-ZTgw-Mjg3Mj-Q2NDE-V1-QL75-UX328.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm766702336/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Release year: 2001
Director: Karan Johar
Main cast
Amitabh Bachchan – Yashvardhan Raichand
Jaya Bachchan – Nandini Raichand
Shah Rukh Khan – Rahul Raichand
Kajol – Anjali Sharma
Hrithik Roshan – Rohan Raichand
Kareena Kapoor – Pooja
------------------------------------

MOVIE I WATCHED THAT REALLY TOUCHED ME
--------------------------------------
Today I’d like to tell you the story of the famous movie Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
Honestly when I started watching this movie I knew it was about love and family.But as I delved into the story I realized it was much deeper than that
It’s a movie about family love,parents and children separation memories forgiveness and the hope that the people we love will one day be reunited

At times the movie makes you laugh and at other times it fills you with emotion It contains many happy moments but also scenes that make you feel the full pain of a family separated for many years

A WEALTHY FAMILY THAT SEEMED HAPPY
----------------------------------
The story begins with a wealthy and respected family led by Yashvardhan Raichand played by Amitabh Bachchan
Yash is a man who places great importance on his family’s name honor,and traditions He loves his family deeply but he’s also a very strict father who believes his children must follow the path he considers to be the right one

His wife Nandini played by Jaya Bachchan is a mother with a big heart
She deeply loves her children especially her eldest son Rahul

Rahul is deeply loved by the entire family. Although he was not originally a biological child of the family he has become an integral member of the Raichand family and has always been loved as a true son.

The family also has another son young Rohan.
At the beginning of the story everything seems perfect The family lives surrounded by happiness celebrations,and love.
But sometimes a single decision can change the life of an entire family.

RAHUL AND THE LOVE THAT CHANGED HIS LIFE
----------------------------------------
As he grows up Rahul’s life changes when he meets a young woman named Anjali played by Kajol
Anjali comes from a very different background than Rahul’s wealthy family.
She is a cheerful young woman full of life and with a kind heart
At first their relationship seems perfectly normal but over time,Rahul and Anjali fall deeply in love with each other
Rahul then realizes that his heart has chosen Anjali
But he knows that a major obstacle stands in their way

His father might never accept this love. 
---------------------------------------
https://i.postimg.cc/d1cMS2qd/MV5BMm-Zi-Zj-Jm-OTkt-MGZk-Yy00Ym-Zm-LWE5ZTYt-Yz-My-NDM4MDA4OTYy-Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX350.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm2006370306/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

LOVE AND FAMILY AT ODDS
-----------------------
Rahul finds himself in a very difficult situation.
On one side there is
His love for Anjali
The life his heart desires
On the other side,there is:
His family
His very strict father
Family traditions and expectations

Yashvardhan wants Rahul to marry a woman who matches their family’s status and name
But Rahul’s heart has already made its choice.
When he decides to follow his heart and marry Anjali a serious conflict erupts between him and his father
This part of the movie really moved me.
We see a man who deeply loves his family but who also doesn’t want to give up the person he loves
In the end Rahul makes a very difficult decision

He leaves the family home
-------------------------
He leaves with Anjali to start a new life
But this decision causes a rift that will deeply shake the entire family.

https://i.postimg.cc/gJjhQZNb/MV5BYWQ0ZTky-MWYt-N2Qz-OC00Mj-Iz-LWFk-MGEt-Nzc2Zm-I3MDIz-ZWNj-Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX582.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm2068339712/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

A MOTHER WHO NEVER FORGOT HER SON
---------------------------------
The person who perhaps suffers the most is Nandini Rahul’s mother
Even though Rahul leaves home, he never leaves her heart.
For many years she thinks of her son.
The house is large and the family has every material wealth imaginable but something is missing
And what’s missing is Rahul
The scenes between the mother and her son are among the most moving in the film
They remind us that

Even when her child is far away a mother often continues to carry him in her heart.
----------------------------------------------
https://i.postimg.cc/7Y8VGKKx/MV5BYm-Yx-Mz-Mz-Y2Ut-Mzdm-Yi00NTI3LWI0Mz-Qt-NTMw-ODQw-Ym-U0ZGMz-Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX776.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm3158858752/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Rahul starts a new life in London
---------------------------------
Rahul and Anjali move to London
There they start a new life
They start their own family and try to live happily
But even though Rahul has started a new life far from home he never completely forgets his family or the memories of the house where he grew up
Time passes
The years go by
But the family’s separation remains a wound that has never truly healed

Rahul starts a new life in London
---------------------------------
Rahul and Anjali move to London
There they start a new life
They start their own family and try to live happily
But even though Rahul has started a new life far from home he never completely forgets his family or the memories of the house where he grew up
Time passes
The years go by
But the family’s separation remains a wound that has never truly healed


ROHAN GROWS UP
--------------
Meanwhile Rohan who was still a child at the time of the separation—grows up
There are many things he didn’t understand when he was little
But when he discovers what really happened to his brother Rahul and why he left the family he feels a deep sadness
Rohan remembers his brother
He realizes that he has always missed Rahul
That’s when he makes a big decision

I want to bring my family back together
---------------------------------------
This decision will change the entire course of the story
Rohan wants to find his brother
He wants to make his mother happy
And above all he wants to reunite his entire family

https://i.postimg.cc/76Nx3sgT/MV5BMTMw-Yjk5Yzkt-ZWI3Ny00MDAz-LTk3OTIt-Nz-Jm-NTli-MGU2Yz-E2Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX776.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm3041932032/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Rohan’s Trip to London
----------------------
Rohan leaves for London with one main goal
To bring Rahul back to his family
When he arrives in London he gradually reconnects with Rahul and his family
But Rohan doesn’t immediately reveal the real reason for his visit
First he wants to understand his brother’s situation
He discovers the new life Rahul has built for himself
He meets Anjali and their family
It’s a moment filled with both love and memories 


POOJA BRINGS JOY TO THE STORY
-----------------------------
In London, Pooja, played by Kareena Kapoor also becomes an important character in the story
Pooja is a young woman full of energy, confidence and joy
When she meets Rohan the film is enriched with fun and lighthearted moments
Their relationship also adds a new touch of love and emotion to the story
It’s like a ray of light shining on a story otherwise marked by a family’s separation

https://i.postimg.cc/76PvkxTd/MV5BZDA3ODAx-YTAt-Ym-Yz-YS00Yzlm-LWJh-ODkt-MDkx-N2E0ZDE2Mjll-Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX670.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm2878989824/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

ROHAN TRIES TO FIND HIS BROTHER
-------------------------------
Rohan’s mission isn’t easy
Rahul has already built a new life for himself
Many years have passed since he left
There are wounds from the past
There is anger
There are words that are hard to forget
But Rohan doesn’t give up
He believes that deep down Rahul still loves his family
He also knows that his mother has never forgotten her son
So Rohan tries to remind everyone of the love that once united their family

https://i.postimg.cc/k5f1WWBy/MV5BOGNh-Mj-U1YTAt-Zj-Jm-Zi00Y2Iz-LTg3ZDUt-Nz-Vk-OTY2ODll-ZGE3Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX372.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm3176149760/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Memories of the past resurface
------------------------------
As the story unfolds memories of the past come flooding back
Rahul remembers the happy days he spent with his family.
His mother meanwhile,continues to think about her son whom she misses
Rohan keeps trying
He realizes that it’s not enough to simply tell Rahul

Come home
---------
The wounded hearts must also find the strength to understand one another again

A FATHER AND SON GROW CLOSE AGAIN
---------------------------------
The greatest conflict in the story is the one between Rahul and his father Yashvardhan.
For many years they remained estranged from one another
But time teaches people many things.
Sometimes we come to understand that pride, anger, and overly rigid decisions can drive people who love each other apart
But we also discover that

A family’s love can sometimes be stronger than many years of separation. 
----------------------------------------------
When events finally begin to bring family members closer together all the long hidden feelings resurface

RAHUL FINALLY RETURNS TO HIS FAMILY
-----------------------------------
This is one of the most moving moments in the film
After many years of separation
After the sadness
After the anger
After memories that are impossible to forget

Rahul finally returns to his family.
-----------------------------------

It’s a moment filled with emotion.
The one who had left home for so many years is finally reunited with his loved ones
His mother who had waited for and missed her son for so long can finally see him again and be by his side
Rohan, who went to such great lengths to reunite his family finally sees his dream come true
This scene shows that all of Rohan’s efforts were not in vain

A FAMILY FINALLY REUNITED
-------------------------
Finally this family which had been separated for many years finds a new chance to grow closer
There is forgiveness
There is understanding
There is a lot of emotion
And above all

The family is finally reunited
------------------------------
Watching this part I felt as though this long emotional journey had finally reached a moment of peace
At first there was happiness
Then conflict arose
The conflict led to separation
But in the end hope and reconciliation prevailed

MY THOUGHTS

I loved the way he portrays a man who deeply loves his family while still wanting to follow his heart His character goes through moments of happiness sadness and deep emotion

Kajol – Anjali
--------------
Kajol brings a lot of humor joy and emotion to the film.Sometimes she makes you laugh and at other times she touches you deeply

https://i.postimg.cc/9fd4kBGP/MV5BOTU3OGVk-NDgt-Nzk4OC00Yj-A3LWJm-Yj-Qt-YTU0MWZh-Mzdl-Nz-U0Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX776.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm2940754944/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Hrithik Roshan – Rohan
----------------------
For me Rohan is the one who brings hope back to the family His efforts become the main reason why the family can finally grow closer again

https://i.postimg.cc/gjQkjwVn/MV5BYz-Ew-Yz-Bi-Mjgt-ODA5ZS00NWM0LTli-Mzkt-Yj-Jj-Zjhm-Yz-Nl-NGQ5Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX776.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm3209704192/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Kareena Kapoor – Pooja
----------------------
She brings energy, joy and plenty of charm to the story

https://i.postimg.cc/WzBTjBVd/MV5BZGZm-MTAx-Nzgt-OWRk-Yi00YWQ0LTgx-YWUt-MDc2Yz-Rm-Mj-Jl-N2Yz-Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX776.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm3080316416/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Amitabh Bachchan – Yashvardhan
------------------------------
He plays a strict father who places great importance on his principles but eventually comes to terms with his own emotions and the love he has for his family

https://i.postimg.cc/VvnLSfDq/MV5BNm-Zk-Mz-U2OTAt-YWU2Yy00Yj-U1LWI3Y2Yt-MGI5NTY1Y2Ex-NTk3Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX776.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm1397251072/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

Jaya Bachchan – Nandini
-----------------------
Her portrayal of a mother is truly moving The love she has for her children is one of the most touching aspects of the film.

https://i.postimg.cc/yxyC4kfg/MV5BNj-Mz-Zj-Y0N2Mt-ODgz-OC00YTZm-LThi-NTAt-Mm-Fk-Nm-E4NWVk-Mj-U4Xk-Ey-Xk-Fqc-Gc-V1-QL75-UX582.jpg

[Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0248126/mediaviewer/rm1128815616/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)

MY OVERALL THOUGHTS ON THE MOVIE
--------------------------------
For me Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham isn’t just a romance
I see it as a story about
Family
Parental love
Separation
Forgiveness
Reunions
Humor
And wonderful music

What I loved most about this movie is the way it shows that a single decision can drive an entire family apart but also how a single person who refuses to give up can bring people back together who’ve been separated for a very long time.

Rohan is the one who never gave up.
The mother never forgot her son
And Rahul even though he built a new life never completely forgot his family
In the end,after a long journey all roads lead back home to family

Conclusion
----------
When I finished watching Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham I understood why this film remains one of the Bollywood movies that so many people hold dear
It’s a long movie but its story takes you on a journey filled with happiness love sadness, separation, and ultimately reconciliation.

family may sometimes drift apart
People may hurt one another
Many years may drive them apart
-------------------------------
But if love and forgiveness are always present in their hearts

then there may come a day when they’ll be reunited
------------------------------------------
Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham is a story that reminds us that family,love,and forgiveness are among the most precious things in life

Personally I really enjoyed this movie especially Rahul and his family’s long journey as well as the way this separated family finally managed to reunite
----------------------------------------------

body.body:
![IMG_20260830_183804.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZF8mYiyR9FBLzhnR7yiHJZaRkWdKAEm8L4ke1sLz3pzQ/IMG_20260830_183804.jpg)

### Drowning 
Large parts of the country are drowning from floods. The provinces of Bulacan and Pampanga have been flooded for a month already. Actually, it has been raining for a month even in our province. Water has been rising for a month, and now our entire village—and even large parts of the town—is flooded. All we hope is for the rain to stop, though our hardships are not over because of the persistent rains. All we can do is pray. 🙏

### Sunday
The rain was very heavy overnight. I expected the flood to have gotten deeper, but so far, it was just around five inches deep. I did some errands downstairs and eventually prepared our food upstairs. Too bad that in less than an hour, the water had risen so high that my boots could not handle it anymore. It had gone knee-deep.

### Reminisce
During the rainy season, I have time to check the photos on my phone. All I can do is reminisce. It is the beauty of Buguias that leaves me in awe.

body.title: The last Sunday of Summer
body.body:
![IMG_6533.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfXK8egAQJxLhUDCQB4XcGb2aqCwwob8pmJQfMW3qEjqX/IMG_6533.jpeg)

Sometimes it seems to me that I'm stuck in some kind of vacuum and completely lost touch with reality. This is especially felt in the last few days, when we live in conditions of constant shelling. I have no idea how I'm going to go to work tomorrow. The only thing I understand is that it's completely useless to think about it, because it's not yet known whether tomorrow will be.

![IMG_6517.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYEVd2DNhmKZBAfhouJ2hShLfnzFXDZWDJoZnXWJJ6mEj/IMG_6517.jpeg)

It seems even more incredible that I continue to do my routine things. That's where the parallel reality is! What's the point of cleaning the yard, planting flowers, doing fitness if there may be no tomorrow? And if it still happens... And I'm not going to spend it in a mess... It's really a matter of choice😂

![IMG_6481.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNxdZ5SHUtnJqrjoYgKpMwoFpXqrPsUPhkhgmr5xmR2pQ/IMG_6481.jpeg)

I can't say that I managed to do much this summer. But I managed to do something. In particular, I finally concreted the porch and the platform in front of the exit from the boiler room. It caused me a lot of problems! In autumn, the rains washed away the ground, and the dogs carried all this dirt into the house. But now I think I will at least get rid of this problem. I did everything slowly, buying bag after bag of crushed stone or concrete. But I did and I'm proud of it. If a woman wants to, she can do everything!
![IMG_6465.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmakDRPvLyexnToF7Qx5GmV1LxhkLypsPxUGFY3rZF4Caf/IMG_6465.jpeg)

One of my achievements is the resumption of a more active lifestyle. We must admit that war is merciless. It provokes depression when you just don't want to move anymore. But for almost a month now, I've been doing a set of exercises every day and going for a walk. It may seem like such a trifle, but for me it was a real breakthrough.

![IMG_6451.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVySrXsgxobwsiiGwDcH2S2DDX25DmD425unScVcTJk14/IMG_6451.jpeg)

body.title: Sweating Out the Beer and Airing Out the Dog: Today's Run Outside the City
body.body:
Hey runners!

I went for a run before lunch today. I took Cesmína with me and we headed out of town. Once again, we ran along field paths and around the pond, where Cesmína could get a drink and cool down a bit. It was quite warm outside.

I was at a beer festival yesterday, so the run wasn't exactly easy. The knee that’s been bothering me acted up a little – it seems like taking several days off between runs doesn't really suit it. 🙂


![1000107332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/243q4PCJumM7AbexsFEAQ9gvU5cCsQMe27cvb4UuAt4qkcm73D64Wc4LVXCyfDwEMWTQZ.jpg)

body.title: SUNDAY MORNING - THINGS THAT MAKE ME WONDER...
body.body: ## SUNDAY MORNING - THINGS THAT MAKE ME WONDER... Let me try something different today in my blog post. I am going to put my new content, my daily ramblings right here at the top. Maybe more people will read it. It is a beautiful sunny morning here in Howley Newfoundland at Cathy and my trailer. Cathy is still in bed and Chase is asleep by my feet. It is 9:41am. As I sip on my 2nd cup of coffee. YOu know I am loving Satsman, I am doing well with it, better with the ProMax upgrade ane being a founding member. But like any program online that requires referrals to do even better it is always a struggle. Story time. I been making money online or trying to since about 1998. Almost 30 years. I think the first thing I ever tried was Cash Fiesta. I wonder if anyone remembers it? ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3SGJAHWS8CgG71swVk6JgUpna2guzbpbKb7E25AmLE9/image.png) You installed a banner bar that ran on the top of you screen. It turned out to be a scam. I remember when I got to my first payout level and they blocked my account. That was my first lession. Over the years I have tried a lot of things. Get paid to read emails. I even ran my own one. Paid to surf, I rain my own one. Who remembers e-gold? ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQme1P4JVPSu77sVVuRrjkzqK7JArmwPrciQ4JMnJM1Z94q/image.png) Oh the things, the promise, the programs that used that. Bubble games, doublers, etc. The there was SFI. So many things I have tried, so so many. Then a little over two months ago I was introduced to Satsman. I fell in love. AS for my title of this post, things that make me wonder. I figured or I guess I was hopeful that bringing people, referring people, to Satsman would be the easiest thing I ever did. I was wrong. People don't want to take the time to recearch, understand things. I find it sad sometimes. I will keep plugging alont, I will keep promoting it. There are a lot of people in the world. And being a founding member I get free referrals. Everyone knows my mission, I guess you could say in life, is to try and help people. And I believe big time that Satsman can help people. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUP3Y3cB1JQnLWrKEdN6srpJjvmqUqaf1Yzkqhcuiddxs/image.png) I joined Satsman 68 days ago and I have done my daily missions for 68 strait days ;) [JOIN MY ARMY HERE](https://satsman.com/?ref=bradleyarrow). Less than 5 minutes a day to earn Sats(Bitcoin).

/> [JOIN MY ARMY HERE]([https://satsman.com/?ref=bradleyarrow](https://satsman.com/?ref=bradleyarrow)). Less than 5 minutes a day to earn Sats(Bitcoin). DEDICATION ---------- Let me start with the fact that I have been on this blockchain now for 2581 days. And I am extremely proud to say my posting streak continues. I have now done at last one post a day for 2581 days. On the road to 3000. If you are trying to build something on Hive, if you are trying get noticed on Hive. This is the type of dedication it takes. I tell you this now every day now to try and motivate you. As your noticed I already have the dedication. DAILY BLOG POST SPOTLIGHTS -------------------------- Please check out @valderalazaro blog post [🤖❤️💀 Amor, muerte y robots: cuando la animación se atreve a pensar diferente](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@valderalazaro/amor-muerte-y-robots-cuando-la-animacion-se-atreve-a-pensar-diferente) And also @valderalazaro wife @diazktty [​Un menú hecho con el corazón: cocina de hogar y amor en familia](https://peakd.com/hive-100067/@diazktty/un-menu-hecho-con-el-corazon-cocina-de-hogar-y-amor-en-familia) And @milagroscmiranda [La generación que aprendió a vivir sin tutoriales 📼](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@milagroscmiranda/la-generacion-que-aprendio-a-vivir-sin-tutoriales)

/>

[VOTE FOR THE BBH PROJECT WITNESS](https://vote.hive.uno/@thebbhproject)

MISSION STATEMENT
-----------------

To make The BBH Project the most profitable passive income token project on Hive.

BBH INCEPTION - 25TH NOV 2020

BBH RELEASE PRICE TODAY: 0.01801 HIVE

Remember 1 BBH equals 1 Satoshi. So as Hive out performs Bitcoin the cost in Hive to buy BBH goes down. BBH is soft pegged to BTC.


THE BBH FOUNDATION
------------------

I have added @thebbhfoundation as a beneficiary on my posts.. You could do the same ;) Also help spread the word. Talk it up in a blog post, etc.

Please don't forget to donate what you can to @thebbhfoundation so Cathy and I can support others in Cuba and around the world.

Lets keep this going. Lets keep helping people in need.

If you know anyone in Cuba you can nominate them for future help. Just write a great story for me and @cathyarrow to review.

Have an awesome fracking sauce day.

Loves you @cathyarrow

DELEGATION TO THE BBH PROJECT
-----------------------------

We are now at Received: 47,234 HP up FROM 47,229 HP in delegation from yesterday. Whoop Whoop. Keep it coming people. Lets aim for 200K :)

Please help spread the word.

Using the @bradleyarrow account for the incoming delegation.

Here is what it is offering.

Daily payouts at 23:57 UTC.

You get 80 percent payout of curation in Hive.  
You get 20 percent payout of curation in BBH.

For 100 percent payout of curation.

But being an open blockchain anyone that wants to check this account for the incoming delegation, you can :)

Next goal is to get to 250K in delegation.

How awesome fracking sauce is that.

To the future ;)

WHITE PAPER FOR THE BBH PROJECT
-------------------------------

Here it is, the updated [THE BBH PROJECT WHITE PAPER](https://peakd.com/bbh/@bbhstrategy/bbhstrategy-the-bbh-project-updated-white-paper).

CURATION TRAIL
--------------

No new members to the Curation Trail since last update.



The new goal of 800 members by the end of 2026.

What is the point of a curation trail and why should I join?

Any post that I up vote, everyone that is upto 468 possible upvotes.

When you join the trail you can set your trail vote to what ever you want. Even if you set the up vote to 0.01. Imagine if we had 1,000 people in the trail that would be 10.00 to the post. Fantastic stuff. A little difference can end up making a giant difference to a Hiver.

That being said, we do have 468 members, I know not all are active, some have passed, but the majority of use are still here.

Imagine if we could get 100 people doing just 1 blog post about the curation trail. Do you think the membership would go up quickly?

Give it a shot, the more, the better for everyone.

And if you are following the trail please support our witness. @thebbhproject.

DRIP DAY
--------

Saturdays are Drip Day. That means it is/was drip day. Now if you are not a regular reader of mine you are wondering what is drip day.

I run a income token and tipping bot all in one. The token is BBH. Every Saturday I payout the people holding BBH tokens. Passive income if you like. I like to call it a 'drip' of a token(s) to the people that own BBH tokens. And unlike some all you have to do is own it. No staking, no nothing.

If you own 10 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive.  
If you own 5,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive and the PIMP token, and GLITTER Tokens.

If you stake 20,000 or more BBHO tokens you get a drip of swap.btc, and ALIVE tokens  
If you stake 5,000 or more BBHO tokens you got a drip of ALIVE tokens.

All just for owning BBH. There are two ways you can get BBH. First you can buy them from the open market. I use TribalDex myself.

Or they can be tipped to you. The great part about BBH tipping is that when you tip a token to someone else you do not loose any of your own. There is a central pool that supplies them.

And a third way to get BBH would be people gift them to you. There was an update to the tipping bot. If you now tip 1 BBH you get 1 BBH also. How facking awesome is that.

And now a forth way to get BBH with the BBH Miner.

BBH AND BBHO TOKEN DIFFERENCE
-----------------------------

It seems some people are still confused. So I am putting this section into my daily post.

BBH token was my first token. It is a tipping bot and a passive income token. You only need to hold it, hold 10 or more to get a drip on drip day(below).

BBHO token is the native token of The BBH Project Tribe. The same as LEO is the native token of InLeo.

It is that simple. I did add drips to stakers of BBHO also as I work on building out use cases for the token.

Hope this helps.

TIPPING  
In a 24 hour period, reset at new day UTC. There are currently five levels of tipping.

Level 1 = 1000 BBH holdings = 1 tip per day you can send  
Level 2 = 5000 BBH holdings = 5 tips per day you can send  
Level 3 = 10000 BBH holdings = 10 tips per day you can send  
Level 4 = 20000 BBH holdings = 20 tips per day you can send  
Level 5 = 50000 BBH holdings = 50 tips per day you can send  
Level 6 = 100,000 BBH holdings = 100 tips per day you can send

The tipping command is ! BBH

body.body:
## Hello friends  ! 

#### Welcome to my blog again . I am so glad that you are here . I Hope you all are good and enjoying yourself . I am also good and enjoying myself with nature  . 


It was a busy month where I was stuck in many stuff and some guest was also there . Yesterday we celebrate our big festival Rakshabandhan. So this evening I thought to go a cafe for relaxing . Even again I had to come early but I spent almost 30 minutes there , and I got opportunity to capture some beauty of nature and the some reflections also .

body.title: The Lunar Base: 1995 to 2000
body.body:
<center>**[The Next Fifty Years in Space](https://peakd.com/astronomy/@harlotscurse/the-next-fifty-years-in-space)**</center>

<center>https://i.postimg.cc/Gm4Mfg51/Dusk_Jacket_Spreadeagled.jpg</center>

In the first six chapters of _The Next Fifty Years in Space_ [Patrick Moore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patrick_Moore) restricted his predictions to the two decades between 1975 and 1995. From Chapter 7 on, however, he turns his attention to the following three decades. For the most part his predictions for 1975–1995 have held up well, but from here on his prognostications must become much less reliable. Moore is keenly aware of this possibility and he is careful to remind his readers of the speculative nature of his predictions:

>Up to now I have been discussing programmes which have either been planned in detail or else are logical developments of them. When we come to discuss the future of man in space, there must inevitably be more in the way of speculation, but at least some vital facts have been firmly established.  ―Moore 101

In Chapter 7, we return to the Moon to see what the post-Apollo era might have in store for our nearest neighbour. Moore opens this chapter with a quote from an interview he conducted with [Neil Armstrong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neil_Armstrong):

>_Question._ “Do you think that in the foreseeable future it is going to be possible to set up scientific bases on the Moon, on a large scale?”
>
>_Answer._ “I’m quite certain that we’ll have such bases in our lifetime. Somewhat like the Antarctic stations and similar scientific outposts; continually manned, although there’s certainly the problem of the environment, with the vacuum and the high and low temperatures of day and night. Still, in some ways it’s more hospitable than the Antarctic ...
>
>That conversation took place on 16 November 1970, and was heard by millions of people inasmuch as it was broadcast on BBC television during a “Sky at Night” programme. I was the questioner; the man who answered was none other than Neil Armstrong―the first pioneer to step out on to the surface of the Moon, and whose opinions are not to be lightly set aside!
>
>... The stage is set, and it would be a pessimist of the deepest dye who would question the logic of what he said. ―Moore 96 ... 101

<center>https://i.postimg.cc/G344Kjj2/Neil-Armstrong-pose-(cropped)-jpg-utm-source-commons-wikimedia.jpg</center><center>**Neil Armstrong**</center>

Moore took a decidedly optimistic stance on the question of lunar bases, but he certainly underestimated the difficulties of living on the Moon:

> ... there is nothing harmful on the Moon itself ... the danger from meteorites falling on to the Moon and causing damage to any man-made structures there is very slight. Quite recently I read an excellent book which had been published in 1953, in which it was claimed that any Lunar Base would have to be built underground―because otherwise it would be soon battered to pieces by the steady cosmical bombardment. Of course, we cannot discount meteorite damage any more than we can on Earth; if the Siberian missile of 1908 had fallen upon a city instead of in frozen wasteland, the casualty list would have been horrifying. But meteorite falls likely to be harmful are probably very rare indeed, and it is significant that as yet no large fallen meteorites have been found on the Moon. One eminent astronomer-geologist, G. J. H. McCall, who―like myself―believes the main craters to be of internal origin, has even asked: ‘‘Where have all the meteorites gone?” ―Moore 101

Moore has completely overlooked the danger posed by [micrometeoroids](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Micrometeoroid), tiny particles of rock less than a gram in mass. The Earth’s atmosphere protects the surface of the planet from the constant precipitation of these cosmic fragments, but the Moon, which has no atmosphere, is being constantly bombarded by these little projectiles. This is even acknowledged by a recent issue of _BBC Sky at Night_, a magazine created in 2005 to accompany Patrick Moore’s _Sky at Night_ program:

>**The Moon is a death trap: These are the life-threatening dangers awaiting astronauts on the lunar surface**
>
>Micrometeorite impacts on the Moon are another source of concern.
>
>Analysis using NASA’s Meteoroid Engineering Model suggests that a lunar base similar in size to the International Space Station would encounter between 15,000-23,000 impacts each year from particles ranging in size from millionths of a gram up to ten grams. ―Lawrence

The fact that there are no large meteorites on the surface of the Moon is not because the Moon isn’t regularly impacted by meteorites, but because the constant bombardment by micrometeoroids pulverizes all the larger meteorites.

<center>https://i.postimg.cc/DwvFjvKJ/1280px-Inflatable-habitat-s89-20084-jpg-utm-source-commons-wikimedia.jpg</center><center>**Artist’s Impression of a Lunar Habitat**</center>

# Russian Predictions #
Moore begins his prognostications by asking what the Soviet Union might be planning in response to the Apollo missions. This might be earmarked as the point in _The Next Fifty Years in Space_ where Moore’s predictions begin to come off the rails:

>As a start in my admittedly uncertain speculations, let us consider what the Russians may do―because there is always the chance that they will begin serious operations before 1990, which is probably the very earliest that the Americans will go back to the Moon.
>
>Up to now the Soviet teams have concentrated upon robot exploration, and there is no doubt that their Lunokhods and recoverable Lunas have been technical triumphs. They have been less fortunate with their manned space research, though it is likely that they are fast overcoming the worst of their problems. When could they possibly start sending expeditions moonward? If they wanted to do so, they could begin by 1982 or thereabouts; and their first step might be to start dumping supplies at the selected site, which might well be one of the “mare” areas some way from the equator. The Mare Imbrium and the Mare Nubium are possibilities.
>
>Supplies, unlike men, are expendable, and would provide excellent tests for the efficiency of the landing craft. A dozen or more vehicles would be sent, all coming down in the same area; they would carry supplies of all kinds, including power packs, elaborate radio equipment, and anything that might be needed in the way of constructional materials, together with medical kit. Once we find that all these are being dispatched, we may be fairly sure that Russian cosmonauts will follow.
>
>The next step would be to send a reconnaissance crew. It is therefore quite on the cards that the first Russians on the Moon, unlike the first Americans, will not make a quick there-and-back trip, but will prepare for a more prolonged stay. ―Moore 102

Of course, none of this ever materialized. Luna 24, which placed a robotic probe in the Mare Crisium in 1976, was the last Russian mission to the Moon for forty-seven years. Its successor, Luna 25, was launched and 2023 and was unsuccessful. The probe crashed into the inner rim of a small crater, approximately 400 kilometers from its intended landing site.

Moore imagines what the ensuing lunar base would look like, with its laboratories, astronomical observatories, instruments for studying the nature of the Moon’s globe, medical centres in which insects and animals will both live and breed, and hydroponic gardens in which edible plants will be cultivated. He is well aware of the speculative nature of these remarks, and he adds a timely warning:

>This, as I have stressed, is guesswork on my part, and it is equally likely that the Russians will not try to set up any Base before the Americans are ready to start again toward the early 1990s. I am merely saying what, in my view, _might_ happen. If it did, then American progress toward the Moon would be speeded up―not because of any political pique, but simply because the Russian experiences would provide an immense amount of detailed information, which would be available whether the Kremlin approved or not. ―Moore 103

<center>https://i.postimg.cc/XNLsK4QV/1280px-Mooncolony-jpg-utm-source-commons-wikimedia.jpg</center><center>**Artist’s Impression of a Lunar Mining Facility**</center>

# American Predictions #
Turning to NASA, Moore’s predictions of an American program to establish a permanent presence on the Moon have fared no better than his predictions of a Soviet base.

>Next let us turn back to the American programme, which is by no means settled as yet, but which should be very much to the fore by 1990. Here too we have the prospect of an initial Base formed from the lunar modules which have taken the astronauts to the Moon, and it may be that the first expedition scheduled for a long stay will number about a dozen members. If this is achieved by―say―1992, there ought to be a full-scale headquarters operating by 1995. And by 2000 we may see the first of the really elaborate Bases, possibly of the hemispherical form which so widely favoured by the much-derided but often far-seeing fiction writers of the days before the Space Age began. ―Moore 103–104

Since the end of the Apollo program in 1972, no human, American or otherwise, has set foot on the Lunar surface. This is something that Moore, writing in 1975, could not possibly have envisaged. From his perspective, the Moon was an ideal place for all sorts of scientific endeavors, and the successes of the 60’s and 70’s had seemingly put colonization within reach:

>The lack of atmosphere, together with the reduced gravity, means that the research teams will be able to carry out experiments which are quite impossible on Earth. Moreover, the lunar surface is exposed to all the various radiations coming from space, and though this will admittedly be a mixed blessing it will be scientifically invaluable. As a radio and television relay station the Moon will also have a part to play; constant surveys of the Earth’s weather systems will be possible, and as a site for an astronomical observatory the Lunar Base will be in a class of its own.
>
>From Earth, optical astronomers are constantly plagued by the turbulence and dirtiness of the atmosphere, and the trouble increases according to the size of the telescope used. The [Palomar 200-inch reflector](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hale_Telescope) works well, and we may expect much from the new [Russian 236-inch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BTA-6), though it is true that the Soviet authorities are being rather reticent about it. But if it were possible to build, say, a 400-inch, the atmosphere would prevent it from being used to capacity, and might easily prevent it from being useful at all. On the Moon there is no atmosphere; and the lesser gravity would make for easier construction, both of optical surfaces and mechanical parts. Our view of the universe would be more than doubled in range.
>
>More important still is the fact that from Earth we can study only a very limited part of the total electromagnetic range. We have the optical window, and there is also a radio window, but most of the radiations from beyond the Earth are blocked out, which is why we have had to use rocket vehicles for X-ray astronomy and other studies. This hazard, too, will not apply to the Moon. The prospects for radio astronomy are equally good, because the construction of very sizable equipment will be made easier by the fact that it will weigh less. Neither will there be serious interference from artificial transmissions, ranging from commercial broadcasting stations to unsuppressed motor-cycle engines.
>
>Looking further ahead, the radio astronomer’s ideal would be an observatory on the far side of the Moon, where shielding from Earth interference is complete. When this will be established must depend upon what happens during the next few decades, but with luck it should be in action before 2025. Contact with Earth, and with other Lunar Bases, will be maintained by using the communications satellites which will by then be orbiting the Moon. ―Moore 104–105

<center>https://i.postimg.cc/2SQbv877/1280px-RIAN-archive-612748-Valentina-Tereshkova-(high-quality)-jpg-utm-source-commons-wikimedia.jpg</center><center>**Valentina Tereshkova**</center>

Sadly, none of this ever materialized, and there is still little prospect of a permanent human presence on the Moon being established within the next few decades. Still, there is plenty of time for another of Moore’s predictions to come true:

>We must realize, too, that a man is not a robot. Neither is a woman, and this leads on to a problem which must already have been in the minds of long-term planners even though it has been too early to say much about it. Women can go into space; one ([Valentina Tereshkova](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valentina_Tereshkova), now married to Cosmonaut Andriyan Nikolayev) has already done so. There is no reason why they should not go to the Moon, and I am quite sure that they will. A married man would not be willing to leave his wife and family for a prolonged period, and a bachelor would be equally unlikely to join a lunar colony if it meant sacrificing any idea of marriage. And when men and women are together in an isolated Base, one does not need to be an Einstein (or a Spock) to realize that children will be born. There are unknown medical problems here. Whether a baby born on the Moon will be able to adapt to Earth conditions is yet another unknown factor, and it would be frightening to learn that a “Moon child” would have to spend his whole life on his adopted world. If so, of course, there would be a moral obligation to keep the Lunar Base in being, whatever the cost, and eventually there would be an entirely new branch of _homo sapiens_, possibly differing from ourselves not only in mental outlook but also in physical appearance. This is not likely to happen before 2025, because evolution is a slow process, but it could have happened before 3025. ―Moore 106

But even a thousand years will surely not be long enough for one of Moore’s more imaginative predictions to come to pass:

>In any case, our colonists must be able to lead lives which are as normal as possible, and this means that there must be ample provision for recreation; one cannot work all the time. There is no problem about what is termed “entertainment” (radio, television, etc.), and undoubtedly one of the early acts will be to establish a proper library. So far as exercise is concerned, there is no question but that regular activities will be essential―as, indeed, they are in space-stations of the Skylab or Salyut type; but it is tempting to go further, and decide what new sports will be worked out. As a cricketer, I can see endless possibilities. Not long ago I remember talking at a local cricket club dinner, and suggesting what could be done about limiting the size of the boundary, working out a new [l.b.w.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leg_before_wicket) law, and bringing in regulations to help the luckless fast bowler whose run-up is bound to be seriously hampered! I look forward with interest to a _Lunar Sportsman’s Manual_ which must inevitably be published sooner or later. ―Moore 106

<center>https://i.postimg.cc/gcgfzV92/Artist-impression-of-a-Moon-Base-concept-pillars.jpg</center><center>**An Artist’s Impression of a Lunar Base**</center>

Moore closes this chapter with some musings on the effect the establishment of international bases on the Moon may have on terrestrial affairs. For the most part, he takes a sanguine view of the political impact:

>Governments and statesmen hold the purse-strings, and only they can rule whether or not the exploration of the Moon is to go on. Yet once it has started, it will be very difficult to stop, and collaboration will not be only desirable but also inevitable. Would a visitor from a Russian Lunar Base be unwelcome in the American headquarters, or vice versa? I hardly think so. Both are Earthmen.
>
>This is bound to cause misgivings in both the White House and the Kremlin, to say nothing of Downing Street and in the office of whoever succeeds Chairman Mao. And yet, in my view, the politicians will be quite unable to put a stop to collaboration on the Moon―for the excellent reason that they will not be able to get there. Once such friendly collaboration has started, it will go on and will increase; and why should it not spread from the Moon to the Earth? ―Moore 107

The last word is given to the common folk:

>One question which I am often asked is: “When will ordinary people―that is to say, non-technicians―be able to go to the Moon ?” It is not a question which can be answered as yet, because it is both logical and necessary that the first and many succeeding expeditions will be made up of people who have been specially trained and have been sent to carry out definite tasks. But by 2000 it is possible that not every lunar traveller will be a scientist; and as the journeys become easier and easier, the training requirements will be relaxed. I do not suggest that before 2000 it will be feasible for members of the public to go to the Moon for a holiday, and I doubt whether this will become possible much before 2100, but one never knows.
>
>From my own point of view, speaking as an observer who has always been particularly interested in the Moon, I must express a feeling of regret. By 1995 I will have reached the age of seventy-two, and I fear that I will never achieve my ambition of presenting a “Sky at Night” programme from the Mare Imbrium. Yet there is a chance that I may survive for long enough to see such a programme put on to the television screen by someone else, and this is something which even I would not have dared to suggest in April 1957, when I presented the first programme in the series and when the Space Age had not even begun. ―Moore 108

Fifty years on, these ambitions still seem as far off as they were when Moore first expressed them.

<center>https://i.postimg.cc/28kjnhX7/Patrick-Moore-by-Bryan-May.jpg</center><center>**Patrick Moore**</center>

And that’s a good a place to stop before the next stage of our journey.

---

body.title: A gift that I did not expect and did not like - a storm on the seashore
body.body:
The long-awaited summer vacation, after two hellish summer months at work, began on Saturday morning, when I arrived in Cyprus.
I didn't pay any special attention to the forecast that predicted precipitation for that day, because it doesn't rain in Cyprus 😂

After breakfast, I put the towel down on the deck chair by the pool, however, the clouds that started to roll in the sky completely covered the sun. 
The wind started blowing.
There was no use sitting by the pool so I retreated to my room.
Just in time to avoid the storm that started a few minutes later.

https://youtube.com/shorts/Qh6gV6VuP5Y?feature=shared

I never expected this kind of rain and storm in Cyprus.

That storm, which hit Cyprus yesterday, creating a tornado leech in the open sea in the vicinity of Larnaca, torrential floods that submerged cars in Nicosia, and in Pernera where I stayed, it brought tons of rain and wind.


That storm and not being able to enjoy the seashore totally distracted me, so I forgot that 29.08 was the day I joined Hive BC 🙂

But there is @hivebuzz who reminded me of that anniversary 🙂

Thank you ❤️

And as an adequate gift, I can count this today's picture from the beach, with sand, sun and blue sky, as expected in Cyprus.

body.title: The Self-Loyal Greater Demon Avarisdeus || Double Strike Makes Him Even More Aggressive
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Aug 30, 2026, 10_31_31 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w2mRhKg3sDEC64bZVESUimVQk8LmWnn1qyFmbQ8AX5SYaTR116bUn3gCwfLYmViCHao.png)
![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EqWqfBugZ7ibafYrEabt4sFhDtzyDEX7BEuWFxgBeJ6ujzhscks5E9JkG5bYaSrN18L.png)


Great Avarisdeus belongs to the same infernal world where his master Barashkukor and his army of devils live. When the Chaos Empire fell, Avarisdeus was given the responsibility of his masters place but Avarisdeus is not a loyal monster. 

Rather, his loyalty is limited to himself. He uses his influence only to advance his secret plans and this betrayal of his is spreading in the revenant city. 

Now if such a monster who is not loyal to his master and friends and is loyal only to himself then how will he behave with the Chaos Empire's units? This is a very savage monster and it is very dangerous against the enemy.

Yes today I want to tell you about the Avarisdeus monster which belongs to the Death Element and has very excellent powers and abilities.

<center>

---
# SKIN AND APPEARANCE
---

![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/242DX8CbUn34ZLvsnUDDcnkgckJp2xaTMpEZcQZfEvJoXyGiadbumgRY6ZCfJLwN9CJLj.png)
![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EqWqfBugZ7ibafYrEabt4sFhDtzyDEX7BEuWFxgBeJ6ujzhscks5E9JkG5bYaSrN18L.png)
</center>

If I talk about its skin and visual appearance because it belongs to the Death Element you can see a purple color in its background. And this monster itself is of a demon character sitting on its feet in an aggressive stance. 

In both of its hands pointed weapons are held which it wants to use to attack enemy units. Along with this it has two very large wings with which it always tries to fly and wherever it gets the best opportunity it makes that its target.

Above all the special thing I liked about this monster card is its mana cost. This monster card is only 4 mana which gives you flexibility in every type of battle. Even you can easily select it in a low mana battle and take full advantage of its best powers. And along with that in mid to high mana battles it will also work and help you as an excellent attacker.

If I talk about its powers it is a ranged attacker monster. At maximum level it has two ranged power meaning in every round it will continue attacking enemy units with +2. 

And the job of a ranged attack is that it will handle the attack while staying at a distance. So never place any ranged monster in the frontline position. Instead keep it in the backline or midline position so that it can take full advantage of its ranged powers.

<center>
![Untitled design (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23yJLgZJdzcvWMkT8eyUUXyiGsx4ZeQAPe4k24sSJGegFmZ713wpKftCyvxgbUk3KxdXe.png)

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 100514.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vhsM8RsceQ2S4V3H7T3Tw9iirNeWEjhRUKo15AcHDonmW8mHCXfjB5WNWrGj29y6jts.png)
![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EqWqfBugZ7ibafYrEabt4sFhDtzyDEX7BEuWFxgBeJ6ujzhscks5E9JkG5bYaSrN18L.png)
</center>

Unfortunately this monster has no armor that can give protection to its health. The job of armor is to defend against any melee or ranged attack and give protection to its health.

At maximum level it has six health which defines its life. This is quite better. Its health in a low mana battle is very excellent but in a high mana battle this health is not very good. This monster can survive for a longer time if you place a healer or protector on its adjacent so that it can survive longer in the battle.

And above all it has very special speed which is +4. This means in every round, it increases its attack speed and also helps it to make any enemy attack miss.

At maximum level this monster has three special abilities which are Scattershot, Double Strike and Flying. These are abilities where a dual strategy of defense and aggressive stance is included.

Let's learn about these abilities.


<center>

---
# SCATTERSHOT
---

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 103356.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/245chA3AmPxBQFKAcKVcvn1tVtr3fB2UjjsChrbP6U3Ay2Kxmcv7FRHBCy4ZuoQUTciWb.png)
</center>


In Scattershot, what happens is that the magic and ranged attack targets a random enemy unit. This ability is specifically for magic and ranged attackers where it can randomly target any unit. Whether it is in the front, in the midline or in the backline position it can randomly target any unit.

And what is the benefit of this? Sometimes we see that a support monster is in the backline position and it is giving good support to its team. So because of this targeting the monster that is continuously supporting will be eliminated. And this is the most special feature of Scattershot.

<center>

---
# DOUBLE STRIKE
---

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 103400.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23v4bqyocNhSBVKinB2LdPagit7o9oSkC27BiaFdgs9N6GEtHfR6X36s5K65mrhyVhqgZ.png)
</center>


The second ability is Double Strike and as the name shows whenever its turn comes it attacks two times.

In normal conditions what happens is that it has two ranged power so in every round it continues attacking enemy units with +2. 

But now because it has Double Strike as soon as its turn comes it attacks the enemy unit with +2 strike and immediately makes another attack with the same ranged power.

Meaning, if you understand it as having four ranged power that would be correct because in every round after Double Strike it will give a total of +4 damage to the enemy units.

And this ability is used for an aggressive stance.

<center>

---
# FLYING
---

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 103405.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eqb342VaBoDMib4S5PxDeRQUYnyd9AxBDTKvGtKMiBeRShDMH2mDEfuCPVqaKpsmAW1.png)
</center>


The third ability is Flying which is considered a defensive and protective ability. And what happens with this is that there is a 25 percent chance that it will avoid physical attacks.

Flying basically works like a dodge ability where after every four attacks it avoids one attack.

The combination of its Flying and its Speed is very excellent and because of this, there is a higher chance up to a 50 percent chance that this monster will avoid physical attacks.

Yes however it is important to know that if the enemy unit also has the Flying ability then its effect is removed.

These are the three special abilities that make this monster extremely powerful.

<center>

---
# PRICE AND RENTING
---




![Screenshot 2026-08-30 100608.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23swgSC4Q3PiUr7NtvjuwvK2YW7KJd9Ws4mCEgjBesgPSxLrtiYGeqKspSJmhJzFcYdot.png)

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 100602.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23swfwG97rxS1HxRMdwvW44TocXPnixZyHNPdDHvLnrDSByyhSxLaKQRiSA3Jb8jtkbjn.png)
![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EqWqfBugZ7ibafYrEabt4sFhDtzyDEX7BEuWFxgBeJ6ujzhscks5E9JkG5bYaSrN18L.png)
</center>

Now lets talk about the important section of this content which is Price and Renting.

Currently in the market, this card is available at Level 2 and Level 4 and its initial price starts from 3 dollars and can go up to a maximum of 20 dollars which depends on its level.

If you cannot afford this monster card then you can easily take it on rent at a very cheap price. 

Renting starts from 1 to 20 DEC per day which is a very reasonable price. You can easily add it to your deck and take full advantage of its best powers.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body.title: Sol-2-Soul Sunday #100: Abundance Year Episode 2074 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 2009
Sunday 30, August 2026
Abundance Year Episode 2074
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Sol-2-Soul Sunday #100

![2074.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbb1KzvNPDoFybBfw7SKbouLsaqH6P2Tw4WoJdhFDRNQE/2074.png)

NEW AUDIO Summer 7. TV Guide. (since 30 August 2026.) Where & What we post, (blogs & videos).  
Today's Episode:  https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/2009_full_8-30-26_2074_sol10:a?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9   
 
Welcome new subscribers. Thanks for tuning in. Veteran subscribers, welcome back as well. We don’t want to forget you. You have gotten this channel where it is today. If you remember, we stated that companies like X-finiky, treat new subscribers like gold, and old subscribers like shit. We treat everybody equally. We love you all. Why? Because you subscribed, despite what we post. So maybe it rings a bell. Maybe there’s a morbid curiosity, or maybe… this is a long shot, Maybe you like it when we call out the bullshit that surrounds us. I know I do. 

So established subscribers, you can skip this audio, especially the last part, because it’s just TV guide type stuff. Exactly the same as last week. We haven’t changed anything. However, I feel a rant coming on, and there’s something new coming in the Full Metal Ox series. So stick around for a few. 

This channel is like none other on Substack. It’s not truth by my own definition, but it seems to be factual. I have not come across any other Stacks that are about promoting a long-running video series. In fact, I don’t know of any other video series like Full Metal Ox. There’s a little bit of brag in this, however the larger part is more self-deprecating. The FMO series is allowed to be quasi-unique because it’s not making money. It doesn’t even run on YouTube. Whatever crypto rewards we receive from archaic blogs, or revenue-sharing from video platforms is, whatever. It’s there. Maybe it will amount to something someday. Who knows? This makes our “model,” “unsuccessful,” so it hasn’t been carbon copied by the herd. We are unique, because we’re economically unviable, which, in our Simulatrix, makes us massively successful. Get it? If you do, maybe that’s why you subscribed. 

If you haven’t absorbed Noxsoma’s Psychological Profile, (AI generated based on our digital footprint), have a listen. It’s quite close to how we see this character. 

New Maxi-series. 

We’ve been working on this Emindcipation series for a significant part of 2026 and we finally completed the final segments in August. 

Let’s rewind. Part of our quest is truth. Pure truth. However, along the way we will accept propaganda, lies, tyranny, conquest, colonization, mental manipulation, and genocide as obstacles and lessons along the path. We, meaning this vessel, have been infiltrated with all of these obstacles, and more, having been raised on this plantation. These obstacles are more like demons, that have skewed our thought process, our language and our mis-understanding of his story and his system. Somehow, we have fought our way to the periphery, where we can get a better perspective of the system, how it has manipulated our good self, how we’ve manipulated others in the game, and in our final three centuries, we will be able to separate our being from that system. 

Not completely however. One of the “truth-parameters” that we’ve accepted, for now, is that the same system that oppresses us, also protects us. Not all of us, and not all of us in the same ways. But there’s an element of protection within the “beast system.” Part of the quest is discerning which bennies to hold and which to fold. 

Prince said something about there being at war. The battlefield is the Mind. The prize is your soul. What Emindcipation will do, is clear that battlefield. This is not a hope. We don’t hope. This is a quest. We quest!   

What is Emindcipation? Mind conjured and constructed this word out of the past. It doesn’t take a genius to see that it’s very similar to Emancipation. Emancipation literally means, “out of hand.” One might have called it, Ex, as in exit, man, or mano, meaning “hand,” cipation. When the slaves in the American South were “emancipated,” they were taken out of the hands of their owners, and put into the hands of the government, who delivered them into the hands of the States, who delivered them into the hands of the states’ prisons. 

Emindcipation is our, (meaning the Trinity’s) exit from the White Supremacy, Colonial mindset. Why? Because we noticed that we were infected with thoughts and attitudes that reflect a lifetime of being taught a certain way, about certain subjects. And although we see bad behavior on display, we know the game. We know the stress, and We know the roots. We also know that there’s so much more to it. Like at least 500, maybe 700 years to it. So the escape isn’t going to happen overnight. So to speak. 

This isn’t about guilt. Just sayin’. We played the game. It’s not about winning. It’s about surviving. Emindcipation isn’t about anybody else’s mind, but this one. If you wanna watch, or join in. You’re welcome. What it’s about, is Freedom. Freeing the Mind from Mental Slavery. (Marley.) 

“Emancipate yourselves from mental slavery.
None but ourselves can free our minds.” 

None but ourselves, can free ourselves. So even if I did want to moneytize this series, and sell Emindcipation subscriptions, you’d still have to do the work. 

Emindcipation, is this century’s Emancipation. 

There is no model for this. Repeat – There is no model for this. The system is not going to teach you how to exit the system. So, like everything else We’ve done during this liphe, we made it up. Just like psychology was made up, just like viruses were made up, just like whiteness was made up. And, just like the zodiac was made up. We just merged a few elements to create an explosive combination. Hopefully it doesn’t blow up in my face.     

So here’s what we did. This is top secret so don’t tell. We took our 12 Defensive Weapons against Fifth Generation Warfare (copyright 2024), and turned them into a Zodiac chakra. Some wise woman on the Stack called our diabolical dozen, a “Zodiac of Resistance.” An idea was born. Then, Universe dropped the Emindcipation bomb on us via a number of Afrocentric Stack channels. We were looking to ditch White Supremacy anyway, and we were looking for a new Mindset. We’re still exploring Afrocentrism and, so far we like what we see. Plus, it’s in our blood. 

So that’s what’s coming. 
We will probably run the Emindcipation series on Fridays. The show will still be 11 minutes and 11 seconds in length, so maybe Emindcipation gets 4 or 5 minutes, depending on what else is going on in that episode. If Friday falls on a promo day, we might ditch promos on that day. We do promo days to give us a break. Friday’s are also, Meditation Days and workout days, so it will be crowded, but we’ll work it out. It’s what we do. 

We will give you the heads up when the Emindcipation series will start, right here in our weekly audio update. 

Coming up next is the TV Guide. All the channels where you can see Full Metal Ox, the schedule for our Long Plays, and Health & Fitness Updates. If you’ve heard it before. You can quit here. If not, and you’ve never seen the series, check it out. Even though we link the series daily, Substack members seem to like writers more than vidiots. 

The show. 

Full Metal Ox. The most prolific daily series you’ve never heard of. Unless you have. 11 minutes and 11 seconds of musings, laughing at the whirled, observing life, calling out the sheeple, and figuring out how to survive the day. Also we drop fragments of ideas for audience consideration. If you like what you see, note it. We will give you the whole jam, the “disco version” in a Long Play episode. 

Full Metal Ox Long Plays. Every five days we cut an album and post it up for all the frustrated folks who get sucked into the frags, only to be left dangling at the really good parts. Not even sorry. You bring it on yourselves. More genuine interaction and we wouldn’t have to rely on systemic gamery and curiosity manipulation to build the channel. It’s like, they can’t take a millisecond to click, “like?” We’re not asking you to write essays. So guess what. You get played, because you’re used to being played. So, if you have the attention span for 30 minutes of brain-saving commentary, check the Long Plays. 

Hepdekad Series. This was originally a ten day health, wellness, fitness and mental check in series. But ten days went by so quickly that not much changed. So we pushed it to 17 days. We chose 17 because it’s not a sacred number, and it wouldn’t interfere with the two other series. The three series pile up once every 85 days. Which is roughly once a century, (100 days). The idea is not only for us to check in with our own development, and share with our audience, but for us, (as your Cosmic Representative), to check on our constituents, and for You to check on your friends and families, and your extended orbit. This is a stray commentary, but “social media” has made us less social. Or so it’s been said. I’ve always been less social. But maybe I am even more less social now. 


The channels. 
The daily Full Metal Ox series can be seen on Bitchute.com. The oldest and most controversial of our locations. We’ve been on this platform for close to a proper decade. 

Rumble.com – Being on Rumble is like Lisa Douglas on Green Acres. A sophisticated socialite follows her husband to a place called Hooterville. We surmise that Rumble is dominated by bible-thumpers, apocalyptos and those cashing in on Near Death experiences, Gospel codes and doomsday. But there’s a little sliver of space for our unique presentation. 

Odysee.com – This is the one we link and promote. It’s the easiest. The newest and has the smallest audience. The most popular times FMO is watched seems to be Sundays, however we are getting a few more views and follows as we warn candidates about what we’re doing. The little flame is more of an acknowledgment than a “like”. It means that a real human showed up. Thanks for that. 

Youtube.com – We are there as Noxsoma. Fitness stuff. It’s a legacy page. 20 years on that platform. Maybe we start it up again. Post some safe click-bait there to get you here. You tell me. 

Instagram – as @Noxsoma. Many years on the gram, maybe a decade or slightly more. We’ve begun posting clips from our workout days. body.title: Segunda audición de los tres niños - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![lsowr.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdGxuepYqD3ndahPrVgosDnQ99t6vmm77jLPJyr8sUmEX/lsowr.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/musico-instrumento-musical-violin-artista-8198576/) Desde la primera audición los tres niños solamente tenían una semana para prepararse, sin embargo, esa semana pasó muy rápido, donde Charlie pasó muchas horas repitiendo partituras con su banjo, Lucas buscaba nuevas ideas y Sofía tenía que trabajar en algunos detalles de su voz para así lograr que se escuchara perfecta. En esa semana hubo estrés, cansancio, pero tenían presente que 59 participantes también tenían el mismo tiempo para prepararse, por eso era una gran responsabilidad y no había tiempo para cometer errores. Finalmente, llegó el día de la segunda la audición y desde muy temprano los tres niños se marcharon hacia el lugar y durante el camino no hablaron, donde Charlie llevaba su banjo con mucho cuidado, mientras Lucas y Sofía veían el paisaje. Minutos después llegaron y se quedaron sorprendidos por la cantidad de personas, ya que cada participante estaba acompañado por sus familiares, además el lugar parecía mucho más grande que en la primera ronda. Los tres niños se miraron y comprendieron que solamente era 60 audiciones y solo muy pocos iban a poder conseguir avanzar. >From the first audition, the three children had only one week to prepare; however, that week went by very quickly. During that time, Charlie spent many hours practicing the music on his banjo, Lucas was looking for new ideas, and Sofía had to work on some details of her voice to make sure it sounded perfect. That week was filled with stress and exhaustion, but they kept in mind that the 59 other participants also had the same amount of time to prepare, so it was a huge responsibility and there was no room for error. # >Finally, the day of the second audition arrived, and very early in the morning, the three children set off for the venue. They didn’t speak on the way there; Charlie carried his banjo very carefully, while Lucas and Sofía looked out at the scenery. Minutes later, they arrived and were surprised by the number of people, since each participant was accompanied by family members, and the venue seemed much larger than in the first round. The three children looked at each other and realized that there were 60 auditions, and only a very few would be able to move on. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewbibUHNCrYnNyrKXbsLnh9EVC2dWB6ysx6Uzd4YpCKx/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/guitarra-de-cuerda-marron-306175/) Tomaron su respectivo puesto donde todos esperaban y poco a poco iban siendo llamados uno por uno, ya que la dinámica era igual subir al escenario, hacer la presentación y que el jurado tomara sus anotaciones, para luego saber si habías conseguido avanzar. En ese momento Lucas comentó —Esto es mucho más difícil que la primera vez— Sofia estaba de acuerdo y Charlie simplemente se quedó en silencio, con su banjo listo, a pesa de tener nervios, tenía que ser fuerte y concentrarse en todo lo que había ensayado. Entonces los tres niños escucharon sus nombres y los tres quedaron sorprendidos, ya que era su turno de presentarse, pero por unos segundos ninguno se movió, hasta que Charlie miró a sus amigos y dijo —Vamos, para eso nos preparamos toda la semana— así que los tres niños comenzaron hacia la tarima, donde había nervios, emoción y en ese momento Charlie recordó a su abuelo, sus primeros errores y todas las veces que quiso rendirse porque pensaba que nunca conseguiría hacerlo bien. Además, Lucas también recordó todos los ensayos y Sofía recordó cada detalle que había preparado para que aquel espectáculo tuviera algo especial. Los tres niños se subieron sobre la tarima y notaron algo de público, muchas luces y los jurados ya ocupaban sus lugares. Charlie miró su banjo y luego miró a Lucas y Sofía, donde sonrieron y ahora los tres niños tenían que enfrentar ese gran desafío, donde todos estaban esperando por ellos y la semana de preparación estaba lista para ser demostrada en estas segundas adiciones. >They took their respective places where everyone was waiting, and little by little they were called up one by one. The process was always the same: go up on stage, give their performance, let the judges take notes, and then find out if they’d made it to the next round. At that moment, Lucas remarked, “This is much harder than the first time.” Sofia agreed, and Charlie simply remained silent, his banjo at the ready; despite his nerves, he had to stay strong and focus on everything he’d rehearsed. # >Then the three children heard their names called, and all three were surprised—it was their turn to perform— but for a few seconds, none of them moved, until Charlie looked at his friends and said, “Come on, that’s what we’ve been preparing for all week.” So the three children made their way to the stage, where there was nervousness and excitement, and in that moment, Charlie remembered his grandfather, his early mistakes, and all the times he’d wanted to give up because he thought he’d never be able to do it right. Lucas also remembered all the rehearsals, and Sofía recalled every detail she had prepared to make that show something special. # >The three children climbed onto the stage and noticed the audience, the bright lights, and the judges already in their seats. Charlie looked at his banjo and then at Lucas and Sofía, who were smiling back at him. Now the three children had to face this huge challenge, with everyone waiting for them, and the week of preparation was ready to be put on display in these second rounds. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQHWFm5QaMWHG8M56sfkaajh91Js6cB8W1Hdhi9f2hD4C/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/ligero-espacio-oscuro-textura-27806693/)
