body.title: [Movie] ANIKOLAKPO (Aníkúlápó)
body.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog 🧡


This movie Anikolakpo ,began with a man, Saro, who was on a journey for a better life, and by the time he got exactly what he had been looking for, he became almost unrecognizable. This alone gave me some suspense that I needed.



![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUDSZuhJvvgM8aiuvwqdraxuQLVoPaKDv9mXAje1qKnwC/136187.jpg)


Award-winning actor Kunle Remi was the one who acted as Saro, and without any stress, he stood out right from when he was introduced to the movie in that marketplace. At the beginning, I paid close attention to him because I liked him; he was also a traveler and a traditional Aso Oke weaver who found himself established in Oyo. And when he got to the new village, he was welcome by one of the successful traders, Awarun. She took him in and also got him a job. And those scenes made it look like he has finally found someone who could change his life.



![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzZLJbGxmhnrcoA9fmPKFUnjXXohJPKDSYFaPfRWJR1U/136190.jpg)

But what I saw about Saro was that everyone that helped him, he was treating them as if they were his next stepping stone to new things, which he was doing. Because after Awarun helped him, he left her and moved to Arolake and from her to the power of the gourd.

At first, I see him as someone who didn't mean harm due to his ambition. But at some point in this movie, he was doing too much, and he didn't know when enough was really enough.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXTRZi8FBEgizmoJ95EpoYztT7c4btTxN18e1zR8C1KU5/136189.jpg)



I felt sorry for Arolake even though I liked the character she played. She was the youngest of the king's wives, and even with that, it doesn't mean that she was favored and happy. The rest of the king's wives didn't like her, and that got her trapped in a marriage she didn't choose, and when she came in contact with Saro, they both found affection towards each other.





What got me so interested in Arolake was how much she went out of her way to help Saro. And after Saro was killed. And after Saro was killed, Arolake, out of her love for him, fought Akala and took the mysterious gourd that could bring the dead back to life. She brought back Saro to life and gave him the power. But with this, Saro became much more powerful, and Arolake became less important to him.


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZyvCkKrgaSGuGibLXUntM7qLCgt18rzE9yF1VJycbWmN/136186.jpg)


Sola Sobowale, who played the role of Awarun, was a character I so much enjoyed watching because of how fluent she was in her local dialect and her charisma, which made her so impossible to ignore. She has her own business and is an independent, wealthy woman and commands a lot of respect and power in her environment. When Saro first got to her village with nothing, Safe connected him to opportunities and also helped him in her way.


And I got a bit furious after I saw how he betrayed her, and this made me realize that Saro was not only ambitious. But should I say he was covetous due to the fact that anyone who helps him, he easily forgets once he no longer needs them because he has moved to the next stage?







![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWpPg78KMM3ngjPDkyu4zBsu5mp56YZTfmYE5ALFKid5f/136188.jpg)

And even though some people like the Alaafin and his wives, who were frustrating Arolake, the palace servants, guards, and market women played a little dialogue in this movie; their impact was still felt, and the chiefs and hunters also made the environment look so much like ancient Oyo, which gave this movie more life and not just Saro's story.

And the place where this movie was getting more interesting to me was when Saro was brought back to life and he began to use his power and how those around him were giving him a special treatment due to his new ability. And what made me dislike him was when he began to make demands from people and ask for payment before he could help anyone when everything he has was handed freely to him. And what he did with the power he had hit me so hard because he believed he was better than the rest of the people.

Apart from the characters, another thing I do much admire about this movie was the environment they used. The Yorùbá cultural details and how detailed the cultural beliefs were.

This movie doesn't treat the supernatural as something separate from what I already knew in my everyday life. Death, spirits, charms, and the living world all exist together, which made the story feel rooted in Yoruba folklore.




Though I still have some complaints about some of the scenes that felt rushed, Aníkúlápó was one of the movies where I saw how someone can come from nothing and become someone and then become nobody again, just like what happened to Saro.

He was privileged to have another opportunity that a lot of people were seeking, but he still lost everything at the end. This kept on ringing in my head even after the movie because it was memorable for me. And I'll rate this movie 89/100. And it is a movie I will recommend to you, anyhow.


Thank you for stopping by my blog 🧡

_Rating: **89/100**_

---

body.title: Relato: ¿Qué se sentiría marcharse?
body.body: ![Hive Banners 2026 - 2026-08-29T071714.067.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickaboleyn/48hJb68bxrvHQvpXW733y5Dibr3MuAM1EVH3AokpqMsf8QEB3nZBaqjqTZ9Ccyp4BF.png) **Imagen editada con Canva. Fuente de la imagen: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/puesta-de-sol-escenica-sobre-ciudad-lejana-30645676/)**

> Varias veces Clara se paraba por la ventana de la casa, contemplando las casas de afuera. Casas grandes, muy cerradas, de esas que esconden historias y secretos que solo aquellos con la curiosidad suficiente se pueden imaginar.

Pero ella no estaba interesada en los secretos. Estaba interesada en algo más mundano, más peregrino, más vago: marcharse, dejarlo todo atrás, sentir la libertad sabiendo que no regresaría.

No pensaba en morir, aunque en su mente la idea también se le había pasado en medio de las lágrimas solitarias. Ella pensaba que quizás marcharse de ahí sin dar explicaciones, sin dar nada a cambio, era la mejor forma de liberarse de todo lo que la mantenía atada a esa casa. Que marcharse la curaría de su depresión, que la liberaría de estar escuchando a su madre esquizofrénica hablar sola o explotar de ira cada vez que se le decía algo, que dejaría atrás a una familia de por sí rota y dividida por los odios eternos entre hermanos, que buscaría a nuevas amistades que puedan escucharla sin juzgar ni darle consejos no pedidos... Que sola se enfrentaría a la vida porque al final así acabó: sola, con poca gente a qué recurrir, sin empleo fijo y estable, sin casa.

Lo último no le asustaba. Ella sentía que aquello era su destino, aunque luchaba por cambiarlo. Porque era de la firme creencia que el destino no es algo a lo que uno se tenía qué resignar: era algo que se podía moldear a gusto.

Y se dio cuenta, conforme el sol se alzaba en el horizonte, que a pesar de que la vida es complicada y el mundo convulso, todavía los sueños se pueden perseguir... Siempre con la conciencia de que todo sueño requiere mucho sacrificio, tiempo, y esfuerzo.

¿Marcharse de casa sería un sacrificio? Quizás sí, quizás no. Eso estaba por averiguarlo.

body.title: South Coast pickleball plus new home orchids  : August 29 2026
body.body:
Got to say I like waling up in our Shoalhaven Heads house. Do not have the sliding doors and windows to wake me up every 10 minutes from 5am. Feel kind of rested after a late night for US markets open. My wife went off for coffee. Was hoping to catch up with my son but his day ran into my afternoon. Decided not the drive the 45 minutes to spend 10 minutes there and drive back ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/86b13132-22fc-48d5-9832-06f10a2a8207.jpg) Went to play pickleball instead at the foot of Coolangatta Mountain. This is part of connecting with the community we will move into sometime next year Worked on some of the drills learned last week. Still feel like I have a long way to go. Will line up some coaching - kind of thinking the 70 year old body is in amazing shape to do well in 70+ competition. Won more than we lost. Just fab playing in the shadow of the mountain with no wind. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/775e5954-a9b9-445e-8eff-638e74d37006.jpg) As befits pickleball days a bit short of photos. Did get photos of the cymbidium orchids flowering. Our friend gifted these when they moved out a few weeks ago. Opened this week. Orchids will come to Sydney with us tomorrow ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b7e00a33-7045-4714-86bc-836f534433df.jpg) Side on - some fabulously contrasted colours - like autumn Cooked a protein melange for friends for dinner. Was a process of managing timing. Thai fish cakes to start made from scratch. Yum. A bbq mix from there on - timing - baked potatoes, eye fillet not sliced, chicken sausages, beef patties, one chicken thigh, lamb chops (from our guests), a few butterflied prawns, seared broccolini. Served with beans and cauliflower veges. Worked well. Chef was talking to himself a lot to keep track. And in between threw the ball for the dog a lot plus a few toilet walks.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@carrinm/actifit-carrinm-20260830t121317842z)_

body.title: Sol-2-Soul Sunday #100: Abundance Year Episode 2074 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 2009
Sunday 30, August 2026
Abundance Year Episode 2074
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Sol-2-Soul Sunday #100

![2074.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbb1KzvNPDoFybBfw7SKbouLsaqH6P2Tw4WoJdhFDRNQE/2074.png)

NEW AUDIO Summer 7. TV Guide. (since 30 August 2026.) Where & What we post, (blogs & videos).  
Today's Episode:  https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/2009_full_8-30-26_2074_sol10:a?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9   
 
Welcome new subscribers. Thanks for tuning in. Veteran subscribers, welcome back as well. We don’t want to forget you. You have gotten this channel where it is today. If you remember, we stated that companies like X-finiky, treat new subscribers like gold, and old subscribers like shit. We treat everybody equally. We love you all. Why? Because you subscribed, despite what we post. So maybe it rings a bell. Maybe there’s a morbid curiosity, or maybe… this is a long shot, Maybe you like it when we call out the bullshit that surrounds us. I know I do. 

So established subscribers, you can skip this audio, especially the last part, because it’s just TV guide type stuff. Exactly the same as last week. We haven’t changed anything. However, I feel a rant coming on, and there’s something new coming in the Full Metal Ox series. So stick around for a few. 

This channel is like none other on Substack. It’s not truth by my own definition, but it seems to be factual. I have not come across any other Stacks that are about promoting a long-running video series. In fact, I don’t know of any other video series like Full Metal Ox. There’s a little bit of brag in this, however the larger part is more self-deprecating. The FMO series is allowed to be quasi-unique because it’s not making money. It doesn’t even run on YouTube. Whatever crypto rewards we receive from archaic blogs, or revenue-sharing from video platforms is, whatever. It’s there. Maybe it will amount to something someday. Who knows? This makes our “model,” “unsuccessful,” so it hasn’t been carbon copied by the herd. We are unique, because we’re economically unviable, which, in our Simulatrix, makes us massively successful. Get it? If you do, maybe that’s why you subscribed. 

If you haven’t absorbed Noxsoma’s Psychological Profile, (AI generated based on our digital footprint), have a listen. It’s quite close to how we see this character. 

New Maxi-series. 

We’ve been working on this Emindcipation series for a significant part of 2026 and we finally completed the final segments in August. 

Let’s rewind. Part of our quest is truth. Pure truth. However, along the way we will accept propaganda, lies, tyranny, conquest, colonization, mental manipulation, and genocide as obstacles and lessons along the path. We, meaning this vessel, have been infiltrated with all of these obstacles, and more, having been raised on this plantation. These obstacles are more like demons, that have skewed our thought process, our language and our mis-understanding of his story and his system. Somehow, we have fought our way to the periphery, where we can get a better perspective of the system, how it has manipulated our good self, how we’ve manipulated others in the game, and in our final three centuries, we will be able to separate our being from that system. 

Not completely however. One of the “truth-parameters” that we’ve accepted, for now, is that the same system that oppresses us, also protects us. Not all of us, and not all of us in the same ways. But there’s an element of protection within the “beast system.” Part of the quest is discerning which bennies to hold and which to fold. 

Prince said something about there being at war. The battlefield is the Mind. The prize is your soul. What Emindcipation will do, is clear that battlefield. This is not a hope. We don’t hope. This is a quest. We quest!   

What is Emindcipation? Mind conjured and constructed this word out of the past. It doesn’t take a genius to see that it’s very similar to Emancipation. Emancipation literally means, “out of hand.” One might have called it, Ex, as in exit, man, or mano, meaning “hand,” cipation. When the slaves in the American South were “emancipated,” they were taken out of the hands of their owners, and put into the hands of the government, who delivered them into the hands of the States, who delivered them into the hands of the states’ prisons. 

Emindcipation is our, (meaning the Trinity’s) exit from the White Supremacy, Colonial mindset. Why? Because we noticed that we were infected with thoughts and attitudes that reflect a lifetime of being taught a certain way, about certain subjects. And although we see bad behavior on display, we know the game. We know the stress, and We know the roots. We also know that there’s so much more to it. Like at least 500, maybe 700 years to it. So the escape isn’t going to happen overnight. So to speak. 

This isn’t about guilt. Just sayin’. We played the game. It’s not about winning. It’s about surviving. Emindcipation isn’t about anybody else’s mind, but this one. If you wanna watch, or join in. You’re welcome. What it’s about, is Freedom. Freeing the Mind from Mental Slavery. (Marley.) 

“Emancipate yourselves from mental slavery.
None but ourselves can free our minds.” 

None but ourselves, can free ourselves. So even if I did want to moneytize this series, and sell Emindcipation subscriptions, you’d still have to do the work. 

Emindcipation, is this century’s Emancipation. 

There is no model for this. Repeat – There is no model for this. The system is not going to teach you how to exit the system. So, like everything else We’ve done during this liphe, we made it up. Just like psychology was made up, just like viruses were made up, just like whiteness was made up. And, just like the zodiac was made up. We just merged a few elements to create an explosive combination. Hopefully it doesn’t blow up in my face.     

So here’s what we did. This is top secret so don’t tell. We took our 12 Defensive Weapons against Fifth Generation Warfare (copyright 2024), and turned them into a Zodiac chakra. Some wise woman on the Stack called our diabolical dozen, a “Zodiac of Resistance.” An idea was born. Then, Universe dropped the Emindcipation bomb on us via a number of Afrocentric Stack channels. We were looking to ditch White Supremacy anyway, and we were looking for a new Mindset. We’re still exploring Afrocentrism and, so far we like what we see. Plus, it’s in our blood. 

So that’s what’s coming. 
We will probably run the Emindcipation series on Fridays. The show will still be 11 minutes and 11 seconds in length, so maybe Emindcipation gets 4 or 5 minutes, depending on what else is going on in that episode. If Friday falls on a promo day, we might ditch promos on that day. We do promo days to give us a break. Friday’s are also, Meditation Days and workout days, so it will be crowded, but we’ll work it out. It’s what we do. 

We will give you the heads up when the Emindcipation series will start, right here in our weekly audio update. 

Coming up next is the TV Guide. All the channels where you can see Full Metal Ox, the schedule for our Long Plays, and Health & Fitness Updates. If you’ve heard it before. You can quit here. If not, and you’ve never seen the series, check it out. Even though we link the series daily, Substack members seem to like writers more than vidiots. 

The show. 

Full Metal Ox. The most prolific daily series you’ve never heard of. Unless you have. 11 minutes and 11 seconds of musings, laughing at the whirled, observing life, calling out the sheeple, and figuring out how to survive the day. Also we drop fragments of ideas for audience consideration. If you like what you see, note it. We will give you the whole jam, the “disco version” in a Long Play episode. 

Full Metal Ox Long Plays. Every five days we cut an album and post it up for all the frustrated folks who get sucked into the frags, only to be left dangling at the really good parts. Not even sorry. You bring it on yourselves. More genuine interaction and we wouldn’t have to rely on systemic gamery and curiosity manipulation to build the channel. It’s like, they can’t take a millisecond to click, “like?” We’re not asking you to write essays. So guess what. You get played, because you’re used to being played. So, if you have the attention span for 30 minutes of brain-saving commentary, check the Long Plays. 

Hepdekad Series. This was originally a ten day health, wellness, fitness and mental check in series. But ten days went by so quickly that not much changed. So we pushed it to 17 days. We chose 17 because it’s not a sacred number, and it wouldn’t interfere with the two other series. The three series pile up once every 85 days. Which is roughly once a century, (100 days). The idea is not only for us to check in with our own development, and share with our audience, but for us, (as your Cosmic Representative), to check on our constituents, and for You to check on your friends and families, and your extended orbit. This is a stray commentary, but “social media” has made us less social. Or so it’s been said. I’ve always been less social. But maybe I am even more less social now. 


The channels. 
The daily Full Metal Ox series can be seen on Bitchute.com. The oldest and most controversial of our locations. We’ve been on this platform for close to a proper decade. 

Rumble.com – Being on Rumble is like Lisa Douglas on Green Acres. A sophisticated socialite follows her husband to a place called Hooterville. We surmise that Rumble is dominated by bible-thumpers, apocalyptos and those cashing in on Near Death experiences, Gospel codes and doomsday. But there’s a little sliver of space for our unique presentation. 

Odysee.com – This is the one we link and promote. It’s the easiest. The newest and has the smallest audience. The most popular times FMO is watched seems to be Sundays, however we are getting a few more views and follows as we warn candidates about what we’re doing. The little flame is more of an acknowledgment than a “like”. It means that a real human showed up. Thanks for that. 

Youtube.com – We are there as Noxsoma. Fitness stuff. It’s a legacy page. 20 years on that platform. Maybe we start it up again. Post some safe click-bait there to get you here. You tell me. 

Instagram – as @Noxsoma. Many years on the gram, maybe a decade or slightly more. We’ve begun posting clips from our workout days. The clips are excerpts from the FMO Dailies and they are designed to bring curious minds to Substack. Simple as that. If you want to follow, fine. If you don’t watch the show, you can watch the fit clips. They don’t run on Substack. 

Blogs: Hive.blog. Minds.com. Steemit.com Gab.com (with audio). Gab gets the 4 20 Substack audio a day late, in the morning, and a link to the Odysee.com channel. 

We are also on Mewe, Mastodon, Telegram, X, Facebook, and maybe a few others we’ve neglected or forgotten about. We use these to get people to Substack and into the Secret City. If we are looking for you, odds are you’re looking for us too. That’s how we roll. 

This is why we do it the way we do. There’s no need to pretend. We want to fund our platform with real humans. Nickles, dimes & dollars. We are not looking for VCs, angel investors, or lottery windfalls, (but maybe we should start playing). When you’re in, you’re in because you want to be in. There’s something you like that you feel is worth maybe a dollar a day, that you won’t miss. 

It’s meant to be and it will happen. 

And we haven’t even told you about the radio station yet. But if you watch the show, (every 10 days we dedicate an 11 11 episode to promos), you already know.      
 

This is Summer Audio seven and it’s going to run all week, and then maybe forever in the archives. So if you have somehow dug this up, 7 times removed, and are wondering where it originated. 
The answer is, noxsoma.substack.com. 

SUBSCRIBE.

body.title: O Mercado Cripto em 2025: Teve Bull Market ou o Varejo Ficou Para Trás?
body.body:
![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/gg-dl/AAQ_wbFqO4sAt6UCWRQdy2_EFDThmgh8ymHCnykWCSQUrmOGbdeLmjXeRHaVNXqN7XeM0oaeybicoH-7bG_eS9ZijqqSJ6fynKsC-RSd_9jNthdfxex3A31rXiVMvS3bjeF9b50JTWuTtuUcyhf43dwJlpvmOLX6XI4LSc09wmklqSU370Rk=s1024-rj)
Se você acompanhou o mercado de ativos digitais em 2025 com a expectativa de ver uma reprise dos ciclos passados — com altas explosivas de 10.000% em moedas alternativas da noite para o dia —, a sensação pode ter sido de frustração.

A resposta curta é: Sim, o mercado teve momentos expressivos de alta, mas a estrutura do ciclo mudou radicalmente. O que vivemos não foi a euforia generalizada do varejo, mas sim um ciclo maduro e institucional.
# O Que Impulsionou a Alta em 2025
**Entrada Institucional e ETFs:** A consolidação dos ETFs à vista e a criação da Reserva Estratégica de Bitcoin nos EUA criaram uma demanda constante e estruturada por ativos de grande porte.

**Profissionalização do Capital:** A liquidez global deixou de ser puxada por pequenos investidores e passou a ser ditada por fundos, tesourarias corporativas e ativos do mundo real tokenizados (RWAs).

**Narrativas de Utilidade:** Redes focadas em alta performance e infraestrutura (como Solana e ecossistemas Layer 2) capturaram valor real por geração de taxas e uso prático, diferindo de ciclos movidos a pura especulação.

A percepção de que a \

não aconteceu decorre de uma mudança profunda na dinâmica do mercado em relação aos ciclos de 2017 e 2021. Anteriormente, a alta do Bitcoin desencadeava um fluxo de capital previsível para o Ethereum e, em seguida, para altcoins menores, impulsionado por um varejo ativo e liquidez abundante espalhada por todo o ecossistema.

No ciclo de 2025, essa lógica mudou:

**Fluxo de Capital**: O dinheiro ficou retido no Bitcoin e em poucas redes dominantes, quebrando a rotação tradicional.

**Perfil dos Investidores:**O mercado passou a ser dominado por instituições focadas em compliance, criptoativos do mundo real (RWAs) e stablecoins, diferentemente do varejo anterior que impulsionava memes e novos tokens diariamente.

**Liquidez:** A liquidez tornou-se extremamente fragmentada devido ao lançamento de centenas de milhares de novos tokens, impedindo a concentração de ganhos expressivos no setor.

**O Diagnóstico Final**
O ciclo de 2025 provou que o mercado de criptomoedas amadureceu. Não tivemos uma \

, mas sim uma valorização seletiva. O Bitcoin e projetos com fundamentos sólidos entregaram performance, enquanto projetos sem utilidade real sofreram com a falta de liquidez.\n\nPosted using [SoMee](https://somee.blog/@selhomarlopes/o-mercado-cripto-em-2025-teve-bull-market-ou-o-varejo-ficou-para-tras)

body.title: Sunday morning run - road block, making things work
body.body:
![IMG_4985.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23qrL6w6cDkeV8NsL5VZYazJbVPFG8dM5cUWEeAdcYu26f5qD8yGir2xcmxAy8RJBfb9X.jpeg)

The Netherlands is famous for it’s waterworks, next to protecting the ground that is below sea level, they also use the waterworks to preserve sweat water in times of extreme heat. This means that they allow some area’s to float in order to prevent the water to reach the sea (where it will be mixed with salt water. My local place has such a designated area that can be floated. They floated this area and will create a big water supply for times in need. 


![IMG_4977.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/245cWQFpLmSF3SwxyeRvLrN8LgcjkP2gVrsuDq3ZWP3kkpsbN2ba9BJSHrUim9VmrY1X3.jpeg)

For me, this means that my usual green zone running route is blocked and I had to find an other route. 

Which was pretty fun, with the limited time I had my run moved to the outed sides of the floated area and some of the light industrial area’s. 

![IMG_4974.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/243fmp9hKNUgxZfM1T9t5qYvRAQHPRkjqDo7vMSs99RoiT2ZGhoTmpLGSbaEbwETg4nMX.jpeg)

![IMG_4981.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/245wHoSJ9Vr16FL3T5zdd3y8YEpM8J7cEmqB3bmQzJNLLSmY2emq75nSypEzK464Z5FhU.jpeg)

![IMG_4976.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/244UohwsTg8GLZ6CaLKNfWRrEDqtri1ebjdthshp1jZmgTUXEYqQKaXcSc4CKnFc1BcY3.jpeg)

On Sunday morning it is fine running here, but I personally avoid the area in the evening. For now, just fun bigger empty roads! 

It was raining quite a bit but that is pretty nice weather to run in (you can only get this wet) so just ignore it! 




![IMG_4984.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/EnWKNPpvwXoXHGXE51iRLkYhjB7ijnsLCeZv8H8NXhRiwcKnRVGaqcibrqxf4kECwR5.jpeg)

Happy running!

The Christian life is totally a life of grace. We are redeemed by grace; we grow by grace and we will reach our point of destination by grace. 

In this spiritual journey, we do not commence with grace and then continue by our own works. No! It is grace throughout. But what then is this grace?
          
The Bible says: 

>_**JOHN 1: 17** - For the law was given through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ._

Grace is simply favour that is unmerited, God’s goodness freely given to us through Christ, not because we deserve it, but because of His love and mercy.

via Josephs BassView  08022026
body.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=steemseph/aizv3t0y ## LIVE MUSIC!!! More from Joseph’s BassView on August 2nd 2026!

### Song: “Flip Flop Fly” ## “**” ### By: ## **Blues Brothers**

### The GoPro battery held out. Occasionally, my iPhone and YouTube’s live stream service is a fun backup. This performance is from August 2nd 2026 with the Jazz Derelicts. The title screen for these videos will also have the green goggles. ## Music: Our arrangement is like the originate recording. The bass part is well written and I play it almost exactly as written, but I try to change octaves and make it heavier sometimes. It’s not a popular song and irony has it so that it’s difficult for me to play. The part is fast swinging 8th notes. I’ve gotten better, I should be better at it, and I know what to work on. Nobody is complaining. The audience danced.

## Gear:

**Amp**: The venue has an amp that I like to use. I plug into a direct box and also the amp. I finally took pictures and I can say that it’s an Ampeg B2-RE head. 450 watts at 4 ohms or 250 at ??? The amp head is on top of a speaker cabinet with 4 ten-inch speakers. I like that for my boomy Fender Jazz bass tendency. 4 tens should be more punch and less big low boomy speaker sub type sound. So far, band mates have no complaints. I also plug into a direct box so that the sound guy can get a clean feed directly from my instrument. He told me later that it sounds good and he runs the bass signal though a compressor. He also plays bass. I ask him if it gets too clicks and he says all good. I like all of that. I have the freedom to accidentally play too loud a little.
**Bass**: Fender Jazz Bass Deluxe 4 String… also known as “*Bread and Butter.*” I use this bass for long periods of time. I modified it for longevity.
**Music Stand AND Lights:** The lights are rechargeable and they come with a long long long charging cable. It’s amazing how long it is. The music stand has been with me for a long time. It’s been very durable. Also, very portable because it folds into a small manageable shape. It’s long and fits well into a former telescope bag. I recently fixed the zippers with a busted @SoCAlHive keychain.
**The venue:** A locally world famous type of spot that loves to have our band, Jazz Derelicts. We bring in a mid-Sunday audience that likes to buy drinks and can afford to eat also. We make them lots of money on an early Sunday afternoon. I hear the burgers are good and I still haven’t purchased one. Venue beer is good enough and a “drink ticket” is nice. They have lots of seating and the room is large. People say the sound is good. There are many good places to hide our equipment. No wind because we are indoors. Parking is awesome, and they have a dance floor.

# Thank you for reading and watching the video.

I love leathers and works that use leather. Your grandma seem like a really passionate one, and good for you for inheriting the kit. I would have loved that myself as well!

That flower design is really good and I learned from you that you gotta wet the leather first before stamping. :D

Recently, I learned about leather and how awesome they are for lasting years... And I got myself a leather folio to keep my journals, stickers, and bookmarks in one place. I love watching people craft with leather. There's a different level of satisfaction I feel cos I know it will last a long time compared to using plastics or synthetics that will end up in landfills after maybe a year or so. 

At one point I wanted to do it myself, but that means buying the materials needed and I'm not ready for that lol. I for sure in the future will do crafting. :D

body.title: BK Lama, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body:
![1788032687398.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23xV6hBTbhpNvDM1KodrC1C5zyG8u3QQ4Rxv6VAZ8th6uicw8tMRNuQn7aMfY2VrPqqBp.jpg)


Blessings, colleagues. Continuing with pianos, today I've drawn a new one. This one is called the i162 BK Lama. This piano is very beautiful; it has striking colors and is among some of the most beautiful pianos in the regular section. It's an electronic piano, so it doesn't have a large soundboard like the large grand pianos. It also doesn't have strings or levers that are actuated by the keys. Everything here is electronic; not even the sound is physically generated, but electronic.

I think you get the point, right? 🙂 This type of piano also has other interesting features: they can be tuned for different genres almost infinitely. Being electronic, they don't have the limitations of a physical piano, which has a limit in the internal strings.

By connecting it to a computer, you can turn it into a synthesizer or various types of pianos. That's why it's so versatile and beloved by pianists. So, let's move on to the drawing to show you how I made it. First, I made the frame, which consists of several perpendicular and parallel rectangles. In one of the larger ones, I made a notch to add the category, which is common.

<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23t8D6MYfEP4rzAcpYkpKheTx8AfbZbKUaHJ2fbbCtnjJrNsRYmeDmDcoi4xuDr7gq87X.jpg) Now I want to show you how to design the piano. It's a rectangle to which I then added some interior lines to give it volume. I also designed the area where the keys will be. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23t8D6MYfEP4rzAcpX9Ye7QjtDvJs1NqoaDJEWoVjPK3Mnx1XeuBHhKnSAw2Z229dT4Cy.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23t8D1dSfkSnsV3mwx4QKv6AC1oTV1sHYp8JZTBXv8djitoyPLJsMyPYp8YRHfBxh3wTw.jpg) In the details section, I've added all the keys. As you can see, I've now used the space I created earlier to place them there. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23tSzChULnPBWHacLG5Dddpd4iWjeWKSNQAC1WRrVkRACRauzx6tnf2BNMURSsXxTfwrH.jpg) With the keys and the outline of the drawing ready, I'll now move on to painting all the contours and their interiors. You know, this is the most fun part. Enjoy the process. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23tcJe44AVf3e2NCJUkbnLmwGYCtU24jMVAXzjjtb7UqvvdiZ84dYd14bBVbSg8u9nAje.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23wgapQzKEi82oVAX3baA6V1FB9uRz3NGuFJBoHa3betWPMVGhjS73quZqRF4r1C7JHM8.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23zkniPa6js71yGRPphzDmWZQADNMQMcDNcaMJQ8rbkqgWLRzX7dW2B56dpZMtLJ7T1Ec.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/242rpWmCwVPgixUzUZ768uRg75uEnY3C2bFeQkKmLUN5p6KRvgaMHKRBs7svviWmNi4NB.jpg) To conclude, colleagues, I'm showing you the final result of the piano with everything painted, but now with the name of the game and the card added as well. In addition to other aesthetic details like the buttons on top of the piano. See you soon, colleagues, blessings. This has been my drawing of the day. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23z7BdaN9ZSdVs59JnnwxQDCokEQeCjASTKAtFLTJYCMrTPf4mViNCTmdP5Uhiy3iFKZV.jpg)

title.title: Tribute to Iranian Women | Creative- Sunday
title.body:
I created this painting at the time when war was imposed on Iran. I gathered all my colors. It was the day when attack on Minab School happened and 168 school girls were martyred. It was such a tragic news for me that my heart felt like it's withering away. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRe5oxuCQL93Dg1CBCVNQwRFrT6inZ3T5uGt7p3LfMpW/1786705961284.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPidXjZ22UB3umPaBN2DPdMfvoWBdMNTsuA7ZHNJWCe3i/1786705961560.jpg)
I picked up my sketchbook and applied pink masking tape around the edges to ensure a clean and neat border, and then I applied various colors.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPX94Wuni6LN3FPeYhm77vZsqVXnxjubfNnNqbYosj85N/1786705961964.jpg)
I tried to create a background setting using two colors red and dark brown.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaprM6NX3rciUY1GgxpfYuYCy22z2fL357WxhjqCxobUo/1786705962255.jpg)
So, my background color was all set and looked quite good. In the next step, I decided to create a painting of a woman with a white face.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY5i1dqp3AWq5AKXUT7NztBkQg6f7kVkHB4TT394KMNkD/1786705962331.jpg)
My intention behind creating an image of a woman was motivated by the fact and the narrative surrounding women. The word of Iranian women was heavily exploited  and used during this conflict. The US  authorities framed the narrative as a \

. The USA authorities claimed a desire to liberate Iranian women from the oppression they supposedly faced.

 Infact, the reality is quite different. 

Every region operates according to its own specific context, and a third party sitting in a distant land can not possibly understand the actual ground realities.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZuTCi2vGcaCL39hymKBuq5SGni2WLBQmf2HP75F6RqE3/1786706366547.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWaTGo4ni3suTJE9RczXSfsZwqNSEq3BpjoWK62kcTsfT/1786706367064.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAzRQ4w4cazpunuYF4hCux7QGPw8XdbpAQKLMWgMXtJq/1786706367286.jpg)
Just trust the process and be with me. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWWhN2QQhAyD3fUGXvNpbP86Hf88PwT4qKE67Dk6NsSGP/1786706367511.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwykGw2zLkxps7isjhucwv1xnjVK1jEKzxs6L6HRRUC6/1786706367729.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcFUnhE4pdgmmX8i7uKg9nq4k5Cd9c1JJJH5dUU93dfCd/1786707222103.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYbM81sCR3hiYYEcr81iPYeTtYftE62rH2piXQ23xDCUZ/1786707222209.jpg)


It's a tribute to all those brave Iranian women who stood tall and steadfast against the terrors of war imposed by imperial powers. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYVmZ11W9NWtc8tQDPotFrSnKpoxWyuyNWoXUpbXCZ4LN/1786707222569.jpg)




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJkspNnuN1ykcN1vo62J9N1tJdXho1Sv4usHBA4fpSfS/1786707274476.jpg)

Here we go! 
We have this ready.

title.title: Melihat Fitur Advertiser di Berbagai Platform Distribusi Konten
title.body:
Jika Anda akan beriklan atau mendistribusikan konten lewat sebuah platform, ada baiknya memahami fitur apa saja yang ditawarkan untuk pengiklan. Berikut tinjauan umum dari beberapa platform yang populer.

Rajabacklink, sebagai marketplace, menawarkan fitur yang relatif sederhana: pilih blog, kirim brief, dan tunggu artikel terbit. Fokusnya pada transaksi backlink yang cepat dan langsung.

Seedbacklink menawarkan cakupan yang lebih luas. Selain backlink, ada layanan liputan media, press release, hingga kolaborasi KOL. Bagi advertiser, ini berarti lebih banyak opsi dalam satu platform, meski kompleksitasnya juga bertambah.

Tauthub, di sisi lain, menekankan pada alur kerja yang terpadu. Advertiser bisa membuat kampanye, menyusun konten dengan bantuan AI, memilih media, lalu memantau status publikasi hingga selesai. Fitur pelaporan juga menjadi bagian dari paket, sehingga hasil kampanye bisa diukur.

Dari perbandingan ini terlihat bahwa setiap platform punya pendekatan berbeda. Ada yang mengutamakan volume dan variasi, ada yang mengutamakan kecepatan transaksi, dan ada yang mengutamakan keteraturan alur kerja.

Bagi advertiser, langkah bijak adalah mencocokkan kebutuhan dengan fitur yang tersedia. Jika Anda butuh banyak opsi media, pertimbangkan platform dengan inventori besar. Jika Anda butuh dokumentasi dan pelaporan yang rapi, platform dengan alur terpadu seperti Tauthub layak dipertimbangkan.

Yang terpenting, jangan terpaku pada satu platform sebelum memahami fiturnya secara menyeluruh.

When we talk about True success in life it begins when we start with God and specialize. Some people may probably wonder, “Why must I begin with God?” The purposes for this are not mere suggestions; they are foundational truths for every single person who seeks a meaningful, successful life.

God is our source and His desire is that we continue in Him and find ultimate fulfillment in His Son Jesus Christ. It’s been proven times over that “A life without Christ is a life full of crises.” Jesus made us to understand that, “I am the vine; you are the branches… apart from Me, you can do nothing” (John 15: 5).

When we start with God, His plans and purposes for our lives becomes visible and clearer. You’ll be able to make reasonable choices and precise judgements. There’s nothing wrong with desiring success unless you pursue them at the expense of neglecting the will of God.

title.title: দু'দিনের পৃথিবীতে / In this Two-Day World
title.body:
দু'দিনের পৃথিবীতে / In this Two-Day World

Bangla Version:

দু'দিনের পৃথিবীতে, ধনমান লভিতে কতই না খুঁজি চোরাগলি! ন্যায়-অন্যায় বোধ, সেই কবে হলো রুদ্ধ বিবেকের কাছে হই বলি।

স্বার্থের দ্বন্দ্ব যেথা, কৌশলী মোরা সেথা চাতুর্যে কথা বেশ বলি।অন্যের দাবি কেড়ে, নিজের পাল্লাভরে স্বস্তির নিঃশ্বাস ফেলি।

বিত্তবিভব নেশা, দিন দিন বাড়ায় আশা বেছে নিই কত কৌশল।করি কত কারসাজি, তোষামুদেও আছি রাজি যদি হয় লক্ষ্য সফল।

নিজের তরেই বাঁচি, সম্পদ রাশি রাশি চাহিদার শেষ নেই আমার।যত পাই তবুও, ভাবি না তো কভুও চারপাশে কী হলো কাহার।

চলিফিরি কত সাজে, মিল নেই কথা কাজে অন্যকে কভু দিই ধোঁকা।মুখে প্রীতি কথা, অন্তরে কপটতা বিশ্বাসে ওরা হয় বোকা।

পথচলা আছে বাকি, কৌশলে পাশে রাখি পাড়ি দিই দুর্গম গিরি।লক্ষ্যটা কাছে পেলে, প্রতিদান যাই ভুলেভাসাই স্বার্থের তরি।

মুখোশের আড়ালে ঢাকা, কথা বলি মধুমাখা কখনো-বা ধর্মের লেবাসধারী।আলহাজ্ব নাম ধরে, ডাকিস আমায় ওরে সমাজোতে নাই মোর জুড়ি।

অবৈধ আয় হতে, দান করি নিজ হাতে জনতার মাঝে হই দাতা।ইচ্ছেটা জাগে মনে, ভেবে যাই ক্ষণে ক্ষণেহতে চাই আগামীর নেতা।

দ্বিধাবোধ নেই তবে, বলছি না দোষী সবে মানবতা হয়নি তো শেষ।নীতিবান আছে বলে, জগতটা আজও চলে যদিও পাশেই থাকে ক্লেশ।

সম্প্রীতি ছায়াতলে, এসো ভেদাভেদ ভুলে ন্যায়ের পথে ফিরে যাই।দু'দিনের এ পৃথিবী, যেতে হবে ফেলে সবি তবুও কেন এত চাই?

English Version:

In this Two-Day World

![nasib-nepal-mountain-2388106_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQyVxZpMipfWNYGJenoKzT8LuujaLeMBed1LwtQtRJvnP/nasib-nepal-mountain-2388106_1920.jpg)

[Image](https://pixabay.com/photos/nepal-mountain-mountain-2388106/)

In this two-day world, to gain wealth and fame, How often do we seek the back alleys! The sense of right and wrong was blocked long ago, We sacrifice ourselves at the altar of conscience.

Where there is a conflict of self-interest, we are clever there, We speak with great cunning.Snatching others' rights, filling our own scales, We heave a sigh of relief.

The addiction to wealth increases hope day by day, We choose so many tactics.We play so many tricks, we are even ready to flatter, If only the goal is successful.

We live only for ourselves, with heaps of wealth, There is no end to my demands.The more I get, still I never think What happened to whom around me.

We move around in many disguises, there is no match between words and deeds, We often deceive others.Words of love on the lips, hypocrisy in the heart, Out of trust, they become fools.

The journey is yet to be completed, we keep tactics by our side, We cross the treacherous mountains.Once the goal is close, we forget the return, And set sail the boat of self-interest.

Hidden behind a mask, I speak sweet words, Sometimes wearing the garb of religion.Calling me by the name of Alhaj, O people, There is no match for me in society.

From illegal income, I donate with my own hands, I become a donor among the public.The desire arises in the mind, I think moment by moment, I want to be the leader of tomorrow.

There is no hesitation though, I am not saying everyone is guilty, Humanity has not come to an end.Because the righteous exist, the world still goes on, Even though suffering remains right beside.

Under the shadow of harmony, come forgetting all differences, Let us return to the path of justice.This two-day world, everything must be left behind, Yet why do we desire so much?

<center><sub>The original bengali poem was written by me, but the English translation was done with the help of AI</sub></center>

![1000462511-066f95ea336d.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/lazzvi/lkt-mtexfzgv-8mozhe67/1000462511-066f95ea336d.webp)

![1000462512-267bea5ce58c.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/lazzvi/lkt-mtexfzgv-8mozhe67/1000462512-267bea5ce58c.webp)

![1000462513-2a0484b8934c.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/lazzvi/lkt-mtexfzgv-8mozhe67/1000462513-2a0484b8934c.webp)

![1000462514-0ccc9a8e6ca0.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/lazzvi/lkt-mtexfzgv-8mozhe67/1000462514-0ccc9a8e6ca0.webp)

Hola a todos los liketuers del mundo! Hoy es domingo, día de esparcimiento. Les traigo algunas gotas de lluvia sobre la superficie verde de algunas plantas de mi huerto y decorativas. Teníamos por acá unos meses bien calurosos y secos, algo no normal en estas zonas tropicales y en estos meses de verano. Pues, bien ayer sábado en la tarde rompió a llover, se sentía la pereza del aire y las plantas elevaban sus hojas como buscando el cielo. En un impasse de la lluvia, salí a mi patio e hice estas fotos de las gotas de lluvia estampadas sobre las hojas. Acá se las dejo, que tengan una excelente semana que empieza. 
English:
Hello to all the liketuers around the world! Today is Sunday, a day of leisure. I bring you a few raindrops on the green surface of some of my garden and decorative plants. We've been having some pretty hot and dry months around here, which isn't normal for these tropical areas during these summer months. Well, yesterday, Saturday afternoon, it finally started to rain — you could feel the sluggishness in the air, and the plants were lifting their leaves as if reaching for the sky. During a lull in the rain, I went out to my yard and took these photos of the raindrops stamped onto the leaves. Here I leave them for you — have an excellent week ahead.

title.title: Batman vs League of Assassins at the Hospital.
title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=yakubnoyon/jwbr6exc

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRPJo7n5jhe44xkdojaJzLNcPjUuQhhXyJXEuyr8qfVr/gaming_photography_2_.gif)

Batman thought maybe he finally found the injured assassin but he was still out of Batman's reach. After finishing the fight with the thugs on the roof Batman saw that the blood trail was going even further. That means the assassin was not here.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNjcdKgfqgvT7aJqknABSjF9RD6TM5GWBrz9k3sNk46bo/snapshot_17.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNhHmUThPgSiTKJN8G7JeK7nRs8JVY7TA9nQHT9Kf755o/snapshot_18.png)

Batman followed the blood trail and kept moving forward. After some time he reached the roof of Elliot Memorial Hospital. The path where the assassin went inside was blocked by an electric generator. Electricity was running through the entrance. Batman had to turn off the generator first if he wanted to go inside.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1kfuUrpLVHwVSDn8o1UnN9BkL5VzyB57TQwh2h9vHTj/snapshot_19.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEnkPqkpiznZ1UajTiLb5WW6xX4imxT7Qk7FcBZSARQm/snapshot_20.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQS31q2oSrfeSn89rFq4iPmBTecJpnBGwquXLS7hGxJKq/snapshot_21.png)

Alfred told Batman that there was a remote electric charger in the GCPD evidence room. This device could be used to turn off the generator. Batman went to GCPD and collected the device from the evidence room. The device can both turn electric power on and off.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmav8HdX8Me4Et1hkefui3WaYG7MTtN3oAmWf2cGdLUFa3/snapshot_22.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXEZE2XJRRc4ctuRXtRDiD4GcY1133JPKk7H2M9a7Rj7W/snapshot_23.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsMXBSGAe35Nh6KGrwUUYq65svpXxBU8gCs9t1mzQTu9/snapshot_24.png)

Batman took the device and left GCPD. He flew through the dark sky of Gotham City and came back to Elliot Memorial Hospital. The generator was still running. Batman used the electric charger and fired an electric shockwave at the generator. The generator started losing power. After three shockwaves the generator finally shut down completely.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdnFL15e8a4mHVKh9VxwZ1jokN4zMkTbDZJVijNsCekLL/snapshot_25.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS6iiUW8PhqP1BSG756irSeL6zJG3VN9EZgw61piL4D5Q/snapshot_26.png)

Batman went inside and saw some soldiers having a meeting with their leader. Batman suddenly attacked them. The League of Assassins soldiers were well trained. Fighting them was much harder than fighting normal criminals.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQzWsf7qqkXjnSNkunMaM6SmRvevR4HyYyQRhxY6HU8gr/snapshot_27.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaRZ5i6ALConKti1MqBzJPawagQgMWvUBKdSLtZuZ6Urq/snapshot_28.png)

First Batman knocked out their leader. Then he started taking down the other soldiers one by one. But suddenly the leader attacked Batman from behind with a sword. Batman used a combo punch and knocked the leader out again.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc2DUmQm6u3BANfEfjeQqRdqseozMt9mw1gbrMSWoMQwc/snapshot_29.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTv57fqqtFyhPnwiKSADB9Xv2pvXL6UaBuSdkeJvHm9oH/snapshot_30.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3eVZkooJHgoXCS8LEVUPQqxyLDYekp2qNZX7SfskLnA/snapshot_31.png)

The door where the blood trail was going was locked. The whole hospital had no power. Batman found the main power switch and turned it on. But even then the power did not come back.

Now what will happen? How will Batman go deeper inside the hospital?

We will find out in the next episode.

title.title: [Movie] Student of the Year: The Ultimate Fantasy Movie
title.body:
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUC1dYMYsP5fnwuDDNvfaSgqyUt3jRuR2tzdmKLpoEDxr/1000094156.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image used under section 107 of Copyright Act 1976</sub></center>

If you grew up watching Bollywood, you have probably seen Student of the Year at least once. It is a movie where you will see everything except actual studying. I give it a 60/100, mostly because it feels less like a real movie and more like a big-budget project made to launch three star kids into the industry. To do that, the movie relies on shirtless scenes, bikini moments, and camera shots that focus way too much on showing off their looks.

The college life in this movie is totally fake. They show students drinking alcohol all the time, touching each other inappropriately, posing, and acting like being a playboy is something cool. Bragging about sleeping with a hundred people while still in college is shown as a flex instead of a bad thing. Almost 90% of regular people cannot relate to this lifestyle, where huge canteens, partying in clubs, and having zero rules are shown as normal student life.

To connect the dance numbers, the movie uses basic stories: the rich guy with daddy issues and the middle-class guy with money problems. But honestly, the money problems shown here are so small that they do not feel like real struggles at all. The competition to win the \

trophy does not test smart people or hard work. Instead, it is about swimming races, treasure hunts, and fashion walks. In real life, students in top colleges actually study hard. Here, studying is shown in just one short song before the movie goes back to Thailand trips and drama.

Behind the fast cars and cool bikes, which looked awesome to kids back then, the relationships are a total mess. Shanaya is shown as a sweet, innocent girl, but her actions say something else. She uses Abhimanyu to make Rohan jealous, crosses boundaries while giving emotional support during a medical emergency, and then plays the victim when the guys call her out. She keeps saying she hates breaking relationships, but she creates all the drama between two best friends and then blames them for it.

Nothing shows how crazy this movie is better than the ending. Ten years later, right after a funeral, two former best friends get into a fight. Suddenly, the fight turns into an argument about who was better in bed. One brags about his body count, the other reveals a secret, and somehow this leads to them hugging and becoming friends again. It makes zero sense. But if you turn off your brain and watch it as a simple fantasy movie made for teenagers of that time, it is still a fun watch.

_Rating: **60/100**_

---

title.title: My Review of A Dream with You/Mi Opinión de Un sueño contigo [ENG/ESP]
title.body: > Hello, dear friends at @MoviesTvShows. Greetings and blessings. Today I’m here to talk to you about a story in which dreams often serve as inspiration for others. Even though we might think of them as a kind of theft, in the end, they’re something we share unintentionally—we just have to know how to handle it and understand that they can come true for both of us, especially when the goal is to make both parties happy. It’s about A Dream with You. --- ![MV5BZGU5ZTE1ZDEtMWI5Ny00ZDgxLTkyN2UtZjg0OWIzNmMwOWE0XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23yJJKeRvuX1Xc6hUhNr377zShGBR3u9JNQYNtz33AG7qAdRSEFaxq7mAE7EEMfnnW54k.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt39028251/mediaviewer/rm2576335618/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

>We begin by talking about Ju Yi-yae (Lee Hye-ri), a young woman with a dream of becoming a film director. She loves movies, creating stories, and giving them a fresh start. Whenever she can, she uses her camera to craft moving stories, even though she knows she needs to study the subject more. That’s why she seeks recognition through film competitions in her area to gain experience and eventually go to college to study filmmaking—or at least that’s what she thought she could do, until she meets Woo Su-bin (Hwang In-yeop), a young man who has just moved to the area. He starts attending the same school as Ju Yi, and somehow connects with her, especially because of his interest in film. --- ![MV5BMWEzZjY5MDYtZjJiYy00NjVhLWFkN2ItMjEzOWU2MGM0MWM1XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wgS5kibyqH39mAWCqa7pR6o3AXeajjTvEy13m7hi1JzrG2RDkd7gFbJeRAvPZJ9ozDn.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt39028251/mediaviewer/rm3011166722/) ---

>Woo Su-bin is a young man whose father wants him to study medicine, because his family has a long tradition of pursuing that career path, and to Woo, this seemed like the natural path—until he learned of Ju Yi’s dream, saw how she views the world through the lens of her camera, appreciated the moments she captures with it, and realized her desire to convey feelings and different emotions through her stories. It seems his path has been shaped by art rather than medicine, but for him, it’s not that simple, since his father is very strict and sends him away so he’ll forget about changing the future his father has planned for him, causing an accident that takes Ju Yi away from her dream of becoming a director. --- ![MV5BMDIzOWVlMzItODRiZi00NDRiLTg3ZjQtNjc1YWQzMTlmOTEwXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23w2jHNkZHiUTLNcKjZi222PXpUWRmqgf1FegPWCi9WUYMyd1d3du5hm5AFpDkNVdWLRE.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt39028251/mediaviewer/rm2860171778/) ---

>Although her path was interrupted by an incident during her studies, she decided to pursue a career in journalism so she could both entertain others and earn a living to help her mother and brother—until Woo Su-bin returned and changed the course of her life once again. this time leading her back to her path in film through him, since he had become a famous director. Against all odds, he managed to fulfill her dream—but was he stealing the dream she once had? For Ju Yi, it was something they would both achieve eventually if necessary; she feels she worked hard only to be left behind, unaware of the problems Woo Su-bin was facing and how he managed to overcome them. However, fate brings them back together to clear up the misunderstandings and fight to fulfill their dreams together with a new story to create. --- ![MV5BMGM0NDZjZmQtYTAyZS00Y2Q3LThjM2YtMWMxZDYyNTU4ZWU2XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23u63F4azJNDKGtCwiu2Vzcr5ukfbewPUnANH9Lb8JrjWY7rQVWSBKA2L1U4au4DYxXAi.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt39028251/mediaviewer/rm4266116098/) ---

title.title: [Movie] Little Bone Lodge
title.body:
The Perfect Lie ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCMokZE66aJLM8Fmrh39zKY6ViTj4NKfxRUpRnVcGdu8/3.jpg)
[Source ](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/1075335-little-bone-lodge/images/backdrops)
Edited in Photoshop & Canva App
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/245cUBXzvWF8QVukk8UvqTFX6FutvCzv1TyGDA8ybnR5QKA1v6nMvGS4j6y81Qg9M2HLn.jpg
There are stories entertaining enough to enjoy. It doesn't matter that the story isn't entirely original and that we've seen many similar things before.The key lies in how the filmmaker translates the story into images and the pacing they create, making it interesting and keeping you hooked. I saw this film a while ago, without high expectations or much of an idea of ​​what it was about, and although it won't go down in cinematic history, it has enough going for it to warrant a recommendation. It's a story with intrigue and suspense, and as it unfolds, surprising revelations and twists emerge. I love unexpected twists, and perhaps that's why I liked the film. Although from the beginning there's something in the air that feels off. We sense, and soon realize, that many are lying. There's something strange about the house the two brothers arrive at, even though it's just a mother with her young daughter and her husband, who is completely paralyzed by an illness. The entire opening section, where the two criminal brothers arrive at a house where these women seem quite vulnerable, sees the brothers becoming increasingly menacing. But here, no one is free of secrets, and little by little, we, along with one of the criminals, realize that not everything is as it seems. The film initially appears to be a home invasion story, even incorporating touches of action and scenes that fit the horror genre. It's a combination that could have gone very wrong, but it ultimately works well, giving us an entertaining product. The film's director is Matthias Hoene, an American who had already ventured into the horror genre, but with less than brilliant results. This was his fifth production, and so far, I think it's his best film. Now, we should keep an eye out for his next project, scheduled for release next year. It's a horror film starring Indi Navarrete, who, after the success of Obsession, has high expectations. Most of the action takes place inside the country house, which becomes even more sinister during the storm. This helps keep us on the edge of our seats with every event that unfolds within its walls. The atmosphere is excellent and enhances the story's development. The cast is also solid and believable in their roles, a crucial element. The film plays with our perceptions, ultimately revealing that some people aren't as bad as they seem, and others aren't as good as they appear. There are secrets that should never be revealed. I hope you'll share your opinion if you see it. ---- > Hay historias lo suficientemente entretenidas como para disfrutarlas. No importa que lo que se cuenta no sea del todo original y que ya hayamos visto muchas cosas parecidas.La clave está en cómo el cineasta plasma la historia en imágenes y el ritmo que le imprime, para que resulte interesante y te mantenga enganchado. > Vi esta película hace tiempo, sin grandes expectativas ni mucha idea de qué trataba, y aunque no pasará a la historia del cine, tiene suficientes puntos a su favor como para recomendarla. Es una historia con intriga y suspense, y a medida que se desarrolla, surgen revelaciones y giros sorprendentes. > Me encantan los giros inesperados, y quizás por eso me gustó la película. Aunque desde el principio hay algo en el ambiente que da mala espina. Intuimos, y pronto nos damos cuenta, de que muchos mienten. Hay algo extraño en la casa a la que llegan los dos hermanos, aunque solo se trata de una madre con su hija pequeña y su marido, que está completamente paralizado por una enfermedad. Toda la parte inicial, donde los dos hermanos delincuentes llegan a una casa donde estas mujeres parecen bastante vulnerables, los hermanos se vuelven cada vez más amenazantes. Pero aquí, nadie está libre de secretos, y poco a poco, nosotros y uno de los criminales nos daremos cuenta de que no todo es lo que parece. > La película inicialmente parece una historia de allanamiento de morada, incluso con toques de acción y escenas que encajan en el género de terror. Una combinación que podría haber salido muy mal, pero que en general termina funcionando bien, dándonos un producto entretenido. > El director de la película es Matthias Hoene, un estadounidense que ya se había aventurado en el género de terror, pero con resultados poco brillantes. Esta fue su quinta producción, y hasta ahora, creo que es su mejor película. Ahora, deberíamos estar atentos a su próximo proyecto, programado para estrenarse el próximo año. Es una película de terror protagonizada por Indi Navarrete, quien, tras el éxito de Obsesión, tiene grandes expectativas. > La mayor parte de la acción transcurre dentro de la casa de campo, que se vuelve aún más siniestra durante la tormenta. Esto contribuye a mantenernos en vilo con cada suceso que se desarrolla entre sus muros. La atmósfera es excelente y favorece el desarrollo de la historia. > El reparto también es sólido y resulta creíble para sus personajes, un elemento crucial. La película juega con nuestras percepciones, revelando finalmente que algunas personas no son tan malas como parecen, y otras no tan buenas como aparentan. Hay secretos que jamás deberían ser revelados. > Espero que compartas tu opinión si la ves.

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. Stir-fried minced pork with holy basil (Pad Kra Prao Moo Sap) or any variation of stir-fried basil (Pad Kra Prao), is a simple and highly popular Thai dish. Whenever people can't think of what to eat, this dish is always the perfect answer. It's the same for my family and my wife. Often, when we don't know what to eat or my wife doesn't know what to cook for the family, she will cook this dish. And my wife cooks it often when we aren't going anywhere. All of the popular vegetable ingredients for this dish are grown in my home garden and my longan orchard (longan orchard is located 600 meters away). The main vegetables for stir-fried holy basil are holy basil, yardlong beans and chili peppers. Sometimes, carrots or other vegetables may be added. This time, my wife cook stir-fried minced chicken with holy basil and also added carrots, white onions, and Thai eggplants to this dish. Of course, my wife still picks the main vegetable ingredients from our home garden : holy basil, yardlong beans, and chili peppers—along with another vegetable she picks from our home garden : Thai eggplants.

The atmosphere during the picking of vegetables from the home garden this time.

holy basil
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd3edxL8No4Wq996z1SHja8fFCoBgaBPQwtt8FgZEqVFE/1788076996453.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVWY4dmEgsFp197gtrNS8ng4fTioDzrUBnLZhLjQM5xcB/1788076996558.jpg)

yardlong beans
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcHJJhMzWJZnFzZfnJJWq3htSaBx5bqmihpywUFWMHSfD/1788077247734.jpg)

chili peppers
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXb4qt7Jj4FX7DmgWezXsT6Sq6YPKWVH25b3zVQkdeyGb/1788077247815.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma58C1RbiHG7wGDnzMjNN3CaVvowMJyqpH3fVKZmmYmuc/1788077247937.jpg)

Thai eggplants
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb9eMvsE6S4UEdmV2FQkXXeMoP3Gs5TCLuBzux8yq2hE2/1788076996663.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUyqYB2B7BZTmMzd2SS5ntZ4ZNWSuyLTRhiLzWbh27CL8/1788076996762.jpg)

Ingredients for stir-fried minced chicken with holy basil.

chicken
holy basil
yardlong beans
chili peppers
Thai eggplants
carrots
onions
garlic
oil
pork flavour seasoning powder
sugar 
oyster sauce
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeeB4kQ3x5RUWGeDdBydZ6ggr6MRVKf3vYi23ByvhCA66/1788077665617.jpg)

Chop all the vegetables and chicken, then crush the chili peppers and garlic using a pestle and mortar.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBa9iP6dxnGRFwDLiB6EKrB53cgGKgLzDogG39fmSbXY/1788077665712.jpg)

Put a pan on the stove, add oil and heat the oil. Then, add the pounded chili peppers and garlic to the pan and stir-fry until fragrant.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVoBGfLfJPwihE1md9K2bYPbTuVmapV4QBjgWbd3wJRNv/1788077665792.jpg)

Add all the vegetables to the pan (except the holy basil) and stir-fry for a while.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQpJMqpEU3JmwQphyuwKW887DoFV1SLAzVAmX476kuPJh/1788077665892.jpg)

Then add the minced chicken to the pan and stir-fry until cooked.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdUfgxNegsugRVqnk3sQvQDNbgxH1GGkXH5uwQcU1mhmx/1788079312567.jpg)

Add a little water to the pan, then season with oyster sauce, sugar, and pork flavour seasoning powder, stir briefly. Then, add the holy basil to the pan, stir-fry until cooked and turn off the heat.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWRcXTATofHaUrNFHBUi6FRbT7q5PgrVFdyY2MMj5jqC/1788079312642.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUZMJGLLEr88rhFLN4cwfQFsDJoXfuqK5q3fyxL5VjjkP/1788079312746.jpg)

It's finished, stir-fried minced chicken with holy basil. Enjoy 😋
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbGqBxEoFd5MPc9K9P3Hk5b4QTEztfv7tLrTR6RWT3bSm/1788079312817.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmToJa9StkMRkJFrzsy21wXH4MVpU9mbuChmicdVcj69fS/1788079312914.jpg)

These are the stories and photos I want to share for this post. Invite everyone to see and enjoy my stories and photos. Please forgive any errors/mistakes. Have a great day. See you next time. Thank you for your support and visiting my post. Bye 🤗

title.body:
The Strait of Hormuz, the most important waterway in the Middle East, is once again in the spotlight. Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bakher Ghalib said that if Iran cannot sell oil, no one else in the region will be able to sell oil either.


[Scr](https://share.google/879gUwFwyxcxsgnOA   ) 


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWLsokXxwLLZvz8AbwR1aLiMAd7EtA3VEWPiSVV4kpLBS/1000077160.png 


His comments have renewed discussions on energy security and the global market. Iran has once again taken a tough stance on the Strait of Hormuz. The country's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bakher Ghalib said that if a situation arises where Iran cannot sell oil, then no country in the region will be able to sell oil.

He also brought up an old post in which a similar warning was given in July this year. The equation of war is very clear: everyone can or no one can. If Iran is deprived of oil exports, the energy trade of the entire region will be under pressure. Behind this statement is a claim from the United States. Admiral Brad Cooper, head of the US Central Command, claimed that US forces are in full control of the Strait of Hormuz.

They have stopped Iran's oil export activities. In response, Ghalib said that the security of Hormuz will be ensured only when there is no US military presence in the region. According to him, the external military presence is a major cause of instability. The Iranian top leader also said that no infrastructure will be safe if the country's security is not ensured. After the recent conflict, the situation in the Strait of Hormuz will never return to its previous state.


[Scr](https://share.google/CkuYvLN7r3Pm0KIJv   ) 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUPvthdar9LeQSzzy1qUVCyWpPRvvLcnfE6WCHud9kQxx/1000077161.jpg 



The Strait of Hormuz is very important in the world's energy market. A large part of the world's oil is transported through this route every day. As a result, everyone believes that if tensions increase in the waterway, there may be concerns about oil prices and supply in the international market. This message from Tehran is a clear signal not only for Washington, but also for the energy-dependent economies of the Middle East. The world market is now watching where the situation goes.

title.title: Nikola Tesla Was A Fraud Said the People Who Couldn't Even Do It While Cheating
title.body: ![WrongScience.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcjqhRCBPJvSBFHUdYAm6a45nhwiABgSLnqfBN79EdGjP/WrongScience.png) One of the most controversial men in recent history. The inventor of the AC motor (usually, incorrectly called the inventor of AC) and champion who got the electrical grid started. Nikola Tesla, if that was all he did, he would have gone down in history as greater than Albert Einstein. But, no, Tesla had hundreds of patented inventions. And, he liked to talk about fantastic things that could be created, to rooms where the high class people mingled. He was quite popular at such parties. When someone talks about fantastic inventions, you usually have to take such with a grain of salt. Many people who barely have one invention (or not) often talk about fanciful things speaking of them as already formed and ready for manufacturing investment. And so, you would not be amiss saying that Tesla was one of these men full of hot air and his head in the clouds, except that Tesla made a LOT of inventions. Many photographed and written about by newspaper men.

> ## Who do you believe? So, you have this scientist here, lets call him Chuck. And, try as he might, he cannot replicated Tesla's inventions, like the Tesla Tower in New York. And, since he can't do it, Chuck assumes that it can't be done. And so, Tesla was a fraud! However, Tesla created lightning arcs over 100 feet long, on command, for the newspaper reporters. Ask Chuck about that, and he will tell you that Tesla fooled the reporters. But, if you asked Chuck to make a 100 foot long lightning arc, he would say that he doesn't have the resources to do that. However, the longest lightning arc in the Guinness Book of World Records is 115 feet, as a substation melted down in the Arizona heat. Tesla did this, repeatedly, in front of spectators. If it was a fraud, then the fraud is a miracle that modern scientists cannot repeat. And so goes most of Tesla's inventions. The are frauds that modern scientists can't replicate.

></center>
## the Tesla Coil

Most of Tesla's inventions are both very simple, and really difficult to get set up correctly.

The Tesla Coil is an example of this.  It, is just a couple coils of wire, a large capacitor and a spark gap.  The theory is really easy.  But getting it tuned correctly is very… complex? tricky? frustrating?  The sizes of the coils imply a frequency, which needs to be matched with the spark gap and capacitor.  Each of which can be varied.

It is an art to get your Tesla Coil set up and humming along.  (some people never get their Tesla Coil working well.)

And, the Tesla Coil does a lot of things that aren't \

. Lots of reports of cranking up a Tesla Coil, and power tools start spinning (just sitting there on the workbench). They have been known to put holes in roofs, while the output harmless to touch. And, of course, they light up fluorescent bulbs. (but, ask a scientists if this is because the field the coil creates excites the fluorescence or excites an electric arc through the mercury vapor in the tube)

></center>
## Other Tesla Stuff

Tesla's Tower was supposed to power the world.  Energy through the air.  Powered by Niagara Falls.

And, scientists use Tesla's name when they transmit energy across the room.

Tesla's Tower's design was very simple, just like the Tesla Coil, with one extra layer.  So, you might say, that its complexity multiplied.  People have trouble tuning one layer of Tesla Coil, imagine trying to tune two layers.  While your scientific understanding handicaps you by saying there is no Aether.  It is really simple, however, no one has repeated it, or so they say.

Tesla created a solar powered generator.  He used large magnifying lenses to focus the rays of the sun into a large boiler, creating steam, and thus power to drive a generator.  This was over 100 years ago.

Tesla supposedly created an electric car that ran off the electricity in the air.  Electricity that is already there… that he was building his tower to excite.

But, the biggest invention, in my opinion, was what he called \

. Or basically a box that created bags of nitrogen fertilizer utilizing an electric arc. We do it today by burning gas in a giant standing tube. If we had this invention from Tesla, we would not be in such dire straits with growing crops today. All of these inventions were demonstrated to newspaper people. Including the tower, which was only a long pole held up by Tesla's workshop in Colorado. Lots of people saw lights lit up miles away. But, of course, that had to be done fraudulently.

> Everyone believes that Trump's uncle who took all the papers from the Hotel room just after Tesla's death, is holding the keys to Tesla's inventions. However, the papers are probably useless. Until you understand the Aether and the electro-magnetic fields therein, you cannot explain anything that Tesla did. And Modern Materialistic Scientists declare that the Aether doesn't exist. When we finally throw Modern Materialistic Science on the scrap heap, then we will probably find that Tesla's inventions are very easy to replicate. And probably will become elementary school science projects. BTW: Tesla said his most important discovery is rotating magnetic fields. Also: Scientists cannot explain how magnets work without using unicorn particles.

>\n

title.title: A Generous Dinner at Sheng Ji Soya Sauce Chicken in Geylang Bahru
title.body:
Yesterday was another good day for a cycling and food adventure! Since Geylang Bahru is only a few minutes away from me by bicycle, I decided to head there and reward myself with a nice and satisfying dinner after cycling around.

Of course, whenever I'm in this area, I wouldn't miss the chance to eat at Geylang Bahru Hawker Centre. There are quite a number of stalls here that have become my favorites over the years, so deciding where to eat can sometimes be a challenge, LOL.

But one stall that's definitely near the top of my list is **Sheng Ji Soya Sauce Chicken Rice / Noodles**.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.57 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoK7GTxyge5huz67k8c5wPhiQuAkBQNiGwrKQ7XVbrNDuuiZhdqBPWK9tHvEKtiBhGp.jpeg)


One thing that caught my attention about this stall is that they have been endorsed by Food King. Over here, Michelin recognition is often considered a good indication of whether a place serves good food, but there are also local food personalities who have earned the trust of many people. So whenever I see one of those familiar recommendation stickers at a hawker stall, my expectations immediately go higher hahaha!

For my dinner, I ordered their **Soya Sauce Chicken Noodles**.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.57 (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep3fjQzwgZ8pRPkDZz4Ww5VxjmvpykCC3HNPuhQ3DFx7fhB1fNmGCQXFsuMwJcs8ZRT.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.58 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23wgMqr1Wpd5X1RgvCJdCfVEfsongCGFCNQyCBrVFC9Ss9QmQK9WH6UmNM2xyBpJ6wC4C.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.58 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc8R3xRJXSbMT3kkEkerbMvetxqJx4DBSkm67iujp9QKpVFu1zrR11yLW1LuhFP54b.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.58.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/2423wwYiQR9sw1cCbP8PXBEuNvdz9yYmDRTcShsr33zeeU9q99nXioKRJgdBeD9mENz81.jpeg)


Unfortunately, I completely forgot to tell the auntie not to add chili paste. My stomach was feeling a little acidic yesterday, so spicy food wasn't exactly what I needed. My solution? Order an additional plate of rice! LOL.

My plan was simple: I would eat the parts of the noodles that weren't covered in chili and use the rice to compensate so I could still have a filling dinner.

But then the aunties surprised me.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.57.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eos2HSjBBhwkFmJJV5ncogGkTRXHSbNHnJABYxqdgzHwzHn4RoGNbUtvK5M6KJxNb6d.jpeg)


Instead of giving me plain rice, they generously added several slices of **Char Siew** on top! Suddenly my table looked like I had ordered enough food for two people even though I originally just wanted chicken noodles, hahaha.

And they weren't finished being generous either.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.56 (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EopsU98VQkV13rnvAT5eY486W8iZfctHEp7YNEBk4cPhqJYWhQmWXuD87zKbjww6eW6.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.56.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoGyNz7EoVMKV6CFr32AAyFXKz3pwS3zQQgT8ocC4wWdhZUycKtimKB1K9FomdPy7tj.jpeg)


The order also came with a small bowl of soup with a dumpling in it. I really appreciate little extras like this because they make a simple hawker meal feel much more satisfying. Perhaps this generosity is also one reason why this stall seems to have a queue so often. Give people tasty food and a little extra, and they'll definitely remember you!


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.56 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EonmTymA5tuQZhabKa6gpQVdwMZXaZkbtMdCR1kHcVTKbaJ3VbEszgPRbUXoDEMEruY.jpeg)


The noodles themselves were perfectly cooked, with that nice springy texture that I enjoy. They were coated in a flavorful sauce that made every bite savory and satisfying. The soya sauce chicken was another highlight. The slices were moist and tender, and I especially liked how the sauce soaked into the chicken and noodles without completely overpowering them.

Then there were the pickled green chilies.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.57 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoptxHZZqZjEPb1zYqGE4QZjGNMEUycyia9rYDAsrsfuov7axpQae2BnhSzxGTjrjRM.jpeg)


Yes, I know I was trying to avoid chili because of my stomach... but I still couldn't resist adding a few pieces, LOL. The sourness from the pickled chilies added another layer of flavor and made the whole dish even more interesting. Sometimes that little bit of acidity and crunch is exactly what a rich, savory noodle dish needs.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.55 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiW82T5fLsh9fNEAD8hq8q3pJF7tWeLR45Wu6T7i3n3hxqqTo8JNHS68kSMAefxXRt.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.56 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eou9gdsJ3QNn2PbF8srygT8GE5CoxEoYKBQtLExEyMgDzFE7GpBvd5kqxM3VbbpN1sN.jpeg)


Overall, this turned into a much bigger dinner than I expected, but I'm definitely not complaining. Good noodles, tender chicken, unexpected Char Siew, soup, and some pickled chilies on the side—what more could I ask for after cycling?

Another satisfying hawker food adventure completed!

**Bon appetit!**



![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 19.01.55.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoK6kKgHCPfxbDZgcvwmBdvX6tQiPQSx2rw1APvfPEfQny5aJb6y3u2zgA2YZe3JQCK.jpeg)
