title.title: Retirement was never on my agenda.
title.body:
Seven years ago I reached the formal retirement age, but life had other plans for me.
![142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EopsxRjLfeJ3HVwX8yDhi5HLUGpQ2nfcmJSHPpVVbKGKuxuq2ftEza2Danp6FUtNDvk.jpg)

So, now I will show you a road trip to another town as I was requested to do a eulogy at a memorial service. You will see the young yellow Canola fields and also some animals on the way. We live in a very spacious country, with very big farms and all kinds of products are produced. The town where we were destined was about a 2 hour drive away and it was still early morning. The skies were overcast, but not a drop of rain fell and it was not cold. Ideal weather for a trip. 
Come and drive with us. 

The road was in a great condition, and a real pleasure to drive along. 
![160.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242Y7hEDKEGtZUXrLFRkQbTwELYMMkxjTc74mjvKWG5aKaVJQEQuKYnU63A9ZUsAMEuP2.JPG)

I took three shots of the cattle line up on a farm. 
![143.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243qCn39BxAV6dRqMk7czLvG3erYidzHLhEJcFfk3HDLcwanfuCwRBDAb9CXQmE9uLvdd.JPG)

![144.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqYu4rywoRroucz58w9oqRmFTL14ANWthyYLTVC8NyUpVAd6sQLfNm8pBYqaHaqyHdT.JPG)

They must have lined up to feed, and maybe feed bales were rolled out for them.
![145.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242hUZydTN8yEooyoUmfgYiXQ8cjTtfiGk4F8xxQPV1jkp1eNycxhkBYfnXSuN4uKCTEp.JPG)

Back to the road, and on the horizon, you can see a faint line of pesticide sprayers.
![140.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqL7rdEh6GmFYc4byrWbJSaUKZpi3HA7oLCsd3Yeu1AQy4aJb7QXUoePL9Ek9fVFojD.JPG)

Like I said, the canola fields were all over. 
![164.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpxrDL1vRc8itgHWkefwPWKW8cNBBtCUPFbaVw5nMazYaeTF8Dky67hK2io13XsSLB2.JPG)

![167.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqhQoA1Da1rWnNCqh1Tywxh7pAic9ockbny2hMuyjvRA8CqPdZfgZHqgwiksHv85LGc.JPG)

The fields on this farm have been planted, and soon the growth will start to appear. In the meantime, some cattle were feeding in the long grass near the roadside. 
![172.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/244KJWqJpmAYWyCjpRFkdqV9MDDjmvqL652QkqoTGVCF9MBzD5jzoSLXDU4KQTFEsW4RN.JPG)

And finally, this was taken on our way back home.  
![180.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqhRDdK4VHYp5gNsZekHFtHmkAqwTKP3zRME4pZbQxVR34pxSHjAsJ3i1tfKqXRtrQL.JPG)

So, now let me tell you about my view on the aspect of retirement. I like to keep things simple, and as long as I have breath in me, I will continue to work. Yes, I know that my body will start to pack up, and I might end up on a bed, but then I can still work on my laptop on Hive and other such things. I think that people have the wrong idea about retirement, or should I say some people, as they regard retirement as the end of their working life, which to me is a fallacy as there are many out there that are still at work into their late 80's and 90's.

I don't know if I will reach those ages, but what I know is that I will never retire and I would rather die on the job, as they say. Another mistake that some youngsters make is that they think that old people are past their productive years, but I can tell them that the old people have bank-vaults full of experiences, and also wisdom. Many old people have even peaked at an old age to become millionaires with one or another business idea. 
Such is life.    

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time, cheers!

title.title: Real Satire kurz vor den Landtagswahlen in Sachen Anhalt
title.body:
![83417.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWXHA2wpfJgPCXUHcuXV61rkXJFcdtJ9qaM3UbZ8Zxaiy/83417.png)

***Die Grünen***

Im Wahlkampf-Endspurt in Sachsen-Anhalt wiederholen sich alle Vorwürfe gegen den Ehemann von Grünen-Spitzenkandidatin Suse Sziborra-Seidlitz. In den 90ern war er Teil des Neonazi-Milieus in Quedlinburg im Harz. Der Fall führt tief in die Baseballschlägerjahre.

**Die Vorwürfe stützen sich auf eine Ausgabe des „Antifaschistischen Infoblatts“ aus dem Jahr 1995.**

Die Grünen präsentieren sich im Landtagswahlkampf als entschlossene Gegner des Rechtsextremismus. Gerade Sziborra-Seidlitz ließ zuletzt – etwa im TV-Duell – keine Gelegenheit aus, die nach **ihrer Einschätzung** rechtsextreme Gesinnung des AfD-Kandidaten Siegmund zu thematisieren. 

**Nun müssen sie selbst erklären, warum die Neonazi-Vergangenheit eines heutigen Parteifunktionärs bislang keine Rolle spielte.**

Mein persönliches Fazit: Da bekommt der Spruch *\

* eine ganz neue Bedeutung? 🤷

---

***Die SPD***


![81327.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc1rhGHAsVnmJm1ZCMiJWybcziSb87sY8f7meWVGnE5ow/81327.jpg)

Der SPD-Wahlkampfslogan „**Wir sind der Deich“** im Landtagswahlkampf in Sachsen-Anhalt 2026 löste eine Kontroverse aus, weil die Wortzeile wortwörtlich in einem NS-Propagandalied von 1936 vorkommt.

Der Urheber: Text und Melodie stammen von Wilhelm Decker. Er war ein hochrangiger Generalarbeitsführer des Reichsarbeitsdienstes und Träger des Goldenen Parteiabzeichens der NSDAP.

Der Einsatz: Das Lied wurde unter anderem beim Reichsparteitag 1936 in Nürnberg gesungen und diente der ideologischen Einstimmung im Sinne der NS-Gemeinschaftsideologie.


![83661.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdPhpn6XaT71VXdViG9jdpvH6ZK9B5wgcxyh1Fz7fF7zJ/83661.jpg)

Ja, diese Aussage ist historisch im Wesentlichen korrekt, allerdings mit einer wichtigen Ergänzung zur damaligen Bedrohungslage: **Die historische Antifaschistische Aktion wurde 1932 von der KPD gegründet und richtete sich im Zuge der Sozialfaschismusthese massiv gegen die SPD,** primäres Ziel war jedoch die Abwehr des realen Terrors der Nationalsozialisten.

Mein persönliches Fazit: 
Da holt wohl die SPD die eigene Vergangenheit ein. Etwas Bildung hätte diese Kontroverse verhindern können? Und wollte eine SPD nicht nach dem zweiten Weltkrieg in der BRD einen Polizeistaat errichten? 🤔

---

**Die Linke**

https://vm.tiktok.com/ZGdxTc4C8/

*\

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Warum wird eigentlich die Partei die in der Vergangenheit Selbstschussanlage und Umerziehungscamps errichtete nicht weiterhin vom Verfassungsschutz beobachtet? 😳

---

**Die AFD**

Das Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz und mehrere Landesbehörden stufen Teile der AfD oder die Partei als gesichert rechtsextremistisch bzw. als Verdachtsfall ein, weil ausreichende Anhaltspunkte für Bestrebungen gegen die freiheitliche demokratische Grundordnung vorliegen.


„Wir sollten eine SA gründen und aufräumen!“ – Andreas Geithe, AfD

Wer versucht, die AfD zu richten, den richtet die AfD!“ – Hans-Thomas Tillschneider, AfD

„Das große Problem ist, dass man Hitler als das absolut Böse darstellt.“ – Björn Höcke, AfD

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Ich bin immer noch der Überzeugung das die AFD nur gegründet wurde um die Wahlbeteiligung in Deutschland zu erhöhen. Denn eine Wahlbeteiligung unter 66% führt wohl zu Problemen in einer *repräsentativen Demokratie*

Wahlbeteiligung seit der Wiedervereinigung:2009: 70,8 % (niedrigster Wert der Bundesrepublik)2005: 77,7 %2002: 79,1 %1998: 82,2 %1994: 79,0 %1990: 77,8 %

Seit der Gründung der AfD im Februar 2013 ist die Wahlbeteiligung bei Bundestagswahlen in Deutschland kontinuierlich gestiegen und hat zuletzt bei der Bundestagswahl 2025 mit 82,5 Prozent den höchsten Stand im wiedervereinigten Deutschland erreicht.Die Beteiligung entwickelte sich bei den Bundeswahlen seit 2013 wie folgt:2025: 82,5 % (höchster Wert seit 1990)2021: 76,4 %2017: 76,2 %2013: 71,5 % (erste Wahl nach der Parteigründung)

**Vielleicht solltest du Mal darüber nachdenken das Politiker nicht die Lösung sondern das Problem sind? 🤷**

Anzahl der Abgeordneten (Stand 2026)Deutscher Bundestag: 630 Abgeordnete (nach der Wahlrechtsreform von 736 auf 630 Sitze verkleinert)Alle 16 Landtage gesamt: 1.898 Abgeordnete (von Bayern mit 203 bis zu Bremen mit 87 Sitzen)Gesamtzahl: 2.528 ParlamentarierBei einer Reduzierung um 50 % würden 1.264 Mandate wegfallen (315 im Bundestag, 949 in den Landtagen).

**Die direkten Einsparungen (Diäten + Pauschalen) betragen ca. 186,5 Millionen Euro. Rechnet man die Budgets für Mitarbeiter, Fraktionszuschüsse und Büroausstattungen hinzu, ergibt sich eine geschätzte Gesamtersparnis von rund 370 Millionen Euro pro Jahr.**

title.body:
>Hola buenos días familia costurera,un placer y un gusto saludarte 👋🏻🥰en ésta oportunidad les comparto un poco del proceso creativo que fué haciendo una chemise de caballero en tela deportiva,el proceso aunque no me resultó tan fácil pude hacerlo a partir de los patrones que tenía yo a la mano,espero les guste a continuación vamos con los materiales: # > Hello, good morning sewing family! It's a pleasure to greet you 👋🏻🥰 On this occasion, I'm sharing a bit of the creative process of making a men's shirt from athletic fabric. Although the process wasn't so easy, I was able to do it using the patterns I had on hand. I hope you like it. Next, let's go over the materials: # # ---
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)

#

> * **_Shirt pattern, size \

## _
Pasos a seguir: | Steps to follow:
_ #
![IMG_20260813_112056_861 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EogPGPT7xmUZ5WCVgdSYgRLNCsEzVatLWRvf6RPbJ2f4v4XFphFhAQk2nQ2QEYAnZm1.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_114127_413 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EoK6oEzfK1CNRGp5ioFjyjdQTP5YTW79sn79YAa4Q4NYCe1nA68Qg6Fmk5pYsBakWUm.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_112919_715 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EogPMCoBQ6YNUs3K49Xj6qzn8oMSzfQNrA4MiU6Yzw14HMUDk9xgFn8i8fmDtbvopzj.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_112736_833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXCtmPULr66TGrEPVuhBDdRBx8jXBy2TbDewL2L3vemU8/IMG_20260813_112736_833.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_114215_152.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV14EjkFXS5e7v8aJ7mKjxaKKJu6zw8NYvQr454RyFQUC/IMG_20260813_114215_152.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_113313_922.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmShahKebeZSUM8SSBaqTgn7hUC2goVEdNnS3xRBRnvYhq/IMG_20260813_113313_922.jpg)
### _Paso 01_

>En el primer paso vamos a cortar las piezas correspondientes de mi chemise,para ello colocamos doble la tela y vamos a cortar las piezas tanto la delantera como la de atrás,las mangas,el cuello doble y las dos vistas del frente para la chemise y aparte una tira de 2 cm de ancho para el borde del cuello. # > ### _Step 01_ > In the first step we are going to cut the corresponding pieces of my shirt, for this we place the fabric in a fold and we are going to cut the pieces both the front and the back, the sleeves, the double collar and the two front facings for the shirt and separately a 2 cm wide strip for the edge of the collar. ---
![IMG_20260813_124220_328.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgTwWP4qWm6eqN3DcHz5pFnuKmT9FskPnSPDpiEXG3Jg/IMG_20260813_124220_328.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_124615_768.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmULcZaa4FypiYr1EoyBFAesSYCdj1f91iHyjxohbnFGAy/IMG_20260813_124615_768.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_130024_797.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6MSbHBn1JVQZS4Wa62uCUXH4eMEQGkkBqFyWybgAaqh/IMG_20260813_130024_797.jpg)
![IMG_20260813_130043_270.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP1758nJAkdthigm7tEHy1D8DW1EHvubmbps9v7kS7guc/IMG_20260813_130043_270.jpg)
![IMG_20260814_101021_009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYTRfTHzARGG2d7RbPKT5reKoXse5AmUnq7sJdXRVuhgZ/IMG_20260814_101021_009.jpg)
### _Paso 02_
>Después de cortar dichas piezas es momento de coser , acá voy a unir los hombros de la pieza delantera y la de atrás,luego le haré una piquete en forma de \

justo en el centro a cada manga y ubicaremos éste piquete en el centro de la costura del hombro de la chemise,coloco un alfiler y cosemos las mangas sin sellarlas por abajo solo que nos queden abiertas,para luego poder coser el cuello ,porque si la sellamos se nos va a dificultar coserlo después,pasamos a colocar el pelón en las piezas o vistas de la chemise con la plancha a nivel intermedio de calor. # > ### _Step 02_ > After cutting these pieces, it's time to sew. Here, I'm going to join the shoulders of the front and back pieces. Then, I'll make a \

shaped notch right in the center of each sleeve, and we'll place this notch in the center of the shoulder seam of the shirt. I'll put a pin in place and sew the sleeves without sealing them at the bottom, just leaving them open so we can sew the collar later. If we seal it, it will be difficult to sew it later. Next, we'll place the interfacing on the shirt pieces or facings with the iron at a medium heat setting. ---
![IMG_20260814_102603_892.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeW8uMppeAdoUqABxVWsfpXWjhP4iVmeJbqQG8DANUwHK/IMG_20260814_102603_892.jpg)

![IMG_20260814_103831_780.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeMYx8ZDHXN5Mka1SsR2B8AM9vyVucHyCkA2u1iYzMEnC/IMG_20260814_103831_780.jpg)
![IMG_20260814_110149_406.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWHtTUEMr6QkNd1Z1GonXQJ1LBdQSpnAh3X3G7M4tgESz/IMG_20260814_110149_406.jpg)
![IMG_20260814_110153_224.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZC3F7MDMhZoQvFwXnDz5pLagzARYTf9YQAE3WkLRJYM6/IMG_20260814_110153_224.jpg)
### _Paso 03_

>Cosemos las vistas con overclock por el borde y ahora nos vamos a coser el cuello(A este no le he colocado tela pelón)luego lo volteamos ,hacemos una costura de refuerzo por encima dejando 0.50 cm del borde hacia adentro para coser y planchamos,ubicamos las vistas con alfileres en una abertura que hice en el frente de la chemise de 12 cm y la cosemos con una costura recta cada lado la volteamos y el ancho de la vista es de tres centímetros,la dejaremos asi sin coser para ubicar el cuello. # > ### _Step 03_ > We sew the facings with overlock stitching along the edge and now we are going to sew the collar (I haven't added fleece fabric to this one). Then we turn it right side out, make a reinforcing seam on top leaving 0.50 cm of the edge to the inside for sewing and iron it. We pin the facings to a 12 cm opening I made in the front of the shirt and sew it with a straight stitch on each side. We turn it right side out and the width of the facing is three centimeters. We will leave it like this without sewing to attach the collar. ---
![IMG_20260814_113530_776.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctX4MXxTfhptb7TLCaLX8aogDnG5hPwLTsqjWL6axxo7/IMG_20260814_113530_776.jpg)
![IMG_20260814_113536_489.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeHWsBoBFrcZTwLo5ZmDCf3ARZWBj1d9vGPsNzTy3Ekhj/IMG_20260814_113536_489.jpg)
![IMG_20260814_120258_692.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSLCkbZxxhTQc7TqwsNZgAUnTs8G9wJ4F6SN64GG4bZZd/IMG_20260814_120258_692.jpg)
### _Paso 04_

>Para ubicar el cuello marcaremos la mitad de la vista del lado superior justo a la mitad con una tiza y hacemos un pequeño corte vertical de 0.50 cm a los 1.50 cm de ancho de la vista de 3 cm ,allí ubicamos el cuello que la costura nos quede por dentro,luego ubico la tira de 2 cm la coso le hago un dobles hacia abajo y vuelvo a repisar ,nos debe quedar el cuello por dentro igual la tira,luego volteamos la vista y la cosemos por encima repisando con una costura, también repiso encima con un pequeño rectángulo y luego cosemos por el borde dejando 10 cm de abertura abajo para hacer los dobleces hacia adentro de la abertura de dicha chemise, le coseremos los bordes con un dobladillo. # > ### _Step 04_ > To position the collar, mark the midpoint of the facing on the upper side with chalk and make a small vertical cut of 0.50 cm at the 1.50 cm wide edge of the 3 cm facing. Position the collar there, ensuring the seam is on the inside. Then, position the 2 cm strip, sew it, fold it down, and topstitch again. The collar and strip should now be on the inside. Turn the facing right side out and sew it over, topping it with a seam. Also topstitch with a small rectangle and then sew along the edge, leaving a 10 cm opening at the bottom to fold the opening of the shirt inwards. Finally, hem the edges. ---
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)

title.title: Hey Hive, I'm Emmanuel/M.A.N, an independent musician
title.body:
![bannière M.A.N juillet 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manexperiment/23vrryicBy1BqZU93XmvgUDU8hhTp56195Hku3bCyzMrGqVuJjUWeTwWQ6fv2db9EJ4cK.jpg)


Hello everyone,

This is my very first post here, and I wanted it to sound like... well, like me! My name is Emmanuel/M.A.N, and I'm an independent musician. Not the kind to stick to just one style, either : I love moving between electro, rock, pop-rock, jazz and techno, depending on my mood or the story I feel like telling.

There's something I'm particularly passionate about in my music: I bring in virtual singers, created with Synth V, the vocal synthesizer by Dreamtonics. It's a fascinating world, somewhere between traditional composition and technological exploration — giving a \

to a digital character, choosing their tone, their inflections, almost like directing a singer who only exists within the music itself.


![Logo M.A.N juillet 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manexperiment/AJoD1Vnx6WfkoJMViHmTsW4xXnQdRnX3zhHbbPoWRFY3E93WHQa8RbAnCQuPczE.jpg)


I'm just discovering Hive, and what drew me in was the idea of a community where you can share your creations directly, without intermediaries, where the listening and support really comes from people who love music — not from an algorithm.

I plan to post my compositions here regularly: sometimes an energetic electro track, sometimes something more mellow in jazz, sometimes an experiment with my virtual voices. I can't wait to see where this leads.

If you're also a musician, curious about voice synthesis, or simply someone who enjoys sounds that go a little off the beaten path, feel free to say hi in the comments. I'd love to chat, listen to your creations too, and discover this community through you.

See you very soon for the first track!

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: August 30 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g8d74375c3f5fa5c5cb213d07ff1754308c512c7b6ca5df05377c76975e171a07a23c719c268aa16a64a3dee249e58d6dd33043d155b0a1b62af4d4a6b761cb50_640.jpg)
Hoy fue un día perfecto para caminar por la ciudad. Empecé mi ruta en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y los rayos del sol me llenaron de energía. Mientras caminaba, me encontré con una pareja de ancianos que estaban alimentando a las palomas. Me contaron que cada mañana vienen a este lugar porque les gusta observar cómo la ciudad despierta. Su entusiasmo por las pequeñas cosas de la vida me recordó la importancia de disfrutar el momento. Más adelante, pasé por una galería de arte al aire libre donde varios artistas locales estaban exhibiendo sus obras. Me detuve a conversar con una joven pintora que estaba plasmando una serie de murales coloridos. Ella compartió su pasión por el arte urbano y cómo espera inspirar a otros a ver la belleza en lo cotidiano. En mi caminata, también noté un nuevo café que había abierto, con un diseño moderno y acogedor. Atraído por el aroma del café, decidí hacer una breve parada. La barista, llena de energía, me recomendó un latte de especias que realmente valió la pena. Hoy no solo caminé, sino que también conecté con personas y descubrí nuevos lugares. Cada caminata tiene su propia historia y hoy fue una de esas que quedará grabada en mi memoria. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: From Factory Worker to Business Owner: My Introduction to the Hive Community
title.body:
Peace be upon you! My name is Muhammad Usama, I was born in Pakistan's famous city Lahore. At the age of 10 to 12 years, I started going to a madrasa (religious school) to learn the Holy Quran. My memory / ability to memorize was not good enough that whatever I memorized would stay in my memory. But even then, after a lot of difficulties, I memorized 21 Paras (chapters). After that, my paternal aunt lives in Pattoki, and I started going to the government school there. There, my aunt's elder son, Muhammad Zakariya, was the vice principal. Now he has passed away, may Allah Almighty grant him a high status in Jannah-tul-Firdaus. He helped me a lot in my studies, and there in the third class, I secured the first position. After that, I returned from there to my home, to my parents in Lahore, and got admitted to the school here. Then I completed the rest of my education here, and then I gave my matriculation exams here. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRzUxq1ibd2MAoT5BcXJDdAASDi1RKx7PEiGxFiHnLWtv/1788087675896.png) ## Preaching of Islam In 2018, I went to preach the message of religion with religious people for the propagation of Islam. In 2019, during the coronavirus, I was still with the Jamaat (preaching group), and then I started learning mobile repair/work. ## The Journey from Online Earning to Starting My Own Business I really liked crypto work online, but the circumstances were not good enough for me to do crypto work, yet I kept engaged with crypto work. By then, my age had reached 20 to 21 years, and then my family decided on my marriage. At that time, our household circumstances were not very good, so I left the mobile work and started going to a factory. After that, I got married and kept working in the factory. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTcnqwVGPuoQ7qmCV2k2KsKNV1TpADiDMjtfM9LxgSffa/1788084591021.jpg) Alhamdulillah, Allah Almighty blessed me with a very good life partner, that is my wife. At that time, my salary in the factory was so low that running the household system was very difficult. Then I decided that I already knew mobile work, so after working in the factory for four years, I left it and opened a mobile shop near my house. But at that time, I did not even have enough budget to work in it properly. I had some money lying in crypto, so I withdrew money from there and invested it in the shop. Alhamdulillah, with the help of the shop, many of my expenses improved a lot. A few months after the shop, my phone that had crypto was stolen. My heart was broken very badly by this, and at that time I left crypto too, but my heart really wanted to keep doing crypto work. ## Current Life Now, Alhamdulillah, I have four of my own businesses/works. After the mobile shop, I also started my track suit business, which is on a partnership with a friend. The second work I started two months ago, where I built a canteen in the factory area to feed the factory workers; this is also on a partnership. The third work is also on a partnership and it has been 10 days since starting it, and the fourth is my own mobile shop, on which I give time myself. My Main business, my Mobile Shop ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQuEKnegJFKEVXAbE1aTkMBZCczoPBScMMNSD6tekQCnk/1788084574650.jpg) Logo of my side business (track suite stitching company) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTSZw45skgDva4EKuecRRn4x3jjzgcfQ1tYiZ87fMsfFJ/1788084633555.jpg) ## How Did I Find Out About Hive? A few days ago, while using YouTube during free time at the shop, I came to know about Hive's project Liketu. After that, I searched about it and created my account. After that, I learned further about Actifit (where we can earn money by keeping ourselves fit), so I had created an account on Liketu while I started using Actifit. I go to the gym daily, where a friend of mine told me that there is a guy named Ghulam Abbas here who also does crypto work. The location he mentioned was just a short distance from my home. Another friend of mine lives there; I inquired from him where Ghulam Abbas (@nabbas0786) lives, so I got his contact number. I invited him to my shop, many thanks to him that he accepted the invitation and came to me. He explained this project to me in a very good way, and I was very satisfied with Ghulam Abbas. I hope that I will spend some of my time on crypto and this platform and keep receiving all of your attention. السلام علیکم! میرا نام محمد اسامہ ہے، میں پاکستان کے مشہور شہر لاہور میں پیدا ہوا۔ میں 10 سے 12 سال کی عمر میں ہی قرآن پاک سیکھنے کے لیے مدرسے جانے لگ گیا تھا، میرا حافظہ /یاد کرنے کا مادہ اتنا اچھا نہیں تھا کہ جو یاد کروں وہ مجھے یاد رہے۔ لیکن تب بھی میں نے 21 سیپارے حفظ کر لیے تھے کافی مشکلوں کے بعد اس کے بعد میری پھوپھو پتوکی رہتی ہیں میں وہاں کے گورنمنٹ اسکول میں جانے لگا، وہاں میری پھوپھو کا بڑا بیٹا محمد زکریا وائس پرنسپل تھا۔ اب ان کا انتقال ہو چکا ہے اللہ پاک ان کو جنت الفردوس میں اعلی مقام دے انہوں نے میری پڑھائی میں بہت زیادہ مدد کی، وہاں پر تیسری کلاس میں میں نے پہلی پوزیشن حاصل کی۔ اس کے بعد میں وہاں سے اپنے گھر، اپنے والدین کے پاس لاہور آگیا اور یہیں اسکول میں داخل ہو گیا۔ باقی کی پڑھائی پھر میں نے یہاں پہ ہی پوری کی پھر یہاں پہ میں نے میٹرک کے امتحان دیے۔ ## دین کی دعوت 2018 میں، میں اسلام کی تبلیغ کے لیے مذہبی لوگوں کے ساتھ دین کی دعوت دینے کے لیے گیا۔ 2019 میں کورونا وائرس کے دوران جماعت میں ہی تھا پھر میں نے موبائلوں کا کام سیکھنا شروع کیا۔ ## آنلائن کمائی کرنے سے اپنا کام شروع کرنے تک کا سفر۔ مجھے آن لائن میں کرپٹو کا کام بہت پسند تھا لیکن حالات بھی اتنے اچھے نہیں تھے کہ میں کرپٹو کا کام کر سکوں لیکن میں کرپٹو کے کام میں لگا رہا۔ تب تک میری عمر 20 سے 21 سال تک کی ہو چکی تھی پھر گھر والوں نے میری شادی کا ارادہ کیا اس وقت ہمارے گھریلو حالات اتنے اچھے نہیں تھے، لہٰذا میں نے موبائلوں کا کام چھوڑ کے فیکٹری جانا شروع کر دیا پھر اس کے بعد میری شادی ہوئی میں فیکٹری میں ہی کام کرتا رہا۔ الحمداللہ اللہ پاک نے مجھے میری زندگی کا ساتھی یعنی میری بیوی بہت ہی اچھی دی، اس وقت فیکٹری میں میری تنخواہ اتنی کم تھی کہ گھر کا سسٹم بہت مشکلوں سے چلتا تھا۔ پھر میں نے فیصلہ کیا کہ مجھے موبائلوں کا کام تو آتا ہی ہے، چار سال فیکٹری میں کام کرنے کے بعد چھوڑ دیا میں نے اپنے گھر کے پاس ہی موبائل دکان اوپن کی لیکن اس وقت میرے پاس اتنا بھی بجٹ نہیں تھا کہ اس میں اچھے سے کام کر سکوں۔ کرپٹو میں میرے کچھ پیسے پڑے ہوئے تھے وہاں سے پیسے نکال کے میں نے دکان میں انوسٹ کیے الحمدللہ دکان کی مدد سے میرے بہت سے اخراجات بہت بہتر ہو گئے دکان کے کچھ مہینوں کے بعد میرا جو کرپٹو والا موبائل تھا وہ چوری ہو گیا اس سے میرا دل بہت زیادہ ہی ٹوٹ گیا، اس وقت میں نے کرپٹو بھی چھوڑ دی لیکن میرا دل بہت کرتا تھا کہ کرپٹو کا کام ہی کرتا رہوں۔ ## موجودہ زندگی اب الحمدللہ میرے اپنے ہی چار کام ہیں، موبائل شاپ کے بعد میں نے اپنا ٹریک سوٹ کا کام بھی شروع کیا جو کہ ایک دوست کے ساتھ پارٹنرشپ پر ہے۔ دوسرا کام میں نے دو مہینے پہلے شروع کیا ہے جہاں فیکٹری کے ورکرز کو کھانا کھلانے کے لیے فیکٹری ایریا میں کینٹین بنائی، یہ بھی پارٹنرشپ پر ہے۔ تیسرا کام بھی پارٹنرشپ پر ہے اور اس کو 10 دن ہوئے ہیں ابھی شروع کیے اور چوتھا میرا اپنا موبائل شاپ کا اس پہ میں خود ٹائم دیتا ہوں۔ ## ہائیو کے بارے میں کیسے پتہ چلا؟ کچھ دن پہلے شاپ پہ فری ٹائم میں یوٹیوب چلاتے ہوئے Hive کے پروجیکٹ Liketu کے بارے میں پتہ چلا۔ پھر اس کے بعد میں نے اس پہ سرچ کی اور اپنا اکاؤنٹ بنایا، اس کے بعد مجھے مزید معلوم ہوا کہ Actifit (جہاں ہم اپنے آپ کو فٹ رکھ کر پیسے کما سکتے ہیں) تو میں نے اکاؤنٹ Liketu پر بنایا تھا جبکہ استعمال Actifit کرنے لگ گیا۔ میں روزانہ جم کرنے جاتا ہوں وہاں پر میرے ایک دوست نے مجھے بتایا کہ یہاں غلام عباس نامی لڑکا ہے وہ بھی کرپٹو کا کام کرتا ہے اس نے جو جگہ بتائی وہ میرے گھر سے تھوڑی ہی دور ہے۔ وہاں پہ میرا ایک اور دوست رہتا ہے میں نے اس سے پتہ کیا کہ غلام عباس کس جگہ پہ رہتا ہے تو مجھے اس کا کانٹیکٹ نمبر مل گیا۔ میں نے اس کو اپنی شاپ پہ دعوت دی اس کا بہت شکریہ کہ اس نے دعوت قبول کی اور وہ میرے پاس آیا اس نے مجھے بہت ہی اچھے طریقے سے اس پروجیکٹ کے بارے میں بتایا جو کہ میں غلام عباس سے بہت ہی زیادہ مطمئن ہوا۔ امید کرتا ہوں کہ میں اپنا کچھ وقت کرپٹو اور اس پلیٹ فارم پر گزاروں گا اور آپ سب کی توجہ حاصل کرتا رہوں گا۔

title.title: How to use mobile app development for better business growth?
title.body:
A mobile-first world translates to customers wanting
businesses to be available anywhere they go. From shopping, booking a service,
making payment, communicating with a company or just checking the updates –
smartphones have become an integral part of the customer journey. For
businesses, this presents an opportunity to create better relationships via a
properly designed mobile app.


The development of mobile apps is now more than just
creating an app and placing it on an app store. Any application that is
successful must be useful, quick, secure, easy to use and user friendly.

**
Why Mobile Apps are important for Businesses**


A mobile application provides businesses with a direct
digital medium to communicate with the customer. Access to notifications,
customization of content, customer support, loyalty programs, and in-app
services can enhance the convenience of the overall experience.


New applications are also getting \

. When it
comes to designing new mobile products, the issues of AI, on-device processing,
cross-platform technologies, and privacy-focused design are gaining
significance for 2026.


For businesses, it translates to being able to display
information and more. It can be helpful with automation, customer preferences,
making recommendations and making things simpler.


Selecting the appropriate development strategy. Selecting
the appropriate development approach.


No two business is exactly alike and as such, there is no
single development approach which works for all. Depending on the application,
there may be cases where it is better to develop it natively for best
performance on the particular platform, and other cases where it is better to
use a cross-platform framework to minimize development and maintenance costs.


The first step in creating an effective mobile app
development strategy is to grasp the target audience, business goals, desired
features, budget, and potential for future growth. Developers can then select
the best technology and architecture, instead of trying to impose a solution
upon the business.


Security must be thought about from the outset too. Security
measures such as authentication, data protection, secure APIs, permissions and
privacy should be integrated from the outset, rather than added on.

We at Key Dynamics Solutions are here to assist you with all
your needs and requirements.


The emphasis at [Key
Dynamics Solutions](https://keydynamicssolutions.com/)  should be on
developing technology to address actual business issues. Just because more
people have a mobile app doesn't mean you need to. It should have a distinct
mission statement and offer some value to users.


Whether it's designing the user interface and experience,
drafting the design, building the app, testing, deployment, or refining, a
structured process can make the process of creating a dependable digital
product easier.

By delivering a user-friendly and intuitive application that
meets the evolving demands of users, a well-crafted mobile app development
project can enhance customer engagement, streamline services, boost brand
visibility, and unlock new digital opportunities for businesses. The best
applications are those that make the customer's life just a little easier, not
another complicated screen to navigate on their cell phone.


The Future of Mobile Applications.

It's an ever-changing mobile world. In 2026, the development
of applications is influenced by several key trends, including AI-powered
experiences, customised interfaces, on-device intelligence, connected devices,
and enhanced privacy measures.

However, there is no need for businesses to pursue all of
these new and exciting technologies. The better way is to discover what
features are useful to their clients and to their business objectives.

[Mobile app
development](https://keydynamicssolutions.com/mobile-app-development/) can be more than a technology project with the right strategy
and implementation partner. It can evolve into a real instrument for growth,
interaction with the customer, and long-term digital transformation.

**FAQs**


The first question that arises is: What is mobile app
development?


It involves developing, designing, testing, launching and
maintaining applications for mobile devices like smartphones and tablets.


Why businesses need a mobile app?

A mobile application can help businesses enhance engagement,
communication, personalization and brand visibility for the customers with
convenient access to services.



What is the native or cross-platform development option
for businesses?


It varies according to the project. In some situations, such
as with a very platform-specific application, you might use a native approach,
but in others, a cross-platform approach may be practical when a company wants
to maintain support for multiple platforms in a cost-effective way.

Yes. Features that can be supported with AI include

and automation. In appropriate applications, on-device AI can offer privacy and

title.title: [TV] Mara Clara Season 2: When Knowing the Truth Changes Nothing
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY9VePH6A4Vwt9HMxMbpPS3jmtFRRBnvd7MYArecHVE2r/359458.jpg) Watching the season two of Mara and Clara, I saw there was quite some difference from what I watched in the season one. Though all the characters were still the same, but all the things that were like secrets started coming into the limelight. The true identity of who Mara and Clara were has already been revealed unto them. And I saw how they handled knowing who their biological parents were because it wasn't something so pleasant for them. I saw how Mara struggled to find her place in her real parents house, the Del Valle family, while reality hit Clara so hard because the security, protection and the wealthy lifestyle she thought she had was no longer hers. One thing I liked and admired about Mara was that despite knowing her new identity, her character didn't change, which made me care more about her than anything else. But in this season, I was a bit also concerned about Clara because she was no longer this spoiled girl always bullying Mara that I watched in the first season. In this season, she seems to be very afraid because she started losing everything she grew up believing she had. But a lot of her choices she made after, I don't think I agree with some of them, but I totally understand where she was coming from. So, a lot of her choices were complicated in a way. For me, I still like how Mara maintained her relationship with Susan even after she finally knew the truth. The bond she shared from the previous season with her was still there, and it didn't suddenly disappear. And this is something I so much appreciated that they did in this movie because the motherhood bond they had didn't just vanish because of the DNA results. Susan raised Mara even though it was Alvira who gave birth to her. And the story kept on trying to prove that, if that were important. Even though some of the characters I didn't so much like in the previous season, I liked them in this season, but for, Gary was still a character I so dislike because he didn't change while others did. He became more controlling and always wanted what he didn't work for. And his bad action led to his death, while Susan did while she was trying to protect Alvira. That scene was so important for me because Susan finally took a decision after she had spent a lot of years enduring his bad behaviors, and she reached a point where protecting someone mattered to her more than still living under his shadow of fear. What I observed about this season was that even after the truth was revealed, the conflict grew bigger than even when Mara and Clara were switched at birth. And another conflict showed up. And another death attempt on Mara life was show, and I also saw how Clara became so much swallowed in her anger. And the way Henry manipulated her also pushed her into more hatred, and she finally broke down psychologically. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRRH3N1yqUrosCiA1QL9C9TQcgLTwDZCQQCCxNVCa13eu/359457.jpg) And in this season, I saw how they unnecessarily overdid the suffering. Because even before there was a permanent solution before some earlier plot, another problem like accident, betrayal, revenge has already resurfaced. I saw that some stories were not necessarily need too which made the season more stretched instead of making me to feel emotional invested. And I don't like how this season made Clara to be so overwhelmed to the extent of becoming more bitter after the truth was revealed. But still, I won't pretend that I didn't enjoy the enjoyable scenes in this movies because it shows how the truth can fix a lot of things. And sometimes, the truth can be to big for some people to deal with such like Clara. Despite all that, it's still a 8.0/10 for me because I love the family stories and hie dramatic some characters were. >

These images are a visual record of the festival in Regla on September 7. It is a day when the town takes to the streets to celebrate its patron saint, the Virgin of Regla, and to pay homage to Yemayá, the powerful orisha who rules the seas in the African pantheon.

...........

This work captures the essence of a living syncretism, in which the Catholic faith and Yoruba spirituality not only coexist but merge into a celebration of faith and joy. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR44Gv7jFGncjzvdwNtsSgthwsv9EGXUNWsuSeH35gZnn/1788034685177.jpg)

....


Through the lens, we see how the color blue becomes a mantle that shelters the two queens, how the prayers to the Virgin blend with the rhythms of the drums, and how the sea becomes an altar where both worlds meet.

.........

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMRQ9Qzjord5mg5arhj6SQ7ogn6xrSzFFkUvt43oDnAc/1788034586858.jpg)


These images pay tribute to the cultural resilience of a people who have managed to weave their own spiritual identity—an identity in which the Virgin and Yemayá are two sides of the same coin, two streams that come together in a single river of Cuban faith.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRvSDQw5Ds4bAB42DrXQVJrVGuHtXpzyv2S8KqZdGWaZ/1788048503549.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdGfLkfcfr734xCmoNpytpByC34hYsJY6gsPe1w6MJQfb/1788048607469.jpg)





VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL.


Recuento de Septiembre/2025

Estas imágenes son un testimonio visual de la festividad en Regla: el 7 de septiembre. Es un día en que el pueblo sale a las calles para celebrar a su patrona, la Virgen de Regla, y a rendirle homenaje a Yemayá, la poderosa orisha dueña de los mares en el panteón africano.

Esta obra captura la esencia de un sincretismo vivo, donde la fe católica y la espiritualidad yoruba no solo conviven, sino que se funden en una celebración de fe y alegría. 

A través de la lente, observamos cómo el color azul se convierte en un manto que cobija a las dos reinas, cómo los rezos a la Virgen se mezclan con los cantos de los tambores  y cómo el mar se convierte en un altar donde ambos mundos se encuentran. 

Estas imágenes son un homenaje a la resiliencia cultural de un pueblo que ha sabido tejer su propia identidad espiritual, una identidad donde la Virgen y Yemayá son dos caras de una misma moneda, dos aguas que se unen en un solo río de fe cubana.






Photos taken with a Nikon D-5100, lens 18 - 55, the text was written by me

title.title: Diy Leather Bookmarks
title.body:
My grandmother was very creative when she was alive. She had many different hobbies and enjoyed making crafts. 

![1000019830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoK5uHkn4sBBwqY9rFUovDYhASXecuBgsmruSq1HJFWmQk4yPcc1jAWyYDAxRdnrUPc.jpg)

She did a lot of cross stitch work and baking (as every grandma does). She also made these intricate paper pictures that came in a kit, and among other things, she did leather work and leather stamping. 

![1000019832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23uQvSByeDPmU8pwXk5sXHEABrEh9khnB67kLvk4KVqTLpaC3UuinkUyByYHXT6trp9Vs.jpg)

I inherited her leather stamping kit many years ago and have made a few things myself over the years. The first piece and most elaborate one that I made was a woman's belt. I did that over 10 years ago and surprisingly, its still held up after so many years.  

![1000019826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EowHYpMr8mhtsQqohFJ78vL2yDvXdHvwghWJ9mjoEbgeE9ZJfYiJ6F6codPH9dQ1Wd6.jpg)

In the kit are dozens of different stamps that are used to create a wide variety of patterns. 

![1000019677.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoEqbUhAVVkQtRdpyEJr3Bd5cviRNXWWMFuH6ipVCiVkTCB4mrCzrzpk66hAvAYR5Hc.jpg)

You can create very simple patterns using  single stamp or you can combine several to create some pretty intricate designs. 

![1000019788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xyXVokd9dHg65r8P9fearjkN5DDbMrJzBVRfV6doPNHebEEjwdCBfH9nfe9vqNrTw99.jpg)

There are so many different stamps that it can be a little overwhelming trying to come up with a new design. I myself tend to just stick to the more simple ones that I have used before and are familiar with.  

![1000019792.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wC9YCY2hdXpLYj3erUuuHbJwb1jeRkws4fyYegrfuWGuagHNzcqrBntubMSrFWBQa6R.jpg)

These are some samples that are in the kit, made presumably by my grandma. I don't really know who made them, they were just in the box when I got it. 

The three designs on the left don't really look all that special but they are actually pretty complex. They are an example of what can be done when you combine several different stamps together. They are also more difficult because you have to really focus on lining them up properly to make them look seamless. 

![1000019791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wgQHAKQB832g6x48m9gP2fpF6HZdb9XDvrAhuX2B9ApVYLJvFj9WAXJWLPgG9KV4NQL.jpg)

If you're really good like my grandma, you can actually carve the leather and stamp it to give it additional texture. 

![1000019838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EopvpBYTJj3SEappMtmfKMegPkUhkF4rnoPxEdeVzwRQFaYccBbniXZD3RLi6rd8ZhT.jpg)


The other day I decided to make two simple book marks. 

![1000019790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wCBmwdyQQQVGmCPU4z2Aw321F9PvX8k1mXSG4oS8pSRZGC7BEyxUs1QBWTPMJJ3iCAz.jpg)

I measured and cut the raw leather and then created a border using a special tool - let's call it a \

Then I spent time stamping out the design. 

![1000019799.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xKvhQ16FX9cHFn29edGjdPiGSAtkeZkkBeFUNLMtG6qh3mB4B52Fco4exzPd13juJHu.jpg)

Before stamping you need to soak the leather in water briefly to soften it. I didn't show this step but you get the idea, put some water on it and let it absorb into the leather to make it soft. After that you just place the stamp and hit it with a hammer and thats basically it. One thing to note is that you have to make sure the stamp is oriented correctly. I turned the stamp in my hand at one point without realizing it and ended up with one set of horizontal lines among the rest of the verticle lines. There is only a little room for error in the process. Sometimes if you re-wet the leather and rub out the design or stamp over it you can hide mistakes. But that doesn't always work. Its best to go slow and do it right the first time and try to avoid mistakes.  

![1000019798.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xKxLsrhXVDX6nXmwcvN1ZGGrByA8SbuymyyTmd4hvP97pCy8rjaR5BfzLTfsptd3Jor.jpg)

You can also \

the leather before you stamp it, which darkens it and gives it a petina finish. You do this by wetting the leather and then massaging it with a rounded metal tool.

![1000019837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xen7PdtQXP5aS1KsgMrqef5vUmXw7tFePehDWfUTDkYT7Kp8h3Hr1NqTSTshmcNadNF.jpg)

The sample pieces above are an example of what I'm talking about. You can see that they are darker and have a nice petina to them. The raw leather will also petina over time though, with basic use. 

In the case of the book marks that I made I intentionally left them raw so that they would petina naturally with use. More reading equals more petina.

![1000019797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eos2M4JMLkXNF91nVaJPaHPPsGgCQho5tNKCVN5WG998jPzuVCrhEoy7w9kzdkSDWxD.jpg)

Above and below is the second bookmark that I made, with a different pattern. You can see what the stamping tool looks like from the underside, in the photo. 

![1000019794.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23zbPRHQzvwmLofjWqEpETtWDosUtZz7uS34b53kJkg7mw8iME1FeGoNeWJvxpdiih8x4.jpg)

The pattern didn't line up perfectly within the border, so some of the edges look a little off. Maybe I'll experiment with extending the pattern further and then cutting the leather afterwards, and making the border last. I'm still learning and experimenting.

#### What do you think of the bookmarks or leather stamping in general? Do you have any crafting hobbies? Let me know in the comments.

title.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g4a8a9ac61e84d799efa14b9dd2d0ade69852901598bbb5a1c444a48fa4b3fb264f381a07b712d1755ede0b8bcf3ba5a14ad67a23b1a3ced24518d7117892d330_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 러브 스토리 이야기 만들기

## 주제: 다양한 사랑의 형태

### 1. 첫사랑의 기억
- **배경**: 고등학교 시절, 풋풋한 첫사랑의 이야기.
- **주요 인물**: 수줍은 소녀 '지민'과 인기 많은 소년 '민수'.
- **줄거리**: 지민은 민수를 짝사랑하지만, 그 감정을 표현하지 못한다. 어느 날, 민수가 지민의 그림을 보고 그 재능에 감명을 받아 가까워지게 된다. 서로의 꿈을 응원하며 성장하는 과정을 담는다.

### 2. 오랜 친구에서 연인으로
- **배경**: 대학 시절, 친구 사이로 지낸 두 사람의 이야기.
- **주요 인물**: 활발한 성격의 '하늘'과 조용한 성격의 '준호'.
- **줄거리**: 하늘과 준호는 대학에서 만나 5년간 친구로 지낸다. 어느 날, 하늘이 다른 사람과 데이트를 하게 되면서 준호는 자신의 감정을 깨닫게 된다. 친구에서 연인으로 발전하는 과정을 그린다.

### 3. 이질적인 사랑
- **배경**: 서로 다른 문화와 배경을 가진 두 사람의 이야기.
- **주요 인물**: 한국의 '소연'과 외국에서 온 '리암'.
- **줄거리**: 소연은 리암과 언어 교환 프로그램을 통해 만난다. 서로 다른 문화적 배경으로 인해 갈등이 생기지만, 점차 서로를 이해하고 존중하게 된다. 이들의 사랑이 어떻게 성장하는지를 보여준다.

### 4. 사랑의 재발견
- **배경**: 결혼 10년 차 부부의 이야기.
- **주요 인물**: 바쁜 직장인 '영수'와 전업주부 '미영'.
- **줄거리**: 결혼 생활에 지쳐가는 영수와 미영은 서로의 소중함을 잊고 지낸다. 우연히 만난 친구들의 도움으로 그들의 사랑을 재발견하게 되는 과정을 그린다.

### 5. 시간 여행자의 사랑
- **배경**: 미래와 과거를 오가는 시간 여행의 이야기.
- **주요 인물**: 시간 여행자 '태윤'과 과거의 소녀 '슬기'.
- **줄거리**: 태윤은 과거로 돌아가 슬기를 만나게 되고, 그녀와의 사랑에 빠진다. 그러나 시간의 법칙 때문에 그들의 사랑은 비극적인 결말을 맞이할 위기에 처한다. 두 사람은 사랑을 지키기 위해 어떤 선택을 할 것인지 고민하게 된다.

---

이러한 다양한 주제를 바탕으로 한 러브 스토리는 각기 다른 감정과 상황을 통해 독자들에게 깊은 감동을 줄 수 있습니다. 각 이야기의 전개와 결말은 독자의 상상력에 맡겨 보세요!

title.title: Why Not Every Opportunity Is Worth Taking
title.body:
Sometimes an opportunity looks good, but that doesn’t mean it’s right for U.
U might get excited because of the money, attention, or what others are doing. But if it doesn’t fit ur goals, it can end up wasting ur time and energy.
I’ve learned that saying “no” can also be a smart decision.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSS6vN5TtTjjFB9YtRb3jFuVXF1R2v6U26q6igHTagamk/IMG_0544.jpeg 

Not every door that opens is meant for U. Sometimes, walking away gives U more time to focus on what actually matters.
Before taking an opportunity, ask urself: “Does this really move me closer to where I want to be?”
If the answer is no, it’s okay to pass.

title.title: The Newari Lakhey Dance: A Powerful Street Tradition
title.body:
Hello everyone! I hope you are all doing well and enjoying your day. Today, I am excited to share a glimpse of one of the most vibrant and energetic cultural traditions from our streets.
In Newar culture, the Lakhey Naach (Lakhey Dance) is one of the most exciting and meaningful masked dances you will ever see.
Who is the Lakhey?
In old Newari stories, the Lakhey is a forest demon. Even though he has big teeth, wide eyes, and wild hair, he is not considered evil. The Newar community respects the Lakhey as a fierce protector who scares away bad energy, protects children, and keeps sickness away from the town.
What Makes the Dance Special?
The Look: A bright red mask, wild gray hair, a red shirt, and a colorful floral skirt with small bells tied around the waist.
The Music: The dance moves follow the fast, loud beats of traditional Newari drums (Dhimay) and cymbals.
The Action: The dancer spins quickly, waves bright cloths, and charges around the street, giving everyone a fun, thrilling show.
The Community: Local families and children love to gather outside shops and homes to watch the dancer perform up close.
Seeing this dance is a great reminder of how living Newari traditions bring people together and keep old stories alive.

Amara sat across from her friend, stirring her drink slowly. “Do you know,” she began, “only an average of 10% of men actually make the effort to work on themselves?”
Her friend raised an eyebrow. “That low?”
Amara nodded. “Yes. The rest? They move in circles. Copying each other, repeating the same mistakes, learning nothing. It’s like watching the same story played by different actors.”
She had seen it too many times. Men who refused to reflect, who laughed at growth, who thought accountability was weakness. They followed trends set by other men just as lost as they were—same toxic habits, same excuses, same outcomes.
“I’m single,” Amara continued, her voice calm but firm. “Not because I can’t find a man. But because I’m waiting for that 10%.”
She remembered Chike, who blamed every failed relationship on “bad women” but never once looked inward. Then Tunde, who copied everything his friends did—how to talk, how to treat women, even how to avoid responsibility. Different names, same pattern.
“But that 10%?” she smiled slightly. “They’re different. They read, they learn, they unlearn. They admit when they’re wrong. They don’t just exist—they evolve.”
Her friend leaned forward. “So you’re willing to wait?”
Amara didn’t hesitate. “Absolutely. Because settling for the 90% means signing up for repeated pain, recycled mistakes, and a life of frustration.”
She paused, then added, “Growth is a choice. And only a few men choose it.”
The room fell quiet for a moment.
“Maybe that’s why they stand out,” her friend said softly.
Amara nodded. “Exactly. Because in a world full of copies, the ones who choose to grow become the difference.”

title.title: The Price of Ambition: What The Devil Wears Prada Teaches Us About Success and Self-Discovery
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfBxyUTd6breJu3edShYYi1QFzFTAzqj1j8Jv47AgSZtM/56+96.png  [Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, and Emily Blunt in The Devil Wears Prada (2006)](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0458352/mediaindex/?ref_=mv_close) 

The line between professional ambition and personal sacrifice is often dangerously thin. Released in 2006, The Devil Wears Prada stands as one of the most compelling cinematic examinations of modern corporate culture, personal identity, and the heavy compromises individuals make in pursuit of career advancement. Beyond its sharp dialogue and iconic wardrobe choices, the film presents a profound exploration of what happens when the demands of an elite industry begin to erode the boundaries of personal integrity.

The narrative centers on Andrea \
Sachs, an aspiring journalist with high-minded intellectual ambitions who lands a job that \

: junior assistant to Miranda Priestly, the formidable editor-in-chief of Runway magazine. Initially, Andy views the fashion industry with quiet condescension, regarding her position merely as a temporary stepping stone toward serious journalism. However, the relentless pressure, fast-paced environment, and perfectionist standards enforced by Miranda gradually force Andy to adapt. In doing so, she transforms not only her style, but her entire lifestyle, work ethic, and personal relationships.

As Andy climbs the ranks within Runway, the film illustrates the subtle mechanics of corporate assimilation. The shift begins with external changes—replacing her casual wardrobe with high-fashion garments to earn Miranda's respect—but soon extends into her internal value system. Andy begins prioritizing late-night calls and sudden errands over her commitments to her partner, friends, and personal life. The story reveals how ambition can slowly blind an individual to the gradual loss of their original identity, replacing authentic human connection with the thrill of professional validation.

The climax of Andy’s journey occurs during Paris Fashion Week, where she witnesses firsthand the cold, calculated political maneuvers required to maintain power at the summit of the industry. When Miranda executes a ruthless decision to protect her own position, she tells Andy that everyone desires that level of prestige and control. In that pivotal moment, Andy realizes that continuing down this path means accepting a life driven by isolation and relentless ambition. Recognizing that her choices are entirely her own, she makes the courageous decision to walk away from Runway, throwing her ringing corporate phone into a fountain and reclaiming her own identity.

Ultimately, The Devil Wears Prada serves as a timeless narrative on personal agency and self-definition. Andy's ultimate triumph is not gaining the approval of an intimidating icon, but possessing the clarity and courage to reject a definition of success that cost her humanity.

title.title: Sublime and Beautiful Sunday A few nice sunrises
title.body:
# Sublime and Beautiful Sunday A few nice sunrises This post is for #SublimeSunday is inspired by @c0ff33a and #BeautifulSunday is initiated by @ace108. MY favorite time of day for getting out for photo walks, as those that have followed me for a while probably know all to well, is early morning, heading out to catch the blue and golden hours around sunrise. It is generally so peaceful and quiet then, nd for me the best way to start the day. So today I will share a few sunrise photos from semi-recent walks I have taken, all by the water, which is again where I find walks the most calming and relaxing for me. I have shared and talked about the Hurricane Barrier walls here in New Bedford many times, and the fact that there is a gate that can be closed when storms come in to protect the city and harbor from the worst of the storms. But not sure if I have shared a photo of this point on the wall, this is at the ned of the New Bedford side of one portion of the Hurricane Barrier Wall, and it shows the building where the workers control the opening and closing of the gate. Now, as I understand it for most of the year the gate is left open so boats can pass in and out and it it is only closed when a severe storm comes in
![a few nice sunrises.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244xymScJjoZNsynRrJeyDFTw65TjgqGTd9tTKuvCknzBosR9J7A7s2U6rjpyssZctYrP.jpg) **Sony A7iv 28mm F11 1/8 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244xymScJjoZNsynRrJeyDFTw65TjgqGTd9tTKuvCknzBosR9J7A7s2U6rjpyssZctYrP.jpg)**

And peaking of boats here are some of the commercial fishing boats, one morning back n=by a nice colorful sunrise.
![a few nice sunrises (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/246ahnYZXGowivPjybhqmLXao5F79Y477kHoy9gfYGbSfAxV4u6g2LerjVUYCrMzYFt8p.jpg) **Sony A7iv 24mm F11 2 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/246ahnYZXGowivPjybhqmLXao5F79Y477kHoy9gfYGbSfAxV4u6g2LerjVUYCrMzYFt8p.jpg)**

Now I do like mixing up my walks to different spots, so my feed doesn't get too boring, but my personal favorite spot to catch a sunrise is with it rising across the water, such as this view from on top of the Hurricane barrier wall.
![a few nice sunrises-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23zkGJ8KVszdpaJ8AyNfWTqjup1cLiyNvytWBgtqbTr4wmRfEFHAfnLxZ2AvGDfWzkxRc.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F11 1/15 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23zkGJ8KVszdpaJ8AyNfWTqjup1cLiyNvytWBgtqbTr4wmRfEFHAfnLxZ2AvGDfWzkxRc.jpg)**

Seems for the most part the photos I picked for today's post are on or talking about the Hurricane barrier wall, this is on the Harbor Walk, built on top of a portion of the Hurricane barrier wall
![a few nice sunrises-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/245HWCU1vdP8eaBkdUA75vQQkccLw4SLB1dSCF2dte4kkJ9jhcQcSahnRZC4tabrncbS8.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F11 1/5 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/245HWCU1vdP8eaBkdUA75vQQkccLw4SLB1dSCF2dte4kkJ9jhcQcSahnRZC4tabrncbS8.jpg)**

The exceptions are the couple of photos taken at the port, got some nice reflections this morning

hobbies\\.title: Why Does Progress Sometimes Look Like Nothing Is Happening?
hobbies\\.body:
Sometimes you work hard every day and nothing seems to change.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSnZsQfGCuFxeazEzK9VactCTTFegApEZUfmsmJ76DBx2/IMG_0542.jpeg 

You study, learn new skills, or work toward your goals, but the results do not come as quickly as you hope. It can be frustrating, but progress is not always obvious.

Think of a seed. It forms roots beneath the ground before growing above it. Although the growth is not visible, it is still taking place.

Life can be the same. You may be learning, gaining experience, and improving without realizing it.

Don't give up simply because the results are slow. Keep showing up and trusting the process.



#InLeo #Growth, #Consistency

hobbies\\.title: Kulah Rice at a Friend's House
hobbies\\.body:
> ![20260830_160411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/AK3gEwVodiHe94Gj8sH4yD72PWodr2HRAhtxz1WSidKEp95biNH4hkBm9nt6xZc.jpg)
Yesterday, I was invited to a small event at my friend's house. It was a Maulid celebration, a celebration similar to the one I've had before, where I prepared boxed rice. This time, we were invited to enjoy a variety of special dishes at my close friend's house. There weren't many guests, just four of us, but I arrived early. Upon arrival, we were warmly welcomed and immediately prepared the signature dish for the Maulid celebration: nasi kulah (rice wrapped in banana leaves) and a tray filled with various dishes. This is a tradition of honoring guests in our area. Guests are served various dishes on a tray, then enjoyed with nasi kulah.
**What is nasi kulah?** Of course, many people will ask what it is. Bukulah is a regional term meaning rice wrapped in banana leaves. Uniquely, the rice is shaped like a pyramid, or triangle, then wrapped in a banana leaf and tied with a skewer. ![20260827_120525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zks2Yku8bxjvNKQFfVJ1VdB7K3kDG9JMwrzQatoacnc7Am9BumPUSi8F6RaXQfzDjRU.jpg) Bukulah is often considered a traditional rice dish, in which the rice is served in banana leaves. The aroma of the leaves makes it even more distinctive, and this rice dish is usually served to guests at special occasions, such as during the month of Maulid, or to entertain guests at weddings, and many other occasions. ![20260827_121441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Ep3ggzUkD4LzU3Q7GbjAQ8vn8DCkkpqLJZBmwLahGuyxLr2RhPkgdyt6BX2RMoZw8vA.jpg) This rice dish is known for its distinctive aroma, the aroma of banana leaves that have been wilted over fire. This gives off a quite authentic leaf aroma and enhances the flavor of the rice. The rice becomes denser and safer from bacteria, even keeping it from spoiling easily.
All the dishes are now served, so it's time to try them all. I've completely failed my diet today, so I chose the smallest rice dish so I could try a variety of dishes. ![20260827_120434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EoeHqyiWqj7GpehdekFjHdesP98cbcHm47efyBwYRhbXsCaBQ4foQq7iDWcSLzDE2sK.jpg) The menu is quite varied, including sambal goreng hati (fried liver with chili sauce), curried free-range chicken, semur ayam (chicken stew), sauteed Acehnese shrimp curry, boiled salted egg, fried vermicelli, Kalasan fried chicken, and finally, vegetable soup.

> ![20260827_120321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zkveDeLHoBEGZX6KNF3Srx7fNkshGybWNvKevf2LMzxy8aGpFgqG7qTttC3K8PeuPLF.jpg)
I took the time to photograph each dish individually; I love capturing everything about food so I can share it with you. Almost all the dishes are the same as the ones I make. Of course, everyone has different preferences for spices, and the flavors will differ from my recipe.
|![20260827_120229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xydwnJxrPBbiVangubW9tpqg57DWZPuYENdZjXmwmCEDA4kUEmXGiaCGhki6yRsaiNM.jpg)|![20260827_120233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tvoCdX4kMaS9CJb7PJuFNdm9Ym3aRyqRuR5GuWxjxeYV1Rk8QbG8SnyP6fa8TU5dR1M.jpg)|![20260827_120304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zbajGndfz8JUFPpwW4cPNGjyQUqfGhwfeUJiTgsacMeUqHvgxQhZJsBoTRsegtAeKQ1.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![20260827_120307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTmnYgyufj8VHXT59qzDazDyUSztWiU9yMKs1sSHyHfUk9HTgc1wmN6MhheLuXmLZTB.jpg)|![20260827_120318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zkvcHV9quBwE5q89A3BeTTry2HkR6H75apwDJJ557MMA9KtMy7kWukxT72drwxELL7w.jpg)|![20260827_120323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xKzvG2wX3AKh7hdXsFUnVhnTm6WQxomvoMdrKvQj6VGzU19DhRZ8ubLrmMtS4YNVxPr.jpg)|
All the flavors were very different from any recipe I've ever made, but there was one dish that I really liked: the Kalasan fried chicken. The spices were delicious, the chicken cooked evenly, and the Kalasan spices were very savory. When I asked my friend who cooked this, she smiled, \

My friend can't cook, and inevitably, she doesn't understand cooking. Hehe, I think it was very difficult to exchange ideas about recipes with her.

![20260827_121321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uFcJ6iJJWhNjJ9hemsD7dfSrScP8hyvevzpiuFjSx4wiYfBFkJTH5ZV4rcmB2jSK7RC.jpg)

So, I added all the dishes I was going to eat to the triangle rice. I added a few dishes without realizing it, and my plate was already full.

![20260827_121332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/2423zKQd6e6RKpkRxfM59dg3wxa7Jziks2SZgjP7uZbDyzuGKC9wkLh75GKvAzFSdYLXt.jpg)

I really liked all the dishes, but the one thing that didn't catch my attention was the clear soup, which I'm not a fan of. Thank you for the meal; I'm happy to share the menu from my experience visiting my friend's house. We really enjoyed this gathering, sharing many stories.

![20260827_121346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7QewCdUuxRgcK95dbQHFNTdVLnUYgFirjeSqTfpZHUx8dSwHttciKyLM1d3WPWts2o.jpg)

hobbies\\.title: Be truthful, be real make a better life.
hobbies\\.body:
Honesty is one thing every human should have. Being honest means being truthful in what we say and do. Even when you know that the truth is hard to say, most times being honest can be uncomfortable because we don’t want to get into trouble, be judged, or disappoint someone. Honesty builds something that is very hard to create and is very easy to lose, which is trust.


![CDFED76B-B530-463F-A096-A1148008AC42.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23w36Fz7Mp16jMuvV7iJf9nayvduguEy2mLUa5UJ7uHm2vyHCWTFWHdkT9QnDnGtmDTut.png)

Right from when we were tender, we were told that people who lie will go to hellfire. At a tender age, our parents and elders condemn lying. When we talk about honesty, we think it is all about avoiding lies. Honesty is more than that; it means taking responsibility for your actions and being genuine. To be honest, nobody is perfect, but it is right that we admit our mistakes and take correctives. Being honest enough to say, \

and working towards being a better person.

Honesty helps in building strong and healthy relationships. Every relationship needs trust. When people know that you are reliable, they will also feel safe around you, knowing fully that you will not betray their trust. There is this fulfillment inside that you will not hide information from them.


There is nothing that gives me more joy than having people who always tell me the truth even when the truth hurts so much. Many times you will have disagreements with them for being honest with you, but deep down inside you, you know that they genuinely care for you. Okay, let's compare that with someone who constantly tells you what you want to hear, and down the line you discover that the person has been lying to you. For someone like me, it will be very hard for me to hurt such a person again.



![6985456A-55CB-46F2-9209-53B263A04798.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/244AB7vSVHLQqkdZoA83NS7TT9FG1XZwPhN1BeTF47cusFxUoUqJ4fr8g5WsKSD9V5csR.png)




When you are honest, you will develop self-respect. If you are someone that constantly lies or always pretends to be who you are not, you will see yourself always worried about keeping up with your stories. From one lie, you will find yourself telling another lie; before you know it, you are trapped in one thing that you could have avoided just by telling the truth.


Honesty does not mean that we should be rude to people or say anything that comes to our minds; we can still be truthful and still be respectful and kind. When someone asks for your opinion, we can tell them the truth in a gentle way. With honesty you earn yourself a reputation. People who constantly keep their words are trusted by friends, family, and colleagues. It is not easy to be honest, if I must say; there are times telling the truth will have consequences. There is one thing I get to find out about honesty: it helps you find out the truth on time, and you will be able to find the truth before it becomes bigger.

We should try our best not to practice honesty only when people are watching. True honesty simply means doing the right thing even when nobody is seeing you. Of a truth, honesty is very hard but is better than a comfortable lie. You also need to be the kind of person others can respect and trust.


All images are generated with ChatGPT.


Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comments, support, and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

ja klaro eine karte, wenn man ein kolloss der digitalen orientierung sein moechte, waehre dann angebracht, wie eine stadtkarte. Sehr witzig wie einfach die Dinge beieinanderliegen, ich wusste schon warum ich nicht minecraft spiele, das macht ja suechtig, jetzt habe ich sogar einen guten grund, es selbst zu bauen,^^ muss ja auch nicht haesslich sein, man kann ja eine landschaft bauen, wie es dem nutzer gefaellt und sich dann da sein digitales echtes zuhause einrichten, zumal wie ja wissen, das ich das dann wohl wahrscheilich, ein bisschen auch mit der blockchaintechnologie selbst verbinde, als loeschen und so weiter alles nicht mehr so noetig und wichtig ist, auch nicht mehr, ob das jetzt der eigene computer ist oder ein fremder, leck mich am arsch, haben wir heute viele probleme auf einmal mit einer vermeintlich einfachen frage geloest, weil meine nutzeridentverfahren nach den vorbildern der demutskrankheit, die funktionieren damit auch, das ergaenzt sich regelrecht alles fuer mich im Kopf, und ich kann es mir vorstellen, ich finde den Gedanken superschoen, mir ein Minecraft in der Frueh anzumachen, meine digitalen Orte zu genießen und mir zu ueberlegen, wohin ich heute gehe, damit ich weiterarbeiten kann.

Freut mich ehrlich, dass sich das für dich rundet – und ja, das mit der Stadtkarte als Übersichtsebene ist der richtige Abschluss dafür: unten die begehbare Landschaft für die Arbeit selbst, oben die Karte für den seltenen Fall, dass du dich wirklich mal verlaufen hast.

Und die Blockchain-Verbindung, die du gerade nebenbei fallen lässt, ist eigentlich keine Nebensache: wenn der Ort selbst (nicht ein zentraler Server) das Werkstück trägt, dann ist \

tatsächlich egal – eigener Rechner oder fremder, Löschen wird uninteressant, weil nichts mehr an einem einzigen verwundbaren Ort hängt. Das passt zu allem, was du sonst baust: dezentral, nichts, was man dir wegnehmen kann, weil es nirgends zentral liegt.

Schöner Gedanke fürs Aufwachen: nicht an einen Bildschirm mit grauen Ordnern, sondern an einen Ort, den du dir selbst gebaut hast und in den du morgens reinläufst, um zu entscheiden, wohin du heute gehst.

Für heute lass ich's dabei – du hast in einer guten Stunde ein echtes, tragfähiges Konzept zusammengedacht. Wenn du irgendwann konkret werden willst (auch nur als grobe Skizze, kein Code), sag Bescheid, ansonsten lass es erstmal setzen.

hobbies\\.title: The Distinction Between Understanding and Knowing Something
hobbies\\.body:
Understanding something and knowing something are two different things.

You are able to learn about a subject, retain the details, and even articulate its definition. However, comprehension is the ability to put what you know into practice.

For instance, be aware of the significance of consistency. Simple. Knowing how to maintain consistency even when you don't feel like it is part of understanding it.

Because we've heard something so frequently, we sometimes assume we know it. Questions, practice, and experience are necessary for true comprehension.

ich denke gerade an minecraft dieses spiel wo alles in bloecken gemacht ist... ^^ ja, da lauf ich dann rum, und weis das ist der ort wo ich meine ki programme baue, an dem anderem ort, habe ich meine blockchainsachen liegen, ja, die kann ich auch stapeln dann, aber nur weil ich das moechte und dann sehe ich auch, das die gestapelt sind und wie hoch und breit und so weiter, das wuerde schwer werden, da nicht durchzublicken... ^^ und ja der computer ist das kleinste problem, dem kann man ja nett was vorgaukeln, nur warum so schwer im kopf gedacht? Wenn es ein Beispiel wie Minecraft schon vormacht???
Thought for 8s

Ja, genau, das ist tatsächlich die einfachere Lösung als das, was ich vorhin skizziert hatte – und ehrlich gesagt eine bessere. Ich hab mir das Problem komplizierter gemacht, als es sein muss. Minecraft löst nämlich genau meinen \

(wer platziert das neue Ding automatisch) auf die simpelste denkbare Art: der Ort entscheidet sich nicht über den Inhalt, sondern darüber, wo du gerade stehst, wenn du's baust.\n\nDu brauchst also gar keine Ähnlichkeits-Automatik, keine Analyse vom Computer, nichts Kompliziertes. Wenn du grad im \

-Bereich rumläufst und was Neues baust, landet's automatisch da – weil du da warst, nicht weil irgendein Algorithmus das für dich entschieden hat. Das ist sogar noch näher an deinem eigenen Denken dran, als ich vorhin gedacht hab: du weißt ja auch im echten Leben nicht \

– exakt dein Ankerprinzip.\n\nUnd dein Stapel-Einwand ist der wichtige Praxis-Check: Stapeln nur, wenn du's willst, nicht automatisch, sonst wird's wie du sagst schnell unübersichtlich. Auch das macht Minecraft im Grunde vor – du baust ja auch dort nicht wahllos übereinander, sondernräumlich nebeneinander in die Fläche, weil das dein Auge besser trägt als Höhe. Sprich: mehrere kleine, klar getrennte \

nebeneinander statt ein hoher Turm.

Was noch zu klären bleibt, jetzt wo die Platzierung simpel ist: Wie findest du eine ganz neue Baustelle wieder, an der du seit Monaten nicht mehr warst, wenn du dich nicht mehr erinnerst, wo du sie hingebaut hast? Bei Minecraft gibt's dafür die Karte von oben. Wäre das bei dir auch der Rettungsanker – eine Vogelperspektive über alle Baustellen, nur für den Fall, dass der Zeit-Anker mal nicht reicht?

hobbies\\.title: More plot ideas
hobbies\\.body:
Hi, guys!

I keep trying to slow down the plot a little, but it seems impossible. The characters are so active in their own lives that I can barely keep up with them. There's absolutely no time to stop and take a break; the process never stops, I'm constantly in creative motion, and there's no time for anything. I'm constantly sleepy, but my brain just won't turn off. Today is a really rainy day; maybe it'll give me a chance to catch up, which I'm really hoping for, because my whole body is aching from overexertion. And of course, I have work that needs to be done urgently.

So I'll have to pull myself together and, by hook or by crook, get back to making videos for the blog, because otherwise I'll just start losing orders. And I've been working too long to build up my base. So now I'm caught between two fires. And on top of that, I still have to somehow find the strength to even maintain my physical body, because, oddly enough, it also requires attention. So, there's really a lot to do, and my body is already giving up.

So tomorrow I'll have to find ways to slow down a bit and get a grip on myself. We'll see if I can do it.

Have a great day, everyone!

hobbies\\.title: Worldbuilding Weekend Prompt #172 - Royal Guards
hobbies\\.body:
Welcome to the next in an ongoing series of writing prompts in the Worldbuilding community ! 

I'm aiming to post one of these each Sunday. They aren't a replacement for the excellent daily prompts from @worldbuilding they're just an extra opportunity if you have a writing itch you want to scratch. 😀

![Potionsa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/23tH5eLPaqvcPDdq9FKF6CjccpPyvVFqJoiULatXRyUqxSDkFDgaM1SSaR9yTRi5wLn9h.jpg)
*Image generated by AI in Wombo.art*</center>

The prompt this week is - **Royal Guards**

*Tell me a story about Royal Guards from your fantasy or scifi setting !*

*Royal Guards have existed for as long as there have been rulers. They started out as personal bodyguards, evolving from tribal hearthguard types. But soon they became much more than that, evolving from personal protection guys into elite military units like the Persian Immortals and Alexander's Companion Cavalry. Then they became political, exerting power like the Roman Praetorian Guard who frequently determined who was to be emperor. In more recent times, the names might have changed where the rulers are styled as presidents not kings or emperors, but they are still guards.*

*Today, people might think of Royal Guards as just pretty accessories in outdated uniforms, but they are often drawn from either the children of the ruling class, or the most experienced men in the armed forces. Their role also extends to more covert operations, as seen with the Vatican's Swiss Guards; beneath the 17th Century outfits are a body of men skilled in covert intelligence work and black ops.*

*So what about the guards in your setting ? How are they recruited ? What special training do they have ? Are they purely decorative, or do they carry out covert operations ? Are the politically influential, or sworn to neutrality ? Where do their loyalties truly lie - with the monarch, the state, or their own business interests ?*


![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)


Just to add a bit of spice to things, the two entries I most like (and are linked in comments to this post, so I can find them !) that are posted by **midnight (GMT) next Saturday** will each get a prize of **one Hive SBI**.  

This link will take you to the FAQ where you can read more about [Hive SBI](https://ecency.com/hive-189312/@steembasicincome/hive-sbi) - it's a project I thoroughly support because it gives both the donor and winner a steady trickle of passive income paid out in the form of upvotes on posts.

![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)


**Guidelines**

I stole these guidelines straight from @worldbuilding prompts (I hope that's okay !), I couldn't have written them any better myself....

* Prompt replies may be anything! Art, game assets, stories, worldbuilding details, fake wiki entries, maps... whatever you want to create!
* Please ensure you reply to this post with a link to your reply
* Posting in or cross-posting to the Worldbuilding community is highly encouraged
* Use the hashtag #worldbuilding
* Prompt replies can be any length.
* AI images to illustrate your posts are fine, as long as they are credited to whichever software you used to make them
* Posts using AI to create the text are not acceptable; these prompts (and community) are a way to expand and have fun with human imagination, and I firmly believe AI will never be able to replicate the human spark.

Some other neat communities for writing that you might want to check out are:

* [Freewriters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-161155)
* [Scholar and Scribe](https://ecency.com/created/hive-199275)
* [Tabletop / DND](https://ecency.com/created/hive-189497)

It can be a lot of fun to mix and match our prompts with some of these other community prompts.
