body.title: Making homemade Ayam Geprek
body.body:
> ![1000716618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ynUodvUhNWcnytVk1LVSe8wRjv73p6JCaHGqDukaB7MG4xgoGoUnuZF8rpmF4pyieJc.jpg) *** *** *** Ayam geprek is a dish of crispy flour chicken that is pounded or crushed together with chili sauce and served directly on a mortar.Usually, when Dad's going out, I buy it from outside. But this time, I had the opportunity to make it myself at home, and I was curious about the recipes. In our place, geprek chicken is very famous everywhere, in fact, I have seen a lot of people selling geprek chicken at a relatively much cheaper price, but the chicken is small and when we have the opportunity or at home, we can eat as much as we want with larger pieces of chicken. ![1000716605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/24241s6Rcy4hUKQqtaw8WoDFzXsR1HN3bEsQLTwSnJJPswqExx2TRbaaZfBNSiXHz1bJ8.jpg) Yes, although I'm actually not very good at frying crispy chicken or battered chicken and I saw this recipe from my social media so I thought this would make it easier for me to make crispy chicken and for the geprek chicken seasoning. As it happens, I already had the ingredients at home—I had a stock of chicken—while for items like chilies, I bought them at the local shop earlier this evening. ![1000716616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKzVinzHoJfuvZ2jdAp9L8QH9dWveU7DNs68hvxhmDwDT86Fd3qT7SKQpWVpHvdxKKb.jpg) Well, instead of continuing to buy fried chicken, it's better if we make it ourselves at home with my version. If you're curious about how I make spicy chili *ayam geprek*, simply follow the step-by-step guide I'm sharing in today's post. *** ###
materials used
### *** ![1000716575.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xemptsjv9rKL8pQwNNTDsFhVuBRSumCXNjtyfoLthhdVZF4g8S7r9qhRZZTbVeZ7mEt.jpg) I used 4 pieces of marinated chicken, some red chilies and some bird's eye chilies for the chilies. Adjust to your taste. I used 3 cloves of garlic for the flour. I used 7 tablespoons of rice flour and 3 tablespoons of cornstarch. For the seasoning, I used Royco salt and ground pepper. Oh yeah, I also use half a teaspoon of soda. *** ###
manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** First, I prepare the flour mixture to marinate the chicken by combining rice flour, cornstarch, Royco, and salt, and mixing them thoroughly. |![1000716576.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wX3GCzHC3HUm5RbArEb8ESGe178VYZdxPFrjPYFFYHMKAUr4YhYyJn25M3ygZceg3YY.jpg)|![1000716577.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yToaHQ4UYSZC3YA63Q7k6xzupgQPSuJ5u9mBKxpueBUEpiaRsNMcDvWteGyAuP5wyG1.jpg) |-|-| |![1000716578.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqtjsM6zTheKPpuzkytH6NV9c9yiXUJGv8NQs8C63bfbnpo5GvUKs45DrKCXD8mmHJU.jpg)|![1000716579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ynagNaezVnTKzRdWfsCHtz6mdq5mcrWgGbDdCuNwF1aTb7Qb374w6QZcJLPekeMphCa.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** Finally, I added the baking soda and stirred everything again until well combined; then, I set that aside, got a bowl of water, and prepared both ingredients. |![1000716580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMWDwBAUUaix3B8UwsDgxuKurwRaJNUjnFM3riw6v9wwayreZ5BFFLgBPMsU73d3Q1g.jpg)|![1000716581.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopsMzc7B5coWC8c1r5hpFvp458b4o6p65XirLxKeyV2TufrE5cBLCEZxcd4WLJCu3B.jpg) |-|-| |![1000716583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc63fdcjwcyUK6E3836JEHqPMjG9G5v5qWUmdWRET3mcJwEmPUN2Gnap4RZaKN9DVT.jpg)|![1000716582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoyNXtoaBNVy1fd9gkuWwbM7GouAtGbzbCcERpfKoxzfK2Gwp5gLit5C8zZuATYc6CU.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** Next, I took one piece of chicken, dipped it in flour, then I dipped it in water for just 1 second, then I took it again, dipped it in flour again and fried it until it was brownish yellow. and I repeat again and so on |![1000716584.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiVJd8k3xgG25YSMC3uhEcjz6ga2atkuatBKQpua6qwCg5YnidD5J6kZUwN5SPQMBz.jpg)|![1000716583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc63fdcjwcyUK6E3836JEHqPMjG9G5v5qWUmdWRET3mcJwEmPUN2Gnap4RZaKN9DVT.jpg)|![1000716585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yd1vSwerznLZ42z97nCAqd2fDc1VG8nxvBqb46tW4cYUNidBkLFzn9kfZHhAwUhXqBW.jpg) |-|-|-| |![1000716586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EokadbFVURpcZYQAWpNd7bWYT7qK9BSYdw8i866qCx6uycDUtzxGNGSuVbYq9bFLYXf.jpg)|![1000716587.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EogLpD6of5Lj3XZusths1xjF7RNipcmGzc6gE4rKcZqKFWsZ3jXuhwYZYqBUapa4qbQ.jpg)|![1000716588.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoni88xPa68m4VMjRa5bLuNmub9ocwNFLhEcpsSySdjr2fDr9jcDzdrwAkbxy5AqVns.jpg) |-|-|-| ***
**Four**
*** Meanwhile, I boil the chilies first until they soften, making them easy to grind later. |![1000716589.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EorypGPafy9Yrn5kzXhQpGhGwT1os1mteUNHBVvqhCo7AonWeMA2oa2idb7jnpi8j5U.jpg)|![1000716591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiUFEPaBLg54DgKBPP9fmesT93MfkRDmWYcivHL2pRm3GgY6QdiiJFwkKExNMwEMD9.jpg) |-|-| |![1000716592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiUGEnHeNL1p9GkVxvxVLPUx9hfqD6zyt7iSQZ3C4qBuFN2dCiMVVthCVw5MLSNgm6.jpg)|![1000716593.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eou8DexBxmiJXouBWQ2LYSqH9vmbzJwFTnWSpRRnF81DeNQzmY6uMGuP6zveBqQhtGb.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Five**
*** I made the seasoning a little rough, don't forget to add salt and a little Royco |![1000716594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EorzoV4X9NPVWXrHpFTn7MA3mLbVmHwFxfr2BzMSH486Br6P1ar76JTqzWqaN1HP5xm.jpg)|![1000716595.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EogMtLoswp8Er931KoaSiCAiwNgvM9aVetQzkZdRNuJa8uKyut76ZqpRWxvzNWYAzgd.jpg) |-|-| |![1000716596.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xyR39fq7kwvAYqr69LdA1pziopEM28ouLV6pPZATQ9DP7SsJNHwzaGKzEj7UDwdmAyE.jpg)|![1000716598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EogKvYDqhmHKe3ECuBUfFNdtPCQmSBBNXGSYTkq1XD6wrukTkfUE8eBtd3DAM2QKnxz.jpg) |-|-| Finally, I heated a little cooking oil and poured it over the chilies. I then took the chicken, placed it in the mortar with the chilies, and smashed it. |![1000716597.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpLfZ7rJ1zNgk27CiWhgvjbz8fACxHBEusMgaL6P7txjeK1ds72tLrgFVd1DwQKcXCv.jpg)|![1000716600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EogMsM8kuHjZS279qEH2hnHsJ8BMcJZH6k3uoXwUdyWtuwUxkvkJpfbvgV9MDweDRuZ.jpg) |-|-| |![1000716601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpXJvBkTNbh4vxSVeoCuB7K68nbUXiQjzBUX8xL58jXf5i3xABAC1mY18yk7Monz7AA.jpg)|![1000716603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpA2XQdzjPt7EKaqzMfFJsfoSUBnVX6DnExgq7chNY7dym6u3b5pdjaHaYsDsmCquSx.jpg) |-|-| *** ###
RESULTS
### *** ![1000716614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23zS3F72RAy1m3uLUh4wWJjRZNfkRET9f4L3cNmzosWuUcwCSPYiiu7n5AeA7RD6RVvfg.jpg) Once it's ready, I serve it right on the mortar, and I find the sambal incredibly spicy. For those of you who love spicy chicken and spicy sambal, this is perfect paired with warm rice—wow, the flavor is just right for me. |![1000716622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep1YR8UnfkK9bRvNQJzBDKovwHQ8MPXX9LoEdnxCqWZF7MtwLtW4xiZcmtfg49zLkwh.jpg)|![1000716621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiY4PZHFmUa6TYagAi4QrggKzANgs6ekMWJ6z7ZangBeaxmszojL1YbAjgzj7VPfDq.jpg)|![1000716620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc9rowAmy3oVAqbe2xpSeVBdqfBaNT267QPmDqshbTQs17L2WAAjoSQsGCCZpiVPeS.jpg) |-|-|-| I immediately took a plate to add rice and I wanted to eat it very greedily. The spiciness was just right, sweet and spicy, and basically it was super delicious. Meanwhile, the chicken was also very crispy and finally I succeeded in making this crispy chicken. ![1000716606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yTjGWp7tcats7rRFUKNUVBHGNWEAX1FzD5PupkqtCyBrcrQk2Gh7yHCCZsPTDVA1vjh.jpg) ![1000716609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep1YMJjVTTW5ZrxEnXA7254orumyWbKEHRPxfJGJTXx2oHBUtiRhW9g7jAFz1YXhbML.jpg) *** *** *** ###
Thank you 🙂🤗

I also like enjoying culinary delights with my little family,Thank you very much for those who have taken the time to read my post this time, I hope this post is a little useful for the readers, and see you in my next post and I also really hope for the support of all friends, so that what we want while we are here we can make it happen</sub>

body.title: AI改变了我们的工作方式
body.body:
几天跟 @lemooljiang 聊天，自然又离不开 AI 这个话题。

聊着聊着，就说到现在人的工作方式，跟以前确实已经很不一样了。

以前人离开电脑、离开办公室，要么就是休息，要么就是下班了。人一走，手头上的工作自然也就暂停了。

而现在呢？

人可能已经不在电脑跟前了，甚至已经下班回家，但 AI 还在那边跑，还在继续工作。

那人空闲出来的这些时间能干什么？

喝喝茶、喝喝咖啡，看会新闻，或闲聊吹水……

甚至像我，有时候快下班了，会特意把一个比较复杂、比较耗时间的任务交给 AI，让它自己慢慢跑。

然后我关电脑下班。

等回到家，再打开远程看一眼，或者直接在手机上看看：

跑到哪一步了？任务完成得怎么样了？

如果一切正常，那这段原本需要自己坐在电脑前等着的时间，就这么省下来了。

这么一想，还真是省心省事。


![001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVNBJskbbUpaxzBpMkG8YWEbM9DSBkmwpcWUDh8ZkpF3q/001.jpg)


不过，AI 干活也不是完全没有烦恼。

其中一个比较明显的问题，就是额度和算力。

比如 Claude 有 5 小时使用额度，一旦额度用得差不多了，就只能等下一轮恢复。

尤其现在用 AI 用习惯了，有时候突然没额度，反而会有一种奇怪的感觉：

离开 AI，怎么好像啥也干不了了？😂

没办法，只好看看新闻、刷刷信息，打发一下时间。

不过像这种情况，也并非没有一些应对的办法。

比如我现在偶尔会用一个小策略。

早晨起床之后，先在 Claude 上随便输入一句话，让这一轮使用窗口先开始计算。

等洗漱、吃早餐、出门，再到办公室，可能已经过去两个小时了。

接下来再集中工作两三个小时。即使这时候刚好碰到额度限制，距离下一轮窗口通常也不会太久。

虽然算不上什么高明的方法，但实际用下来，倒也能让自己的工作时间和 AI 的额度窗口配合得更顺一些。

当然，还有一个更简单的办法：

不要把所有工作都压在一个 AI 身上。

比如我现在比较常用的就有三个：

Claude、Codex 和 Kimi。

三个 AI 交替使用，一方面可以避免某一个 AI 额度耗尽以后，所有工作都跟着停下来；另一方面，我越来越觉得，不同 AI 其实都有自己比较擅长和不太擅长的地方。

有些任务 Claude 做起来顺手，有些交给 Codex 更合适，还有一些事情用 Kimi 反而方便。

所以现在我的习惯，已经不是非得争论“哪个 AI 最厉害”。

而是：

这个任务，交给谁干最合适？

甚至有时候，我会把几个任务同时分出去。

Claude 在这边跑一个，Codex 在另外一边处理另一个，人反而成了最闲的那个。

以前工作的时候，是人在电脑前不停地敲键盘，电脑等着人的指令。

现在慢慢变成了——

人把活安排出去，然后等 AI 干完回来汇报。

这么看下来，AI 真正改变的，可能不只是“一个任务能快多少”。

过去我们管理的是自己的时间，现在开始连 AI 的时间、额度和任务队列也一起管理了。

AI正在改变的，是我们整个工作的方式。

body.title: Trust in God / confía en Dios
body.body:
![470348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/albertocova/23xerBVNyMKSJNixocWcpCuuEeBPDkZNBS8UMCN7W8F78xd3fzbHfiXA6jFfJctaZKdR2.jpg)

Buenos días mis queridos hivers .

Español: Soltar el control y confiar de verdad.

A casi todos nos pasa lo mismo: nos encanta sentir que tenemos el control de nuestra vida. Planificamos, analizamos pros y contras, pensamos en el peor escenario y tratamos de asegurarnos de que nada salga mal. Nos han enseñado a confiar ciegamente en nuestro propio criterio. Por eso, cuando leemos Proverbios 3:5-6, el texto nos choca directamente con la realidad: «Confía en el Señor con todo tu corazón, y no te apoyes en tu propio entendimiento. Reconócelo en todos tus caminos, y Él enderezará tus sendas».

La primera parte nos pide algo difícil: confiar \

. En el día a día, esto significa no guardarte una carta bajo la manga por si las cosas no salen como tú quieres. La fe real no es un plan B ni una red de seguridad para cuando la lógica falla; es decidir apoyarte en Dios antes de tomar cualquier decisión.\n\nLuego viene la advertencia: \

. Ojo, esto no quiere decir que tengamos que apagar el cerebro o dejar de pensar. Lo que advierte el versículo es que nuestra lógica es limitada. Muchas veces tomamos decisiones basados en lo que vemos en el momento, en nuestras emociones o en el miedo, y terminamos metiendo la pata. Apoyarnos únicamente en nuestro criterio es como caminar por un terreno desconocido usando un mapa incompleto.\n\nPor último, la promesa es muy clara: \
implica meterlo en lo cotidiano: el trabajo, las relaciones, los proyectos personales y hasta en los momentos de duda. Y que Él \

no significa que no vaya a haber problemas o baches en el viaje, sino que Dios se encarga de limpiarnos el rumbo para que no nos perdamos ni terminemos en un callejón sin salida. Al final, este pasaje es una invitación a quitarnos la presión de querer resolverlo todo solos y aprender a caminar con tranquilidad.

Gracias por leerme .

English: Letting Go of Control and Truly Trusting.
Good morning, my dear Hivers.

Most of us struggle with the same exact thing: we love being in control. We plan ahead, weigh the pros and cons, prepare for the worst-case scenario, and try to make sure nothing goes wrong. We’ve been raised to rely almost entirely on our own judgment. That's why Proverbs 3:5-6 hits so close to home: \
\n\nThe first line asks for something that’s easier said than done: trust \

In everyday life, this means not keeping a backup plan just in case God doesn't move the way you expected. True trust isn’t a safety net you use only when things fall apart; it’s choosing to rely on God before you even make your first move.\n\nThen comes the warning: \

This doesn't mean we should turn off our brains or stop thinking critically. It simply reminds us that our perspective is limited. We often make choices based on temporary feelings, fear, or partial information, and we end up making mistakes. Relying solely on our own logic is like trying to navigate a new city with an outdated map.\n\nFinally, the passage ends with a practical promise: \
means bringing Him into the everyday stuff—your job, your relationships, your finances, and your quiet doubts. And having Him \

doesn't mean life will suddenly be free of trouble or pain. It means He will clear the way so you don't get lost or end up down a dead-end road. Ultimately, this verse is an invitation to take the pressure off ourselves and stop trying to figure out everything on our own.\n\nThank you for reading me.

body.title: Chocolates Solé. Dark Chocolate Puro ZERO 72% cocoa KETO
body.body:
Chocolates Solé Dark Chocolate Puro ZERO 72% cocoa KETO – czekolada gorzka 72% kakao bez dodatku cukru ze stewią KETO
Producent: Chocolates Solé SA, Barcelona, Hiszpania
Masa netto: 100 gramów
Cena: 16,99 zł, regularna, Rossmann

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQnkYaVNjo9vxADskNEn7xtMe8v3XAkwNAjyTB6kKPm6G/image)

#### Chocolates Solé ZERO KETO z Rossmanna
Miałam już okazję próbować czekolady dostępnej w Rossmannie hiszpańskiej marki Chocolates Solé. Była to [Chocolate Puro 73% cacao de República Dominicana](https://czekolada.blog/chocolates-sole-chocolate-puro-73-cacao-de-republica-dominicana) słodzona syropem z agawy. Jest to czekolada bardzo smaczna, o własnym, ciekawym, ciemnym profilu smakowym, ale również \

– smakowała również domowym testerom.
W niedużym sklepie sieci Rossmann w moim miasteczku wybrana na dziś czekolada nie jest dostępna. Tabliczkę w wersji bezcukrowej zakupiłam w dużym sklepie, w którym dział spożywczy oferuje wszystkie produkty z oferty sieci. Czekolada dostępna jest również w sklepie internetowym.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQma58XtksZZv8EYByauyu7hRaH2dSjtDkUy3VHRrbdVmyq/image)

Czekolada zapakowana jest w papier i dodatkowo w srebrną folię. Styl opakowania jest charakterystyczny dla czekolad eko-bio – prosty, jasny, bez złoceń, tłoczeń i połysków. Informacja na rewersie dla polskich konsumentów jest dodana w postaci naklejki.

#### Skład czekolady Chocolates Solé ZERO KETO
Skład: kakao, substancja słodząca: erytrytol, masło kakaowe, inulina, emulgator: lecytyna słonecznikowa, ekstrakt wanilii, substancja słodząca: glikozydy stewiolowe 0,03%
Masa kakaowa: minimum 72%.

100 gramów tej czekolady ma wartość energetyczną 473 kcal, zawiera 39,1 g tłuszczów, 27,4 węglowoganów (w tym 0,7 g cukrów), 16,9 g błonnika, 9,3 g białka i 0,02 g soli.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXthYSCfKKG4ESUv4VYfwpQ526w8ExX8Mana8aai6HoGD/image)

Skład Chocolates Solé ZERO KETO 72% to świetny produkt w kategorii słodyczy bezcukrowych i dietetycznych. 

Kluczowy atut to erytrytol zamiast maltitolu. Większość  czekolad „bez cukru” bazuje na tańszym maltitolu, który ma stosunkowo wysoki indeks glikemiczny i często wywołuje rewolucje żołądkowe. Erytrytol ma zerowy indeks glikemiczny i zero kalorii, co czyni tę tabliczkę w 100% odpowiednią dla osób na diecie keto oraz diabetyków. Niewielki dodatek stewii ma na celu wygładzenie chłodzącego posmaku, jaki czasem daje sam erytrytol.
Baza to wyłącznie masło kakaowe i miazga kakaowa – zero oleju palmowego czy tłuszczów utwardzanych. Dodatkowo zamiast powszechnej lecytyny sojowej użyto lecytyny słonecznikowej, a zamiast syntetycznej waniliny – prawdziwego ekstraktu z wanilii.
Ciekawy jest dodatek inuliny. Inulina to naturalny błonnik rozpuszczalny (prebiotyk), który nie tylko poprawia teksturę czekolady i dodaje jej aksamitności, ale też podbija zawartość błonnika aż do 16,9 g na 100 g.

Chocolates Solé przyłożyło się również do produktu dla diabetyków. Skład jest dopracowany: bez glutenu, soi, chemicznych zamienników lub dodatków.

#### Recenzja Chocolates Solé ZERO KETO

Czekolada pachnie bardzo ładnie. Jest to ciemny, kakaowy, lekko roślinny, głęboki zapach.
Czekolada jest dość twarda. Łamie się z trzaskiem.

Kawałek czekolady startuje w ustach z lekkim opóźnieniem, a pierwsze wrażenie to delikatna słodycz. Po chwili dołączają lekko taninowe akcenty i nuty kawowo-korzenne, całość ociepla smak waniliowy. Konsystencja nie jest idealnie gładka, co jest typowe dla \

czekolad.  Czuć minimalny chłód erytrytolu, ale w połączeniu ze smakiem kakao, to wrażenie jest bardzo dyskretne. Kompozycja smakowa jest bardzo przyjemna. Na koniec utrzymuje się lekki akcent taninowy, ale łączy się on z bogatym bukietem nut smakowych kakao i wanilii.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRaswzXac3o68TXAQFDq4nXfMhe1YYT6tK6MWEXubiGs/image)

Domowi testerzy byli zadowoleni. Czekolada smakowała wszystkim. Młodszy i starszy z domowych testerów nie zorientowali się, że jest to czekolada bezcukrowa. Uznali, że jest to klasyczna czekolada gorzka o wysokim procencie zawartości kakao. Dodatkowo starszy tester, który w niektórych tabliczkach wyczuwa nielubiany przez niego smak stewii, tu w odpowiednim miksie z erytrytolem nie miał negatywnych wrażeń. Młodsza domowa testerka, która chętnie próbuje produktów tego typu była bardzo zadowolona.

Chocolates Solé ZERO KETO 72% okazała się bardzo dobrym wyrobem w kategorii czekolad funkcjonalnych i bezcukrowych. To dowód na to, że przy starannym doborze słodzików oraz wysokiej jakości surowca kakaowego nie pojawiają się kompromisy smakowe. Głęboki aromat, twarda struktura oraz zbalansowany, wytrawny profil z nutami kawy, korzeni i ciepłej wanilii składają się na przemiłe wrażenia degustacyjne.
Miks erytrytolu ze stewią okazał się naprawdę udany. Charakterystyczny dla erytrytolu chłodzący akcent został zminimalizowany do bardzo dyskretnego tła, a nielubiany przez wielu posmak stewii jest niewyczuwalny.

Dla kogo ta tabliczka będzie dorym wyborem?
Dla osób na dietach Keto, Low-Carb oraz dla diabetyków. Zaledwie 0,7 g cukrów prostych, zerowy indeks glikemiczny erytrytolu i aż 16,9 g błonnika czynią z tej tabliczki wzorcowy, bezpieczny deser, który nie podbija glukozy ani insuliny.
Dla miłośników czystych etykiet (clean label). Każdy, kto unika kontrowersyjnego maltitolu, oleju palmowego, lecytyny sojowej czy syntetycznej waniliny, odnajdzie tu wzorcowo czysty skład.
Dla fanów klasycznych, wyrazistych czekolad deserowych (70%+). Jeśli szukacie wytrawnego, lekko taninowego i bogatego smakowo kakao bez ulepkowatej słodyczy, ta tabliczka zachwyci Was swoim bogatym bukietem, bez zdradzania, że powstała bez użycia grama tradycyjnego cukru.

Kolejna bardzo dobra czekolada, warto spróbować.

body.title: 當然可以！以下是一個關於自然的部
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g323d0f7d10b1bc01e34d6df6442de98cf69d38234d7ae75afb99c35803060906c8b514d3909527be544577422244bfa1184312bb6b7fc2e6bd825bd5fd493faa_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 當然可以！自然的美麗

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它不僅提供了生命所需的資源，還以其獨特的美麗和多樣性吸引著我們。以下是一些關於自然的精彩部分：

## 1. 自然的奇觀

- **山脈**：巍峨的山脈不僅是地球的脊樑，也是許多生態系統的家園。
- **海洋**：廣闊的海洋涵蓋了地球表面的70%，是無數生物的棲息地。
- **森林**：茂密的森林是地球的肺，提供氧氣並吸收二氧化碳。

## 2. 自然的多樣性

- **動物王國**：地球上生活著數以百萬計的動物，每一種都有其獨特的特徵和適應能力。
- **植物世界**：從高大的紅杉樹到微小的苔蘚，植物以其多樣性為地球增添了色彩和生命。

## 3. 自然的變遷

- **季節的變化**：春夏秋冬的更替讓我們感受到自然的循環與變化，這些變化影響著生態系統的平衡。
- **氣候變遷**：隨著全球氣候變遷的加劇，自然環境面臨著前所未有的挑戰，這需要我們共同努力來保護。

## 4. 自然的靈感

- **藝術與文學**：許多藝術作品和文學作品都受到自然的啟發，展現出自然的壯麗與神秘。
- **心靈的療癒**：自然的美景能夠幫助我們放鬆心情，減輕壓力，增強幸福感。

## 結語

自然是人類生活的重要組成部分，我們應該珍惜和保護這一份美麗。讓我們一起努力，讓未來的世代也能欣賞到這份自然的奇妙！

***

What a wonderful hobby! It’s true that not only can you learn a great deal from this activity, but it can also be very relaxing. It’s certainly true that it requires a great deal of patience and is best enjoyed in places far from the city, such as the countryside or the mountains. I’ve rarely had the chance to do it, but when I have, it’s been marvellous. If there weren’t so much light pollution, the world would see some truly marvellous sights.

It’s also true what you say about protecting your eyes during an eclipse; I read reports that many people suffered irreversible damage to their eyes because they didn’t use the right protection. It must have been a spectacular sight, absolutely magnificent!! Thank you so much for the invitation; I took part at the start of the month, but it’s great to see more people getting involved. Thank you very much again and a big hug!🤗

>Que maravilloso hobby! Es verdad no sólo se puede aprender mucho de esta actividad sino también puede producir relajación. Si es verdad que es algo que lleva mucha paciencia y es mucho mejor en lugares alejados de la ciudad, como los campos o las montañas. Pocas veces tuve esa oportunidad, pero cuando lo he visto es maravilloso. Si no hubiera tanta contaminación lumínica el mundo vería maravillas. 

>También es verdad lo que mencionas sobre la protección de los ojos ante un eclipse, leí noticias que muchas personas vieron afectados sus ojos irreversiblemente por no usar la protección adecuada. Debió ser un gran espectáculo, grandioso!! Muchas gracias por la invitación, ya he participado a principios de mes, pero es genial ver más participaciones. Muchas gracias nuevamente y un gran abrazo!🤗

body.title: Warum ich keine \
mit meiner Delegation an die FDP machen kann und warum ich jetzt erst davon schreibe.
body.body:
Ich habe einer aus Mitleid fuer diese Person nicht namentlich naeher genannte FDP Parteiangehoerige mit niedrigem aber nicht unbekanntem Bekanntheitsgrad angeschrieben vor etwa drei Monaten.

In der Nachricht, die kann ich auch veroeffentlichen, wuerde dann aber umso schlimmer werden fuer die FDP, habe ich klargemacht, wer ich bin, was ich will und warum ich ueberhaupt schreibe.

Das man hier eine Gelegenheit finden wird, mich als Erst und Letztwaehler zu gewinnen.

Das ich nicht mit dem Parteiprogramm der FDP einhergehe, sondern ein bisschen Zeit zum Arbeiten brauche und die Bedeutung der ehemals großen FDP damit Unterstuetzen moechte, die Mitte der Gesellschaft abzubilden.

Aber das wurde alles nicht beantwortet, was mir sagt, das man keine Waehlerstimmen braucht, in einem goldenem Palast der Phantasie wohnt und sich wahrscheinlich, fuer was Besseres haelt, als der Rest.

Ich habe die Person regelrecht ausgewaehlt, und mich entschlossen, falls sie den Versuch ueberhaupt unternimmt, sei es noch so Trocken, zu Antworten, die FDP zu waehlen.

Oder eben nicht, wenn keine Antwort kommt.

So nach drei Monaten, fast drei Monaten, kann ich sagen, es kommt keine Antwort und keine Antwort, ist auch eine Antwort.

Deswegen ist die FDP Unwaehlbar fuer mich, so wie alle anderen Parteien auch, und deswegen, werde ich meine Stimme in unserer wundervollen Demokratie behalten und weiterhin, selbst einsetzen.

Die Gesellschaftliche Mitte kann sich derweile ueberlegen, mich als Voridioten zu nutzen, wenn sie bei Verstand geblieben ist und sich endlich mal Traut, den Mund aufzumachen.

Links und Rechts, Oben und Unten, muessen mal wieder brav abgewatscht werden wenn ihr mich fragt. Die Spinnen naemlich, die Roemer! ;-)

Salve

Sascha Pürner

body.title: !DIY Kawaii animated version of the Holozing creature Cinella, made with foam clay. (Tutorial) [ENG] [ESP]
body.body:
> Hello!! Good evening, #Holozing community, video game lovers, and Web3 gaming enthusiasts! Today I'm going to show you how to make the creature Cinella using foam clay, but this time in an animated kawaii version designed by me. I hope you all really like this creation—the entire community in general—and I'm super happy to present my experience with this flexible material. Come along with me! Next, I'll show you step by step how I made my work. To start, I'll mention all the materials used:
Hola!! Buenas Noches comunidad #Holozing, amantes de los videojuegos y juegos Web3, el día de hoy les enseñaré a realizar con foami moldeable (foam clay) a la criatura Cinella, pero esta vez en una versión kawaii animada diseñada por mí. Espero les guste mucho la creación, a toda comunidad en general y yo súper contento en presentarles mi experiencia con este material flexible. ¡Acompáñame! A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

>

Reference Image taken from @holozing / Imagen de Referencia tomada de @holozing.

> Cinella is an insect-type creature from the game Holozing, designed as an adorable red ladybug. It is known for its speed and its ability to slow down opponents while reducing their chance of landing hits. The inspiration for this project came thanks to @dayadam's recent post dedicated to this insect, which motivated me to create a cute animated piece for the community.
Cinella es una criatura tipo insecto del juego Holozing, con el diseño de una mariquita roja adorable . Es conocida por su velocidad y habilidad para ralentizar a los oponentes y reducir su probabilidad de acertar golpes . La inspiración para este proyecto llegó gracias al post reciente de @dayadam dedicado al insecto, que me motivó a crear un animado tierno para la comunidad.
https://ecency.com/@holozing/new-creatures-zingtober-event-finished-alpha-vials

Materiales / Materials

  • Foami moldeable Blanco / White foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Negro / Black foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Rojo / Red foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Beige / Beige foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Verde / Green foam clay
  • Herramientas para pasta foami / Kit of foami

>

STEP / PASO 1

In the initial phase, I start by taking a portion beige and black color clay to create the body of our cute character. Then, with my hands, I shape it into a ball, giving it a smooth and playful finish.
En la fase inicial, comienzo tomando una porción de arcilla en color beige y negro para realizar el cuerpo del animado. Luego, con las manos moldeó en forma de bola, dándoles una terminación curiosa.

>

STEP / PASO 2

Next, I develop the kawaii body parts of the creature: its head, hair, ladybug antennae, flower-shaped dress, legs, and arms—always giving it my very best.
Seguidamente, desarrollo las piezas del cuerpo Kawaii en la criatura, su cabeza, el cabello, sus antenas de mariquita, su vestido de flor, sus patas y manos, siempre dando lo mejor de mi.

>

STEP / PASO 3

Finally, I make its eyes, wings, the four-leaf clover, and some final touches on its face, also using green, red, black, and white for the highlights. This design is a bit more complex, since the parts are smaller when it comes to molding.
Ya por último, realizamos sus ojos, las alas, el trébol de cuatro hojas y retoques finales en su cara, utilizando también el color verde, rojo, negro y blanco para el brillo. Este diseño es un poco más complejo, pues son más pequeñas las partes a la hora de moldear.

>

Final result / Resultado final

It should be noted that this design was sought in the Holozing community; but the realization are made by me, with dedication to look more beautiful in the home or bedroom, I will return with new ideas to share with you, see you soon and excellent week.
Cabe destacar que este diseño fue buscado en la comunidad de Holozing; pero la realización son hechos por mí, con dedicación para que luzcan mas bonitos en el hogar o dormitorio, volveré con nuevas ideas para compartir con vosotros, nos vemos pronto y excelente semana.

>
If you liked it, don't forget to leave a comment and follow me for future posts. I'd love to know your opinion and ideas for the next one. Regards
Si te ha gustado, no olvides dejar tu comentario y seguirme para próximas publicaciones. Me encantaría saber tu opinión e ideas para el siguiente. Saludos

body.title: Як швидко згадати хімію перед 1 вересня: ТОП-книги та лайфхаки для студентів і школярів
body.body:
>Знаєте цей специфічний запах кінця серпня? Суміш розпеченого асфальту, першого сухого листя і ледь помітного, але чіткого тривожного трепету в повітрі. До 1 вересня залишаються лічені дні, і неважливо, чи ви першокурсник, який щойно вирвався зі шкільної лави, чи викладач, якому за тиждень стояти перед аудиторією — відчуття підвішеного стану знайоме кожному. Ти дивишся на свій робочий стіл, де серед кавових чашок і літніх нотаток лежить уявна хімічна формула, і розумієш: пам'ять за літо перетворилася на чистий аркуш. Знайомо? О, я пройшов через це десятки разів.

\n\n

>Щороку наприкінці серпня в мене виникає одне й те саме бажання — зібрати докупи розплавлені літом мізки і повернути їм колишню гостроту. Але давайте чесно: гортати сотні сторінок сухого фоліанта в останній тиждень — це шлях до гарантованого неврозу. Потрібен не просто підручник, а точний інструмент, який спрацює як хімічний каталізатор.
>Коли до мене звертаються студенти із розпачливим запитанням: \

, я завжди запитую про метамелі. Якщо вам потрібно освіжити фундаментальний університетський рівень і згадати, чому бензольне кільце поводиться саме так, а не інакше, вам потрібна справжня важка артилерія, але викладена людською мовою.

>Першим у моєму особистому топі університетських підручників завжди стоїть «Органічна хімія» авторів В. П. Черних, Б. С. Зіменковського та І. С. Гриценка. Це, без перебільшення, класика, яка рятувала не одне покоління студентів. Що мені в ній подобається — це абсолютно залізна логіка. Автори не просто висипають на вас оберемок фактів, вони показують прямий зв'язок між будовою молекули та її реакційною здатністю. Коли ви розумієте цей принцип, вам більше не треба зубрити сотні реакцій поспіль — ви починаєте їх відчувати. Для швидкого експрес-повторення перед першою лекцією це просто ідеальний вибір.

>Якщо ж ви навчаєтеся на хіміко-технологічному напрямі чи біотехнологіях, зверніть увагу на праці львівської школи. «Органічна хімія» С. А. Воронова, В. А. Дончака та А. М. Когута, випущена видавництвом «Львівська політехніка», має дуже свіжий, сучасний погляд на матеріал. Вона написана саме так, як сприймає інформацію сучасний студент — стисло, суттєво та із чітким практичним ухилом.

>А для тих, хто прагне зануритися в саму суть електронів та орбіталей, існує двотомник О. В. Авілової та В. І. Лупандіна. Це фундаментальна база. Якщо за літо з голови вивітрилися поняття стереохімії або класичні названі реакції, розгортайте саме їх. Вони розкладають по поличках електронну будову сполук так детально, що після кількох вечорів читання ви знову почнете бачити просторові конфігурації уві сні.

>Звісно, органіка не існує у вакуумі. Якщо ви відчуваєте, що просіли самі основи — термодинаміка, кінетика, розчини чи хімічний зв'язок — не соромтеся повертатися до першоджерел. «Загальна та неорганічна хімія» А. М. Голуба — це фундаментальна книга, яка дає міцний фундамент. Без розуміння фізико-хімічних законів, викладених Голубом, будь-яка спроба осягнути складний органічний синтез буде нагадувати будівництво замку на піску.

\n\n

>Але що робити, якщо вам потрібно не занурюватися в університетські глибини, а швидко залатати діри в шкільній базі чи підготуватися до складання НМТ? Тут діють зовсім інші закони. В умовах дефіциту часу довгі описові тексти — ваш ворог. Вам потрібні витискачі сенсу.

>У цій категорії є свій беззаперечний бестселер, про який знає кожен, хто хоч раз відкривав програму підготовки до іспитів — «Хімія. Комплексне видання для підготовки до ЗНО/НМТ» Анатолія Березана. Це справжній мастхев для експрес-реанімації знань. Його головна фішка — опорні схеми, таблиці та алгоритми. Жодної води. Бачите формулу, бачите алгоритм розв'язання, бачите приклад. Якщо вам треба за два дні згадати всі основні класи сполук, стехіометрію та номенклатуру, кращого тренажера не знайти.

>Ще один чудовий помічник — «Хімія: Довідник школяра та абітурієнта» О. Г. Ярошенко. Це компактний, дуже добре структурований довідник, який зручно тримати під рукою. Його краса в тому, що він покриває весь шкільний курс — від елементарної неорганіки до базової органіки. Якщо під час вирішення задачі ви раптово забули конкретну якісну реакцію або формулу кислоти, ви відкриваєте Ярошенко і знаходите це за три секунди.
>Проте зауважу одну важливу річ, яку я зрозумів на власному досвіді: пасивне читання теорії дає ілюзію знання. Ви гортаєте сторінку, дивитеся на знайому схему і думаєте: \
. Але варто закрити книжку й взяти чистий аркуш, як упевненість випаровується.

>Саме тому третім обов'язковим елементом підготовки є практика. Для відновлення обчислювальних навичок і вміння бачити логіку задач візьміть «Збірник задач і вправ з хімії» того ж Анатолія Березана. А якщо ви готуєтеся до серйозніших викликів у ЗВО, шукайте навчальні посібники та збірники задач, випущені профільними кафедрами КНУ ім. Тараса Шевченка, ЛНУ ім. Івана Франка або КПІ. Це специфічна, але дуже якісна школа, яка швидко вчить мислити не шаблонами, а глибинними механізмами.

>Тож як побудувати свій останній тиждень перед навчанням, щоб не перегоріти ще до початку вересня? Мій особистий алгоритм дуже простий. Забудьте про спроби прочитати все від палітурки до палітурки. Використовуйте довідники як інструмент точкового удару: відкрили схеми, освіжили ключові поняття, проглянули базові механізми — нуклеофільне й електрофільне заміщення, приєднання, елімінування. Згадали номенклатуру IUPAC, розв'язали п'ять-сім різнотипних задач для розминки пальців — і досить.

>Головне завдання зараз — не вивчити все заново, а дати мозку сигнал, що літній відпочинок завершено і час повертатися в робочий тонус. Навчання — це не спринт, це марафон, і входити в нього треба з холодною головою та свіжим інтересом.
>А як ви зазвичай реанімуєте свої знання перед новим навчальним роком? Віддаєте перевагу старим перевіреним підручникам чи шукаєте нові інтерактивні конспекти?

body.title: The New Era of Crypto Contributions Links Noize With Onchain Activity
body.body:
Crypto has a funny way of rewarding the person who makes the most noise rather than the person who creates the most value. Every day, timelines are flooded with recycled narratives and engagement bait!

I am tired of endless bullish posts and people competing to see who can mention the same project in the most creative way possible. The result is a massive amount of content but very little quality! 

That is why the question I keep coming back to is simple: what is the difference between quality on social media and just noise? Most crypto communities are incredibly good at creating noise.

We can turn a single announcement into hundreds of posts, memes and hot takes within minutes, but once the algorithm moves on, most of that content disappears into the timeline in short time.

Attention is temporary, while a genuinely useful contribution can continue helping people long after the original post has been forgotten. This is what makes GenLayer particularly interesting to me.

The GenLayer Portal gives contributors somewhere their work can actually become part of the ecosystem rather than disappearing into a random Discord thread or getting buried beneath the next wave of crypto farming.

The Portal brings together The Compass, the Manifesto and the whitepaper, giving people a starting point for understanding what GenLayer is building and why it matters. The bigger reason is the contribution system itself.

There are more than 50 contribution types, creating opportunities for people to contribute in very different ways, from writing tutorials, hosting meetups, creating educational content, or building Intelligent Contracts. 

Your contribution does not have to look like everyone else's, and that is important because ecosystems become stronger when they recognise different types of work rather than rewarding only whoever can post the fastest.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRiZoRjVCqb8tXcWKszWVSc2aH2VYbZneZk2tXkinK9kz/image.png)


Instead of constantly asking yourself what you can post today to get another few minutes of attention, you can start thinking about what you can create that somebody else will actually find useful tomorrow.

A tutorial can help a new developer get started, an educational thread can make a complicated concept understandable, and a meetup can bring people into the ecosystem who eventually become builders themselves.

That is a much more interesting definition of content creation. This creates a completely different relationship between creators and crypto projects. Your social media post becomes the doorway, rather than the destination.

When contributions can be reviewed by stewards and tracked through a public leaderboard, your work has somewhere to live beyond the lifespan of a single post. Instead of disappearing into the timeline, it becomes part of your visible history within the ecosystem.

The contribution system also introduces something that crypto desperately needs: a record of the work people actually do. You are no longer just farming impressions; you are building a reputation around what you actually contribute.

For content creators, this could represent a new era where the goal is not simply to become louder, but to become more useful. The best creators will not necessarily be the people who produce the highest number of posts. 

As AI agents begin interacting, negotiating and making decisions, there will be situations where deterministic code alone cannot resolve questions involving interpretation, evidence or judgment.

GenLayer is building around that idea, and educating people about why this matters is itself a meaningful contribution. Noise tells people that something is happening. Quality helps them understand why it matters and what they can do about it.

You can start with The Compass to understand the bigger vision, explore the Manifesto and whitepaper to go deeper, and then look at the different contribution paths to figure out where your own skills can actually add value.

That makes the Portal more than another destination for information. It becomes a place where curiosity can turn into participation and participation can turn into a visible contribution to the ecosystem.

Crypto has spent years obsessing over followers, impressions and engagement numbers, but those metrics only tell part of the story. The more interesting metric is what happened because someone paid attention.

Did they learn something? Did they build something? Did they join the ecosystem? Did they contribute? Did your content help someone take the next step? That is the kind of attention that compounds.

So yes, keep posting, keep creating, keep memeing and keep being terminally online if that is your thing. Just remember that there is a difference between filling the timeline and leaving something behind.

Don't let a crackhead work harder than you. Make your content count, turn attention into contribution and make your contribution part of the record. Make it happen anon... don't let a crackhead try harder than you!


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmajRyXG9DqyqcuGAJBy2K2CQ2ovqx5YYRkEub6t6MWqDm/image.png)

body.title: 小菜园的蔬菜到了尾季
body.body:
![mmexport1788078208695-b51c06d55815.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/tingjie/lkt-mtfjomau-94x1of3t/mmexport1788078208695-b51c06d55815.webp)

![mmexport1788078190527-979c1be5158e.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/tingjie/lkt-mtfjomau-94x1of3t/mmexport1788078190527-979c1be5158e.webp)

由于小菜园这边的路比较低洼，我都好久没过来了。。后来几次过来，回去时衣服鞋子都要洗一遍，我也不想特意买双雨鞋，索性就不来了，让我爸一个人管理了。唯一放不下的就是我种的紫苏，一段时间没摘，怕是要疯长了！今天早上就计划下午要到小菜园看看，鞋子上套两个袋子好了。

谁知下午突然来了场倾盆大雨🌧️把我一个夏天晒的茄干浇了一个透🙄白忙活一场。茄干特别难晒（可能是我晾晒的那个地方太阳不是特别充足）前两天看太阳好，晒莲子时又把茄干挂出去了，想着晚上在去收回来，下午就下雨，想收也赶不及。

下雨也没能阻止我要来小菜园的心，雨停我就出发了。好久不来 小菜园被我爸整的空旷了，番茄，黄瓜，南瓜，豆角，茄子这些全部清除了。还剩两棵白玉脂辣椒🌶️和几棵大辣椒，辣椒也挂了一些，因为上次大雨后，第二天就大太阳，这种天气它们就比较容易挂。园子里生命力最强的怕只有紫苏了吧！长势真好，还好只有几颗，太多收起来都要发愁了😂

还剩下第二次种的豆角，这个豆角品种可比第一次种的好吃太多，不知道是不是种的晚的原因，种上后也没给肥，长得特别好 还不招虫，豆角结的还可长了。之前买菜时我还买了两棵爬菜苗（我这里叫它爬菜，有的叫猫耳菜）大概是它太能爬高了吧哈哈～大家都不喜欢吃这个菜，所以就买了两棵，后来不知啥原因就剩下一颗了。它顺着豆角架爬的可凶了，最近没啥当季叶菜吃，偶尔吃下它 好过没有咯～

又摘了满满一袋，辣椒，爬菜，豆角，紫苏和小葱，紫苏头全部掐了一遍，最后一次摘了，静等它长种子了，豆包说我这里天气要到九月底才能长出种子。

路上看到一个要强的冬瓜😄

This is a live experience that people who previously doubted they could create using AI (the irony in my post AGAIN...) have now successfully said, NOP! I CAN!

And for all that, @shiftrox just had to try! The work is visible in the number of users he attracted to the game, and the evolution over time also showed lots of learned steps.

Feedback consumption and his persistence here (I would say) were the most HIVE blooded atitudes I can commend to anyone jumping into this kind of world (developing products on Hive). I think it just pays off to be building on top of the Hive community, and then, if successful, it will only tag along more people outside of Hive (because people eventually share stuff).

So, this model is a win-win by default.

Yes, still lots in flight like all the games above, but this is how active development and participation on Hive works, and vs many other chains, a unique possible thing with very little to no costs (discarding the AI part, which will be on you, LOL).

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos / Volver de la Muerte
body.body:
Returning from death is not waking from a dream. It is opening your eyes after being devoured by darkness, and discovering that the light still exists, but it is no longer the same. It is like being reborn in a body that remembers having died, with a soul marked by a silence that is not found in this world.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXss6ckT2avgXfTkbrPakAbM6VchM4ukAwxJo1QU4v1Tf/death_valley_4250244_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2019/06/03/23/37/death-valley-4250244_1280.jpg)



When I was on the other side, I knew that death is not the end, but the dissolution of noise. There was no time there, no pain, no questions. Only a peace so immense it suffocated, a stillness that was everything and nothing at once. And then, without warning, the heartbeat returned. First as a distant echo, then as an insistent drum that tore me from nothingness.

The return hurts. It hurts because the colors are too bright, the sounds too loud, and people talk about things that no longer matter. I have seen the face of eternity, and now the world seems to me a tiny stage where everyone is playing the same role. Every sunset hurts like a farewell, because I know what it's like to be on the side where the sun never sets.

Returning from death is learning to inhabit a body that no longer entirely belongs to me. I walk among you, but a part of me remained there, in that place where boundaries blur and the soul finally rests. I have seen the end and returned to tell you there is nothing to fear, but also to warn you that life, true life, slips through our fingers like water.

Now I know that living is an act of courage. That every breath is a miracle we don't deserve, and that love is the only trace we leave before we disappear. I returned to remind you that death is not an enemy, but a teacher. And that, in the end, we will all return to that silence from which we once emerged.

Credits: I used the DeepL Translate translator.

body.title: Not Everyone Has to Understand Me
body.body:
These days, I find myself choosing peace more than I choose people’s understanding. I used to care a lot about what people thought. If I made a decision someone didn’t understand, I felt the need to explain myself. If I turned down an invitation, I would start wondering if they were offended. Even when I needed some time alone, I felt like I had to give people a reason for it.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcuMmUZfeNtdcqwkqbom3Qfq3MMfVi9nEYLQGgYCu43Ds/1000266689.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/girl-boat-ocean-vacation-kid-3555716/)

But I’m slowly getting tired of all that, not because I don’t care about people anymore. I do, I just don’t think I should have to keep exhausting myself to prove that I care.

Life has a funny way of teaching you what really matters. Sometimes, you go through a period where you simply don’t have the energy for unnecessary conversations, forced friendships, constant explanations, or being everywhere just because people expect you to be there.

And honestly, there is nothing wrong with that.

I have started paying more attention to how certain people and situations make me feel. Some conversations leave me smiling. Others leave me completely drained. Some people make me feel comfortable enough to be myself, while others make me question every little thing I say.

I think that difference matters.

These days, I’m trying to be more intentional about where I put my time and energy. I don’t want a huge circle just for the sake of saying I have one. I would rather have a few genuine people around me than constantly be surrounded by people I cannot truly be myself with.

Sometimes I just don’t feel like going out. Sometimes I need to stay home. Sometimes I don’t have the capacity to keep a conversation going. Sometimes I need to take a step back from certain people without turning it into a big argument or dramatic ending.

And I’m learning not to feel guilty about that. There are things about my life that people may never understand, and I’m becoming okay with that.

Not everyone has to agree with my choices. Not everyone has to know why I made them. Not everyone has to be happy with the boundaries I set.

At some point, you realize that constantly trying to be understood can become another form of losing yourself. So I’m choosing differently now.

I’m choosing the quiet days. I’m choosing honest friendships, I’m choosing rest when I need it, I’m choosing to protect my peace without feeling the need to announce it to everyone. I’m not trying to shut people out, I’m just trying to make room for myself too.

Maybe growing up is partly about realizing that you don’t have to respond to everything, attend everything, explain everything, or hold on to everyone.

Some things can simply be left alone, and some people can be loved from a distance. Right now, I’m more interested in building a life that feels peaceful and genuine than one that looks good to everyone else. I may not always get it right, but at least I’m learning to listen to myself.






**Thank for checking on my post and have a wonderful day**


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@leemah1/not-everyone-has-to-understand-me-bnx)

body.title: ‎Protect Your Peace: Not Every Battle Deserves Your Reaction
body.body:
‎Hello Hives,
‎
‎One thing life has taught me is that not everything deserves an immediate response. Sometimes, people will say things that annoy you, challenge your patience, or make you feel like you need to defend yourself immediately. But honestly, learning to stay calm in those moments can save you from making decisions you will later regret because I have been there before.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbxgfnDsK4P8ftrQyVATXxfXDuLN994HfhsppfG3CDmRC/avi_acl-morning-2243465_1920.jpg 

‎[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/morning-sunrise-woman-silhouette-2243465/)
‎
‎There are times when someone says something hurtful, and the first thing that comes to mind is to reply immediately. You want them to know how you feel. You want to prove your point. You want to make sure they don't think you are weak. But reacting while you are angry can make a small situation much bigger than it needs to be.
‎
‎That is why I believe we should learn to prioritize our peace.
‎
‎Being calm does not mean you are weak. It does not mean you cannot stand up for yourself. Sometimes, staying quiet is simply choosing not to allow another person's behaviour to control your emotions.
‎
‎I have learned that it is okay to step away from a situation for a few hours or even a few days. Give yourself time to think. Let the anger settle. Look at the situation again when your mind is clearer. You may discover that what felt like a huge problem in the heat of the moment does not deserve the energy you were about to give it.
‎
‎Emotional intelligence is not about pretending that everything is fine. It is about understanding what you are feeling and knowing how to handle those feelings without allowing them to make decisions for you.
‎
‎Sometimes, the best response is not the fastest response.
‎
‎Before you send that angry message, take a breath. Before you say something you cannot take back, give yourself some time. Before you make a decision because you are hurt, allow yourself to calm down.
‎
‎Peace is valuable. Your mental space is valuable. Your relationships, reputation, and future decisions are valuable too.
‎
‎Not every argument needs a winner. Not every accusation needs an explanation. Not every person deserves access to your emotions.
‎
‎As we grow, we should learn to choose our battles wisely. Protect your peace, control your reactions, and give yourself enough time to think before responding.
‎
‎Sometimes, the strongest thing you can do is pause.
‎When your mind is calm, you see things differently—and you are more likely to make choices you will be proud of later.
‎
‎**Thanks for Reading**
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

#### [[Movie] For Night Will Come (En attendant la nuit)](https://ecency.com/@jcrodriguez/for-night-will-come-en-attendant-la-nuit-mte98v7c) by @jcrodriguez

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ourpick/23yTS3pRRKPMdBkxo8Bzq7QCwd7xuE5f6xsmx6zScmhHLsBqdrFkNgLWT3tBuGyZr4cYz.png)

> *What an interesting film, especially as the director is portraying part of her own life and her brother’s experiences there, even though the genre is a blend of horror, science fiction and romance. It’s a really good combination, by the way. I really like it when horror has that romantic touch. But the film also addresses teenagers’ need for acceptance, which is a very topical issue, although not in quite the same way as the film portrays it, so it conveys a powerful message about today’s society.
I’m not really keen on overly commercial films either; they don’t convey any message, whereas European cinema is much better.*

<center>
![LEN Divider - Pick2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptofiloz/23vhKckUthotT4G75iuSazJXjJYtZZpUqAkYAj8TuSYAwpQcsTBJZxGeMRLm3XYNiVnZ2.png)
</center>

#### [The Peel Mortuary Chapel . Overton.](https://ecency.com/@grindle/the-peel-mortuary-chapel--overton) by @grindle

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ourpick/23u5xwxD55YTjHasTBqDQ2RNxGFqvJb12stnoxwAjmzZKvE5HeeJxLntBBU1Wor8JEktH.png)

> *You’ve no idea how much I love and am fascinated by cemeteries, especially if they’re old, and I find this place you’ve shown us absolutely captivating: from the original entrance gate, which is so beautiful, to the funeral chapel, as well as every gravestone entwined with the vegetation and the stories that lie there. People in those days died very young; many diseases were unknown and so went untreated, and often no one knew what people were dying of. And that place is ideal for mystery stories. I love details like that bunch of grapes on one of the gravestones… and the ‘nocturnal poet’, it can blend both horror and romanticism.*

<center>
![LEN Divider - Pick3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptofiloz/23vhKckUthotT4G74RAZkFg39g7xkai4vXWirc1vVhf9g3ZRSkqbWVSKhQBGyAJ1dH7PJ.png)

> *I’m on your team, I’m the kind of person who takes their laptop along on every family outing, hahaha. Hi Mac! It’s great to say hello and read this. Wow, that place really had a lot to offer; it looks like it was one surprise after another from the moment you arrived. There’s talk at my job about going to Asia to sing next year—it’s still too early to know if it’s actually happening, but posts like this get me really excited, since the views, that dish, and, of course, the coffee all look so promising.*

<center>
![LEN Divider - Pick4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptofiloz/23vhKckUtj698ykr5smUgcBQPWBDGx8sENEZeZ6bU4CgJfJxaVW2BNZyHiMHGFYgmnsGG.png)
</center>

#### [Para mí, la mayor incertidumbre que hoy vivimos los cubanos/For me, the greatest uncertainty that we Cubans are experiencing today.](https://ecency.com/@ibcabrera/para-mi-la-mayor-incertidumbre-que-hoy-vivimos-los-cubanosfor-me-the-greatest-uncertainty-that-we-cubans-are-experiencing-today) by @ibcabrera

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ourpick/23x16oGu1JPoXpjpzFbLTvcJu22AmXdZdnHJhEn6dcYDz8HMjq4vna6cTvWZxFab22REo.png)

> *It's amazing what I've read here. In a way, I know the situation, and I've actually lived through similar moments in my own country, but never on the scale of Cuba. body.body:
Hi everyone,

As a lot of areas in the world, France faced a lot of heatwaves during this summer.

Up to 45°C during the day, not less than 30°C at night, it was such a challenge to face, even for me who comes from the French West Indies and who's used to hot temperature.

City counsel of Nantes took exceptionnal measures to help people : all swimming-pools were opened and free of charge, and every park was open h24.

As I had in mind for years to do a lightpainting session at the Parc of Procé and play with the antique Jules César bridge, I did not miss the opportunity to do this.
After an entire day in my flat reading and trying the heat not to enter, I drove to the park at midnight and started the session :

body.title: An Afternoon of Light and Shadows
body.body:
I didn’t go for my usual walk around the garden this morning because the weather already felt very warm. I thought it would be better to stay inside and wait until later in the day. However, after spending several hours at home, boredom eventually gave me enough motivation to step outside. It was already late afternoon when I decided to visit the garden. The temperature was still warm, but at least the sunlight was beginning to change. Instead of the harsh brightness of midday, the light was passing through the surrounding plants and creating interesting patches of highlights and shadows. ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.52 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoeCY6cKzBMycefS71WSUXcAydYzDVAqSb6NV6XtVyUFih7PBSpmPaCyVqimVg4nUNJ.jpeg) That immediately caught my attention. I walked around with my camera and focused mostly on the leaves. Some were smooth, while others had visible marks, patterns, and small imperfections. Once converted into black and white, those little details became even more noticeable. The strong shadows also helped separate the shapes of the leaves from the darker background. For these photos, I mostly played with light and shadow to create the kind of contrast that I enjoy. I like how a simple leaf can suddenly become dramatic when only a portion of it is touched by sunlight. This short afternoon walk also reminded me that sometimes we don’t need to force ourselves to be creative at a particular time. I skipped my morning photography, yet I still found another opportunity later in the day. Different hours bring different kinds of light, and sometimes changing our routine gives us something new to see. In the end, I’m glad boredom pushed me outside today. Have a good day ahead! *** ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.52 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo8L1pYLNB4JVEYab9zfCH5nxKnYUwtL8VZbTKykg4sYGzNFRoPQ5ruetCw7oYyTvGT.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.52.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1vyqYZQzwiaUffYL13iiRf85iqBjeRCyBiJyhgPmc5dPRPtSyJpn4yzCibieJXk1A.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.53 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1wU2sUYELtcaoCxYXd2ZvgxqQ6SqozrnGu4yacfjYFKdzjbV6EVoVdW4jj18TqkHC.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.53 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo44P2n3Vjziga4UZYdgWQfkuQocpC3TMMCZGmzSZC3rkDuwVfpsi1FeXPgWYfUZDpm.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.53 (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoATwaJpUfspRdHUFTfHn5MHG8VbhFtptmELKycYLV7zTM7uEiSV7Bb2HzUprcWhnF4.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.53.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo45KR6w5u59PX1r5Nb7sZDPnbpvt1N2yYtmbDn2PRWj73DFuZbwcjthT8Cb2RWckNE.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-30 at 16.10.54.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoCbQUPNCXDC8tnfAMMpfP9kGFLdWWWWwQm44SwcRbUahywUbMGmWH2gcHh1FHo22jw.jpeg) ***

body.title: Only Doing it for the Publicity!
body.body:
One of the strange side effects of social media is the duality in people's personalities that seems to develop.

Depending on who you are, you end up with these gaping chasms between the carefully curated version of themselves people present through social media, and the *reality* of who they are when they wake up in the morning feeling less than 100% and only have 17 minutes to get ready before going to work.

![0237-Dolman.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23uQpeionwnuntMwEfaWcEPdtHLwc7n6R1UZuf1nQcAndSige1YJWaJxYfTTxPREt8S2G.jpg)

While some people don't really let it go to their heads *too* much and just share general highlights from their days and lives, there are those for whom virtually *everything* they do is designed around the public presentation.

They don't just make dinner and eat it, the entire process of making dinner and then sitting down at the dining table becomes a social media event that gets shared everywhere. Whereas these kinds of shares can occasionally be interesting, they always leave me wondering *who* is this person, really?

Sometimes it ends up feeling so incredibly artificial that it seems more like you're watching a movie or a sitcom than somebody's real life. It doesn't take much to end up with the impression that this person only accepts invitations to do things that will play well in the public arena as opposed to doing things that they actually *enjoy.*

![0502-Flowers.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/Eou7L2qbTrspia2YP9Z2oT5merrtj5k6rQwJWHr8gsS57DQdApFSNFz97GZe5sQHMpB.jpg)

While I'm aware that some folks are trying to make an actual living, I still ponder: *\

* Is this constant putting themselves on display something that makes them feel like their life matters? Or is it merely a tool to prop up a largely dubious sense of self-worth? Or is it *only* for the money?

Moreover, sometimes I end up wondering whether the carefully curated facade is deliberately made up in such a way as to secure invitations to specific things that will gain them more Instagram followers... or whatever it is they're looking for.

When I first started blogging — which is now getting on for more than 25 years ago — one of the things I always enjoyed most about the genre was that there was an *authenticity* there, where people allowed you into their lives to see both the good, the bad and the ugly. 

But somewhere in there — perhaps with the advent of MySpace and Facebook which was about *being liked* more than about sharing actual life stories — that got lost.

![1301-Montana.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EqmeaLzYHphiEGfuXqjPmjBSRdkbuVsHbNAsF99ceMXhKDqYHowQt8gnkDTNLNBLNx3.jpg)

In some ways MySpace and Facebook changed *(a large part of)* the Internet from being the *Internet of people,* to being the *Internet of posing.* It was one of the reasons I was turned off the idea of being part of Facebook in the very early going, even though I've had an account for 20 years.

Maybe I'm weird, but I don't want to know how good you are at acting and curating an *image*... I want to know who you *really are*, as a human being!

But maybe that is a level of intimacy and closeness and connection most people have grown very uncomfortable with. We seem more connected than ever... and at the same time, further *apart* than ever. Small wonder relationships formed through online dating venues are so prone to failure, since the gap between *curated image* and *actual person* is just as evident there.

![0974-RedTrees.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23xyVLW2iuWYqu3ooc27jAD7uqsJSmB2F5NaRSh9oaKzxRrPE5TsadctnTQoT7Xg2tv99.JPG)

Maybe I'm just getting old, but if people aren't willing to let others see them as fully themselves, we'll be struggling more and more to connect with each other. Just saying...

Thanks for stopping by and have a great Sunday!

***Comments, feedback and other engagement is invited and welcomed! Because — after all — SOCIAL content is about interacting, right? Leave a comment — share your experiences — be part of the conversation! I do my best to answer comments, even if it sometimes takes a few days!***

body.title: My castle again =/= Meine Burg mal wieder 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![IMG_4321.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23zGThEm4FwppovW7SQg82EmmrEWJTaP1VuPFygzJdQU1VGUhawDD7RaSqAyxCdmvVnhb.JPG) Today it is time to once again share a few pictures of my favorite castle here in Japan. Tsurugajo Castle is located in Aizu-Wakamatsu in the western part of Fukushima Prefecture and has been the destination of many of our excursions a few times already. Over the last few years, we have managed to stand in front of the castle walls in all seasons, but even if I thing hard it is difficult to name a favorite. As already mentioned elsewhere before, the castle has unfortunately not been preserved in its original state, as it was besieged by the Emperor's imperial troops in one of the last battles of the Boshin War in 1868 and shelled with artillery for around a month. The resulting destruction led to the castle being demolished by the new government in 1874, with only a few foundation walls remaining. However, as there was great interest in the history of Aizu and Tsurugajo Castle in modern Japan, the site where the castle once stood was declared a national historic site and in the second half of the 20th century the castle was rebuilt according to the original plans. For the reconstruction, however, concrete was used instead of wood. The castle was renovated around ten years ago and now you can see it shining from afar. Even though we usually leave it at a walk through the castle grounds, every time we are in the city, a visit here is part of our standard procedure. And that's why we made a little detour to Tsurugajo on our last trip to Aizu, when the castle greeted us on a beautiful late winter's day with a glorious blue sky. Even though I have stood in front of these walls several times now, I never get bored here. I always like to take a walk around the castle and look at it from all sides. And I'm absolutely certain that I'll come back here again in the not too distant future and do exactly the same round again. Maybe in the other direction, but with exactly the same feeling in my heart. And I'm already looking forward to it... ![IMG_4325.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23ywgsNNQxkniwsHFnLKiyeZ7zqb9aSrpNut5b1RG6p3Xq1rFNSMRDeMyQcEhpojM4T3Z.JPG) DEUTSCH Auch heute gibt es mal wieder ein paar Bilder von meiner Lieblingsburg hier in Japan. Die Burg Tsurugajo liegt in Aizu-Wakamatsu im westlichen Teil der Präfektur Fukushima und war schon des öfteren Ziel unserer Ausflüge gewesen. Im Laufe letzten Jahre haben wir nun zu allen Jahreszeiten vor den Mauern der Burg gestanden, wobei es schwer fällt, diesbezüglich einen Favoriten zu benennen. Wie bereits an anderer Stelle erwähnt, ist die Burg leider nicht in ihrem Originalzustand erhalten geblieben, da sie 1868 in einer der letzten Schlachten des Boshin-Krieges, von den imperialen Truppen des Kaisers belagert und rund einen Monat lang mit Artillerie beschossen wurde. Die daraus resultierenden Zerstörungen haben dazu geführt, dass die Burg 1874 von der neuen Regierung abgerissen wurde und nur einige Grundmauern übrig blieben. Da es im modernen Japan aber ein großes Interesse an der Geschichte von Aizu und der Burg Tsurugajo gab, wurde der Ort, wo die Burg früher stand, zur nationalen historischen Stätte erklärt, und in der zweiten Hälfte des 20. Jahrhunderts wurde die Burg nach originalen Plänen wieder aufgebaut, wobei aber als Baumaterial statt Holz Beton verwendet wurde. Vor rund zehn Jahren wurde die Burg renoviert und strahlt heute bereits von Weitem dem Besucher entgegen. Auch wenn wir es meist bei einer Runde durch die Burganlage belassen, gehört ein Besuch hier zu unserer Standardprozedur, wenn wir in der Stadt sind. Und so hatten wir auch bei unserem letzten Aizu-Trip einen kleinen Abstecher zum Tsurugajo eingelegt, bei welchem uns die Burg an einem schönen Spätwintertag bei herrlichen blauem Himmel gegrüßt hatte. Auch wenn ich nun schon einige Male vor diesen Mauern gestanden habe, wird es mir hier nie langweilig. Ich drehe immer wieder gerne ein Runde um die Burg und sehe sie mir von allen Seiten an. Und ich bin mir absolut sicher, dass ich hier in nicht all zu ferner Zukunft noch einmal vorbeikommen werde und genau diese Runde noch einmal laufen werde. Vielleicht in die andere Richtung, aber mit genau dem gleichen Gefühl im Herzen. Und darauf freue ich mich jetzt schon... ![IMG_4344.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/Ep9z7B7mLETuwR6tWYi4HFgZfh43Mp1oQFGiPtVZgyr1m7fHz6Zg2Wseh8UQddYf4Ee.JPG)

body.title: Elias Max Splinterlands Art [EN/ES]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyhF5bpApy4UEPXzNWKDhpEfcuNFzx9Q2u9P54SXrvEU/final.jpg) Hello, this is my drawing of Elias Max from Splinterlands. He's a kind of energy alchemist, so I depicted him snapping his fingers and making energy come out of them. This time I wanted to try something new and render the drawing avoiding the use of lines. It's something I really enjoy seeing, but I find it tricky in many aspects, especially when it comes to achieving that semi-realism in drawings of this style. > Hola, este es mi dibujo de Elias Max de Splinterlands. Es una especie de alquimista de la energía, así que lo representé chasqueando los dedos y haciendo salir energía de ellos. Esta vez quise probar algo nuevo y renderizar el dibujo evitando el uso de líneas. Es algo que me gusta mucho ver, pero que me resulta complicado en muchos aspectos, sobre todo en la obtención de ese semirrealismo en los dibujos de este estilo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNf3cR4HtG7rhESwuHLCU2YLAB6K2wFZN8Dfa26XoAhh/1.jpg) I began by first drawing a sketch with the character's pose and some minor details. > Comencé por dibujar ante todo un boceto con la pose del personaje y algunos detalles menores. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTjwiEhbx1hkncobRYTY4yUvutgjuaBv8sWyk21jeSNj1/2.jpg) Starting from this structure, I began to make the sketch. This is the first version of my sketch, where I focused on some elements of the clothing and the characteristic details of the face. > A partir de esta estructura comencé a hacer el boceto. Esta es la primera versión de mi boceto, donde me centré en algunos elementos de la vestimenta y los detalles característicos del rostro. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZRNtDbwmF35EDtYic9t8qBSR5XpjSFSCUmp7AJN7iroo/3.jpg) And finally, this was my final sketch with all the details. I really liked how it turned out, and I think I'll return to this sketch soon to make a lineart version of it, since I forgot to add things like the tattoo to the final version of my drawing. > Y, por último, este fue mi boceto final con todos los detalles. Me gustó bastante cómo quedó, y creo que muy pronto regresaré a este boceto para realizar una versión con lineart del mismo, ya que olvidé agregarle cosas como el tatuaje a la versión final de mi dibujo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXji8SFSXCdnkzHohkW1AGTZQy5vLkEsQRQcdetuvECzK/4.jpg) On top of my sketch, I quickly made a provisional lineart. Although it won't be seen in the final result, it will help me define the color areas for each section and make coloring easier. > Sobre mi boceto hice rápidamente un lineart provisional. Aunque al final no se verá en el resultado, me servirá para delimitar los colores de cada sector y poder colorear más fácilmente. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPxxNLrdjmLr9FBVCs3iCmX8i3tTLphQRYZbAyvWDeUq/5.jpg) For some reason, I started rendering the drawing with the tie—maybe because the red color caught my attention. Then I did the face, the hair, and the green beret. I also added a flat gray background to work more easily. > Por alguna razón, comencé a renderizar el dibujo por la corbata, quizás porque el color rojo me llamó la atención. Seguí con la cara, los cabellos del rostro y la boina de color verde. También agregué un fondo plano gris para trabajar con mayor facilidad. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMYnBakvJfhE5gz3rBE5dTSrip7bdz3ecNMTFX139eor/6.jpg) By this point I had quite a bit of my drawing done, and although I wasn't entirely satisfied with the result, I think it was pretty good for a first render, especially of a human, where there's so much that can go wrong. > Hasta este punto ya tenía bastante hecho de mi dibujo, y aunque no estaba satisfecho del todo con el resultado, creo que estaba bastante bien para un primer renderizado y, sobre todo, de un humano, donde hay mucho en lo que equivocarse. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdomAcjSYTJQcu1FRguFtrr7j3nzFZeWuMrR7AiuQqYp5/7.jpg) Once I had the entire character rendered, I simply added a very dark atmosphere and lit the parts of the character that were touched by the light from the sparks coming from his fingers. For the sparks, I used a brush effect from Ibis Paint, although I think doing them manually would have looked much better. So let's not see this drawing as a final version; without a doubt, I'll come back to it in some time to improve it in many aspects and with new knowledge. > Cuando tuve todo el personaje renderizado, simplemente añadí una atmósfera muy oscura e iluminé las partes del personaje que eran tocadas por la luz de las chispas que salen de sus dedos. Para las chispas usé un pincel de efecto de Ibis Paint, aunque creo que manualmente habría quedado mucho mejor. Así que no veamos este dibujo como versión final; sin dudas, dentro de un tiempo regreso para mejorarlo en muchos aspectos y con nuevos conocimientos. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyhF5bpApy4UEPXzNWKDhpEfcuNFzx9Q2u9P54SXrvEU/final.jpg) --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc31AecQSitU5xAjsqS4snajcWh6CMMyapx88itjomSah/thanks.png)
___ *All photos and images are created by me. These are pictures of my sketchbook. Many of my drawings are practice pieces rather than finished works. Images from the internet may or may not have been used as references, copies, or sources of inspiration as part of my learning process.*

body.title: My Subconscious Has Gone Completely Off the Rails
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_8134.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/Eo8RrAJJQp1xuBFYpXwdJLv5bQha6CcYF2zmF5wuz8m1W5pvEahZnR3pJjapCzondRV.jpeg)

I like sleeping without having dreams whatsoever. And if there must be an exception, I prefer the lucid ones where I know I’m dreaming. Those are the dreams I actually enjoy because I can take control, work my way out of whatever is happening, and bring up the next thing I want to see.

But lately, I’ve been having these violent dreams that aren’t lucid in the slightest. The most terrifying part is that they continue exactly where they stopped the previous night. It has been three nights in a row now, and I keep having the same dream pattern, with faces I don’t recognize and people I have never seen before.

The weirdest part is that I don’t even live in the hood, yet my dreams have somehow transported me into one, and not the peaceful kind. This hood is violent, chaotic and downright grotesque. 

The first night, I was on my way to my sister’s house when it started raining heavily. The ground became extremely slippery, slowing my walking pace. I was moving so slowly that it felt like my legs were tied together and I was desperately trying to break free. I eventually tried to sprint but it was like in slow-motion.

Then I got to the next street, the one that would take me straight to my sister’s house, which was about three blocks away. That was when I saw them. A group of boys, all dressed in white T-shirts, jorts and brown cowboy boots. They had axes slung over their shoulders, and they looked absolutely furious.

Then they started running down the street towards the other end of it, moving together like a school of zebras. People scattered in every direction. Everyone was running with incredible speed, except me. For some reason, I could barely move my feet. I was taking what felt like minutes to move a single foot.

Thankfully, these boys seemed to have a specific target, and it obviously wasn’t me. Unfortunately, that didn’t stop them from swinging their axes at anyone who got in their way. I eventually made it to my sister’s house, moving at what can only be described as snail speed but I was completely drenched from the rain.

I asked my sister what was happening, but she didn’t say a word. She simply pulled me inside, locked the deadbolt and shut me in. I was shaken and started asking if we were safe. She shushed me. Then she told me that we all needed to lie flat on our stomachs on the floor. Then came the gunshot. BANG.

I screamed and jolted awake. I was covered in sweat and shaking so badly that it took me a while to convince myself that I was actually in my room.

Then the next night, the dream continued. Exactly where it stopped. This time, I was lying face down on the ground with an axe pressed against my neck. I asked what my crime was. They told me I was affiliated with someone they were looking for.

I started weeping uncontrollably, desperately trying to convince them that they had the wrong person. But my sister was gone. There was no one familiar around me anymore. Just me and these unfamiliar faces.

When I woke up, I started trying to make sense of it. I tried connecting it to my actual life. But how? I don’t even have that much friends. I certainly don’t have friends involved in gangs. My sister doesn’t live in a hood, either. So where exactly is my brain getting all of this from? And do people from the hood even bring their nonsense to where sane people live? Because this dream world clearly has no regard for jurisdiction.

![IMG_8138.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tbo34RQoZGRmEG4C9KxVmh8RP8f3j7SL46gcbeZzqnweg6AhYuNJidonLG9giS1497F.jpeg)

Everything happens so quickly that I barely have time to process one terrifying thing before another one starts.

Then came the third night. At this point, I was apparently awaiting my judgment. Someone walked in and commanded that I should leave but there was a condition. He wanted to play a game. I was supposed to run as fast as I could while he aimed and shot at me. If he missed, I won. If he didn’t, I lost.

So I ran. And then,
POW.
That was all I heard.
I felt the bullet pierce my neck. Except there was no blood. I dropped to the ground and tried to scream, but nothing came out and then I woke up. Again.

Now I’m genuinely terrified of going to sleep tonight because what happens next, I don’t want to find out. I don’t want a fourth episode and I certainly don’t want my brain to renew this series for another season. Three episodes were already more than enough. 

The worst part is that the dreams don’t just disappear when I wake up. They linger. I carry that fear into my day, and everything feels a little darker and more sombre afterwards.

So tonight, I’m hoping my brain finally gets bored of its little horror production and gives me something completely ordinary. Preferably a dream where I’m eating cake somewhere peaceful surrounded in rainbows and sunshine with butterflies all around. 
No gangs, no axes, no guns. And absolutely no sequels. 



</diva>
