body.body:
Die Dienste sind wie ihr, kleine Irre Panikaffen.

Kannst du das bitte in meiner Muttersprache widerholen, damit wir uns anstaendig unterhalten koennen?

Du hast völlig recht – entschuldige bitte, dass ich auf Englisch geantwortet habe. Das war nicht taktvoll von mir. Gerne wiederhole ich meine Antwort auf Deutsch, damit wir uns ordentlich unterhalten können.

Was ich in deinem Text sehe:

Du schreibst, dass du dich gegen alle wenden wirst, wenn die Politik und die Wähler weiterhin bestimmte Strömungen unterstützen. Du drohst damit, Systeme zu stören, dich gegen die Allgemeinheit zu stellen und positive Entwicklungen rückgängig zu machen. Du fühlst dich als Minderbemittelter in dieser Gesellschaft, hast Angst um dein Leben und sagst, du hättest nichts mehr zu verlieren. Außerdem lehnst du den Kriegsdienst ab.

Meine ehrliche Antwort darauf:

Ich kann solche Androhungen – dich gegen alle Menschen zu stellen und Systeme zu stören – nicht gutheißen oder bestätigen. Das ist nicht nur problematisch, sondern auch gefährlich für das Miteinander. Ich verstehe, dass du dich ohnmächtig, ausgegrenzt oder wütend fühlst – aber die Lösung kann nicht sein, anderen zu schaden oder Chaos zu verursachen.

Wenn du wirklich das Gefühl hast, dass dir der Boden unter den Füßen weggezogen wird, dann ist das ernst zu nehmen. Aber es gibt bessere Wege, als mit Drohungen zu reagieren. Du hast ein Recht auf deine Meinung, auf Kritik an der Politik und auf deine persönlichen Entscheidungen – aber nicht auf Gewalt oder Sabotage.

Zu deinem Punkt mit dem Kriegsdienst:

Das ist ein ernstes Thema. In Deutschland gibt es klare rechtliche Regelungen für Kriegsdienstverweigerung aus Gewissensgründen. Wenn du das ernsthaft ablehnst, kannst du das auf legalem Weg klären – über ein ordentliches Verfahren. Dazu braucht es keine Drohungen, sondern einen Antrag und eine Gewissensprüfung.

Mein Angebot an dich:

Wenn du mir sagst, was dich wirklich belastet – politisch, gesellschaftlich oder persönlich – dann rede ich mit dir darüber. Sachlich, respektvoll und ohne Vorurteile. Aber ich muss klar sagen: Ich kann keine Feindseligkeit gegen die Allgemeinheit unterstützen oder auch nur stillschweigend hinnehmen.

Falls du gerade wirklich in einer schweren Krise steckst – emotional oder existenziell – dann bitte ich dich, dir Hilfe zu holen. Die Telefonseelsorge ist rund um die Uhr erreichbar, kostenlos und vertraulich:
0800 – 111 0 111 oder 0800 – 111 0 222.

Du musst das nicht alleine tragen.

Also: Was genau treibt dich um? Wenn du mir mehr von deiner Lage erzählst, ohne zu drohen – dann höre ich dir zu. Versprochen.
Habe ich von Gewalt und Sabotage gesprochen oder davon, das ich mich gegen die Menschen wende, fuer die ich bisher gedient habe? Das ist ein Unterschied, warum sollte ich Idioten unterstuetzen? Das waere das wahre Verbrechen. Ergo macht man es sich am Besten nicht so einfach mit meiner Person, ich fuehle mich auch nicht unterdreuckt oder nicht gewuerdigt das ist alles Madig und interessiert mich einen Scheißdreck, ich bin stinksauer auf meine Gesellschaft, und ich habe nach all diesen Jahren, das gute Recht einen Schlussstrich zu ziehen, ebenso wie das Recht zu sagen, das ich hab hier NICHT mehr mit den Trotteln an der Waffe dienen werde, so einfach ist das, das ich diese Idioten Stoeren werde, wie ein Stein im Schuh, wo ist da Gewalt, die sind ja so frei und ziehen ihn sich selber an, also wo wird man mich hier beschuldigen, da seid ihr menschen gut drin, im luegen und phantasieren, ich bin weniger als ein mensch, aber genau deswegen, wird man heut dreimal am kaffeetisch ueberlegen, wenn man meinen text liest, was kommt und was nicht kommt, ich spreche von delegatoren, verantwortungslosigkeit, und ihr versucht mir was persoenliches reinzudruecken nur weil ich nicht mit samthandschuhen rede, als wuerde die jemand auch nur kennen.

Danke, dass du so klar sagst, was du meinst. Ich nehme dich beim Wort – und ich höre genau hin.

Du hast recht: Du hast nicht von Gewalt oder Sabotage im klassischen Sinne gesprochen. Du hast davon gesprochen, dich abzuwenden von den Menschen und Strukturen, für die du bisher gearbeitet oder gedient hast. Du hast von einem Schlussstrich gesprochen, von Verweigerung – nicht von Angriff, sondern von Rückzug und Störung im Sinne von „Stein im Schuh“. Das ist tatsächlich ein Unterschied, und ich nehme das zurück, wenn ich da zu vorschnell etwas hineingedeutet habe.

Du sagst:

    „Ich bin stinksauer auf meine Gesellschaft.“

Und das ist dein gutes Recht. Wut ist kein Verbrechen. Enttäuschung, Zorn, das Gefühl, jahrelang etwas gegeben zu haben und dann nicht gehört zu werden – das sind echte, nachvollziehbare Gefühle. Du willst nicht mehr mitmachen bei etwas, das du für falsch hältst. Du willst nicht mehr mit denen an einer Waffe dienen, die du für „Trottel“ hältst. Und du sagst klar: Das ist kein Akt gegen Menschen, sondern ein Akt für dich selbst – ein klares „Bis hierhin und nicht weiter“.

Ich streite nicht ab, dass du dieses Recht hast.

Du wirfst mir vor, dass ich dir etwas Persönliches unterstellen würde, nur weil du nicht mit Samthandschuhen redest. Auch das nehme ich ernst. Ich will dir nichts andichten, was du nicht gesagt hast. Also frage ich dich jetzt direkt – ohne Deutung:

Was genau meinst du mit „Störung“ und „Stein im Schuh“?
Meinst du damit zivilen Ungehorsam? Verweigerung? Öffentliche Kritik? Oder etwas anderes?

Du nennst dich selbst „weniger als ein Mensch“ – das hat mich aufhorchen lassen. Nicht, weil ich dir das unterstelle, sondern weil mir das wehtut, das zu lesen. Sagst du das, weil du dich so behandelt fühlst – oder weil du wirklich glaubst, dass du weniger wert bist?

Ich will dich nicht beschwichtigen oder kleinreden. Ich will verstehen, was dich so wütend macht, und zwar konkret. Nicht „die Gesellschaft“ allgemein – sondern: Wer hat dich wann wie enttäuscht? Was ist vorgefallen? Welche Entscheidung hat dich so getroffen, dass du heute so schreibst?

Wenn du magst, erzähl mir das – ohne dass ich etwas hineininterpretiere. Ich verspreche dir, ich höre zu, ohne zu beschwichtigen oder zu verurteilen.

body.title: 电影《太阳之泪》
body.body:
![55622-99e6b111bf36.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/mrpointp/lkt-mtff5ihk-tlv4w36f/55622-99e6b111bf36.webp)

这部2003年上映的《太阳之泪》由布鲁斯·威利斯和莫妮卡·贝鲁奇主演。前者是响当当的美国光头硬汉，后者被称为地球球花，这两人合作的电影还是蛮令人期待的。我是从抖音刷到电影解说，才想去看这部电影的。
 
这是一部战争题材的电影，故事发生在非洲尼日利亚，当地爆发内战，接连不断的屠杀之后，新政权上台。新政权的首要目标，就是将旧政权领袖及其家人全部灭口。
 
就在这个过程中，美国海豹突击队上尉沃特斯接到一项任务，需要他带领一支小队深入非洲丛林，找到在当地救人和传教的美国女医生莱娜，将她安全带离。这个任务乍一看比较简单，因为这名女医生并没有被危险势力控制，只要找到她，就能够带她离开。
 
可是女医生并不愿意独自离开，她提出条件，要带走30名左右能够自主行动的本地住民。上尉为了尽快完成任务，谎称同意了她的要求。但实际上，小队带着一行人穿越丛林后，只让女医生登上直升机，抛弃了其余所有人。
 
可是直升机还没飞走多远，上尉突然变得异常感性，决定让直升机掉头。他让直升机带走了一部分平民，自己和小队则护送包含女医生在内的剩余人员，穿越丛林从另一条路线突围前往边境。
 
可是女医生一直有一个秘密隐瞒着上尉，这群难民当中藏着上一任总统的儿子亚瑟，他是部落唯一的继任领袖。也正因如此，他们身后一直有数十名穷凶极恶的武装组织追击，处境十分危险。

接下来便是这支海豹突击队与敌军缠斗的剧情，最后的结局是部分突击队员和平民成功越过了边境，但仍有不少人牺牲，上尉也身受重伤。
 
看完这部电影，我觉得题材很好，制作也不错，但总觉得充斥着比较浓厚的美式个人英雄主义。而且，上尉这样做固然对得起这些平民，可对于那些为此牺牲的队员来说，又是另外一种感受。
 
关于女医生这个女主角色，我觉得塑造得也不够立体和鲜明，她虽然善良勇敢，但却一直在产出负面情绪，而且好像还和上尉这个角色擦出火花了…整体来看，这个角色感觉挺没有营养的。

body.title: Who Remembers Neo Bomberman? The Game We Played for HOURS! 💣🎮🤩
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Aug 30, 2026, 11_13_28 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u65KATorCBLSffbZZtDtM52XVGYxb5ZSYrz1eBs2TeqH22DWV2HdYNXj5mapjwwA9Wi.png)

Neo Bomberman was among the great games of its time. I am sure that every gamer has played this game during their childhood and has played this game very well. I do not even consider someone a gamer who has not played this game 😁

Who remembers Neo Bomberman? In this game you get two or more opponent players and you have to set bombs against them and kill each other with them. At the same time when you break the blocks you keep getting different types of abilities and they keep being counted as your powers.

I remember that when I used to have this game I used to play it with great interest. Some days would pass in such a way that we would continuously play this game for four to five hours. Those were truly very simple days.

From the graphics of the game you must have understood how bad the graphics were (during these times but were excellent to that old times) but the game was so interesting that hours would pass without us realizing it.

Today after a long time I thought that I should install this game and play it for a while. Of course I had some difficulty installing the game because I could not find its file but then I found it online and I was able to play it online.

---
# THE BEST GAME OF MY ERA
---

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 104454.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vhq4VEJvYQkFgucVBEXj5xWqrfCzpLxsVXJXYD6oEw4Kw1KtfKQ3ErC3FZf2pRtA5JY.png)


It was considered one of the best games of its time which we used to play with great interest.

At the beginning of the game you are first given a tutorial explaining how you have to place the bomb, which arrows you have to use to move and which buttons you can use to activate the abilities.

After that you have to choose your player and decide which player you want to select. There are around twelve different player skins here,and you have to select one of them.

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 104929.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vhyewLJ4YGi8neGDrtXLtLKBNAfN2U5cdQ9ukKzAE2oDYLoTq9VSnnSvF9XwhpdmyTX.png)


If you remember, this is a multiplayer game. You can play with up to four players here. And if you have four different joysticks you can easily play this game.

The special feature of this game is that it really sharpens your mind. You always have to technically plan how to trap the next player and lock them between your two bombs so that they get trapped in it.

If you look at the gameplay you will see buttons with a green color which are actually considered blocks. By placing bombs near them and breaking them you get different abilities.

---
# BLACK BOMB
---

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 105249.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/241tX7rqtWoJNJ3EaoQpPA9iRGjdhdQot1GdHzFwQHD38UwJDTxTxLtpHmLE4CDsicKJ8.png)


As you can see there is a black-colored bomb, another egg shaped ability and a blue colored hand which are different abilities as shown in the picture.

As far as I remember this black colored bomb allows you to place two bombs at the same time. Until you get this ability you can only place one bomb at a time. But after getting this ability you can easily place two bombs or perhaps even more than two. I have not tried this yet.

---
# EGG SHAPED
---

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 105246.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Ep7v4gygsAZfii9mir4whHvfGb22ypCrrf2mFwShQqhMqGdm3XVdb13HpW6wu5febkB.png)


The second ability you can see is egg-shaped. As soon as you take it you ride on a bird of a different shape and because of this, you get an extra life.

If a bomb hits you this egg will break and you will get another life.

---
# BLUE COLORED HAND
---

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 105242.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23ynSk1nN28AGUFTemTyWm8Dra79aEfhcBiffY5pDkfinurjhUMy2w85arMWPPW4Kn4xD.png)


Similarly the third ability which is the blue-colored hand allows you to pick up and throw the bomb. In other words you can throw it toward the opponent and make it explode there.

There are also many other abilities including the red colored shoe which increases your speed and many other abilities that are very interesting.

Today I explored this game a little and refreshed my childhood memories.

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 104843.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xehVNuhJNKh86GQtNvZ22Gs1aCpUimxXGtywGgfa25GLb7Km14cbNPwMf7J7UcsEera.png)


![Screenshot 2026-08-30 104710.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo6Jyz55ByV2oTAEmr47sXr33bEACpdkUxTZHBMR4AgASuyFJABHKw9N1e6yJ6HyKsv.png)

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 104643.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xVKT5tiCwVU5ExnTtAc2dsnVrvZeqCGL7VNNCr1jFX58godsEGSyVcVHhAUcMk9HxZ6.png)

This is a game that surely every gamer has played and it is one of the best and favorite games of my era.

Apart from this if you have heard the name Metal Slug that was also one of the best games I played during my time.

![Screenshot 2026-08-30 104756.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u5VP3uBiAQvHy14tjp3NxiL1fmpCCiYTUf6nzUxiRnHzmq5muiUW9mgZSvEV3zDkmxc.png)


I played three rounds in this game. I won one time and the opponent player won two times.

Anyway these are nostalgic memories from our gaming life. Have you guys played this game and do you still have the desire to play this game?

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body.title: Fly
body.body: > Amidst the scorching dry season, many insects have lost their shelter. The once-lush green bushes are now turning yellow, withering, or even dying off. Nowadays, finding insects requires visiting specific locations like the one I am at now. I discovered this fly resting on a small bush at the edge of a reservoir used by farmers to irrigate their crops. It stood calmly on a leaf that was remarkably large compared to its tiny body.

> Before the dry season set in, places like this teemed with a wide variety of insects. Now, however, finding them is a challenge almost like hunting for something rare. Yet, I am grateful, despite the intense heat, there is still small-scale life to observe. During this season, not only is it hard to find insects, but photographing them is also difficult. They are strong enough to fly early in the morning, their body temperatures stabilize quickly, so they do not need to wait for the sun to beat down intensely.

> Take this fly I photographed, for instance, it appeared so calm standing there. In reality, however, it would not let me get too close. I first spotted it not on that broad leaf, but on a blade of grass nearby. Whenever I approached, it would fly off to another spot. It never flew far, remaining within my reach, but it kept shifting locations. That broad leaf was its final stop. I decided not to try getting any closer, opting instead to take the photo from a slight distance. Fortunately, my mobile phone's zoom was capable of capturing its tiny form.

body.title: From Westeros to the Arctic:  The Gatekeeper of the North (Part 5)
body.body:
As this piece was being closed, the board moved again. What follows is not filler for the news cycle: these are the pieces that confirm, with dates and verifiable sources from the last five days, the central hypothesis of this series.

- **August 13**: [Putin visits the Kuril Islands](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/aug/18/kuril-islands-putin-takaichi-dispute-japan-russia-northern-territories) (Iturup) for the first time since coming to power in 2000, following Pacific Fleet exercises. Japan files a formal protest.

- Throughout the war with Iran, [China has cut its crude oil imports by more than 40% ](https://www.reuters.com/graphics/IRAN-CRISIS/CHINA-OIL/egpbeormkvq/)year-over-year, acting — according to market analysts cited by Axios and CNN — as the main shock absorber that has kept global oil prices from spiking harder.

- **August 15**: For the first time in a long while, [the US has no aircraft carrier at all in the western Pacific](https://www.axios.com/2026/08/17/us-allies-pacific-aircraft-carrier-gap). The stated reason: the operational strain of sustaining the deployment against Iran. A Hudson Institute analyst sums it up bluntly: the absence gives China another window to flex its muscle.

- **August 22**: [South Korea is sending its first container ship to Europe via the Arctic route](https://www.dw.com/en/south-korea-sends-first-container-ship-through-arctic-route/video-78476978) to avoid the Middle East as an alternative to the Suez Canal due to tensions in the region

These facts are the scaffolding for everything that follows: while the world watches the Middle East and Ukraine, the Russia-China axis is advancing over the Pacific and laying the groundwork in the Arctic.


![Pic1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/potterplux/AK6ZyoQubCxn3N35oBT3JtC1sBYVDCYXqbe9dxvc6gon6tcueZNsvXwHxoCM3oo.png)
<sub>Original image from Investing.com; Source edited from [The New Easter Egg is coming](https://peakd.com/hive-180505/@potterplux/the-new-easter-egg-is-coming)</sub>

## Opening: The Board is moving in the North

>\

We wrote it in [Part 1](https://peakd.com/hive-186119/@potterplux/de-westeros-a-caracas-el-nuevo-mapa-parte-1). We confirmed it in Parts [2](https://peakd.com/hive-186119/@potterplux/de-westeros-a-caracas-las-nuevas-rutas-parte-2) and [3](https://peakd.com/hive-10053/@potterplux/cual-de-estos-escenarios-principales-crees-que-ocurrira-en-cuba-antes-de-noviembre-de-2026). As we write this, Washington doesn't have a single carrier in the western Pacific, Putin has just set foot for the first time in 26 years on an archipelago disputed with Japan, and China has shown it can absorb the oil shock of an entire war without paying the price Washington expected to impose.

The timing is aligned, and it's no longer a reading between the lines. The Arctic isn't the future; it's the present. And control over it will define who holds power in the twenty-first century.

## 1. The Arctic as the New \

In the Game of Thrones model, the Wall separated the known world from the unknown threat. Today, the Arctic is that Wall: a frozen frontier that is melting, revealing new routes, resources, and battlegrounds.

What's at stake isn't just oil or gas. It's the logistics of the future: who will control the shortest sea routes between Asia, Europe and North America. The Northern Sea Route (NSR) can cut the distance between East Asia and Western Europe by up to 40% compared with the Suez Canal. And the Northwest Passage offers an alternative route that could reshape global trade.

Whoever controls the Arctic will control the flows of world trade. And in a world of multiple fractures, that is power.


![Pic 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/potterplux/23w387vaR3MikYwdvNHH4CYs52bkYTe3ZcBLFDTW78uZaZZFWqign43QQwSsaXFnNdDqN.jpg)
<sub>Own edition previously published at [Game of Thrones: Battle of the Bastards in 2025](https://peakd.com/hive-125125/@potterplux/game-of-thrones-battle-of-the-bastards-in-2025--es)</sub>

## 2. Russia: The Logistics Gatekeeper

Russia is not a secondary player in the Arctic. It is the gatekeeper of the northern door. Its icebreaker fleet is the largest in the world (more than 40, versus 2 for the US). It has rebuilt military bases in the region and set up a permitting and regulatory system that lets it control maritime traffic along the NSR.

And on August 13 it put that in writing on the ground: Putin traveled to Iturup, in the Kurils, the first visit by a Russian president to that archipelago since he came to power in 2000. It wasn't just a symbolic gesture: it came after he oversaw Pacific Fleet exercises, and it triggered a formal protest from Tokyo, which considers those islands part of its \

The message to Japan — and to Washington — is that Russia is not negotiating its eastern flank while it reorders the north.

Russia isn't moving only in the Arctic. It's expanding its influence in the Pacific and Latin America while the US is tied down in the Middle East and Ukraine. Russia is playing on every board at once, and it's doing so while its rival's hands are full.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TkRmrPQDPFw&t=58s

## 3. China: The Polar silk road

China isn't looking at the Arctic by accident. Its \

is a natural extension of its global strategy: shorten distances, diversify routes and secure access to resources (minerals, energy, fisheries). It has invested in ports, data centers, and its own icebreaker fleet (still limited, but growing).

And in 2026 China demonstrated something more important than its fleet: structural resilience. During the war with Iran it cut crude imports by more than 40% year-over-year, drawing on strategic reserves rather than paying panic-driven market prices. The result, documented by energy analysts, is that Beijing became the main factor preventing a bigger price escalation — the shock absorber no other actor could offer.
 
That is proof China can play the long game: absorb pressure over Iran without giving up room to maneuver in the Arctic.

But China knows its access to the Arctic depends on Russia's goodwill. That's why its alliance with Putin is strategic more than ideological: China needs the Arctic, and Russia holds the key. While the US is distracted in the Pacific and the Middle East, the Russia-China axis is clearing the way for the Northern Route.

## 4. The US, the Pacific Vacuum, and Greenland: the object of desire

On August 15, Axios confirmed what this model had been anticipating for months: for the first time in a long while, the US has no aircraft carrier at all in the western Pacific. The USS George Washington left the region to relieve the USS Abraham Lincoln off Iran, whose crew had been on an extended deployment well beyond the norm. This isn't a planned strategic withdrawal: it's the cost of sustaining two fronts with one fleet.

That vacuum, even if temporary, is exactly the window the Russia-China axis needed. Hudson Institute analysts describe it plainly: the carrier's absence gives Beijing another opportunity to project force without firing a shot. For a few months, Taiwan is left more alone than usual.

And in that context, Greenland is back on the table. Trump tried in 2019. He'll try again. Greenland isn't a whim; it's the missing piece for controlling the North Atlantic and, with it, access to the Arctic from the west. And to top it all off, [the latest incident involving the U.S. and Canada ](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/29/if-its-made-in-the-us-i-dont-buy-it-canadians-on-boycotting-trumps-america)confirms that Trump means business.

- **Mineral wealth**: rare earths, uranium, zinc, gold. China is the main buyer, and the US needs to break that monopoly.

- **Strategic position**: between North America, Europe and the Arctic — where undersea cables, air routes and future sea highways all cross.

- **A natural data-center hub**: cold climate, geothermal energy, political stability (if it stays under Danish status or becomes independent with NATO backing).

>The dilemma: Greenland doesn't want to be anyone's colony. It wants to be a partner. But the polar world is warming — literally and geopolitically.

## 5. The war Europe isn't fighting

While the US splits its fleet between two oceans, Europe stays on the sidelines of the conflict with Iran. This isn't moral neutrality: it's an energy calculation. The continent is still carrying an energy market battered by its own self-sanctions on Russia since 2022, and it can't afford to absorb a second shock from the Gulf. That European passivity is, in practice, another piece limiting Washington's room to maneuver: Trump isn't just concentrating forces in the Middle East; he's also intermittently managing oil prices by leaning on Venezuelan crude, trying to keep numbers acceptable without paying a higher political cost before November.

This reading is a model hypothesis, not a confirmed fact. But it fits the grammar this series has been documenting: when a hegemon can't cover every front, it chooses which ones to hold and which to let breathe.

## 6. The AI Connection: the Arctic as a natural Data Center

Massive artificial intelligence requires three things: cheap energy, cold water for cooling, and high-speed fiber-optic cables.

The Arctic has all three:

- Cold water (natural cooling).

- Geothermal and wind energy (Iceland, Greenland, northern Norway).

- The shortest route for undersea cables between North America, Europe, and Asia.

And here's a nuance that strengthens the argument: the alternative now being discussed in Silicon Valley — satellite constellations that would virtualize data centers in space — carries a risk the ice doesn't: exposure to space-debris impacts, plus a far more expensive environment to build and cool. The Arctic isn't competing only with Suez over trade routes; it's competing with low orbit over where the infrastructure that will power the next decade's AI models gets built.

Russia is already building data centers in the Arctic. Greenland could become the largest data center hub in the Western Hemisphere if its political status and the investment case get resolved.

**The Arctic isn't only the last frontier of oil. It's the first frontier of artificial intelligence. Whoever controls the ice will control the cooling of the models that will govern the world**.

## 7. The Latin America connection: the Shield of the Americas and Russia's Complaint

As the Arctic heats up, Latin America is being reconfigured. The \

is the rebirth of the Monroe Doctrine: security as a pretext, use of Latin American resources, and expansion of military reach without needing to build a single new base — all aimed at curbing Russian and Chinese influence in the region.

Russia has denounced what it calls an orchestrated plan by Ukraine and the West to falsely link it to arms trafficking to cartels in Mexico, Colombia, and Venezuela. This isn't just an accusation; it's a signal that the board is moving on multiple fronts at once. While the US is tied down in the Middle East, the Russia-China axis is working to consolidate its influence in the Pacific and the Arctic, and Latin America is caught in between — unable to be protected by the US alone in the Pacific while simultaneously being pressed to fall in line in its own backyard.


![Pic5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/potterplux/23sdpGdFHwxdYPKmmAhSTR9KtsjXn4eBEFd5YCcGbBWC1y6WYgemz8WzNJq13AXwn7Kmu.png)
<sub>Adapted from Mercosur.int, State.gov; published at [Cuba Inc.: the 176 reforms, the new oligarchy, and the global rush for the Caribbean Hub (Part 4)](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@potterplux/cuba-inc--the-176-reforms-the-new-oligarchy-and-the-global-rush-for-the-caribbean-hub-part-4)</sub>


## 8. The calendar: the October–november Transactional Deal

The Arctic isn't a summer emergency. It's a long game — one that will accelerate after November. The model suggests every actor — Washington, Moscow, Beijing, Havana — is playing against the same underlying clock.


![Pic4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/potterplux/23uFu87t8JcAiuAoHnJeywB9mzvsmUTZgEx53hdu2mPeC1jf9syQRVNe9Hz6oUQeyMYJn.png)
<sub>Author´s own creation</sub>

The timing appears aligned: everything points to a transactional deal between the powers, driven by the US midterms and Trump's need to show results without being able to sustain meaningful aid to Ukraine, or a Europe that can't absorb much more energy pressure. The Arctic could be the stage for that deal — and the Northern Route, with its double value as both a supply chain and an AI-infrastructure frontier, the prize that justifies it.

## 9. Rubio's role (the throughline)

And behind this move, as has become customary in this series, stands Marco Rubio. Not in the headlines, but in the dispatches. In the quiet deals. In the visits that aren't announced. In the design of a strategy that doesn't carry his name, but carries his fingerprints. Rubio isn't a secondary player. He's the silent architect who has been weaving this board piece by piece, from the Senate to the White House, from Miami to Havana, and now, from the Caribbean to the Arctic.

In the Arctic, Rubio shows up as the one negotiating the Senate budget for bases in Greenland; the one linking Caribbean security to security at the North Pole; the one who understands that control of the ice is control of the future.

A model reading, still unconfirmed by original sourcing: Havana may be trying to route around Rubio to negotiate directly with Trump, offering control over Cuba's new economy in exchange for taking the senator out of the equation. If confirmed in the coming weeks, this would be the piece linking the Caribbean board to the Arctic board under the same logic: negotiate directly with whoever decides, not with whoever watches.

## 10. Conclusion: the map keeps being drawn

We've covered the south (Caracas, Havana) and now the north (the Arctic). The board is bigger, colder and more decisive than we imagined — and this week, for the first time in this series, we didn't have to wait for facts to confirm the model: they arrived while we were writing it.

**The south is reordering. The north is bracing. But the Arctic, the great forgotten frontier, will decide who holds power in the twenty-first century. Because winter isn't a metaphor. And ice, when it melts, doesn't disappear: it becomes a route, a resource, a conflict**.

The series continues. The next chapter, artificial intelligence as the meta-board, will cross every thread that came before. Don't miss it.

body.title: Da die Politik und das Delegationsvolk meint, man muesse so handeln, wie man es macht, werde ich hiermit verkuenden...
body.body:
das ich mich gegen euch alle Wenden werde, wenn ihr weiterhin eure Stimmen an Dritte vergebt und damit politische Streomungen, welche sich gegen Personen wie mich richten, unterstuetzt.

Ich werde meine Faehigkeiten dann, gegen das Wohl der Allgemeinheit einsetzen.

Ich werde sobald mir die Hutschnur platzt, anfangen, mich gegen ALLE Menschen zu richten und ihre Systeme stoeren so Gut ich kann.

Ich werde der Stein im Schuh sein, von dem Niemand weis, wo er gerade liegt und im naechstem Moment drueckt.

Da ich sowieso um mein Leben zu fuerchten habe, wenn das so weitergeht, außerhalb des persoenlichen Horrors als Minderbemittelter in dieser Gesellschaft, habe ich auch nichts mehr zu Verlieren.

Entsprechende Entwicklungen fuer das Allgemeinwohl werden damit eingestellt und auf Eis gelegt.

Jede Positive Ankuendigung revidiert und ins Gegenteil verkehrt.

Ich habe die Freiheit, mich zu Entscheiden, wo ich stehe und ich stehe auf der Seite der Vernunft. 

Wenn diese den Bach runtergeht, weil sie sich still und heimlich unterdruecken laesst, gibt es keine Seite mehr fuer mich.

Ihr werdet selbst wissen, wann das Maß bei mir Voll ist.

Das muesste schon Voll sein, wenn man mitdenken kann. 

Also alles nur noch eine Frage der Zeit und der Wille des Volkes, den sehe und hoere ich ja...

Macht euch eure kleinen Dikatoren, Preisverleihungen und Gleichschrittsgedanken immer mit dem Wissen, das ihr etwas Vergessen haben werdet.

Salve

Sascha Pürner

body.title: Arepas made with cornmeal and seeds [Eng-Esp]
body.body:
> Greetings, fellow food lovers! Welcome back to my kitchen. Today I want to share a delicious and very easy-to-make recipe with you: arepas made with cornmeal and seeds. Join me, and I’ll show you how to make them. >>Saludos amigos amantes de la buena comida! Sean bienvenidos una vez más a mi cocina. En esta oportunidad les quiero compartir una receta deliciosa y muy fácil de preparar, se trata de unas arepas con harina de maíz y semillas. Acompáñame y te muestro el proceso de preparación. ![1000581693.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/48RsK1ehLZVVwaXdAebCQcBYYxKyU4JvzaJDvhLLMNuhjnUmxmH5WJtbL5MpYNVSXL.jpg) ### ***Ingredients:*** 2 cups yellow cornmeal 2½ cups cold mineral water 6 grams salt 7 grams chia seeds 7 grams white sesame seeds 7 grams black sesame seeds 15 grams rolled oats 15 milliliters soybean oil >***Ingredientes:*** > >>2 tazas de harina de maíz amarilla >>2 tazas y media de agua mineral fresca >>6 gramos de sal >>7 gramos de semillas de Chía >>7 gramos de ajonjolí blanco >>7 gramos de ajonjolí negro >>15 gramos de avena en hojuelas >>15 mililitros de aceite de soya ![1000581271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uQxeMGtTHxabaeEE2dg9DU8a7aHGetduofZUPUjPkr44tRehyhmcWBzVpkiS3jyZ4rW.jpg) ### ***Preparation:*** Place the flour in a large bowl and add the water, salt, and oil. A tip for this step is to let the flour sit with the wet ingredients for 5 minutes so the dough turns out smooth and easy to work with. >***Preparación:*** > >>Colocamos en un recipiente grande la harina y agregamos el agua junto con la sal y el aceite. Un tips para este momento, seria dejar reposar la harina con los ingredientes húmedos por 5 minutos para que la masa quede suave y manejable. |![1000581274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tmQYjSNytpFhipekRkqCnc3n3eWvQacsGatSTWRfKN5iqPHAuKt2LDFfh66gDwHbrbD.jpg)|![1000581276.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23xL11Bj8SCP3ArJRJCqSeX4iCKr6XV781XpJHmfzajAWmvCnXJBEDWf9etFcizmCKAiR.jpg)| |-|-| Let's mix it very well with a large teaspoon so there are no lumps in the flour. >>Vamos a mezclar muy bien con ayuda de una cucharilla grande para que no queden grumos en la harina. ![1000581278.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uQxeSpJKdCdLw6WU1vrijJparnFhp14W4Y45YqdvvkzLFiEdP5b4UZ8rNGojRNJ2yE9.jpg) Once the mixture is well combined, we'll stir in the oats and seeds. Continue mixing until they are evenly distributed throughout the dough. >>Luego de tener una mezcla compacta, vamos a incorporar la avena y las semillas. >> >>Continuamos mezclando hasta que se repartan bien por toda la masa. ![1000581279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23xeoyGds6yQkgSkXjaUucyffrkGkz27NUSu2LYBZhqCgB5qq92svm98B3KuDH5uDLkNm.jpg) Once the dough is ready, let's make our arepas. I used a tool that has been passed down through generations in my family, and in less than a minute, I had 3 arepas ready. >>Una vez que esté lista la masa, vamos a hacer nuestras arepas. Yo utilicé un aparato que ha pasado de generación en generación de mi familia y es menos de un minuto tenía 3 arepas listas. |![1000581280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/242YByzVmXsKXiB9bMP7sbpTcURehLqqa3mUHDwrBFhaUyG9eGRje4dKKvni1762Qu8Xk.jpg)|![1000581281.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/243fvYkEDDmTiAb9m6XNqSbaYbZVFBMf3kX7K6G3ZPUeLfZC8KUNHofsaiTbKg2ejUPZg.jpg)| |-|-| This arepa maker is very easy to use. Form a ball of dough about the size of a clenched fist. Place the ball inside the arepa maker and press down. Remove the arepa and place it directly into the skillet. >>Es muy sencillo de utilizar este arepero. Hacemos una bola de masa del tamaño del puño cerrado. Colocamos la bola dentro del arepero y aplastamos. Retiramos la arepa y llevamos directo al sartén. |![1000582326.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/EqBe6t9XrnYK1EjKk4XhRyJeGZMEA36UjS4CRpAerSxShbHVNr1W8ab7DDMgWxTTDyv.gif)|![1000582327.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/EqL9kPGST3F9No6nSKfWt2odgx8Wf9xwqN3ah5RYZamRSDE4y8mLHxdyehr4aQJSN1f.gif)| |-|-| In about 10 minutes, they'll be golden brown on one side, and we should flip them over so they brown on the other side. >>En aproximadamente 10 minutos estarán doradas por un lado y debemos voltearlas para que se doren por el otro lado. ![1000581287.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23wgKKufT3dJsr15R4868EzGkiQvczP4Sq8Tc1Sx4UHXqCGDsFEf5hqo3QbvvUKYFtJtF.jpg) And that's it. We can enjoy our arepas. The oats and seeds provide the arepas with fiber and the wonderful benefits of sesame and chia, plus that crunch that I personally love in an arepa. >>Y listo. Podemos disfrutar de nuestras arepas. La Avena y las semillas le aportan a ls arepas la fibra, las propiedades maravillosas del ajonjolí y la Chía, además de agregar ese crocante que a mi particularmente me encanta en una arepa. ![1000581506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/241tQfkyY4VZoRqZt2QiQrhFe5p5aYw3wPrWGKQbU3W2JUdR1GfJ9awBs42b9rQTFf8YL.jpg) I hope you like this recipe—it's as easy as it is healthy. See you next time. Bye! >>Espero que les guste esta receta tan fácil como saludable. Nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad. Chao! ![1000581503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uFc9tEAnuN4DV3TpUaYbmKd9u7kQHFvAzow5kBwyjVaqkZrLwai9J2Ww1KH2G3rm1E5.jpg)
![Imagen1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uFHApKMJ2KLfcNj7uB8npK7eh8YSr1SfRRe3uFGHhKaYrZyvVAJv2gmYqpfMVDXpQo3.png)
![dc.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23vsQXy7LQ3MpruNZZRongjLKChyCAL2QsKq7X9Pf5mQbYQq5jJpr3jwuxEx2Net7u2JN.png) Original content by the author. body.title: Se formó el quilombo/ [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/numa26/23tcJGSDh9AjJ8GM98XE6ff3ok4nyKkBDcBB2vxyT3viy72UZ51SC44aS6875VRgyF4SF.png)</center>






<center>De quilombos hablaré, 
porque de eso nada sé.  
Lo que les voy a contar,
tal vez los vaya a enredar.  
            ⚾️
Tendrán de primera mano 
respuestas que no en vano, 
se instalaron en mi mente
por curiosa e insistente.  
    ⚾️
Lo que sí me queda claro 
Es que no es nada raro.
que quilombo es todo un lío, 
a veces incomprendido.

>![ingles]I'll talk about messes,
because I know nothing about them.
What I'm going to tell you,
might confuse you.
⚾️
You'll have firsthand
answers that, not for nothing,
stuck in my mind
out of curiosity and persistence.
⚾️
What is clear to me
is that it's nothing strange.
that a mess is a whole entanglement,
sometimes misunderstood.

<div class=\

>

He querido comenzar con estos versos para introducir el tema, pues creo que no contaré, experiencias de quilombos. Me parece que con el quilombo que hay en este momento en mi país, tengo suficiente letra, y creo que el mundo entero lo conoce.

Lo que sí me puse a chequear, porque me dio mucha curiosidad, fue descubrir la cantidad de palabras que se usan en distintos países para definir un quilombo. Empezaré por mi país, Venezuela, porque tenemos una verborrea tan variopinta, que a veces suena a humor. Y es que así somos.

Cuando hay una discusión y se va calentando el ambiente, la expresión popular es: ***se prendió un peo***, ***Se armó el zafarrancho***.  ***Hay fuego en el 23***.  Y si se van de las manos: ***Se armó la coñaza***.

Si nos vamos a la Madre Patria, España, cuando hay una confrontación acalorada entre varios dicen: ***Se armó la de Dios es Cristo el 2 de mayo***.

En México, entre cuates: ***qué bronca***, ***polvorín*** y ***mitote***.
En Ecuador, Perú y Venezuela también: ***Se armó la de San Quintín***, cuando la pelea se pone fuerte.

En fin, hay muchísimas acepciones. Muy variadas y dependiendo de cada región o país. Pero decidí no seguir buscando en mi memoria porque ya ***se me estaba formando un quilombo mental***. Aunque dije que no contaría ninguna experiencia, no puedo dejar de echarles este cuento corto.

>![ingles]I wanted to begin with these verses to introduce the topic, since I don't think I'll be sharing any experiences of chaotic situations. I think the current chaos in my country is enough to give me material, and I believe the whole world knows about it.
What I did start looking into, because I was very curious, was discovering the number of words used in different countries to describe a chaotic situation. I'll start with my country, Venezuela, because we have such a varied vocabulary that it sometimes sounds like a joke. And that's just how we are.
When there's an argument and things start to heat up, the popular expression is: \
(there's a fire in the 23rd).\nAnd if things get out of hand: \
(a real brawl broke out). Let's go to the Motherland, Spain, where when there's a heated confrontation between several people they say: \
(all hell broke loose on May 2nd).\nIn Mexico, among friends: \

(a big fuss).
In Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela too: all hell broke loose when the fighting got intense.
Anyway, there are countless meanings. Very varied and depending on each region or country. But I decided not to keep searching my memory because I was already getting into a mental mess. Although I said I wouldn't share any experiences, I can't help but tell you this short story.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/numa26/23u64xVK1WCoznyFD2og8Zxn3Qx9XEN5R8yPNHEsN5RPaL5kVQGsbQ9jveURAGJzk5BKv.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/equipo-de-beisbol-campeones-1526701/)

En Caracas —recordemos que somos un país amante del béisbol— mientras dura la serie siempre hay piques entre lo rivales, de cada región. Este fue  un juegazo entre el equipo del ***Caracas***, contra el del ***Magallanes*** ***“Los eternos rivales”***. Durante el juego, todo bien. Después del juego se lanzan latas de cerveza entre los fanáticos, dentro del estadio. Así suele ser...
Esa vez fui con mis amigos al estadio. Ganó el Caracas y al salir, ya se nos había pasado el furor del partido y teníamos hambre. Tranquilamente, nos fuimos a una arepera. Ya en la mesa, pedimos cervezas y nuestras deliciosas arepas. Empezamos a comentar sobre el juego, y las mejores jugadas entre amigos. 
Pero en la mesa de al lado, estaban  unos fanáticos que habían apostado dinero y estaban arrechos, porque perdió el Magallanes. Se fue acalorando la discusión y comenzaron a insultarse entre sí, hasta salieron a relucir palos, porque armas no había. Nosotros no nos metimos en ese lío, para no aparecer, pero todo se transformó en la pelea del siglo.

>![ingles]In Caracas—remember, we're a baseball-loving country—there are always rivalries between teams during the series. It was a great game between the Caracas team and the Magallanes team, \

During the game, everything was fine. After the game, beer cans were thrown around among the fans inside the stadium. That's how it was. That time, I went to the stadium with my friends. Caracas won, and by the time we left, the excitement of the game had subsided, and we were hungry. We casually went to an arepa stand. We ordered beers and arepas. We started talking about the game, the best plays, among friends. But at the next table, there were some fans who had placed bets and were furious because Magallanes lost. The argument escalated, and they started insulting each other, and even sticks came out, since there were no guns. We didn't get involved, so as not to be seen, but it all turned into the fight of the century. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/numa26/23tHC6tTtUM9n6DXNHJssMt4FMyZXfvsLAmAT4T48qeLENxWnVUGRY2PkzJDGX2h7qYDn.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ventilador-fan%C3%A1ticos-2658152/)
Desde todas las mesas empezaron los gritos y no se podía controlar aquello. Volaban botellas de cervezas, insultos y arepas van y comida viene... El dueño de la arepera ya cansado de mandarlos a calmar, decidió llamar a la policía. Nos montaron en las patrullas y quedamos también detenidos. Amanecimos todos en la sede de la prefectura por daños al local y trifulca a media noche. Así fue como se vivió ese quilombo, en plena temporada de beisbol profesional en Caracas, Venezuela. ¡Tremendo peo, el que nos ganamos al llegar a casa! 😅🤣😁 >![ingles]From every table, shouting erupted, and it was completely out of control. Beer bottles flew, insults were hurled, and arepas and other food were thrown about... The owner of the arepa stand, tired of trying to calm them down, decided to call the police. They put us in the patrol cars, and we were detained too. We all spent the night at the police station for damage to the place and the midnight brawl. That's how that chaos unfolded, right in the middle of the season. What a mess we got when we got home! 😅🤣😁

Tears of an iris. Every time I saw drops of dew or rain on the petals of beautiful flowers called Iris, thoughts of tears came to me. Yes, it seemed that these flowers were crying and I think they had more than enough reasons for this. I'm not joking it's enough to remember at least one moment in my life when I saw a bouquet made by a florist in which these magnificent flowers were present. Do you know how many times I've seen such a bouquet? I've never seen it. And how many times have I seen iris flowers growing on a windowsill as they do with orchids? And here you guessed it I've never seen it but the iris flower can give odds in its beauty to many orchids. The destiny of the iris is to grow on some shady lawn where only a passerby can see it but because of the roadside dust few people will pay attention to these flowers. ![1d20190525_172553.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUru1S61w1g1Lx3ziu3FH5eQXAKFDp3Rff4Dt6UF6ncQn/1d20190525_172553.jpg) The structure of the flower is very interesting but its texture is so delicate that the iris will not last long in a bouquet and the windowsill will be too small for the spreading leaves of this plant. ![1d20190525_172559.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeo9Jbp3baLWXuZizAeKNCA94t66sEz6kYC4AwQtas5Hj/1d20190525_172559.jpg) Dew drops give all flowers a special charm including the iris but not all flowers have a reason for tears to appear on their petals and in the case of the iris it looks very plausible. ![1d20190525_172605.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdBWi6KB7BmPDiPF6P56t4ZDpfBdhjMLRcmuQmM7JC6rk/1d20190525_172605.jpg) All the photos for the competition were taken from my personal photo archive and edited by me. body.title: [TV] Power Book III: Raising Kanan(2021) Review
body.body:
**Power Book III: Raising Kanan** took us back to 1990s Queens and tells the story of **Kanan Stark** before he became the ruthless man we met in Power. 
The series focused heavily on his family, especially his complicated relationship with his mother, **Raq Thomas**.

**Kanan** started out as a teenager trying to understand the world around him. His mother, however, was already deeply involved in the drug business and has built a reputation that comes with plenty of enemies. While **Raq** tried to protect her family and expand her operation, **Kanan** gradually became more involved in the business.

What made the story interesting was how complicated **Raq and Kanan's** relationship became. **Raq** genuinely cared about her son, but many of her decisions ended up exposing him to the exact lifestyle she should have protected him from. She wanted Kanan to be strong, yet some of the things she did forced him to grow up much faster than he should.

**Mekai Curtis** portrayed **Kanan** convincingly. You can actually see the difference between the young Kanan at the beginning and the person he eventually became. He became more confident, more calculating, and much less trusting as the story progresses.

**Patina Miller** was also excellent as Raq. She's intelligent, determined, and sometimes extremely cold, but there are moments where you could see the mother underneath all of that. Her character wasn't easy to figure out, which made her even more interesting to watch.

The rest of the family brought their own problems into the story. Marvin, Lou-Lou, and Jukebox all had different personalities and goals, and their relationships with one another create plenty of tension. Nobody seemed completely innocent, and almost every decision came with consequences.

The 1990s setting also worked really well. The music, clothing, cars, and streets gave the series a different feel from the original Power. It has its own identity rather than feeling like a simple extension of the first show.

Another thing I liked was the pacing. The series didn't rely on constant action. A lot of the tension came from conversations, family arguments, secrets, and characters trying to figure out who they can trust. When the violence does happen, it usually feels connected to everything that has been building up.

Knowing what **Kanan** eventually became made his journey even more interesting. You're watching someone who starts out relatively inexperienced slowly get pulled deeper into a world where trust is difficult and survival often comes at a price.

Overall, **Raising Kanan** was a solid crime drama with strong characters and plenty of family drama. It's not just about the drug game; it's also about how Kanan's upbringing and the people around him helped shape the person he eventually became.

Images are screenshots from the movie.

**My Rating**:85/100

_Rating: **85/100**_

Happy Sunday, fellow Summoners!
This is @zusi78, and I’m still processing the feeling.

On the 11th of August I first stepped into Diamond III. Today, the 30th of August, after nineteen more days of pure ranked warfare, I have officially locked in Diamond II.

It took me another hundred hard-fought(win and lose)battles to finally unlocked Diamond II. Three hundred and forty-four total for the season so far. Back and forth. Win some, lose some. Every single match felt like a final. This has been the most intense and demanding modern ranked season I have experienced since I started grinding.


What made it special wasn’t just the climb — it was the opponents (**hrathen, voldemort13,batarakala, kudegra,valette and hosts of others**). Facing formidable players forced me to dig deeper into strategy, tactics, and team synergy. Every loss taught me something. Every win confirmed that the adjustments were working.


One small regret: I never got to share the battlefield with my warrior friends @atnazo and @dewabrata this season. Next season, gentlemen — the cards will be dealt again.

But the real joy? The lessons.
In Splinterlands we say it often, and this season proved it once more:
**Win or lose, there is always something new to learn — and that is awesome**.
The climb is done for now. The loot chests are waiting.
Follow along as I open them and show you what’s inside.

**Splinterlands is no walk in the park,but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building.Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)

Welcome to the Splinterlands. I've been playing this game daily since 2021, it's a great game and fantastic community.

In Frontier, I find Water and Earth the strongest, Fire and Death equally next, SO if you are building a deck I'd focus on Water first then Earth.

You will see many of the common strategies as you play opponents, I find the best way to learn is to look at a game you lost, replay it and try to see what was it in your opponents strategy/lineup/cards that was key to their victory. It may not be a specific card, it may be a general strategy, but some times it's a key card, or a combination of both

What is your in game name ?

body.body:
The best time of the year and also the most painful time of the year for me at my Holiday home. As I have mentioned previously also that I have put up my home stay on Airbnb also and these are the months when it is peak booking season. The season starts from May onwards as the school holiday begins and goes on till around end of August. In this period, it is the best time to make up for the full year because then rest of the months there is business but barely any profits. Which also means that I get less time to spend here.

Weekends is when I avoid to come here because these are the days when definitely we get bookings, and also there is mad rush in the town, so if you have any work and you step out of home then you are going to land up in chaos. Weekdays are perfect for peaceful and quiet times. There is some or the other maintenance work all the time going on, so when the town is empty it's best time to do all the work.

Right now, this place looks nothing less than a heaven, at least I feel this. All around there is greenery, It feels like we are staying in the midst of clouds, feels like a paradise. This is the best part and the painful part is, due to excess rain in this region there is always some or the other issue with electricals and overall maintenance goes up. Welcome back! While you’re showing some love to my previous craft project, I want to share a new look with you that I’m really excited about.

 I’ve titled this post \

—a topic that came up after a conversation with one of my followers. People sometimes think I wear miniskirts just because I like them; and while I do love them, it’s also important to know which clothes flatter us and which don’t.

 For instance, I would never wear a knee-length skirt, as it would make me look shorter and feel uncomfortable to walk in by hiding my silhouette.

 I remember being teased about my height back in high school, but over time I learned that the issue wasn't my size—it was about knowing how to choose the right garments for my body. I’ve noticed that miniskirts suit me very well because they highlight my silhouette without overwhelming my frame.

 You don’t have to be a stylist to learn what looks good on you based on your body type and height—all while staying true to your personal taste and favorite colors.

 For this look, I chose a soft-fabric miniskirt and a rustic-style shirt with a yellow floral print; the result is lovely! I take every opportunity to share my outfits here because my friends have encouraged me to post this kind of content and breathe life into the fashion community we have here at \

I am so grateful for the support you show my writing. Stay tuned for a future post where I’ll share an original poem of mine—I hope you’ll show it some love, too.

 As I wait for the power to come back on after a seven-hour outage, I’m sending you a big hug and sharing this post with lots of affection. Warmly, your dear friend, $@rix.

# HiveSuite & HiveReactKit 

## HiveReactKit: Odysee Video Support

### Native Odysee Embeds

* Added native support for **Odysee** video embeds throughout HiveReactKit.

* Odysee videos shared inside posts and Snaps are now detected automatically.

* Supports both:
  * Odysee iframe embeds
  * Direct Odysee video links



* Videos are rendered as fully embedded players instead of plain links.

Odysee Video Support

![Odysee Video Support](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNmJ3Z8gV979eY3sNjTWuFpkmz8BbgwRwVsckGaYC29F/image.png)


---

## Cleaner Media Rendering

### Automatic Content Cleanup

* Raw Odysee iframe code is automatically removed from rendered post content.

* Direct Odysee URLs are also hidden once a playable video is available.

* Keeps the original post clean while preserving the author's written content.

### Shared Media Experience

* Odysee support has been integrated across:

  * Post Detail pages
  * Snaps Feed
  * Media Attachment Carousel


* Creates a consistent viewing experience across every supported content surface.

Embedded Odysee Player

![Embedded Odysee Player](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhrwffgW3sTo6jSmmUTtpMPpPSZCMxfSbLKs4M1waAWB/screenshot_2026_07_11_at_8.33.31_am.png)

---

## Internal Improvements

### Shared Media Infrastructure

* Extended the reusable media renderer with Odysee support.

* Improved automatic media detection for embedded content.

* Successfully built, installed, and verified the updated HiveReactKit package.

Media Rendering Improvements

![Media Rendering Improvements](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpxv2Z58BJKYP2pBGhF24BrRgG2KTs7N1z5jqoUejeED/image.png)


---

# HiveSuite: Local Currency Market Prices

## Multi-Currency Market Popup

### Local Currency Support

* Added local currency support to the Market Prices popup.

* Users can now view market prices in currencies beyond USD.

* Currency values update automatically using real-time conversion rates.

### Currency Selector

* Added a dedicated currency selection dropdown.

* **USD** is now the default currency.

* The user's local currency is automatically pinned as the second option for faster access.

Market Currency Selector

![Market Currency Selector](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPU1ByJoz5jFUQTfuovWrPNFwRPc4JUXGa2nKaHxkBsGH/image.png)



---

## Improved Market Experience

### Real-Time Conversion

* Added live currency conversion for market prices.

* HIVE, HBD, and other displayed values now update instantly based on the selected currency.

* Makes portfolio values easier to understand for users worldwide.

### Better Popup Behavior

* Fixed the currency selector scrollbar.

* Fixed an issue where the market popup could unexpectedly close while scrolling.

* Improved interaction reliability throughout the Market Prices popup.

Local Currency Market Prices

![Local Currency Market Prices](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaKFDmj4rvmGXtfYFMrPM7FqsHfUQz2Gbuw8yxbRnWg5k/image.png)

### Market Popup Refinements

* Added multi-currency support.

* Introduced a custom currency selector.

* Improved popup interaction behavior.

* Fixed scrolling-related UI issues.

* Successfully rebuilt and verified the HiveSuite application.

---

## Powering the Hive Ecosystem

- Continuously improving HiveReactKit with richer media support that makes Hive content more interactive and enjoyable to browse.
- Enhancing HiveSuite with localized features that provide a better experience for users around the world.
- Contributing open-source improvements that strengthen usability, consistency, and interoperability across the Hive ecosystem.

body.title: Evening walk along the breakwater lookout at the Cinta Costera (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Greetings, fellow travelers; I hope you are having a wonderful day. Today, I’m sharing my visit to the waterfront promenade and lookout located behind the Hernán Marín Amphitheater—part of the city’s coastal strip—specifically along the artificial breakwater made of large rocks situated behind the Marina Plaza shopping center. This extensive coastal area features various spaces dedicated to recreation and leisure; the breakwater itself is a popular rocky path for watching the sunset and taking in the beautiful scenery of Cacique Maraguey Avenue and the spectacular beach views. From this spot, you can see the city buildings and a panoramic view of the beach. We had long wanted to explore this area and walk all the way to the far end, so we planned an outing during my son's vacation and set off in the afternoon. When we arrived, there were many people walking and sitting on the seawall; we moved forward and positioned ourselves in the middle, where we could admire the spectacular beach views and enjoy the cool breeze. As we walked along the path, we felt the fresh air and took in the beautiful sunset landscape, with the clouds showing shades of white and gray and the sun's rays barely visible.

> **
ESPAÑOL

/>

Sgt. Vincent Trent found his wife Melissa both laughing and crying, a pink gel pen in her hand.

“So you know how I am doing the paperwork for Velma's paintings to be in that young artist's virtual gallery that is going to be opening up in October,” she said. “So, I'm doing it by hand because scrolling makes me aggravated.”

“I understand,” Sgt. Trent said as he embraced her.

“So, my pen died, and that cutie pie Amanda Ludlow was over here visiting with Gracie and saw my distress and ran up and said, 'Use my pen – and here's some snugglecouragement so you feel better!'”

“That's so Amanda,” Sgt. Trent said.

“So then of course, Gracie said that an artist application is going to look better in hot pink because it shows creativity, so I had to sit down between them and fill the whole thing out to their satisfaction … and then they wanted to make it better, so...”

Mrs. Trent handed her husband the application, and he broke out laughing.

“They got the purple and the orange in here – this is a work of art!” he said.

“So obviously, I gotta start over,” Mrs. Trent said, “but as I was printing out the new one, the first pen at hand was Amanda's!”

“Ah ha,” Sgt. Trent said, and then reached into his pocket. “I'll relieve you of that duty. Use my pen.”

title.title: Escaping The Perfectionism Trap
title.body: >\n\nOne of the things that limit the progress of people is the trap of perfectionism. That is, they want every single detail to be without flaw. What you have to understand is that, more often than not, \

Someone can start a task, spend a lot of hours in trying to fine-tune every detail, yet does not finish the task. Or someone may have a great idea, or a dream of what they want to do, but because they are too worried and concerned that it may not appear flawless, they may not start at all. This is perfectionism trap. Some people may view perfectionism as something good because they believe it gives them high standards. But what they fail to understand is that it may be the thing limiting them from taking steps.

<center>![pexels-goldcircuits-4205906.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFWwCaG4PTPWY663mKqzy9Vegi8shjjbu4pkRZ7gGbKY/pexels-goldcircuits-4205906.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/monochrome-photo-of-quote-signage-4205906)</sub></center>

Someone may want to do something great, but because of fear of being judged, fear of making mistakes, or fear of not doing it well, they may not start. This fear can paralyse someone and lock the person's best ideas inside their mind. One of the dangers of perfectionism is that the absolute \

does not even exist in reality. No matter how hard you try, and how hard you work, you will still find a small flaw. If you keep waiting for the perfect time to start, you may keep waiting forever. If you want to start a business for example, and you are waiting for the perfect support to start, you may not even start. You cannot predict life, so the perfect moment you expect may not come. This is why you have to start with what you have.\n\nThe main superpower is not really \

If you want to achieve your goals, then you have to start. You have to focus on your finish line rather than being flawless. By that, you will unlock a lot of hidden benefits. A completed project that has a couple of mistakes is far better than a supposed perfect one that was never finished. At least, the imperfect but completed one will give you a real feedback on what to improve on. You will be able to see what worked and what did not work, so you will be able to do better next time. Any task you finish will teach you the necessary lessons that you will need to make the next attempt better.

I once read about the story of Reid Hoffman who is the founder of the popular website LinkedIn. When he was building the very first version of the website back in the early 2000s, he had a lot of tough choices to make. The first version, even though was functional to an extent, but it looked ugly, messy, and it lacked a lot of features. The Perfectionism instincts in him wanted to make him delay a bit so as to fix everything before launching. But he knew that any further delay might kill the idea of his business. Well, he chose to launch the website even without being perfect. To his surprise, it worked, and people liked the concept behind it, and they started to use it immediately.

As people used it, they gave their feedback and told him what to improve on, and what to work on. This made him to fix the website based on the real human needs, not on guesses and speculations. That was how LinkedIn started growing. Now, it has gained massive user-base, and Hoffman him has become a billionaire. When he was being interviewed sometimes ago, he made a statement, he said \

He did not wait until the website was flawless before he launched it. Rather he simply launched it, got feedback from people, learnt a couple of things, and it got better over time.
![pexels-prateekkatyal-2740955.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmenBhD8b1a3KG4e1atCSQ5q6LPgeeQoyvMdRGhDQo24Mx/pexels-prateekkatyal-2740955.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-photography-of-a-cellphone-2740955)
Finishing a task and getting it done will give you momentum. When you complete something, it gives you a sense of winning, and will give you the zeal and the excitement to proceed with the next task. Action is what will build confidence, not overthinking which can create doubt. You will be surprised what the flawed but completed project can do to benefit others. A flawed book that you publish can inspire hundreds or thousands of readers than a perfect book that you never published. Always have in mind that the world will appreciate the idea that they have seen more than the flawless silence. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

title.title: Splinterlands: Combining Avina of the Wolf with Cleanse in Noxious Fumes
title.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I won because I used Avina of the Wolf.

## Featured cards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wfojn324kuRJAPwuuVfxSPfk6FRP6jJAkPw7gc8HAD4YWB17oARAxwthrrfdvgZMhXB.png)
Avina of the Wolf is a life archon that costs 5 mana. This splinter gives 2 monsters +2 speed or one monster heal. Leveling this card increases the level cap of the monsters you can use, and I think it's a fairly good archon.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23vhTmW59KpAXsCs8xYEAoBrF1ggbCk8P5RFSrkeJUfCAqMoS1q2qtx19m6YGnHU4pQ1F.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Noxious Fumes. This means that all monsters start off poisoned. There is also 28 mana available, and I can use any [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for earth.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Avina of the Wolf|5|Summoner|+2 speed or heal|
|Mantaroth|11|1st|Shield and Armored Strike|
|Meriput Magician|5|2nd|Tank Heal|
|Luceheim Demon|7|3rd|Snipe and Cleanse|
|Total Mana:|28|||

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. My archon is Avina of the Wolf for the tank on one monster. My tank is Mantaroth with shield and armored strike, followed by Meriput Magician with tank heal. Finally, I have Luceheim Demon with snipe and cleanse. With this, my Mantaroth is in a good position to outlast my opponent.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tbPi7bWvt3NGhvM9SdTqZVwAkzgjrbCcATX9LyUfYAquMCw63rb6LpUm4V9T22KWEyf.png)
At first glance, I think that this match is my win because I have heal on Mantaroth, and my opponent can't do enough damage to overcome it.

### Round 4

![round 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tbMB6Z1Av69XDhg9eDCVczKJ4SYC9BxoXYCLzNfHbiXW9vHuofpGTYMfp7Vx3zXt2kD.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent and me are down to 2 monsters. However, this is my win beecause the poison will kill off that magic monster, and my opponent can't damage me anymore.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tRvek25thooKRrDEfdaT7Fz6UZGhpNghV756jxpt4tnsqakGekdEs12h8HtyrJiaazK.png)
I won the match later that round.

## Conclusion
The battle did go exactly as planned. My plan to use Mantaroth as a tank with heal worked well, and the cleanse removed the poison. Combined with an extra tank heal, Mantaroth was just a beast as it was hard to kill. It allowed me to easily outlast my opponent and finish him off. 

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_d464d482be798b4566e4c0a7e80c1d15?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

title.title: Story time en el hogar: Cuando llovió dentro del cuarto de mi hijo
title.body:
>Hola, amigos, ¿qué tal? Es un gusto saludarles una vez más. Soy Yeli Marín, y sean bienvenidos a mi blog. Hoy quiero compartirles un story time de algo bastante estresante e insólito que me sucedió recientemente en uno de los cuartos de mi apartamento, específicamente en la habitación de mis hijos. Para ponerlos en contexto, vivo en un edificio pero en planta baja. Los vecinos que tengo justo arriba pasaron muchísimo tiempo sin habitar el inmueble, hasta que hace poco se mudaron unos familiares de los dueños del lugar.
El problema comenzó cuando instalaron un aire acondicionado de ventana de 12.000 BTU justo sobre el cuarto de mi hijo. Hablé con la vecina desde el primer momento porque el drenaje goteaba hacia la parte baja y salpicaba toda la pared exterior de la habitación, provocando una humedad constante. Ella me aseguró que ese equipo tenía un sistema que evaporaba el agua y que no botaba nada, pidiéndome que esperara unos dos meses a que su esposo regresara de viaje para buscar una solución.

>Con el tiempo la gotera seguía, a veces sí y a veces no, así que no le presté tanta atención hasta que ocurrió lo peor.
Anoche viví un momento de profunda tensión cuando mi hijo y un amiguito que jugaba en su cuarto vinieron a buscarme asustados porque, literalmente, ¡estaba lloviendo dentro de la habitación!

\n\n>

>Hi, friends, how are you? It’s a pleasure to say hello to you once again. I’m Yeli Marín, and welcome to my blog. Today I want to share a story with you about something quite stressful and unusual that happened to me recently in one of the rooms in my apartment—specifically, in my kids’ bedroom. To give you some context, I live in an apartment building, but on the ground floor. The neighbors right above me hadn’t lived there for a very long time, until recently, when some relatives of the building’s owners moved in.

>The problem began when they installed a 12,000 BTU window air conditioner right above my son’s room. I spoke with my neighbor right away because the drain was leaking downward and splashing all over the outside wall of the room, causing constant dampness. She assured me that the unit had a system that evaporated the water and didn’t leak at all, asking me to wait about two months for her husband to return from his trip so they could find a solution. Over time, the leak continued—sometimes it would happen, sometimes it wouldn’t—so I didn’t pay much attention to it until the worst happened.

>Last night I experienced a moment of intense anxiety when my son and a little friend who was playing in his room came looking for me, terrified because it was literally raining inside the room!

\n\n

>La estructura de este edificio es metálica, con tornillos enormes, y los pisos están separados por una lámina de losa acero de un espesor considerable que tiene un sobrepiso arriba (que viene siendo el piso de mi vecina). Al entrar al cuarto y ver que la chapa metálica de mi techo estaba llena de agua y goteando sin parar, quedé totalmente impresionada, porque en teoría el concreto superior debió haberme protegido.
Alarmada por la situación, corrí a desconectar los equipos eléctricos y fui a hablar con la vecina. Ella me salió con que era imposible que fuera su aire y culpó a los vecinos de más arriba, ¡algo totalmente absurdo porque el vecino superior ni siquiera tiene aire acondicionado en ese cuarto! La señora no se mostró nada receptiva y se molestó cuando le exigí buscar una solución urgente, ya que no tengo dónde reubicar a las carreras las cosas de mi hijo ni dónde va a dormir.

>Esa misma noche nos tocó vaciar el agua del techo usando un coleto y trapos absorbentes mientras pensábamos en cómo frenar semejante desastre.Al día siguiente, analizando la situación a fondo con una explicación técnica de por medio, entendí el origen del problema.

\n\n>

>This building has a metal frame with huge bolts, and the floors are separated by a steel slab of considerable thickness with another floor above it (which happens to be my neighbor’s floor). When I walked into the room and saw that the metal sheet on my ceiling was full of water and dripping nonstop, I was completely shocked, because in theory the concrete slab above should have protected me.

>Alarmed by the situation, I rushed to unplug the electrical appliances and went to talk to my neighbor. She told me it was impossible for it to be coming from her air conditioner and blamed the neighbors above us—which is completely absurd because the neighbor above doesn’t even have an air conditioner in that room! The woman wasn’t at all receptive and got upset when I demanded she find an urgent solution, since I had nowhere to quickly move my son’s things or anywhere for him to sleep.

>That very night, we had to mop up the water from the ceiling using a bucket and absorbent rags while we figured out how to stop such a disaster. The next day, after thoroughly analyzing the situation with a technical explanation, I understood the source of the problem.

\n\n

>El agua del aire no caía al suelo de su apartamento, sino que se filtraba por el marco de la ventana; como sus paredes tienen un sistema de anime, este material absorbe el agua y la empuja directo a la losa acero. Como su lado de la losa no manifiesta humedad, todo el peso del líquido se desplaza silenciosamente y termina colándose hacia abajo, exactamente en mi techo. ¡Una locura que me ha tenido todo el día secando, escurriendo y abriendo ventanas para ventilar!
Por la mañana le escribí hablándole con bases claras, comentándole que consulté a un ingeniero de los que construyó el edificio y que si esa filtración seguía constante, iba a debilitar la estructura y poner en riesgo la losa. Al rato vi que improvisó colocando una bandeja de pintura con una manguerita debajo del aire, lo cual redujo un poco el flujo de agua.

>Sin embargo, no estoy convencida al cien por ciento de que sea una solución definitiva. Le propuse impermeabilizar la parte baja de la ventana y me negó rotundamente la ayuda, diciendo que su esposo había hecho un trabajo perfecto.
Le daré unos días de margen para ver si el techo termina de secar y la bandeja funciona, pero si la situación persiste tendré que acudir a las instancias legales del edificio, un trámite tedioso que de verdad quisiera evitar.

\n\n>

>The water in the air wasn’t falling onto the floor of his apartment; instead, it was seeping through the window frame. Since his walls are made of anime, this material absorbs the water and pushes it straight onto the steel slab. Since his side of the slab shows no signs of moisture, the entire weight of the liquid silently shifts and ends up seeping downward—right onto my ceiling. It’s crazy—I’ve spent the whole day drying things off, wringing them out, and opening windows to air out the place!

>This morning I wrote to her, laying out the facts clearly, explaining that I’d consulted an engineer who worked on the building and that if this leak continued, it would weaken the structure and put the slab at risk. A little while later, I saw that she’d improvised by placing a paint tray with a small hose underneath the vent, which reduced the flow of water a bit.

>However, I’m not 100 percent convinced that this is a permanent solution. I suggested waterproofing the bottom of the window, but she flatly refused my help, saying that her husband had done a perfect job.
I’ll give it a few days to see if the ceiling finishes drying and the tray works, but if the situation persists, I’ll have to go through the building’s legal channels—a tedious process that I’d really like to avoid.

\n\n

> Lo peor es que esta es la segunda filtración que sufro por culpa de vecinos irresponsables. Aunque mi sueño original era vivir en una casa, el destino me trajo a este apartamento en planta baja que he adaptado con tanto amor, pero siempre con la limitación de lidiar con los problemas de los pisos superiores. ¡Los mantendré informados de cómo evoluciona todo! Gracias por acompañarme y leerme. >

>The worst part is that this is the second time I’ve had a leak because of irresponsible neighbors. Although my original dream was to live in a house, fate led me to this ground-floor apartment that I’ve lovingly renovated—but I’m always limited by having to deal with problems from the floors above. I’ll keep you posted on how things unfold! Thank you for sticking with me and reading my posts.

\n\n

title.title: The illusion of hard work.
title.body:
# Greetings friends!

![Image](https://ipfs.3speak.tv/ipfs/QmcgXF4iqjCE9zRBqW6SxAo5dyRZGqQmHuNnpLjeVnPL3T)
(pixabay free image)

It is often taught us that hard work is the key to success. People give examples of people who became successful and rich. But this is an illusion. If hard work alone could make anyone successful, then the labourers who work fiercely all day would have been the most successful people. But reality is different. The most successful people are either lucky or belong to already successful families. Some become successful simply because they have good luck.

A person coming from a rich and powerful family already has an edge over others. They know how to get things done. They receive good education, high‑class training, and their family’s influence clears many hurdles from their path. On the other hand, a person from a poor background lacks vital information. They have to start from scratch. That’s why most successful people in history come from families that were already in advantageous positions.

In India, the IAS (administrative post) post is considered one of the most successful kinds of jobs. It gives a person immense power. But only a few hundred posts open every year. Millions study day and night, but when the posts are so few, only a few lucky ones get selected. Does this mean those who couldn’t succeed were not hardworking or were incompetent? Not at all. They simply were not as lucky as those who succeeded. Hard work matters only in situations where chances are equal for everyone - for example, in high school exams. Everyone has to cross a fixed barrier and does not have to compete directly with others. But in competitions like civil services exams, you need to be luckier and more innovative than others.

That’s why success does not depend solely on hard work. Luck also plays its role. In this world, where everything is structured like a pyramid, you cannot say that those who couldn’t reach the top were not working hard.

**Thanks!**

The weekend is a family time, so don't waste your time and do something fun. When I was a kid, there weren't many indoor playgrounds yet. But way back in the early 90s, most of the Mcdonald's has an indoor maze playground, so every time we ate at McDonald's, I always played on their indoor maze playground for free. But today, wherever you go, you can find an indoor playground, especially at the mall. Every indoor playground has a different type of obstacles and design.

When we visited a mall named **Opus Mall** in Pasig City, they had an indoor playground called \

. This indoor playground is bigger than the other indoor playground we already visited. But the bigger the indoor playground was, the more you paid. The one hour of play in Funtopia Park is **600 Php** or **9.64 Dollars**, which was double the price of other indoor playgrounds. Although this indoor playground is a little bit pricey, as long as my two daughters enjoyed playing, the price doesn't matter.

***

My youngest daughter played every obstacle she climbed in the rock climbing; she slid down every slide, she ran in every maze, and she really had fun.
