title.title: Street photography, plus the fair, lots of colour and wonderful architecture.
title.body:
> --- >One of the city’s most important events, and also one of the most eagerly anticipated, is the city fair; even tourists come from all over Europe to enjoy this event, which I think has been much busier this year than in previous years. --- ![Image_1787829140807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMguLVFp4LruHpeDagaczaDS4TkpJDKpcpEWj9Gmdcn2qQGUQ5EEfgyrwBQeayb6xcJ.jpg) --- Although I always take photographs of nature, art exhibitions and even the city streets, I try to ensure that people do not appear in the photos. The reason is that I don’t like to invade people’s privacy and, besides, as I don’t like having my photo taken, I do the same with everyone else. But this time it was very different; everyone was taking photographs, mainly of the streets, the decorations, the stalls selling all sorts of fair-related items, and even of the shows and the women dressed in traditional flamenco costumes, and, of course, most of the people doing this were tourists. So I felt like just another tourist. --- ![20260819_180421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yToVQYXC3ZWRA3ZUeP6Jnp7tqzFZbrtbbYTgKTopZBGSS7wJM2nBwvcGXUQgunmkXJE.jpg) ![20260819_180135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAaBsB1VVLchqaUSZSx6Z1SAGEdJ7M3XgXoJ2ThVwUiUPnsVZoz81y2tLrSXE82JFq4.jpg) ![20260819_180222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1FPhFW7qaabXnsF8CfQtKns5kEs6ac6wrya4SfuDjvQ37WzMF1zW51L7DMA1kvuU7y.jpg) ![20260819_180311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wX3o2CeDrb9y4TZk4tivxHx6EarQ6XKP1vUdJDYgiNVJY5PDKxq27ocx67VChWYGLf2.jpg) ![20260819_180517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ydETqa9qFAL2DiCQWC3wys4Jhm7NEU7a3GnDPrjUs1Tby7zUY7WVtt7uYP5AUPKX2rc.jpg) ![20260819_180544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245wMsbHjAXb6t7dMqX22cEx1YYUuNscisqGykQqD1YC6GgFaSKwNENqXFqc6uViaKuaS.jpg) --- That’s why I really enjoyed strolling amongst the crowds, admiring the ítems, especially the handcrafted ones, that the stalls were selling, but above all taking photos of the moment, as if capturing those fleeting moments of joy among the people, of this event that takes place once a year in the city and which embodies culture and tradition. That is precisely how it felt to walk amongst the people, that tradition of singing, dancing and the objects that form part of the culture, such as shawls, flowers of every colour, and fans ranging from simple ones to hand-painted ones, which are absolutely stunning. The infectious joy, the sense of sharing, all of that is part of the way of life of the people here, and that is what I wanted to capture in my photographs. --- ![20260819_180557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyg2EuW2DHKf7VhYM2oPDwA9J57qBmDjkBDsLqhCswoyGpFdyfA1evwUedzVe7fwwzL.jpg) ![20260819_180634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywyr9SZU8fqobQ7qeQmeqUHPCtbYHsph4coH6WqQVuq4jAzcH4fkQ3BLs38jVGqxp4c.jpg) ![20260819_180731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAgUjFB9jNqdp14pKEx3xBWRgqt44tdcjQWVzsMttZrCn2RPzsfeB2TP49g2f5NneUz.jpg) ![20260819_180822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8x6X9Mu3jiuZK5Fd5vyUCQCUaVQN4NnbccNysCt7651FySi43otiQB6AYfEoUujHdV.jpg) ![20260819_180853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1DKBG8f4f8ynWm88B3o5SrfebqqnRSW6YnXWGqZuaceGkXrVuSYvCT2E4h8sSNBacf.jpg) ![20260819_180906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yd9qG4bNGJTNeXxicDyrPsfyDK2B7r5G4EhZx6C6q6oDg2upKATM4R2XjjUibrrKph7.jpg) --- Of course, what caught my eye most were the embroideries on the shawls, and although they’re mass-produced rather than handmade, which is of inestimable value as it’s a first-class textile art, the flowers still stood out on them, as did the various designs and patterns on the fans. I never tire of saying it: those are the two things I like best. But I mustn’t fail to mention that the fact the fair takes place on Calle Larios gives it a distinctive style, as the buildings on this street are of exquisite architecture, as you can see. That, too, is art, and whilst today I’m not bringing you an exhibition of paintings inside a museum, art in the city can be found at every turn, and architecture is also an art form. --- ![20260819_180939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKziigVqnQmra2kBPShS7FYKhsA4uM5PiYbC11WVx24yQ4qH1CUs8mUoTySpEvSAfAg.jpg) ![20260819_181029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMeanLUDwb5ixhDAATxChvCHKoHSDhNPFeM82zonRCxyT22RpGeLhXjErt7wPQ9PgmZ.jpg) ![20260819_181054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z7L4tV1HnNrziVJpZGSt4DF5pLGJcDCXSvEm2XSmDngAqSj25rQykuoqjymj3PSZ6Cq.jpg) ![20260819_181057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJJcQkXf7ZY9r9x7LzDdMM3xnFgUxTuVQbX7ZBq6adHqPwkenYCaD1JmxzZtvqei983.jpg) ![20260819_181105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgS9cwA1gDdDGuMuFy2FsdBoxPBrkdvcT3riWKmTDN5jK9W8yJv3AVimmyJRsjfdBEW.jpg) --- At one point, I enjoyed standing in front of the monumental display that the council puts up every year for the fair, which on this occasion was completely new and colourful. I liked standing there and just pausing to take a few photos, as if the people were moving but everything else wasn’t. Capturing moments. I’ve seen this in the work of many photographers here on Hive and wanted to try it myself; I learn from them when I look at their photos, and I love that. ---
![20260819_181135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23qrQYNsGcoo9BRqdrhnmGRLiTcmbv5L1JJrUNGj3Jft79D89DXyh8xhjF9Xz3oimBXb8.jpg)
![20260819_181200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zS5FAXMgdFWchNjvir38L195PLzx2rWaZvHppzudZbLjeDM16H7qif8aXTTDBgvTFcG.jpg)
![20260819_181203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WVjySpKzxTzLmUMq1TcbHvyjtV3PEruaLJonDRtvivKfwh8tjyvsk8R6h7jbbZpBfS.jpg)

I crossed the road and there were more stalls, but I was also struck by the fair-themed decorations at a very new and modern hotel. Chairs arranged in various shapes, symbolising dance and flamenco. --- ![20260819_181227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yToMi1coJTExRb3REjpntR4XQYhUXyZYxtimTG9zsFKAzFL54m2Ff4aixrZzdXD6gDu.jpg)

Hi, friend, I think exploring delegations as a payment method is an excellent idea. It's a very practical option. The possibility of doing it through delegations, paying the rest in Hive or HBD, seems interesting to me, at least; I don't know what other users think.

As a suggestion, I'd like to see a calculator: a simple tool within the platform where the user enters the amount of HP they want to delegate, and the system automatically calculates the discount they'll receive and the exact amount to pay in HIVE/HBD.

This way, any user, regardless of their budget, could take advantage of this tool and see the available options or the most convenient one. It would also be more visually appealing.

For me, it would greatly facilitate our decision-making process, especially for those of us who don't have many HP.

title.title: Bread Pudding
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbMTPUL4d5r7nFTYA4YSKYgG1hJpSo4EttYkkBETdZLmk/1788065860041.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, enjoy your weekend! Today I’m going to share a light, sweet treat that’s easy to make. I used some leftover white bread I had at home, along with eggs and milk, to make this snack. As a lover of dairy products, I find this recipe very practical, it has a soft texture and tastes delicious. Okay, let’s get right to it 

**Ingredients:**

- 4 slices of white bread
- 2 eggs
- 1 tbsp granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp vanilla extract 
- 2 tbsp cornstarch
- 200 ml milk 
- powdered sugar
- ground cinnamon

**Instructions:**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaz1hUsjmzyY8ASaPaVrZSrLS94CV3eJ3nBrb2PX36div/1788066072999.jpg)

- Prepared the white bread

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPMavbUigVc9oDq47PoizdR2YgiGo9i1cJ46p8ve1st2R/1788066103684.jpg)

- Cut the white bread into small pieces

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfcApBe2e3NFXeSKosi8JjTADrfB1xRAahQr72us1ttC/1788066140463.jpg)

- Place them in a heat-resistant bowl

- Set aside

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamredYTzsYRRTXmcCdKFyzEm4a3H1VPpjw18X7APcujM/1788066175179.jpg)

- Crack the eggs into a bowl

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqGMaXYKAquRuVHSkhxMJaFBgSCPBHByqj4wGRSv3KzM/1788066207634.jpg)

- Add the vanilla extract to the bowl

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdffJJCxounU8Dxiq1f2FMwcWTS5A14YE6fehPA1s3PM3/1788066229835.jpg)

- Add the cornstarch

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVkmCWNGhXH6ZV7gPoXp8VMggBuxA9JQDFELQHpZpGxYP/1788066270043.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSWgsPhNSNdY3zURyFpq5PaW7GVKCQzfJLtDEvaBX4tV4/1788066270227.jpg)

- Add the milk to the bowl 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6wARsbE2xSNeLQRgLgYiBJVhiSEvKjwPV1ExMUyn8dm/1788066294871.jpg)

- Stir all the ingredients until well combined

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tNqZ4ECpCnfW6kQTvetKrUpo2DqvW79DD2Wf1qwQ4/1788066313807.jpg)

- Strain the egg and milk mixture

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUugPT5TUxjMGc5Kg6WVy9nJfkWgFV1feTiWFGZHkNqoU/1788066333281.jpg)

- Pour the egg and milk mixture into the dish containing the bread 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCoZXENHmZaBLpDB3LHCu9fGCXkKkDfLmde6SdaaYPH7/1788066358047.jpg)

- Pour until the bread is submerged 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcF4YASTJWTcR5WKjC8iYG1H75fgNUTN2LrN8UhfJKp89/1788066390707.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYKozDAy5ZDaSW4FzhR68xEnKxy5DXrWRLaPEmJ5cB6g/1788066390875.jpg)

- Place in the oven and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmawFe5pKfTfM562oG4Jhq5VThFqv2DsXxSjpvDEWyidTU/1788066407474.jpg)

- Once cooked and set, remove the dish

- Let it cool

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfVSsL8tc5wgUZoNJgJVVomsehMZcaTWo79X9D2ZYfdoD/1788066430585.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZt86R27VXgUe5iv92oYqmBhBCBXS6c4EjAMmP7KgBkpR/1788066445275.jpg)

- Once cooled, sprinkle powdered sugar and cinnamon powder on top

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXffTCEPnGicKpLXBkwLP1NnKmsy7bFX3ZEojDBwVTPXX/1788066521176.jpg)

- The bread pudding is ready to eat

title.title: Un Ciempiés Ladrón / A Thieving Centipede
title.body:
<center>

Un ciempiés muy abusivo,
entro a casa sin permiso,
camino como si fuera su piso
mientras yo estaba en otro sitio.

Tomó un televisor de la mesa
y se lo llevó sin ninguna pena,
desapareció de la escena,
es un robo que nadie espera.

>A very pushy centipede,
came into the house without permission,
walked around as if it were his own place
while I was somewhere else.

>He grabbed a TV from the table
and took it without a second thought,
then vanished from the scene,
it’s a theft no one expects.

![119231.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23zGoEwXWVJaFvzwQEujth6PY31AZtu7doKrLmQ6eRx8zqVYbP7eyb5eUwY3nKKq3Hmzg.gif)

Cuando llegué a mi casa,
el televisor no estaba,
grité angustiada,
y revisé que nada más faltara. 

Salí a buscar una nueva televisión 
y mientras tanto algo pasó,
el abusivo insecto regresó 
y está vez mi cama se robó.

>When I got home,
the TV was gone,
I screamed in distress,
and checked to make sure nothing else was missing.

>I went out to look for a new TV,
and while I was gone, something happened,
that pesky bug came back,
and this time it stole my bed.

![119232.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23zky6SH19d2hxACEhLdFWi5mRFgSPkkDqXXYCgCqXfGmJYQejVK7qGwRx3naY4gv6Sup.gif)

Cuando regresé me enfadé 
y sentada en el suelo me quedé,
está situación debo resolver 
y al ladrón voy a descubrir está vez. 

Cuando el ciempiés llegó,
mi pierna con fuerza tomó,
quería robarme, mucho me asustó 
pero me liberé y lo enfrenté con convicción. 

>When I came back, I got angry
and sat down on the floor,
I have to resolve this situation
and this time I’m going to catch the thief.

>When the centipede arrived,
it grabbed my leg with force,
it wanted to steal from me,it scared me a lot,
but I broke free and faced it with determination.

![119233.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23zS9puKGNQajHfYJSFq8CYRKyHBiEtpVTAitCLcGF1Gd1ryfdcS2mR4tLQpMN1VSrx7J.gif)

El animal se avergonzó por los hechos
y trajo la cama de regreso,
la dejó en su puesto
y yo recuperé algunos de elementos. 

Antes de irse, llamé al animal 
y le dije que la almohada se podía llevar.
El ciempiés se alegro de más 
y así compartí un poco de mi felicidad, aunque me robó sin piedad. 

>The animal felt ashamed of what had happened
and brought the bed back,
put it back in its place,
and I recovered some of my belongings.

>Before it left, I called out to the animal
and told it that it could take the pillow.
The centipede was overjoyed,
and so I shared a little of my happiness with it, even though it had robbed me without mercy.

![119234.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/242YES64ZsnnPmR3dN9ZuaMk6RKrv3ENPQcCvmpFvT53GcwkxVkQHyKkCwiYmyHksBybF.gif)

title.title: Inept Healer || Splinterlands ||  Legendary Fire Unit.
title.body:
>
Hello .. !! My dear Hive friends, I am @samadbro08 from Bangladesh. Today is Sunday , August 30/2026
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdWj9X3oB4BytiohZVM7tp2AVBo3QcJu7ufki9yLZ7R7/1788066934888.png) [Source](ChatGpt.com) Hi everyone, How are you? I hope everyone is well. Today I am taking about Fire Splinter's amazing support legendary unit Inept Healer. Inept Healer from Splinterlands is a Legendary Fire Unit, which provides amazing support and anti-magic power at a low mana cost. This card can create a lasting advantage for your team at a cost of only 3 mana. It is known to be a very effective card especially against Magic-dependent opponents. Let me discuss this card with you today.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRb4rz49zRaBmMKgECZ9WUJk73DxpZK2c3YY5M2ZCbRoy/1788066935053.png)
Picture is a screenshot from the game splinterlands
>This card has one of the most powerful abilities of Inept Healer from the first level, Magic Reflect. When an enemy Magic Attacks, a part of that attack is returned to the attacker. As a result, the opponent suffers a part of the damage of his own attack against Magic-based teams. And due to its low mana cost, this card is very popular in various low-mana matches including Little League. At the same time, it also works as an effective support unit in high-mana matches. However, this ability heals a certain amount of injured allied units each round. However, their maximum Health decreases slightly with each heal. As a result, it gives them a chance to survive on the one hand, and on the other hand, creates a strategic balance in long battles.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVQ4F8xL4bxrTUrmgVebXn96UBowTrGtqvaNqgZTCs5YK/1788066935120.png)
Picture is a screenshot from the game splinterlands
When you use this on the battlefield, if the opponent's team has multiple Magic Attackers, Inept Healer is extremely effective. Due to Void and Magic Reflect, it also survives itself and damages the enemy. However, it usually does not miss Magic Attack. But because of Phase, Magic Attack can also be dodged. As a result, this card becomes much more durable against Magic-dependent opponents. And when this card is at its highest level, Void's ability reduces Magic Damage by half. And when Phase, Magic Reflect and Void work together, Inept Healer becomes a powerful Anti-Magic unit.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeGF36XcsG3rcQKfZsgzKaGwvcGoZ6KM6RtdMCPQBWxQb/1788066935178.png)
Picture is a screenshot from the game splinterlands
And so what I personally think about this card is that Inept Healer is a Legendary card that, although it seems ordinary at first glance, its true value is understood on the battlefield. It is especially effective in Magic Heavy Meta. It is a very valuable collection for Fire Splinter players due to its low mana cost, Magic Attack and strong support ability. And if you like long-term Battle Strategy and want to slowly defeat the opponent while keeping the team alive, then Inept Healer should be in your deck. Anyway, I am finishing my writing about this card today, thank you everyone.

title.title: cafe on Varca beach. Part 1089========Café \
on Varca Strand. Part 109
title.body:
HALLO.HIVE!

![IMG_20190330_185050.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWN7DcAKaAP9zW4knF1gLzMA5gD1wWwGFefMHKEKYPRLT/IMG_20190330_185050.jpg)


Like almost everywhere, the menu here offers a variety of egg dishes. You can easily have breakfast at beach cafes, and why not? For some reason, omelettes are strictly reserved for breakfast; if you eat them for dinner, you'll definitely get food poisoning and die.


![IMG_20190330_183509.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdbLwpZ9zMv4TQNQ9Gs8ucARLD3ThbA2SVpxDC5eAEGv/IMG_20190330_183509.jpg)


The standard selection of fish and seafood. But you have to ask the waiter what exactly is available. Fish is a watery business! We've been \

by good fish (cod, halibut, grouper, flounder) since childhood, so we're not particularly interested in this topic in Goa. In Vietnam, we'd eat the freshest seafood; there's a wide selection of fresh seafood on the beach, but here, all those unappetizing barracudas just don't whet our appetite. All the fish will definitely be frozen and iced, and here, the power goes out often. It might not even be perfectly fresh, since that's the most expensive option... Let's just say the tuna we tried several times in Goa on different beaches wasn't the freshest and had a bit of a smell. So, the best fish in Goa is chicken! Although we've had fried shrimp dishes a couple of times, and they were fine. Naans with butter, biryani, shahi paneer, malai kofta, rice, and noodles—they're our everything in India!



![IMG_20190330_183520.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZJsnfHReyKP4fb6Tdg5fF3DmK69ASCiS6NH618jCEqna/IMG_20190330_183520.jpg)




Tandoori chicken (roughly, these are fragrant chunks of chicken in yogurt and spices, cooked on a grill/tandoori), sizzlers (sizzling food on a hot cast-iron skillet straight from the stove)—those are also must-haves! Uh... they even have borscht on the menu! Although this soup clearly has nothing to do with borscht. Not every beetroot soup is borscht, let the borscht firestorm break out! They even have French onion soup! Would you dare? I remember we laughed for a long time in the Dominican Republic over the local version of sushi. Rice porridge with some kind of puny filling.


![IMG_20190330_183529.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZQEKM1FiLW8gFM7QEiB2qh4m9gXqok6uEAZpPxVBR2S/IMG_20190330_183529.jpg)





Rice in various variations, naans, biryani pilaf. There's plenty to enjoy here! Now that's what Indians know!



![IMG_20190330_183547.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWEG2peADwFmpq7uaZbeA9dtnPtzT3jafN9cFBRswk68A/IMG_20190330_183547.jpg)


Black tea for 25 rupees? This place has passed the \
! Acceptable! Noodles, vegetable salads, everything is wonderful! Alas, the desserts are weak! No dodol, bebinka, not even \

only pancakes and fruit salads.



![IMG_20190330_183611.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWCiCHBNJBzR7u42aJVUkbGasoWA6686uJLM2mteiqAHm/IMG_20190330_183611.jpg)


We placed our order and are sitting here \

I'm kind of tired of all these sweet drinks like Limca and Maaz, so by the second week of our vacation, we just started drinking water. A beachfront location with a view of the Arabian Sea! How wonderful! Who said there are sun loungers on the beachfront?! That's just too much!



![IMG_20190330_184137.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPXdXX6NCj4rTwirHGTTVu9vVZD7wD8EJzWmAxzH223XQ/IMG_20190330_184137.jpg)


Gradually, our food arrives. A tomato salad with mayonnaise. Almost all the salads on the beach are coarsely chopped vegetables, essentially just sliced ​​vegetables, with or without dressing. At least tomatoes are easy to chew, but carrots of that size (and that happened too)—oh, my poor teeth, we're not horses.



![IMG_20190330_185040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWch1eZjsvMa7WtxPoh1gjPd8kWKmcBYewfs8k2ySByqF/IMG_20190330_185040.jpg)


And here comes our shrimp noodles! I think they also had naan bread, but I'm not sure. All this is for two people. In Goa, we \
trying to keep within the budget of 500 rupees for a meal for two. It's not that there was any pressing financial need for it, it's just a kind of \

—setting yourself a goal and trying to achieve it. Then we'll go to the store for ice cream and have some tea and cookies in the room—that's not included in the price, ha. The cafe was deemed quite good, there's still one more to visit—spoiler alert: it's the best of the three.



![IMG_20190330_185050.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWN7DcAKaAP9zW4knF1gLzMA5gD1wWwGFefMHKEKYPRLT/IMG_20190330_185050.jpg)


●
...to be continued...


Wie fast überall bietet die Speisekarte hier eine Auswahl an Eierspeisen. In Strandcafés kann man problemlos frühstücken, und warum auch nicht? Omeletts sind aus irgendeinem Grund ausschließlich dem Frühstück vorbehalten; wer sie abends isst, riskiert eine Lebensmittelvergiftung.

Die Auswahl an Fisch und Meeresfrüchten ist Standard. Man muss aber den Kellner fragen, was genau angeboten wird. Fisch ist eine heikle Angelegenheit! Wir sind seit unserer Kindheit mit gutem Fisch (Kabeljau, Heilbutt, Zackenbarsch, Flunder) verwöhnt, daher interessiert uns dieses Thema in Goa nicht besonders. In Vietnam würden wir die frischesten Meeresfrüchte essen; am Strand gibt es eine große Auswahl an frischen Meeresfrüchten, aber hier regen all die unappetitlichen Barrakudas einfach nicht unseren Appetit an. Der Fisch ist garantiert gefroren und auf Eis, und hier fällt der Strom oft aus. Es ist vielleicht nicht mal ganz frisch, da es die teuerste Option ist… Sagen wir mal so: Der Thunfisch, den wir in Goa an verschiedenen Stränden mehrmals probiert haben, war nicht der frischeste und roch etwas streng. Also, der beste Fisch in Goa ist Hühnchen! Obwohl wir auch schon ein paar Mal frittierte Garnelen gegessen haben, und die waren in Ordnung. Naan mit Butter, Biryani, Shahi Paneer, Malai Kofta, Reis und Nudeln – das sind unsere Lieblingsgerichte in Indien!

Tandoori-Hühnchen (grob gesagt: duftende Hühnerstücke in Joghurt und Gewürzen, gegrillt im Tandoor), Sizzler (brutzelndes Essen direkt vom Herd in einer heißen Gusseisenpfanne) – die muss man einfach probieren! Ähm… sie haben sogar Borschtsch auf der Speisekarte! Obwohl diese Suppe eindeutig nichts mit Borschtsch zu tun hat. Nicht jede Rote-Bete-Suppe ist Borschtsch, da kann man mal ne Diskussion drüber nachdenken! Sie haben sogar französische Zwiebelsuppe! Würdest du dich trauen? Ich erinnere mich, wie wir in der Dominikanischen Republik lange über die dortige Sushi-Variante gelacht haben. Reisbrei mit einer winzigen Füllung.

Reis in allen Variationen, Naan, Biryani-Pilaw. Hier gibt es so viel zu entdecken! Das ist es, was Inder wissen!

Schwarzer Tee für 25 Rupien? Dieser Laden hat den „Giertest“ bestanden! Akzeptabel! Nudeln, Gemüsesalate, alles ist wunderbar! Leider sind die Desserts enttäuschend! Kein Dodol, keine Bebinka, nicht einmal „Hello Queen“, nur Pfannkuchen und Obstsalat.

Wir haben bestellt und sitzen hier und warten auf besseres Wetter. Ich habe diese ganzen süßen Getränke wie Limca und Maaz langsam satt, deshalb trinken wir seit der zweiten Urlaubswoche nur noch Wasser. Direkt am Strand mit Blick auf das Arabische Meer! Wie herrlich! Wer sagt denn, dass es Liegestühle am Strand gibt?! Das ist ja wohl übertrieben!

Nach und nach kommt unser Essen. Ein Tomatensalat mit Mayonnaise. Fast alle Salate am Strand bestehen aus grob gehacktem Gemüse, im Grunde nur geschnittenes Gemüse, mit oder ohne Dressing. Tomaten sind wenigstens leicht zu kauen, aber Karotten dieser Größe (und die gab es auch) – oh je, meine armen Zähne, wir sind ja keine Pferde.

Und da kommen unsere Garnelennudeln! Ich glaube, es gab auch Naan-Brot, aber ich bin mir nicht sicher. Das alles ist für zwei Personen. In Goa hatten wir unseren „Spaß“, mit 500 Rupien für ein Essen zu zweit auszukommen. Es war nicht so, dass wir es unbedingt brauchten, es ist einfach eine Art „Wettbewerb“ – sich ein Ziel setzen und versuchen, es zu erreichen. Danach gehen wir noch in den Laden, holen uns Eis und trinken Tee und essen Kekse im Zimmer – das ist nicht im Preis inbegriffen, haha. Das Café war ganz gut, es gibt noch eins zu besuchen – Spoiler-Alarm: Es ist das beste der drei.

●
...Fortsetzung folgt...

![duremarr.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTdU7pPFdy45MmcpEsUeN2gg8duECL2L7cok1ZJHEhtX6/duremarr.png)

title.title: Punished for Not Already Knowing
title.body:
![1000130809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/Eoc62ony16PKUjimNVfuuyZ5Yz9SpAXC3vVi4Z7nnhFYpUM8vGvvuvbEX8ZMBXKqbGk.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)











<center>There is a fragment I picked up without knowing yet what it wanted to become, a half sentence, a stray color, a shape that caught me before I understood why,
There is a fragment I picked up without knowing yet what it wanted to become, and I almost set it back down because it didn't announce its purpose the moment I touched it,
There is a fragment I picked up without knowing yet what it wanted to become, so I carried on with my day anyway, unsure if I was keeping a treasure or just collecting more clutter,
Do I actually trust myself to know what's worth keeping before it has proven anything, that explaining myself is even harder as I imagined,
There is a fragment I picked up without knowing yet what it wanted to become, and I am learning to hold it loosely enough that it still has room to surprise me, more than I could imagine…







<center>I keep measuring the raw thing before I have even finished gathering it, handing out verdicts to ideas that are still only half formed and barely out of the dark, but I remember I am going somewhere,
I keep measuring the raw thing before I have even finished gathering it, as though every rough draft owes me proof of its future the moment it arrives, that it deserves a place even yet it’s purpose is just a seed,
I keep measuring the raw thing before I have even finished gathering it, and I wonder how many quiet possibilities I have already thrown away for failing a test they were never meant anything of my future judgement,
I still keep evidence of what have I already discarded because my brain already judged it before it even arrived,
I keep measuring the raw thing before I have even finished gathering it, and I am trying, slowly, to let the gathering happen first, and real assessment could happen later…







<center>There is a whisper of an idea I almost threw away because it arrived looking unfinished, thin and unimpressive, nothing like the confident ones I usually telling stories with,
There is a whisper of an idea I almost threw away because it arrived looking unfinished, and I have a history of mistaking quiet for weak and loud for worthy,
There is a whisper of an idea I almost threw away because it arrived looking unfinished, but something made me pause long enough to set it aside instead of figuring out the next possible step,
How many quiet ones have I already lost because I only knew how to recognize the loud ones as much more real,
There is a whisper of an idea I almost threw away because it arrived looking unfinished, and I am starting to keep the unfinished ones on purpose now, just to see what they become after reassessing its inner structure…








<center>I collect these small, unproven things and then punish myself for not knowing their worth yet, it’s as if certainty is supposed to magically arrive at the exact moment I start collecting them,
I collect these small unproven things and then punish myself for not already knowing their worth, demanding a verdict from myself before I've given the thing enough time to even take shape,
I collect these small, unproven things and then punish myself for not knowing their worth, the punishment costs me more than the ignorance ever actually did, realizing too late for the hidden to unfold,
What would happen if I let something stay unproven for a while without treating that as my something that might not actually work, or treating it with automatic flaws to begin with,
I collect these small unproven things and then punish myself for not already knowing their worth, and I am tired enough now to finally set that particular punishment down, and I realize that perhaps the work was never asking me to know its worth yet, only to keep gathering what might become something…







<center>Watchwords:
A fragment I picked up without knowing,
Grading the raw thing before gathering it,
The whisper I almost threw away,
Punish myself for not already knowing,
These small unproven things I collect,







![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>

title.title: [ENG/ESP] A quiet Saturday under a clear sky.
title.body: > **Sundays are usually the most peaceful days when we’re at home—those days when our bodies finally slow down and our minds settle into a much-appreciated state of calm. They can also turn into days full of fun when we get together, when family or friends gather and the house fills with conversation, laughter, and impromptu plans. That’s why I always hope everyone’s Sunday is great—filled with good times, rest, or exciting plans, depending on what each person needs. This past Saturday was a simple but very productive day. After resting a bit at home, my husband and I decided to go out to run some errands and fill up on gas, because we like to have everything ready for a relaxed, worry-free Sunday. For me, a Sunday with no pending tasks is almost a gift—an opportunity to take a deep breath and enjoy the peace and quiet that I value so much. I’ll tell you that the wonderful weather continues, and when I say “wonderful,” I mean that it’s not raining, because the humidity doesn’t agree with me very well. This week was a little tough for me because of my allergies; my bronchial tubes were acting up, and any change in the weather affected me. But I’m getting over them, little by little, and this weekend’s rest has been a big help. Sometimes the body just needs a break, a breather, a day without demands to feel balanced again. We left the house after lunch, because at that time the weather is usually nice and warm, and I needed to soak up a little sun. I like to make the most of those moments when the day is radiant, not only because it lifts my spirits, but also because I always find something beautiful to photograph. The city, even in its daily routine, has spots that sparkle when the sun hits them just right, and I love capturing those moments that make the walk even more special.**

> *Los domingos suelen ser los días más tranquilos cuando estamos en casa, esos días en los que el cuerpo por fin baja el ritmo y la mente se acomoda en un estado de calma que tanto se agradece. También pueden convertirse en días de gran ocurrencia cuando nos juntamos, cuando la familia o los amigos coinciden y la casa se llena de conversaciones, risas y planes improvisados. Por eso siempre deseo que el domingo de cada uno sea genial, que esté lleno de buenos momentos, de descanso o de grandes planes, según lo que cada quien necesite. Este sábado que recién culminó fue un día sencillo pero muy provechoso. Después de descansar un poco en casa, mi esposo y yo decidimos salir para hacer algunas compras y colocar combustible, porque nos gusta dejar todo listo para tener un domingo relajado y sin preocupaciones. Para mí, un domingo sin pendientes es casi un regalo, una oportunidad para respirar profundo y disfrutar de la tranquilidad que tanto valoro. Les cuento que continúa el clima maravilloso, y cuando digo maravilloso me refiero a que no llueva, porque la humedad no me hace muy bien. Esta semana fue un poco difícil para mí con las alergias; los bronquios estuvieron resentidos y cualquier cambio de clima me afectaba. Pero ya las voy superando, poco a poco, y el descanso de este fin de semana me ha servido de gran ayuda. A veces el cuerpo solo necesita una pausa, un respiro, un día sin exigencias para volver a sentirse en equilibrio. Salimos de casa después de almorzar, porque a esa hora el clima suele estar bien calentito y yo necesitaba tomar un poco de sol. Me gusta aprovechar esos momentos en los que el día está radiante, no solo porque me anima, sino porque siempre encuentro algo bonito que fotografiar. La ciudad, incluso en su rutina, tiene rincones que brillan cuando el sol cae de cierta manera, y me encanta capturar esos instantes que hacen que el recorrido sea más especial.*
![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep5mCm8jfwE3hiCo5AV5jzutLmZE1SopCTFvkHfB4iYsRoroNDYoLXqoaDLfJo4NdNV.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqDhb2TomQQ3p4hKrV4cWcL6xg5ocfqftoc6EHVBUuv7RmUd1YFWbvg9j6merMsoWsy.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqHyTz6DcQy8C616QbchTgCDGr8rx7fxvmhY7G3g15jjohjoErkDQYbpc1CWRtwEA6v.jpg)

> **We went to several places to buy the things we needed. That’s quite common this time of year, when high demand for certain products means you have to go from store to store to find what you’re looking for. But we do it patiently, because we’re used to it by now and because, in the end, we always manage to figure it out.**

> *Recorrimos varios lugares para poder comprar las cosas que necesitábamos. Eso es algo muy normal en estas temporadas, cuando la demanda de algunos productos hace que uno tenga que ir de tienda en tienda para encontrar lo que busca. Pero lo hacemos con paciencia, porque ya estamos acostumbrados y porque al final siempre logramos resolver.*
![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq9N1YyzDh3fScfKzepti5dLonbUMxmCdQJHExSrAQDVkGxCyBoyqmEvAQ2n9MJ8Bxn.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqHy1njRY8Rw7JP3fLi96t8zs5ZewGwCF4kP1pjry34VU2ndAeHvTZXLKKXbQ7xkxXw.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT2GKr6HLEUd9qksL1oLj3h3ZBbaDNbsvy5SAbA1Ysnjza4w85dNhsgfcpYyYcy9sY.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqYrDHqJEm1wrsgvtFfQxWzERRNDmHg3MSdCNPuqkz4wNkWev1J75kVEo1onWpQHH9R.jpg)

> **And of course, if we take a tour of the city and my husband doesn’t have a delicious chicha, it’s as if he hadn’t even gone out. So he had his nice glass—nice and cold and thick, just the way he likes it. I love it too, but since I still have a cold in my bronchial tubes, I’m avoiding very cold foods and dairy products until my allergies get better. I’ll have my chance to enjoy it as usual soon enough.**

> *Y claro, si damos un recorrido por la ciudad y mi esposo no se toma una deliciosa chicha, para él es como si no hubiera salido. Así que se tomó su buen vaso, bien frío y espeso como le gusta. A mí me encanta también, pero como aún tengo los bronquios resfriados, estoy evitando las cosas muy frías y los lácteos hasta que las alergias estén mejores. Ya tendré mi momento para disfrutarla como siempre.*
![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23w2kgmso8bQ91ywx6qs5Doi8Nchzp8o1Ue9Z2k79fyyZTNJRJUYY1sx6eJuwH844Qvnf.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23tvcDvS7FyFJtRniryHs3nCD68J157btsBh8JP2a3kLT7ppatTT4iPp2i49q9SJ3T5Wq.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep5mJfE3CFcoDiTk7yn6Tgt3ZmF3qCgMZaRfiAnvrfufiTRM4z6GnvDNywbrzPACyM8.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptYzNPaidbMURcJpVESp2jq22dPjxB7wT7T5neqTV2VgFSLogDPRPzkYC5yPhFLCKz.jpg)

> **With our shopping done, we stopped to fill up on gas and then set off on the drive home, taking in the beautiful scenery on this glorious Saturday. The sky was clear, the light was warm, and everything had that special glow that makes you feel grateful for the simple things.**

> *Con nuestras compras hechas, fuimos a colocar combustible y luego emprendimos el camino de regreso a casa, apreciando los hermosos paisajes de este sábado radiante. El cielo estaba despejado, la luz era cálida y todo tenía ese brillo especial que hace que uno se sienta agradecido por lo simple.*
![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqjUrqyc2hXL5t16ZB43qjS7BgJUCyRrN9KDttiNvSxfdknLXoKS2Yg9dh6S3FdG9Mw.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7rjjueAd9bdSqS9AqoChUgzuktf8CSceeWG9a8gAi6wwFKzSAHGnEswCFHDk82JQX.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-01 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5CUymsqgN1EY4y4ovCkhXAqVnJB9egkKugZDMiyyRGGS1jb7bJPPAahFc6uHNBQRk.jpg) ![photo_2026-08-29_22-15-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpVA7bhCHsKHt7jZHFbtNeaULuFLgr3XH7CxdRPcwjjnQ7YZWXn4NErRdpHqdb4TMyu.jpg)
> **I'll see you all tomorrow to let you know how things are going this weekend, which promises to be peaceful and restful. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Mañana los veré para contarles cómo nos continúa yendo este fin de semana, que promete ser tranquilo y reparador. Hasta pronto. Chao.*

title.title: Ripe plantain stuffed with beet and carrot salad (Eng-Esp)
title.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yToVquTPLbMsW1DnnJXBsv9diCsGCzBGXzwUPDXe1HScmiHSwef3Hs2ZLvWB9Pk81uM.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, hivers; I hope you’ve had a fantastic Saturday... Here is how to prepare a delicious \

. You can cook the plantain in the oven or an air fryer; I chose the latter for this recipe.
The magic of this dish lies in the wonderful, subtly sweet contrast of its ingredients and its exquisite texture... A true treat for the palate!

>* Buenas noches hivers, espero hayan pasado un fantástico sábado... A continuación, les explicaré como preparar un delicioso \
. Para la cocción del plátano pueden utilizar el horno o el air fryer, en esta ocasión está última opción fue mi elección.\nLa magia de esta receta la encontramos en el maravilloso contraste \

que aportan sus ingredientes y en su exquisita consistencia... Un manjar al paladar!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgUWXjBpGvSv3hMYdVQiXQw8YTipLb86bvMRjhzsEXsnvbMxudorqXeesx3Myq4M5ZJ.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: beetroot, carrot, ripe banana, mayonnaise, mustard, honey, pepper, spinach leaves for garnish, and salt.

>* INGREDIENTES: remolacha, zanahoria, plátano maduro, mayonesa, mostaza, miel, pimienta negra, hojas de espinaca para decorar y sal.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23zSLQvRaTpYfG2HaiuS7umKWg5SLctuoqHEgo2wdfZF2VhnT3dDEvjWTbpiKHZtrSuQ6.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/244oZ2b7VvKwEgXTGwuopszRgTrWAYa69eMxqcCVyV2HtzZQQyh5hWMjU3eLZEVa4yMUt.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* The first step is to prepare our appetizing dressing... combine mayonnaise, mustard, black pepper, and salt in a bowl (mix until well blended).

>* El primer paso será preparar nuestro apetitoso aderezo... incorporamos en un bowl: mayonesa, mostaza, pimienta negra y sal (mezclamos hasta integrar bien).

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yToVTcccDrzVdfMEge5zeKt65bDRgAkGQZHEEZpLDyw4e6e5iNG5jHxephZtUVSc5Ju.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvsD1tm8t8v9jkYQ2avV8dueqsq2NJq5nFxEe6JbZxA68cVuXfEWqMTfnZH6p4s3bg7.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wqti363Gp21qZ4nW4htCXyzy9sasgeqd8vk9CWwJ5TxkBFPfe6qzrNJLeTpo7HHwTaZ.png)</center>

* Next, we add the honey... This ingredient will provide a sweetish contrast that I’m sure you’ll love!
Set it aside in the fridge.

>* A continuación, colocamos la miel... Este ingrediente aportará un contraste dulzón que les encantará!
Tapamos y reservamos en la nevera.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23viCmCDsY9fvnryctVBKWgz9vb8M5mjisp7tYSJ3N4EnTL96W6p9esDuK8crVDx38qq2.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wX9dQShyVWQB4hVDaRYsvHsr4akUoy6qJ2eAQAHWde3WiDtkAGiKgfsfrV7YX9dSrwT.png)</center>

* Grate the beetroot and carrot using the fine side of the grater... place them in a deep bowl and mix.
Add the reserved dressing... and mix gently.
Cover and refrigerate, allowing the vegetables to soften slightly and fully absorb the delicious dressing.

>* Rallamos la remolacha y la zanahoria por el lado fino... Integramos en un envase hondo, mezclamos.
Añadimos el aderezo que teníamos reservado... mezclamos con movimientos suaves.
Reservamos en la nevera, para que la textura de las verduras se suavicen un poco y se impregnen bien con nuestro suculento aderezo.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EqNHcLhMpvUfJx2Vy2p3HiTW6VAp4sXUViCCQVRSZkBUh6kwdnYqU1WR4LwJMZUudcR.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/244ohgvdFQtLYPdH4Pbmy147vqpmPpFkN4CPazLSgYkU9mQ7qmE1JBpoWazWNrenHhdY2.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242NsqqQixGqUfM53KV16am9dck9PJyUhcpfsEeJhpDveUxQDA7E7LLgRr1jpjXiujY9S.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/245HupmsNy9VDdvJa1cPftKUikyAoYhGDAjrKhuxMbqa7pg9SVd8VwUrCBpfsYYtkBSUt.png)</center>

* I used the air fryer to cook the plantain... I made a horizontal cut in the skin, taking care not to cut all the way to the ends. The cooking time was 15 minutes. Don't worry if the skin turns very dark; the flesh inside will remain very soft and juicy.
I let it cool to room temperature before removing and discarding the skin.

>* Para cocinar el plátano utilicé el air fryer... realizamos un corte horizontal en la piel, cuidando de no cortar hacia el extremo. El tiempo de su cocción fue de 15 minutos. No se preocupen si observan que la piel toma un color muy oscuro, ya que en su interior la pulpa quedará muy suave y jugosa.
Esperamos que se enfríe a temperatura ambiente, para proceder a extraer y desechar la piel.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u6DrBFxaK3vCkRbLfsTRukPQBzjw3c72cEP3J35vgc2G4sSKmswkMADFpGs1ehhb9mG.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoiW9RCzKFTnmF5io9n2f2TZW6BCRnnPz6BuiUGc7rQzNjavjhhz2VYKnqxRf4GPj7n.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wX9hosmhkYZuAr2zhvrv59ZnaEXLSosbjkTwsHH9DYMDp3FU6tKtdsDWLr6AaSiwMEL.png)</center>

* Next, we fill the plantain with our healthy, nutritious, and colorful salad... To add a fresh touch to the dish, I thought it would be great to garnish it with spinach leaves (finely chopped).

>* A continuación, rellenamos el plátano con nuestra saludable, nutritiva y colorida ensalada... Para aportar un toquesito fresco a la preparación, me pareció genial decorar con hojas de espinacas (finamente cortadas).

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xAgUrM2abaWFxkwGbth2TDcMWvcv4wDDHgTsXkkjVkP9THuusgTtZ2jDMuJZMSYZWVw.png)</center>

* And now, here is our delicious dish—an excellent choice to enjoy with family and friends. Thank you so much for visiting my blog; I hope you enjoyed the process of making this tasty recipe. I’m sure you’ll love it just as much as I do!
I’ll sign off now by wishing you *bon appétit*. See you in the next post... Greetings!

>* A continuación, les presento nuestro delicioso platillo, una excelente opción para disfrutar con sus familiares y amigos... Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, espero hayan disfrutado el proceso de esta sabrosa receta, estoy segura que la amarán tanto como yo!
Me despido deseándoles buen provecho, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. Un abrazo!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgUWXjBpGvSv3hMYdVQiXQw8YTipLb86bvMRjhzsEXsnvbMxudorqXeesx3Myq4M5ZJ.png)</center>

title.title: MagicOS 10: Exploring the New Features on My HONOR Phone - Lets Explore...
title.body:
Hey All,

![MagicOS-Update.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/244yAWCyceicDEoC7vkV7t8YcChS3Zrv3uiuaPGKvXtYSCrEdYENsJCJ7jn2HkpdBwSbm.png)


Will start the post with this famous line which goes by \

</u>** Busy busy and busy is all what I can say. Coming to todays post if all foscuses around the MagicOS 10 updates which has introduced a revamped user interface, advanced AI integration, and expanded cross-device sharing capabilities. I kept getting alerts on my mobile device to upgrade the software, and finally, before deciding to upgrade, I wanted to check what was actually included in the update and what changes I could expect. Here is the snaptshot of images taken from my mobile to give the glimpse around the Magic OS 10 updates...


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-27 at 8.07.37 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23zm5gYRM745ApyUFWEHwaj36eD41AhnvybXEYqNaL3ac1Vqnx9uTMMw5xhhT1isFc6pt.jpeg)

**Current version: 10.0.0.166 (C185E6R5P1) - Latest**

A bit on the

So, what is MagicOS  which is the software that runs on HONOR smartphones. We can think of it like One UI on Samsung phones or OxygenOS on OnePlus phones. Hence for HONOR mobile phones its the MagicOS and here is a high-level summary of the recent updates and improvements that come with MagicOS 10, making the phone smoother, smarter, and more enjoyable to use.

- Smoother – better animations and overall performance
- Smarter – more AI-based features and improvements. I am yet to explore the AI features
- Fresh looking – changes to the design and user interface. Looks amazing.
- More efficient – improvements aimed at making everyday use better


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-27 at 8.07.38 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23wgiurwP6CgWbLuz3HKzZFye7t72nzw1sBvAHo5yWZ7LEHvmC8vkapoMDgkwQSWQx5T6.jpeg)

Yes, there is also **Cross-Brand Smart Connectivity**, which allows HONOR devices to connect and work more smoothly with devices from other brands, making it easier to share and transfer content between them. I tried this feature by connecting it with Samsung mobile phones, and it worked smoothly without any major issues or complicated setup.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-27 at 8.07.38 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23wqxwQuw7mniCW2AcippyV98PyufZxqanKSQ7ifB7akXXpPvJVQZwg3niBsVFKaba4BU.jpeg)

Do you see this feature where they are naming it as Industry-Leading AI anti-fraud call detection. I am actually using this feature myself and, to be honest, I really like it but so far have not expereinced the AI intervening or alerting that the call is potentially a fraud one. So, let me show you how you can enable it and how it can be useful in your day-to-day calls. 

**How to enable it AI anti-fraud call detection**



![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-27 at 8.07.38 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23uFrsz3skFUvE4dxPYVhpaPApX2dneB9Bj23oiBKzbWjHDqiRNfkfJeBmX7pbmdNz1si.jpeg)

Based on your HONOR phone and MagicOS 10 version, you can generally look under:

**Settings → Security → AI Anti-Fraud / Anti-Fraud Protection**

Now the the AI feature is enabled one need not manually check every call. The feature works in the background and can provide a warning when it detects a potentially risky or fraudulent call. As I mentioned, I am yet to experience a situation where MagicOS actually detects a conversation as fraudulent and alerts me about it during the call. So, I cannot share a personal experience of how the warning appears in a real scam call. Maybe some other time when I have expereinced about it then will do a seprate post around it. But for now the jest is that if someone calls you and the AI detects something that looks suspicious or potentially fraudulent, the mobile phone can show a warning during the call. At a high level visualize the following image and it should give you an idea how AI is coming into the picture detecting Anti-Fraud Calls..


![ChatGPT Image Aug 30, 2026, 10_31_51 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/48jihsX9R3Ko7BrKWSEDKSFP6KpEuJQHuw4HW4H91TrkBn6GcDBNsKeHvF9e8ZY5rQ.png)

More around the same to be continued in the next post. For now this should be it for todays post on - \

Do let me know your views, especially if you are already using **MagicOS 10** and have come across any interesting features that I may have missed calling out... cheers

title.title: Visita a la plaza María Rodríguez, en la avenida Fernández de Zerpa [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** En esta ocasión, comparto mi visita a la plaza María Rodríguez, situada en la avenida Fernanda. Fue inaugurada recientemente; según la placa, el lugar albergaba anteriormente la plaza Diego Fernández de Serpa, llamada así en honor al hombre que repobló definitivamente *Nueva Toledo* (de Gonzalo de Ocampo) y *Nueva Córdoba* (de Jacome Castellón, fundada como Cumaná en 1569). En 2015, las autoridades municipales de aquel entonces la rebautizaron como plaza María Rodríguez para rendir homenaje a la figura cultural María Rodríguez. La plaza se extiende a lo largo de un tramo que comienza cerca de la estación de bomberos; al cruzar, se encuentra una rotonda con una palmera central y un sendero pavimentado con baldosas de arcilla (*caico*). Tras cruzar la avenida, se llega a la entrada de la plaza, donde se alza un letrero informativo azul decorado con flores de hibisco, las mismas que solía lucir la artista que da nombre al lugar. El letrero también promueve el cuidado del medio ambiente. En el extremo opuesto de la plaza se encuentra la escultura de un hermoso hibisco, flor que la artista solía usar para adornar su cabello. La escultura tiene forma ovalada y descansa sobre un muro de piedra y hormigón que forma una jardinera; el pedestal se asienta sobre una base rectangular blanca. Desde ese ángulo se puede apreciar la parte posterior de la escultura, incluidas las hojas y la cara interna de los pétalos. A continuación, se muestra una vista lateral donde se observan los pétalos, el pistilo y la placa con la inscripción que indica el nombre anterior del sitio y su cambio de nombre en honor a María Rodríguez. La vista frontal permite ver los pétalos y, al fondo, la avenida que conduce al monumento; el suelo está pintado de varios colores, destacando un diseño grande y hermoso de hibisco cerca de la escultura.

> **
ENGLISH
** This time, I am sharing my visit to María Rodríguez Plaza, located on Fernanda Avenue. It was inaugurated recently; according to the plaque, the site was formerly home to the Diego Fernández de Serpa Plaza—named after the man who definitively repopulated Gonzalo de Ocampo’s *Nueva Toledo* and Jacome Castellón’s *Nueva Córdoba* (founded as Cumaná in 1569). It was renamed María Rodríguez Plaza in 2015 by the municipal authorities of the time to honor the cultural figure María Rodríguez. The plaza spans a long stretch starting near the fire station; upon crossing, one finds a traffic circle featuring a central palm tree and a *caico* (clay tile) walkway. After crossing the avenue, you reach the plaza entrance, where a blue information sign stands, decorated with hibiscus flowers—blooms frequently worn by the artist for whom the plaza is named. The sign also encourages environmental stewardship. At the far end of the plaza stands a sculpture of a beautiful hibiscus—a flower the artist often used to adorn her hair. The sculpture features an oval shape and rests on a rock-and-concrete wall that forms a planter; the pedestal sits on a rectangular white base. From that angle, one can see the back of the sculpture, including the leaves and the inner side of the petals. Next, there is a side view showing the petals, the pistil, and the inscription plaque noting the site's former name and its renaming in honor of María Rodríguez. A frontal view reveals the petals, with the avenue leading to the monument visible in the background; the ground is painted in various colors, highlighted by a large, beautiful hibiscus design near the sculpture. ![82887.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/242hRqm2QYW41bf11E45uMqNk6viBtB8uC2rRp997W1WmUpAuqpbLGsKXWNCEXHJjjSJB.jpg) ![82873.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EouA9r4uec2ChwhVLTZ1kbLJxeZi78f3KSD4icRcBFk59NxR1Cj1SFTakXbj4TpUTe8.jpg) ![82874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoptwyFmtD1zqZj1Q7p5375eB7eX56jTzWhk1FQDoA4UbMCZdMuBFGH1Qy5NFmdshTe.jpg) ![82875.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23xAdzhfcDHMS1dU3mYHu57zw5L4cZBMshxBnG2dUkRgNiZY8LeuAdaAQrdhhqpKeD9YG.jpg) ![82876.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqJ2FQe7vG8r2iJLJ3Dorg7NkJFPyT5Pr8QNGdeUzWt81cQ4YPK8LXvZUq331ARGXMm.jpg) ![82877.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EprTAvbes96pyKuQDG9zkDaaEK5KtEH9wsUkspTvKK1yRMzJiz7EsKdS41BbqWFXJYQ.jpg) ![82878.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep3fmhe98CZAtQ86d9SM5ZvkCQK6r7vDs3CDU5aEiteBp6Ljkvdp12sWmw3LA1NWZzq.jpg) ![82879.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23yd3uzQVyEhc7EYGqpt3Vs9zpAwmGEKZjGLMCRAn1S2XW724ARvVDkEMxUvsH1jkiyF2.jpg) ![82880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23y8xKTwywCdJuXnCG9fCeqoDJhB8RRQQv63neakomsp3cWfMJnEn8Kmwqg4KEBQdmwhB.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> La placa es negra y lleva el sello del estado Sucre y el logotipo de la gobernación a ambos lados. El suelo de hormigón está decorado con líneas amarillas, grises y azules, y presenta en el centro una hermosa flor de hibisco que ocupa una gran superficie. Más adelante se encuentran jardineras cuadradas —adornadas con líneas de colores y un hibisco en la esquina— seguidas de una vista de los bancos grises, que lucen franjas de esos mismos colores. Desde la entrada se divisa el sendero que conduce a la escultura, flanqueado por bancos, caminos y jardineras tanto cuadradas como circulares; la vista se dirige luego hacia el camino central, los bancos y las jardineras situadas a los lados.

> The plaque is black and bears the seal of Sucre State and the governor's office logo on both sides. The concrete ground is decorated with yellow, gray, and blue lines, featuring a beautiful hibiscus flower in the center that spans a large area. Further along, there are square planters—adorned with colored lines and a hibiscus in the corner—followed by a view of the gray benches, which feature stripes in those same colors. From the entrance, one can see the walkway leading to the sculpture, flanked by benches, pathways, and both square and circular planters; the view then shifts to the central walkway, the benches, and the planters situated along the sides. ![82881.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/243fr9kDVZgyam91vSJ1Qj6fyMYz3zb1QxJz2Hj84AFbw6CRVmZqYVHrwtGcanEnRe9vQ.jpg) ![82882.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpxsCmRy8P8A3jAK2US16vhA6TovmrAGvcuoXJMiUe1yFdTPf8BU2vXLKrydSLDK4FV.jpg) ![82883.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EowG2U3sShrRZxVQUt59xyagg4MEcWrAuXzquZ5ANQrPmkyU569xiJoD6ePaDdTDGSZ.jpg) ![82884.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpNovtYFv7iz2itGu3i47mbDJWsMTnPGuf18jdu5nJHJiLPNoZ3yTTgrZXZr8LJ6URo.jpg) ![82885.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpEHDzvTBPMfLUuPyivDABKuFrBkisRpL9BnBZbbdG1ht6rcWWG5MJxoHdFHeRpV8tP.jpg) ![82886.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eokchq98TPZtvdu3zCqyoXSX5tazaACzmhU4C1x4p1Egei1nwwaGFKEx57HGiCeFKaJ.jpg) ![82888.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EonmyLo55zwCoueZk4YgUZ23m1bmt5iKmrrnbgsJzVHWo5fxzkga796MvqXMitavgig.jpg) ![82889.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqHyy81XanfC8bbL7z6DXB8Zt9ni3aQoa7z3fg3NWtDUVBg7s1wbi2LyTDWyPjZWUcp.jpg) ![82890.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqHyQ9dnTYzzZQe8oLBP8qLbzN7TbFyRHYVigxTmrUAQMakgtXGgJVYRa8RsppW3f8t.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Al acercarte a la escultura, encuentras quioscos de madera con bancos, así como papeleras e iluminación LED para ayudar a mantener limpia la zona. Esta plaza destaca por sus coloridos parterres y la escultura de la *cayena* (hibisco) situada al fondo; es un espacio diseñado para el disfrute y el esparcimiento tanto de niños como de adultos. Me gustó mucho el diseño de la gallina y las franjas coloridas que decoran el suelo de la plaza. Gracias por acompañarme en esta aventura mientras recorría los senderos y aprendía sobre la cultura de la *cayena*, en homenaje a María Rodríguez.

This plaza stands out for its colorful garden borders and the *cayena* (hibiscus) sculpture located at the far end; it is a space designed for the enjoyment and recreation of both children and adults. I really liked the design of the hen and the colorful bands decorating the plaza floor. title.title: ‎If The Money Is Right and Chelsea Already Have A Replacement, Let Him Go
title.body:
‎To say the fact, I’m not going to lose sleep if Enzo Fernández ends up leaving Chelsea which I believe he will.
‎
‎Of course, he is a good midfielder and he has played an important role for us, but football is bigger than one player. If Manchester City genuinely want him and are ready to meet Chelsea’s valuation, then I’m perfectly fine with the club moving on.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ6o7XKUPjx8NdDJEAGz7JHe5TQHQBpGuQWqHJdYLwsK2/Chelsea-plan-to-sign-Monaco-midfielder-Lamine-Camara-as-Enzo-Fernandezs-replacement.jpg 

‎[Source](https://teamtalk.com/chelsea/enzo-fernandez-sale-decision-chelsea-60m-lamine-camara-transfer-exclusive)
‎
‎What interests me more is what Chelsea do next.
‎
‎The news that Chelsea have agreed a deal for Lamine Camara from Monaco is actually quite interesting. The Senegalese midfielder is only 22, and if the club sees him as someone capable of stepping into the midfield after Enzo, then I’m willing to give the guy a chance.
‎
‎I know some Chelsea fans will be worried about losing Enzo, but personally, I’m looking at the bigger picture.
‎
‎If City come with the right money, take the player, and Chelsea use that money wisely to strengthen the squad, then why should we complain?
‎
‎My only concern would be replacing Enzo properly.
‎
‎I don't want Chelsea to sell him for a huge amount and then suddenly realise they have no proper replacement. That would be poor planning. But if Camara is already coming in and the club genuinely believes he can develop into an important midfielder, then I have no problem with the decision.
‎
‎And let's be honest, £120 million is serious money.
‎
‎If Manchester City are prepared to pay that kind of figure for Enzo, Chelsea have to be smart. We should not hold onto players simply because they have a big name or because fans are emotionally attached to them.
‎
‎Players leave. New players arrive. That's football.
‎
‎What matters is whether Chelsea can continue building a team capable of competing for trophies.
‎
‎So if Enzo stays, fine.
‎
‎If he leaves for the right price, also fine because I'm already tired of his transfer saga all this while.
‎
‎I’m more interested in seeing what Lamine Camara can bring to this Chelsea midfield.
‎
‎Maybe this could even turn out to be one of those transfers where we look back a year or two later and say, “Chelsea actually made the right decision.”
‎
‎For now, I’m keeping an open mind.
‎
‎If City want Enzo, pay the money. If Camara is the replacement, let’s see what the young man can do. 💙🔥
‎
‎#Chelsea #EnzoFernandez #LamineCamara #CFC #ChelseaFC
‎

title.title: Slim people don't separate fights
title.body: On a particular Saturday, my boss informed me that Mr. John had been admitted to the hospital because he had been pierced with a knife.\n\n_\

_ he replied, and I couldn't believe what I just heard. I knew the son in question couldn't have been in an ordinary one to have had them use a knife in the fight as if they were shooting a Chinese movie. On Sunday of that week, which was the following day, I decided to go to the hospital after church to visit him. When I got there, I wept. The guy couldn't even open his eyes to see the people around him. He was still battling the pain from the knife-cut injury. When I got back and asked questions about the situation involving the family whose fight he had gone to de-escalate, they said the guy who stâbbed him was a cūltist and had been on the run ever since he committed the crime. That situation added more fuel to the reasons why I don't like to de-escalate fights. The only fights you can see me de-escalating are the ones involving children, which I can swish away from each other with just 10% effort from my right hand. You can't see me in the midst of fights between adults, not even in husband-and-wife fights. I can only tell them to stop fighting with my mouth, but I never get physical when trying to separate a fight because I'm very slim by nature, and people's moves can easily kick me away. I don't want to experience that.

/>

Many times, I have witnessed fights between husbands and wives in my area, and I don't dare launch myself into the fight just because I want to separate them. No way. I can only shout at them to stop.

Thanks for reading.

title.title: You’ll Love This Cauliflower
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUo3w9hKcxyfdCQ9xg2JpvDVf2fnensyrNmqP5yPHg2yB/1788065787754.png)

Today I thought of sharing a simple and delicious vegetable recipe with you. If you like cauliflower then you will definitely enjoy this recipe. Today we are making a very tasty and flavorful cauliflower. It is easy to make and you can serve it with roti, naan or rice. It also tastes really good with cold yogurt.
So let’s start and see what ingredients we need.
Ingredients
For this recipe I am using two cauliflowers. We also need about five tomatoes, one onion, ginger and garlic. You can also take green chilies according to your taste.
For the spices I am using mixed spices, salt and a little cumin and coriander powder. You can add the spices according to your taste.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWra1V38jg4LAYYcV3jAPxnToiPZT35PaB7t7vMXg55tb/1788065823315.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRxHFp22YdUZNbLrZMz1x2UXdiK7eFHej1oZhnZWyr6zf/1788065823738.jpg)

For garnishing we will need some green chilies and fresh coriander.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYK2XnBeBgyKoo9r4BENS5KqHKCtMa34r5UJ58q1bqhAb/1788065860136.jpg)

How to Make It
First wash the cauliflower well and then cut it into pieces. I am cutting the cauliflower into bigger pieces because we like big pieces of cauliflower at home. You can cut them smaller if you like.
After cutting and washing the cauliflower, take some water in a pot. Add a little turmeric and salt to the water. Now add the cauliflower and boil it lightly for about 5 to 10 minutes.
I like to clean cauliflower this way because sometimes there can be small insects or dirt inside the cauliflower that we cannot see from outside. When you boil it lightly, the dirt and small insects, if any, come out into the water.
After boiling, drain all the water from the cauliflower and keep it aside.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRsMLvHVdMyw9FT94C2ijdvQZLfJ2wkYubtR8hdhFGYSX/1788065900264.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS65cTrXdpAFQu5aM36z3EYgfmbCpg4gy4m8cDQgHFjts/1788065900595.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUjpxbWEHq9kBJ9s6co3mxvhaybS51kH2PvrvLKrMhVrr/1788065900891.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTE3VLWDF1pyGwfJaJWHxnGJDcx6sC6cWyY71draDjHHU/1788065901223.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfYBS5vHvnmxWd9A5Q1NqrW8p7PaCgisqgjJwpFwNBVsH/1788065901558.jpg)

Now take a pan or a pressure cooker and add some oil. Heat the oil and add finely chopped onion. Fry the onion until it becomes light golden brown.
Now add crushed ginger and garlic. Fry them well with the onion until the raw smell goes away and everything becomes nice and fragrant.
Next, add the spices. I am adding mixed spices, salt and a little cumin and coriander powder. Mix everything well and cook the spices for a little while.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZf1Azp9L6E6akBqh58a3HviBDJf1h4DmybLYPkjiVs3g/1788065937441.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPbvp5xcCJURnejW49MDp36kYV77MXfidPgDi2rpYk3sM/1788065937779.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTgatzp9Hhfev8gCkZ37Fef5FotGc9sm2iAuq8cJMES61/1788065938117.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPeMPGNV4KVxpgeq1WhjrD8YK74VBKTTRN5BBvU6AtKLN/1788065938486.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzqYbbnLYqRP6Z42zLNqNi1XWLtDK2ToLa4tdJmTWCL3/1788065938836.jpg)

Now add the boiled cauliflower. Mix it well with the spices and fry it for a few minutes. This helps the cauliflower absorb all the delicious flavors of the spices.
Once the cauliflower is nicely fried, add the chopped tomatoes. Mix everything well and cover the pan.
I am making this cauliflower in a pressure cooker today because I wanted to cook it quickly. But you can also make it in a normal pot or pan.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjukDaHpHFGfRR5Kyxd2e8PFjpiwFdme5GXHHbpRBMe5/1788065985669.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmafXhE43JiHALbCvaMWz7T9gZKQ9k2YZSJGVY7LFCtFeF/1788065986030.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcJLzSoKQgrohWxGF7hcHyRX49f8dDeiE7JKo8Aa5o5cr/1788065986389.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXqDeDRPZjVhVWyWiuovEPvqmChuYW9zgthxBtLHdvJs7/1788065986765.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNRgaKH4Gn1N6zT7xU9t9m24oVczHpPkJ3yeSm2YRAUo/1788065987152.jpg)

If you are using a pressure cooker, give it pressure for about five minutes. If you are cooking it in a normal pot, cook it on low to medium heat for about 20 minutes or until the cauliflower becomes soft and well cooked.
Once the cauliflower is cooked and the tomatoes have mixed well with the spices, our delicious cauliflower is ready.
Finally, garnish it with some green chilies and fresh coriander.
And that’s it! Our delicious and flavorful cauliflower is ready to serve.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXtrweeoLJsFnhaxeM8fGnsru7oDPYXRuAwDQB43knPa9/1788066063914.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT3ZxK5bDTeEEMsoqpZB4EGgaYs7vxd94MsdXg5HJnKR2/1788066064280.jpg)

You can enjoy it with roti, naan or rice. I especially love eating it with cold yogurt because the combination tastes even better.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcpcbjvuNj1YuFF19evETeGKrq5QSBd5sGiEMyR293AFG/1788066081522.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVjErcJCsUxVU4DxHmVWd52qVHj48T4qknT2tYQwSkCCH/1788066081925.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQFSYPYL85NbrX4xqcAL3zfrJF9vc11aGTMsRnHgo7ZmK/1788066082309.jpg)

If you like cauliflower, do try this simple recipe at home. I hope you enjoy it as much as we do.
This was my recipe for today. Thank you for reading and I hope you will give it a try

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPNoTcqQBAir5SfBoS6GSXWfu4kKYvRhhTdNQ2JNWtiY6/img_0906.png)
Hello Hivers! It’s me again with another travel  blog. In my recent blogs i mentioned lower Kachura lake this time its Uper kachura Lake which is around at 30 minutes distance from 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT9hZe5AF87sNLeKDHobACSqpCoH4WcoZdBYqUWTA5qSy/img_0676.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaenrUcB7ymsZrEZjVZBTREuEmdvAQpux5neEVLvt4Sj8/img_0677.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXbfYkKD1VoBm8xSb78chLPExVKQALau9D9F3eWMgwi6P/img_0680.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXv3f2hdg3xMYCNmnvtkNMVcZv55doNULjaJx9ZhjQimV/img_0681.jpg)

lower kachura Lake aka Shangrilla.
So, we went to Upper Kachura Lake, and the journey was absolutely worth it and amazing. Since cars can’t reach the lake itself, we had to park our car and walk for a while to get there. It was very tiring and I was out of breath while reaching  there. 


It’s approximately an hour to an hour and a half away from Skardu city itself while from shangrila  it takes around 20 to 30 minutes to reach this side and around 15 mins of walk 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUvLeoPvQQ1EqL2Eq9dwPqDRN9rgqszzbXsoZchveAMUW/img_0682.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJ6LBKdtTELN2p9M64te56qb5JaEPvgBNviFdNsGML53/img_0684.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNBQyDGg3qaw7yDQTMoNk5CggfTze3e1s8sf7JR2dbt1/img_0687.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY6cqQWCKX51wM7BSG9cuq2k9YMfsbAcr7dzAzGVEKn5S/img_0691.jpg)

The views along the way were absolutely beautiful. Once we reached the lake, we went for boating, and honestly, it was an extremely interesting experience I both cried and laughed  at the same time as i was scared but it was funny aswell I had done this kind of boating before, but this felt completely different. It wasn’t the usual calm, simple kind of boating—it was a little adventurous and definitely something I’ll remember.

After that, we had a cup of tea and started climbing up, and then came the hiking part. On our ways there were small vendors selling dried fruits and gem stones. They had made their stalls and shops outside their house and sell organic things especially to tourists there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKVuGYxfkFEjNJZfRX9UimptvYhXEPFZgBY2AG9MLCKn/img_0679.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTRR2NyxYKj5LXJdzsoei8HkDbFFjRegh2x1QNHe9gsYy/img_0675.jpg)

This was of my visit to this beautiful lake. Let me know if you have ever been to this place or something like this.

title.title: Two floors of joy\\Zwei Etagen voller Freude
title.body:
Hello,my friends!
New story of Svinni the pig right now!



![dvaetazha.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaFRVhFJgCMaNaoxQf9FabyEzbrdzsoGjPyTyJmQ86q5B/dvaetazha.jpg)

And so one day, two friends set off on another long journey. Everyone knows that long trips are best taken by train. The romance of stops and the clatter of square wheels. Tea in faceted glasses in cup holders, cookies from the conductor, and all that. Choop-choop, and the train departed. Off we go! This time, it wasn't just any train, but a two-story train!

Cthulhu was sent to scout the upper floor, while Svinni remained on the lower floor. He had no business walking up and down those stairs! There are specially trained squids with multiple legs for that. He had to figure out which way is more convenient! Maybe things are much better up there! Maybe there's blackjack, casinos, and girls with low social responsibility? In fact, Svinni had cheated a little. Numerous bags of food went down with Svinni. He couldn't carry all that wealth up to the upper floor! Piglet prepares very carefully for trips and takes hefty bags of food with him. It's a long trip, so we need to travel in comfort and be prepared for the unexpected! What if we get hungry?!

In the midst of the pig feast, Cthulhu entered the compartment... It turned out the second floor wasn't so great. The view from the window was a bit problematic, and the squid was so seasick that he wouldn't mind a piece of chicken. The hint was clear! Cthulhu was simply hungry, that's why he came down. Now we'll slip him some fried squid, heh, and see what he says! Then he'll squeal and scurry up to the second floor, and we'll have a decent meal without him!

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Und so brachen zwei Freunde eines Tages zu einer weiteren langen Reise auf. Jeder weiß, dass lange Reisen am besten mit dem Zug zurückgelegt werden. Die Romantik der Haltestellen und das Klappern der eckigen Räder. Tee in eleganten Gläsern in den Becherhaltern, Kekse vom Schaffner und so weiter. Tusch-tusch, und der Zug fuhr ab. Auf geht's! Diesmal war es nicht irgendein Zug, sondern ein doppelstöckiger!

Cthulhu wurde losgeschickt, um das Obergeschoss zu erkunden, während Svinni unten blieb. Er hatte nichts auf den Treppen zu suchen! Dafür gibt es speziell trainierte Tintenfische mit mehreren Beinen. Er musste herausfinden, welcher Weg bequemer war! Vielleicht ist es da oben viel besser! Vielleicht gibt es Blackjack, Casinos und Mädchen mit wenig Verantwortungsbewusstsein? Tatsächlich hatte Svinni ein wenig geschummelt. Zahlreiche Säcke mit Essen waren mit ihm nach unten gewandert. Er konnte den ganzen Reichtum unmöglich nach oben schleppen! Ferkel bereitet sich sehr sorgfältig auf Reisen vor und nimmt immer große Säcke mit Essen mit. Es ist eine lange Reise, also müssen wir es uns bequem machen und auf alles gefasst sein! Was, wenn wir Hunger bekommen?!

Mitten im Schweinefestmahl betrat Cthulhu das Abteil … Es stellte sich heraus, dass das zweite Stockwerk nicht so toll war. Die Aussicht aus dem Fenster war etwas gewöhnungsbedürftig, und dem Tintenfisch war so übel, dass er sich über ein Stück Hühnchen gefreut hätte. Der Wink war klar! Cthulhu hatte einfach Hunger, deshalb war er heruntergekommen. Jetzt stecken wir ihm ein paar frittierte Tintenfischstücke zu, heh, und schauen, was er sagt! Dann wird er quieken und schnell wieder ins zweite Stockwerk huschen, und wir können ohne ihn eine anständige Mahlzeit genießen!

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

title.title: Breaking Free from Analysis Paralysis: How I Reorganized My Crypto.com Stack for Maximum Returns
title.body: Today I took what for me is drastic action. I unstaked my Level-Up CRO in the Crypto.com app. It's a big decision because my account has been grandfathered into the Level-Up Plus tier with 2550 CRO, which is far less in value today than it was when I staked. The Level-Up tier requires $500 worth of CRO, which it was worth back when I originally staked it. I'll discuss why I made my decision and what I expect to happen now that I've done it.\n\n

/>

I often become paralyzed by too much analysis. Lately, I've decided to do what many people do, which is to do something and worry about the fallout later. I don't know if there will be fallout, mind you. It's a reversible decision, although it would be a bit more difficult to undo. I think it was a rational decision to unstake, and the numbers should demonstrate why.

<h2 style=\

>PLUS Crypto.com offers [membership tiers](https://crypto.com/us/levelup) for staking different amounts of CRO or for subscribing. You can certainly use the service without staking or subscribing, which would cost you full retail on all transactions. My membership was at the PLUS level, which offers 2-3.5% cash back rewards on spending with their debit and/or credit card. There are other benefits that come with this first level upgrade, but aren't all that useful unless you do your banking on their platform. For example, you get higher interest (3.25% APY) on cash deposits, paid in CRO.

>PRO The Level-Up Pro tier is where things start to get interesting. Unlike PLUS, the PRO tier pays staking rewards for the CRO that is locked up. The difference is that the lockup goes from $500 worth of CRO to $5000 worth of CRO. This is a 10X greater commitment, which rewards the user. For that commitment, the user also gets more cash back on spending and higher interest on deposited cash. I'll skip the other tiers as they are presently unreachable to me and expand on the same concept, staking $50K worth of CRO and stake $500K worth of CRO. Greater cash back on spending, etc. . . .
>Long-term Staking Tiers Several months back, Cronos governance voted to offer tiered staking rewards. *

>It's not until recently that Crypto.com added the feature allowing users to change staking tiers to their app interface. The feature is still not available on the Cronos onchain app, but will be released mid-September.

>The 4-Year staking option is the reason that I have decided to unstake for the Plus tier, which offers no staking rewards at all. At current valuations, the rewards would not be much. But once a crypto bull market kicks in, the staking rewards could be more meaningful. The idea is to take the 2550 CRO that were staked for the card and put them into the 4-Year staking to start compounding.

>Something else that Crypto.com instituted is the option to upgrade the Level-Up tier via subscription rather than staking. For $4.99/month or $49.90/year, you can enjoy all the benefits of PLUS without having to lock up your CRO. For the PRO tier, the subscription goes up to $29.99/month or $299.90/year.

>If you don't have a large amount of CRO, it's unlikely to make sense to subscribe. You would need to spend like a fiend on the debit or credit card to justify the subscription from the cash back rewards.

>In my case, it makes sense to unlock the 2550 CRO, combine it with the other CRO I have, and stake the full 11,000 CRO for a 4-Year term, yielding a bit over 100 CRO per month in rewards. At the present price of $.05834, that's more than the cost of the monthly subscription. And things will only improve by staking more CRO, or with a good bull market run.

>There is a similar point at which it makes sense to pay the monthly subscription for the PRO tier out of pocket rather than from card staking. That point, at today's price, is roughly 45,500 CRO, which would yield enough to cover the $29.99 cost every month. Although the PRO level membership does pay rewards for card staking, the rate is much lower than the rewards for the 4-Year staking. It makes more sense to upgrade with cash flow from the staking rewards than by directly staking for the card.

One important detail about this decision is that unstaking from Level-Up has a 28-day wait period before the CRO becomes available. Had I been receiving staking rewards, that would have been a loss. However, the PLUS level doesn't pay out card staking rewards, so there is no difference. I will, however, not receive any cash back rewards on purchases with the debit card until I decide to either stake again or subscribe for a Level-Up tier.

>I'm still undecided whether I should subscribe to the PLUS level now, or wait until all of my CRO is in 4-Year staking. About half of it is locked in Airdrop Arena, which pays out other tokens instead of CRO in return for staking. My CRO won't be completely released from Airdrop Arena until November. The main disadvantage of subscribing is that I'd be paying to be able to earn cash back on more spending. In some form, it makes sense as I'd be offsetting the cost of the subscription with the cash back rewards.

>An alternative would be to take the $4.99 each month and buy more CRO. This works out at the present CRO price. However, should the price of CRO increase significantly, I might be better to rely on free CRO rewards from staking and cash back.

>After making the decision and executing on it, I feel much better as I can just let it go from my mind.

\n\n#crypto #cryptocurrency #cro #staking #crypto-com #defi #blockchain #investment #finance
