title.title: THE PERFECT COUNTER TO CRIPPLE! 🔥 | 72 MANA
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Aug 29, 2026, 12_15_48 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23u64tavExeJFPdtuRhkE2BCb4KyKiGTFsfcasEVU9dhuQ4WTA8fRdc4w4WwBsRAptex2.png)


Today's 72 mana battle was very interesting and especially if we look at its rules they were very special which was important to understand. Remember that in any battle for winning it is necessary for you to understand the rules well and along with that select your monsters correctly and bring your monsters into the battle field under a specific strategy and plan. 

50% of winning any battle is in understanding the rule set correctly especially if three modifiers come then you have to be very careful and where there are restrictions make your plan accordingly and where you are given an advantage then you will give more preference to those monsters.

Today's high mana battle was very interesting where I got the best opportunity to select monsters because in a high mana battle the choice of monster selection is much higher and you can easily select and position them properly according to the rule set. 

Before I tell you about the battle and strategy it is important to understand these rule sets well and according to them I will share my strategy and battle plan.

![Screenshot 2026-08-29 115329.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/EoEjFEdryVEbzXFFgwPwgs5LzBq54bESLphE8papQVY8Pm1Cw9K16pgPRPsZPxRMAtK.png)


### RULESET 1 - TIS BUT SCRATCHES

The first rule set is Tis But scratches. This is a rule set where all units whether they are allied units or enemy units all of them get the Cripple ability. 

Now what happens in Cripple is that after every successful attack -1 health is reduced. For example I have any monster and it attacks and after a successful attack meaning the attack does not miss or dodge then the health of that same monster meaning my monster is reduced by minus one.

One thing you should also keep in mind is what removes the effect of the Cripple ability. Any monster that also has the Immunity ability so it is better that you give preference to a monster with the Immunity ability in this battle so that the Cripple ability and its effect can be removed.

Keeping this rule set in mind it is better to plan this strategy that first of all you will give preference to monsters with Immunity ability after that you should try to select monsters with high health and high armor because after every successful attack your health has to continuously decrease which keeps making the unit weaker after every round.

### RULESET 2 - OUTSIDER

The second special rule set is Outsider and in this you are only allowed to summon one Wild unit. Apart from this you cannot select any other Wild unit. 

So according to this rule set you should select from your Wild units the monster that has high health high armor and a heavy striker because as much as possible according to this rule set summon your best Wild unit and make a good grip in this battle.

![Screenshot 2026-08-29 120303.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23t7YTTwUmXJMBbhhkaMBFpbPpuCRMgTicBMkcdBVMKvCQwnA6pATGWdBBrFzh46V6NSm.png)


### RULESET 3 - HEALED OUT

Heal Out is the third rule set and in this all units and Archons will lose their abilities which restore health. For example any healer whether it is from a normal unit or from an Archon has no benefit in the battle according to this rule set because healing is removed. 

So keeping this rule set in mind it is important to understand that instead of focusing on healer monsters you should focus on monsters with high health.

So after understanding these three rule sets what strategy did I adopt? I selected my Archon monster which has the plus one health ability. Because of this all of my units will get plus one health at the beginning of the first round of the battle. 

### STRATEGY ACCORDING TO THE RULESETS

The health of all the monsters will increase because to survive the Cripple ability rule set one of the best options is to select monsters with high health.

After that I selected three strong melee tank monsters in the front line which had good health and also good strikers and in the mid to back position I kept a mixed combination of ranged and magic attackers so that they could stay in the back line and continue attacking.

Keeping these rule sets in mind I made sure that all the units should have good health so that they could survive the Cripple rule set for a long time.

![Screenshot 2026-08-29 120317.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tvg5ZQe6c5unifd4X4NvEHJ3Q8Y2MzSrxPP1ev6JszELmAaisu2Qh7BswdSE2g8Yga8.png)

![Screenshot 2026-08-29 120444.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uFTqpihXvKBwJoQeEiPnwBnCmPQUiPGwP2RyWf89SFLJPQm7QS13fJVFmLRdiA6gWTb.png)

![Screenshot 2026-08-29 120459.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/EoCiCKZbWnPQWhRjyw6Z3sR7dAuiEMt3vJRSsDQdgBxFiCXM8sB5p7hnj4ugj5ScKU7.png)

![Screenshot 2026-08-29 120508.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tvgpxveboC2G6pAJSkanx1vAsTkHJQzbP6vL32RkdDbpLFvm3xXcgMWHzLzL2p3w3dH.png)

### IN THE BATTLEFIELD

As soon as the battle started and I saw the enemy units I felt quite relaxed because in this battle my team was quite strong and this was going to be a one sided battle. 

At the beginning of the battle as I had adopted the strategy my front line monsters continuously absorbed damage and because of the continuous hits from my back line monsters two enemy units were eliminated.

In round two the enemy units made an excellent comeback where my front line monsters were eliminated. And similarly in round three my team's grip became strong again and all the enemy units from the front line to the mid position were destroyed while all my units except the front line remained alive.

And in the end it became a one versus five battle where I destroyed all the monsters of the enemy units and I got an excellent victory in this battle.

This was a one sided battle and the main reason for this was understanding the rule set correctly and selecting the monsters accordingly.

![Screenshot 2026-08-29 120359.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tbGx8sK8bA8NU9VtaWL8K2MgxiR9dNA7w94piEQkwYL7fmfTAfSnVTEBvDxdrtRvwte.png)


In this battle I would call my front line monster my favorite monster because due to continuously absorbing damage it helped me win this battle.

What would your strategy be in this type of rule set and which monsters would you give more preference to? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

title.title: [Movie] Sound of Freedom.
title.body:
<center>
https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQSJ4YtRfsKxDT8FMqpRshzhyHA2YZT4UxkqxWWT7Prg/1001793182.png
[Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt7599146/) 
</center>


<center>
![siempre_20260725_211847_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUGf5WPRe6NKSovFENgGNwnkZzzescHyPjNKRjNfrZYm4/siempre_20260725_211847_0000.png)
</center>




Cuando ví por primera vez el sonido de la libertad me impactó bastante, quizás porque el tema es algo delicado, esta película que mezcla el drama, el suspenso también me puso el corazón triste, se publicó en el año 2023 protagonizada por Jim Caviezel, además que es basada en hechos reales, tiene una duración de 131 minutos. Al tratarse de una historia real no puede dejar de pensar en los peligros que corren los niños del mundo.


>When I first saw The Sound of Freedom, it really impacted me, perhaps because the subject matter is somewhat sensitive. This film, which blends drama and suspense, also saddened me. Released in 2023 and starring Jim Caviezel, it's based on true events and runs for 131 minutes. Because it's a true story, I couldn't help but think about the dangers children around the world face.


<center>
![Screenshot_20260829_230959_IMDb.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUnUMwVrderQrFT4xrFjKwPehqayLSc2wYYbqiuEk4ehi/Screenshot_20260829_230959_IMDb.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt7599146/) 
</center>





La película se basa en la historia de un ex agente especial que logra infiltrarse para desmantelar y rescatar a niños de la trata de personas en América latina, bajo ofertas engañosas se llevaban a los niños de sus casas con autorización de sus padres lo que se vería después es algo fuerte y que desearía que no fuese cierto, el personaje desarrolla bien su papel aunque creo que en estos tiempos encontrar a alguien que arriesgue su vida en misión tan difícil sería algo casi imposible.

>The film is based on the story of a former special agent who manages to infiltrate and rescue children from human trafficking in Latin America. Under deceptive offers, the children were taken from their homes with their parents' permission. What is revealed later is disturbing, and I wish it weren't true. The character develops his role well, although I think that in these times finding someone willing to risk their life on such a difficult mission would be almost impossible.


<center>
![Screenshot_20260829_230910_IMDb.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgdgdYst2xW6QgqjYwzakNbucn8v7vU3ausgmzXjLGha/Screenshot_20260829_230910_IMDb.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt7599146/) 
</center>

<center>
![siempre_20260725_211847_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUGf5WPRe6NKSovFENgGNwnkZzzescHyPjNKRjNfrZYm4/siempre_20260725_211847_0000.png)
</center>




El protagonista se ve como un hombre fuerte, altamente capacitado y entrenado para la misión que toma por su propia cuenta, que es ir en busca de todos los niños secuestrados, mientras miraba las escenas se me ponía el corazón chiquitito, pienso que la maldad está en todas partes y no soportaría ver en una situación a un familiar, es difícil que en el mundo si pasen estas cosas, la escena que más me marcó fue cuando reúne a varios niños ya fuera de peligro, cantando disfrutando de su infancia a pesar de lo malo y mientras habla con su amigo dice está frase: \

Para mí una de las escenas más fuertes y que puede afectar nuestra parte emocional.\n\n>The protagonist is portrayed as a strong, highly skilled man, trained for the mission he undertakes on his own: to search for all the kidnapped children. Watching the scenes, my heart ached. I think evil is everywhere, and I couldn't bear to see a family member in such a situation. It's hard to believe these things happen in the world. The scene that affected me most was when he gathers several children, now safe, singing and enjoying their childhood despite the hardship. While speaking to his friend, he says, \

For me, it's one of the most powerful scenes, one that can deeply affect us emotionally.


<center>
![Screenshot_20260829_230948_IMDb.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb4cidxrTFF66KU39W17myQBcHHKufB8P6bnd7FWSuAA2/Screenshot_20260829_230948_IMDb.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt7599146/) 
</center>


<center>
![siempre_20260725_211847_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUGf5WPRe6NKSovFENgGNwnkZzzescHyPjNKRjNfrZYm4/siempre_20260725_211847_0000.png)
</center>


Se podría decir que algunas escenas exageran en cuanto a las peleas, pero no tengo muchas cosas negativas que decir,  la verdad si me gustó bastante ya que nos hace reflexionar, me mantuve pendiente de todo lo que pasaba así que te deja enganchado, puedo decir que es una buena película con un mensaje poderoso para todo el mundo, y es simplemente que debemos proteger a nuestros niños de todas las formas, durante la película Rocío y Miguel tuvieron la esperanza de ser rescatados y volver a sus casas con su padre. 


>You could say that some scenes are a bit exaggerated in terms of the fights, but I don't have many negative things to say. I actually liked it quite a bit because it makes you think. I was hooked on everything that was happening, so it really keeps you engaged. I can say that it's a good movie with a powerful message for everyone, which is simply that we must protect our children in every way possible. Throughout the movie, Rocío and Miguel held onto the hope of being rescued and returning home to their father.


<center>
![Screenshot_20260829_230934_IMDb.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWp48S4zKqcNM4HZ5aDWrtNHGg8Th8uhmuuhEb1P66mf2/Screenshot_20260829_230934_IMDb.jpg)

title.title: Playing to level up in Steal a Game ESP-ENG
title.body:
>

Saludos que tal su fin de semana saben estaba jugando roba un huevo en roblox un juego simple roba el huevo del jefe y llevatelo a tu base sencillo pero no tanto porque para lograr llevarte de las ultimas zonas o los huevos mas raros y pesados necesitas tener mucha mucha velocidad, de lo contrario te estaran alcanzando los jefes haciendo que sea casi imposible llevartelo de forma individual, en ayuda con otras personas puede ser mejor siempre que no te quieran ellos robar.

Greetings, how was your weekend? You know, I was playing \

in Roblox, a simple game: steal the boss's egg and bring it to your base. Simple, but not quite, because to manage to take eggs from the last zones or the rarest and heaviest eggs, you need to have a lot of speed. Otherwise, the bosses will catch up to you, making it almost impossible to take it on your own. Teaming up with other people can be better, as long as they don't try to steal from you instead.

>

Este dia fue una maravilla estuve cazando varios huevos como ven tengo ademas con mutaciones de cerezo que es de la ultima zona que sacaron entonces alla es mas dificil por que apesar de tener 3800 millones de velocidad aun era poco para esa zona entonces tenia que hacer muchos viajes para llevarme un huevo pequeño para mi base pero logre conseguir huevos muchos de otras zonas que me dan mucho dinero.

This day was fantastic, I was hunting several eggs. As you can see, I also got some with cherry blossom mutations, which is from the latest zone they released. So it's harder over there because despite having 3.8 billion speed, it was still too little for that area. I had to make many trips to carry a small egg to my base, but I managed to get plenty of eggs from other zones that give me a lot of money.

>

Con toda la emocion decidi comprar velocidad asi que gaste apenas 2 roblux como es poco no me molesta gastar para ir sumando un poco mas rapido velocidad, pero debo decir muchos han puesto mucho roblux que tienen mas de 100billones de velocidad una barbaridad para mi es una diferencia gigante por eso no me quedo en esos servidores con esas personas es imposible ganarles para tomar un huevo.

With all the excitement I decided to buy speed, so I spent just 2 Robux. Since it's a small amount, I don't mind spending it to build up speed a bit faster. But I must say many players have spent a lot of Robux and have over 100 trillion speed—an insane amount. For me, it's a huge difference, which is why I don't stay in servers with those players; it's impossible to beat them to snatch an egg.

>

Como estaba farmeando varios cristales de la zona de cerezo tenia para algunos huevos para mutar, esta maquina pide 1500 cristales de cerezo para dar alguna mumtacion solo existe 2, pero bloom es la mas comun tiene mas de 90% de posibilidad te salga esta mutacion la otra que ofrece es mas rara pero si te sale tu mascota va a dar mucho dinero.

Como no tengo mucha velocidad no pude tomar huevos muy grandes solo tome lo que podia, aun con todo esto me salieron buenas mascotas para mi nivel, tengo varias de 200millones que me da por segundo.

De esta manera estoy subiendo lentamente mi velocidad y el dinero que consigo en el juego, quiero comprarme las 2 ultimas caminadoras pero cuestan 300T y 100T de dinero entonces debo ahorrar por un buen tiempo.

Since I was farming several crystals from the cherry blossom area, I had enough for a few eggs to mutate. This machine asks for 1,500 cherry crystals to give a mutation. There are only 2 available, but \

is the most common with over a 90% chance of getting it. The other one offered is rarer, but if you get it, your pet will produce a lot of money. Since I don't have much speed, I couldn't take very large eggs, so I just grabbed what I could. Even with all that, I got good pets for my level; I have several that give me 200 million per second. In this way, I'm slowly increasing my speed and the money I earn in the game. I want to buy the last 2 treadmills, but they cost 300T and 100T in cash, so I'll have to save up for a good while.

---

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: August 30 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gabe3c92605ca572a11ca3e2841a60f1945bac7c54bf816b82de12f2c187d6d1b90dfc21d5b8b5dfd100496843df50bd982d99fe6d128cc3c4a6ddb828b8db22b_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Comencé mi recorrido en un parque que, aunque pequeño, estaba lleno de vida. Allí conocí a un anciano que siempre se sienta en el mismo banco, disfrutando de su libro. Hablamos brevemente, y me contó que ha estado leyendo clásicos desde hace más de 50 años, lo que me inspiró a volver a mis lecturas. Más adelante, pasé por un mercado local. El vibrante colorido de las frutas y verduras frescas era algo digno de ver. Conversé con una joven emprendedora que vendía jugos naturales. Ella me habló sobre la importancia de consumir productos locales y me ofreció una muestra de su jugo de remolacha, que estaba delicioso. En el camino, también vi un mural nuevo en una de las paredes de un edificio, una obra de arte que retrata la diversidad cultural de la ciudad. Su mensaje de unidad y aceptación realmente me resonó. En definitiva, fue una caminata no solo física, sino también un viaje lleno de conexiones humanas y descubrimientos artísticos. ¡No puedo esperar a salir de nuevo mañana! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Baked chicken with zucchini, red bell pepper, and celery  [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Hoy voy a compartir esta receta sencilla y deliciosa de pollo al horno con calabacín, pimiento rojo y apio: es una auténtica delicia para el paladar. Me encanta prepararla como plato principal porque es muy rica en proteínas y calorías. Espero que lapruebes. Aquí tienes las instrucciones paso a paso.

> >Today I’m sharing this simple and delicious recipe for baked chicken with zucchini, red bell pepper, and celery, it’s a real treat for the taste buds. I love making it as a main course because it’s packed with protein and calories. I hope you’ll give it a try. Here are the step-by-step instructions.
![Añadir un subtítulo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23zSBUj8oyT9xtKVS28Q9jWAsWsEjooH7PE26L3rCEQY1EKso6cTPmm4oR4oHeE3o4vsN.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EowGfFj7BBzAYoGJCyuVLxEquq7KzAfbXGvkLBrndvRKjrX7Ff8N8aKSTZo8vT4f6Fs.png) 700 grs de filete de pollo, 02 calabacines, 02 cebollas, 01 pimiento rojo, 02 tallos de apio, 01 cucharada de mostaza, 04 dientes de ajo, 01 cucharada de orégano, 01 cucharada de aceite de oliva, sal y pimienta al gusto. >700 grams of chicken breast, 2 zucchini, 2 onions, 1 red bell pepper, 2 celery stalks, 1 tablespoon of mustard, 4 cloves of garlic, 1 tablespoon of oregano, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt and pepper to taste.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

>
Empieza lavando los filetes de pollo y sazonándolos con sal, pimienta, mostaza, ajo picado, aceite de oliva y orégano; mézclalos bien y déjalos marinar durante media hora.

> >Start by washing the chicken cutlets and seasoning them with salt, pepper, mustard, crushed garlic, olive oil, and oregano; mix well and let them marinate for half an hour.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eondoa8Je38EJ1rdA6qoUQSDZ3WkYbwizrqmCPHzYDrQ3fLR8FNdMSRqk4VyqnP5SpQ.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep1UyVgucJbwcHoBgN96ny9Gs7ce3HxrcRASV3d65SgwHKXaJMLn9BBWKRkmy8qpbJ8.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAcd3BMyjG9D4wDujos8Ehvx9M1FhgwkPHxi6ByseRGf2kemfSPG9Ca4CcHQq93Jwv.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep9z3G2s8HENKisioHwyNeieRuEjwJeWvpBkkMQEUyqyhP5TPfmQNiv9UgLRBTPvgnc.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EokbgWavei75nxVevjPF6UZvBKyFwsHS5rDinx9ofxYB3bDY3UzDrPsgTScqkPAoTrv.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/2432LHDX2o2TzzqpJxNW4higf2JevG77MiJ3vsNhSCFgqAovxcxCUXpXkh6cUb7hW5A5U.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoptPjToGiMpuP7NsbYrsH2waRDcLLk5fcPUCm3Bbvow9M5GJstZDALdpRUKfWgk3d1.png)

>
Luego, lava y corta la cebolla y el pimiento rojo en tiras finas, el calabacín en rodajas y el apio en trozos.

> >Next, wash and cut the onion and red bell pepper into julienne strips, the zucchini into slices, and the celery into chunks.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoCj3nbt3JgLeteAdPFE4KmKrKyCCEtWNC3cKXRm6oYwNR9uSU1we1seCxJd2uoiz1i.png)

>
Engrasa una bandeja de horno con aceite de oliva y, a continuación, coloca en ella el pollo, la cebolla, el pimiento rojo, el apio y el calabacín; sazona con sal y pimienta y cúbrelo con papel de aluminio.

> >Grease a baking sheet with olive oil, then arrange the chicken, onion, red bell pepper, celery, and zucchini on it; season with salt and pepper, and cover with aluminum foil.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGyNqzUQoUrBLMswhVRdFjNBzViQhLhGNopKukagJqKXmZBb9WPTd6kdyZjWVPX3K6.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo8UkZp9iH3WeMsZyUahV2K9QXDy3UAEPQcb4pRwdQ1knJQVo6CVccKy3usXRHRUuLC.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAbAQrWi81N33GEFtTdcrt4hMiVzwgMdWvcVKjsRihGJrvybQBbTwuVXs4VBivRrrC.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAcbAxFgxkGa6uvHyTJEcU6vyzM7mMoZWoJtM9P5FKeUL3WxW7i5QmdTPvCLJwzC7a.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAbcHPS9jWyf4fP7T1EQceQdp8R99ofuBBSKSo6d7StepWU13A3W3Cw5Pmc4BVE8U2.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo4CRon7CZiHVaMxkZZXqMk5MUZtekxsi6Sw123epQCp6TbYBoK7dMuB3yf8dEQ4wK3.png)

>
Hornea a 200 °C durante aproximadamente una hora, o hasta que se dore. A mitad de la cocción, retira el papel de aluminio para que se evapore el líquido. Dale la vuelta al pollo para que se dore por ambos lados y las verduras queden tiernas.

> >Bake at 200 °C for about an hour, or until golden brown. Halfway through baking, remove the aluminum foil to allow the liquid to evaporate. Turn the chicken over so it browns on both sides and the vegetables are tender.

title.title: (Segunda parte) [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVJg2u4YepLryEUjamSrZ2p715HXv9c1Zd6qSYBj3Xmf/1788058405807.jpg)

[Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/una-mujer-sentada-en-una-silla-frente-a-un-nino-ycIdYuLIPR4)

Saludos de nuevo a la comunidad Green Zone 💚

Retomo el hilo donde lo dejamos. Mi amiga actriz, sentada en el sillón de mi consulta, con esa confesión que pesaba como manta mojada. Y yo, con la certeza de que no podía ofrecerle recetas frías ni diagnósticos que la etiquetaran. Tenía que hablarle en su idioma. Y su idioma, el único que realmente la hacía vibrar, era el del escenario.

Así que hice algo que quizá suene extraño para un psiquiatra. Le propuse llevar nuestro trabajo terapéutico a su grupo teatral, disfrazarlo de taller de diálogo entre psiquiatría y teatro, y usar como excusa dos obras que son auténticos bisturíes existenciales: \

.

El grupo no sabía que detrás de aquella idea académica se escondía un pacto silencioso, una alianza terapéutica que ella y yo habíamos sellado en la intimidad de su confesión.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQxMr93GQGnoA3aySw3Hm5vpmq8c2Se6fc5bnPAv2uhU1/1788058581224.jpg)

[Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/hombre-sentado-en-una-silla-tapandose-los-ojos-12yvdCiLaVE)

Preparamos el taller con esmero. La obra de Wilder fue nuestra primera parada. La escena de Emily, ese momento en que la muchacha ya muerta regresa a su duodécimo cumpleaños, fue nuestro campo de batalla y nuestro territorio de paz.

Recuerdo aquella tarde de ensayo. Propuse que trabajáramos la escena desde dentro, no como interpretación, sino como encarnación. Mi amiga se dispuso a hacer de Emily. Y cuando llegó el momento de la pregunta clave, no fue Emily quien habló. Fue ella. Preguntó con la voz quebrada: \
\n\nEl silencio que siguió era el del reconocimiento. Alberto, un actor veterano que interpretaba al padre, se quedó inmóvil, con la mirada perdida en el vacío, y luego susurró: \

. Otro compañero, Carlos, que hacía el papel de George, abandonó su marcación y se sentó en el borde del escenario, con la cabeza entre las manos, y confesó que llevaba meses sintiendo que sus personajes le devoraban su propia identidad.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmViowSRJe1m38HTx8g4dx5fA8F4HFYWJ9kXXAUB9SibaM/1788058783076.jpg)

[Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/persona-caminando-por-el-laberinto-del-acantilado-de-piedra-betmVWGYcLY)

La segunda parte del taller fue el desmontaje de \
. Allí, Analía, una actriz joven que interpretaba a Sera en un monólogo que preparaba, dijo algo que heló la sala: \
. Y Alberto, que había estado en silencio, levantó la cabeza y añadió: \
.\n\nMi amiga, al final del taller, se me acercó. Me dijo con esa voz que ya no era la de la actriz ni la de la paciente, sino la de una mujer que acababa de dar un paso importante: \

Esa noche supe que habíamos hecho algo importante. No habíamos curado el vacío, pero habíamos logrado que dejara de ser un enemigo para convertirse en un territorio a explorar juntos. Y eso es el verdadero sentido del psicodrama: no eliminar los conflictos, sino darles un escenario donde puedan ser mirados, nombrados, abrazados.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejJZ7MQ7em8iVJkSpciT2DhWMGKF8uapEQioy7xpT1Sn/1788059133600.jpg)

[Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/un-grupo-de-personas-sentadas-en-una-habitacion-YlPCH249qHE)

Pero esta historia tiene más actos. Porque el vacío existencial no se resuelve en un taller. Lo que vino después, cuando mi amiga decidió llevar esas herramientas a su vida cotidiana, eso es lo que les contaré en la tercera y última parte de este dossier.

Y como siempre, invito a esta comunidad a sumarse. Especialmente quiero saludar a @ylich, que sé que estaba esperando esta segunda parte con la misma curiosidad con la que yo escuché aquella confesión inicial. Y también invito a mi estimada amiga @camelia28 a leer esta publicación, porque sé que su mirada sensible y su experiencia pueden enriquecer esta conversación.

Porque el arte de vivir, como el arte de actuar, se aprende en el ensayo constante, en el error, en el abrazo. Y el vacío, ese viejo conocido, quizá no sea más que el espacio que dejamos para que entre algo nuevo.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdUSFC4uSVyAUyEd7ms1Ss6ckihe5MdHcG1W8XwhN3eji/1788059294298.jpg)

[Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/decorado-con-sillas-y-mesas-jhPSJDhiRyQ)

Nos leemos en la tercera parte. 💚

Tu psiquiatra en Green Zone.

***

\

(Part Two)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVJg2u4YepLryEUjamSrZ2p715HXv9c1Zd6qSYBj3Xmf/1788058405807.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/una-mujer-sentada-en-una-silla-frente-a-un-nino-ycIdYuLIPR4)

Hello again, Green Zone community 💚

Picking up where we left off. My actress friend, sitting in the armchair of my office, carrying that confession that weighed like a wet blanket. And me, certain that I couldn't offer her cold prescriptions or labels disguised as diagnoses. I had to speak her language. And her language—the only one that truly made her vibrate—was that of the stage.

So I did something that might sound strange for a psychiatrist. I proposed taking our therapeutic work to her theater group, dressing it up as a dialogue workshop between psychiatry and theater, using as an excuse two plays that are genuine existential scalpels: Thornton Wilder's Our Town and Leaving Las Vegas.

The group had no idea that behind that academic proposal lay a silent pact—a therapeutic alliance she and I had sealed in the intimacy of her confession.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQxMr93GQGnoA3aySw3Hm5vpmq8c2Se6fc5bnPAv2uhU1/1788058581224.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/hombre-sentado-en-una-silla-tapandose-los-ojos-12yvdCiLaVE)

We prepared the workshop with care. Wilder's play was our first stop. Emily's scene—that moment when the deceased girl returns to her twelfth birthday—became our battlefield and our territory of peace.

I remember that rehearsal afternoon. I suggested we work the scene from within, not as interpretation but as embodiment. My friend prepared to play Emily. And when the key moment arrived, it wasn't Emily who spoke. It was her. She asked, in a fractured voice: \
\n\nThe silence that followed was one of recognition. Alberto, a veteran actor playing the father, stood frozen, his gaze lost in the void, then whispered: \

Another colleague, Carlos, who was playing George, dropped his blocking and sat on the edge of the stage, head in his hands, confessing that for months he'd felt his characters devouring his own identity.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmViowSRJe1m38HTx8g4dx5fA8F4HFYWJ9kXXAUB9SibaM/1788058783076.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/persona-caminando-por-el-laberinto-del-acantilado-de-piedra-betmVWGYcLY)

The second part of the workshop was the dissection of Leaving Las Vegas. There, Analía—a young actress preparing a monologue as Sera—said something that froze the room: \
And Alberto, who had been silent, lifted his head and added: \
\n\nAt the end of the workshop, my friend came up to me. She said, in a voice that was no longer the actress's or the patient's, but that of a woman who had just taken an important step: \

That night I knew we had done something important. We hadn't cured the void, but we had managed to turn it from an enemy into a territory to explore together. And that's the true meaning of psychodrama: not eliminating conflicts, but giving them a stage where they can be seen, named, embraced.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejJZ7MQ7em8iVJkSpciT2DhWMGKF8uapEQioy7xpT1Sn/1788059133600.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/un-grupo-de-personas-sentadas-en-una-habitacion-YlPCH249qHE)


But this story has more acts. Because the existential void doesn't get resolved in one workshop. What came after—when my friend decided to take those tools into her daily life—that's what I'll tell you in the third and final part of this dossier.

And as always, I invite this community to join in. A special shout-out to @ylich, who I know was waiting for this second part with the same curiosity with which I listened to that initial confession. I also invite my esteemed friend @camelia28 to read this post, because I know her sensitive gaze and experience can enrich this conversation.

Because the art of living, like the art of acting, is learned through constant rehearsal, through mistakes, through embrace. And the void—that old acquaintance—might just be the space we leave for something new to enter.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdUSFC4uSVyAUyEd7ms1Ss6ckihe5MdHcG1W8XwhN3eji/1788059294298.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/decorado-con-sillas-y-mesas-jhPSJDhiRyQ)

See you in part three. 💚

Your psychiatrist in Green Zone.

***

title.title: Q3 Investment Pipeline — Hugging Face, Perplexity, Poolside, and the Circularity We're Not Calling Circularity
title.body:
Let's tally what we're actually proposing to spend before Friday's board call, because I don't think the deck captures it cleanly.

$12.9 billion for Hugging Face. Company revenue: roughly $150 million annualized. That's an 86x multiple on a platform that hosts 2.5 million models and 950,000 datasets and, by its own founders' account two years ago, turned down $500 million from us because they didn't want to compromise platform neutrality. We're now offering roughly 26 times that rejected number for the whole thing. Something changed. It wasn't the revenue.

Separately, we're in talks to put money into Perplexity's new round at a $30 billion-plus valuation, more than 50% above the $20 billion mark it set less than a year ago. Perplexity's annualized revenue has gone from under $250 million in January to $750 million now, which sounds impressive until you note the growth is partly a function of Perplexity Computer running workloads that consume the exact compute we sell. We are proposing to fund the customer that buys our chips so it can grow fast enough to justify a valuation that makes our investment look prescient in hindsight. This is not a new structure. It rhymes with the Poolside licensing arrangement we signed earlier this year for $6 billion, and it rhymes with arrangements Lucent and Nortel used to run with their fiber customers in 1999, right up until the customers stopped paying and the vendor got left holding both the receivable and the write-down.

Nobody on this committee needs the history lesson. I'm including it anyway because the committee keeps acting like the circularity concern is a media narrative rather than a balance sheet fact. It is a balance sheet fact. When we fund Perplexity's round and Perplexity spends part of that money on our GPUs, we have converted an equity check into revenue recognition. That is not fraud, it's disclosed, Reuters and The Information have both reported the mechanics — but it is also not organic demand, and every analyst modeling our forward multiple off \

is modeling off a demand curve we are partially manufacturing ourselves.\n\nHere's the part of the memo that should actually worry people: none of this is happening in a friendly rate environment. Fed Chair Warsh spent Friday's Jackson Hole keynote walking through a 3.7% core PCE print and getting September hike odds from 35% to 57% in the space of one speech. The 2-year yield touched its highest level since July. Gold got taken down 3% in a session, which tells you money was scrambling for dollars, not safety. We are proposing to write an $12.9 billion check and lead a $30 billion-plus round in a week when the risk-free rate just repriced higher and the market flinched. Our own cost of capital is not falling. Our targets' valuations are rising anyway. That gap has to be justified by something other than \

because that phrase, respectfully, is not a discount rate.

I want to flag the legal overhang on Perplexity specifically, since it's been treated as a footnote. Amazon sued Perplexity over Comet's agent accessing Amazon accounts and placing orders without going through Amazon's own channel. The Ninth Circuit vacated the initial injunction on narrow computer-access-law grounds, which is a win, but the case is back at the district court and Amazon can still pursue contractual claims. As a minority investor we inherit some exposure to that; had this been a full acquisition instead of an equity round, we'd own the litigation outright. Someone should confirm the round structure protects us from anything beyond our check size, because right now the deck treats this as resolved and it isn't.

Silver hit $70 an ounce intraday this week for the first time on record. I mention this not because it's our problem but because it's a useful gut check on where capital is actually fleeing right now — into hard, uncorrelated, can't-be-diluted assets, at the same moment we're asking this committee to write checks into equity rounds priced at 40x and 86x revenue for companies whose growth partly depends on continued access to our own hardware. The market outside this building is pricing debasement risk. Inside this building we're pricing eighteen more months of exponential AI demand as though it's underwritten by something other than our own spending.

None of this means don't do the deals. Hugging Face gets us distribution and a genuine moat around the open-source layer that a competitor could otherwise own. Perplexity gets us a seat at a company Bezos and SoftBank already backed, ahead of a 2028 IPO its CEO has said will happen regardless of how OpenAI or Anthropic list. Those are real strategic rationales and I'd defend them in front of the board.

What I won't defend is presenting the revenue these investments generate as evidence of external demand when a meaningful share of it is our own money moving through someone else's income statement and back into ours. If a hike lands in September and growth-stock multiples compress the way they did the last three times the 2-year moved 10 basis points in a week, I'd like this committee on record as having known exactly how much of our growth story was self-funded before that happened, not after.

title.title: Delicioso desayuno: huevos fritos con calabacín y zanahoria , suero, arepa y café [ESP/ENG]
title.body: # Delicioso desayuno: huevos fritos con calabacín y zanahoria , suero, arepa y café [ESP/ENG]\n<div class=\

>

Buenas noches queridos amigos que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood , espero que todos hayan tenido un excelente día . Sean todos bienvenidos.

Hoy una vez más  paso por esta gran comunidad, con el fin de presentarles este delicioso y nutritivo desayuno que preparé el día de ayer para todos mis compañeros de misión.

![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7QHnaAKseCL3upbTyqhe8zWpj4GPGHqRwKsrSptNAE1zLpoouGBBSBdT3QPzzB82Bv.jpg)

Los ingredientes  que utilicé fueron :
* 1 calabacín grande
* 2 zanahorias pequeñas
* 5 huevos grandes 
* 4 cucharadas de aceite
* 1/4 de cebolla rayada
* 2 tomates grandes
* sal y pimienta al gusto 

Lo primero que hice fue sofreír la cebolla con el tomate cortado en cuadros muy pequeños, lo dejé cocinar por espacio de tres minutos, luego los trituré, le agregue la zanahoria rallada, revolví muy bien y le agregué  el calabacín rallado, revolví muy bien. 


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCFztLodgnJfp67bjEdzGfcZuzj9VqYCHjHME5zQnVNqNXrZEpgQntMdDta7ZA6Uv3b.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xpEiBP1W1SjEzX9GdVhvvEyhHZ8niAMonZrSp3kKAZs7DtEPKG72a6giiHyxToNGC27.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyZjxM7ZyNq2YCoFr1SUbmtxF9JXceEYjAzNHPfmrG5uzDCc54aNPeTidxKycEwmEdM.jpg)

A la par batí los huevos en un bol con sal y pimienta, luego los vertí en esta especie de salsa que hice con el tonante, zanahoria y el calabacín , volví a revolver y lo dejé tres minutos mas, de modo  que secara el agua que el calabacín suelta al momento de la cocción.

También acompañé estos huevos con suero criollo, arepas, cambur frito y una deliciosa tasa de café negro. 


![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVMW8AEmyfMK14bAACDmLzp6UVjK3HEDfr9M34hr1MQQiA7PnvMHHTXdRwzqrBoZK7Y.jpg)

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xL2VpAWCjwFcJekKb7YPAD5ypgg5r1gCGSqgB3EMU6HJRLNbXrDACSQfGeHg7fs7ixi.jpg)

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xeoyG5mX5JDUHd1RppGxnWTMWQAthHrsT6VekrvGM3Nvqf69nrvBsp19nk79a8Q5fmy.jpg)

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokdeBgi8sySUYS1jMRGwyeA82uJP7cjGvRLaziRd6RZcBJ9oDbEWNQbd8VqimGTEpm.jpg)


Realmente todo quedó muy rico y fue un desayuno nutritivo ya que contiene proteínas  que serían las proteínas del huevo Al igual el café también quedó súper delicioso ni simple ni dulce, quedó en su punto. 

Este desayuno es sencillo y rápido de preparar, es la primera vez que preparo los huevos de esta manera con calabacín y zanahoria. 
Hasta aquí mi contenido, espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos luego en un nuevo post. Saludos y bendiciones en abundancia para todos.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\

> # Versión en Inglés # Delicious breakfast: fried eggs with zucchini and carrots, whey, an arepa, and coffee. Good evening, dear friends who read my posts in the @hivefood community. I hope you all had a wonderful day. Welcome, everyone. Today, once again, I’m stopping by this great community to share with you this delicious and nutritious breakfast that I prepared yesterday for all my fellow mission members. ![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7QHnaAKseCL3upbTyqhe8zWpj4GPGHqRwKsrSptNAE1zLpoouGBBSBdT3QPzzB82Bv.jpg) The ingredients I used were: * 1 large zucchini * 2 small carrots * 5 large eggs * 4 tablespoons of oil * 1/4 of a shredded onion * 2 large tomatoes * salt and pepper to taste The first thing I did was sauté the onion with the tomatoes, cut into very small cubes. I let them cook for about three minutes, then pureed them, added the grated carrots, stirred well, and added the grated zucchini, stirring well again. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wCFztLodgnJfp67bjEdzGfcZuzj9VqYCHjHME5zQnVNqNXrZEpgQntMdDta7ZA6Uv3b.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xpEiBP1W1SjEzX9GdVhvvEyhHZ8niAMonZrSp3kKAZs7DtEPKG72a6giiHyxToNGC27.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyZjxM7ZyNq2YCoFr1SUbmtxF9JXceEYjAzNHPfmrG5uzDCc54aNPeTidxKycEwmEdM.jpg) At the same time, I beat the eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper, then poured them into this sauce I’d made with the tonante, carrot, and zucchini; I stirred it again and let it cook for three more minutes so that the water released by the zucchini during cooking would evaporate. I also served these eggs with Creole whey, arepas, fried plantains, and a delicious cup of black coffee. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVMW8AEmyfMK14bAACDmLzp6UVjK3HEDfr9M34hr1MQQiA7PnvMHHTXdRwzqrBoZK7Y.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xL2VpAWCjwFcJekKb7YPAD5ypgg5r1gCGSqgB3EMU6HJRLNbXrDACSQfGeHg7fs7ixi.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xeoyG5mX5JDUHd1RppGxnWTMWQAthHrsT6VekrvGM3Nvqf69nrvBsp19nk79a8Q5fmy.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokdeBgi8sySUYS1jMRGwyeA82uJP7cjGvRLaziRd6RZcBJ9oDbEWNQbd8VqimGTEpm.jpg) Everything turned out really delicious, and it was a nutritious breakfast since it contains protein—specifically, the protein from the eggs. The coffee was also super delicious—neither too plain nor too sweet—it was just right. This breakfast is simple and quick to make; it’s the first time I’ve prepared eggs this way with zucchini and carrots. That’s all for now. I hope you enjoyed this post, and I’ll see you soon in a new one. Greetings and abundant blessings to everyone. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/delicioso-desayuno-huevos-fritos-con-calabacn-y-zanahoria-suero-arepa-y-caf-espeng-ac)

title.title: #MyHiveGoals - Steady, Slow & Boring!
title.body:
![ttgtgg1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTNA2jokRGcQFx3UzEjF9cqSgrvLxcXnsrAAtv4ZHDoFn/ttgtgg1.png)

And it's just the way I like it :)

I have to apologize for making this post a bit shorter than normal.  I have some family that came in from out of town, so I snuck downstairs to get #myhivegoals for the week posted.

But like I mentioned in the title...THis week was steady, slow and very boring. Which is exactly how I want my weeks to go on chain lol

Boring isn't a bad thing.  I just think when we start freaking out about the markets, the world drama and the state of the blockchain, we turn from boring to....Drama filled lol

So I like this...**Quiet**. 

Just stack every day.  Don't worry too much about the things we can't control and then see where we end up in a few years from now.

So that's exactly the mentality I had this week...

Let's see how it went:

## 50,000 Hive Power

I have a bunch of liquid Hive that I didn't power up last week, and that's because I want to make sure this month's HPUD event is a good one.

Still I added quite a bit of Hive...

**50,000 - 33,379 = 16,621 left to go**

Love it! Added another 400 or so Hive to my totals.  And also brought my k/e ratio down from 3.17 to **3.13**

A great week which was....Steady, slow and boring :)

## 350 Subscribers To The Kingdom

A big week on [the Kingdom](https://peakd.com/c/hive-142376/created) :)

![C-The-Kingdom-PeakD-08-29-2026_09_05_PM.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXYFScGkMaX1mBARFE8fSDy1ZA649xZDmfMWU6FYTPgqF/C-The-Kingdom-PeakD-08-29-2026_09_05_PM.png)

We added 2 new subscribers to the community and that's so awesome to see.

Only 2 subs away from our goal for the year.  Exciting times!!

## BBHO & Things

I can't tell you how much my BBHO vote is worth because....Well their brand new shiny front end hasn't loaded for me in like 48 hours.

Sad stuff really and I wish there was some serious effort put into this community.  It's so needed on chain, but for whatever reason...Issues all the time.

I'm still stacking and curating as much as I can!

Hive Grove on the other hand, has been such an awesome experience...

![Hive-Grove-08-29-2026_09_09_PM.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaKrFqLDYe8nYmitoQLeWCJ56XSRdd4f8wCAmUFdnE8qq/Hive-Grove-08-29-2026_09_09_PM.png)

Added a few extra Hive this week and I can't wait to see where we will be at in a few months from now.  Hopefully I can recoup my investment quickly and then dive into more land plots and trees!!

I've also started tracking my 'email subscribers' via Ecency - [Be sure to sign up if you haven't!!](https://ecency.com/@jongolson?subscribe=digest)

And my little Hive Engine leasing projects that I've supported.

Overall, another GREAT slow, steady and boring week!

Hope you guys crush your goals in the next seven days!

title.title: Will Hunting (1997)  Is One Of The Best Character Driven Films Of The Nineties. It Has An Incredible Cast, A Great Story, And Some Of The Most Genuine Conversations You Will Find In A Movie.
title.body:
Good Will Hunting (1997)  Is One Of The Best Character Driven Films Of The Nineties. It Has An Incredible Cast, A Great Story, And Some Of The Most Genuine Conversations You Will Find In A Movie. It Is A Film About Intelligence, Friendship, Trauma, And Finally Learning To Let Yourself Move Forward.

![IMG_7065.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZC5SD9JqQ6J9oDzC2SSne8PbrNbCfeocDZXSAzyqyQqq/IMG_7065.webp)

Good Will Hunting, released in 1997, is one of those movies that does not need a complicated plot to be great. At its core, it is about a young man who is incredibly intelligent but has absolutely no idea what to do with his life. What makes it work is the way the movie slowly gets underneath that intelligence and shows you the damaged person hiding behind it.

The film was directed by Gus Van Sant, who brings a very grounded style to the story. The screenplay was written by Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, who were still relatively young actors at the time. They also put themselves in the movie, which makes the whole thing even more impressive considering how strong the final film turned out.

Matt Damon stars as Will Hunting, a young man from South Boston who works as a janitor at MIT. Will looks like an ordinary working class guy, but he possesses an almost unbelievable mathematical intelligence. He can solve incredibly complicated problems that stump students and professors, yet he has no interest in using his talent to build the life everyone else thinks he should have.

Robin Williams plays Sean Maguire, a psychologist who is brought in to work with Will after he gets into legal trouble. Williams gives one of the best dramatic performances of his career. This is not the Robin Williams of Mrs. Doubtfire or Aladdin. Sean is quiet, damaged, funny, angry, and deeply human.

Ben Affleck plays Chuckie Sullivan, Will’s best friend. Chuckie and the rest of Will’s friends know that Will is smarter than all of them, but they do not resent him for it. Chuckie actually wants Will to get out of South Boston and do something with his life. Affleck brings a lot of authenticity to the role because he understands exactly where these characters come from.

The story begins when Professor Gerald Lambeau, played by Stellan Skarsgård, discovers that the mysterious janitor solving complicated mathematical problems is actually Will. Lambeau sees an incredible opportunity and wants to help Will use his talent. The problem is that Will does not want anyone telling him what his life should be.

After Will gets arrested, part of his agreement allows him to work on mathematics with Lambeau while also seeing a therapist. After Will goes through several therapists, he finally meets Sean. Their relationship starts terribly because Will immediately begins trying to figure out Sean’s weaknesses and use them against him.

Sean is different from the other therapists because he refuses to play Will’s game. He understands that Will is using his intelligence as armor. If he can outsmart everyone in the room, he never has to let anyone get close enough to hurt him.

That is really what the movie is about. Will is not struggling because he lacks intelligence. He is struggling because he has been through things that taught him not to trust people. His intelligence gives him an escape, but it also gives him a way to avoid confronting himself.

The relationship between Will and Skylar, played by Minnie Driver, adds another important part to the story. Skylar genuinely cares about Will, but Will has trouble accepting that someone might actually love him. He pushes her away because getting close to somebody means giving them the opportunity to hurt him.

Minnie Driver is excellent in the role, and the chemistry between her and Damon feels natural. Skylar is not simply there to be Will’s love interest. She challenges him in ways that his friends and Sean cannot, especially when it comes to his fear of leaving behind the life he knows.

The movie also has some fantastic scenes between Will and Chuckie. One of the best is when Chuckie basically tells Will that if he is still living in South Boston years later, he will be disappointed. He wants his friend to leave and become something more because he knows Will is capable of it. That is a powerful kind of friendship because Chuckie wants what is best for Will even if it means losing him.

But obviously, the heart of the movie is Sean and Will. Their conversations slowly become less about mathematics and psychology and more about life. Sean realizes that Will’s biggest problem is not that he does not know what to do. It is that he is terrified of finding out what he could actually become.

Robin Williams absolutely destroys the final emotional scenes. The famous “It’s not your fault” moment works because the movie has spent so much time building up the relationship between these two characters. It is not simply a dramatic speech. It is the moment when Will finally allows himself to accept something he has spent years refusing to believe.

What I really like about Good Will Hunting is that it never says intelligence automatically equals success. Will could become anything academically, but none of that matters if he cannot deal with himself. The movie understands that sometimes the biggest thing holding a person back is not a lack of ability. It is fear.

The movie also feels authentic because the characters talk like real people. There are plenty of philosophical conversations, but there is also a lot of humor, sarcasm, and everyday bullshit. The friendship between Will and his friends keeps the movie from becoming too heavy, while the emotional scenes have real weight because they grow naturally out of the story.

For me, Good Will Hunting is one of the great nineties dramas because it combines an excellent screenplay with some incredible performances. Damon is fantastic, Affleck is perfectly cast, Minnie Driver is great, Stellan Skarsgård gives the movie another strong personality, and Robin Williams delivers a career defining dramatic performance.

It is ultimately a movie about potential. Will has the intelligence to accomplish almost anything, but he has to make the decision to stop running from his past and take a chance on his future. That is something a lot of people can relate to, even if they are obviously not mathematical geniuses working as janitors at MIT.

![IMG_7064.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRpTi2UWFefADNyD94U6xMJP8VpgYPHuTwdZx6vHUzPdc/IMG_7064.webp)

More than twenty five years later, Good Will Hunting still holds up because the story is not really about mathematics or academia. It is about friendship, love, trauma, fear, and learning that your past does not have to determine your future. It is funny, emotional, intelligent, and incredibly well acted. And sometimes the best movies are the ones that simply remind you that you are capable of more than you think.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: August 29 2026 - Back to the flea market: A day full of surprises ✨
title.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello everyone in this community! This weekend, after about two months, the market I usually participate in as an artisan reopened. Luckily, I'd spent the last few weeks sewing and making new products to offer when the opportunity arose, which it did 😌 It was a very emotional day, where I reconnected with the artisans I've met through my participation, and I also had some good sales.
![1000481889.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23uFaMiVtvaNdQfdfftFm9zKfddzyXgy9uLUDuWnKUpWz7qhpKjPWvhDZZa856tYZREUM.jpg)
**✨ The dinner I had, thanks to my mom: Chicken-filled pastries ✨**

On the way back, it was difficult to get home due to transportation problems, but even so, I was able to cope with the long hours of waiting thanks to the positive energy I'd gathered throughout the day. I hope to talk properly about the market another time. For now, what I want most is to lie down and rest, since I have to go again tomorrow and I'm hoping it will be as productive a day as today... Wish me luck! 🤗
![1000481683.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVM9TZXZXhvhVxaMTZcGiJapP61QTvc7BR9QeSb5LsMyBqa2mGyrohrGBTh5z6wCTPP.jpg)
**✨ I found this cute handmade keychain on the street, now it will be my lucky charm ✨**

### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![sticker-hive-good-luck_eng.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AJmmUV1yayiznHFJfUGf3NNWfH9ifhsnVHdRXhexXndn8Ky6G7nHMgfMBVmfQdV.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![SEPARADOR.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCF6RtBK44fyUqZnnPGvJWAgep2EUuKVgg1fmuih7CXvQzHPWpAqG5Q2SEJmUAZxCx.jpeg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad! Este fin de semana, después de dos meses más o menos, volvió a activarse el mercadillo al que suelo participar como artesana. Por suerte, había estado las últimas semanas cosiendo y elaborando productos nuevos para ofrecer cuando llegase la oportunidad, como así lo hizo 😌 Fue un día muy emotivo, en dónde me reencontré con los artesanos que he ido conociendo en mis participaciones, así como tuve buenas ventas.
![1000481889.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23uFaMiVtvaNdQfdfftFm9zKfddzyXgy9uLUDuWnKUpWz7qhpKjPWvhDZZa856tYZREUM.jpg)
**✨ La cena que tuve, gracias a mi madre: Pastelitos rellenos de pollo ✨**

De regreso, se me hizo difícil trasladarme a casa por problemas con el transporte, pero aún así, pude lidiar con las extensas horas de espera gracias a mi ánimo recolectado a lo largo del día. Espero hablar adecuadamente sobre el mercadillo en otra oportunidad. Por lo pronto, lo que más deseo es acostarme a descansar, ya que mañana también tengo que ir y tengo la esperanza de que será un día tan provechoso como el de hoy... ¡Deséenme suerte! 🤗
![1000481683.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVM9TZXZXhvhVxaMTZcGiJapP61QTvc7BR9QeSb5LsMyBqa2mGyrohrGBTh5z6wCTPP.jpg)
**✨ Me encontré este lindo llavero artesanal en la calle, ahora será mi amuleto ✨**

### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨

title.title: Noticing Details to Share (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> The community of Quetepe has a group of fishermen, which is why, on the main wall as you enter the beach, there is a mural depicting the Virgin of the Valley, featuring several reliefs made of different materials to make it more eye-catching. Her dress is made of white fabric and lace, with a pink center. The crown is made of small fabric flowers and pieces of glass to make it sparkle even from a great distance.
![1000135949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xVF9M94To8KRF62K35CoSJEigHQt6QfQoDKiSXKNg4yA8mTvDKc3f5QCSmemdMUjcGc.jpg)
![1000126497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wX1R7Z2f8zMmML42D1WkU4XH718P2zcVe3VHZUqm2cApJo7badJNAsbEbP9rutFiP8E.jpg)
![1000126494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnCrjVML3aCLU7ZJzTxab5E2VRzKHasQWFazJWyaAdYUgSFJBLrD8DJkhdut3DCPap.jpg)
Every time they set sail, the fishermen entrust themselves to the Virgin of the Valley, as they consider her their patron saint and protector—a tradition that has been upheld for centuries. As I’ve shown previously on my blog, I’ve come across several images of the Virgin on different beaches throughout Sucre State.
![1000126493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEGNKVAsaRjQUxR5Ym8y8GziVuKESf8Y3ms2V685wWu1RPnNg5CttwLqyosbRuHTa1.jpg)
![1000126492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EowG4QonXFSaPGEHvCueKMfiyuBJLxToUMrtCDLPvjQz8sGv9V3NqpDbv4TexN2cC9b.jpg)
![1000126500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqquPdivexeYLRjZr3vyufgwjSo7nwgMDVgjW5fiHKTXCeDPVuSe4SwgoudyJmyj1VF.jpg)
When we entered Quetepe, we came across another mural—this one featuring the area’s name—with a volleyball net in the background and the silhouettes of some players. This area is known for its recreational facilities; given its size, events are held here frequently, and it was even home to the Water Park.
![1000126510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eqb27BeJgFwXxF4iZnDXXgsHkAjfzGq8ysmGMR13oXxPG3SG24ixswcG9P1MFbD2udQ.jpg)
![1000126472.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEFqyUDc74NqdBg1ag5zwZGZvwVT7GYCCTrVnuCbkHLoBsJuj2gH2HPcchL8fXhBjg.jpg)
![1000126476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqNFAzXGtkKvFfiswA1RM7jCmEchfDAEiEPdR8oH9dFZNfmKmNt7AQsWveLZEbTxZzK.jpg)
![1000126533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpxpuBt8AWn3i9mWgfdCdrJdcQKbMbKmGary6C4YD9ne6onqNpCLbJwLG6mcc98T92U.jpg)
Through this visit, I’ve realized that the Quetepe community has much more to offer than just its beautiful beach; it also has lovely hills, a mangrove forest, and land suitable for farming, making this a diverse and quite extensive ecosystem.
![1000126504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EnqU596eaKtRYxkvQL8iaNfy5xNc4vgVTA82Xt6AWtumaVCTAymTpyxqfyPwFnkuVSo.jpg)
![1000126507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpLfwjirTYToZjrGrWCcxNVyPaZKKtqy32fWmhGWkkDwp5TnnNCqTDnVik8utkVUmLT.jpg)
![1000126511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpT4gRJ42ncw1n53BkDvMxbLWLoZDJxsPu4bt7BCcUKKBoicwSMgy11fESQhFfuHsF3.jpg)
For some time, Quetepe was the favorite beach of event organizers because of its large open area leading up to the beach, which later shrunk due to increased construction—a change that is evident at a glance. As a result, beach festivals and similar events began to be held on the beaches of San Luis and The Peñon, both located in Cumana. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La comunidad de Quetepe cuenta con un grupo de pescadores, de allí que en la pared principal, al entrar a la playa, se observe un mural con la imagen de la Virgen del Valle que tiene varios relieves con diferentes materiales para hacerlo más llamativo. El vestido está realizado con telas y encajes blancos y en el centro de color rosa. La corona está elaborada con pequeñas flores de tela y pedazos de vidrio para lograr un brillo a gran distancia.
![1000135949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xVF9M94To8KRF62K35CoSJEigHQt6QfQoDKiSXKNg4yA8mTvDKc3f5QCSmemdMUjcGc.jpg)
![1000126497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wX1R7Z2f8zMmML42D1WkU4XH718P2zcVe3VHZUqm2cApJo7badJNAsbEbP9rutFiP8E.jpg)
![1000126494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnCrjVML3aCLU7ZJzTxab5E2VRzKHasQWFazJWyaAdYUgSFJBLrD8DJkhdut3DCPap.jpg)
Los pescadores, cada vez que zarpan, se encomiendan a la Virgen del Valle, pues la consideran su patrona y protectora, tradición que se mantiene desde hace siglos. Tal como he mostrado anteriormente en mi blog, he encontrado a varias imágenes de la virgen en diferentes playas del estado Sucre.
![1000126493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEGNKVAsaRjQUxR5Ym8y8GziVuKESf8Y3ms2V685wWu1RPnNg5CttwLqyosbRuHTa1.jpg)
![1000126492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EowG4QonXFSaPGEHvCueKMfiyuBJLxToUMrtCDLPvjQz8sGv9V3NqpDbv4TexN2cC9b.jpg)
![1000126500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqquPdivexeYLRjZr3vyufgwjSo7nwgMDVgjW5fiHKTXCeDPVuSe4SwgoudyJmyj1VF.jpg)
Cuando ingresamos en Quetepe nos topamos con otro mural, ahora uno que tiene la identificación del lugar, acá está una red de vóleibol de fondo con algunas siluetas de jugadores. Este sitio se ha caracterizado por las instalaciones recreativas, dado que, por su extensión se realizan eventos de forma frecuente, inclusive aquí se ubicaba el Parque Acuático.
![1000126510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eqb27BeJgFwXxF4iZnDXXgsHkAjfzGq8ysmGMR13oXxPG3SG24ixswcG9P1MFbD2udQ.jpg)
![1000126472.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEFqyUDc74NqdBg1ag5zwZGZvwVT7GYCCTrVnuCbkHLoBsJuj2gH2HPcchL8fXhBjg.jpg)
![1000126476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqNFAzXGtkKvFfiswA1RM7jCmEchfDAEiEPdR8oH9dFZNfmKmNt7AQsWveLZEbTxZzK.jpg)
![1000126533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpxpuBt8AWn3i9mWgfdCdrJdcQKbMbKmGary6C4YD9ne6onqNpCLbJwLG6mcc98T92U.jpg)
Con esta visita me he dado cuenta que la comunidad de Quetepe tiene mucho más que ofrecer que su hermosa playa, además posee hermosas colinas, un manglar y terrenos aptos para la siembra, lo que convierte este lugar en un ecosistema variado y bastante amplio.
![1000126504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EnqU596eaKtRYxkvQL8iaNfy5xNc4vgVTA82Xt6AWtumaVCTAymTpyxqfyPwFnkuVSo.jpg)
![1000126507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpLfwjirTYToZjrGrWCcxNVyPaZKKtqy32fWmhGWkkDwp5TnnNCqTDnVik8utkVUmLT.jpg)
![1000126511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpT4gRJ42ncw1n53BkDvMxbLWLoZDJxsPu4bt7BCcUKKBoicwSMgy11fESQhFfuHsF3.jpg)
Quetepe fue por algún tiempo la playa predilecta de promotores de eventos debido a su gran terreno previo a la playa, mismo que posteriormente fue disminuyendo debido al aumento de construcciones, lo que se advierte a simple vista. Debido a ello, los festivales playeros y eventos similares pasaron a realizarse en las playas de San Luis y de El Peñón, ambas ubicadas en Cumaná. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.title: Remembering Gene Wilder (Eng - Esp)
title.body:
Ten years have passed since the death of actor, filmmaker, and screenwriter Gene Wilder, which occurred on August 29, 2016. Many of us film lovers were fortunate enough to enjoy the movies in which he acted or directed. We can always revisit them and relive the pleasure we felt watching them at the time.
![500px-GeneWilderMay07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23xVHHktP4ya9NnWZXH1Wrkr67v1gwxTjjs7StN7NVem3nojLrNyihsmnMyFkrvjXMWKC.jpg)
Wilder at a book signing in 2007 - [Fuente](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene_Wilder#/media/File:GeneWilderMay07.jpg) - [License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0)

I remember that, as a young man in the late 1970s or early 1980s, I saw one of his major achievements, Young Frankenstein, at a film club in my city (Cumaná, Venezuela). I laughed a lot at that humorous parody conceived and directed by the genius Mel Brooks in 1974, in which Wilder participated as a co-writer. Of course, its original source is Mary Shelley's Gothic novel, *Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus*, from 1818, and later, the 1931 film adaptation directed by James Whale and starring Boris Karloff.
![Poster de El joven Frankenstein.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23wWy6cDve4mZSit9qD2agb1dCxiZmiYeCyRR4489MZ1uek9HeSKbMQqZVk6L1Tg2Z8R7.png)
Movie poster - [Fuente](https://www.filmaffinity.com/us/filmimages.php?movie_id=367692)

![Foto de El joven Frankenstein.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23tGcJ1jWMo3jihM37GjTdTeJuAbY9vHxU1kUWy3yCyq9pR1TsmrrobWWJ5yeA7zgaT7i.jpg)
Photo from the film - [Fuente](https://www.filmaffinity.com/us/filmimages.php?movie_id=367692)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UsOnSlh7Lns

Mel Brooks's film recreates the monster's story through the grandson of the scientist Victor Frankenstein, who invented that grotesque creature. A neurosurgeon, Dr. Frederick Frankenstein, brilliantly portrayed by Gene Wilder, inherits his grandfather's estate in Transylvania and discovers documents detailing his ancestor's experiments, deciding to resume them. This might sound like a very serious film, but it is anything but. Sarcasm, irony, and almost hilarious humor characterize this version, but underlying it are critical commentaries on science, love, and even the very meaning of humanity. The story is populated by strange, sometimes absurd or outlandish characters, portrayed by actors such as Peter Boyle, Marty Feldman, and Madeline Kahn, among others. Wilder, obviously, shines in the role of the new scientist.

A second film I remember fondly, this time directed, co-written, and starring Gene Wilder, was released in 1984. I'm referring to *The Woman in Red*. I enjoyed it immensely. While humor is prominent, this film is more of a mischievous take on desire and love.
![Poster film.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23xpTU46T3Y7Z6j4zmdgdGSt7kKGNgiiJHZw6fzrYAzUcFq3Hy8qbTd4Utb1VTqKNx2ch.png)
Movie poster - [Fuente](https://www.filmaffinity.com/us/film914136.html)

An advertising executive, Teddy Pierce (Gene Wilder), who had a normally happy life, becomes obsessed with a woman he \

in a chance encounter on the street, where her figure is revealed in its exciting sensuality. This fleeting encounter will disrupt Teddy's love life and career. Personally, and perhaps many of you reading this will agree, I'll be able to revisit this famous Wilder film with the same enjoyment I felt the first time. The simple and funny story is captivating enough, but it's further enhanced by the alluring beauty of Kelly LeBrock's character, the woman who captivates Teddy with her alluring physical eroticism as revealed by the ventilation grate. That scene will be unforgettable, and I think not just for men.
[Also noteworthy in this film is Stevie Wonder's iconic song, which won an award ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=58RgLQ_0Ars).
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=58RgLQ_0Ars

There are several Gene Wilder films, especially his acting roles, that come to mind when we think of him, such as *Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory* (1971) and Woody Allen's *Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask*) (1972) (which I remember fondly and with a touch of mischief), among others that immediately spring to mind. Let's hope we don't forget him!

EL TUCUSITO

Yo conozco un Tucusito
de sombrero y popular 
con su voz y su cantar
improvisa muy bonito. 

Con sus alitas veloces
que las bate sin parar
y moverse sin cesar
inquieto va entre los brotes. 

Cuando entona el galerón 
no hay quien le ponga remedo
no se asuste compañero
responda con precisión.

Ese señor es bajito
pues tiene un gran corazón 
no pierde su condición 
pues parece un muchachito.

Cuando su verso revienta
no hay quien le ponga un atajo
no le asustan los carajos
que de la boca se avientan.

Cuando el Tucusito canta
el Gavilán se estremece
porque el pico no le crece
y se le traba la garganta.

Tucusito, Tucusito 
dame letra compañero
Para retar a un viajero
que viene de Caimancito.

#

THE LITTLE TURTLE

I know a little turt,
with a hat and a popular face,
with his voice and his song,
he improvises beautifully.

With his swift little wings,
which he flaps without stopping,
and moving without ceasing, he restlessly goes among the shoots.

When he sings the galerón,
no one can imitate him,
don't be afraid, friend,
answer with precision.

That gentleman is short,
but he has a big heart,
he doesn't lose his stature,
for he looks like a little boy.

When his verse bursts forth,
no one can stop him,
he's not afraid of the insults
that fly from his mouth.

When the little turt sings,
the hawk trembles,
because his beak doesn't grow,
and his throat gets stuck.

Little turt, little turt,
give me lyrics, friend,
to challenge a traveler
who comes from Caimancito.

title.title: Як персоналізована стрічка соцмереж непомітно руйнує ваш настрій. Що кажуть сканування мозку 2026 року
title.body: >З зловісною регулярністю я спіймав себе на одному й тому самому вечірньому ритуалі. Тиша в кімнаті, тьмяне світло від настільної лампи й екран смартфона, який м'яко відбивається в моїх окулярах. Я просто гортав стрічку соціальних мереж, ніби намагаючись трохи розслабитися після довгого та виснажливого дня. Але замість жаданого спокою я відчув, як у грудях повільно закручується знайомий тугий вузол тривоги. Чому пара веселих відео, кілька новин та звичайні дописи знайомих залишили після себе такий важкий гіркий осад?

>Здавалося б, це просто алгоритми, які підбирають контент особисто під нас. Вони мають показувати те, що нам «цікаво», чи не так? Проте буквально днями натрапив на свіжі дані нейробіологічних досліджень, опубліковані в кінці серпня 2026 року, і вони змусили мене подивитися на це явище під зовсім іншим кутом. Вчені використали функціональну МРТ, щоб подивитися, що насправді відбувається всередині нашого мозку, коли ми споживаємо «персоналізований» контент. Виявилося, що наше підсвідоме відчуття роздратування чи пригніченості — це не просто вдома втома або емоційна підвищена чутливість. Це пряма нейрофізіологічна реакція на те, як розумні алгоритми взаємодіють із нашими нейронними мережами.

>Коли ми підписуємося на певні спільноти або залишаємо вподобайки під певними темами, ми щиро віримо, що будуємо свій власний безпечний цифровий простір. Нам здається, що алгоритм — це слухняний персональний помічник, який просто дає нам більше того, що нас цікавить. Але наш мозок працює куди складніше за формулу «запит-відповідь». У нас є ціла система нейронних зв'язків, яка відповідає за соціальну оцінку, порівняння себе з іншими та сприйняття загрози чи підтримки.

>Сканування мозку показало тривожну тенденцію: коли алгоритм підбирає контент на основі наших попередніх дій та емоційних спалахів, він не просто задовольняє інтерес, а починає створювати замкнене замкнене коло — ехо-камеру негативу. Побачивши допис, який викликав смуток чи роздратування, ми миволі затримуємо на ньому погляд трохи довше. Для алгоритму це чіткий сигнал: «О, це працює, покажи йому ще таке!». І наступного разу розумна система підсовує схожі публікації, підсилюючи саме ті нейронні шляхи, які відповідають за стресові реакції та тривожність.

>Замість того, щоб слугувати містком для підтримки та зв'язку з іншими людьми, персоналізована стрічка підступно перетворюється на підсилювач негативного настрою. Ми починаємо бачити світ крізь призму гіперболізованих загроз, чужого «ідеального» життя чи нескінченних суперечок.

>

> Мозкові мережі, ймовірно, залучені до використання соціальних мереж. Широке дослідження соціального пізнання за допомогою візуалізації мозку, проведене з використанням офлайн-парадигм, виявило кілька основних мозкових мереж, які можуть бути залучені до використання соціальних мереж. (i) Менталізаційна мережа (області головного мозку синім кольором): дорсомедіальна префронтальна кора (DMPFC), скронево-тім’яний зв’язок (TPJ), передня скронева частка (ATL), нижня лобова звивина (IFG) і задня поясна кора/прекунеус (PCC); (ii) самореферентна когнітивна мережа (області мозку червоним): медіальна префронтальна кора (MPFC) і PCC; і (iii) напрямна мережа (області мозку зеленим): вентромедіальна префронтальна кора (VMPFC), вентральний стріатум (VS) і вентральна тегментальна область (VTA). \[2 [Source](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/347993508_The_relationship_between_social_media_use_and_narcissism/figures?lo=1)

>Мене особливо зачепила деталь про те, як мозок реагує на персоналізований контент у порівнянні зі випадковим. Коли інформація здається нам «особистою» або такою, що стосується нашої ідентичності чи поглядів, активність у ділянках мозку, відповідальних за емоційне сприйняття та саморефлексію, різко зростає. Якщо цей контент забарвлений негативом, емоційний імпульс б'є в рази сильніше. Ми сприймаємо його не просто як абстрактну новину з іншого кінця світу, а як щось, що загрожує безпосередньо нашому особистому комфорту та безпеці.

>Я раптом згадав свої власні відчуття. Бували вечори, коли після пів години в соцмережах мені здавалося, що весь світ навколо повільно божеволіє, а надії на краще практично немає. Тепер я розумію: це не світ раптово рухнув за 30 хвилин. Це алгоритм успішно знайшов мої слабкі місця, «просканував» емоційні тригери й почав бомбардувати ними мій мозок, запускаючи потужний сплеск гормонів стресу.

>Найбільша пастка полягає в тому, що цей процес відбувається абсолютно непомітно. Ми вважаємо, що контролюємо ситуацію, бо самі гортаємо пальцем по екрану. Але насправді в цей момент наш мозок знаходиться в пастці ретельно спроєктованого алгоритмічного петлювання.

>Сканування голови вчених чітко доводить: тривале перебування в таких цифрових «петлях» виснажує нервову систему. Мозок постійно знаходиться в стані підвищеної бойової готовності, шукаючи підвоху чи загрози в кожному наступному дописі. Звідси виникає відчуття хронічної втоми, апатії та навіть легка депресивна симптоматика, яку багато хто з нас списує на звичайний брак сну чи робочий перевантаж.

>Що ж із цим усім робити? Не викидати ж смартфон у річку та не тікати жити в глухий ліс без інтернету — у 2026 році це звучить щонайменше нереалістично та й не потрібно. Але повернути собі контроль над власною емоційною гігієною просто необхідно.

>Особисто я після прочитання цього дослідження вирішив кардинально змінити свої цифрові звички. Насамперед я запровадив для себе жорстке правило «цифрового тиші» за дві години до сну. Якщо моєму мозку потрібен відпочинок, то смартфон має лежати екраном униз на іншому кінці кімнати. По-друге, я почав свідомо ламати алгоритми: як тільки бачу, що стрічка починає затягувати мене в суцільний негатив, я навмисно шукаю щось нейтральне або позитивне — наукові статті, фотографії природи чи мистецтво. Це як дати алгоритму ляпаса й сказати: «Ні, друже, сьогодні ти не змусиш мене панікувати».

>Наш мозок — це неймовірно гнучкий та дивовижний орган, але він розроблявся еволюцією не для того, щоб щохвилини обробляти гігабайти штучно підібраних тривожних подразників. І коли ми усвідомлюємо біологічні механізми цієї пастки, у нас з'являється шанс вирватися з неї.

>Зрештою, наше ментальне здоров'я варте того, щоб захищати його від найхитріших алгоритмів. А як ви почуваєтеся після вечірнього гортання стрічки? Чи помічали за собою, що персоналізовані рекомендації іноді просто псують настрій без видимих на те причин? Давайте обговоримо це в коментарях, мені справді цікаво почути ваш досвід.

title.title: El susurro del mar y el eco de mi alma [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNaz1dRChJxm5gxxewKEtSo7zDRuNG4zYArxkXtfd4mpb/1788057946292.jpg)

***
***
A veces, la vida se convierte en un escenario y entonces actuamos para nuestros jefes, para nuestra familia, para los amigos, incluso para nosotros mismos, mientras representamos un papel que hemos ensayado tan bien que ya ni recordamos dónde termina la máscara y dónde comienza nuestro rostro verdadero. Este verano, frente al mar, todas las máscaras cayeron.

Llegué a la playa al atardecer, cuando el sol ya no quemaba sino que acariciaba. Las familias comenzaban a recoger sus sombrillas, los niños corrían por última vez antes de irse, las voces se iban apagando como las olas al retirarse, y me senté en la arena, no en la orilla sino un poco más atrás, donde la humedad del mar apenas llega, y me permití simplemente ser.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4hM3XeuMsGcXf8C2HeTbxoGEPALgXfBWTnQwyJ5Czh3/1788057947299.jpg)


***
No había nadie que me observara, tampoco había expectativas, ni conversaciones que mantener, ni sonrisas que ofrecer por cortesía. En ese momento éramos solo yo y el horizonte infinito, y fue entonces cuando ocurrió la magia. Sin darme cuenta, mi respiración se sincronizó con el ritmo de las olas: inspiraba cuando el mar avanzaba, expiraba cuando se retiraba, como si mi pecho y el océano compartieran un mismo pulso ancestral.

Recordé entonces que antes, cuando era niña, no necesitaba estos momentos a solas para ser yo misma. En esos años de mi vida, la autenticidad era mi estado natural. Reía a carcajadas sin importar quién escuchara, bailaba sin música, hablaba sin filtros, pero el mundo, con sus reglas y sus juicios, fue moldeándome hasta convertirme en esta versión más pulida, pero también más distante de quien realmente soy.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRoAgWCLw8FCi1iaGoPFnM1o4ZL4ha2U81MS12yrngGpN/1788057946759.jpg)


***
Frente al mar, esas capas empezaron a desprenderse como escamas, y no lo decidí conscientemente porque simplemente sucedió. Mis hombros, que siempre llevo tensos como si esperara un golpe, se relajaron, y mi mandíbula se soltó. Mis dedos escribieron mi nombre, y el mar, cómplice, lo borró con suavidad, guardando mis secretos en su inmensidad.

Pensé en las personas que amamos y cómo, paradójicamente, a veces son ellas las que más nos exigen representar un papel, y no por maldad, sino porque necesitan que seamos la versión de nosotros que les da seguridad, que les encaja en su historia. Nosotros accedemos porque queremos ser amados, y acabamos perdiendo de vista que el amor verdadero no debería requerir máscaras.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYmm4mkX5BQMcA661HQBi7SUoY2L9AqdNjaNaMGvkVWBA/1788057947413.jpg)


***
En aquella playa, en aquel momento de soledad elegida, no necesitaba que nadie me amara. Solo necesitaba yo misma, en mi estado más puro y vulnerable, amarme a mí, y lo hice. Reconocí a esa mujer sentada en la arena, con el pelo revuelto y la mirada perdida en el mar, y supe que era yo.

>Esa noche volví a casa distinta, no porque el mar hubiera resuelto mis problemas, sino porque había encontrado un lugar interior al que puedo regresar.

Los momentos a solas no son un lujo sino una necesidad; son el oxígeno que necesitamos para recordar quiénes somos antes de volver a la obra de la vida. Al final, cuando las máscaras caen, lo único que queda es hermoso; no perfecto, sino real, y eso es mucho más valioso.

<center>🩵</center>
