### <center>ENGLISH VERSION</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>The Whisper of the Sea and the Echo of My Soul </center>



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmav2aCXymVg6m3YnUkkSBovSmv5EcJeL3AYjQQvSDNnYH/1788057946483.jpg)


***
***


Sometimes life becomes a stage, and we perform for our bosses, for our family, for our friends, and even for ourselves, while playing a role we have rehearsed so well that we no longer remember where the mask ends and where our true face begins. This summer, by the sea, all the masks fell away.

I arrived at the beach at sunset, when the sun no longer burned but rather caressed. Families were starting to pack up their umbrellas, children ran one last time before leaving, voices faded like the withdrawing waves, and I sat down on the sand, not right at the shoreline but a little further back, where the sea's dampness barely reaches, and I allowed myself simply to be.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4hM3XeuMsGcXf8C2HeTbxoGEPALgXfBWTnQwyJ5Czh3/1788057947299.jpg)


***
There was no one watching me, no expectations, no conversations to keep up, no smiles to offer out of politeness. In that moment, it was just me and the infinite horizon, and that was when the magic happened. Without realizing it, my breathing synchronized with the rhythm of the waves: I inhaled as the sea advanced, exhaled as it receded, as if my chest and the ocean shared the same ancestral pulse.

I remembered then that before, when I was a child, I did not need these moments alone to be myself. In those years of my life, authenticity was my natural state. I laughed out loud without caring who heard, I danced without music, I spoke without filters, but the world, with its rules and judgments, gradually shaped me until I became this more polished version, yet also more distant from who I truly am.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRoAgWCLw8FCi1iaGoPFnM1o4ZL4ha2U81MS12yrngGpN/1788057946759.jpg)


***
By the sea, those layers began to peel off like scales, and I did not decide it consciously; it simply happened. My shoulders, which I always carry tense as if bracing for a blow, relaxed, and my jaw unclenched. My fingers wrote my name, and the sea, complicit, gently erased it, keeping my secrets in its vastness.

I thought about the people we love and how, paradoxically, sometimes they are the ones who most demand that we play a role, not out of malice, but because they need us to be the version of ourselves that gives them security, that fits into their story. We go along with it because we want to be loved, and we end up losing sight of the fact that true love should not require masks.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYmm4mkX5BQMcA661HQBi7SUoY2L9AqdNjaNaMGvkVWBA/1788057947413.jpg)

***
On that beach, in that chosen moment of solitude, I did not need anyone to love me. I only needed myself, in my purest and most vulnerable state, to love myself, and I did. I recognized that woman sitting on the sand, with disheveled hair and her gaze lost in the sea, and I knew she was me.

>That night I returned home different, not because the sea had solved my problems, but because I had found an inner place I can return to.

Moments alone are not a luxury but a necessity; they are the oxygen we need to remember who we are before returning to the performance of life. In the end, when the masks fall, what remains is beautiful; not perfect, but real, and that is far more valuable.

![1000027415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23uQk46RdotKk3yNMNDn51NuSXBRz2RTgJnva5kNfUBjfByanfKDXSdfCoJFA3Qvc38Hu.jpg)
I've been working home for the past month now and honestly, it does get boring. From 9am to 6pm, I'm with my laptop learning about my new job with very little human interaction. Well, from time to time, we do have virtual calls with my supervisor to discuss about work. To say the least, with this set up, I really need to hangout with friends and family during weekends. Besides, I kinda like the idea of going out and spending time with family and friends intentionally, rather than performative.

Back when I used to work on a hybrid set up, I dread going out during weekends. I enjoy doing household chores that serves as my way of recharging. 

This weekend, we were invited to a condo pre-selling showroom located in the heart of Cebu City. Our main reason for coming is really because of the free food, but also to show support to our friend who invited us. 
![1000027385.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23zbKXmHoKL3NNQkHas9JXwwMtJUV1fHfaukRXnhDwfReDGVRjDthn7Jix4Rbhtr5MJPM.jpg)
Look at that building, isn't she beautiful? 

In the food buffet setup, I found this displayed kombucha bottle. As a home Brewer myself, I filled my cup and tasted their kombucha. Its only been a few times I drank a ready made kombucha so I took my time and reassessed the taste. Like any other store bought kombucha that ive had, it's always carbonated. I wonder if they added carbon water to the brew because a naturally brewed kombucha isn't that carbonated.
![1000027384.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23vhsM5iG23CcUyXTERn33NJH1ypRp8rZL22s6PUVdFQVWauksu4Wzhx81DNqXCgiywPo.jpg)
Anyways, back to the condo unit, our friend toured us around their showroom and explained the amenities in details. 
![1000027387.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23tmLE4cpc8vEsgRBiCZp4F6J1q58sfgUsqE12jaapYKYvNrvM6w4S59qG2GXNaUKXZQH.jpg)
After which, the debate of whether owning a condo or buying a house came into light. My parents are pro house buying as they believed condos are overpriced for their floor area. While my sister's boyfriend, who lives in a condo, argued that when buying a condo, buyers are not simply buying a square-metered but also convenience and location.

I personally believe that a house should still be the first priority, while condos are for temporary living and investment.

That's it for today's blog. See you in my next one!

Sending some love and light 

Love, Jane

title.title: La última semana y sobre el día a día [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Lifestyle community. Today I’m stopping by to share a new day in my life with you all. This past Saturday dawned quite clear, treating us to a beautiful morning sun that I truly enjoyed before starting my chores at home. However, around noon, the sky began to cloud over, and we realized we wouldn’t have the whole day to take photos as we’d planned. Going down to the river or nearby areas where the natural gardens of Puerto Ordaz are located wasn’t a very good option because when these frequent rains occur (for days on end), the rivers tend to overflow, the underbrush grows rapidly, the trail becomes unstable, and it’s also hard to spot wildlife. It’s risky. So we had to make some changes.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Lifestyle. El día de hoy me uno por aquí para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida. En esta oportunidad, el día sábado se alzó con bastante claridad, entregándonos un bello sol de mañana que disfrute realmente antes de comenzar mis labores en casa. Sin embargo a eso de las 12 del mediodía todo comenzó a apagarse en el cielo y supimos que no íbamos a tener el día completo para hacer fotografías cómo habíamos planificado. Bajar al río o zonas cercanas dónde están los jardines naturales de Puerto Ordaz, no era muy buena opción pues cuando ocurren estas lluvias tan frecuentes (durante días y días) suelen desbordarse los ríos, la maleza crece rápidamente, se hace inestable el camino y además la fauna silvestre se hace difícil de percibir. Es un riesgo. Así que hubo cambios.

![IMG_8609.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EorsfbkqQec96EeBZXN78DLqNEYiRvmF5HpzSU3HCEVyUfko2QaF9mzoST4WaNtJeUm.jpeg) ![IMG_8596.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Ep3dQ5rXTtKgoNeANnuqQgWHgWJkb7KdDvt8k4RAsfjb3dYiAtgrtzKSzCXPEBFWToy.jpeg) ![IMG_8595.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoeEU9ornQB9gksLksfPMu3X2o9SexWSvMs4iXQjv2MfdbBHRVMKGzJTaio5rrAseJM.jpeg) ![IMG_8593.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpNpuL5H6XkkWWdVy1egKLfSWpTyZ7BVw56nTBhxr2cByTHpnYxnTNimcRY3vBP8UR5.jpeg) ![IMG_8602.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoK4MpeDjX6nFjxMjeQASDAtVDpFDvtPJVoxuypb1gXCBhbiH7tiCk1Y5RFJ4QRSTte.jpeg)

>At 2 p.m., it started raining so hard that water began to seep into the house. We had to be careful to keep the water from reaching the areas of the floor where there are no tiles right now, because the water could seep through there, but fortunately, nothing like that happened. When the rain stopped, I took some time to rest. What you see there where the cats are is a toy of theirs—I attached a meter of yarn to it and tied it to a nail in the wall. I usually move that stuffed animal around the house so the cats can play and “hunt” it, but I think the method I just mentioned is more practical. By the way, one of the cats completely destroyed a painting I rescued a while back from the buildings downstairs. It was the “Autana of the Amazon.” It’s a shame because I liked it, and it ended up in terrible shape. That’s why I’m adding more toys for them to play with.

\n\n

>Wilfredo and I went out in the afternoon to buy some “savory” snacks and took advantage of the trip to walk Brandy. I didn’t walk Mía today because everything was really wet, and I didn’t think it was worth it. That makes me feel guilty because I always try to treat everyone at home the same. It’s been a quiet weekend; I’m continuing to make progress on what I need to do, and soon everything will be better. Although there are some things you just can’t forget. With that, thank you so much for stopping by.

\n\n>

>A las 2 de la tarde comenzó a llover tan fuerte que el agua también empezó a entrar a la casa. Tuvimos que tener cuidado de que el agua no llegara a las zonas del suelo dónde ahora no hay baldosas porque se podía filtrar el agua por allí, pero afortunadamente no sucedió nada de eso. Cuando paso la lluvia, me di un tiempo para descansar. Eso que ven allí donde están los gatos es un juguete que ellos tienen al cual le coloque un metro de estambre y lo ate a un clave que estaba en la pared. Usualmente yo muevo ese peluche por toda la casa para que los gatos jueguen y \

al animalito, pero creo que es más practica la última forma que comente. Por cierto, uno de los gatos destrozó por completo un cuadro que rescate hace un tiempo en los edificios de abajo. Era el Autana del Amazonas. Es una lastima porque me gustaba y terminó peor. He allí la razón de añadir más juguetes a la disposición de ellos.

\n\n>
>Wilfredo y yo salimos en la tarde a comprar algo de \

y aprovechamos e viaje para pasear a Brandy. Hoy no paseo Mía porque realmente estaba muy mojado todo y creo que no valía la pena. Lo que me deja con remordimiento porque siempre intento que las cosas sean igual para todos en casa. Ha sido un fin de semana tranquilo, sigo avanzando en lo que necesito y pronto todo estará mejor. Aunque hay cosas que no se pueden olvidar. Sin más que decir muchísimas gracias por pasar por aquí.

![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

Hoy fue un día perfecto para caminar por la ciudad. Comencé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde el sol brillaba y las flores estaban en plena floración. Allí, conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las aves. Tenía una sonrisa cálida y me contó que visitaba el parque todos los días para relajarse y disfrutar de la naturaleza. Me compartió algunas historias de su juventud y me hizo apreciar aún más la belleza del lugar. Continué mi camino hacia un barrio cercano y me llamó la atención un mural colorido en una pared. Era una obra de arte urbano que representaba la diversidad de la ciudad. Me detuve a tomar algunas fotos y conocí a un grupo de artistas locales que estaban trabajando en un nuevo proyecto. Se mostraron muy apasionados por su arte y compartieron su visión sobre cómo el arte puede transformar espacios públicos y unir a la comunidad. Fue un día lleno de pequeños momentos que me recordaron la riqueza de la vida cotidiana y las historias que cada persona tiene para contar. Volví a casa sintiéndome inspirado y agradecido por las conexiones que hacemos mientras exploramos nuestro entorno. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title.title: Weekend in Hardwar
title.body:
Hello Hive Fam

Good day to you all, and I hope you're having a good time wherever you are.

This weekend I am in Hardwar and its been over 6 months when I am visiting this holy place once again this year. it is one of the places that I can visit every month.But because of the work schedule that's not possible.However, I enjoy every time I come to this place.Because it feels peaceful and I enjoy wherever visit and spend time over here. 

It is rainy season because of that the experience it's slightly different this time.However, I would not say it's bad.Because in the rain season its important to plan timing etc. i reached here in early morning so that it was not crowded.And I was right that I planned this way because now I can see more people coming here and now for me it's time to leave.But I got a good time to spend on this place where I got the opportunity to witness the Ganga Arti. This is something a lot of people want to enjoy and I got it anyway.  

![37609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/Eq7KtArRG4GdurbChVCRyK8a5FojQivjDeYcPuqhoLCwbjaMn7HhzCouuTjvNitS5Pr.jpg)

![37608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/EpzwF8u5o12sUTxNZqwc1KbkVBxhzRvKWeNw16teoQjAQW2DjfhAngnqbSfsjFMw8Lh.jpg)

It started raining, so i'm not going to visit Rishikesh because its not safe to go there during rain as Rishikesh had gor a lot of mountains.  during rainy season, it is not good because of the landslide problem.And that's why I'll just spend one day here and we'll go back.

title.title: Taking a Music Break in Rising Star with a Beautiful Chinese Track
title.body:
Hello, Rising Star family!

Today, while wondering what to write about, I found myself doing some Music Lessons in the Rising Star game. Sometimes, sitting down to draft a post leaves my mind completely blank. But while listening to music in the background, an idea clicked: why not write about the songs that keep me company?

I listen to a wide variety of music. Rather than focusing strictly on the lyrical meaning right away, I pay close attention to the melody and the vocal performance. Listening deeply like this helps me connect with the emotion—even across language barriers, I can feel whether a track is filled with longing, love, or simple comfort.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4S4DeTzjV9skMFDzJxPvhf9xaNvZQGGpCv1TWmhtfdd/ai_generated.png)


Lately, I've been watching quite a few Chinese dramas and getting into Chinese soundtracks. Today, I'd like to share a beautiful theme song that caught my heart. I used Google Translate to dive deeper into its meaning. The song is \
(如果可以 - If Only) sung by WeiBird (韋禮安).\n\nThis track serves as the main theme song for the Taiwanese fantasy romance film \

(月老).

The Story Behind the Song
The plot follows Ah Lun, who tragically dies after being struck by lightning. Arriving in the underworld, his past good deeds grant him the chance to become Yue Lao—the God of the Red String—to earn his reincarnation.
His duty is to bind couples on Earth together with the red string of fate. However, while on Earth, he unexpectedly encounters his past life’s love, Xiao Mi, who is caring for stray dogs.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeFLJmABpUN1wmjCEwW3tLJTi2Jx9mTbdZY9FjrnX11k3/1788057151066.jpg)

[Image Source](https://youtu.be/8MG--WuNW1Y?si=RQrO8EihdpUhQnf0)
Xiao Mi can no longer see him, and as a god, Ah Lun tries to match her with someone else. Yet, no matter what he tries, the red string keeps snapping. The story unfolds into a deeply moving tale of eternal love, fate, and heart-wrenching sacrifice across reincarnations.


[Chorus]
Chinese: 如果可以 我想和你回到那天相遇
Pinyin: Rú guǒ kě yǐ, wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ huí dào nà tiān xiāng yù
English: If only I could... I want to go back to the day we first met with you.
Chinese: 让时间停止那一场雨
Pinyin: Ràng shí jiān tíng zhǐ nà yī chǎng yǔ
English: To let time freeze right in that pouring rain.
Chinese: 只想拥抱 你在身边的证据 吻你的呼吸
Pinyin: Zhǐ xiǎng yōng bào nǐ zài shēn biān de zhèng jù, wěn nǐ de hū xī
English: I just want to hold you tight as proof of your presence, and kiss your breath.
Chinese: 一眨眼一瞬间 你说好就是永远 不会变
Pinyin: Yī zhǎ yǎn yī shùn jiān, nǐ shuō hǎo jiù shì yǒng yuǎn, bù huì biàn
English: In a single blink, your simple nod became a promise of forever that will never change.
Chinese: 如果可以 茫茫人海千年一眼相遇
Pinyin: Rú guǒ kě yǐ, máng máng rén hǎi qiān nián yī yǎn xiāng yù
English: If only I could... even if it takes a thousand years to spot you in a vast sea of people,
Chinese: 月光下转身那就是你
Pinyin: Yuè guāng xià zhuǎn shēn nà jiù shì nǐ
English: The moment I turn around under the moonlight, it will still be you.
Chinese: 红线划过深藏轮回的秘密 我花光运气
Pinyin: Hóng xiàn huà guò shēn cáng lún huí de mì mì, wǒ huā guāng yùn qì
English: As the red string traces the secrets buried deep in reincarnation, I used up all my good luck just to find you.
Chinese: 你是我赌上世界的决定
Pinyin: Nǐ shì wǒ dǔ shàng shì jiè de jué dìng
English: You are the single decision I bet my entire world on.

Listening to this track carries a tragic yet beautifully gentle melancholy. What about you all? What song has been on repeat for you lately?

https://youtu.be/8MG--WuNW1Y?si=ubkSbHK4FkasTdic

မင်္ဂလာပါ Risingstar ချစ်သူတို့ရေ။ ဒီနေ့မှာတော့ ဘာအကြောင်းရေးရမလဲတွေးရင်း Risingstar Game ရဲ့ Music Lesson တွေကို လုပ်နေဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ တစ်ခါတလေ စာရေးရတာလည်း ဘာတွေတွေးလို့ ဘာရေးရမှန်းမသိဖြစ်တက်ပါတယ်။ ဒါနဲ့ သီချင်းလေးတွေနားထောင်ဖြစ်တဲ့ အကြောင်း ရေးမယ်လို့ အတွေးဝင်လာပါတယ်။ ကျွန်မက တေးဂီတ အစုံနားထောင်လေ့ရှိပါတယ်။ သီချင်းအကြောင်းအရာထက် သံစဉ်နဲ့ သီဆိုသူရဲ့ အသံကို သေချာဂရုစိုက်နားထောင်ပါတယ်။ သေချာဂရုစိုက်နားထောင်တဲ့အခါ ဘာသာစကားမတူပေမဲ့ သူ လွမ်းနေတာလား အချစ်အကြောင်းလား သာယာတဲ့ သီချင်းလားဆိုတာ နည်းနည်းတော့ ခွဲခြားတက်လာပါတယ်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAk2cTof4a3hm4yJ5rmPNMp7HEtDkuPoA6sG5tVeujWg/1778387232876.jpg)

အခုတလော ကျွန်မက တရုတ် Drama တွေလည်း အတော်လေးကြည့်ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ပြီးတော့ တရုတ် သီချင်းလေးတွေကိုလည်း နားထောင်ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ဒါကြောင့် ဒီနေ့မှာတော့ တရုတ်ဇာတ်ဝင်တေးသီချင်းတပုဒ်ကို မျှဝေချင်ပါတယ်။ ဒီသီချင်းကို သေချာသိဖို့အတွက် Google Translate ကို အသုံးပြုထားပါတယ်။ သီချင်းလေးနာမည်ကအဆိုတော် WeiBird (韋禮安) သီဆိုထားတဲ့ \
(Red Scarf / တကယ်လို့ ရနိုင်ခဲ့ရင်) ဆိုတဲ့ သီချင်းလေး ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။\n\nဒီသီချင်းဟာ တိုင်ဝမ် နာမည်ကြီး Fantasy Romance ရုပ်ရှင်ဖြစ်တဲ့ \

(月老 - Yue Lao / ချစ်သူဆုံစည်းရာ) ရဲ့ Main Theme Song ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

အဓိကဇာတ်ဆောင် Ah Lun (အာလွန်) ဟာ မိုးကြိုးပစ်ခံရပြီး ကံဆိုးစွာနဲ့ အသက်ဆုံးပါးသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ သူငရဲပြည်ကို ရောက်သွားတဲ့အခါ အတိတ်ဘဝ ကောင်းမှုကံတွေကြောင့် လူပြန်ဝင်စားခွင့်ရဖို့အတွက် အချစ်နတ်ဘုရား (Yue Lao - Red String God) အဖြစ် တာဝန်ထမ်းဆောင်ရပါတော့တယ်။

သူ့ရဲ့ တာဝန်ကတော့ လူ့ပြည်မှာရှိတဲ့ စုံတွဲတွေကို ကြိုးနီ (Red Scarf / Red String) နဲ့ စည်းနှောင်ပေးရတာပါ။ ဒါပေမဲ့ လူ့ပြည်မှာ တာဝန်ထမ်းဆောင်ရင်း ခွေးတွေကို ကာကွယ်ပေးနေတဲ့ သူ့ရဲ့ အတိတ်ဘဝ ချစ်သူဟောင်း မိန်မပျိုလေး Xiao Mi (ရှောင်းမီ) ကို ပြန်တွေ့သွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVLyThM3Fqa8wJw2mFubfxxh8MkuvrLTa1JfLyyLELRf/1778387201786.png)

Xiao Mi က သူ့ကို မမြင်နိုင်တော့သလို၊ Ah Lun ကလည်း အချစ်နတ်ဘုရား ဖြစ်နေတဲ့အတွက် Xiao Mi ကို အခြားသူတစ်ယောက်နဲ့ ကြိုးနီချည်ပေးဖို့ ကြိုးစားပေမဲ့ ဘာကြောင့်မှ ကြိုးနီက တပ်လို့မရဘဲ ပြတ်ထွက်သွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဘဝဆက်တိုင်း၊ သံသရာဆက်တိုင်းမှာ သူတို့နှစ်ဦးရဲ့ အချစ်က ဘယ်လောက်အထိ ခိုင်မြဲပြီး လေးနက်ကြောင်းနဲ့ မမျှော်လင့်ထားတဲ့ စေတနာ စွန့်လွှတ်စွန့်စားမှုတွေကို မျက်ရည်ကျစရာ ရိုက်ကူးထားတဲ့ ဇာတ်လမ်းလေး ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

[Chorus / အဓိက အပိုဒ်]
Chinese: 如果可以 我想和你回到那天相遇
Pinyin: Rú guǒ kě yǐ, wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ huí dào nà tiān xiāng yù
မြန်မာပြန်: တကယ်လို့ ရနိုင်ခဲ့ရင်... မင်းနဲ့ စတင်ဆုံတွေ့ခဲ့ဖူးတဲ့ အဲဒီနေ့လေးဆီ ပြန်သွားချင်မိတယ်။
Chinese: 让时间停止那一场雨
Pinyin: Ràng shí jiān tíng zhǐ nà yī chǎng yǔ
မြန်မာပြန်: အဲဒီမိုးရွာနေတဲ့ အခိုက်အတန့်မှာ အချိန်တွေကို ခဏလောက် ရပ်တန့်ထားလိုက်ချင်တယ်။
Chinese: 只想拥抱 你在身边的证据 吻你的呼吸
Pinyin: Zhǐ xiǎng yōng bào nǐ zài shēn biān de zhèng jù, wěn nǐ de hū xī
မြန်မာပြန်: မင်း ငါ့ဘေးမှာ ရှိနေတယ်ဆိုတဲ့ သက်သေအဖြစ် မင်းကို တင်းတင်းကျပ်ကျပ် ပွေ့ဖက်ထားပြီး မင်းရဲ့ ထွက်သက်ဝင်သက်တွေကို နမ်းရှိုက်ချင်ရုံပါပဲ။
Chinese: 一眨眼一瞬间 你说好就是永远 不会变
Pinyin: Yī zhǎ yǎn yī shùn jiān, nǐ shuō hǎo jiù shì yǒng yuǎn, bù huì biàn
မြန်မာပြန်: မျက်စိတစ်မှိတ် လက်ဖျစ်တစ်တွက် အတွင်းမှာတင် \

လို့ မင်းငြိမ့်ပြခဲ့တဲ့ ကတိက ထာဝရအတွက် ဖြစ်သွားခဲ့ပြီ... ဘယ်တော့မှ ပြောင်းလဲမှာ မဟုတ်ဘူး။
Chinese: 如果可以 茫茫人海千年一眼相遇
Pinyin: Rú guǒ kě yǐ, máng máng rén hǎi qiān nián yī yǎn xiāng yù
မြန်မာပြန်: တကယ်လို့ ရနိုင်ခဲ့ရင်... အဆုံးမရှိတဲ့ လူပင်လယ်ကြီးထဲမှာ အနှစ်တစ်ထောင်ကြာမှ တစ်ကြိမ် ဆုံတွေ့ရရင်တောင်မှ၊
Chinese: 月光下转身那就是你
Pinyin: Yuè guāng xià zhuǎn shēn nà jiù shì nǐ
မြန်မာပြန်: လရောင်အောက်မှာ လှည့်ကြည့်လိုက်တဲ့အခါ တွေ့ရမှာက မင်းပဲ ဖြစ်နေမှာပါ။
Chinese: 红线划过深藏轮回的秘密 我花光运气
Pinyin: Hóng xiàn huà guò shēn cáng lún huí de mì mì, wǒ huā guāng yùn qì
မြန်မာပြန်: သံသရာရဲ့ လျှို့ဝှက်ချက်တွေကို ကြိုးနီလေးက ဖြတ်သန်းဆက်သွယ်ပေးခဲ့တယ်... မင်းကို တွေ့ဖို့ ငါ့ရဲ့ ကံကြမ္မာ ကံကောင်းခြင်းတွေ အကုန်လုံးကို သုံးစွဲပစ်ခဲ့ပြီ။
Chinese: 你是我赌上世界的决定
Pinyin: Nǐ shì wǒ dǔ shàng shì jiè de jué dìng
မြန်မာပြန်: မင်းဟာ ငါ့ကမ္ဘာတစ်ခုလုံးနဲ့ ပုံအောပြီး လောင်းကြေးထပ်ထားတဲ့ ငါ့ရဲ့ တစ်ခုတည်းသော ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ပါပဲ။

ဒီသီချင်းလေးကို နားဆင်ရတာ တကယ်ကြေကွဲဖို့ကောင်းသလို သံစဉ်လေးကလည်း ငြိမ့်ငြိမ့်လေးနဲ့ လွမ်းစရာကောင်းလှပါတယ်။ မိတ်ဆွေတို့ကော ဘယ်လို ထင်ပါသလဲ။

title.body:
> I had wanted to visit the Santa Maria de la Cabeza Castle for a long time; I was filled with curiosity every time I saw the small chapel from Bartolome Salom Street. I started doing some research to find out where the entrance to these ancient ruins was, and I walked through the Historic District in search of useful information to help me reach my goal. Surprisingly, there were passersby who were just as lost as I was; they even sent me to San Francisco Street and around Plaza Ribero.
![1000135922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX1dJ8eA2LEmE9vVVbsXRFCZRAtWMReDFsQG4Ny8GansWaLeJgKRiNTZq6z1w1xQEXG.jpg)
Finally, I ran into a former coworker who was on his way to his godchildren’s graduation Mass at the Basilica of Santa Ines; he told me that the entrance to the castle was right by the church. Although this event was scheduled, I went over anyway to get more information about it. When I mentioned that I was alone, they let me in, but told me that the tour guides were busy with other events.
![1000135898.png](image-1-1000135898.png)![1000135920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMYNqXYtmoDTMePG1pSXYJVXrQVRvkcK5GH1rpzFexH6vx8iESpkJN3VoamUsJtkA3b.jpg)
The entrance is near the Lourdes Grotto; I went in that way via a flight of stairs. The area is surrounded by railings that serve as a safety barrier. The view is incredible; on one side, you can see the side of the Basilica of Saint Agnes, majestic as always. You can also see the rooftops of some houses and the lush vegetation typical of this area. The only building visible here is a small chapel, painted beige and white with beautiful designs along its edges and a large wooden door. Inside are some plaster figures; this space is used for prayer—a more intimate sanctuary for the faithful.
![1000135914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x176gtHEEGuYTz3Tygj6kaCZgMUz4u9BkFUjGFLGs73v6XKTrdsd5ctaorGSYAynJic.jpg)
Another striking feature of this place is the floor, which is covered with various stones. There are also some statues adorning the gardens, which are beautiful though sparsely vegetated. Since I was alone, I was able to enjoy the place in all its splendor; I was given complete freedom to explore and discover, a situation I took full advantage of.
![1000135906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgPfsxUP741keDNwtCDxgx8kgkqmRZg27wg8FUVtGy7k2ZzPJCpLQNV2SRkKYSSzfAm.jpg)
The Santa Maria de la Cabeza Castle became the most important in Cumana by 1673, as it served as the city’s main barracks and military garrison, as well as the residence of Governor Sancho Fernandez de Angulo y Sandoval. However, the powerful earthquake of 1797 destroyed the fortress; those ruins are still visible from Sucre Street, next to the Basilica of Santa Ines. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Desde hace mucho tiempo quería visitar el Castillo Santa María de la cabeza, me llenaba de curiosidad cada vez que observaba la pequeña capilla desde la calle Bartolomé Salóm. Empecé a investigar para saber cuál era la entrada a estas ruinas antiguas, recorrí el Casco Histórico en busca de una información útil para lograr mi objetivo. De forma sorprendente, había transeúntes que estaban tan perdidos como yo, incluso me enviaron a la calle San Francisco y por los lados de la Plaza Ribero.
![1000135922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX1dJ8eA2LEmE9vVVbsXRFCZRAtWMReDFsQG4Ny8GansWaLeJgKRiNTZq6z1w1xQEXG.jpg)
Finalmente me topé con un antiguo compañero de trabajo, quien iba a la misa de graduación de sus ahijados en la Basílica Santa Inés, él me indicó que la entrada a ese castillo era precisamente por la iglesia. Aunque estaba pautado este acto, igual me acerqué para que me suministrarán más información al respecto. Al indicar que estaba sola me dieron acceso al lugar, pero me dijeron que los guías turísticos estaban ocupados en otros eventos.
![1000135898.png](image-1-1000135898.png)![1000135920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMYNqXYtmoDTMePG1pSXYJVXrQVRvkcK5GH1rpzFexH6vx8iESpkJN3VoamUsJtkA3b.jpg)
La entrada queda cerca de la gruta de Lourdes, por allí ingresé a través de unas escaleras. El lugar está cercado por barandas que sirven de protección. La vista es increíble, de un lado se puede observar la parte lateral de la Basílica Santa Inés, majestuosa como de costumbre. También se ve el techado de algunas casas y la vegetación abundante que se suele apreciar en esta zona. La única edificación que se percibe en este lugar es una pequeña capilla, la cual viste de beige y blanco con hermosos diseños en sus bordes y una gran puerta de madera. Adentro están algunas figuras de yeso, este espacio sirve para la oración. Un refugio más íntimo para los fieles creyentes.
![1000135914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23x176gtHEEGuYTz3Tygj6kaCZgMUz4u9BkFUjGFLGs73v6XKTrdsd5ctaorGSYAynJic.jpg)
Otro elemento llamativo de este lugar es el piso debido a que diversas piedras cubren su superficie. También se observan algunas figuras adornando los jardines, bonitos aunque con poca vegetación. Al estar sola disfruté del lugar en todo su esplendor, me concedieron plena libertad para explorar y conocer, situación que aproveché al máximo.
![1000135906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgPfsxUP741keDNwtCDxgx8kgkqmRZg27wg8FUVtGy7k2ZzPJCpLQNV2SRkKYSSzfAm.jpg)
El Castillo Santa María de la Cabeza llegó a ser el más importante de Cumaná para el año de 1673 debido a que era el cuartel principal y guarnición militar de la ciudad, además de residencia del gobernador Sancho Fernández de Ángulo y Sandoval. Sin embargo, el fuerte terremoto ocurrido en 1797 destruyó la fortaleza, esas ruinas son las que aún se observan desde la calle Sucre, al lado de la Basílica de Santa Inés. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.title: [ESP-ENG] Te enseño paso a paso a hacer delicioso Hummus de Caraotas Negras // I'll teach you step by step how to make delicious Black Bean Hummus
title.body:
Saludos mis queridos amigos de Gems, es un verdadero placer para mi estar nuevamente con todos ustedes. El día de hoy les traigo un delicioso **Hummus de Caraotas Negras.** Realmente queda super sabroso y con ese sabor a comino que me encanta. Aunque habitualmente esta preparación se hace con garbanzos me encantó probar esta variante porque queda con un sabor muy similar. Es muy fácil de hacer, a continuación les muestro el paso a paso para su preparación. >Greetings my dear friends at Gems! It's a true pleasure to be with you all again. Today I'm bringing you a delicious **Black Bean Hummus.** It's incredibly tasty and has that cumin flavor I love. Although this dish is usually made with chickpeas, I loved trying this variation because it has a very similar taste. It's very easy to make; below I'll show you the step by step instructions. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekStrTtrzW6fryjjv6epEphortBcXyfMPR2JibqKyWYY/1788053519045.jpg)
**Ingredientes:**
• 2 tazas de caraotas negras cocidas y escurridas. • 1 cucharadita de comino. • 2 dientes de ajo. • 4 cucharadas de aceite de oliva. • 1 cucharadita de sal. • 1/4 cucharadita de pimienta negra. • Jugo de 1 limón pequeño. • 4 o 5 cucharadas de agua para suavizar la preparación. >
**Ingredients:**
• 2 cups cooked and drained black beans. • 1 teaspoon cumin. • 2 cloves garlic. • 4 tablespoons olive oil. • 1 teaspoon salt. • 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. • Juice of 1 small lemon. • 4 or 5 tablespoons water to thin the mixture. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCV8wDCJ3KpjHViVheDfknCRXMwPcWR2TorCpaU5N6i3/1788053643373.jpg)
**Paso a paso:**
>
**Step by step:**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme1oBVkWsY5NL3qKtZpKghC2sSqCL9wFBmxLuEs2MGPfb/1788053864830.jpg) Vamos a iniciar nuestra preparación agregando en la licuadora las caraotas previamente cocidas, yo las cocine en la olla de presión por 30 minutos, escurri, deje enfríar y lista para preparar. Seguidamente agregamos el agua y el aceite de oliva. Llevamos a licuar para que vaya agarrando consistencia ya que mi licuadora no tiene mucha potencia. Cuando la mayoría de los granos se hayan procesado retiramos. >Let's begin our preparation by adding the previously cooked black beans to the blender. I cooked mine in a pressure cooker for 30 minutes, drained them, let them cool, and they're ready to use. Next, add the water and olive oil. Blend until it reaches the desired consistency, as my blender isn't very powerful. Once most of the beans have been processed, remove the blender. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRFhxgKabYrPQKHLmuV32MBsKZcHW7AKyRpTjVBUg4Ka8/1788054750940.jpg) Seguidamente añadimos el ajo, la sal, comino, pimienta, y jugo de limón. >Next add the garlic, salt, cumin, pepper, and lemon juice. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNiJSwLyu442LUbDCwh2cWLpmLkyEUE38HJr1riLjFK6h/1788054824478.jpg) Llevamos nuevamente a licuar, dejando descansar la licuadora y removiendo la mezcla para ayudar a la incorporación de todos los ingredientes. Estará listo este delicioso hummus cuando se haya integrado por completo y nos quede una prepración espesa. >Blend again, letting the blender rest and stirring the mixture occasionally to help incorporate all the ingredients. This delicious hummus will be ready when it's completely smooth and has a thick consistency. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfGKcUQeaPxowJQhzgbunaqN8jbQGbiYZvbEHRGt1v1fe/1788054919385.jpg) Servimos en un envase, hacemos las ondas características del hummus, agregamos encima un chorrito de aceite de oliva, comino en polvo y unas hojas de cilantro picado en el centro. Todo esto es opcional para decorar. Acompañamos con pan arabe integral tostado. >Serve in a container, swirl it into the characteristic hummus swirls, drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with ground cumin, and add a few chopped cilantro leaves in the center. These are all optional garnishes. We serve it with toasted whole wheat pita bread. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwv4LA2qYSHfHThBmwmHXynXBXAdCBxgcRQVyr7k38We/1788054985067.jpg)
**El resultado final de mi delicioso Hummus de Caraotas Negras.**
>
**The final result of my delicious Black Bean Hummus.**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbGuY2Wh6JkhDzdySb4waRnTwA1SMdgDs4xu8kAVGuCdj/1788055049846.jpg) Hasta aquí mi receta del día de hoy, muchas gracias a todos los amigos de la comunidad por su importante apoyo a mis publicaciones. Me despido hasta la próxima receta apreciados amigos. >That's all for today's recipe. Thank you so much to all the friends in the community for your important support of my posts. Until the next recipe dear friends.

title.title: [Movie] DJANGO UNCHAINED (2012) (EN-ES) | REVIEW 🎬
title.body:
> Many, many years ago, cinema experienced a phenomenon known as the spaghetti Western. The Western genre consists of films set in the Old West. This particular subgenre conquered the film and television industries during the 1960s and 1970s; an entire generation grew up watching the legends of gunslingers and outlaws. Children back then dreamed of becoming a sheriff cowboy, riding horses into the sunset, and catching outlaws with a lasso—or becoming the criminal with a **“Wanted”** poster. Everyone wanted to be like Arthur Morgan from Red Dead Redemption 2. Directed by Quentin Tarantino, this film uses the classic spaghetti Western trope and applies his distinctive style to create what he himself called a **“Southern.”** The story takes place in the American South, not the West.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAUmMM2pCUauCYKvGaX1PvtPoS7ryZRRKo1k4MhpQees/2ozklizubvzxxzifzv7hi68d6xf.webp)
**\

** pays tribute to filmmakers such as Sergio Corbucci and Sergio Leone, who were stars of the Western genre. This can best be seen in the scenes where the camera moves with dramatic zooms, uses wide shots of desolate landscapes, and features action choreography built around extremely realistic violence.

The story takes place in 1858, when Django, a slave, is freed from his chains by Dr. King Schultz, a former German dentist turned expert bounty hunter. Schultz needs Django to identify a group of outlaws, so in exchange for his services, he promises him complete freedom. Together, they travel across the country hunting down criminals.

As they forge an unusual friendship during the winter, their business partnership reaches a point where they embark on a dangerous mission: They enter the heart of Mississippi’s deadly plantations with the sole objective of finding and rescuing Broomhilda, Django’s wife, who was sold to an eccentric landowner.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkYMsaex9p8eDFUw7VzBUiKZctq8a1zVdyFQiVfLY26L/oxgt9e7fiwojd99cn1p764c83eo.webp)</center>

By transferring the aesthetic of the Old West to the American South during the years before the Civil War, the director manages to revive a genre that had already seemed unviable in modern times. Tarantino achieved this by combining violence with straightforward, easy-to-understand dialogue.

Gunslinging cowboys were the greatest. They staged shootouts and completely destroyed saloons. That was the superhero genre of its time. The Western had conquered everything, but trends pass quickly, and as the years went by, the genre became ordinary until it was forgotten. Yet it never truly disappeared; it simply went unnoticed until it resurfaced in this film.

There is something in Django’s story that makes his development feel epic. Django begins completely alone, the victim of a system that oppresses him miserably. He is nothing more than a tool, with no family, no friends, and nothing of value.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRzCoc3TSfRpugk51XBfqeyPEKkm4hEbquUcq6cX7DU85/lvci3motumvebods1og7qov6lfc.webp)</center>

It is not until someone gives him the chance to become a free man that he finally gains the strength to break the chains binding him to a life of misery. Django prepares himself to fight for what he wants—for what he believes in, what he deserves, and the people he loves. That leads him on an adventure that transforms him from a slave into a gunslinger.

It is the story of a man seeking justice in an unjust world, because when life gives you no choice but to fight, you have no other option. In our own way, we all carry chains that limit us until they break our spirits. But no matter how bad the situation is or how heavy the circumstances may be, there is always a small opportunity to change things dramatically.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFwCuP1XJ9uYqRR9m5eNNhosZYP4BnVjCMLnyqRaWTZK/9inyeccekbs5g0ekb4p0zbq9dix.webp)</center>

As the film shows, being African American in 1858 was practically a sentence. Life was very different from what we are accustomed to today; it was an extremely difficult time. Not only that, but the law was highly unstable, and people were accustomed to taking the law into their own hands. Bounty hunters were simply people looking for work in the most conventional way they could think of, because carrying a weapon was as normal as wearing a hat.

It is difficult to discuss these subjects, so I will focus entirely on the film and what I thought of it, so we do not stray from the topic. The film’s successful impact is mainly due to its cast, who elevate their characters to iconic status.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaM6sWZw69fTnF4E198dPhB3ozLJmS6mydQXSdqYdZ144/yr4u0pp4mo6xc8acmjdlailx7ef.webp)</center>

Jamie Foxx plays Django, and he is an imposing actor in his own right. But as Django, his fascinating evolution becomes clear: he goes from being a traumatized slave to becoming an unstoppable action hero. He established himself with Django and triumphed as Django.

Christoph Waltz, in the role of Dr. King Schultz, is undoubtedly the most fascinating character because he is an intellectual. He delivers monologues that will amaze you, and his charisma, overflowing with confidence, is captivating. His performance earned him an Oscar.

Leonardo DiCaprio plays Calvin Candie as an actor willing to push the limits of his craft. DiCaprio has often been seen as the hero of the story, but in this film he is a charming antagonist who can be intimidating when he chooses to be. His role is that of a true monster whose cruelty hides behind a false Southern courtesy. It is very different from what DiCaprio had done before, but he literally put blood and sweat into the role. There is even a scene in which DiCaprio injures his hand badly enough to make it bleed, yet he never broke character.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfH4uxUWxMEgXN179ZbaCSeXNfU4UGxTmL9rraQkNFJ1c/pbkoiqd9skjnig5w1hj0fu02bjp.webp)</center>

Samuel L. Jackson plays the daring servant Stephen, who delivers the most complex performance. Knowing Samuel’s history with these subjects, it is admirable how he portrays the role. Stephen represents an alienated loyalty to a system that literally has him on his knees. It is difficult to put into words, but in my opinion, Jackson did an excellent job.

Beyond the entertainment that a film about wild gunslingers can provide, the movie conceals a reflection on one of the darkest periods in American history. The brutality of slavery at the time was far more severe than what is shown or even mentioned. Innocent men and women were abused in unimaginable ways. Django is the emblematic character who represents the spirit of freedom, empowerment, resistance, and poetic justice.

Tarantino does not soften the subject. He uses cinematic exaggeration to dismantle the romanticization of the Old South, exposing the dehumanization that was normal at the time.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWcT7BmyTbGyy9LghnXSUAvWaYBb8evDz2HbLHsvHdCLC/sjzkesj13ebnffgyqhqu0tksqan.webp)</center>

By giving an oppressed man the power to become the agent of his own liberation and revenge, the film offers a satisfying fantasy about the need to destroy, from the ground up, the systems that promote injustice through oppressive structures. To me, this film is a historical reinvention that speaks about taking control of your life despite difficulties. If you are given the opportunity, everything bad can be left behind.

**\

** is one of Tarantino’s most memorable works in contemporary cinema, which is why it is one of the most notable productions in his filmography. The way it balances historical tragedy with action and humor allows viewers to understand exactly what life was like at the time. Every now and then, we all enjoy explosive action; it is like watching fireworks.

Tarantino’s creative genius comes from a highly distinctive vision that involves firearms in most of his films. Although his explicit violence can be overwhelming for some viewers, every aesthetic decision serves a narrative purpose that adds significance to the film.

In the end, **\

** is a satisfying cinematic experience for its audience. Those moments of frustration become worthwhile when you see just how far a man with nothing to lose is willing to go.


<center>![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)</center>



<details>

<summary>Original version in Spanish</summary>

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSETdTVw8aM24Wvt8QPCb32gTraujDyDd7kpP91nh1LUn/w6fs4bije1naeilo9kwac1y6bvp.webp)</center>

Hace mucho pero muchos años, el cine tuvo un fenómeno conocido como spaghetti wéstern. El género cinematográfico de **\

** son todas aquellas cintas ambientadas en el viejo oeste, ese subgénero en particular conquistó la industria del cine y la televisión en los años de 1960-1970, toda una generación se crió viendo la leyenda del pistolero y el forajido. \n\nLos niños de aquel entonces soñaban con ser un vaquero comisario, como montar a caballo y cabalgar hacia el atardecer y atrapar con un lazo a los forajidos. O ser el delincuente con un cartel de **\

** Todos querían ser como Arthur Morgan de Red Dead Redemption 2.\n\nDirigido por Quentin Tarantino, está película usa el ya clásico tropo del spaghetti wéstern y le aplica su estilo para crear lo que él mismo denominó un \

. Ya que la historia se ambienta en el Sur de estados unidos, no en el oeste. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAUmMM2pCUauCYKvGaX1PvtPoS7ryZRRKo1k4MhpQees/2ozklizubvzxxzifzv7hi68d6xf.webp)</center>

**\

** rinde homenaje a cineastas como Sergio Corbucci y Sergio Leone, quienes eran estrellas del género wéstern. Eso puede apreciarse mejor en esas escenas en dónde la cámara se mueve haciendo zooms dramáticos, encuadres amplios de paisajes desolados y una coreografía en los momentos de acción que usa una violencia es muy realista.

La historia se ambienta en 1858, en donde Django, un esclavo que es liberado de sus cadenas por el Dr. King Schultz, un ex dentista alemán convertido en un experto cazarrecompensas. Schultz necesita a Django para identificar a unos forajidos, por lo que a cambio de sus servicios, le promete su libertad total. Por lo que ambos viajan por el país asesinado malhechores.

A medida que forjan una inusual amistad durante el invierno, su asociación comercial llega a un punto en el que se aventuran en una misión peligrosa: Se adentran en el corazón de las letales plantaciones de Mississippi con el único objetivo de encontrar y rescatar a Broomhilda, la esposa de Django, quien fue vendida a un excéntrico terrateniente. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkYMsaex9p8eDFUw7VzBUiKZctq8a1zVdyFQiVfLY26L/oxgt9e7fiwojd99cn1p764c83eo.webp)</center>

Al trasladar la estética del Viejo Oeste al sur de los Estados Unidos en la época previa a la Guerra Civil, el director logra revivir un género que ya parecía inviable en tiempos modernos; pero Tarantino lo logró gracias a combinación de la violencia con los diálogos simples de entender.

Los vaqueros pistoleros eran lo máximo, hacían tiroteos y destruían una cantina por completo, eso fue el género de superhéroes de aquel entonces, el **\

** lo había conquistado todo, pero las modas pasan volando y conforme pasaron los años el género se normalizó hasta quedar en el olvido. Pero el género no desapareció, pasó desapercibido hasta que resurgió en esta película. 

Y hay algo en la historia de Django que hace que su desarrollo sea épico: Django comienza completamente solo, siendo víctima de un sistema que lo oprime miserablemente, no es nada más que una herramienta. Sin familia, sin amigos, sin nada de valor. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRzCoc3TSfRpugk51XBfqeyPEKkm4hEbquUcq6cX7DU85/lvci3motumvebods1og7qov6lfc.webp)</center>

No es hasta que alguien le da la oportunidad de ser un hombre libre que por fin adquiere la fuerza de romper las cadenas que lo ataban a una vida llena de miseria. Django se preparo para luchar por lo que quiere: por lo que cree, por lo que merece y por sus seres queridos. Eso lo llevo a la aventura que lo transformo de esclavo a pistolero. 

Es un historia de un hombre que busca justicia en un mundo injusto, por que cuando la vida solo te da la opción de luchar, no te queda otra opción. A nuestra manera, todos cargamos con cadenas que nos limitan hasta doblegar nuestro espíritu, pero sin importar que tan mal este la situación o que tan pesadas sean las circunstancias, siempre existe una mínima oportunidad para cambiar las cosas de sobremanera. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFwCuP1XJ9uYqRR9m5eNNhosZYP4BnVjCMLnyqRaWTZK/9inyeccekbs5g0ekb4p0zbq9dix.webp)</center>

Tal y como se muestra en la película, ser afroamericano en 1858 era prácticamente una condena, en ese entonces el estilo de vida era muy diferente al que estamos acostumbrados en la actualidad, era la máxima dificultad. Y no solo eso, la ley era algo muy inestable, las personas acostumbraban a tomar la ley por mano propia. Los cazarrecompensas eran personas que simplemente buscaban trabajo de la manera más convencional que se les ocurría porque tener un arma era tan normal como tener sombrero.  

Es difícil hablar de estos temas así que me enfocaré de lleno en la película y en qué me pareció para no para no desviarnos del tema...El exitoso impacto de esta película se debe principalmente gracias al elenco que eleva a sus personajes a la categoría de iconos. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaM6sWZw69fTnF4E198dPhB3ozLJmS6mydQXSdqYdZ144/yr4u0pp4mo6xc8acmjdlailx7ef.webp)</center>

Jamie Foxx es quien interpreta a Django, y él es un sujeto que impone por actuar como el mismo, pero al ser Django, es notoria una evolución fascinante, pasando de ser un esclavo traumado a convertirse en un héroe de acción implacable. Se consagró con Django y triunfo como Django.

Christoph Waltz en su papel del Dr King Schultz, es sin duda el personaje más fascinante por ser un intelectual, tiene monólogos que te maravillaran y su carisma tan rebosante de confianza te sorprenderá (su actuación lo hizo ganar un Oscar)

Leonardo DiCaprio interpreta a Calvin Candie como un actor que está dispuesto a superar los límites de la actuación, a Dicaprio siempre se le ha visto como el heroe de la historia, pero en esta cinta es un antagonista encantador que puede ser intimidante cuando se lo propone. Su papel es el de un verdadero monstruo cuya crueldad se esconde detrás de una falsa cortesía sureña. Es algo muy diferente a lo que Dicaprio ha hecho, pero literalmente puso sangre y sudor en desempeñar su rol. (Literalmente hay una escena en la que Dicaprio se hiere la mano al punto de hacerse sangrar, pero no se salió del personaje) 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfH4uxUWxMEgXN179ZbaCSeXNfU4UGxTmL9rraQkNFJ1c/pbkoiqd9skjnig5w1hj0fu02bjp.webp)</center>

Samuel L. Jackson, interpreta al audaz sirviente Stephen, quien ofrece la actuación más compleja (sabiendo como es Samuel con estos temas, es admirable como caracteriza su papel), representando la lealtad alienada hacia un sistema que literalmente lo tiene de rodillas contra el suelo, es muy complicado de poner en palabras, pero hizo un buen trabajo a mi parecer. 

Más allá del entretenimiento que puede generar una película de pistoleros salvajes, el filme esconde una reflexión sobre una de las épocas más oscuras de la historia estadounidense. La brutalidad de la esclavitud de aquel entonces fue mucho más severo del que se llega a mostrar o mencionar, hombres y mujeres inocentes fueron de formas inimaginables. Django es el personaje insignia que representa a el espíritu de la libertad, el empoderamiento, la resistencia y la justicia poética. 

Tarantino no suaviza el tema, utiliza la exageración del cine  para desmantelar la romantización del viejo sur, exponiendo la deshumanización que era normal en aquel entonces. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWcT7BmyTbGyy9LghnXSUAvWaYBb8evDz2HbLHsvHdCLC/sjzkesj13ebnffgyqhqu0tksqan.webp)</center>

Al otorgarle a un hombre oprimido el poder necesario para ser el agente de su propia liberación y venganza, es una fantasía satisfactoria sobre esa necesidad de destruir desde los cimientos los sistemas que promueven la injusticia en estructuras opresivas. Para mí, está cinta es una reinversión histórica que habla sobre tomar con fuerza las riendas de la vida a pesar de las dificultades, si se tiene la oportunidad, todo lo malo puede quedar atrás.

**\

** es una obras memorables de Tarantino en el cine contemporáneo, no por nada es una de las producciones más destacadas de su filmografía. La forma en que logra equilibrar la desgracia histórica con la acción y el humor hace que el espectador pueda entender perfectamente lo que se vivía en aquel entonces. De ves en cuando a todos nos gusta la acción explosiva, son como fuegos artificiales. 

El genio creativo de Tarantino tiene una visión muy peculiar que involucra armas de fuego en su mayoría de películas. Aunque su violencia explícita puede resultar abrumador para algunos espectadores, cada decisión estética tiene un propósito narrativo que le suma importancia al filme. 

Al final, la historia de **\

** es una experiencia cinematográfica satisfactoria para su audiencia. Esos momentos de frustración valdrán la pena cuando veas que tan lejos está dispuesto llegar un hombre que no tiene nada que perder.

title.title: Tardigrades could be alive on the Moon.
title.body:
Tardigrades could be alive on the Moon.


https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqQ6Frt9FDTPnvSRhoSw1LaayGiue2esx7tsqVt8cPdh/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> On April 11, 2019, an Israeli probe named Beresheet attempted to land on the Moon; it was the first lunar landing attempt by a private mission and the first for Israel. The mission's goal was to create a sort of backup copy or archive of Earth. Included in the data carried by the spacecraft was a backup of life on Earth: 30 million pages of information in English—books, dictionaries, languages, and so on—as well as DNA samples from various individuals (specifically 25 people), although only one is publicly known: Nova Spivack, the mission's founder and leader.


The identities of the other 24 people who provided DNA samples remain unknown. The idea was that, in the future, these samples—housed in a sort of \

sent to the Moon—could be retrieved to create clones. While current technology makes this impossible, it might be feasible in the not-too-distant future; however, DNA samples exposed to cosmic radiation do not last more than 50 years—or perhaps 100 at most, depending on the level of protection (which is not well documented). The fact remains that the ark aboard the spacecraft also carried a colony of tardigrades; unfortunately, the craft crashed in the Sea of ​​Serenity, yet it is suspected that the tardigrade colony—or at least part of it—survived.\n


\nThis does not mean that they are currently reproducing or colonizing the Moon; they remain there in a spore-like state until something wets them with liquid water. Although tardigrades are highly resistant to space conditions and radiation, that resilience applies to their dry, dormant form; to live, thrive, reproduce, and mate, they require water—which is why they are known as \

\n


\nThe point is that there are now terrestrial living beings—or at least organisms in a dormant state—on the Moon. They may not be the only ones; in the future, there could be many more. I am not referring to the humans traveling to the Moon, but to the organisms that will accompany them and remain there. On August 16, 2026, NASA released a statement

Researchers studied various organisms—bacteria and fungi that typically travel with us on our skin, in spacesuits, and within habitats—that could survive in a dormant state in the shadowed regions of the lunar south pole. This is precisely where upcoming missions are headed, as the current objective is to reach the lunar south pole, search for water and water ice, and establish a base there.


NASA scientists modeled conditions in three regions near the lunar south pole and discovered that various microbes common to human skin, as well as certain fungi, could survive—at least in a dormant state. These researchers identified survival niches of widely varying sizes, ranging from the floor of a crater spanning several square kilometers to something as small as an astronaut's bootprint. If located within a shadowed zone, those microbes or fungi could remain alive in a dormant state for some time, at the very least.
